import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { readdir } from "node:fs/promises";
import { join } from "node:path";

const ROOTS = ["src", "scripts", "test"];

async function collectJavaScriptFiles(directory) {
  const entries = await readdir(directory, {
    withFileTypes: true,
  });
  const files = [];

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const path = join(directory, entry.name);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      files.push(...await collectJavaScriptFiles(path));
    } else if (
      entry.isFile()
      && entry.name.endsWith(".js")
    ) {
      files.push(path);
    }
  }

  return files;
}

const files = (
  await Promise.all(
    ROOTS.map(collectJavaScriptFiles),
  )
).flat().sort();

for (const file of files) {
  const result = spawnSync(
    process.execPath,
    ["--check", file],
    {
      stdio: "inherit",
    },
  );

  if (result.error) {
    throw result.error;
  }

  if (result.status !== 0) {
    process.exit(result.status ?? 1);
  }
}

console.log(
  `Syntax check passed for ${files.length} JavaScript files.`,
);

// One-shot script to update the Discord bot avatar
// Usage: node set-avatar.js

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const TOKEN = process.env.DISCORD_TOKEN;
if (!TOKEN) {
  try {
    process.loadEnvFile(
      "/etc/discord-bot-server.env",
    );
  } catch (error) {
    if (error?.code !== "ENOENT") throw error;
  }
}

const token = process.env.DISCORD_TOKEN;
if (!token) {
  console.error("DISCORD_TOKEN not found");
  process.exit(1);
}

const imagePath = process.argv[2];
if (!imagePath) {
  console.error("Usage: node set-avatar.js <path-to-image>");
  process.exit(1);
}

const imageBuffer = readFileSync(imagePath);
const base64 = imageBuffer.toString("base64");

// Determine MIME type from extension
const ext = imagePath.split(".").pop().toLowerCase();
const mimeTypes = { jpg: "image/jpeg", jpeg: "image/jpeg", png: "image/png", gif: "image/gif", webp: "image/webp" };
const mime = mimeTypes[ext] || "image/jpeg";

const dataUri = `data:${mime};base64,${base64}`;

console.log(`Image: ${imagePath} (${imageBuffer.length} bytes, ${mime})`);
console.log("Updating bot avatar via Discord API...");

const response = await fetch("https://discord.com/api/v10/users/@me", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    authorization: `Bot ${token}`,
    "content-type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ avatar: dataUri }),
});

if (response.ok) {
  const data = await response.json();
  console.log(`✅ Avatar updated! Username: ${data.username}#${data.discriminator}`);
  console.log(`   Avatar hash: ${data.avatar}`);
} else {
  const error = await response.text();
  console.error(`❌ Failed (${response.status}): ${error}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

import { extractCrossrefRequest } from "./crossref-context.js";
import { extractGitHubRequest } from "./github-context.js";
import { extractOpenAlexRequest } from "./openalex-context.js";
import { extractOpenLibraryRequest } from "./open-library-context.js";
import { needsExpandingLandStatus } from "./game-status.js";
import { needsLegendModPlayerStatus } from "./legend-mod-status.js";
import { extractBoredRequest } from "./bored-context.js";
import { extractDowndetectorRequest } from "./downdetector-context.js";
import { extractWeatherRequest } from "./weather-context.js";
import { extractWikidataRequest } from "./wikidata-context.js";
import { extractWikipediaRequest } from "./wikipedia-context.js";
import { extractWebSearchRequest } from "./web-search-context.js";
import { extractWebpageRequest } from "./webpage-context.js";

function planStep(enabled, label, reason) {
  return {
    enabled,
    label,
    reason,
  };
}

function enabledLine(step, index) {
  const state = step.enabled ? "USE" : "SKIP";
  return `${index + 1}. ${state} ${step.label}: ${step.reason}`;
}

function explicitlyTargetsExpandingLand(question) {
  const text = String(question ?? "").toLowerCase();
  return text.includes("expanding land")
    || text.includes("expanding.land")
    || text.includes("legend ffa")
    || (/\bel\b/i.test(text) && /\b(?:player|players|online|status|map|server|people)\b/i.test(text));
}

export function buildAgentPlan(
  question,
  {
    routing,
    hasImage = false,
    liveStatusAllowed = false,
  } = {},
) {
  const normalizedQuestion = String(question ?? "").trim();
  const wantsCrossref = Boolean(extractCrossrefRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsGitHub = Boolean(extractGitHubRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsOpenAlex = Boolean(extractOpenAlexRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsOpenLibrary = Boolean(extractOpenLibraryRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsWikidata = Boolean(extractWikidataRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsWikipedia = Boolean(extractWikipediaRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsWebpage = Boolean(extractWebpageRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsWebSearch = Boolean(extractWebSearchRequest(normalizedQuestion))
    && !wantsWikipedia
    && !wantsWikidata
    && !wantsCrossref
    && !wantsOpenAlex
    && !wantsOpenLibrary
    && !wantsGitHub
    && !wantsWebpage;
  const wantsWeather = Boolean(extractWeatherRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsBored = Boolean(extractBoredRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsDowndetector = Boolean(extractDowndetectorRequest(normalizedQuestion));
  const wantsLiveLegendStatus = needsLegendModPlayerStatus(normalizedQuestion);
  const wantsLiveGameStatus = needsExpandingLandStatus(normalizedQuestion)
    && (!wantsLiveLegendStatus || explicitlyTargetsExpandingLand(normalizedQuestion));

  const steps = [
    planStep(true, "core answer", "Use bounded built-in knowledge plus the current requester context."),
    planStep(
      Boolean(routing?.intent === "follow_up"),
      "conversation continuity",
      routing?.intent === "follow_up"
        ? "Resolve references from the recent requester thread before answering."
        : "This looks like a fresh question, so no follow-up-only reasoning is needed.",
    ),
    planStep(
      hasImage,
      "image analysis",
      hasImage
        ? "The requester attached an image, so answer using the visible image content too."
        : "No image was attached for this request.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsWeather,
      "Open-Meteo weather lookup",
      wantsWeather
        ? "The requester explicitly asked for current weather or forecast data."
        : "No weather or meteo lookup is needed.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsDowndetector,
      "Downdetector outage lookup",
      wantsDowndetector
        ? "The requester explicitly asked about outage or down-status data."
        : "No Downdetector outage lookup is needed.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsBored,
      "Bored API activity lookup",
      wantsBored
        ? "The requester explicitly asked for an activity suggestion."
        : "No Bored API activity lookup is needed.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsLiveGameStatus && liveStatusAllowed,
      "Expanding Land live status",
      wantsLiveGameStatus
        ? liveStatusAllowed
          ? "The requester asked for current Expanding Land data."
          : "Live Expanding Land data was requested but requester access is restricted."
        : "No current Expanding Land snapshot is needed.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsLiveLegendStatus && liveStatusAllowed,
      "Legend Mod live player feed",
      wantsLiveLegendStatus
        ? liveStatusAllowed
          ? "The requester asked for current Legend Mod player or server data."
          : "Live Legend Mod data was requested but requester access is restricted."
        : "No current Legend Mod player feed is needed.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsWikipedia,
      "Wikipedia lookup",
      wantsWikipedia
        ? "The requester explicitly asked for Wikipedia or Wikimedia article information."
        : "No explicit Wikipedia lookup was requested.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsWikidata,
      "Wikidata lookup",
      wantsWikidata
        ? "The requester explicitly asked for Wikidata entity information."
        : "No explicit Wikidata lookup was requested.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsCrossref,
      "Crossref lookup",
      wantsCrossref
        ? "The requester explicitly asked for Crossref or DOI metadata."
        : "No explicit Crossref lookup was requested.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsOpenAlex,
      "OpenAlex lookup",
      wantsOpenAlex
        ? "The requester explicitly asked for OpenAlex scholarly work metadata."
        : "No explicit OpenAlex lookup was requested.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsOpenLibrary,
      "Open Library lookup",
      wantsOpenLibrary
        ? "The requester explicitly asked for Open Library, ISBN, or book metadata."
        : "No explicit Open Library lookup was requested.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsGitHub,
      "GitHub lookup",
      wantsGitHub
        ? "The requester explicitly asked for GitHub repo history, issues, or releases."
        : "No explicit GitHub lookup was requested.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsWebSearch,
      "public web search",
      wantsWebSearch
        ? "The requester explicitly asked to search or verify something on the web."
        : "No explicit web search was requested.",
    ),
    planStep(
      wantsWebpage,
      "public webpage read",
      wantsWebpage
        ? "The requester explicitly asked about a specific public URL."
        : "No public webpage read was requested.",
    ),
  ];

  const selectedCapabilities = {
    conversationContinuity: routing?.intent === "follow_up",
    imageAnalysis: hasImage,
    weather: wantsWeather,
    downdetector: wantsDowndetector,
    bored: wantsBored,
    liveGameStatus: wantsLiveGameStatus && liveStatusAllowed,
    liveLegendStatus: wantsLiveLegendStatus && liveStatusAllowed,
    wikipedia: wantsWikipedia,
    wikidata: wantsWikidata,
    crossref: wantsCrossref,
    openAlex: wantsOpenAlex,
    openLibrary: wantsOpenLibrary,
    github: wantsGitHub,
    webSearch: wantsWebSearch,
    webpage: wantsWebpage,
  };

  const isMechanicsRequest = /\b(?:how\s+(?:to|does|do|can)|what\s+is|explain|guide|tutorial|install|setup|work|works|feature|mechanic)\b/i.test(normalizedQuestion);
  const isPureLiveRequest = (wantsLiveGameStatus || wantsLiveLegendStatus) && !isMechanicsRequest;

  return {
    selectedCapabilities,
    needsRestrictedLiveAccess:
      (wantsLiveGameStatus || wantsLiveLegendStatus) && !liveStatusAllowed && isPureLiveRequest,
    promptContext: [
      "Agent plan for this request:",
      ...steps.map(enabledLine),
      "Planning rule: use only the enabled capabilities above, keep every external lookup bounded, and never claim to have used a skipped capability.",
    ].join("\n"),
  };
}

const DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODEL_LIST = {
  chat: "yoanndev90/llama-3.1-8b-fast:free",
  reasoning: "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
  code: "yoanndev90/laguna-s-2.1:free",
  vision: "yoanndev90/gemma-4-31b:free",
};

const CODE_PATTERNS = [
  /\bcode\b/i,
  /\bcoding\b/i,
  /\bscript\b/i,
  /\buserscript\b/i,
  /\bjavascript\b/i,
  /\btypescript\b/i,

];

];

function normalizeProvider(provider) {
  return String(provider ?? "groq").trim().toLowerCase();
}

function normalizeAllowedModels(allowedModels) {
  const models = Array.isArray(allowedModels) && allowedModels.length > 0
    ? allowedModels
    : Object.values(DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODEL_LIST);
  return new Set(
    models
      .map((value) => String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean),
  );
}

function firstAllowedModel(allowedModels) {
  return (Array.isArray(allowedModels) ? allowedModels : [])
    .map((value) => String(value ?? "").trim())
    .find(Boolean) ?? null;
}

function pickAllowedModel(preferred, allowedSet, fallbackCandidates) {
  const preferredModel = String(preferred ?? "").trim();
  if (preferredModel && allowedSet.has(preferredModel.toLowerCase())) {
    return preferredModel;
  }

  for (const candidate of fallbackCandidates) {
    const safeCandidate = String(candidate ?? "").trim();
    if (safeCandidate && allowedSet.has(safeCandidate.toLowerCase())) {
      return safeCandidate;
    }
  }

  return preferredModel || null;
}

function matchesAny(text, patterns) {
  return patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(text));
}

function computeProfileScores(question, routing, hasImage) {
  const text = String(question ?? "").trim();
  const scores = {
    chat: 10,
    reasoning: 0,
    code: 0,
    vision: 0,
  };
  const reasons = [];

  if (hasImage) {
    scores.vision += 100;
    reasons.push("has_image_attachment");
  } else if (matchesAny(text, VISION_PATTERNS)) {
    scores.vision += 30;
    reasons.push("vision_keywords_found");
  }

  if (matchesAny(text, CODE_PATTERNS)) {
    scores.code += 50;
    reasons.push("code_keywords_found");
  }

  if (routing?.intent === "live_data_request") {
    scores.reasoning += 40;
    reasons.push("live_data_intent");
  }
  if (matchesAny(text, REASONING_PATTERNS)) {
    scores.reasoning += 30;
    reasons.push("reasoning_keywords_found");
  }

  // Determine top score profile
  let topProfile = "chat";
  let topScore = scores.chat;

  for (const [prof, score] of Object.entries(scores)) {
    if (score > topScore) {
      topScore = score;
      topProfile = prof;
    }
  }

  return { profile: topProfile, profileScores: scores, routeReasons: reasons };
}

export const DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS = Object.freeze({
  ...DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODEL_LIST,
});

export function resolveAiRoute({
  provider = "groq",
  question = "",
  routing = null,
  configuredModel = "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
  modelRoutingEnabled = true,
  allowedModels = [],
  routeModels = DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS,
  hasImage = false,
} = {}) {
  const selectedProvider = normalizeProvider(provider);
  const fallbackModel = String(configuredModel ?? "").trim();

  if (selectedProvider !== "pollinations" || !modelRoutingEnabled) {
    return {
      provider: selectedProvider,
      model: fallbackModel,
      profile: "default",
      routingEnabled: false,
      profileScores: { chat: 10, reasoning: 0, code: 0, vision: 0 },
      routeReasons: ["routing_disabled_or_groq"],
    };
  }

  const allowedSet = normalizeAllowedModels(allowedModels);
  if (allowedSet.size === 0) {
    return {
      provider: selectedProvider,
      model: fallbackModel,
      profile: "default",
      routingEnabled: false,
      profileScores: { chat: 10, reasoning: 0, code: 0, vision: 0 },
      routeReasons: ["no_allowed_models"],
    };
  }

  const { profile, profileScores, routeReasons } = computeProfileScores(question, routing, hasImage);
  const routeModelConfig = routeModels && typeof routeModels === "object"
    ? routeModels
    : DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS;
  const firstAllowed = firstAllowedModel(allowedModels);
  const model = pickAllowedModel(
    routeModelConfig[profile],
    allowedSet,
    [fallbackModel, firstAllowed],
  );

  return {
    provider: selectedProvider,
    model: model || fallbackModel,
    profile,
    routingEnabled: true,
    profileScores,
    routeReasons,
  };
}

const HUMAN_SCOPE_REDIRECT =
  "I mainly help here with Legend Mod, Agar.io, Expanding Land, LC, plus bounded lookups like weather, Wikipedia, Wikidata, Crossref, OpenAlex, Open Library, GitHub, public webpages or web search, Downdetector, and activity suggestions. If you want, ask me about one of those and I will help.";

const UNEXTRACTED_LEARN_MARKER_PATTERN = /<!--LEARN:.*?-->/gs;
const MENTION_PATTERN = /@(everyone|here)|<@&\d+>/g;

export function validateAnswer(answer, _context = {}) {
  let clean = String(answer ?? "").trim();
  if (!clean) return { valid: false, cleanAnswer: "", issues: ["empty_answer"] };

  const issues = [];

  // Check for OFF_TOPIC response
  if (clean.startsWith("OFF_TOPIC") || clean.includes("OFF_TOPIC_RESPONSE")) {
    issues.push("off_topic_redirect");
    clean = HUMAN_SCOPE_REDIRECT;
  }

  // Remove leftover unextracted LEARN markers
  if (UNEXTRACTED_LEARN_MARKER_PATTERN.test(clean)) {
    issues.push("unextracted_learn_marker");
    clean = clean.replace(UNEXTRACTED_LEARN_MARKER_PATTERN, "").trim();
  }

  // Neutralize role/everyone mentions
  if (MENTION_PATTERN.test(clean)) {
    issues.push("sanitized_mentions");
    clean = clean
      .replace(/@everyone/g, "@everyone-disabled")
      .replace(/@here/g, "@here-disabled")
      .replace(/<@&(\d+)>/g, "@role");
  }

  // Deduplicate identical consecutive paragraphs
  const paragraphs = clean.split("\n\n");
  const uniqueParagraphs = [];
  for (const paragraph of paragraphs) {
    const trimmed = paragraph.trim();
    if (trimmed && uniqueParagraphs.at(-1) !== trimmed) {
      uniqueParagraphs.push(trimmed);
    } else if (trimmed && uniqueParagraphs.at(-1) === trimmed) {
      issues.push("duplicate_paragraph_removed");
    }
  }
  clean = uniqueParagraphs.join("\n\n");

  // Enforce max length safety
  if (clean.length > 3_500) {
    issues.push("truncated_over_limit");
    clean = `${clean.slice(0, 3_497)}...`;
  }

  return {
    valid: issues.length === 0,
    cleanAnswer: clean,
    issues,
  };
}

export class AskRateLimiter {
  constructor({
    globalLimit = 25,
    globalWindowMs = 60_000,
  } = {}) {
    this.globalLimit = globalLimit;
    this.globalWindowMs = globalWindowMs;
    this.globalRequests = [];
  }

  claim(now = Date.now()) {
    this.globalRequests =
      this.globalRequests.filter(
        (timestamp) =>
          now - timestamp < this.globalWindowMs,
      );

    if (
      this.globalRequests.length
      >= this.globalLimit
    ) {
      return { allowed: false };
    }

    this.globalRequests.push(now);

    return { allowed: true };
  }
}

export const defaultAskRateLimiter = new AskRateLimiter();

}

function deltaWatchStartMessage(started, durationMinutes) {
  const replaceLine = started.replaced
    ? ` Previous watch closed: \`${started.replacedServerToken}\`.`
    : "";
  const tagLine = started.clanTag
    ? ` Using tag \`${started.clanTag}\`.`
    : "";

  if (started.watchChat && started.watchParticipants) {
    return `Starting a live Delta chat and participant watch for \`${started.displayServer}\` for up to ${durationMinutes} minutes.${tagLine}${replaceLine} New chat lines plus tracked participant counts, names, and join/leave changes will appear here as they arrive. Anyone can stop the current watch by asking to close or stop the Delta chat connection.`;
  }

  if (started.watchParticipants) {
    return `Starting a live Delta participant watch for \`${started.displayServer}\` for up to ${durationMinutes} minutes.${tagLine}${replaceLine} I will post tracked participant counts, names, and join/leave changes here as they arrive. Anyone can stop the current watch by asking to close or stop the Delta chat connection.`;
  }

  return `Starting a live Delta chat watch for \`${started.displayServer}\` for up to ${durationMinutes} minutes.${tagLine}${replaceLine} New chat and command lines will appear here as they arrive. Anyone can stop the current watch by asking to close or stop the Delta chat connection.`;
}

function deltaParticipantSnapshotMessage(snapshot) {
  const target = snapshot.clanTag
    ? `${snapshot.displayServer} with tag \`${snapshot.clanTag}\``
    : snapshot.displayServer;
  const sampleNames = Array.isArray(snapshot.names) ? snapshot.names : [];
  const namesLine = sampleNames.length === 0
    ? ""
    : sampleNames.length < snapshot.participantCount
      ? ` Showing ${sampleNames.length} names: ${sampleNames.join(", ")}.`
      : ` Names: ${sampleNames.join(", ")}.`;

  return `There are currently ${snapshot.participantCount} tracked Delta chat users on \`${target}\`.${namesLine}`;
}

function liveAccessDeniedMessage() {
  return message(
    "Live Legend Mod and Expanding Land status is available only to LC candidates, members, and staff.",
  );
}

export function questionTextFromInteraction(interaction) {
  return String(
    interaction.data?.options
      ?.find((option) => option.name === "question")
      ?.value ?? "",
  ).trim();
}

function optionValue(interaction, name) {
  return interaction.data?.options?.find((option) => option.name === name)?.value ?? null;
}

function attachmentFromInteraction(interaction, name = "image") {
  const attachmentId = optionValue(interaction, name);
  if (!attachmentId) return null;

  const attachment = interaction.data?.resolved?.attachments?.[attachmentId] ?? null;
  if (!attachment?.url) return null;

  const contentType = String(attachment.content_type ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (contentType && !IMAGE_CONTENT_TYPES.has(contentType)) {
    return null;
  }

  return attachment;
}

function imageAttachmentsFromMessage(message) {
  const attachments = Array.isArray(message.attachments) ? message.attachments : [];
  return attachments.filter((attachment) => {
    const contentType = String(attachment?.content_type ?? "").toLowerCase();
    if (contentType && IMAGE_CONTENT_TYPES.has(contentType)) return true;
    return /\.(?:png|jpe?g|webp|gif)(?:\?|$)/i.test(String(attachment?.url ?? ""));
  });
}

function questionFromInteraction(interaction) {
  const question = questionTextFromInteraction(interaction);

  if (
    !question
    || question.length > MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "The question must contain between 1 and 500 characters",
    );
  }

  return question;
}

function validatedQuestion(question) {
  const trimmed = String(question ?? "").trim();

  if (
    !trimmed
    || trimmed.length > MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "The question must contain between 1 and 500 characters",
    );
  }

  return trimmed;
}

export function deferredAskResponse() {
  return {
    type: 5,
    data: {},
  };
}

const LEARN_MARKER_PATTERN =
  /<!--LEARN:(.*?)-->/gs;

export function extractLearnMarkers(answer) {
  const markers = [];
  const cleanAnswer = String(answer ?? "").replace(
    LEARN_MARKER_PATTERN,
    (_fullMatch, jsonPayload) => {
    try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonPayload);

        if (
          parsed
          && typeof parsed === "object"
          && typeof parsed.action === "string"
          && typeof parsed.subject === "string"
          && parsed.subject.trim()
        ) {
          markers.push(parsed);
        }
      } catch {
        // Malformed JSON — skip
      }
      return "";
    },
  );

  return {
    cleanAnswer: cleanAnswer.trim(),
    markers,
  };
}

export async function buildAskMessageFromText(
  question,
  {
    aiProvider = "groq",
    apiKey,
    groqApiKey,
    pollinationsApiKey,
    model,
    aiModelRoutingEnabled = true,
    pollinationsAllowedModels = [],
    pollinationsRouteModels = null,
    requesterContext,
    requesterIdentity,
    discussionMemory,
    userQuestionMemory,
    recentImageMemory,
    userMemoryKey,
    playerProfiles,
    playerProfileInteraction = null,
    communityKnowledge,
    limiter = defaultAskRateLimiter,
    gameStatusUrl,
    gamePlayingCapacity,
    gameSpectatorCapacity,
    gameBotCount,
    channelName,
    downdetectorApiToken = null,
    downdetectorClientId = null,
    downdetectorClientSecret = null,
    downdetectorDefaultCountry = null,
    legendModStatusUrl,
    legendModWebSocketCtor,
    liveStatusFailureReporter,
    legendModStatusFailureReporter,
    deltaChatWatcher,
    guildId = null,
    channelId = null,
    requesterId = null,
    requesterName = "unknown",
    imageUrls = [],
    allowedDomains = [],
    fetchImpl = fetch,
    resolveHostname = undefined,
  },
) {
  let resolvedImageUrls = Array.isArray(imageUrls) ? [...imageUrls] : [];
  if (resolvedImageUrls.length > 0 && recentImageMemory && requesterId && channelId) {
    recentImageMemory.rememberImages({ guildId, channelId, userId: requesterId, imageUrls: resolvedImageUrls });
  } else if (resolvedImageUrls.length === 0 && recentImageMemory && requesterId && channelId && isImageReferencingPrompt(question)) {
    resolvedImageUrls = recentImageMemory.getRecentImages({ guildId, channelId, userId: requesterId });
  }
  const normalizedQuestion = validatedQuestion(question);
  const deltaChatWatchStopRequest =
    extractDeltaChatWatchStopRequest(normalizedQuestion);
  if (deltaChatWatchStopRequest) {
    const activeWatch = deltaChatWatcher?.status?.() ?? null;
    if (!activeWatch) {
      return message(
        "No live Delta chat watch is active right now.",
      );
    }

    await deltaChatWatcher.stop(
      `stopped by ${requesterName}`,
      { notify: true },
    );

    return message(
      `Closed the live Delta chat watch for \`${activeWatch.displayServer}\`. Anyone can stop the current watch by asking to close or stop the Delta chat connection.`,
    );
  }

  const deltaChatWatchRequest =
    extractDeltaChatWatchRequest(normalizedQuestion);
  const liveStatusAllowed =
    typeof requesterContext === "string"
    && LIVE_STATUS_ALLOWED_PATTERN.test(requesterContext);

  if (deltaChatWatchRequest) {
    if (!liveStatusAllowed) {
      return liveAccessDeniedMessage();
    }

    if (!deltaChatWatcher) {
      return message(
        "Live Delta chat watch is not configured right now.",
      );
    }

    if (deltaChatWatchRequest.requestMode === "snapshot") {
      const snapshot = await deltaChatWatcher.snapshotParticipants({
        serverToken: deltaChatWatchRequest.serverToken,
        displayServer: deltaChatWatchRequest.displayServer,
        clanTag: deltaChatWatchRequest.clanTag,
      });
      return message(deltaParticipantSnapshotMessage(snapshot));
    }

    const started = await deltaChatWatcher.startWatch({
      channelId,
      requesterId,
      requesterName,
      serverToken: deltaChatWatchRequest.serverToken,
      displayServer: deltaChatWatchRequest.displayServer,
      clanTag: deltaChatWatchRequest.clanTag,
      durationMs: deltaChatWatchRequest.durationMs,
      watchChat: deltaChatWatchRequest.watchChat,
      watchParticipants: deltaChatWatchRequest.watchParticipants,
    });

    const durationMinutes = formatWatchMinutes(
      deltaChatWatchRequest.durationMs ?? DEFAULT_DELTA_CHAT_WATCH_DURATION_MS,
    );

    return message(
      deltaWatchStartMessage(started, durationMinutes),
    );
  }

  return buildAnswerFromText(normalizedQuestion, {
    apiKey,
    groqApiKey,
    pollinationsApiKey,
    aiProvider,
    model,
    aiModelRoutingEnabled,
    pollinationsAllowedModels,
    pollinationsRouteModels,
    requesterContext,
    requesterIdentity,
    discussionMemory,
    userQuestionMemory,
    recentImageMemory,
    userMemoryKey,
    playerProfiles,
    playerProfileInteraction,
    communityKnowledge,
    limiter,
    gameStatusUrl,
    gamePlayingCapacity,
    gameSpectatorCapacity,
    gameBotCount,
    channelName,
    downdetectorApiToken,
    downdetectorClientId,
    downdetectorClientSecret,
    downdetectorDefaultCountry,
    legendModStatusUrl,
    legendModWebSocketCtor,
    liveStatusFailureReporter,
    legendModStatusFailureReporter,
    imageUrls: resolvedImageUrls,
    allowedDomains,
    fetchImpl,
    resolveHostname,
  });
}

export async function buildAnswerFromText(
  question,
  {
    routingQuestion = question,
    memoryQuestion = question,
    aiProvider = "groq",
    apiKey,
    groqApiKey,
    pollinationsApiKey,
    model,
    aiModelRoutingEnabled = true,
    pollinationsAllowedModels = [],
    pollinationsRouteModels = null,
    requesterContext,
    requesterIdentity,
    discussionMemory,
    userQuestionMemory,
    recentImageMemory,
    userMemoryKey,
    playerProfiles,
    playerProfileInteraction,
    communityKnowledge,
    limiter = defaultAskRateLimiter,
    gameStatusUrl,
    gamePlayingCapacity,
    gameSpectatorCapacity,
    gameBotCount,
    channelName,
    downdetectorApiToken = null,
    downdetectorClientId = null,
    downdetectorClientSecret = null,
    downdetectorDefaultCountry = null,
    legendModStatusUrl,
    legendModWebSocketCtor,
    liveStatusFailureReporter,
    legendModStatusFailureReporter,
    imageUrls = [],
    allowedDomains = [],
    resolveHostname = undefined,
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  },
) {
  let resolvedImageUrls = Array.isArray(imageUrls) ? [...imageUrls] : [];
  if (
    !question
    || question.length > MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "The question must contain between 1 and 500 characters",
    );
  }

  const conversationMessages =
    userQuestionMemory?.messagesForKey(userMemoryKey)
    ?? [];
  const continuityContext =
    userQuestionMemory?.continuitySummaryForKey?.(userMemoryKey)
    ?? "";
  const effectiveQuestion = String(routingQuestion ?? question ?? "");
  const storedQuestion = String(memoryQuestion ?? routingQuestion ?? question ?? "");

  const routing = analyzeQuestionRouting(effectiveQuestion, {
    conversationMessages,
    channelName,
    hasRecentAnswer: conversationMessages.some((entry) => entry?.role === "assistant"),
    hasImage: Array.isArray(imageUrls) && imageUrls.length > 0,
  });

  if (routing.needsClarification) {
    return message(routing.clarificationPrompt);
  }

  const liveStatusAllowed =
    typeof requesterContext === "string"
    && LIVE_STATUS_ALLOWED_PATTERN.test(requesterContext);
  const agentPlan = buildAgentPlan(routing.canonicalQuestion, {
    routing,
    hasImage: Array.isArray(imageUrls) && imageUrls.length > 0,
    liveStatusAllowed,
  });

  if (agentPlan.needsRestrictedLiveAccess) {
    return liveAccessDeniedMessage();
  }

  if (isWeatherOnlyPlan(agentPlan.selectedCapabilities)) {
    try {
      const directWeatherAnswer = await fetchWeatherAnswer(
        routing.canonicalQuestion,
        { fetchImpl },
      );

      if (directWeatherAnswer) {
        if (userQuestionMemory && userMemoryKey) {
          await userQuestionMemory.rememberByKey(
            userMemoryKey,
            storedQuestion,
            directWeatherAnswer,
          );
        }

        return embedMessage(directWeatherAnswer);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (isUserFacingContextError(error)) {
        return message(error.message);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  const discussionContext =
    discussionMemory?.contextFor(effectiveQuestion) ?? "";
  const communityKnowledgeContext =
    communityKnowledge?.contextFor(effectiveQuestion) ?? "";
  const matchedMemberContext =
    playerProfiles?.searchByQuestion(effectiveQuestion)
    ?? "";
  const playerProfileContext =
    playerProfiles?.contextFor(playerProfileInteraction) ?? "";

  let liveGameStatusContext = "";
  let liveLegendModStatusContext = "";
  let weatherContext = "";
  let downdetectorContext = "";
  let boredContext = "";
  let wikipediaContext = "";
  let wikidataContext = "";
  let crossrefContext = "";
  let openAlexContext = "";
  let openLibraryContext = "";
  let githubContext = "";
  let webSearchContext = "";
  let webpageContext = "";

  const settledResults = await Promise.allSettled([
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.liveGameStatus
      ? liveGameStatusContextForQuestion(
        routing.canonicalQuestion,
        {
          statusUrl: gameStatusUrl,
          playingCapacity: gamePlayingCapacity,
          spectatorCapacity: gameSpectatorCapacity,
          botCount: gameBotCount,
          onStatusSuccess: async () => {
            await liveStatusFailureReporter?.clearFailure?.("expanding-land-status");
          },
          onStatusFailure: async (error) => {
            await liveStatusFailureReporter?.reportFailure?.(
              "expanding-land-status",
              "Expanding Land status unavailable",
              `The local Expanding Land status endpoint failed while serving a live request: ${error.message}.`,
            );
          },
          fetchImpl,
        },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.liveLegendStatus
      ? liveLegendModStatusContextForQuestion(
        routing.canonicalQuestion,
        {
          statusUrl: legendModStatusUrl,
          webSocketCtor: legendModWebSocketCtor,
          onStatusSuccess: async () => {
            await legendModStatusFailureReporter?.clearFailure?.("legend-mod-status");
          },
          onStatusFailure: async (error) => {
            await legendModStatusFailureReporter?.reportFailure?.(
              "legend-mod-status",
              "Legend Mod websocket feed unavailable",
              `The live Legend Mod websocket feed failed while serving a player-status request: ${error.message}.`,
            );
          },
        },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.weather
      ? fetchWeatherContext(
        routing.canonicalQuestion,
        { fetchImpl },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.downdetector
      ? fetchDowndetectorContext(
        routing.canonicalQuestion,
        {
          apiToken: downdetectorApiToken,
          clientId: downdetectorClientId,
          clientSecret: downdetectorClientSecret,
          defaultCountry: downdetectorDefaultCountry,
          fetchImpl,
        },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.bored
      ? fetchBoredContext(
        routing.canonicalQuestion,
        { fetchImpl },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.wikipedia
      ? fetchWikipediaContext(
        effectiveQuestion,
        { fetchImpl },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.wikidata
      ? fetchWikidataContext(
        effectiveQuestion,
        { fetchImpl },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.crossref
      ? fetchCrossrefContext(
        effectiveQuestion,
        { fetchImpl },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.openAlex
      ? fetchOpenAlexContext(
        effectiveQuestion,
        { fetchImpl },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.openLibrary
      ? fetchOpenLibraryContext(
        effectiveQuestion,
        { fetchImpl },
      )
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.github
      ? fetchGitHubContext(effectiveQuestion, {
        fetchImpl,
      })
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.webSearch
      ? fetchWebSearchContext(effectiveQuestion, {
        fetchImpl,
      })
      : "",
    agentPlan.selectedCapabilities.webpage
      ? fetchWebpageContext(effectiveQuestion, {
        fetchImpl,
        resolveHostname,
        allowedDomains,
      })
      : "",
  ]);

  const capabilityLabels = [
    "Expanding Land status",
    "Legend Mod feed",
    "Weather",
    "Downdetector",
    "Bored API",
    "Wikipedia",
    "Wikidata",
    "Crossref",
    "OpenAlex",
    "Open Library",
    "GitHub",
    "Web search",
    "Webpage",
  ];

  for (const result of settledResults) {
    if (result.status === "rejected" && isUserFacingContextError(result.reason)) {
      return message(result.reason.message);
    }
  }

  [
    liveGameStatusContext,
    liveLegendModStatusContext,
    weatherContext,
    downdetectorContext,
    boredContext,
    wikipediaContext,
    wikidataContext,
    crossrefContext,
    openAlexContext,
    openLibraryContext,
    githubContext,
    webSearchContext,
    webpageContext,
  ] = settledResults.map((result, idx) => {
    if (result.status === "fulfilled") return result.value ?? "";
    const label = capabilityLabels[idx];
    return `[Note: ${label} context lookup was unavailable for this request: ${result.reason?.message ?? "lookup failed"}]`;
  });

  const aiRoute = resolveAiRoute({
    provider: Array.isArray(resolvedImageUrls) && resolvedImageUrls.length > 0
      ? "pollinations"
      : aiProvider,
    question: effectiveQuestion,
    routing,
    configuredModel: model,
    modelRoutingEnabled: aiModelRoutingEnabled,
    allowedModels: pollinationsAllowedModels,
    routeModels: pollinationsRouteModels,
    hasImage: Array.isArray(resolvedImageUrls) && resolvedImageUrls.length > 0,
  });

  const limit = limiter.claim();

  if (!limit.allowed) {
    return message(
      "The free AI limit is temporarily busy. Try again shortly.",
    );
  }

  const rawAnswer = await askGroq(
    question,
    {
      provider: aiRoute.provider,
      apiKey: aiRoute.provider === "pollinations"
        ? null
        : (groqApiKey ?? apiKey),
      pollinationsApiKey: pollinationsApiKey ?? null,
      model: aiRoute.model,
      allowedModels: pollinationsAllowedModels,
      modelProfile: aiRoute.profile,
      imageUrls: resolvedImageUrls,
      requesterContext,
      requesterIdentity,
      knowledgeQuestion: routing.canonicalQuestion,
      routingContext: routing.routingContext,
      agentPlanContext: agentPlan.promptContext,
      discussionContext,
      conversationMessages,
      continuityContext,
      playerProfileContext,
      matchedMemberContext,
      communityKnowledgeContext,
      preferenceContext: routing.preferenceContext,
      liveGameStatusContext,
      liveLegendModStatusContext,
      weatherContext,
      downdetectorContext,
      boredContext,
      wikipediaContext,
      wikidataContext,
      crossrefContext,
      openAlexContext,
      openLibraryContext,
      githubContext,
      webSearchContext,
      webpageContext,
      fetchImpl,
    },
  );

  const { cleanAnswer, markers } =
    extractLearnMarkers(rawAnswer);

  for (const marker of markers) {
    try {
      if (marker.action === "store") {
        await communityKnowledge?.store(
          marker.subject,
          marker.content ?? "",
          marker.tags ?? [],
          playerProfileInteraction,
        );
      } else if (marker.action === "delete") {
        await communityKnowledge?.remove(
          marker.subject,
        );
      }
    } catch {
      // Non-critical — continue
    }
  }

  const rawValidated = cleanAnswer || rawAnswer;
  const { cleanAnswer: answer } = validateAnswer(rawValidated);

  if (userQuestionMemory && userMemoryKey) {
    await userQuestionMemory.rememberByKey(
      userMemoryKey,
      storedQuestion,
      answer,
    );
  }

  const description =
    answer.length <= MAX_ANSWER_LENGTH
      ? answer
      : `${answer.slice(
          0,
          MAX_ANSWER_LENGTH - 3,
        )}...`;

  return {
    content: "",
    embeds: [
      {
        description,
        color: 0xf55036,
      },
    ],
    allowed_mentions: {
      parse: [],
    },
  };
}

export async function buildAskMessage(
  interaction,
  {
    aiProvider = "groq",
    apiKey,
    groqApiKey,
    pollinationsApiKey,
    model,
    aiModelRoutingEnabled = true,
    pollinationsAllowedModels = [],
    pollinationsRouteModels = null,
    requesterContext,
    requesterIdentity: identity,
    discussionMemory,
    userQuestionMemory,
    recentImageMemory,
    playerProfiles,
    communityKnowledge,
    limiter,
    gameStatusUrl,
    gamePlayingCapacity,
    gameSpectatorCapacity,
    gameBotCount,
    channelName,
    downdetectorApiToken,
    downdetectorClientId,
    downdetectorClientSecret,
    downdetectorDefaultCountry,
    legendModStatusUrl,
    legendModWebSocketCtor,
    liveStatusFailureReporter,
    legendModStatusFailureReporter,
    deltaChatWatcher,
    allowedDomains = [],
    resolveHostname = undefined,
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  },
) {
  const question =
    questionFromInteraction(interaction);
  const imageAttachment = attachmentFromInteraction(interaction, "image");

  return buildAskMessageFromText(question, {
    apiKey,
    groqApiKey,
    pollinationsApiKey,
    aiProvider,
    model,
    aiModelRoutingEnabled,
    pollinationsAllowedModels,
    pollinationsRouteModels,
    requesterContext,
    requesterIdentity: identity,
    discussionMemory,
    userQuestionMemory,
    recentImageMemory,
    userMemoryKey: userQuestionMemory?.keyFor(interaction),
    playerProfiles,
    playerProfileInteraction: interaction,
    communityKnowledge,
    limiter,
    gameStatusUrl,
    gamePlayingCapacity,
    gameSpectatorCapacity,
    gameBotCount,
    downdetectorApiToken,
    downdetectorClientId,
    downdetectorClientSecret,
    downdetectorDefaultCountry,
    channelName,
    legendModStatusUrl,
    legendModWebSocketCtor,
    liveStatusFailureReporter,
    legendModStatusFailureReporter,
    deltaChatWatcher,
    allowedDomains,
    resolveHostname,
    guildId: interaction.guild_id ?? null,
    channelId: interaction.channel_id ?? null,
    requesterId: interaction.member?.user?.id ?? interaction.user?.id ?? null,
    requesterName: interaction.member?.user?.username ?? interaction.user?.username ?? "unknown",
    imageUrls: imageAttachment?.url ? [imageAttachment.url] : [],
    fetchImpl,
  });
}

export { imageAttachmentsFromMessage };

export function buildAskErrorMessage(error) {
  if (error instanceof AiConfigurationError) {
    return message(error.message);
  }

  if (
    error instanceof GroqApiError
    && error.status === 429
  ) {
    return message(
      "The free AI limit is temporarily busy. Try again shortly.",
    );
  }

  if (
    error.message
    === "The question must contain between 1 and 500 characters"
  ) {
    return message(error.message);
  }

  if (isUserFacingContextError(error)) {
    return message(error.message);
  }

  return message(
    "LC is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.",
  );
}

function buildMessageFacts(message, recentImages = null, now = Date.now()) {
  const content = message.content?.trim() ?? "";
  let imageUrls = messageImageUrls(message);

  if (imageUrls.length > 0 && recentImages && message?.author?.id && message?.channel_id) {
    recentImages.rememberImages({
      guildId: message.guild_id,
      channelId: message.channel_id,
      userId: message.author.id,
      imageUrls,
    }, now);
  } else if (imageUrls.length === 0 && message?.referenced_message) {
    const replyImages = messageImageUrls(message.referenced_message);
    if (replyImages.length > 0) {
      imageUrls = replyImages;
      if (recentImages && message?.author?.id && message?.channel_id) {
        recentImages.rememberImages({
          guildId: message.guild_id,
          channelId: message.channel_id,
          userId: message.author.id,
          imageUrls,
        }, now);
      }
    }
  }

  if (imageUrls.length === 0 && recentImages && message?.author?.id && message?.channel_id && isImageReferencingPrompt(content)) {
    const cached = recentImages.getRecentImages({
      guildId: message.guild_id,
      channelId: message.channel_id,
      userId: message.author.id,
    }, now);
    if (cached.length > 0) {
      imageUrls = cached;
    }
  }

  const hasImage = imageUrls.length > 0;
  const lcQuestion = textLcQuestion(message.content);

  return {
    content,
    imageUrls,
    hasImage,
    explicitQuestion: lcQuestion === null
      ? null
      : lcQuestion || explicitImagePrompt(hasImage),
  };
}

// ── Human conversation detection ──────────────────────────────────
// People in a Q&A channel don't only ask questions. They greet each
// other, thank helpers, react, joke around, and answer each other.
// The bot should only speak up when someone is genuinely asking.
// IMPORTANT: The bot NEVER deletes user messages. It only replies.

// Short filler words and phrases that are clearly not questions.
// Matched against the full message (lowercased, trimmed, emoji stripped).
const FILLER_EXACT = new Set([
  "ok", "okay", "k", "kk", "yes", "no", "yep", "nope", "yea", "yeah",
  "nah", "sure", "true", "facts", "agreed", "same", "lol", "lmao",
  "rofl", "haha", "hehe", "xd", "gg", "rip", "f", "nice", "cool",
  "wow", "damn", "bruh", "bro", "oof", "hmm", "idk", "idc", "np",
  "ty", "thx", "thnx", "thanks", "thank you", "thanks!", "thank u", "tysm",
  "welcome", "yw", "you're welcome", "ur welcome", "your welcome",
  "no problem", "no worries", "np bro", "np man",
  "hi", "hello", "hey", "yo", "sup", "whats up", "what's up", "wassup",
  "good morning", "good night", "gm", "gn", "bye", "cya", "see ya",
  "my bad", "sorry", "mb", "i see", "oh", "oh ok", "oh okay",
  "ah ok", "ah okay", "got it", "understood", "makes sense",
  "good luck", "gl", "have fun", "hf", "ggs", "ez",
  "let's go", "lets go", "lesgo", "yay", "woo", "aight", "bet",
  "for sure", "fs", "fr", "no cap", "cap", "slay", "based",
  "i know", "ikr", "right", "exactly", "100", "fax",
]);

// Patterns at the START of a message that indicate someone is
// providing an answer/help, not asking a question.
const ANSWER_PREFIXES = [
  /^you (?:can|should|need to|have to|gotta|just|could|might)/i,
  /^just (?:go|click|press|open|use|do|try|check|look|type|set)/i,
  /^(?:it's|its|it is|that's|that is) (?:in|on|at|the|a|under|called)/i,
  /^(?:go to|open|click|press|try|check|look at|look in|use|enable|disable|turn on|turn off)/i,
  /^(?:i think|i believe|i guess|in my experience|imo|imho|tbh|honestly)/i,
  /^(?:no,? |yes,? |yeah,? |nah,? )(?:you|it|that|the|he|she|they)/i,
  /^(?:btw|fyi|also|anyway|anyways|actually|well,)/i,
  /^here(?:'s| is| you go| u go)/i,
];

// Strip emoji (including custom Discord emoji <:name:id>) so that
// "THANK U 😊😊" matches "thank u" and "ur welcome! ❤" matches "ur welcome".
function stripEmoji(text) {
  return text
    .replace(/<a?:\w+:\d+>/g, "")       // custom Discord emoji
    .replace(/[\p{Emoji_Presentation}\p{Extended_Pictographic}]/gu, "")
    .trim();
}

function isConversationalFiller(content) {
  const stripped = stripEmoji(content);
  const lower = stripped.toLowerCase().replace(/[!?.,]+$/g, "").trim();

  // Exact match against known filler
  if (FILLER_EXACT.has(lower)) return true;

  // Very short messages with only emoji, punctuation, or reactions
  if (/^[\p{Emoji}\s!?.,<:>\d_-]+$/u.test(content) && content.length < 40) return true;

  // Message is entirely a URL or Discord link (someone sharing, not asking)
  if (/^\s*https?:\/\/\S+\s*$/i.test(content)) return true;

  return false;
}

function looksLikeAnAnswer(content) {
  // Only check the first ~80 chars to avoid false positives on long questions
  // that happen to contain "you can" somewhere in the middle.
  const start = content.slice(0, 80);

  for (const pattern of ANSWER_PREFIXES) {
    if (pattern.test(start)) return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// ── Social vs. informational question detection ───────────────────
// The bot should only answer questions about THINGS (topics, features,
// game mechanics). It should NOT answer questions about PEOPLE
// (who's here, can someone help, want to play).
//
// Key insight: "can someone explain the merge timer?" has a SPECIFIC
// TOPIC (merge timer) so the bot should answer. But "can someone help
// me?" has no topic — it's a meta-request for human attention.

// Patterns for messages that are social/meta — NOT seeking information.
// These are tested against the full message (lowercased, trimmed).
const SOCIAL_PATTERNS = [
  // Presence checks: "am I alone?", "anyone here?", "is someone there?"
  /^(?:am i|is (?:anyone|somebody|someone)|anybody|anyone)\s+(?:alone|here|online|there|awake|around)/i,
  /^(?:hello|hey|hi|yo)\?*$/i,

  // Meta-help: asking for a PERSON to help, not asking a QUESTION.
  // Only blocks vague requests — "can someone help me?" but NOT
  // "can someone explain the merge timer?" (which has a real topic).
  /^(?:can|could|would)\s+(?:someone|somebody|anyone|anybody|you|u)\s+(?:help|assist)\s*(?:me|us|pls|plz|please)?\s*[?!.]*$/i,
  /^(?:can|could|would)\s+(?:someone|somebody|anyone|anybody)\s+(?:answer|respond|reply)\s*(?:to)?\s*(?:me|my|this|that|the)?\s*(?:question|msg|message)?\s*[?!.]*$/i,
  /^(?:i need|i want|please|pls|plz|someone|somebody)\s+help\b/i,
  /^(?:i have|i got|got)\s+a\s+question\s*[?!.]*$/i,
  /^help\s*(?:me)?\s*(?:pls|plz|please)?\s*[?!.]*$/i,
  /^(?:help me|pls help|plz help|please help)\s*(?:pls|plz|please)?\s*[?!.]*$/i,

  // Social pleasantries as questions
  /^how\s+(?:are you|is everyone|are things|'s it going|r u|are u)/i,
  /^(?:what(?:'s| is| r)\s+(?:up|good|happening|going on))/i,
  /^(?:how(?:'s| is)\s+(?:it going|everything|life|your day))/i,

  // Play invitations / coordination
  /^(?:anyone|who|somebody)\s+(?:wants?|wanna|down|tryna|trying)\s+(?:to\s+)?(?:play|team|1v1|duo|trio)/i,
  /^(?:let's|lets|wanna|want to)\s+(?:play|1v1|team|go|run)/i,
  /^(?:looking for|lf|lfg|need)\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:team|partner|duo|player|teammate)/i,

  // Rhetorical / opinion-seeking (not factual)
  /^(?:am i the only|is it just me|does anyone (?:else )?(?:think|feel|notice))/i,
  /^(?:don't you|do you guys?|do y'all)\s+(?:think|feel|agree|like)/i,

  // Self-identification without a question
  /^(?:i'm|im|i am)\s+(?:new|a (?:new|noob|beginner))\s*[?!.]*$/i,

  // ── Pronoun-only questions ──────────────────────────────────────
  // If the "topic" of the question is just a pronoun (it, this, that),
  // the bot has no context to answer. These are always conversational.
  // "can you test it?" → talking to a person about something unknown
  // "is this working?"  → referring to something in context
  // "did you fix that?" → asking a person about a specific thing
  // BUT "can you explain popsplit?" → has a REAL topic, so it passes.
  /^(?:can|could|will|would|did|do|does|should|shall|have|has)\s+(?:you|u|he|she|they|we|it)\s+\w+\s+(?:it|this|that|them)\s*[?!.]*$/i,
  /^(?:is|are|was|were|does|did)\s+(?:it|this|that)\s+\w+\s*(?:\w+)?\s*[?!.]*$/i,

  // "You"-directed short requests with no topic substance
  // "can you do it?", "will you try?", "can u check?"
  // These are person-to-person, not knowledge-seeking.
  /^(?:can|could|will|would)\s+(?:you|u)\s+(?:do|try|check|test|see|look|fix|send|show|tell)\s*(?:it|this|that|me)?\s*[?!.]*$/i,
];

function isSocialOrMetaQuestion(content) {
  const trimmed = content.trim();

  for (const pattern of SOCIAL_PATTERNS) {
    if (pattern.test(trimmed)) return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// ── Discord message splitting ─────────────────────────────────────
// Discord has a 2000-char limit per message content and 4096 for
// embed descriptions. If the AI gives a long answer, split it at
// natural boundaries so nothing gets cut off.
const DISCORD_MAX_LENGTH = 2000;
const DISCORD_EMBED_MAX_LENGTH = 4096;

function splitMessage(text, maxLength = DISCORD_MAX_LENGTH) {
  if (text.length <= maxLength) return [text];

  const chunks = [];
  let remaining = text;

  while (remaining.length > maxLength) {
    let splitAt = -1;

    // Prefer splitting at paragraph boundaries (double newline)
    const paragraphEnd = remaining.lastIndexOf("\n\n", maxLength);
    if (paragraphEnd > 200) {
      splitAt = paragraphEnd;
    }

    // Fall back to single newline
    if (splitAt === -1) {
      const lineEnd = remaining.lastIndexOf("\n", maxLength);
      if (lineEnd > 200) {
        splitAt = lineEnd;
      }
    }

    // Fall back to last space
    if (splitAt === -1) {
      const spaceEnd = remaining.lastIndexOf(" ", maxLength);
      if (spaceEnd > 200) {
        splitAt = spaceEnd;
      }
    }

    // Hard cut as last resort
    if (splitAt === -1) {
      splitAt = maxLength;
    }

    chunks.push(remaining.slice(0, splitAt).trimEnd());
    remaining = remaining.slice(splitAt).trimStart();
  }

  if (remaining.length > 0) {
    chunks.push(remaining);
  }

  return chunks;
}

function singleLinePromptText(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function trimPromptSection(value, maxLength) {
  const clean = singleLinePromptText(value);
  if (clean.length <= maxLength) return clean;
  if (maxLength <= 3) return clean.slice(0, maxLength);
  return `${clean.slice(0, maxLength - 3).trimEnd()}...`;
}

function buildAutoAnswerPrompt(rawQuestion, recentAnswer) {
  const cleanQuestion = singleLinePromptText(rawQuestion);

  if (!recentAnswer) {
    const prefix = `[Auto-answer. ${AUTO_ANSWER_SCOPE_NOTE}]`;
    const remaining = Math.max(1, AUTO_ANSWER_QUESTION_LIMIT - prefix.length - 2);
    return `${prefix}\n\n${trimPromptSection(cleanQuestion, remaining)}`;
  }

  const prefix = `[Auto-answer follow-up. ${AUTO_ANSWER_SCOPE_NOTE}]`;
  const previousQuestionLabel = "Previous user question: ";
  const previousAnswerLabel = "Previous bot answer: ";
  const followUpLabel = "Current user follow-up: ";
  const separatorLength = 3;
  const fixedLength =
    prefix.length
    + previousQuestionLabel.length
    + previousAnswerLabel.length
    + followUpLabel.length
    + separatorLength;
  const available = Math.max(60, AUTO_ANSWER_QUESTION_LIMIT - fixedLength);
  const previousQuestionBudget = Math.max(40, Math.floor(available * 0.25));
  const previousAnswerBudget = Math.max(50, Math.floor(available * 0.3));
  const currentBudget = Math.max(
    40,
    available - previousQuestionBudget - previousAnswerBudget,
  );

  const promptLines = [
    prefix,
    `${previousQuestionLabel}${trimPromptSection(recentAnswer.question, previousQuestionBudget)}`,
    `${previousAnswerLabel}${trimPromptSection(recentAnswer.answer, previousAnswerBudget)}`,
    `${followUpLabel}${trimPromptSection(cleanQuestion, currentBudget)}`,
  ];

  return promptLines.join("\n");
}

function duplicateQuestionKey(userId, question) {
  const normalizedUserId =
    String(userId ?? "").trim();
  if (!normalizedUserId) return "";

  const normalizedQuestion =
    canonicalizeProjectTerms(question)
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
      .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
      .trim()
      .slice(0, 180);

  return normalizedQuestion
    ? `${normalizedUserId}:${normalizedQuestion}`
    : "";
}

// ── Question signal detection ─────────────────────────────────────
// Instead of blocking every bad pattern (whack-a-mole), REQUIRE
// positive evidence that the message is asking something. If there's
// no question signal, it's a statement — and the bot stays quiet.
//
// "this game is trash" → statement → skip
// "just got updated"   → statement → skip
// "how do i install LM?" → question word + ? → answer
// "legend mod not working" → help-seeking → answer

// Help-seeking patterns that don't use question marks or question words
// but clearly indicate someone needs assistance.
const HELP_SEEKING_PATTERNS = [
  /\bnot\s+(?:working|loading|running|showing|opening|starting|installing)\b/i,
  /\b(?:doesn't|doesnt|does not|don't|dont|do not|can't|cant|cannot|won't|wont|will not)\s+(?:work|load|run|show|open|start|install|appear|connect|find)\b/i,
  /\b(?:unable|failed|failing|stuck|broken|bugged|bugging|glitch(?:ed|ing|y)?|error|crash(?:ed|ing|es)?)\b/i,
  /\bhow\s+(?:to|do|can|should)\b/i,
  /\bwhere\s+(?:to|do|can|is|are)\b/i,
  /\bwhat\s+(?:is|are|does|do|should|can)\b/i,
  /\b(?:search|look\s+up|lookup|read|check|review|scan|summari[sz]e|show|find)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:web|search|webpage|website|page|url|link|github|repo|repository|wikipedia|wikidata|crossref|openalex|doi|open\s+library|isbn|downdetector|activity)\b/i,
  /\bsuggest\b[\s\S]{0,80}\bactivity\b/i,
  /\b(?:need|want)\s+(?:to|help\s+with)\b/i,
  /\b(?:problem|issue|trouble|bug)\s+with\b/i,
];

// Question words that indicate the message is asking something
const QUESTION_WORD_PATTERN = /^(?:how|what|where|when|why|which|who|whom|whose|is|are|was|were|can|could|do|does|did|will|would|should|shall|has|have|may|might)\b/i;

function hasQuestionSignal(content) {
  // Has a question mark anywhere
  if (content.includes("?")) return true;

  // Starts with a question word
  if (QUESTION_WORD_PATTERN.test(content.trim())) return true;

  // Contains a help-seeking pattern
  for (const pattern of HELP_SEEKING_PATTERNS) {
    if (pattern.test(content)) return true;
  }

  return false;
}

const IMAGE_HELP_PATTERNS = [
  /\b(?:image|img|photo|picture|pic|screenshot|screen)\b/i,
  /\b(?:read|see|look|show|identify|recognize|analyse|analyze|explain|describe)\b/i,
  /\bwhat\s+(?:is|does)\s+(?:this|that|it)\b/i,
  /\bwho\s+is\s+(?:this|that)\b/i,
  /\bwhich\s+\w+\s+is\s+this\b/i,
];

function hasImageQuestionSignal(content, hasImage) {
  if (!hasImage) return false;
  const trimmed = String(content ?? "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) return false;
  if (hasQuestionSignal(trimmed)) return true;
  if (/^(?:this|that|it|here)\b/i.test(trimmed) && trimmed.length <= 40) return true;

  return IMAGE_HELP_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(trimmed));
}

function explicitImagePrompt(hasImage) {
  if (!hasImage) return null;
  return "Please analyze the attached image and answer what it shows or what matters in it for the current question.";
}

function pruneExpiredMap(
  entries,
  cutoff,
  isExpired,
) {
  for (const [key, value] of entries) {
    if (isExpired(value, cutoff)) entries.delete(key);
  }
}

export function classifyMessageReference(message, botUserId = null) {
  if (!message?.message_reference) {
    return { isReply: false, isReplyToBot: false, isReplyToHuman: false };
  }
  const referencedAuthorId = message.referenced_message?.author?.id;
  const isReplyToBot = Boolean(botUserId && referencedAuthorId === botUserId);
  return {
    isReply: true,
    isReplyToBot,
    isReplyToHuman: !isReplyToBot,
  };
}

function normalizedReplyText(reply) {
  const rawText = reply.embeds?.[0]?.description ?? reply.content ?? "";
  return rawText.trim().startsWith("OFF_TOPIC")
    ? HUMAN_SCOPE_REDIRECT
    : rawText;
}

function replyReference(messageId) {
  return {
    message_reference: {
      message_id: messageId,
    },
    allowed_mentions: {
      parse: [],
      replied_user: false,
    },
  };
}

async function sendChunkedReply(
  sendMessage,
  token,
  channelId,
  messageId,
  text,
  {
    useEmbeds = true,
    color = 0xf55036,
  } = {},
) {
  const maxLength = useEmbeds
    ? DISCORD_EMBED_MAX_LENGTH
    : DISCORD_MAX_LENGTH;
  const chunks = splitMessage(text, maxLength);
  const firstPayload = useEmbeds
    ? {
      content: "",
      embeds: [{ description: chunks[0], color }],
      ...replyReference(messageId),
    }
    : {
      content: chunks[0],
      embeds: [],
      ...replyReference(messageId),
    };

  await sendMessage(token, channelId, firstPayload);

  for (let i = 1; i < chunks.length; i += 1) {
    await sendMessage(token, channelId, useEmbeds
      ? {
        content: "",
        embeds: [{ description: chunks[i], color }],
        allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
      }
      : {
        content: chunks[i],
        embeds: [],
        allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
      });
  }
}

// ── Burst detection ───────────────────────────────────────────────
// In Discord, people send multiple messages quickly in a burst:
//   User: @AnotherZone     ← has mention → skip
//   User: can you test it? ← no mention, but part of same conversation
//
// If a user's message was skipped recently (because it was a reply,
// mention, filler, etc.), their next message within 10 seconds is
// probably part of the same conversation — skip it too.
const BURST_WINDOW_MS = 10_000;

// ── Topic relevance gate ──────────────────────────────────────────
// Auto-answer should ONLY respond to questions about Legend Mod,
// Agar.io, Expanding Land, and related game/clan topics. It's not a
// general-purpose chatbot. If the message doesn't contain ANY game-
// related keyword, it's off-topic and the bot stays silent.
//
// "can you answer philosophical questions?" → no topic word → skip
// "what is the meaning of life?"           → no topic word → skip
// "how do I install LM?"                   → "install","LM" → answer
// "what key is popsplit?"                   → "key","popsplit" → answer

const TOPIC_KEYWORDS = new Set([
  // Agar.io & game mechanics
  "agar", "agario", "agar.io", "miniclip", "cell", "cells", "pellet",
  "virus", "split", "merge", "mass", "eject", "feed", "splitrun",
  "popsplit", "tricksplit", "doublesplit", "triplesplit", "autosplit",
  "linesplit", "macro", "ffa", "teams", "team", "experimental", "party",
  "spectate", "spectator", "leaderboard", "arena", "anti-team", "detector",
  // Legend Mod & extensions
  "legend", "lm", "lme", "legendmod", "mod", "extension", "userscript",
  "script", "tampermonkey", "greasemonkey", "violentmonkey", "ogario",
  "addon",
  // Mod features
  "hotkey", "hotkeys", "keybind", "keybinds", "shortcut", "controls",
  "minimap", "overlay", "fps", "zoom", "skin", "skins", "theme",
  "respawn", "autoplay", "webhook", "chat command", "teamboard",
  // Technical / installation
  "install", "installation", "setup", "download", "update", "enable", "disable",
  "developer mode", "dev mode", "chrome", "firefox", "brave", "edge",
  "vivaldi", "opera", "browser", "web store",
  // Expanding Land & servers
  "expanding", "expanding.land", "land", "server", "bots", "players",
  "private server",
  // Clan & community
  "lc", "clan", "legend clan", "member", "join", "recruit", "candidate",
  "discord", "token", "webhook",
  // Delta / Doublesplit
  "delta", "delt.io", "doublesplit",
  // Performance
  "lag", "performance", "crash", "fps", "frame rate",
  // Weather / meteo
  "weather", "meteo", "forecast", "temperature", "temp", "degrees",
  "rain", "raining", "humidity", "wind", "sunrise", "sunset",
  // Bounded external lookups
  "wikipedia", "wikimedia", "wiki",
  "wikidata",
  "crossref", "doi",
  "openalex",
  "open library", "isbn",
  "github", "repo", "repository", "commit", "commits", "release", "releases",
  "issue", "issues", "changelog", "downdetector", "outage", "website",
  "webpage", "webpages", "web", "search", "lookup", "look up", "page",
  "pages", "url", "urls", "link", "links", "activity", "activities", "bored",
  // Key game terms people use informally
  "key", "keys", "settings", "config",
  // Extended Legend Mod terms
  "potion", "potions", "brew", "boost", "boosts", "coins", "dna",
  "trophies", "league", "leagues", "quest", "quests", "reward", "rewards",
  "gift", "gifts", "friend", "friends", "profile", "profiles",
  "multibox", "world spectate", "full spectate", "ghost cells",
  "mother cell", "mothercell", "split range", "virus range",
  "daily deal", "deals", "shop", "store", "video skin",
  "custom skin", "skin upload", "quick message", "chat macro",
  "server token", "party token", "rejoin", "reconnect",
]);

// Build regex patterns for multi-word keywords and single-word matching
const MULTI_WORD_TOPIC_PATTERNS = [];
const SINGLE_WORD_TOPICS = new Set();

for (const keyword of TOPIC_KEYWORDS) {
  if (keyword.includes(" ") || keyword.includes(".")) {
    MULTI_WORD_TOPIC_PATTERNS.push(
      new RegExp(`\\b${keyword.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")}\\b`, "i"),
    );
  } else {
    SINGLE_WORD_TOPICS.add(keyword.toLowerCase());
  }
}

function isTopicRelevant(content) {
  const lower = content.toLowerCase();

  // Check multi-word keywords first (e.g., "developer mode", "agar.io")
  for (const pattern of MULTI_WORD_TOPIC_PATTERNS) {
    if (pattern.test(lower)) return true;
  }

  // Check single-word keywords (including hyphenated words like "anti-team")
  const words = lower.match(/[a-z0-9][-a-z0-9.]*/g) ?? [];
  for (const word of words) {
    if (SINGLE_WORD_TOPICS.has(word)) return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// ── Bot dismissal detection ───────────────────────────────────────
// When a user explicitly tells the bot to stop or back off, skip.
// "not you bot", "don't answer", "i want others to answer"
const BOT_DISMISSAL_PATTERNS = [
  /\b(?:not\s+you|not\s+the\s+bot|not\s+bot)\b/i,
  /\b(?:don't|dont|do not|stop)\s+(?:answer|respond|reply)\b/i,
  /\b(?:i\s+want|let)\s+(?:others|someone\s+else|humans|people|them)\s+(?:to\s+)?answer\b/i,
  /\bshut\s+up\b/i,
  /\bbe\s+quiet\b/i,
  /\bnobody\s+asked\s+(?:you|the\s+bot)\b/i,
];

const FOLLOW_UP_PREFIX_PATTERNS = [
  /^(?:and|also|plus)\b/i,
  /^(?:what|how)\s+about\b/i,
  /^(?:about|for|with|without|on|in)\b/i,
  /^(?:if|then|so|but)\b/i,
  /^(?:same|similar)\s+(?:for|with|on|issue)\b/i,
  /^(?:another|other)\b/i,
];

function isBotDismissal(content) {
  for (const pattern of BOT_DISMISSAL_PATTERNS) {
    if (pattern.test(content)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function userMemoryKeyFromMessage(message) {
  const userId = message.author?.id;
  if (!userId) return null;

  const guildId = message.guild_id ?? "direct-message";

  return createHash("sha256")
    .update(`${guildId}:${userId}`)
    .digest("hex");
}
