export class AutoAnswer {
  constructor({
    token,
    guildId,
    channelName = "questions-answers",
    channelId = null,
    minLength = 10,
    aiProvider = "groq",
    groqApiKey,
    groqModel,
    pollinationsApiKey = null,
    pollinationsModel = null,
    recentImageMemory = null,
    aiModelRoutingEnabled = true,
    pollinationsAllowedModels = [],
    pollinationsRouteModels = null,
    requesterRoles,
    discussionMemory,
    userQuestionMemory,
    playerProfiles,
    communityKnowledge,
    gameStatusUrl,
    gamePlayingCapacity,
    gameSpectatorCapacity,
    gameBotCount,
    downdetectorApiToken = null,
    downdetectorClientId = null,
    downdetectorClientSecret = null,
    downdetectorDefaultCountry = null,
    deltaChatWatcher = null,
    webAllowedDomains = [],
    legendModStatusUrl = null,
    legendModWebSocketCtor = undefined,
    liveStatusFailureReporter = null,
    legendModStatusFailureReporter = null,
    fetchChannels = getGuildChannels,
    sendMessage = createChannelMessage,
    logger = console,
  }) {
    this.token = token;
    this.guildId = guildId;
    this.channelName = channelName.toLowerCase();
    this.minLength = minLength;
    this.aiProvider = aiProvider;
    this.groqApiKey = groqApiKey;
    this.pollinationsApiKey = pollinationsApiKey;
    this.recentImages = recentImageMemory ?? new RecentImageMemory();
    this.groqModel = groqModel;
    this.pollinationsModel = pollinationsModel;
    this.aiModelRoutingEnabled = aiModelRoutingEnabled;
    this.pollinationsAllowedModels = Array.isArray(pollinationsAllowedModels)
      ? pollinationsAllowedModels
      : [];
    this.pollinationsRouteModels = pollinationsRouteModels && typeof pollinationsRouteModels === "object"
      ? { ...pollinationsRouteModels }
      : null;
    this.requesterRoles = requesterRoles;
    this.requesterLocations = new DiscordLocationContext(token, { logger });
    this.discussionMemory = discussionMemory;
    this.userQuestionMemory = userQuestionMemory;
    this.playerProfiles = playerProfiles;
    this.communityKnowledge = communityKnowledge;
    this.gameStatusUrl = gameStatusUrl;
    this.gamePlayingCapacity = gamePlayingCapacity;
    this.gameSpectatorCapacity = gameSpectatorCapacity;
    this.gameBotCount = gameBotCount;
    this.downdetectorApiToken = downdetectorApiToken;
    this.downdetectorClientId = downdetectorClientId;
    this.downdetectorClientSecret = downdetectorClientSecret;
    this.downdetectorDefaultCountry = downdetectorDefaultCountry;
    this.deltaChatWatcher = deltaChatWatcher;
    this.webAllowedDomains = Array.isArray(webAllowedDomains) ? webAllowedDomains : [];
    this.legendModStatusUrl = legendModStatusUrl;
    this.legendModWebSocketCtor = legendModWebSocketCtor;
    this.liveStatusFailureReporter = liveStatusFailureReporter;
    this.legendModStatusFailureReporter = legendModStatusFailureReporter;
    this.fetchChannels = fetchChannels;
    this.sendMessage = sendMessage;
    this.logger = logger;

    this.limiter = new AskRateLimiter();
    this.channelId = channelId;
    this.userCooldowns = new Map();
    this.recentSkips = new Map();  // userId → timestamp of last skipped message
    this.recentAnswers = new Map(); // userId → { answeredAt, question, answer }
    this.recentQuestionReplies = new Map(); // normalized question → { answeredAt, answer }
    this.processing = new Set();
  }

  async resolveChannel() {
    // If a channel ID was provided directly, skip the API call
    if (this.channelId) {
      this.logger.log(`Auto-answer using configured channel ID ${this.channelId}`);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const channels = await this.fetchChannels(this.token, this.guildId);
      const match = channels.find(
        (channel) =>
          channel.type === TEXT_CHANNEL_TYPE &&
          channel.name?.toLowerCase() === this.channelName,
      );

      if (match) {
        this.channelId = match.id;
        this.logger.log(`Auto-answer resolved channel #${this.channelName} -> ${match.id}`);
      } else {
        this.logger.warn(`Auto-answer: channel #${this.channelName} not found in guild ${this.guildId}`);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn("Auto-answer channel resolution failed", error.message);
    }
  }

  isUserCoolingDown(userId) {
    return this.isUserCoolingDownAt(userId, Date.now());
  }

  isUserCoolingDownAt(userId, now) {
    const lastAt = this.userCooldowns.get(userId);
    if (!lastAt) return false;
    return now - lastAt < PER_USER_COOLDOWN_MS;
  }

  markUserCooldown(userId) {
    this.markUserCooldownAt(userId, Date.now());
  }

  markUserCooldownAt(userId, now) {
    this.userCooldowns.set(userId, now);

    // Prune old entries periodically
    if (this.userCooldowns.size > 200) {
      pruneExpiredMap(
        this.userCooldowns,
        now - PER_USER_COOLDOWN_MS,
        (timestamp, cutoff) => timestamp < cutoff,
      );
    }

    // Also prune expired burst entries
    if (this.recentSkips.size > 200) {
      pruneExpiredMap(
        this.recentSkips,
        now - BURST_WINDOW_MS,
        (timestamp, cutoff) => timestamp < cutoff,
      );
    }

    if (this.recentAnswers.size > 200) {
      pruneExpiredMap(
        this.recentAnswers,
        now - FOLLOW_UP_WINDOW_MS,
        (entry, cutoff) => !entry || entry.answeredAt < cutoff,
      );
    }

    if (this.recentQuestionReplies.size > 400) {
      pruneExpiredMap(
        this.recentQuestionReplies,
        now - DUPLICATE_ANSWER_WINDOW_MS,
        (entry, cutoff) => !entry || entry.answeredAt < cutoff,
      );
    }
  }

  recentAnswerFor(userId) {
    return this.recentAnswerForAt(userId, Date.now());
  }

  recentAnswerForAt(userId, now) {
    if (!userId) return null;

    const entry = this.recentAnswers.get(userId);
    if (!entry) return null;
    if (now - entry.answeredAt >= FOLLOW_UP_WINDOW_MS) {
      this.recentAnswers.delete(userId);
      return null;
    }
    return entry;
  }

  rememberRecentAnswer(userId, question, answer) {
    if (!userId) return;
    this.recentAnswers.set(userId, {
      answeredAt: Date.now(),
      question: String(question ?? "").trim().slice(0, 500),
      answer: String(answer ?? "").trim().slice(0, 1_000),
    });
  }

  duplicateAnswerFor(userId, question) {
    return this.duplicateAnswerForAt(
      userId,
      question,
      Date.now(),
    );
  }

  duplicateAnswerForAt(userId, question, now) {
    const key = duplicateQuestionKey(
      userId,
      question,
    );
    if (!key) return null;

    const entry =
      this.recentQuestionReplies.get(key);
    if (!entry) return null;

    if (
      now - entry.answeredAt
      >= DUPLICATE_ANSWER_WINDOW_MS
    ) {
      this.recentQuestionReplies.delete(key);
      return null;
    }

    return entry.answer;
  }

  rememberQuestionReply(userId, question, answer) {
    const key = duplicateQuestionKey(
      userId,
      question,
    );
    if (!key || !answer) return;

    this.recentQuestionReplies.set(key, {
      answeredAt: Date.now(),
      answer: String(answer)
        .trim()
        .slice(0, 1_000),
    });
  }

  isFollowUpCandidate(message, content = message.content?.trim() ?? "") {
    return this.isFollowUpCandidateAt(
      message,
      content,
      Date.now(),
    );
  }

  isFollowUpCandidateAt(
    message,
    content = message.content?.trim() ?? "",
    now,
  ) {
    const userId = message.author?.id;
    const recentAnswer = this.recentAnswerForAt(userId, now);
    if (!recentAnswer || !content) return false;
    if (isConversationalFiller(content)) return false;
    if (looksLikeAnAnswer(content)) return false;
    if (isSocialOrMetaQuestion(content)) return false;
    if (isBotDismissal(content)) return false;
    if (hasQuestionSignal(content)) return true;
    return FOLLOW_UP_PREFIX_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(content));
  }

  explicitAskQuestion(message, facts = buildMessageFacts(message)) {
    return facts.explicitQuestion;
  }

  canHandleExplicitAsk(message, question = this.explicitAskQuestion(message)) {
    if (question === null) return false;
    if (message.author?.bot) return false;
    if (message.type !== undefined && message.type !== 0) return false;
    if (message.application_id || message.interaction_metadata || message.interaction) return false;

    const userId = message.author?.id;
    if (!userId) return false;
    if (!question || question.length > AUTO_ANSWER_QUESTION_LIMIT) return false;
    if (this.processing.has(userId)) return false;

    return true;
  }

  markRecentSkip(userId, now) {
    if (userId) this.recentSkips.set(userId, now);
  }

  inspectMessage(message) {
    const now = Date.now();
    const facts = buildMessageFacts(message, this.recentImages, now);
    const explicitQuestion = facts.explicitQuestion;
    const explicitAsk = this.canHandleExplicitAsk(message, explicitQuestion);
    const passiveStopRequest =
      !explicitAsk
      && !message.author?.bot
      && (message.type === undefined || message.type === 0)
      && this.deltaChatWatcher?.isActiveInChannel?.(message.channel_id)
      && extractDeltaChatWatchStopRequest(message.content);

    if (explicitAsk) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: true,
        explicitAsk: true,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    if (passiveStopRequest) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: true,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: true,
        explicitQuestion,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // Only handle messages in the resolved channel
    if (!this.channelId || message.channel_id !== this.channelId) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // Ignore bot messages (including self)
    if (message.author?.bot) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // Ignore system messages (joins, pins, boosts, etc.)
    if (message.type !== undefined && message.type !== 0) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    const imageQuestionSignal = hasImageQuestionSignal(facts.content, facts.hasImage);
    const recentAnswer = this.recentAnswerForAt(message.author?.id, now);
    const followUpCandidate = !!recentAnswer
      && this.isFollowUpCandidateAt(message, facts.content, now);
    const routing = analyzeQuestionRouting(facts.content, {
      hasRecentAnswer: followUpCandidate,
      channelName: this.channelName,
      hasImage: facts.hasImage,
    });

    // Ignore messages that are too short
    if (
      facts.content.length < (followUpCandidate ? FOLLOW_UP_MIN_LENGTH : this.minLength)
      && !imageQuestionSignal
    ) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // ── Human conversation awareness ──────────────────────────────
    // The goal: only respond when someone is genuinely asking a question
    // to the channel, not when they're chatting with each other.

    const userId = message.author?.id;

    // ── Burst detection ───────────────────────────────────────────
    // If this user's previous message was skipped (reply, mention,
    // filler, etc.) within the last 10 seconds, they're mid-conversation
    // with another person. Skip this message too.
    if (userId) {
      const lastSkip = this.recentSkips.get(userId);
      if (!followUpCandidate && lastSkip && now - lastSkip < BURST_WINDOW_MS) {
        this.markRecentSkip(userId, now);  // extend the burst window
        return {
          shouldHandle: false,
          explicitAsk: false,
          passiveStopRequest: false,
          explicitQuestion,
          recentAnswer,
          followUpCandidate,
          imageQuestionSignal,
          routing,
          ...facts,
          now,
        };
      }
    }

    // If someone is replying to another message:
    // Replies to the bot are valid follow-up candidates.
    // Replies to other humans are ignored unless prefixed with /lc.
    if (message.message_reference) {
      const refInfo = classifyMessageReference(message, this.botUserId);
      if (refInfo.isReplyToHuman && !textLcQuestion(facts.content)) {
        this.markRecentSkip(userId, now);
        return {
          shouldHandle: false,
          explicitAsk: false,
          passiveStopRequest: false,
          explicitQuestion,
          recentAnswer,
          followUpCandidate,
          imageQuestionSignal,
          routing,
          ...facts,
          now,
        };
      }
    }

    // If the message @mentions a user, it's directed at a specific person.
    if (message.mentions?.length > 0) {
      this.markRecentSkip(userId, now);
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // Conversational filler that isn't a real question — greetings,
    // reactions, agreement, thanks. People say these constantly.
    if (isConversationalFiller(facts.content)) {
      this.markRecentSkip(userId, now);
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // Messages that look like someone is ANSWERING (not asking):
    // "you can press Q", "just go to settings", "it's in the tools tab"
    if (looksLikeAnAnswer(facts.content)) {
      this.markRecentSkip(userId, now);
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // Social/meta questions — about PEOPLE, not THINGS:
    // "am i alone?", "can someone help me?", "anyone wanna play?"
    // These are talking to humans, not seeking information.
    if (isSocialOrMetaQuestion(facts.content)) {
      this.markRecentSkip(userId, now);
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // ── Question signal requirement ───────────────────────────────
    // REQUIRE positive evidence that the message is asking something.
    // No question mark, no question word, no help-seeking pattern?
    // It's a statement — the bot stays quiet.
    // "this game is trash" → statement → skip
    // "just got updated"   → statement → skip
    // "how do i install?" → question word → answer
    // "LM not working"    → help-seeking → answer
    if (
      !followUpCandidate
      && !routing.needsClarification
      && !hasQuestionSignal(facts.content)
      && !imageQuestionSignal
    ) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // ── Bot dismissal detection ───────────────────────────────────
    // If the user explicitly tells the bot to stop, back off.
    // "not you", "don't answer", "shut up", "let others answer"
    if (isBotDismissal(facts.content)) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // ── Topic relevance gate ──────────────────────────────────────
    // Auto-answer is NOT a general chatbot. Only answer questions
    // about Legend Mod, Agar.io, Expanding Land, and the clan.
    // "can you answer philosophical questions?" → no topic → skip
    // "what is the meaning of life?"           → no topic → skip
    // "how do i install LM?"                   → "install" → answer
    if (
      !followUpCandidate
      && !routing.needsClarification
      && !isTopicRelevant(facts.content)
      && !imageQuestionSignal
    ) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // ── Rate limiting ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    // Ignore if user is on cooldown
    if (!userId) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }
    if (!followUpCandidate && this.isUserCoolingDownAt(userId, now)) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // Ignore if already processing a message from this user
    if (this.processing.has(userId)) {
      return {
        shouldHandle: false,
        explicitAsk: false,
        passiveStopRequest: false,
        explicitQuestion,
        recentAnswer,
        followUpCandidate,
        imageQuestionSignal,
        routing,
        ...facts,
        now,
      };
    }

    // Clear the burst tracker — this user is asking a real question
    this.recentSkips.delete(userId);

    return {
      shouldHandle: true,
      explicitAsk: false,
      passiveStopRequest: false,
      explicitQuestion,
      recentAnswer,
      followUpCandidate,
      imageQuestionSignal,
      routing,
      ...facts,
      now,
    };
  }

  shouldHandle(message) {
    return this.inspectMessage(message).shouldHandle;
  }

  async handle(message) {
    const inspection = this.inspectMessage(message);
    const {
      explicitQuestion,
      explicitAsk,
      passiveStopRequest,
      imageUrls = [],
      content = "",
      recentAnswer = null,
      followUpCandidate: isFollowUp = false,
      routing = null,
      now,
    } = inspection;
    if (!inspection.shouldHandle) return;

    const userId = message.author.id;
    this.processing.add(userId);
    if (!explicitAsk && !passiveStopRequest) {
      this.markUserCooldownAt(userId, now);
    }

    try {
      if (explicitAsk) {
        const userMemoryKey = userMemoryKeyFromMessage(message);
        const requesterLocation = await this.requesterLocations.describe(message);
        const requesterContext = await this.requesterRoles.describeFromMessage(message);
        const identity = requesterIdentityFromMessage(message, requesterLocation);
        const reply = await buildAskMessageFromText(explicitQuestion, {
          aiProvider: this.aiProvider,
          apiKey: this.groqApiKey,
          groqApiKey: this.groqApiKey,
          pollinationsApiKey: this.pollinationsApiKey,
          recentImageMemory: this.recentImages,
          model: this.aiProvider === "pollinations" ? (this.pollinationsModel ?? null) : this.groqModel,
          aiModelRoutingEnabled: this.aiModelRoutingEnabled,
          pollinationsAllowedModels: this.pollinationsAllowedModels,
          pollinationsRouteModels: this.pollinationsRouteModels,
          requesterContext,
          requesterIdentity: identity,
          discussionMemory: this.discussionMemory,
          userQuestionMemory: this.userQuestionMemory,
          userMemoryKey,
          playerProfiles: this.playerProfiles,
          playerProfileInteraction: message,
          communityKnowledge: this.communityKnowledge,
          limiter: this.limiter,
          gameStatusUrl: this.gameStatusUrl,
          gamePlayingCapacity: this.gamePlayingCapacity,
          gameSpectatorCapacity: this.gameSpectatorCapacity,
          gameBotCount: this.gameBotCount,
          downdetectorApiToken: this.downdetectorApiToken,
          downdetectorClientId: this.downdetectorClientId,
          downdetectorClientSecret: this.downdetectorClientSecret,
          downdetectorDefaultCountry: this.downdetectorDefaultCountry,
          channelName: requesterLocation.channelName ?? this.channelName,
          legendModStatusUrl: this.legendModStatusUrl,
          legendModWebSocketCtor: this.legendModWebSocketCtor,
          liveStatusFailureReporter: this.liveStatusFailureReporter,
          legendModStatusFailureReporter: this.legendModStatusFailureReporter,
          deltaChatWatcher: this.deltaChatWatcher,
          allowedDomains: this.webAllowedDomains,
          guildId: message.guild_id ?? null,
          channelId: message.channel_id,
          requesterId: message.author?.id ?? null,
          requesterName: message.author?.username ?? message.author?.global_name ?? "unknown",
          imageUrls,
        });

        const safeAnswerText = normalizedReplyText(reply);
        const useEmbeds = Array.isArray(reply.embeds) && reply.embeds.length > 0;
        await sendChunkedReply(
          this.sendMessage,
          this.token,
          message.channel_id,
          message.id,
          safeAnswerText,
          {
            useEmbeds,
            color: reply.embeds?.[0]?.color ?? 0xf55036,
          },
        );

        this.rememberRecentAnswer(userId, explicitQuestion, safeAnswerText);
        return;
      }

      if (passiveStopRequest) {
        const activeWatch = this.deltaChatWatcher.status();
        await this.deltaChatWatcher.stop(
          `stopped by ${message.author?.username ?? "unknown"}`,
          { notify: true },
        );
        await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
          content: `Closed the live Delta chat watch for \`${activeWatch?.displayServer ?? "the current server"}\`.`,
          embeds: [],
          ...replyReference(message.id),
        });
        return;
      }

      // Prefix the question with an auto-answer instruction so the AI
      // stays on topic but redirects naturally instead of emitting a token.
      const rawQuestion = content.slice(0, 500);
      const userMemoryKey = userMemoryKeyFromMessage(message);
      const requesterLocation = await this.requesterLocations.describe(message);
      const resolvedChannelName =
        requesterLocation.channelName ?? this.channelName;
      const effectiveRouting = resolvedChannelName === this.channelName
        ? routing
        : analyzeQuestionRouting(rawQuestion, {
          conversationMessages: this.userQuestionMemory?.messagesForKey(userMemoryKey) ?? [],
          channelName: resolvedChannelName,
          hasRecentAnswer: isFollowUp,
          hasImage: imageUrls.length > 0,
        });
      if (effectiveRouting.needsClarification) {
        await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
          content: effectiveRouting.clarificationPrompt,
          embeds: [],
          ...replyReference(message.id),
        });
        return;
      }
      const duplicateAnswer =
        !isFollowUp
        && effectiveRouting.intent
          !== "live_data_request"
          ? this.duplicateAnswerForAt(
              userId,
              rawQuestion,
              now,
            )
          : null;
      if (duplicateAnswer) {
        this.rememberRecentAnswer(userId, rawQuestion, duplicateAnswer);
        await sendChunkedReply(
          this.sendMessage,
          this.token,
          message.channel_id,
          message.id,
          duplicateAnswer,
        );
        return;
      }
      const question = buildAutoAnswerPrompt(
        rawQuestion,
        isFollowUp ? recentAnswer : null,
      );

      const requesterContext = await this.requesterRoles.describeFromMessage(message);
      const identity = requesterIdentityFromMessage(message, requesterLocation);

      const reply = await buildAnswerFromText(question, {
        routingQuestion: rawQuestion,
        memoryQuestion: rawQuestion,
        aiProvider: this.aiProvider,
        apiKey: this.groqApiKey,
        groqApiKey: this.groqApiKey,
        pollinationsApiKey: this.pollinationsApiKey,
        recentImageMemory: this.recentImages,
        model: this.aiProvider === "pollinations" ? (this.pollinationsModel ?? null) : this.groqModel,
        aiModelRoutingEnabled: this.aiModelRoutingEnabled,
        pollinationsAllowedModels: this.pollinationsAllowedModels,
        pollinationsRouteModels: this.pollinationsRouteModels,
        requesterContext,
        requesterIdentity: identity,
        discussionMemory: this.discussionMemory,
        userQuestionMemory: this.userQuestionMemory,
        userMemoryKey,
        playerProfiles: null,
        playerProfileInteraction: message,
        communityKnowledge: this.communityKnowledge,
        limiter: this.limiter,
        gameStatusUrl: this.gameStatusUrl,
        gamePlayingCapacity: this.gamePlayingCapacity,
        gameSpectatorCapacity: this.gameSpectatorCapacity,
        gameBotCount: this.gameBotCount,
        downdetectorApiToken: this.downdetectorApiToken,
        downdetectorClientId: this.downdetectorClientId,
        downdetectorClientSecret: this.downdetectorClientSecret,
        downdetectorDefaultCountry: this.downdetectorDefaultCountry,
        liveStatusFailureReporter: this.liveStatusFailureReporter,
        legendModStatusFailureReporter: this.legendModStatusFailureReporter,
        imageUrls,
        allowedDomains: this.webAllowedDomains,
        channelName: resolvedChannelName,
      });

      const safeAnswerText = normalizedReplyText(reply);
      const embedColor = reply.embeds?.[0]?.color ?? 0xf55036;

      this.rememberRecentAnswer(userId, rawQuestion, safeAnswerText);
      if (!isFollowUp && effectiveRouting.intent !== "live_data_request") {
        this.rememberQuestionReply(
          userId,
          rawQuestion,
          safeAnswerText,
        );
      }

      await sendChunkedReply(
        this.sendMessage,
        this.token,
        message.channel_id,
        message.id,
        safeAnswerText,
        { color: embedColor },
      );
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn("Auto-answer failed", error.message);

      try {
        const errorReply = buildAskErrorMessage(error);
        await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
          ...errorReply,
          ...replyReference(message.id),
        });
      } catch {
        // Double failure — give up silently
      }
    } finally {
      this.processing.delete(userId);
    }
  }
}

const BORED_API_BASE_URL = "https://bored-api.appbrewery.com";
const BORED_TYPES = new Set([
  "education",
  "recreational",
  "social",
  "charity",
  "cooking",
  "relaxation",
  "busywork",
]);

const TRIGGER_PATTERNS = [
  /\b(?:i(?: am|'m|m)\s+bored)\b/i,
  /\bbored api\b/i,
  /\bsomething to do\b/i,
  /\bactivity idea\b/i,
  /\b(?:give|find|pick|suggest|recommend)\b[\s\S]{0,30}\b(?:activity|activities)\b/i,
];
const BORED_TYPE_PATTERNS = [...BORED_TYPES].map((type) => ({
  type,
  pattern: new RegExp(`\\b${type}\\b`, "i"),
}));

function compact(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function normalizeNumber(value) {
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(String(value ?? ""), 10);
  return Number.isInteger(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function parseParticipants(text) {
  const explicit = text.match(/\b(?:for|with)\s+(\d+)\s+(?:people|persons|participants?)\b/i);
  if (explicit) {
    const parsed = normalizeNumber(explicit[1]);
    return [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8].includes(parsed) ? parsed : null;
  }

  if (/\b(?:just\s+me|solo|for\s+me)\b/i.test(text)) return 1;
  if (/\b(?:me and my friend|my friend and i|for two)\b/i.test(text)) return 2;
  return null;
}

function parseType(text) {
  for (const entry of BORED_TYPE_PATTERNS) {
    if (entry.pattern.test(text)) {
      return entry.type;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function formatPrice(value) {
  if (typeof value !== "number" || Number.isNaN(value)) return "n/a";
  if (value === 0) return "free";
  return `${value}`;
}

function formatActivity(activity, index) {
  return [
    `${index + 1}. ${activity.activity}`,
    `Type: ${activity.type ?? "n/a"}`,
    `Participants: ${activity.participants ?? "n/a"}`,
    `Price: ${formatPrice(activity.price)}`,
    `Accessibility: ${activity.accessibility ?? "n/a"}`,
    `Duration: ${activity.duration ?? "n/a"}`,
    typeof activity.kidFriendly === "boolean"
      ? `Kid-friendly: ${activity.kidFriendly ? "yes" : "no"}`
      : null,
    activity.link ? `Link: ${activity.link}` : null,
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
}

export class BoredContextError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "BoredContextError";
  }
}

export function extractBoredRequest(question) {
  const text = compact(question);
  if (!TRIGGER_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(text))) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    text,
    type: parseType(text),
    participants: parseParticipants(text),
  };
}

export async function fetchBoredContext(
  question,
  { fetchImpl = fetch } = {},
) {
  const request = extractBoredRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const hasFilters = request.type || request.participants;
  const url = new URL(hasFilters ? "/filter" : "/random", BORED_API_BASE_URL);
  if (request.type) url.searchParams.set("type", request.type);
  if (request.participants) url.searchParams.set("participants", String(request.participants));

  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(url, {
      headers: { accept: "application/json" },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6_000),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new BoredContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "The Bored API timed out."
        : "The Bored API is temporarily unavailable.",
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new BoredContextError(`The Bored API returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }

  const payload = await response.json();
  const activities = Array.isArray(payload)
    ? payload.filter((item) => item && typeof item.activity === "string")
    : payload && typeof payload.activity === "string"
      ? [payload]
      : [];

  if (activities.length === 0) {
    throw new BoredContextError("The Bored API did not return activities for that filter.");
  }

  const limitedActivities = activities.slice(0, hasFilters ? 3 : 1);

  return [
    "Bored API activity data fetched for this request only:",
    `Filter type: ${request.type ?? "none"}`,
    `Filter participants: ${request.participants ?? "none"}`,
    ...limitedActivities.map((activity, index) => formatActivity(activity, index)),
    "Limits: this API is rate limited to 100 requests every 15 minutes. Use only the returned activities; if a needed filter is absent, say so.",
  ].join("\n\n");
}

import { mkdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";

const SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 1;

export class BotAuditLog {
  constructor({
    dataPath = "data/bot-audit-log.json",
    maxEntries = 500,
    now = Date.now,
    logger = console,
  } = {}) {
    this.dataPath = resolve(dataPath);
    this.maxEntries = maxEntries;
    this.now = now;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.snapshot = {
      version: SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
      updatedAt: null,
      entries: [],
    };
    this.persistQueue = Promise.resolve();
  }

  prune() {
    if (!Array.isArray(this.snapshot.entries)) {
      this.snapshot.entries = [];
    }

    this.snapshot.entries = this.snapshot.entries
      .filter((entry) => entry && typeof entry === "object" && typeof entry.type === "string")
      .sort((left, right) => String(left.timestamp ?? "").localeCompare(String(right.timestamp ?? "")))
      .slice(-this.maxEntries);
  }

  async load() {
    try {
      const snapshot = JSON.parse(await readFile(this.dataPath, "utf8"));
      if (snapshot?.version === SNAPSHOT_VERSION) {
        this.snapshot = snapshot;
        this.prune();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code !== "ENOENT") this.logger.warn("Bot audit log could not be loaded", error.message);
    }
  }

  async persist() {
    await mkdir(dirname(this.dataPath), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    const temporaryPath = `${this.dataPath}.tmp`;
    await writeFile(temporaryPath, `${JSON.stringify(this.snapshot)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    await rename(temporaryPath, this.dataPath);
  }

  persistCurrent() {
    this.persistQueue = this.persistQueue.catch(() => {}).then(() => this.persist());
    return this.persistQueue;
  }

  async start() {
    await this.load();
  }

  async stop() {
    await this.persistCurrent();
  }

  async record(entry) {
    this.snapshot.entries.push({
      ...entry,
      timestamp: entry.timestamp ?? new Date(this.now()).toISOString(),
    });
    this.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date(this.now()).toISOString();
    this.prune();
    await this.persistCurrent();
  }

  latestEntry(types = []) {
    this.prune();
    const typeSet = new Set(
      Array.isArray(types)
        ? types.filter((type) => typeof type === "string" && type.trim())
        : [],
    );

    const entries = this.snapshot.entries ?? [];
    for (let index = entries.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const entry = entries[index];
      if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object") continue;
      if (typeSet.size > 0 && !typeSet.has(entry.type)) continue;
      return entry;
    }

    return null;
  }
}

import { createChannelMessage } from "./discord-api.js";
import { buildWelcomeMessage, sendWelcomeMessage } from "./member-welcome.js";
import { isRestartRequest, restartExpandingLand } from "./server-actions.js";

const ACTION_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const PREVIEW_COLOR = 0xf55036;
const DEFAULT_ANNOUNCEMENT_COLOR = 0xf59e0b;
const CONFIRM_PATTERN = /^(?:yes|y|confirm|send|send it|post|post it|do it|go ahead)$/i;
const CANCEL_PATTERN = /^(?:cancel|stop|abort|nevermind|never mind)$/i;
const ANNOUNCEMENT_PREFIXES = [
  /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?(?:(?:make|send|post|preview)\s+(?:an?\s+)?)?(?:announcement|announce)\b[:,-]?\s*/i,
  /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?(?:post|send|preview)\s+this\b(?:\s+(?:announcement|update|notice))?(?:\s+in\s+(?:<#\d+>|lobby))?[:,-]?\s*/i,
];
const WELCOME_PREFIXES = [
  /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?(?:welcome|greet)\b/i,
  /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?(?:preview|send|post)\s+(?:the\s+)?welcome\b/i,
];
const STATUS_PREFIX =
  /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?(?:(?:show|give|post|send)\s+)?(?:(?:bot|deployment|server)\s+)?(?:status|health|report|self-report)\b/i;
const FEATURES_PREFIX =
  /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?(?:(?:show|list)\s+)?(?:enabled\s+)?features\b/i;
const AUDIT_QUERY_PATTERNS = [
  {
    pattern: /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?who\s+(?:posted|sent|triggered)\s+(?:the\s+)?last\s+announcement\b/i,
    types: ["chat_announcement", "json_command", "json_message"],
    label: "announcement",
  },
  {
    pattern: /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?who\s+(?:posted|sent|triggered)\s+(?:the\s+)?last\s+welcome\b/i,
    types: ["chat_welcome", "welcome_command", "welcome_join"],
    label: "welcome",
  },
  {
    pattern: /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?who\s+(?:restarted|triggered)\s+(?:the\s+)?last\s+restart\b/i,
    types: ["chat_restart"],
    label: "restart",
  },
];
const REMEMBER_PREFIX =
  /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?(?:remember|learn|teach)\b/i;
const FORGET_PREFIX =
  /^(?:<@!?\d+>\s*)?(?:please\s+)?(?:forget|delete|remove)\b/i;

function cleanString(value, maxLength = 2_000) {
  return String(value ?? "").trim().slice(0, maxLength);
}

function actionKey(message) {
  return `${message.guild_id ?? "dm"}:${message.author?.id ?? "unknown"}`;
}

function formatChannel(channelId) {
  return channelId ? `<#${channelId}>` : "not configured";
}

function formatBoolean(value) {
  return value ? "on" : "off";
}

function formatDuration(totalSeconds) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(totalSeconds) || 0));
  const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
  const remainder = seconds % 60;
  return [
    hours > 0 ? `${hours}h` : null,
    minutes > 0 ? `${minutes}m` : null,
    `${remainder}s`,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

function mentionedChannelId(content) {
  return String(content ?? "").match(/<#(\d+)>/)?.[1] ?? null;
}

function announcementTitleFromText(text) {
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes("legend mod") && lower.includes("update")) return "Legend Mod Update";
  if (lower.includes("legend mod") && lower.includes("development")) return "Legend Mod Development Notice";
  if (lower.includes("expanding land")) return "Expanding Land Announcement";
  return "Announcement";
}

function normalizeAnnouncementDescription(text) {
  const trimmed = cleanString(text, 4_000);
  if (!trimmed) return "";
  const sentence = trimmed.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + trimmed.slice(1);
  return /[.!?]$/.test(sentence) ? sentence : `${sentence}.`;
}

function announcementRequestFromContent(content) {
  const trimmed = cleanString(content, 4_000);
  const prefix = ANNOUNCEMENT_PREFIXES.find((pattern) => pattern.test(trimmed));
  if (!prefix) return null;

  const targetChannelId = mentionedChannelId(trimmed);
  const targetChannelName = !targetChannelId && /\bin lobby\b/i.test(trimmed)
    ? "lobby"
    : null;
  const body = normalizeAnnouncementDescription(
    trimmed
      .replace(prefix, "")
      .replace(/\s+in\s+<#\d+>/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+in\s+lobby/i, "")
      .replace(/^\s*(?:about|for)\s+/i, ""),
  );
  if (!body) return null;

  return {
    title: announcementTitleFromText(body),
    description: body,
    color: DEFAULT_ANNOUNCEMENT_COLOR,
    footer: { text: "LC staff preview" },
    targetChannelId,
    targetChannelName,
  };
}

function mentionedUserId(message) {
  const directMention = message.mentions?.find((entry) => typeof entry?.id === "string")?.id;
  if (directMention) return directMention;

  const match = String(message.content ?? "").match(/<@!?(\d+)>/);
  return match?.[1] ?? null;
}

function welcomeRequestFromMessage(message) {
  if (!WELCOME_PREFIXES.some((pattern) => pattern.test(message.content ?? ""))) return null;

  const userId = mentionedUserId(message);
  if (!userId) return { error: "Mention the member you want me to welcome." };

  return { userId };
}

function buildStatusLines(status) {
  const features = status?.features ?? {};
  const deployment = status?.deployment ?? {};
  const budgets = features.webLookupBudgets ?? {};
  const domains = Array.isArray(features.webAllowedDomains) ? features.webAllowedDomains : [];
  const aiRouteModels = features.aiRouteModels && typeof features.aiRouteModels === "object"
    ? features.aiRouteModels
    : null;
  return [
    `Commit: \`${status?.commitSha ?? "unknown"}\``,
    `State: ${status?.ready ? "ready" : "starting"}`,
    `Uptime: ${formatDuration(status?.uptimeSeconds ?? 0)}`,
    `Gateway ping: ${status?.discord?.gatewayPingMs === null ? "connecting" : `${status?.discord?.gatewayPingMs}ms`}`,
    `Welcome channel: ${formatChannel(deployment.welcomeChannelId ?? features.welcomeChannelId ?? null)}`,
    `Auto-answer: ${formatBoolean(features.autoAnswerEnabled)}`,
    `AI backend: ${features.aiProvider ?? "groq"} (${features.aiModel ?? "unknown"})`,
    `AI routing: ${formatBoolean(features.aiModelRoutingEnabled)}`,
    aiRouteModels
      ? `AI routes: chat ${aiRouteModels.chat}, reasoning ${aiRouteModels.reasoning}, code ${aiRouteModels.code}, vision ${aiRouteModels.vision}`
      : null,
    `Public memory: ${formatBoolean(features.publicMemoryEnabled)}`,
    features.publicMemoryDisabledDetail
      ? `Public memory note: ${features.publicMemoryDisabledDetail}`
      : null,
    `JSON prefix: ${features.jsonMessagePrefix ?? "!json"}`,
    `JSON default channel: ${formatChannel(features.jsonAnnouncementDefaultChannelId ?? null)}`,
    `Live member-only data: candidates, members, staff`,
    `Web lookups: ${features.webLookupMode ?? "explicit-only"}`,
    domains.length ? `Trusted domains: ${domains.join(", ")}` : null,
    budgets.webSearchMaxResults
      ? `Lookup budgets: search ${budgets.webSearchMaxResults} results, webpages ${budgets.webpageTimeoutMs}ms, GitHub ${budgets.githubMaxCommits}/${budgets.githubMaxIssues}/${budgets.githubMaxReleases}, Groq ${budgets.groqMaxCompletionTokens} tokens`
      : null,
  ].filter(Boolean);
}

function describeAuditEntry(entry, label) {
  if (!entry) return `I could not find a recent ${label} entry in the audit log.`;

  const actor = entry.actorName || entry.actorId || "system";
  const when = entry.timestamp || "unknown time";
  const targetChannel = entry.targetChannelId ? `<#${entry.targetChannelId}>` : "unknown channel";
  const sourceChannel = entry.sourceChannelId ? `<#${entry.sourceChannelId}>` : "unknown source";

  return [
    `Latest ${label}: ${actor}`,
    `When: ${when}`,
    `Target channel: ${targetChannel}`,
    `Source channel: ${sourceChannel}`,
    entry.messageId ? `Message ID: ${entry.messageId}` : null,
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
}

function knowledgeStoreRequestFromContent(content) {
  const trimmed = cleanString(content, 1_000);
  if (!REMEMBER_PREFIX.test(trimmed)) return null;

  const candidate = trimmed
    .replace(REMEMBER_PREFIX, "")
    .replace(/^that\s+/i, "")
    .trim();

  const delimiters = [
    /\s+means\s+/i,
    /\s+is\s+/i,
    /\s*=\s*/,
    /\s*->\s*/,
    /\s*:\s*/,
  ];

  for (const delimiter of delimiters) {
    const parts = candidate.split(delimiter);
    if (parts.length < 2) continue;
    const subject = cleanString(parts.shift(), 80);
    const fact = cleanString(parts.join(" "), 500);
    if (!subject || !fact) continue;
    return {
      subject,
      content: fact,
      tags: [/\bmeans\b/i.test(candidate) ? "alias" : "staff-note"],
    };
  }

  return null;
}

function knowledgeDeleteRequestFromContent(content) {
  const trimmed = cleanString(content, 500);
  if (!FORGET_PREFIX.test(trimmed)) return null;

  const subject = cleanString(
    trimmed
      .replace(FORGET_PREFIX, "")
      .replace(/^(?:fact\s+)?(?:about\s+)?/i, "")
      .trim(),
    80,
  );

  return subject ? { subject } : null;
}

export class ChatActionHandler {
  constructor({
    token,
    requesterRoles,
    channelIdProvider = () => null,
    jsonMessages,
    resolveWelcomeChannelId,
    resolveChannelIdByName = async () => null,
    config,
    communityKnowledge = null,
    getBotStatus = null,
    auditLog = null,
    sendMessage = createChannelMessage,
    restartServer = restartExpandingLand,
    logger = console,
    now = Date.now,
  }) {
    this.token = token;
    this.requesterRoles = requesterRoles;
    this.channelIdProvider = channelIdProvider;
    this.jsonMessages = jsonMessages;
    this.resolveWelcomeChannelId = resolveWelcomeChannelId;
    this.resolveChannelIdByName = resolveChannelIdByName;
    this.config = config;
    this.communityKnowledge = communityKnowledge;
    this.getBotStatus = getBotStatus;
    this.auditLog = auditLog;
    this.sendMessage = sendMessage;
    this.restartServer = restartServer;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.now = now;
    this.pendingActions = new Map();
  }

  eligible(message) {
    const activeChannelId = cleanString(this.channelIdProvider(), 64);
    return Boolean(activeChannelId)
      && message.channel_id === activeChannelId
      && !message.author?.bot
      && !message.webhook_id
      && (message.type === undefined || message.type === 0)
      && typeof message.content === "string"
      && message.content.trim().length > 0;
  }

  prunePending() {
    const cutoff = this.now() - ACTION_TTL_MS;
    for (const [key, action] of this.pendingActions) {
      if (action.createdAt < cutoff) this.pendingActions.delete(key);
    }
  }

  async staffOnly(message) {
    return (await this.requesterRoles.tierForMessage(message)) === "staff";
  }

  async reply(message, content, embeds = []) {
    await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
      content,
      embeds,
      message_reference: { message_id: message.id },
      allowed_mentions: {
        parse: [],
        replied_user: false,
      },
    });
  }

  async handlePending(message) {
    this.prunePending();
    const key = actionKey(message);
    const pending = this.pendingActions.get(key);
    if (!pending || pending.channelId !== message.channel_id) return false;

    const content = message.content.trim();
    if (CANCEL_PATTERN.test(content)) {
      this.pendingActions.delete(key);
      await this.reply(message, "Cancelled.");
      return true;
    }

    if (!CONFIRM_PATTERN.test(content)) return false;

    if (!await this.staffOnly(message)) {
      this.pendingActions.delete(key);
      await this.reply(
        message,
        "Your staff authorization is no longer valid. The pending action was cancelled.",
      );
      return true;
    }

    this.pendingActions.delete(key);

    if (pending.type === "announcement") {
      await this.jsonMessages.postBodies(pending.targetChannelId, [pending.post], {
        type: "chat_announcement",
        actorId: message.author?.id ?? null,
        actorName: message.author?.username ?? null,
        sourceChannelId: message.channel_id,
      }, pending.targetChannelId === message.channel_id ? message.id : null);

      await this.reply(
        message,
        `Posted the announcement to <#${pending.targetChannelId}>.`,
      );
      return true;
    }

    if (pending.type === "welcome") {
      const sent = await sendWelcomeMessage({
        token: this.token,
        channelId: pending.targetChannelId,
        member: { user: { id: pending.userId } },
        config: this.config,
        sendMessage: this.sendMessage,
      });

      await this.auditLog?.record({
        type: "chat_welcome",
        actorId: message.author?.id ?? null,
        actorName: message.author?.username ?? null,
        sourceChannelId: message.channel_id,
        targetChannelId: pending.targetChannelId,
        messageId: sent?.id ?? null,
        targetUserId: pending.userId,
      });

      await this.reply(message, `Posted the welcome message to <#${pending.targetChannelId}>.`);
      return true;
    }

    if (pending.type === "restart") {
      const username = message.author?.username ?? message.author?.global_name ?? "unknown";
      const result = await this.restartServer(username);
      await this.auditLog?.record({
        type: "chat_restart",
        actorId: message.author?.id ?? null,
        actorName: message.author?.username ?? null,
        sourceChannelId: message.channel_id,
        targetChannelId: null,
        messageId: null,
      });
      await this.reply(message, result);
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  queuePending(message, action) {
    this.pendingActions.set(actionKey(message), {
      ...action,
      channelId: message.channel_id,
      createdAt: this.now(),
    });
  }

  async handleAnnouncement(message) {
    const preview = announcementRequestFromContent(message.content);
    if (!preview) return false;

    let requestedChannelId = preview.targetChannelId;

    if (!requestedChannelId && preview.targetChannelName) {
      requestedChannelId = await this.resolveChannelIdByName(
        message.guild_id,
        preview.targetChannelName,
      );

      if (!requestedChannelId) {
        await this.reply(
          message,
          `I could not find #${preview.targetChannelName}. Mention the target channel explicitly.`,
        );
        return true;
      }
    }

    const targetChannelId = this.jsonMessages.resolveTargetChannelId(
      requestedChannelId,
      message.channel_id,
    );
    if (!this.jsonMessages.isAllowedTarget(targetChannelId)) {
      await this.reply(message, "No valid announcement channel is configured.");
      return true;
    }

    const post = {
      content: "",
      embeds: [{
        title: preview.title,
        description: preview.description,
        color: preview.color,
        footer: preview.footer,
      }],
      allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
    };

    this.queuePending(message, {
      type: "announcement",
      targetChannelId,
      post,
    });

    await this.reply(
      message,
      `Preview ready for <#${targetChannelId}>. Reply \`yes\` to send or \`cancel\` to stop.`,
      post.embeds,
    );
    return true;
  }

  async handleWelcome(message) {
    const request = welcomeRequestFromMessage(message);
    if (!request) return false;
    if (request.error) {
      await this.reply(message, request.error);
      return true;
    }

    const targetChannelId = cleanString(this.resolveWelcomeChannelId(), 64);
    if (!targetChannelId) {
      await this.reply(message, "No welcome channel is configured.");
      return true;
    }

    const preview = buildWelcomeMessage({ user: { id: request.userId } }, this.config);
    if (!preview?.content) {
      await this.reply(message, "I could not build the welcome message.");
      return true;
    }

    this.queuePending(message, {
      type: "welcome",
      targetChannelId,
      userId: request.userId,
    });

    await this.reply(
      message,
      `Preview ready for <#${targetChannelId}>. Reply \`yes\` to send or \`cancel\` to stop.\n\n${preview.content}`,
    );
    return true;
  }

  async handleRestart(message) {
    if (!isRestartRequest(message.content ?? "")) return false;

    this.queuePending(message, { type: "restart" });
    await this.reply(
      message,
      "I understood this as a server restart request. Reply `yes` to restart Expanding Land or `cancel` to stop.",
      [{ description: "This uses the existing server restart function.", color: PREVIEW_COLOR }],
    );
    return true;
  }

  async handleStatusReport(message) {
    const content = message.content ?? "";
    if (!STATUS_PREFIX.test(content) && !FEATURES_PREFIX.test(content)) return false;
    if (typeof this.getBotStatus !== "function") {
      await this.reply(message, "Bot status reporting is not configured.");
      return true;
    }

    const status = this.getBotStatus();
    const lines = buildStatusLines(status);
    await this.reply(message, "", [{
      title: "Bot Self-Report",
      description: lines.join("\n"),
      color: PREVIEW_COLOR,
    }]);
    return true;
  }

  async handleAuditLookup(message) {
    const query = AUDIT_QUERY_PATTERNS.find(({ pattern }) => pattern.test(message.content ?? ""));
    if (!query) return false;
    if (!this.auditLog?.latestEntry) {
      await this.reply(message, "Audit lookup is not configured.");
      return true;
    }

    const entry = this.auditLog.latestEntry(query.types);
    const description = describeAuditEntry(entry, query.label);

    await this.reply(message, "", [{
      title: `Latest ${query.label}`,
      description,
      color: PREVIEW_COLOR,
    }]);
    return true;
  }

  async handleKnowledgeStore(message) {
    const request = knowledgeStoreRequestFromContent(message.content);
    if (!request || !this.communityKnowledge) return false;

    await this.communityKnowledge.store(
      request.subject,
      request.content,
      request.tags,
      {
        guild_id: message.guild_id,
        member: {
          user: {
            id: message.author?.id,
            username: message.author?.username,
            global_name: message.author?.global_name,
          },
        },
      },
    );

    await this.auditLog?.record({
      type: "chat_learn",
      actorId: message.author?.id ?? null,
      actorName: message.author?.username ?? null,
      sourceChannelId: message.channel_id,
      targetChannelId: null,
      messageId: message.id,
      subject: request.subject,
    });

    await this.reply(message, `Stored: **${request.subject}** -> ${request.content}`);
    return true;
  }

  async handleKnowledgeDelete(message) {
    const request = knowledgeDeleteRequestFromContent(message.content);
    if (!request || !this.communityKnowledge) return false;

    const removed = await this.communityKnowledge.remove(request.subject);
    await this.auditLog?.record({
      type: "chat_forget",
      actorId: message.author?.id ?? null,
      actorName: message.author?.username ?? null,
      sourceChannelId: message.channel_id,
      targetChannelId: null,
      messageId: message.id,
      subject: request.subject,
      removed,
    });

    await this.reply(
      message,
      removed
        ? `Forgot **${request.subject}**.`
        : `There was no stored fact for **${request.subject}**.`,
    );
    return true;
  }

  async handle(message) {
    if (!this.eligible(message)) return false;

    if (await this.handlePending(message)) return true;
    if (!await this.staffOnly(message)) return false;

    if (await this.handleStatusReport(message)) return true;
    if (await this.handleAuditLookup(message)) return true;
    if (await this.handleKnowledgeStore(message)) return true;
    if (await this.handleKnowledgeDelete(message)) return true;
    if (await this.handleAnnouncement(message)) return true;
    if (await this.handleWelcome(message)) return true;
    if (await this.handleRestart(message)) return true;

    return false;
  }
}

function normalized(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").normalize("NFKD").toLowerCase().trim();
}

function matchesAny(text, patterns) {
  return patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(text));
}

export function canonicalizeProjectTerms(text) {
  let result = String(text ?? "");
  for (const { pattern, value } of CANONICAL_REPLACEMENTS) {
    result = result.replace(pattern, value);
  }
  return result.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

export function projectGlossaryForQuestion(question) {
  const lines = GLOSSARY_PATTERNS
    .filter(({ pattern }) => pattern.test(question))
    .map(({ value }) => value);

  return lines.length > 0
    ? `Project alias hints: ${lines.join("; ")}`
    : "";
}

export function inferConversationPreferences(conversationMessages) {
  if (!Array.isArray(conversationMessages) || conversationMessages.length === 0) return "";

  const userMessages = conversationMessages
    .filter((message) => message?.role === "user" && typeof message.content === "string")
    .slice(-6)
    .map((message) => normalized(message.content));

  if (userMessages.length === 0) return "";

  const combined = userMessages.join(" \n ");
  const browser = BROWSER_NAMES.find((name) => combined.includes(name)) ?? null;
  const topic = TOPIC_NAMES.find((name) => combined.includes(name)) ?? null;
  const lines = [];

  if (browser) {
    lines.push(`Recent preference signal: the requester has been discussing ${browser}.`);
  }

  if (topic) {
    lines.push(`Recent topic signal: the requester has been focused on ${topic}.`);
  }

  return lines.join("\n");
}

function latestRecentMessages(conversationMessages) {
  return Array.isArray(conversationMessages)
    ? conversationMessages
      .filter((message) => typeof message?.content === "string" && message.content.trim())
      .slice(-8)
      .map((message) => String(message.content).trim())
    : [];
}

function detectRecentTopic(recentMessages) {
  for (let index = recentMessages.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const rawText = recentMessages[index];
    const text = normalized(canonicalizeProjectTerms(rawText));
    for (const topic of TOPIC_NAMES) {
      if (topic === "legend clan" && /\btag\b/i.test(rawText)) {
        continue;
      }
      if (text.includes(topic)) return topic;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function detectRecentBrowser(recentMessages) {
  for (let index = recentMessages.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const match = canonicalizeProjectTerms(recentMessages[index]).match(BROWSER_PATTERN);
    if (match?.[0]) return match[0].toLowerCase();
  }
  return null;
}

function detectRecentServerToken(recentMessages) {
  for (let index = recentMessages.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const match = recentMessages[index].match(SERVER_TOKEN_PATTERN);
    if (match?.[1]) return match[1].toLowerCase();
  }
  return null;
}

function detectRecentClanTag(recentMessages) {
  for (let index = recentMessages.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const match = recentMessages[index].match(CLAN_TAG_PATTERN);
    if (match?.[1]) return match[1];
  }
  return null;
}

function hasExplicitTopic(text) {
  return matchesAny(text, EXPLICIT_TOPIC_PATTERNS);
}

function hasContextualReference(text) {
  return matchesAny(text, CONTEXTUAL_REFERENCE_PATTERNS);
}

function shouldInheritRecentTopic(text, hasRecentAnswer) {
  return hasRecentAnswer && !hasExplicitTopic(text) && (
    (matchesAny(text, FOLLOW_UP_PREFIX_PATTERNS) && hasContextualReference(text))
    || (matchesAny(text, SUPPORT_SIGNAL_PATTERNS) && hasContextualReference(text))
    || (matchesAny(text, LIVE_REQUEST_PATTERNS) && IMPLICIT_LIVE_FOLLOW_UP_PATTERN.test(text))
  );
}

export function inferRecentThreadContext(conversationMessages) {
  const recentMessages = latestRecentMessages(conversationMessages);
  if (recentMessages.length === 0) return null;

  const topic = detectRecentTopic(recentMessages);
  const browser = detectRecentBrowser(recentMessages);
  const serverToken = detectRecentServerToken(recentMessages);
  const clanTag = detectRecentClanTag(recentMessages);

  if (!topic && !browser && !serverToken && !clanTag) return null;

  return {
    topic,
    browser,
    serverToken,
    clanTag,
  };
}

function enrichQuestionWithRecentContext(
  question,
  canonicalQuestion,
  recentContext,
  hasRecentAnswer,
) {
  const raw = String(question ?? "").trim();
  const text = normalized(canonicalQuestion);
  if (!recentContext || !raw) return canonicalQuestion;

  const additions = [];

  if (shouldInheritRecentTopic(text, hasRecentAnswer) && recentContext.topic && !text.includes(recentContext.topic)) {
    additions.push(recentContext.topic);
  }

  if (
    recentContext.browser
    && /\b(?:same browser|that browser|this browser)\b/i.test(text)
    && !text.includes(recentContext.browser)
  ) {
    additions.push(recentContext.browser);
  }

  if (
    recentContext.serverToken
    && /\b(?:there|that server|this server|same server)\b/i.test(text)
    && !SERVER_TOKEN_PATTERN.test(text)
  ) {
    additions.push(`server ${recentContext.serverToken}`);
  }

  if (
    recentContext.clanTag
    && /\b(?:same tag|that tag|this tag)\b/i.test(text)
    && !CLAN_TAG_PATTERN.test(text)
  ) {
    additions.push(`tag ${recentContext.clanTag}`);
  }

  return additions.length > 0
    ? `${canonicalQuestion} ${additions.join(" ")}`
    : canonicalQuestion;
}

function recentThreadContextLine(recentContext) {
  if (!recentContext) return "";
  const parts = [];
  if (recentContext.topic) parts.push(`topic ${recentContext.topic}`);
  if (recentContext.browser) parts.push(`browser ${recentContext.browser}`);
  if (recentContext.serverToken) parts.push(`server ${recentContext.serverToken}`);
  if (recentContext.clanTag) parts.push(`tag ${recentContext.clanTag}`);
  return parts.length > 0
    ? `Recent thread context inferred from the requester conversation: ${parts.join(", ")}.`
    : "";
}

function needsClarification(question, canonicalQuestion, hasRecentAnswer, hasImage = false) {
  const raw = String(question ?? "").trim();
  const lower = normalized(canonicalQuestion);

  if (!raw) return "";
  if (hasRecentAnswer) return "";
  if (hasImage && /^(?:it|this|that|here|look|read|see)\b/i.test(raw)) {
    return "";
  }

  if (raw.length <= 12 && !/\?/.test(raw) && !hasExplicitTopic(lower)) {
    return "Do you mean Legend Mod, Expanding Land, LC Discord, or official Agar.io?";
  }

  if (matchesAny(lower, AMBIGUOUS_SUBJECT_PATTERNS) && matchesAny(lower, SUPPORT_SIGNAL_PATTERNS)) {
    return "Do you mean Legend Mod install, Legend Mod in-game behavior, Expanding Land live status, or an LC Discord issue?";
  }

  if (matchesAny(lower, SUPPORT_SIGNAL_PATTERNS) && !/\blegend\b|\bland\b|\bclan\b|\bdiscord\b|\bagar\b|\bdelta\b|\bbrowser\b|\bfirefox\b|\bchrome\b/i.test(lower)) {
    return "What exactly is having the problem: Legend Mod, Expanding Land, Agar.io, the browser, or the LC Discord setup?";
  }

  return "";
}

function detectIntent(canonicalQuestion, { hasRecentAnswer = false } = {}) {
  const text = normalized(canonicalQuestion);

  if (matchesAny(text, ACTION_PATTERNS)) return "action_request";
  const hasLiveSignal = matchesAny(text, LIVE_REQUEST_PATTERNS);
  const asksCurrentLiveState = matchesAny(text, LIVE_CURRENTNESS_PATTERNS);
  const asksForRoster = matchesAny(text, LIVE_ROSTER_PATTERNS) && matchesAny(text, LIVE_TARGET_PATTERNS);
  if (hasLiveSignal && (asksCurrentLiveState || asksForRoster)) {
    return "live_data_request";
  }
  if (hasRecentAnswer && (/\?/.test(text) || matchesAny(text, FOLLOW_UP_PREFIX_PATTERNS))) {
    return "follow_up";
  }
  return "new_question";
}

function detectEmotion(question, conversationMessages = []) {
  const recentUserText = Array.isArray(conversationMessages)
    ? conversationMessages
      .filter((message) => message?.role === "user" && typeof message.content === "string")
      .slice(-3)
      .map((message) => message.content)
      .join("\n")
    : "";
  const text = `${question}\n${recentUserText}`;

  if (matchesAny(text, FRUSTRATION_PATTERNS)) return "frustrated";
  if (matchesAny(text, CONFUSION_PATTERNS)) return "confused";
  if (matchesAny(text, GRATITUDE_PATTERNS)) return "grateful";
  if (matchesAny(text, EXCITEMENT_PATTERNS)) return "excited";
  return "neutral";
}

function emotionGuidance(emotion) {
  switch (emotion) {
    case "frustrated":
      return "Emotion: frustrated. Respond calm, reassuring, and solution-first. Use one brief empathetic phrase, then get practical.";
    case "confused":
      return "Emotion: confused or uncertain. Respond patiently, simplify the explanation, and use clear step-by-step wording.";
    case "grateful":
      return "Emotion: grateful or friendly. Respond warmly, acknowledge briefly, then continue naturally.";
    case "excited":
      return "Emotion: excited. Match with light enthusiasm, but keep the answer concise and useful.";
    default:
      return "Emotion: neutral. Stay friendly and direct without extra emotional coloring.";
  }
}

export function clarifyWithEmotion(clarificationPrompt, emotion) {
  switch (emotion) {
    case "frustrated":
      return `Sounds like something is failing. ${clarificationPrompt}`;
    case "confused":
      return `Let's narrow it down. ${clarificationPrompt}`;
    case "grateful":
      return `Sure. ${clarificationPrompt}`;
    case "excited":
      return `Nice. ${clarificationPrompt}`;
    default:
      return clarificationPrompt;
  }
}

export function buildStandaloneQuestion(
  currentQuestion,
  conversationMessages = [],
  _options = {},
) {
  const rawCurrent = String(currentQuestion ?? "").trim();
  if (!rawCurrent) return "";

  const canonicalCurrent = canonicalizeProjectTerms(rawCurrent);
  const lowerCurrent = normalized(canonicalCurrent);

  if (canonicalCurrent.length > 200 || /https?:\/\/\S+/i.test(rawCurrent) || /sk-[a-z0-9]/i.test(rawCurrent)) {
    return canonicalCurrent.slice(0, 500);
  }

  const recentMessages = latestRecentMessages(conversationMessages);
  if (recentMessages.length === 0) {
    return canonicalCurrent.slice(0, 500);
  }

  const recentTopic = detectRecentTopic(recentMessages);
  const recentBrowser = detectRecentBrowser(recentMessages);
  const lastUserTurn = [...conversationMessages].reverse().find((m) => m?.role === "user")?.content ?? "";
  const lastUserCanonical = canonicalizeProjectTerms(lastUserTurn);

  if (/^and\s+centered(?:\s+mode)?\??$/i.test(lowerCurrent)) {
    if (/world\s+spectate/i.test(lastUserCanonical)) {
      return "How does centered World Spectate mode work?";
    }
  }

  if (/^how\s+long\s+for\s+legendary\??$/i.test(lowerCurrent) || /legendary\s+potion/i.test(lowerCurrent)) {
    const topic = recentTopic ?? "Expanding Land";
    return `How long does a legendary ${topic} potion take to brew?`;
  }

  if (/^(?:on|in|with|for)\s+(brave|chrome|firefox|edge|opera|vivaldi)\??$/i.test(lowerCurrent)) {
    const browser = lowerCurrent.match(BROWSER_PATTERN)?.[0] ?? recentBrowser ?? "Brave";
    const formattedBrowser = browser.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + browser.slice(1);
    if (lastUserCanonical) {
      const baseAction = lastUserCanonical.replace(/\b(?:on|in|with|for)\s+(?:chrome|firefox|brave|edge|opera|vivaldi)\b/gi, "").trim();
      return `${baseAction} on ${formattedBrowser}?`.replace(/\?\?$/, "?");
    }
    return `How do I install Legend Mod on ${formattedBrowser}?`;
  }

  if (/^(?:and|what about)\s+bots\??$/i.test(lowerCurrent)) {
    return "How many bots are currently online on Expanding Land?";
  }

  if (/^does\s+it\s+freeze\s+inactive\s+cells\??$/i.test(lowerCurrent)) {
    return "Does Legend Mod multibox freeze inactive cells?";
  }

  const hasTopicInCurrent = hasExplicitTopic(lowerCurrent);
  if (!hasTopicInCurrent && recentTopic && /^(?:and|also|what about|how about|does it|is it|why|how|on|in|with)\b/i.test(lowerCurrent)) {
    return `${canonicalCurrent} (${recentTopic})`.slice(0, 500);
  }

  return canonicalCurrent.slice(0, 500);
}

export function analyzeQuestionRouting(
  question,
  {
    conversationMessages = [],
    channelName = null,
    hasRecentAnswer = false,
    hasImage = false,
  } = {},
) {
  const baseCanonicalQuestion = canonicalizeProjectTerms(question);
  const glossaryContext = projectGlossaryForQuestion(question);
  const preferenceContext = inferConversationPreferences(conversationMessages);
  const recentThreadContext = inferRecentThreadContext(conversationMessages);
  const canonicalQuestion = enrichQuestionWithRecentContext(
    question,
    baseCanonicalQuestion,
    recentThreadContext,
    hasRecentAnswer,
  );
  const clarificationPrompt = needsClarification(question, canonicalQuestion, hasRecentAnswer, hasImage);
  const intent = detectIntent(canonicalQuestion, { hasRecentAnswer });
  const answerStyle = normalized(channelName) === "lobby" ? "public_brief" : "standard";
  const emotion = detectEmotion(question, conversationMessages);
  const emotionContext = emotionGuidance(emotion);
  const standaloneQuestion = buildStandaloneQuestion(question, conversationMessages);

  const lowerQuestion = normalized(canonicalQuestion);
  const entities = [];
  for (const topic of TOPIC_NAMES) {
    if (lowerQuestion.includes(topic)) entities.push(topic);
  }
  const browserMatch = lowerQuestion.match(BROWSER_PATTERN);
  if (browserMatch) entities.push(browserMatch[0].toLowerCase());

  const confidence = clarificationPrompt ? "low" : intent === "live_data_request" ? "high" : "medium";

  return {
    canonicalQuestion,
    standaloneQuestion,
    glossaryContext,
    preferenceContext,
    intent,
    answerStyle,
    emotion,
    emotionContext,
    recentThreadContext,
    confidence,
    needsClarification: Boolean(clarificationPrompt),
    clarificationPrompt: clarifyWithEmotion(clarificationPrompt, emotion),
    subject: entities[0] ?? (intent === "live_data_request" ? "live_status" : "general_project"),
    entities,
    constraints: [],
    requestedFacts: [],
    temporalMode: intent === "live_data_request" ? "current" : "timeless",
    conversationMode: hasRecentAnswer ? "follow_up" : "fresh",
    answerMode: clarificationPrompt ? "clarify" : intent === "live_data_request" ? "status" : "direct",
    shouldUseContinuity: hasRecentAnswer,
    isExplicitBotRequest: /^\/lc\b/i.test(String(question ?? "").trim()),
    isHumanDirected: false,
    isSocialMessage: false,
    isAcknowledgement: false,
    isCorrection: false,
    isContinuation: hasRecentAnswer,
    isStatusRequest: intent === "live_data_request",
    isComparison: false,
    isTroubleshooting: Boolean(clarificationPrompt),
    isInstructionRequest: false,
    isCurrentDataRequest: intent === "live_data_request",
    reasons: [intent, confidence],
    routingContext: [
      `Intent: ${intent}`,
      `Confidence: ${confidence}`,
      `Answer style: ${answerStyle}`,
      emotionContext,
      hasImage ? "Attachment context: the requester attached an image, so references like this, that, screenshot, or read this may point to it." : null,
      hasRecentAnswer ? "Conversation state: recent assistant answer exists for this requester." : null,
      recentThreadContextLine(recentThreadContext) || null,
      intent === "live_data_request"
        ? "Tooling rule: only use live status or websocket data because the requester explicitly asked for current data."
        : "Tooling rule: do not use live status or websocket tools unless the requester clearly asks for current data.",
      glossaryContext || null,
      preferenceContext || null,
    ].filter(Boolean).join("\n"),
  };
}

const EPHEMERAL_FLAG = 1 << 6;
const RESPONSE_MESSAGE = 4;
const RESPONSE_UPDATE = 7;
const BUTTON_PRIMARY = 1;
const BUTTON_SECONDARY = 2;
const BUTTON_LINK = 5;

function formatUptime(totalSeconds) {
  const days = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 86400);
  const hours = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 86400) / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
  const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

  return [
    days > 0 ? `${days}d` : null,
    hours > 0 ? `${hours}h` : null,
    minutes > 0 ? `${minutes}m` : null,
    totalSeconds < 60 ? `${seconds}s` : null,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");
}

function number(value) {
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.trunc(value).toLocaleString("en-US") : "Unknown";
}

function integer(value) {
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? String(Math.trunc(value)) : "Unknown";
}

function controls(websiteUrl, detailView) {
  return [
    {
      type: 1,
      components: [
        {
          type: 2,
          style: BUTTON_PRIMARY,
          custom_id: detailView
            ? "legend:refresh:details"
            : "legend:refresh",
          label: "Refresh",
        },
        {
          type: 2,
          style: BUTTON_SECONDARY,
          custom_id: detailView ? "legend:overview" : "legend:details",
          label: detailView ? "Back" : "Details",
        },
        {
          type: 2,
          style: BUTTON_LINK,
          url: websiteUrl,
          label: "Play",
        },
      ],
    },
  ];
}

function onlineEmbed(game, detailView, botStatus, display) {
  const common = {
    title: "Legend FFA",
    description: "**Online** - Expanding Land Agar.io server",
    color: 0x57f287,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  if (detailView) {
    return {
      ...common,
      fields: [
        { name: "Food", value: number(game.food), inline: true },
        { name: "Viruses", value: number(game.viruses), inline: true },
        {
          name: "Bot gateway",
          value: botStatus.discord.gatewayPingMs === null ? "Connecting" : `${botStatus.discord.gatewayPingMs}ms`,
          inline: true,
        },
      ],
      footer: { text: "Details are read from the local game server" },
    };
  }

  return {
    ...common,
    fields: [
      {
        name: `${integer(game.alive)}/${integer(display.playingCapacity)}`,
        value: "Players",
        inline: true,
      },
      {
        name: `${integer(game.spectators)}/${integer(display.spectatorCapacity)}`,
        value: "Spectators",
        inline: true,
      },
      {
        name: formatUptime(Number(game.uptime) || 0),
        value: "Uptime",
        inline: true,
      },
      { name: integer(display.botCount), value: "Bots", inline: true },
      {
        name: formatMapTier(game.map_scale, { includeRaw: false, multiplySign: "\u00d7" }),
        value: "Map tier",
        inline: true,
      },
      { name: String(game.version ?? "Unknown"), value: "Version", inline: true },
    ],
    footer: { text: "Press Refresh for current status" },
  };
}

function offlineEmbed() {
  return {
    title: "Legend FFA",
    description: "**Offline** - the game status endpoint is not responding",
    color: 0xed4245,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    footer: { text: "Press Refresh to try again" },
  };
}

export async function buildLegendResponse(
  interaction,
  {
    gameStatusUrl,
    gameWebsiteUrl,
    gamePlayingCapacity = 1024,
    gameSpectatorCapacity = 200,
    gameBotCount = 960,
    getBotStatus,
    liveStatusFailureReporter = null,
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  },
) {
  const isComponent = interaction.type === 3;
  const detailView = new Set([
    "legend:details",
    "legend:refresh:details",
  ]).has(interaction.data?.custom_id);
  let game;

  try {
    game = await fetchGameStatus(gameStatusUrl, fetchImpl);
    await liveStatusFailureReporter?.clearFailure?.("expanding-land-status");
  } catch (error) {
    await liveStatusFailureReporter?.reportFailure?.(
      "expanding-land-status",
      "Expanding Land status unavailable",
      `The local Expanding Land status endpoint failed while serving the dashboard: ${error.message}.`,
    );
    console.error("Legend FFA status request failed", error.message);
  }

  const data = {
    embeds: [
      game?.status === "online"
        ? onlineEmbed(game, detailView, getBotStatus(), {
            playingCapacity: gamePlayingCapacity,
            spectatorCapacity: gameSpectatorCapacity,
            botCount: gameBotCount,
          })
        : offlineEmbed(),
    ],
    components: controls(gameWebsiteUrl, detailView),
    allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
  };

  if (!isComponent) {
    data.flags = EPHEMERAL_FLAG;
  }

  return {
    type: isComponent ? RESPONSE_UPDATE : RESPONSE_MESSAGE,
    data,
  };
}
