import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";

const SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 1;
const MAX_SUBJECT_CHARS = 80;
const MAX_CONTENT_CHARS = 500;
const MAX_TAG_CHARS = 30;
const MAX_TAGS = 5;

const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  "about", "after", "again", "also", "and", "are",
  "can", "did", "does", "for", "from", "have", "how",
  "into", "just", "our", "that", "the", "their",
  "then", "there", "they", "this", "was", "what",
  "when", "where", "which", "who", "why", "will",
  "with", "you", "your",
]);

function normalizedWords(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .toLowerCase()
    .match(/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g) ?? [];
}

function normalizeKey(subject) {
  return String(subject ?? "")
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
}

function sanitizeText(value, maxLength) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/gi, "[link]")
    .replace(/(?:gsk[_-]|sk-)[a-z0-9_-]{20,}/gi, "[secret]")
    .replace(
      /[a-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[a-z0-9_-]{6,}\.[a-z0-9_-]{20,}/gi,
      "[secret]",
    )
    .replace(/<@!?\d+>|<@&\d+>/g, "@user")
    .replace(/<#\d+>/g, "#channel")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
}

function taughtByHash(interaction) {
  const userId =
    interaction?.member?.user?.id
    ?? interaction?.user?.id
    ?? interaction?.author?.id;

  const guildId =
    interaction?.guild_id ?? "direct-message";

  if (!userId) return null;

  return createHash("sha256")
    .update(`${guildId}:${userId}`)
    .digest("hex");
}

function taughtByName(interaction) {
  const user =
    interaction?.member?.user
    ?? interaction?.user
    ?? interaction?.author;

  return user?.global_name
    ?? user?.username
    ?? "unknown";
}

function validFact(fact) {
  if (
    !fact
    || typeof fact !== "object"
    || typeof fact.subject !== "string"
    || typeof fact.content !== "string"
    || !Number.isFinite(fact.createdAt)
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const subject = sanitizeText(
    fact.subject,
    MAX_SUBJECT_CHARS,
  );

  const content = sanitizeText(
    fact.content,
    MAX_CONTENT_CHARS,
  );

  if (!subject || !content) return null;

  const tags = Array.isArray(fact.tags)
    ? fact.tags
        .filter((tag) => typeof tag === "string")
        .map((tag) => tag.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, MAX_TAG_CHARS))
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(0, MAX_TAGS)
    : [];

  return {
    subject,
    content,
    tags,
    taughtBy:
      typeof fact.taughtBy === "string"
        ? fact.taughtBy
        : null,
    taughtByName:
      typeof fact.taughtByName === "string"
        ? fact.taughtByName.slice(0, 40)
        : "unknown",
    createdAt: fact.createdAt,
    updatedAt: Number.isFinite(fact.updatedAt)
      ? fact.updatedAt
      : fact.createdAt,
  };
}

export class CommunityKnowledge {
  constructor({
    dataPath = "data/community-knowledge.json",
    maxFacts = 500,
    maxContextChars = 1_500,
    now = Date.now,
    logger = console,
  } = {}) {
    this.dataPath = resolve(dataPath);
    this.maxFacts = maxFacts;
    this.maxContextChars = maxContextChars;
    this.now = now;
    this.logger = logger;

    this.snapshot = {
      version: SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
      updatedAt: null,
      facts: {},
    };

    this.persistQueue = Promise.resolve();
  }

  prune() {
    const cleaned = {};

    for (const [key, fact] of Object.entries(
      this.snapshot.facts,
    )) {
      const valid = validFact(fact);

      if (valid && normalizeKey(key)) {
        cleaned[normalizeKey(key)] = valid;
      }
    }

    const entries = Object.entries(cleaned);

    if (entries.length > this.maxFacts) {
      entries.sort((left, right) => {
        const leftAt = left[1].updatedAt ?? 0;
        const rightAt = right[1].updatedAt ?? 0;
        return rightAt - leftAt;
      });

      this.snapshot.facts = Object.fromEntries(
        entries.slice(0, this.maxFacts),
      );
    } else {
      this.snapshot.facts = cleaned;
    }
  }

  async load() {
    try {
      const snapshot = JSON.parse(
        await readFile(this.dataPath, "utf8"),
      );

      if (
        snapshot?.version === SNAPSHOT_VERSION
        && snapshot.facts
        && typeof snapshot.facts === "object"
      ) {
        this.snapshot = snapshot;
        this.prune();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code !== "ENOENT") {
        this.logger.warn(
          "Community knowledge could not be loaded",
          error.message,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  async persist() {
    await mkdir(dirname(this.dataPath), {
      recursive: true,
      mode: 0o700,
    });

    const temporaryPath = `${this.dataPath}.tmp`;

    await writeFile(
      temporaryPath,
      `${JSON.stringify(this.snapshot)}\n`,
      { mode: 0o600 },
    );

    await rename(temporaryPath, this.dataPath);
  }

  persistCurrent() {
    this.persistQueue = this.persistQueue
      .catch(() => {})
      .then(() => this.persist());

    return this.persistQueue;
  }

  async start() {
    await this.load();
  }

  async stop() {
    await this.persistCurrent();
  }

  async store(subject, content, tags, interaction) {
    const key = normalizeKey(subject);
    const cleanSubject = sanitizeText(
      subject,
      MAX_SUBJECT_CHARS,
    );

    const cleanContent = sanitizeText(
      content,
      MAX_CONTENT_CHARS,
    );

    if (!key || !cleanSubject || !cleanContent) {
      return false;
    }

    const now = this.now();
    const existing = this.snapshot.facts[key];

    this.snapshot.facts[key] = {
      subject: cleanSubject,
      content: cleanContent,
      tags: Array.isArray(tags)
        ? tags
            .filter((tag) => typeof tag === "string")
            .map((tag) => tag.trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, MAX_TAG_CHARS))
            .filter(Boolean)
            .slice(0, MAX_TAGS)
        : [],
      taughtBy: taughtByHash(interaction),
      taughtByName: taughtByName(interaction),
      createdAt: existing?.createdAt ?? now,
      updatedAt: now,
    };

    this.prune();
    this.snapshot.updatedAt =
      new Date(now).toISOString();

    try {
      await this.persistCurrent();
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn(
        "Community knowledge could not be saved",
        error.message,
      );
    }

    return true;
  }

  async remove(subject) {
    const key = normalizeKey(subject);
    if (!key) return false;

    const existed = Boolean(this.snapshot.facts[key]);
    delete this.snapshot.facts[key];

    if (existed) {
      this.snapshot.updatedAt =
        new Date(this.now()).toISOString();

      try {
        await this.persistCurrent();
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.warn(
          "Community knowledge could not be saved",
          error.message,
        );
      }
    }

    return existed;
  }

  contextFor(question) {
    const queryWords = new Set(
      normalizedWords(question)
        .filter((word) => !STOP_WORDS.has(word)),
    );

    if (queryWords.size === 0) return "";

    const scored = Object.values(this.snapshot.facts)
      .map((fact) => {
        const factWords = new Set([
          ...normalizedWords(fact.subject),
          ...normalizedWords(fact.content),
          ...fact.tags.flatMap((tag) =>
            normalizedWords(tag),
          ),
        ]);

        const overlap = [...queryWords].filter(
          (word) => factWords.has(word),
        ).length;

        return { fact, score: overlap };
      })
      .filter((entry) => entry.score > 0)
      .sort(
        (left, right) =>
          right.score - left.score
          || (right.fact.updatedAt ?? 0)
            - (left.fact.updatedAt ?? 0),
      );

    const selected = [];
    let length = 0;

    for (const { fact } of scored) {
      const line =
        `- ${fact.subject}: ${fact.content}`
        + (fact.taughtByName
          ? ` (shared by ${fact.taughtByName})`
          : "");

      if (
        selected.length >= 5
        || length + line.length > this.maxContextChars
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      selected.push(line);
      length += line.length + 1;
    }

    return selected.join("\n");
  }

  factCount() {
    return Object.keys(this.snapshot.facts).length;
  }
}

import { DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS } from "./ai-routing.js";
import { DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_FREE_MODELS } from "./groq-client.js";

const LOOPBACK_HOSTS = new Set(["127.0.0.1", "::1", "localhost"]);
const DEFAULT_WEB_ALLOWED_DOMAINS = [
  "join.lc",
  "legendmod.ml",
  "expanding.land",
  "github.com",
  "chromewebstore.google.com",
  "greasyfork.org",
  "support.miniclip.com",
  "delt.io",
  "agar.snez.org",
  "discord.com",
  "jimboy3100.github.io",
];

function required(env, name) {
  const value = env[name]?.trim();

  if (!value) {
    throw new Error(`Missing required environment variable: ${name}`);
  }

  return value;
}

function parsePort(value) {
  const port = Number.parseInt(value ?? "3100", 10);

  if (!Number.isInteger(port) || port < 1 || port > 65535) {
    throw new Error("HEALTH_PORT must be an integer between 1 and 65535");
  }

  return port;
}

function parseNonNegativeInteger(value, fallback, name) {
  const parsed = Number.parseInt(value ?? String(fallback), 10);

  if (!Number.isInteger(parsed) || parsed < 0) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a non-negative integer`);
  }

  return parsed;
}

function parseIdList(value) {
  const raw = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (!raw) return [];
  return raw
    .split(",")
    .map((entry) => entry.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function parseStringList(value, fallback = []) {
  const raw = String(value ?? "").trim();
  const source = raw
    ? raw.split(",")
    : fallback;

  return [...new Set(
    source
      .map((entry) => String(entry ?? "").trim())
      .filter(Boolean),
  )];
}

function parseDomainList(value, fallback = DEFAULT_WEB_ALLOWED_DOMAINS) {
  const raw = String(value ?? "").trim();
  const source = raw
    ? raw.split(",")
    : fallback;

  const domains = source
    .map((entry) => String(entry ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean);

  return [...new Set(domains)];
}

function parseBoolean(value, fallback = false) {
  if (value === undefined || value === "") return fallback;
  if (value === "true") return true;
  if (value === "false") return false;
  throw new Error("Boolean configuration values must be true or false");
}

function parseOptionalCountryCode(value, name) {
  const raw = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  if (!/^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(raw)) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a two-letter country code`);
  }
  return raw.toUpperCase();
}

function parseAiProvider(value, { hasPollinationsKey = false } = {}) {
  const provider = String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!provider) {
    return hasPollinationsKey ? "pollinations" : "groq";
  }
  if (provider === "groq" || provider === "pollinations") {
    return provider;
  }
  throw new Error("AI_PROVIDER must be groq or pollinations");
}

function parseRouteModel(value, fallback, allowedModels, name) {
  const model = String(value ?? "").trim() || fallback;
  if (!allowedModels.includes(model)) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be included in POLLINATIONS_ALLOWED_MODELS`);
  }
  return model;
}

function healthConfig(env) {
  const host = env.HEALTH_HOST?.trim() || "127.0.0.1";

  if (!LOOPBACK_HOSTS.has(host)) {
    throw new Error("HEALTH_HOST must be a loopback address");
  }

  return {
    healthHost: host,
    healthPort: parsePort(env.HEALTH_PORT),
  };
}

function parseUrl(value, name, { loopbackOnly = false } = {}) {
  let url;

  try {
    url = new URL(value);
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`${name} must be a valid URL`);
  }

  if (!new Set(["http:", "https:"]).has(url.protocol)) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must use HTTP or HTTPS`);
  }

  if (loopbackOnly && !LOOPBACK_HOSTS.has(url.hostname)) {
    throw new Error(`${name} must use a loopback host`);
  }

  return url.toString();
}

export function loadRuntimeConfig(env = process.env) {
  const guildId = env.DISCORD_GUILD_ID?.trim() || null;
  const publicMemoryEnabled = parseBoolean(env.PUBLIC_MEMORY_ENABLED?.trim().toLowerCase(), false);
  const playerProfilesEnabled = parseBoolean(env.PLAYER_PROFILES_ENABLED?.trim().toLowerCase(), false);
  const memberJoinMemoryEnabled = parseBoolean(env.MEMBER_JOIN_MEMORY_ENABLED?.trim().toLowerCase(), false);
  if (publicMemoryEnabled && !guildId) {
    throw new Error("DISCORD_GUILD_ID is required when PUBLIC_MEMORY_ENABLED is true");
  }
  if (memberJoinMemoryEnabled && !guildId) {
    throw new Error("DISCORD_GUILD_ID is required when MEMBER_JOIN_MEMORY_ENABLED is true");
  }
  const playerProfilePromptsEnabled = parseBoolean(
    env.PLAYER_PROFILE_PROMPTS_ENABLED?.trim().toLowerCase(),
    false,
  );
  if (playerProfilePromptsEnabled && !publicMemoryEnabled) {
    throw new Error("PUBLIC_MEMORY_ENABLED must be true when PLAYER_PROFILE_PROMPTS_ENABLED is true");
  }
  if (playerProfilePromptsEnabled && !playerProfilesEnabled) {
    throw new Error("PLAYER_PROFILES_ENABLED must be true when PLAYER_PROFILE_PROMPTS_ENABLED is true");
  }

  const autoAnswerEnabled = parseBoolean(env.AUTO_ANSWER_ENABLED?.trim().toLowerCase(), false);
  if (autoAnswerEnabled && !guildId) {
    throw new Error("DISCORD_GUILD_ID is required when AUTO_ANSWER_ENABLED is true");
  }
  const pollinationsApiKey = env.POLLINATIONS_API_KEY?.trim() || null;
  const aiProvider = parseAiProvider(env.AI_PROVIDER, {
    hasPollinationsKey: Boolean(pollinationsApiKey),
  });
  const groqModel = env.GROQ_MODEL?.trim() || "openai/gpt-oss-20b";
  const pollinationsAllowedModels = parseStringList(
    env.POLLINATIONS_ALLOWED_MODELS,
    DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_FREE_MODELS,
  );
  const pollinationsModel = env.POLLINATIONS_MODEL?.trim()
    || pollinationsAllowedModels[0]
    || DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_FREE_MODELS[0];
  if (aiProvider === "pollinations" && !pollinationsAllowedModels.includes(pollinationsModel)) {
    throw new Error("POLLINATIONS_MODEL must be included in POLLINATIONS_ALLOWED_MODELS");
  }
  const aiModelRoutingEnabled = parseBoolean(
    env.AI_MODEL_ROUTING_ENABLED?.trim().toLowerCase(),
    true,
  );
  const pollinationsRouteModels = aiProvider === "pollinations"
    ? {
        chat: parseRouteModel(
          env.POLLINATIONS_CHAT_MODEL,
          DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS.chat,
          pollinationsAllowedModels,
          "POLLINATIONS_CHAT_MODEL",
        ),
        reasoning: parseRouteModel(
          env.POLLINATIONS_REASONING_MODEL,
          DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS.reasoning,
          pollinationsAllowedModels,
          "POLLINATIONS_REASONING_MODEL",
        ),
        code: parseRouteModel(
          env.POLLINATIONS_CODE_MODEL,
          DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS.code,
          pollinationsAllowedModels,
          "POLLINATIONS_CODE_MODEL",
        ),
        vision: parseRouteModel(
          env.POLLINATIONS_VISION_MODEL,

export const CROSSREF_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 6_000;
export const CROSSREF_MAX_RESULTS = 3;
const CROSSREF_WORKS_API = "https://api.crossref.org/works";
const CROSSREF_USER_AGENT = "discord-bot-server/1.0 (+https://github.com/kyriakidisdimitrios/discord-bot-server)";

export class CrossrefContextError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "CrossrefContextError";
  }
}

function cleanText(value, maxLength = 280) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
}

function normalizeQuery(value) {
  return cleanText(value, 220);
}

function stripExplicitCrossrefPrompt(text) {
  let query = String(text ?? "").trim();

  const patterns = [
    /^(?:please\s+)?search\s+crossref\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?look\s+up\s+(?:on\s+)?crossref\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?check\s+crossref\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+|on\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?what\s+does\s+crossref\s+say\s+about\s+/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?crossref\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?find\s+(?:this\s+)?doi\s+on\s+crossref\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
  ];

  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    query = query.replace(pattern, "");
  }

  query = query
    .replace(/\bon\s+crossref\b/gi, "")
    .replace(/[?]+$/g, "")
    .trim();

  return normalizeQuery(query);
}

export function extractCrossrefRequest(question) {
  const text = cleanText(question, 500);
  if (!text) return null;

  const explicitIntent =
    /\bcrossref\b/i.test(text)
    || (/\bdoi\b/i.test(text) && /\bcrossref\b/i.test(text));

  if (!explicitIntent) return null;

  const query = stripExplicitCrossrefPrompt(text);
  if (!query) return null;

  return { query };
}

async function fetchJson(url, fetchImpl) {
  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(url, {
      headers: {
        accept: "application/json",
        "user-agent": CROSSREF_USER_AGENT,
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CROSSREF_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new CrossrefContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "The Crossref lookup timed out."
        : "The Crossref lookup could not be completed right now.",
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new CrossrefContextError(`The Crossref lookup returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

function pickPublishedDate(parts) {
  const values = Array.isArray(parts) ? parts : [];
  return values[0]
    ? values.slice(0, 3).join("-")
    : "";
}

function summarizeWork(item) {
  const title = cleanText(Array.isArray(item?.title) ? item.title[0] : item?.title, 180);
  const doi = cleanText(item?.DOI ?? "", 120);
  const type = cleanText(item?.type ?? "", 80);
  const publisher = cleanText(item?.publisher ?? "", 120);
  const published =
    pickPublishedDate(item?.issued?.["date-parts"]?.[0])
    || pickPublishedDate(item?.published?.["date-parts"]?.[0]);
  const authors = Array.isArray(item?.author)
    ? item.author
      .slice(0, 3)
      .map((author) => cleanText(
        [author?.given, author?.family].filter(Boolean).join(" "),
        80,
      ))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(", ")
    : "";
  const link = cleanText(
    item?.URL
      || item?.resource?.primary?.URL
      || "",
    260,
  );

  return [
    `- ${title || "Untitled work"}`,
    doi ? `DOI ${doi}` : null,
    type ? `Type ${type}` : null,
    published ? `Published ${published}` : null,
    authors ? `Authors ${authors}` : null,
    publisher ? `Publisher ${publisher}` : null,
    link ? `URL ${link}` : null,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" | ");
}

export async function fetchCrossrefContext(
  question,
  {
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  } = {},
) {
  const request = extractCrossrefRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const searchUrl = new URL(CROSSREF_WORKS_API);
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("query", request.query);
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("rows", String(CROSSREF_MAX_RESULTS));
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("select", "DOI,title,author,publisher,type,URL,issued,published,container-title");

  const payload = await fetchJson(searchUrl, fetchImpl);
  const items = Array.isArray(payload?.message?.items)
    ? payload.message.items.slice(0, CROSSREF_MAX_RESULTS)
    : [];

  if (items.length === 0) {
    throw new CrossrefContextError("Crossref did not return a matching work.");
  }

  const topItem = items[0];
  const topTitle = cleanText(Array.isArray(topItem?.title) ? topItem.title[0] : topItem?.title, 180);
  const topDoi = cleanText(topItem?.DOI ?? "", 120);
  const topJournal = cleanText(
    Array.isArray(topItem?.["container-title"])
      ? topItem["container-title"][0]
      : topItem?.["container-title"],
    140,
  );

  const lines = [
    "Crossref data fetched for this request only:",
    `Query: ${request.query}`,
    topTitle ? `Top work: ${topTitle}` : null,
    topDoi ? `Top DOI: ${topDoi}` : null,
    topJournal ? `Journal or container: ${topJournal}` : null,
    `Results:\n${items.map(summarizeWork).join("\n")}`,
    `Limits: timeout ${CROSSREF_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Results ${CROSSREF_MAX_RESULTS}. Use only this bounded Crossref snapshot.`,
  ];

  return lines.filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
}

function parseRequestedWatchDurationMs(text) {
  const match = text.match(/\b(?:for|during|keep|watch|stream|follow|monitor)\s+(?:up to\s+)?(\d{1,2})\s*(minutes?|mins?|m)\b/i)
    ?? text.match(/\b(?:up to|max(?:imum)? of?)\s+(\d{1,2})\s*(minutes?|mins?|m)\b/i);
  if (!match) return null;

  const minutes = Number.parseInt(match[1], 10);
  if (!Number.isInteger(minutes) || minutes < 1) return null;

  return Math.min(minutes * 60_000, MAX_DELTA_CHAT_WATCH_DURATION_MS);
}

function utf16Bytes(value) {
  const bytes = [];
  for (const char of String(value ?? "")) {
    const code = char.charCodeAt(0);
    bytes.push(code & 0xff, code >> 8);
  }
  return bytes;
}

function stringPacket(opcode, value = "") {
  return new Uint8Array([opcode, ...utf16Bytes(value)]);
}

function statePacket(state) {
  return new Uint8Array([state & 0xff]);
}

function roomPacket({
  serverToken,
  clanTag = "",
  region = "",
  gameMode = "",
  partyToken = "",
}) {
  const encode = (value = "") => [value.length & 0xff, ...utf16Bytes(value)];
  return new Uint8Array([
    9,
    ...encode(serverToken),
    ...encode(clanTag),
    ...encode(region),
    ...encode(gameMode),
    ...encode(partyToken),
  ]);
}

function deltaAuthPacket() {
  return new Uint8Array([0, 0]);
}

function deltaUInt32Packet(opcode, value = 0) {
  return new Uint8Array([
    opcode & 0xff,
    value & 0xff,
    (value >> 8) & 0xff,
    (value >> 16) & 0xff,
    (value >> 24) & 0xff,
  ]);
}

function deltaUtf8ZeroPacket(opcode, value = "") {
  const bytes = [...Buffer.from(String(value ?? ""), "utf8"), 0];
  return new Uint8Array([opcode & 0xff, ...bytes]);
}

function deltaRoomPacket({
  serverToken,
  clanTag = "",
  region = "",
  gameMode = "",
  partyToken = "",
}) {
  let flags = 0;
  const payload = [];
  const appendUtf16Zero = (bit, value) => {
    const normalized = cleanText(value, MAX_SERVER_HINT_LENGTH);
    if (!normalized) return;
    flags |= bit;
    payload.push(...utf16Bytes(normalized), 0, 0);
  };

  appendUtf16Zero(1, serverToken);
  appendUtf16Zero(2, clanTag);
  appendUtf16Zero(4, region);
  appendUtf16Zero(8, gameMode);
  appendUtf16Zero(16, partyToken);

  return new Uint8Array([9, flags, ...payload]);
}

function readLengthPrefixedUtf16(view, start) {
  if (start >= view.length) {
    return { value: "", next: view.length };
  }

  const length = view[start];
  let offset = start + 1;
  let value = "";
  for (let index = 0; index < length && offset + 1 < view.length; index += 1) {
    value += String.fromCharCode(view[offset] | (view[offset + 1] << 8));
    offset += 2;
  }
  return {
    value,
    next: offset,
  };
}

function readNullTerminatedUtf16(view, start) {
  let end = start;
  while (end + 1 < view.length) {
    if (view[end] === 0 && view[end + 1] === 0) break;
    end += 2;
  }

  let value = "";
  for (let offset = start; offset + 1 < end; offset += 2) {
    value += String.fromCharCode(view[offset] | (view[offset + 1] << 8));
  }
  return {
    value: value.trim(),
    next: Math.min(end + 2, view.length),
  };
}

function parseLegacyChatMessage(value) {
  const fullText = sanitizeChatText(value, MAX_TEXT_LENGTH + MAX_NAME_LENGTH + 2);
  if (!fullText) return null;

  const separatorIndex = fullText.indexOf(": ");
  if (separatorIndex <= 0) {
    return {
      name: "unknown",
      text: sanitizeChatText(fullText, MAX_TEXT_LENGTH),
    };
  }

  return {
    name: sanitizeChatText(fullText.slice(0, separatorIndex), MAX_NAME_LENGTH) || "unknown",
    text: sanitizeChatText(fullText.slice(separatorIndex + 2), MAX_TEXT_LENGTH),
  };
}

function decodeLegacyChatPacket(bufferLike) {
  const view = bufferLike instanceof Uint8Array
    ? bufferLike
    : new Uint8Array(bufferLike);

  if (view.length < 10 || view[0] !== 100) return null;

  const parsed = parseLegacyChatMessage(readNullTerminatedUtf16(view, 10).value);
  if (!parsed?.text) return null;

  return {
    type: view[1] === 102 ? "cmd" : "chat",
    ...parsed,
  };
}

function decodeDeltaChatPacket(bufferLike) {
  const view = bufferLike instanceof Uint8Array
    ? bufferLike
    : new Uint8Array(bufferLike);

  if (view.length < 8 || view[0] !== 25) return null;

  let offset = 1;
  const typeByte = view[offset++];
  offset += 6;
  const name = readLengthPrefixedUtf16(view, offset);
  offset = name.next;
  const text = readLengthPrefixedUtf16(view, offset);

  return {
    type: typeByte === 2 ? "cmd" : "chat",
    name: sanitizeChatText(name.value, MAX_NAME_LENGTH) || "unknown",
    text: sanitizeChatText(text.value, MAX_TEXT_LENGTH),
  };
}

class DeltaPacketReader {
  constructor(bufferLike) {
    const bytes = bufferLike instanceof Uint8Array
      ? bufferLike
      : new Uint8Array(bufferLike);
    this.view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength);
    this.offset = 0;
  }

  get length() {
    return this.view.byteLength;
  }

  canRead(bytes) {
    return this.offset + bytes <= this.view.byteLength;
  }

  readUInt8() {
    return this.view.getUint8(this.offset++);
  }

  readInt8() {
    return this.view.getInt8(this.offset++);
  }

  readUInt16() {
    const value = this.view.getUint16(this.offset, true);
    this.offset += 2;
    return value;
  }

  readInt16() {
    const value = this.view.getInt16(this.offset, true);
    this.offset += 2;
    return value;
  }

  readUInt24() {
    const red = this.readUInt8();
    const green = this.readUInt8();
    const blue = this.readUInt8();
    return (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue;
  }

  readUInt32() {
    const value = this.view.getUint32(this.offset, true);
    this.offset += 4;
    return value;
  }

  readUTF16StringLength() {
    const length = this.readUInt8();
    let value = "";
    for (let index = 0; index < length && this.canRead(2); index += 1) {
      value += String.fromCharCode(this.readUInt16());
    }
    return value;
  }

  readUTF16StringZero() {
    let value = "";
    while (this.canRead(2)) {
      const code = this.readUInt16();
      if (code === 0) break;
      value += String.fromCharCode(code);
    }
    return value;
  }
}

function decodeDeltaPresenceEstablishedPacket(bufferLike) {
  const reader = new DeltaPacketReader(bufferLike);
  if (!reader.canRead(3) || reader.readUInt8() !== 0) return null;
  return {
    connectionId: reader.readUInt16(),
  };
}

function decodeDeltaPresenceRemovePacket(bufferLike) {
  const reader = new DeltaPacketReader(bufferLike);
  if (!reader.canRead(1) || reader.readUInt8() !== 12) return null;

  const removedIds = [];
  while (reader.canRead(2)) {
    const playerId = reader.readUInt16();
    if (playerId === 0) break;
    removedIds.push(playerId);
  }
  return removedIds;
}

function decodeDeltaPresenceUpdatePacket(bufferLike) {
  const reader = new DeltaPacketReader(bufferLike);
  if (!reader.canRead(1) || reader.readUInt8() !== 16) return null;

  const updates = [];
  while (reader.canRead(2)) {
    const playerId = reader.readUInt16();
    if (playerId === 0) break;
    if (!reader.canRead(1)) break;

    const flagsTopLevel = reader.readUInt8();
    if (flagsTopLevel === 0) continue;

    const flagsDownLevel = flagsTopLevel & 1
      ? reader.readUInt8()
      : 0;
    const clientId = flagsDownLevel & 1 ? reader.readUInt16() : undefined;
    const nick = flagsDownLevel & 2 ? reader.readUTF16StringLength() : undefined;
    const customSkin = flagsDownLevel & 4 ? reader.readUTF16StringLength() : undefined;
    const customColor = flagsDownLevel & 8 ? reader.readUInt24() : undefined;
    const skin = flagsDownLevel & 16 ? reader.readUTF16StringLength() : undefined;
    const color = flagsDownLevel & 32 ? reader.readUInt24() : undefined;
    const accountId = flagsDownLevel & 64 ? reader.readUInt32() : undefined;

    const position = flagsTopLevel & 2
      ? {
          x: reader.readInt16(),
          y: reader.readInt16(),
          mass: reader.readUInt32(),
        }
      : undefined;
    const isAlive = flagsTopLevel & 4 ? reader.readUInt8() !== 0 : undefined;
    const quadrant = flagsTopLevel & 8 ? reader.readInt8() : undefined;

    updates.push({
      playerId,
      clientId,
      nick: sanitizeChatText(nick, MAX_NAME_LENGTH) || "",
      customSkin,
      customColor,
      skin,
      color,
      accountId,
      position,
      isAlive,
      quadrant,
    });
  }

  return updates;
}

function tokenLong(ip) {
  let result = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ip.length; i += 1) {
    const value = ip[i];
    let multiplier = 1;
    for (let j = 0; j < i; j += 1) multiplier *= AGARIO_TOKEN_RANGES[j] + 2;
    result += Math.floor((value / AGARIO_TOKEN_RANGES[i]) * (AGARIO_TOKEN_RANGES[i] + 1) + 0.5) * multiplier;
  }
  return result;
}

function sourceToServerToken(source) {
  const trimmed = cleanText(source, MAX_SERVER_HINT_LENGTH);
  if (!trimmed) return "";

  const oldArenaMatch = trimmed.match(/live-arena-([\w\d]+(?:\.tech)?)\.agar\.io/i);
  if (oldArenaMatch) {
    return oldArenaMatch[1].toLowerCase();
  }

  const newArenaMatch = trimmed.match(/web-arenas-live-v25-0\.agario\.miniclippt\.com\/([^/]+)\/(\d+-\d+-\d+-\d+)/i);
  if (newArenaMatch) {
    const regionIndex = AGARIO_AWS_REGIONS.indexOf(newArenaMatch[1]);
    const ipOctets = newArenaMatch[2]
      .split("-")
      .map((value) => Number.parseInt(value, 10));
    if (regionIndex >= 0 && ipOctets.length === 4 && ipOctets.every((value) => Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 255)) {
      return tokenLong([regionIndex, ...ipOctets]).toString(36).padStart(7, "0");
    }
  }

  const genericWsMatch = trimmed.match(/^wss?:\/\/(.+)$/i);
  if (genericWsMatch) {
    return Buffer.from(genericWsMatch[1], "utf8").toString("base64");
  }

  return trimmed;
}

export function normalizeDeltaChatServer(input) {
  const raw = cleanText(input, MAX_SERVER_HINT_LENGTH);
  if (!raw) return null;

  if (/^[a-z0-9]{5,8}(?:\.tech)?$/i.test(raw)) {
    return {
      serverToken: raw.toLowerCase(),
      displayServer: raw.toLowerCase(),
      sourceInput: raw,
    };
  }

  if (/^wss?:\/\//i.test(raw)) {
    return {
      serverToken: sourceToServerToken(raw),
      displayServer: raw,
      sourceInput: raw,
    };
  }

  return {
    serverToken: raw,
    displayServer: raw,
    sourceInput: raw,
  };
}

export function extractDeltaChatWatchRequest(question) {
  const text = cleanText(question, 500);
  if (!text) return null;

  const urlMatch = text.match(/wss?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+/i);
  const labeledMatch = text.match(/\b(?:server|room|token)\b\s*[:#-]?\s*([A-Za-z0-9+/_=.:?-]{4,200})/i);
  const shortTokenMatch = labeledMatch
    ? null
    : text.match(/\b(?=[a-z0-9]{5,8}(?:\.tech)?\b)(?=[a-z0-9]*[a-z])[a-z0-9]*\d[a-z0-9]*(?:\.tech)?\b/i);
  const disableTag = /\b(?:dont|don't|do not|without|no)\s+(?:use\s+)?tag\b/i.test(text);
  const clanTagMatch = disableTag
    ? null
    : text.match(/\b(?:use\s+tag|with\s+tag|clan\s+tag|tag)\b\s*[:=#-]?\s*([^\s,;]+)/i);
  const candidate = urlMatch?.[0] ?? labeledMatch?.[1] ?? shortTokenMatch?.[1] ?? "";
  const normalized = normalizeDeltaChatServer(candidate);
  if (!normalized?.serverToken) return null;

  const durationMs = parseRequestedWatchDurationMs(text);
  const explicitStreamRequest = /\b(?:watch|stream|follow|monitor|relay|track)\b/i.test(text);
  const participantChangeRequest = /\b(?:join(?:s|ed|ing)?|leave(?:s|d|ing)?|left)\b/i.test(text);
  const watchChat =
    /\b(?:show|watch|stream|follow|monitor|relay|track)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:chat|messages?|commands?|cmds?|lines?)\b/i.test(text)
    || /\b(?:chat|messages?|commands?|cmds?|lines?)\b[\s\S]{0,80}\b(?:show|watch|stream|follow|monitor|relay|track)\b/i.test(text);
  const watchParticipants =
    /\b(?:how many|count|total|amount)\b/i.test(text)
    || /\b(?:users?|people|participants?|members?|names?|nicks?|nicknames?|online)\b/i.test(text)
    || /\b(?:who(?:'s| is)?\s+(?:there|in|online|using))\b/i.test(text)
    || participantChangeRequest;

  if (!watchChat && !watchParticipants) {
    return null;
  }

  const clanTag = cleanClanTag(clanTagMatch?.[1] ?? "");
  const requestMode = !watchChat
    && watchParticipants
    && !explicitStreamRequest
    && !participantChangeRequest
    && !durationMs
    ? "snapshot"
    : "watch";

  return {
    ...normalized,
    clanTag,
    durationMs,
    requestMode,
    watchChat,
    watchParticipants,
  };
}

export function extractDeltaChatWatchStopRequest(question) {
  const text = cleanText(question, 500);
  if (!text) return null;

  if (!/\b(?:stop|close|end|cancel|disconnect)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return null;
  }

  if (!/\b(?:delta|chat|watch|connection|socket|stream)\b/i.test(text)) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    reason: text,
  };
}

function messageBody(content) {
  return {
    content,
    allowed_mentions: {
      parse: [],
    },
  };
}

function formatDuration(ms) {
  const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.round(ms / 1000));
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const remain = seconds % 60;
  if (minutes === 0) return `${remain}s`;
  return `${minutes}m ${remain}s`;
}

function watchTargetLabel(displayServer, clanTag = "") {
  const safeServer = escapeMentions(displayServer);
  const safeTag = escapeMentions(clanTag);
  return clanTag
    ? `${safeServer} with tag \`${safeTag}\``
    : safeServer;
}

function participantDisplayName(playerId, player = null) {
  const preferred = sanitizeChatText(player?.nick ?? "", MAX_NAME_LENGTH);
  return preferred || `player-${playerId}`;
}

function participantNamesSample(players) {
  const names = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const [playerId, player] of players.entries()) {
    const name = participantDisplayName(playerId, player);
    const key = name.toLowerCase();
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    names.push(name);
    if (names.length >= MAX_PARTICIPANT_NAME_SAMPLE) break;
  }
  return names;
}

function describeWatchMode({ watchChat, watchParticipants }) {
  if (watchChat && watchParticipants) {
    return {
      noun: "chat and participant watch",
      activity: "Delta chat or participant activity",
    };
  }
  if (watchParticipants) {
    return {
      noun: "participant watch",
      activity: "Delta participant activity",
    };
  }
  return {
    noun: "chat watch",
    activity: "chat",
  };
}

export class DeltaChatWatchManager {
  constructor({
    token,
    relayUrl = DEFAULT_DELTA_CHAT_RELAY_URL,
    presenceUrl = DEFAULT_DELTA_CHAT_PRESENCE_URL,
    presenceProtocol = DEFAULT_DELTA_CHAT_PRESENCE_PROTOCOL,
    durationMs = DEFAULT_DELTA_CHAT_WATCH_DURATION_MS,
    connectTimeoutMs = DEFAULT_DELTA_CHAT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS,
    idleTimeoutMs = DEFAULT_DELTA_CHAT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS,
    keepAliveMs = DEFAULT_DELTA_CHAT_KEEPALIVE_MS,
    participantBaselineMs = DEFAULT_DELTA_PARTICIPANT_BASELINE_MS,
    postMessage = createChannelMessage,
    webSocketCtor = WebSocket,
    now = Date.now,
    setTimeoutFn = setTimeout,
    clearTimeoutFn = clearTimeout,
    logger = console,
  } = {}) {
    this.token = token;
    this.relayUrl = relayUrl;
    this.presenceUrl = presenceUrl;
    this.presenceProtocol = presenceProtocol;
    this.durationMs = durationMs;
    this.connectTimeoutMs = connectTimeoutMs;
    this.idleTimeoutMs = idleTimeoutMs;
    this.keepAliveMs = keepAliveMs;
    this.participantBaselineMs = participantBaselineMs;
    this.postMessage = postMessage;
    this.webSocketCtor = webSocketCtor;
    this.now = now;
    this.setTimeoutFn = setTimeoutFn;
    this.clearTimeoutFn = clearTimeoutFn;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.active = null;
  }

  #runBackground(
    task,
    label,
    watch = null,
  ) {
    Promise.resolve(task).catch((error) => {
      this.logger.warn(
        `Delta ${label} failed`,
        error?.message ?? error,
      );

      if (
        watch
        && this.active === watch
        && !watch.finishing
      ) {
        Promise.resolve(
          this.#finishWatch(
            watch,
            `${label} failed`,
            {
              notify: false,
            },
          ),
        ).catch((finishError) => {
          this.logger.warn(
            "Delta watch cleanup failed",
            finishError?.message
              ?? finishError,
          );
        });
      }
    });
  }

  status() {
    if (!this.active) return null;
    return {
      channelId: this.active.channelId,
      requesterId: this.active.requesterId,
      requesterName: this.active.requesterName,
      serverToken: this.active.serverToken,
      displayServer: this.active.displayServer,
      clanTag: this.active.clanTag,
      watchChat: this.active.watchChat,
      watchParticipants: this.active.watchParticipants,
      startedAt: this.active.startedAt,
      messageCount: this.active.messageCount,
      participantCount: this.active.participants.size,
    };
  }

  isActiveInChannel(channelId) {
    return Boolean(this.active && channelId && this.active.channelId === channelId);
  }

  async startWatch({
    channelId,
    requesterId = null,
    requesterName = "unknown",
    serverToken,
    displayServer = null,
    clanTag = "",
    durationMs = null,
    watchChat = true,
    watchParticipants = false,
  }) {
    if (!this.token) throw new Error("Delta chat watch requires a Discord token");
    if (!channelId) throw new Error("Delta chat watch requires a channel ID");
    if (!serverToken) throw new Error("Delta chat watch requires a server token");

    const previous = this.status();
    if (previous) {
      await this.stop("replaced by a newer request", { notify: false });
    }

    const watch = {
      channelId,
      requesterId,
      requesterName,
      serverToken,
      displayServer: displayServer || serverToken,
      clanTag: cleanClanTag(clanTag),
      watchChat: watchChat !== false,
      watchParticipants: Boolean(watchParticipants),
      durationMs: Number.isInteger(durationMs) && durationMs > 0
        ? Math.min(durationMs, MAX_DELTA_CHAT_WATCH_DURATION_MS)
        : this.durationMs,
      startedAt: this.now(),
      joined: false,
      messageCount: 0,
      participantJoinCount: 0,
      participantLeaveCount: 0,
      opcodeCounts: new Map(),
      recentKeys: new Map(),
      participants: new Map(),
      participantConnectionId: null,
      participantBaselineReady: false,
      participantBaselineTimer: null,
      participantBaselinePosted: false,
      connectTimer: null,
      durationTimer: null,
      idleTimer: null,
      keepAliveTimer: null,
      chatSocket: null,
      participantSocket: null,
      finishing: false,
    };

    this.active = watch;

    this.#scheduleDurationTimeout(watch);
    this.#scheduleConnectTimeout(watch);
    this.#scheduleIdleTimeout(watch);

    if (watch.watchChat) {
      const socket = new this.webSocketCtor(this.relayUrl, "lc-watch");
      watch.chatSocket = socket;
      socket.binaryType = "arraybuffer";
      socket.onopen = () => {
        try {
          this.#sendJoinPackets(watch);
          this.#scheduleKeepAlive(watch);
        } catch {
          this.#runBackground(
            this.#finishWatch(
              watch,
              "chat socket setup failed",
              {
                notify: true,
              },
            ),
            "chat socket setup",
            watch,
          );
        }
      };

      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
        this.#runBackground(
          this.#handleChatMessage(
            watch,
            event.data,
          ),
          "chat message handling",
          watch,
        );
      };

      socket.onerror = () => {
        this.#runBackground(
          this.#finishWatch(
            watch,
            "chat socket error",
            {
              notify: true,
            },
          ),
          "chat socket shutdown",
          watch,
        );
      };

      socket.onclose = (event) => {
        if (!watch.finishing) {
          const code =
            event?.code ?? "unknown";

          this.#runBackground(
            this.#finishWatch(
              watch,
              `chat socket closed (${code})`,
              {
                notify: true,
              },
            ),
            "chat socket close handling",
            watch,
          );
        }
      };
    }

    if (watch.watchParticipants) {
      const socket = new this.webSocketCtor(this.presenceUrl, this.presenceProtocol);
      watch.participantSocket = socket;
      socket.binaryType = "arraybuffer";
      socket.onopen = () => {
        try {
          socket.send(
            deltaAuthPacket(),
          );
          socket.send(
            deltaUInt32Packet(134, 0),
          );
          socket.send(
            deltaUtf8ZeroPacket(133, ""),
          );
        } catch {
          this.#runBackground(
            this.#finishWatch(
              watch,
              "participant socket setup failed",
              {
                notify: true,
              },
            ),
            "participant socket setup",
            watch,
          );
        }
      };

      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
        this.#runBackground(
          this.#handleParticipantMessage(
            watch,
            event.data,
          ),
          "participant message handling",
          watch,
        );
      };

      socket.onerror = () => {
        this.#runBackground(
          this.#finishWatch(
            watch,
            "participant socket error",
            {
              notify: true,
            },
          ),
          "participant socket shutdown",
          watch,
        );
      };

      socket.onclose = (event) => {
        if (!watch.finishing) {
          const code =
            event?.code ?? "unknown";

          this.#runBackground(
            this.#finishWatch(
              watch,
              `participant socket closed (${code})`,
              {
                notify: true,
              },
            ),
            "participant socket close handling",
            watch,
          );
        }
      };
    }

    return {
      serverToken: watch.serverToken,
      displayServer: watch.displayServer,
      clanTag: watch.clanTag,
      watchChat: watch.watchChat,
      watchParticipants: watch.watchParticipants,
      replaced: Boolean(previous),
      replacedServerToken: previous?.serverToken ?? null,
    };
  }

  async stop(reason = "stopped", { notify = true } = {}) {
    if (!this.active) return false;
    await this.#finishWatch(this.active, reason, { notify });
    return true;
  }

  async snapshotParticipants({
    serverToken,
    displayServer = null,
    clanTag = "",
    timeoutMs = DEFAULT_DELTA_PARTICIPANT_SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  }) {
    if (!serverToken) {
      throw new Error("Delta participant snapshot requires a server token");
    }

    const settledDisplayServer = displayServer || serverToken;
    const settledClanTag = cleanClanTag(clanTag);

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      let socket = null;
      let finished = false;
      let timeoutTimer = null;
      let settleTimer = null;
      const participants = new Map();

      const clearTimers = () => {
        if (timeoutTimer) this.clearTimeoutFn(timeoutTimer);
        if (settleTimer) this.clearTimeoutFn(settleTimer);
        timeoutTimer = null;
        settleTimer = null;
      };

      const closeSocket = (reason) => {
        if (!socket) return;
        try {
          socket.onopen = null;
          socket.onmessage = null;
          socket.onerror = null;
          socket.onclose = null;
          if (socket.readyState < 2) {
            socket.close(1000, reason);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          this.logger.warn("Delta participant snapshot close failed", error?.message ?? error);
        }
      };

      const finish = () => {
        if (finished) return;
        finished = true;
        clearTimers();
        closeSocket("snapshot complete");
        resolve({
          serverToken,
          displayServer: settledDisplayServer,
          clanTag: settledClanTag,
          participantCount: participants.size,
          names: participantNamesSample(participants),
        });
      };

      const fail = (error) => {
        if (finished) return;
        finished = true;
        clearTimers();
        closeSocket("snapshot failed");
        reject(error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error ?? "Delta participant snapshot failed")));
      };

      const scheduleSettle = () => {
        if (settleTimer) {
          this.clearTimeoutFn(settleTimer);
        }
        settleTimer = this.setTimeoutFn(() => {
          settleTimer = null;
          finish();
        }, this.participantBaselineMs);
      };

      timeoutTimer = this.setTimeoutFn(() => {
        fail(new Error("Delta participant snapshot timed out"));
      }, Number.isInteger(timeoutMs) && timeoutMs > 0
        ? timeoutMs
        : DEFAULT_DELTA_PARTICIPANT_SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS);

      socket = new this.webSocketCtor(this.presenceUrl, this.presenceProtocol);
      socket.binaryType = "arraybuffer";
      socket.onopen = () => {
        try {
          socket.send(
            deltaAuthPacket(),
          );

          socket.send(
            deltaUInt32Packet(134, 0),
          );

          socket.send(
            deltaUtf8ZeroPacket(133, ""),
          );
        } catch (error) {
          fail(error);
        }
      };

      socket.onmessage = (event) => {
        if (finished) return;

        try {
          const bytes =
            event.data instanceof Uint8Array
              ? event.data
              : new Uint8Array(event.data);

          const established =
            decodeDeltaPresenceEstablishedPacket(
              bytes,
            );

          if (established) {
            socket.send(
              deltaRoomPacket({
                serverToken,
                clanTag: settledClanTag,
              }),
            );

            scheduleSettle();
            return;
          }

          const removedIds =
            decodeDeltaPresenceRemovePacket(
              bytes,
            );

          if (removedIds) {
            for (const playerId of removedIds) {
              participants.delete(playerId);
            }

            scheduleSettle();
            return;
          }

          const updates =
            decodeDeltaPresenceUpdatePacket(
              bytes,
            );

          if (!updates?.length) return;

          for (const update of updates) {
            const existing =
              participants.get(
                update.playerId,
              ) ?? null;

            participants.set(
              update.playerId,
              {
                ...existing,
                ...update,
                nick:
                  update.nick
                  || existing?.nick
                  || "",
              },
            );
          }

          scheduleSettle();
        } catch (error) {
          fail(error);
        }
      };
      socket.onerror = () => {
        fail(new Error("Delta participant snapshot socket error"));
      };
      socket.onclose = (event) => {
        if (finished) return;
        fail(new Error(`Delta participant snapshot socket closed (${event?.code ?? "unknown"})`));
      };
    });
  }

  #sendJoinPackets(watch) {
    if (this.active !== watch || !watch.chatSocket) return;
    watch.joined = true;
    watch.chatSocket.send(stringPacket(10, WATCHER_NICK));
    watch.chatSocket.send(stringPacket(15, ""));
    if (watch.clanTag) {
      watch.chatSocket.send(stringPacket(11, watch.clanTag));
    }
    watch.chatSocket.send(stringPacket(16, watch.serverToken));
    watch.chatSocket.send(
      roomPacket({
        serverToken: watch.serverToken,
        clanTag: watch.clanTag,
      }),
    );
    watch.chatSocket.send(statePacket(3));
  }

  #scheduleConnectTimeout(watch) {
    watch.connectTimer =
      this.setTimeoutFn(() => {
        this.#runBackground(
          this.#finishWatch(
            watch,
            "connection timed out",
            {
              notify: true,
            },
          ),
          "connection timeout handling",
          watch,
        );
      }, this.connectTimeoutMs);
  }

  #scheduleDurationTimeout(watch) {
    watch.durationTimer =
      this.setTimeoutFn(() => {
        this.#runBackground(
          this.#finishWatch(
            watch,
            `${formatDuration(
              watch.durationMs,
            )} window finished`,
            {
              notify: true,
            },
          ),
          "duration timeout handling",
          watch,
        );
      }, watch.durationMs);
  }

  #scheduleIdleTimeout(watch) {
    if (watch.idleTimer) {
      this.clearTimeoutFn(
        watch.idleTimer,
      );
    }

    watch.idleTimer =
      this.setTimeoutFn(() => {
        const mode =
          describeWatchMode(watch);

        this.#runBackground(
          this.#finishWatch(
            watch,
            `no ${mode.activity} arrived for too long`,
            {
              notify: true,
            },
          ),
          "idle timeout handling",
          watch,
        );
      }, this.idleTimeoutMs);
  }

  #scheduleKeepAlive(watch) {
    if (watch.keepAliveTimer) {
      this.clearTimeoutFn(
        watch.keepAliveTimer,
      );
    }

    watch.keepAliveTimer =
      this.setTimeoutFn(() => {
        if (
          this.active !== watch
          || watch.finishing
          || !watch.chatSocket
        ) {
          return;
        }

        try {
          watch.chatSocket.send(
            new Uint8Array([1]),
          );

          this.#scheduleKeepAlive(watch);
        } catch {
          this.#runBackground(
            this.#finishWatch(
              watch,
              "keepalive send failed",
              {
                notify: true,
              },
            ),
            "keepalive failure handling",
            watch,
          );
        }
      }, this.keepAliveMs);
  }

  #clearTimers(watch) {
    if (watch.connectTimer) this.clearTimeoutFn(watch.connectTimer);
    if (watch.durationTimer) this.clearTimeoutFn(watch.durationTimer);
    if (watch.idleTimer) this.clearTimeoutFn(watch.idleTimer);
    if (watch.keepAliveTimer) this.clearTimeoutFn(watch.keepAliveTimer);
    if (watch.participantBaselineTimer) this.clearTimeoutFn(watch.participantBaselineTimer);
    watch.connectTimer = null;
    watch.durationTimer = null;
    watch.idleTimer = null;
    watch.keepAliveTimer = null;
    watch.participantBaselineTimer = null;
  }

  #pruneRecentKeys(watch) {
    const cutoff = this.now() - DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS;
    for (const [key, seenAt] of watch.recentKeys.entries()) {
      if (seenAt < cutoff) watch.recentKeys.delete(key);
    }
  }

  #recordOpcode(watch, opcode) {
    watch.opcodeCounts.set(opcode, (watch.opcodeCounts.get(opcode) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  #markActivity(watch) {
    if (watch.connectTimer) {
      this.clearTimeoutFn(watch.connectTimer);
      watch.connectTimer = null;
    }
    this.#scheduleIdleTimeout(watch);
  }

  async #handleChatMessage(watch, data) {
    if (this.active !== watch || watch.finishing) return;

    const bytes = data instanceof Uint8Array ? data : new Uint8Array(data);
    const opcode = bytes[0];
    this.#recordOpcode(watch, opcode);
    this.#markActivity(watch);

    if (opcode === 1) {
      watch.chatSocket?.send(new Uint8Array([1]));
      return;
    }

    const decoded = decodeLegacyChatPacket(bytes) ?? decodeDeltaChatPacket(bytes);
    if (!decoded?.text) return;

    this.#pruneRecentKeys(watch);
    const dedupeKey = `${decoded.type}\n${decoded.name.toLowerCase()}\n${decoded.text.toLowerCase()}`;
    if (watch.recentKeys.has(dedupeKey)) return;
    watch.recentKeys.set(dedupeKey, this.now());

    watch.messageCount += 1;

    const label = decoded.type === "cmd" ? "cmd" : "chat";
    await this.postMessage(
      this.token,
      watch.channelId,
      messageBody(`[${label}] ${decoded.name}: ${decoded.text}`),
    );
  }

  #scheduleParticipantBaseline(watch) {
    if (watch.participantBaselineReady) return;
    if (watch.participantBaselineTimer) {
      this.clearTimeoutFn(watch.participantBaselineTimer);
    }
    watch.participantBaselineTimer = this.setTimeoutFn(() => {
      watch.participantBaselineTimer = null;
      this.#runBackground(
        this.#postParticipantBaseline(
          watch,
        ),
        "participant baseline posting",
        watch,
      );
    }, this.participantBaselineMs);
  }

  async #postParticipantBaseline(watch) {
    if (this.active !== watch || watch.finishing || watch.participantBaselinePosted) return;
    watch.participantBaselineReady = true;
    watch.participantBaselinePosted = true;
    const names = participantNamesSample(watch.participants);
    const namesLine = names.length
      ? ` Names: ${names.join(", ")}.`
      : "";
    await this.postMessage(
      this.token,
      watch.channelId,
      messageBody(
        `[participants] Tracking ${watch.participants.size} live Delta users on \`${watchTargetLabel(watch.displayServer, watch.clanTag)}\`.${namesLine}`,
      ),
    );
  }

  async #postParticipantDelta(watch, joined, left) {
    if (this.active !== watch || watch.finishing || (!joined.length && !left.length)) return;

    const joinedLine = joined.length
      ? ` Joined: ${joined.join(", ")}.`
      : "";
    const leftLine = left.length
      ? ` Left: ${left.join(", ")}.`
      : "";

    await this.postMessage(
      this.token,
      watch.channelId,
      messageBody(
        `[participants] Tracked now: ${watch.participants.size} on \`${watchTargetLabel(watch.displayServer, watch.clanTag)}\`.${joinedLine}${leftLine}`,
      ),
    );
  }

  async #handleParticipantMessage(watch, data) {
    if (this.active !== watch || watch.finishing) return;

    const bytes = data instanceof Uint8Array ? data : new Uint8Array(data);
    const opcode = bytes[0];
    this.#recordOpcode(watch, opcode);
    this.#markActivity(watch);

    const established = decodeDeltaPresenceEstablishedPacket(bytes);
    if (established) {
      watch.participantConnectionId = established.connectionId;
      watch.participantSocket?.send(
        deltaRoomPacket({
          serverToken: watch.serverToken,
          clanTag: watch.clanTag,
        }),
      );
      return;
    }

    const removedIds = decodeDeltaPresenceRemovePacket(bytes);
    if (removedIds) {
      const left = [];
      for (const playerId of removedIds) {
        const existing = watch.participants.get(playerId) ?? null;
        if (!existing) continue;
        if (watch.participantBaselineReady) {
          left.push(participantDisplayName(playerId, existing));
          watch.participantLeaveCount += 1;
        }
        watch.participants.delete(playerId);
      }
      if (watch.participantBaselineReady) {
        await this.#postParticipantDelta(watch, [], left);
      }
      return;
    }

    const updates = decodeDeltaPresenceUpdatePacket(bytes);
    if (!updates?.length) return;

    const joined = [];
    for (const update of updates) {
      const existing = watch.participants.get(update.playerId) ?? null;
      const next = {
        ...existing,
        ...update,
        nick: update.nick || existing?.nick || "",
      };
      watch.participants.set(update.playerId, next);

      if (!existing && watch.participantBaselineReady) {
        joined.push(participantDisplayName(update.playerId, next));
        watch.participantJoinCount += 1;
      }
    }

    if (!watch.participantBaselineReady) {
      this.#scheduleParticipantBaseline(watch);
      return;
    }

    await this.#postParticipantDelta(watch, joined, []);
  }

  async #finishWatch(watch, reason, { notify }) {
    if (watch.finishing) return;
    watch.finishing = true;

    if (this.active === watch) {
      this.active = null;
    }

    this.#clearTimers(watch);

    if (watch.chatSocket) {
      try {
        watch.chatSocket.onopen = null;
        watch.chatSocket.onmessage = null;
        watch.chatSocket.onerror = null;
        watch.chatSocket.onclose = null;
        if (watch.chatSocket.readyState < 2) {
          watch.chatSocket.close(1000, reason);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.warn("Delta chat watch close failed", error?.message ?? error);
      }
      watch.chatSocket = null;
    }

    if (watch.participantSocket) {
      try {
        watch.participantSocket.onopen = null;
        watch.participantSocket.onmessage = null;
        watch.participantSocket.onerror = null;
        watch.participantSocket.onclose = null;
        if (watch.participantSocket.readyState < 2) {
          watch.participantSocket.close(1000, reason);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        this.logger.warn("Delta participant watch close failed", error?.message ?? error);
      }
      watch.participantSocket = null;
    }

    if (notify) {
      const elapsed = this.now() - watch.startedAt;
      const opcodeSummary = Object.fromEntries([...watch.opcodeCounts.entries()].sort((left, right) => left[0] - right[0]));
      this.logger.info?.("Delta chat watch summary", {
        serverToken: watch.serverToken,
        clanTag: watch.clanTag,
        watchChat: watch.watchChat,
        watchParticipants: watch.watchParticipants,
        messageCount: watch.messageCount,
        participantCount: watch.participants.size,
        participantJoinCount: watch.participantJoinCount,
        participantLeaveCount: watch.participantLeaveCount,
        opcodeCounts: opcodeSummary,
        elapsedMs: elapsed,
        reason,
      });
      const mode = describeWatchMode(watch);
      const countsLine = watch.watchParticipants
        ? ` Participants tracked at stop: ${watch.participants.size}. Joins after baseline: ${watch.participantJoinCount}. Leaves after baseline: ${watch.participantLeaveCount}.`
        : "";
      await this.postMessage(
        this.token,
        watch.channelId,
        messageBody(
          `Stopped the Delta ${mode.noun} for \`${watchTargetLabel(watch.displayServer, watch.clanTag)}\` after ${formatDuration(elapsed)}. Unique lines shown: ${watch.messageCount}.${countsLine} Reason: ${reason}.`,
        ),
      );
    }
  }
}

const API_BASE_URL = "https://discord.com/api/v10";
const USER_AGENT = "DiscordBot (https://github.com/kyriakidisdimitrios/discord-bot-server, 1.0.0)";
export const DISCORD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

function delay(milliseconds) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
}

async function request(path, options, attempt = 0) {
  const headers = {
    accept: "application/json",
    "user-agent": USER_AGENT,
  };

  if (options.token) {
    headers.authorization = `Bot ${options.token}`;
  }

  if (options.body !== undefined) {
    headers["content-type"] = "application/json";
  }

  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${path}`, {
      method: options.method ?? "GET",
      headers,
      body:
        options.body === undefined
          ? undefined
          : JSON.stringify(options.body),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(
        DISCORD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS,
      ),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const timedOut =
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
      || error?.name === "AbortError";

    const requestError = new Error(
      timedOut
        ? `Discord API request timed out: ${path}`
        : `Discord API request failed before receiving a response: ${path}`,
      {
        cause: error,
      },
    );

    requestError.path = path;
    throw requestError;
  }

  const text = await response.text();
  let payload = null;

  if (text) {
    try {
      payload = JSON.parse(text);
    } catch {
      payload = text;
    }
  }

  if (response.status === 429 && attempt === 0) {
    const retryAfterMs = Math.ceil(Number(payload?.retry_after ?? 1) * 1000);
    await delay(Math.min(retryAfterMs, 5000));
    return request(path, options, attempt + 1);
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = typeof payload === "object" && payload?.message ? `: ${payload.message}` : "";
    const error = new Error(`Discord API request failed (${response.status})${detail}`);
    error.status = response.status;
    error.path = path;
    error.discordCode = typeof payload === "object" ? payload?.code ?? null : null;
    error.discordMessage = typeof payload === "object" ? payload?.message ?? null : null;
    error.discordPayload = payload;
    throw error;
  }

  return payload;
}

export async function getGatewayUrl(token) {
  const payload = await request("/gateway/bot", { token });
  return payload.url;
}

export function getGuildRoles(token, guildId) {

}

  return request(`/channels/${encodeURIComponent(channelId)}/messages?limit=${safeLimit}`, { token });
}

    token,
    body,
  });
}

function cleanString(value, fallback = "") {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim()
    ? value.trim()
    : fallback;
}

function normalizedPath(error) {
  return cleanString(error?.path, "");
}

function baseMessage(error) {
  const status = Number.isFinite(error?.status) ? `HTTP ${error.status}` : "unknown error";
  const detail = cleanString(error?.discordMessage, cleanString(error?.message, ""));
  return detail ? `${status}: ${detail}` : status;
}

export function diagnoseDiscordAccess(error, contextLabel = "Discord") {
  const path = normalizedPath(error);
  const label = cleanString(contextLabel, "Discord");

  if (error?.status !== 403) {
    return `${label} request failed (${baseMessage(error)}).`;
  }

  if (path.includes("/messages")) {
    return `${label} is missing access to read one or more channels. Check View Channel and Read Message History for the bot role.`;
  }

  if (path.includes("/channels")) {
    return `${label} cannot list or access one or more guild channels. Check that the bot can View Channel in the target category and rooms.`;
  }

  if (path.includes("/roles")) {
    return `${label} cannot read guild roles. Check that the bot is still in the server and has permission to view the guild setup.`;
  }

  return `${label} returned Missing Access. Check the bot's server membership and channel permissions.`;
}

export function diagnosePublicDiscussionAccess(error, categoryName = "PUBLIC ROOMS") {
  const category = cleanString(categoryName, "PUBLIC ROOMS");
  const advice = diagnoseDiscordAccess(error, `Public discussion sync for ${category}`);

  if (error?.status === 403) {
    return `${advice} The bot needs access to the ${category} category and its text rooms.`;
  }

  return advice;
}

const DOWNDETECTOR_API_BASE_URL = "https://downdetectorapi.com/v2";
const DOWNDETECTOR_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;
const COUNTRY_ALIASES = new Map([
  ["greece", "GR"],
  ["gr", "GR"],
  ["usa", "US"],
  ["us", "US"],
  ["united states", "US"],
  ["uk", "GB"],
  ["united kingdom", "GB"],
  ["great britain", "GB"],
  ["england", "GB"],
  ["germany", "DE"],
  ["de", "DE"],
  ["france", "FR"],
  ["fr", "FR"],
  ["italy", "IT"],
  ["it", "IT"],
  ["spain", "ES"],
  ["es", "ES"],
  ["canada", "CA"],
  ["ca", "CA"],
  ["australia", "AU"],
  ["au", "AU"],
]);

const TRIGGER_PATTERNS = [
  /\bdowndetector\b/i,
  /\b(?:is|are)\s+.+?\s+down(?:\s+right\s+now)?\b/i,
  /\boutage(?:\s+reports?)?\s+(?:for|on)\s+.+/i,
];

let cachedToken = null;
let cachedTokenExpiresAt = 0;

function compact(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function normalizeServiceName(value) {
  return compact(value)
    .replace(/^["'`([{<]+/, "")
    .replace(/["'`)\]}>]+$/, "")
    .replace(/\b(?:right now|currently|today|please|pls|plz)\b.*$/i, "")
    .replace(/\b(?:on|in)\s+downdetector\b/gi, "")
    .replace(/\b(?:in|for)\s+[a-z .-]+\b$/i, (match) => {
      const maybeCountry = match.replace(/^(?:in|for)\s+/i, "").trim().toLowerCase();
      return COUNTRY_ALIASES.has(maybeCountry) ? "" : match;
    })
    .replace(/[?!.,;:]+$/g, "")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);
}

function parseCountry(text, fallback = null) {
  const matches = [...String(text ?? "").matchAll(/\b(?:in|for)\s+([a-z .-]+?)(?=$|\b(?:right now|currently|today|tomorrow|please|pls|plz)\b|[?!.;,])/gi)];
  for (let index = matches.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const normalized = matches[index][1].trim().toLowerCase();
    const country = COUNTRY_ALIASES.get(normalized);
    if (country) return country;
  }
  return fallback;
}

function pickBestCompany(query, companies) {
  const normalizedQuery = compact(query).toLowerCase();
  const normalizedSlug = normalizedQuery.replace(/\s+/g, "-");

  const exact = companies.find((company) =>
    String(company?.name ?? "").toLowerCase() === normalizedQuery
    || String(company?.slug ?? "").toLowerCase() === normalizedSlug,
  );
  if (exact) return exact;

  const prefix = companies.find((company) =>
    String(company?.name ?? "").toLowerCase().startsWith(normalizedQuery)
    || String(company?.slug ?? "").toLowerCase().startsWith(normalizedSlug),
  );
  if (prefix) return prefix;

  return companies[0] ?? null;
}

function latestBucket(stats) {
  return Array.isArray(stats) && stats.length > 0
    ? stats[stats.length - 1]
    : null;
}

function authHeaders(token) {
  return {
    accept: "application/json",
    authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  };
}

async function readJsonOrThrow(response, fallbackMessage) {
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new DowndetectorContextError(fallbackMessage(response.status));
  }
  return response.json();
}

async function fetchAccessToken({
  apiToken = null,
  clientId = null,
  clientSecret = null,
  fetchImpl = fetch,
}) {
  if (apiToken) return apiToken;

  if (!clientId || !clientSecret) {
    throw new DowndetectorContextError("Downdetector Enterprise is not configured right now.");
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  if (cachedToken && now < cachedTokenExpiresAt) {
    return cachedToken;
  }

  const url = new URL("/tokens", DOWNDETECTOR_API_BASE_URL);
  url.searchParams.set("grant_type", "client_credentials");

  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(url, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        accept: "application/json",
        authorization: `Basic ${Buffer.from(`${clientId}:${clientSecret}`).toString("base64")}`,
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(DOWNDETECTOR_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new DowndetectorContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "Downdetector Enterprise timed out while creating a token."
        : "Downdetector Enterprise is temporarily unavailable.",
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
      throw new DowndetectorContextError("Downdetector Enterprise credentials were rejected.");
    }
    throw new DowndetectorContextError(`Downdetector Enterprise token setup returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }

  const payload = await response.json();
  const token = String(payload?.access_token ?? "").trim();
  const expiresIn = Number.parseInt(String(payload?.expires_in ?? "3600"), 10);
  if (!token) {
    throw new DowndetectorContextError("Downdetector Enterprise did not return an access token.");
  }

  cachedToken = token;
  cachedTokenExpiresAt = now + Math.max(60, expiresIn - 300) * 1_000;
  return token;
}

export class DowndetectorContextError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "DowndetectorContextError";
  }
}

export function extractDowndetectorRequest(question, { defaultCountry = null } = {}) {
  const text = compact(question);
  if (!TRIGGER_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(text))) {
    return null;
  }

  let service = "";
  const patterns = [
    /\bdowndetector\s+(?:for\s+)?(.+)$/i,
    /\b(?:is|are)\s+(.+?)\s+down(?:\s+right\s+now)?\b/i,
    /\boutage(?:\s+reports?)?\s+(?:for|on)\s+(.+)$/i,
  ];

  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    const match = text.match(pattern);
    if (match?.[1]) {
      service = normalizeServiceName(match[1]);
      if (service) break;
    }
  }

  return {
    text,
    service,
    country: parseCountry(text, defaultCountry),
  };
}

export async function fetchDowndetectorContext(
  question,
  {
    apiToken = null,
    clientId = null,
    clientSecret = null,
    defaultCountry = null,
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  } = {},
) {
  const request = extractDowndetectorRequest(question, { defaultCountry });
  if (!request) return "";

  if (!request.service) {
    throw new DowndetectorContextError(
      "Ask about a specific service, for example: is Discord down on Downdetector?",
    );
  }

  const token = await fetchAccessToken({
    apiToken,
    clientId,
    clientSecret,
    fetchImpl,
  });

  const searchUrl = new URL("/companies/search", DOWNDETECTOR_API_BASE_URL);
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("name", request.service);
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("page_size", "10");
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("fields", "id,name,slug,url,country_iso");
  if (request.country) searchUrl.searchParams.set("country", request.country);

  let searchResponse;
  try {
    searchResponse = await fetchImpl(searchUrl, {
      headers: authHeaders(token),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(DOWNDETECTOR_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new DowndetectorContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "Downdetector Enterprise search timed out."
        : "Downdetector Enterprise is temporarily unavailable.",
    );
  }

  const searchResults = await readJsonOrThrow(
    searchResponse,
    (status) => status === 401 || status === 403
      ? "Downdetector Enterprise access was denied."
      : `Downdetector Enterprise search returned HTTP ${status}.`,
  );

  const companies = Array.isArray(searchResults) ? searchResults : [];
  const company = pickBestCompany(request.service, companies);
  if (!company?.id) {
    throw new DowndetectorContextError("Downdetector did not find a matching company for that service.");
  }

  const detailsUrl = new URL(`/companies/${company.id}`, DOWNDETECTOR_API_BASE_URL);
  detailsUrl.searchParams.set(
    "fields",
    "id,name,slug,url,country_iso,description,status,baseline_current,stats_24",
  );
  const statusUrl = new URL(`/companies/${company.id}/status`, DOWNDETECTOR_API_BASE_URL);
  const last15Url = new URL(`/companies/${company.id}/last_15`, DOWNDETECTOR_API_BASE_URL);

  let details;
  let status;
  let last15;
  try {
    [details, status, last15] = await Promise.all([
      fetchImpl(detailsUrl, {
        headers: authHeaders(token),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(DOWNDETECTOR_TIMEOUT_MS),
      }).then((response) => readJsonOrThrow(
        response,
        (statusCode) => `Downdetector company details returned HTTP ${statusCode}.`,
      )),
      fetchImpl(statusUrl, {
        headers: authHeaders(token),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(DOWNDETECTOR_TIMEOUT_MS),
      }).then((response) => readJsonOrThrow(
        response,
        (statusCode) => `Downdetector company status returned HTTP ${statusCode}.`,
      )),
      fetchImpl(last15Url, {
        headers: authHeaders(token),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(DOWNDETECTOR_TIMEOUT_MS),
      }).then((response) => readJsonOrThrow(
        response,
        (statusCode) => `Downdetector last-15 reports returned HTTP ${statusCode}.`,
      )),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof DowndetectorContextError) throw error;
    throw new DowndetectorContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "Downdetector Enterprise timed out while reading company details."
        : "Downdetector Enterprise is temporarily unavailable.",
    );
  }

  return [
    "Downdetector Enterprise data fetched for this request only:",
    `Requested service: ${request.service}`,
    `Country filter: ${request.country ?? "none"}`,
    `Matched company: ${details?.name ?? company.name ?? request.service}`,
    `Company id: ${details?.id ?? company.id}`,
    `Slug: ${details?.slug ?? company.slug ?? "n/a"}`,
    `Country: ${details?.country_iso ?? company.country_iso ?? "n/a"}`,
    `Company URL: ${details?.url ?? company.url ?? "n/a"}`,
    details?.description ? `Description: ${details.description}` : null,
    `Current status endpoint: ${typeof status === "string" ? status : "n/a"}`,
    `Cached company status: ${details?.status ?? "n/a"}`,
    `Reports in last 15 minutes: ${typeof last15 === "number" ? last15 : "n/a"}`,
    `Current baseline: ${typeof details?.baseline_current === "number" ? details.baseline_current : "n/a"}`,
    `Latest cached 15-minute bucket: ${latestBucket(details?.stats_24) ?? "n/a"}`,
    "Status meanings from the API: success = normal, warning = elevated, danger = outage-like.",
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
}
