const STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS = 1_500;

const LIVE_QUERY_WORDS = new Set([
  "alive",
  "bot",
  "bots",
  "capacity",
  "client",
  "clients",
  "connected",
  "connections",
  "food",
  "map",
  "online",
  "offline",
  "people",
  "pellets",
  "player",
  "players",
  "playing",
  "population",
  "runtime",
  "scale",
  "slots",
  "spectating",
  "spectator",
  "spectators",
  "status",
  "tier",
  "uptime",
  "version",
  "virus",
  "viruses",
]);

function normalizedText(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9.]+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

function editDistance(left, right) {
  const previous = Array.from({ length: right.length + 1 }, (_, index) => index);

  for (let leftIndex = 1; leftIndex <= left.length; leftIndex += 1) {
    const current = [leftIndex];
    for (let rightIndex = 1; rightIndex <= right.length; rightIndex += 1) {
      current[rightIndex] = Math.min(
        current[rightIndex - 1] + 1,
        previous[rightIndex] + 1,
        previous[rightIndex - 1] + (left[leftIndex - 1] === right[rightIndex - 1] ? 0 : 1),
      );
    }
    previous.splice(0, previous.length, ...current);
  }

  return previous[right.length];
}

function resembles(word, expected, tolerance) {
  return word.length >= expected.length - tolerance && editDistance(word, expected) <= tolerance;
}

function explicitlyNamesExpandingLand(text, words) {
  if (text.includes("expanding.land") || text.includes("legend ffa")) return true;

  const expandingIndexes = words
    .map((word, index) => (resembles(word, "expanding", 3) ? index : -1))
    .filter((index) => index >= 0);

  return expandingIndexes.some((index) => words
    .slice(Math.max(0, index - 1), index + 4)
    .some((word) => word.startsWith("l") && resembles(word, "land", 1)));
}

function explicitlyNamesOfficialAgario(text) {
  return text.includes("agar.io")
    || text.includes("official agar")
    || /\bagar io\b/.test(text)
    || /\bagario\b/.test(text);
}

export function needsExpandingLandStatus(question) {
  const text = normalizedText(question);
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const explicitlyExpandingLand = explicitlyNamesExpandingLand(text, words);
  if (explicitlyExpandingLand) return true;
  if (explicitlyNamesOfficialAgario(text)) return false;

  const wordSet = new Set(words);
  const hasLiveTerm = words.some((word) => LIVE_QUERY_WORDS.has(word));
  const asksQuantity = /\bhow (many|much)\b/.test(text);
  const asksCurrentState = wordSet.has("now")
    || wordSet.has("current")
    || wordSet.has("currently")
    || wordSet.has("online")
    || wordSet.has("offline")
    || wordSet.has("status")
    || wordSet.has("uptime");

  return hasLiveTerm && (asksQuantity || asksCurrentState);
}

export async function fetchGameStatus(statusUrl, fetchImpl = fetch) {
  const response = await fetchImpl(statusUrl, {
    headers: { accept: "application/json" },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Game status returned HTTP ${response.status}`);
  }

  const status = await response.json();
  if (!status || typeof status !== "object" || Array.isArray(status)) {
    throw new Error("Game status response was not an object");
  }

  return status;
}

function numeric(value) {
  const parsed = typeof value === "number" ? value : Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function integer(value) {
  const parsed = numeric(value);
  return parsed === null ? "unknown" : Math.trunc(parsed).toLocaleString("en-US");
}

function uptime(value) {
  const parsed = numeric(value);
  if (parsed === null) return "unknown";
  const totalSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(parsed));
  const days = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 86_400);
  const hours = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 86_400) / 3_600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3_600) / 60);
  const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
  const parts = [
    days ? `${days}d` : null,
    hours ? `${hours}h` : null,
    minutes ? `${minutes}m` : null,
    seconds || totalSeconds === 0 ? `${seconds}s` : null,
  ].filter(Boolean);
  return `${parts.join(" ")} (${integer(totalSeconds)} seconds)`;
}

export function formatMapTier(value, { includeRaw = true, multiplySign = "x" } = {}) {
  const raw = numeric(value);
  if (raw === null || raw <= 0) {
    return includeRaw && raw !== null ? `unknown (raw map_scale: ${integer(raw)})` : "unknown";
  }

  const scale = (raw / 100).toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, "");
  const tierPosition = Math.log2(raw / 25);
  const roundedTier = Math.round(tierPosition);
  const exactTier = Math.abs(tierPosition - roundedTier) < 0.01;
  const rawSuffix = includeRaw ? `; raw map_scale: ${integer(raw)}` : "";

  if (exactTier) {
    return `Tier ${roundedTier} (${scale}${multiplySign} area${rawSuffix})`;
  }

  const lowerTier = Math.floor(tierPosition);
  const upperTier = Math.ceil(tierPosition);
  return `between Tier ${lowerTier} and Tier ${upperTier} (${scale}${multiplySign} area${rawSuffix})`;
}

function cleanVersion(value) {
  const version = String(value ?? "").replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, " ").trim();
  return version ? version.slice(0, 40) : "unknown";
}

export function formatGameStatusContext(
  game,
  {
    playingCapacity = 1_024,
    spectatorCapacity = 200,
    botCount = 960,
  } = {},
) {
  const status = String(game.status ?? "unknown").toLowerCase();
  if (status !== "online") {
    return `Current Expanding Land status: ${status}. Live parameters are unavailable.`;
  }

  return [
    "Current Expanding Land snapshot (authoritative for this request only):",
    `Status: online`,
    `Players: ${integer(game.alive)}/${integer(playingCapacity)} (use this for people or players playing)`,
    `Connections: ${integer(game.connected)} (separate raw server field; do not call it player count)`,
    `Spectators: ${integer(game.spectators)}/${integer(spectatorCapacity)}`,
    `Bots: ${integer(botCount)} (configured dashboard value)`,
    `Food: ${integer(game.food)}`,
    `Viruses: ${integer(game.viruses)}`,
    `Uptime: ${uptime(game.uptime)}`,
    `Map tier: ${formatMapTier(game.map_scale)}`,
    `Version: ${cleanVersion(game.version)}`,
    "Limits: this snapshot has no player identities or human-versus-bot breakdown; do not invent or derive them.",
  ].join("\n");
}

export async function liveGameStatusContextForQuestion(
  question,
  {
    statusUrl,
    playingCapacity,
    spectatorCapacity,
    botCount,
    onStatusSuccess = null,
    onStatusFailure = null,
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  },
) {
  if (!statusUrl || !needsExpandingLandStatus(question)) return "";

  try {
    const game = await fetchGameStatus(statusUrl, fetchImpl);
    await onStatusSuccess?.(game);
    return formatGameStatusContext(game, { playingCapacity, spectatorCapacity, botCount });
  } catch (error) {
    await onStatusFailure?.(error);
    return "Current Expanding Land status could not be read. Say that live data is temporarily unavailable; do not estimate it.";
  }
}

import { EventEmitter } from "node:events";

import { getGatewayUrl } from "./discord-api.js";

const GATEWAY_VERSION = "10";
const GUILDS_INTENT = 1;
const GUILD_MEMBERS_INTENT = 1 << 1;
const GUILD_MESSAGES_INTENT = 1 << 9;
const MESSAGE_CONTENT_INTENT = 1 << 15;
export const PUBLIC_DISCUSSION_INTENTS = GUILDS_INTENT | GUILD_MESSAGES_INTENT | MESSAGE_CONTENT_INTENT;
export const MEMBER_JOIN_INTENTS = GUILDS_INTENT | GUILD_MEMBERS_INTENT;
const FATAL_CLOSE_CODES = new Set([4004, 4010, 4011, 4012, 4013, 4014]);
const RESET_SESSION_CODES = new Set([4003, 4005, 4007, 4009]);

function gatewayAddress(baseUrl) {
  const url = new URL(baseUrl);
  url.searchParams.set("v", GATEWAY_VERSION);
  url.searchParams.set("encoding", "json");
  return url.toString();
}

async function messageText(data) {
  if (typeof data === "string") return data;
  if (data instanceof ArrayBuffer) return Buffer.from(data).toString("utf8");
  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(data)) return Buffer.from(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, data.byteLength).toString("utf8");
  if (typeof data?.text === "function") return data.text();
  return String(data);
}

export class DiscordGateway extends EventEmitter {
  constructor(token, options = {}) {
    super();
    this.token = token;
    this.WebSocketClass = options.WebSocketClass ?? globalThis.WebSocket;
    this.fetchGatewayUrl = options.fetchGatewayUrl ?? getGatewayUrl;
    this.intents = options.intents ?? GUILDS_INTENT;
    this.socket = null;
    this.gatewayUrl = null;
    this.resumeGatewayUrl = null;
    this.sessionId = null;
    this.sequence = null;
    this.user = null;
    this.guildIds = new Set();
    this.ready = false;
    this.gatewayPingMs = null;
    this.heartbeatTimeout = null;
    this.heartbeatInterval = null;
    this.awaitingHeartbeatAck = false;
    this.lastHeartbeatAt = null;
    this.reconnectTimer = null;
    this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
    this.resumeOnHello = false;
    this.resumeAfterClose = null;
    this.reconnectDelay = null;
    this.stopping = false;
  }

  async start() {
    if (typeof this.WebSocketClass !== "function") {
      throw new Error("This bot requires the built-in WebSocket available in Node.js 22");
    }

    this.stopping = false;
    this.gatewayUrl = await this.fetchGatewayUrl(this.token);
    this.#open(false);
  }

  stop() {
    this.stopping = true;
    this.ready = false;
    this.#clearTimers();

    if (this.socket && this.socket.readyState < this.WebSocketClass.CLOSING) {
      this.socket.close(1000, "Service stopping");
    }

    this.socket = null;
  }

  getStatus(startedAt) {
    return {
      ready: this.ready,
      uptimeSeconds: Math.floor((Date.now() - startedAt) / 1000),
      discord: {
        gatewayPingMs: this.gatewayPingMs,
        guilds: this.guildIds.size,
      },
    };
  }

  #open(resume) {
    if (this.stopping) return;

    const baseUrl = resume && this.resumeGatewayUrl ? this.resumeGatewayUrl : this.gatewayUrl;
    this.resumeOnHello = resume && Boolean(this.sessionId);
    const socket = new this.WebSocketClass(gatewayAddress(baseUrl));
    this.socket = socket;

    socket.addEventListener("message", (event) => {
      if (this.socket !== socket) return;
      this.#handleMessage(event.data).catch((error) => {
        console.error("Discord Gateway message failed", error);
        socket.close(4002, "Payload decode error");
      });
    });

    socket.addEventListener("close", (event) => {
      if (this.socket !== socket) return;
      this.#handleClose(event.code, event.reason);
    });

    socket.addEventListener("error", (event) => {
      console.error("Discord Gateway WebSocket error", event.error ?? "connection error");
    });
  }

  async #handleMessage(data) {
    const payload = JSON.parse(await messageText(data));

    if (payload.s !== null && payload.s !== undefined) {
      this.sequence = payload.s;
    }

    if (payload.op === 10) {
      this.#startHeartbeat(payload.d.heartbeat_interval);
      this.#send(this.resumeOnHello ? this.#resumePayload() : this.#identifyPayload());
      return;
    }

    if (payload.op === 11) {
      this.awaitingHeartbeatAck = false;
      if (this.lastHeartbeatAt !== null) {
        this.gatewayPingMs = Date.now() - this.lastHeartbeatAt;
      }
      return;
    }

    if (payload.op === 1) {
      this.#sendHeartbeat(true);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.op === 7) {
      this.#requestReconnect(true);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.op === 9) {
      const canResume = Boolean(payload.d);
      if (!canResume) this.#resetSession();
      this.reconnectDelay = 1000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4000);
      this.#requestReconnect(canResume);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.op !== 0) return;

    if (payload.t === "READY") {
      this.sessionId = payload.d.session_id;
      this.resumeGatewayUrl = payload.d.resume_gateway_url;
      this.user = payload.d.user;
      this.guildIds = new Set(payload.d.guilds.map((guild) => guild.id));
      this.ready = true;
      this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
      this.emit("ready", this.user);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.t === "RESUMED") {
      this.ready = true;
      this.reconnectAttempts = 0;
      this.emit("resumed");
      return;
    }

    if (payload.t === "GUILD_CREATE") {
      this.guildIds.add(payload.d.id);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.t === "GUILD_DELETE" && !payload.d.unavailable) {
      this.guildIds.delete(payload.d.id);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.t === "INTERACTION_CREATE") {
      this.emit("interaction", payload.d);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.t === "MESSAGE_CREATE") {
      this.emit("messageCreate", payload.d);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.t === "MESSAGE_UPDATE") {
      this.emit("messageUpdate", payload.d);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.t === "MESSAGE_DELETE") {
      this.emit("messageDelete", payload.d);
      return;
    }

    if (payload.t === "GUILD_MEMBER_ADD") {
      this.emit("memberJoin", payload.d);
    }
  }

  #identifyPayload() {
    return {
      op: 2,
      d: {
        token: this.token,
        intents: this.intents,
        properties: {
          os: "linux",
          browser: "discord-bot-server",
          device: "discord-bot-server",
        },
      },
    };
  }

  #resumePayload() {
    return {
      op: 6,
      d: {
        token: this.token,
        session_id: this.sessionId,
        seq: this.sequence,
      },
    };
  }

  #send(payload) {
    if (!this.socket || this.socket.readyState !== this.WebSocketClass.OPEN) return false;
    this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(payload));
    return true;
  }

  #startHeartbeat(intervalMs) {
    this.#clearHeartbeat();
    const firstDelay = Math.floor(Math.random() * intervalMs);

    this.heartbeatTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      this.#sendHeartbeat();
      this.heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => this.#sendHeartbeat(), intervalMs);
    }, firstDelay);
  }

  #sendHeartbeat(force = false) {
    if (this.awaitingHeartbeatAck && !force) {
      console.warn("Discord Gateway heartbeat was not acknowledged; reconnecting");
      this.#requestReconnect(true);
      return;
    }

    if (this.#send({ op: 1, d: this.sequence })) {
      this.awaitingHeartbeatAck = true;
      this.lastHeartbeatAt = Date.now();
    }
  }

  #requestReconnect(resume) {
    if (this.stopping) return;

    this.ready = false;
    this.resumeAfterClose = resume;

    if (this.socket && this.socket.readyState < this.WebSocketClass.CLOSING) {
      this.socket.close(4000, "Reconnecting");
      return;
    }

    this.#scheduleReconnect(resume);
  }

  #handleClose(code, reason) {
    this.socket = null;
    this.ready = false;
    this.#clearHeartbeat();

    if (this.stopping) return;

    if (FATAL_CLOSE_CODES.has(code)) {
      this.emit("fatal", new Error(`Discord Gateway closed with fatal code ${code}: ${reason}`));
      return;
    }

    if (RESET_SESSION_CODES.has(code)) {
      this.#resetSession();
    }

    const resume = this.resumeAfterClose ?? Boolean(this.sessionId);
    this.resumeAfterClose = null;
    this.#scheduleReconnect(resume);
  }

  #scheduleReconnect(resume) {
    if (this.stopping || this.reconnectTimer) return;

    const exponentialDelay = Math.min(30000, 1000 * 2 ** this.reconnectAttempts);
    const delayMs = this.reconnectDelay ?? exponentialDelay + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000);
    this.reconnectDelay = null;
    this.reconnectAttempts += 1;

    this.reconnectTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      this.reconnectTimer = null;
      this.#open(resume && Boolean(this.sessionId));
    }, delayMs);
  }

  #resetSession() {
    this.sessionId = null;
    this.resumeGatewayUrl = null;
    this.sequence = null;
    this.user = null;
    this.guildIds.clear();
  }

  #clearHeartbeat() {
    clearTimeout(this.heartbeatTimeout);
    clearInterval(this.heartbeatInterval);
    this.heartbeatTimeout = null;
    this.heartbeatInterval = null;
    this.awaitingHeartbeatAck = false;
    this.lastHeartbeatAt = null;
    this.gatewayPingMs = null;
  }

  #clearTimers() {
    this.#clearHeartbeat();
    clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimer);
    this.reconnectTimer = null;
  }
}

export const GITHUB_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 6_000;
export const GITHUB_MAX_COMMITS = 3;
export const GITHUB_MAX_ISSUES = 3;
export const GITHUB_MAX_RELEASES = 2;

const GITHUB_API_BASE = "https://api.github.com";
const GITHUB_USER_AGENT = "discord-bot-server/1.0 (+https://github.com/kyriakidisdimitrios/discord-bot-server)";

export class GitHubContextError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "GitHubContextError";
  }
}

function cleanText(value, maxLength = 240) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
}

function repoFromText(text) {
  const githubUrlMatch = String(text ?? "").match(/github\.com\/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)/i);
  if (githubUrlMatch) {
    return { owner: githubUrlMatch[1], repo: githubUrlMatch[2].replace(/\.git$/i, "") };
  }

  const labeledMatch = String(text ?? "").match(/\b(?:repo|repository|github)\b[\s:=-]*([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)/i);
  if (labeledMatch) {
    const [owner, repo] = labeledMatch[1].split("/");
    return { owner, repo };
  }

  const plainMatch = String(text ?? "").match(/\b([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\b/);
  if (plainMatch && /\b(?:github|commit|commits|issue|issues|release|releases|changelog|change log|release notes)\b/i.test(text)) {
    const [owner, repo] = plainMatch[1].split("/");
    return { owner, repo };
  }

  return null;
}

export function extractGitHubRequest(question) {
  const text = cleanText(question, 500);
  if (!text) return null;

  const repo = repoFromText(text);
  if (!repo?.owner || !repo?.repo) return null;

  const wantsCommits = /\b(?:commit|commits|history|recent changes?)\b/i.test(text);
  const wantsIssues = /\b(?:issue|issues|bugs?)\b/i.test(text);
  const wantsReleases = /\b(?:release|releases|changelog|change ?log|release notes?)\b/i.test(text);

  if (!wantsCommits && !wantsIssues && !wantsReleases) return null;

  return {
    owner: repo.owner,
    repo: repo.repo,
    wantsCommits,
    wantsIssues,
    wantsReleases,
  };
}

async function fetchJson(url, fetchImpl) {
  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(url, {
      headers: {
        accept: "application/vnd.github+json",
        "user-agent": GITHUB_USER_AGENT,
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(GITHUB_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new GitHubContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "The GitHub lookup timed out."
        : "The GitHub lookup could not be completed right now.",
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    if (response.status === 404) {
      throw new GitHubContextError("That GitHub repository or resource was not found.");
    }
    if (response.status === 403) {
      throw new GitHubContextError("GitHub refused the lookup right now.");
    }
    throw new GitHubContextError(`The GitHub lookup returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

function summarizeCommits(commits) {
  return (Array.isArray(commits) ? commits : [])
    .slice(0, GITHUB_MAX_COMMITS)
    .map((entry) => {
      const sha = cleanText(entry?.sha ?? "", 7);
      const message = cleanText(entry?.commit?.message?.split("\n")[0] ?? "", 140);
      const date = cleanText(entry?.commit?.author?.date ?? "", 40);
      const url = cleanText(entry?.html_url ?? "", 220);
      return `- ${sha || "unknown"} | ${message || "No message"} | ${date || "unknown date"} | ${url || "no link"}`;
    });
}

function summarizeIssues(issues) {
  return (Array.isArray(issues) ? issues : [])
    .filter((entry) => !entry?.pull_request)
    .slice(0, GITHUB_MAX_ISSUES)
    .map((entry) => {
      const number = cleanText(entry?.number ?? "", 20);
      const title = cleanText(entry?.title ?? "", 140);
      const state = cleanText(entry?.state ?? "", 20);
      const url = cleanText(entry?.html_url ?? "", 220);
      return `- #${number || "?"} | ${title || "Untitled"} | ${state || "unknown"} | ${url || "no link"}`;
    });
}

function summarizeReleases(releases) {
  return (Array.isArray(releases) ? releases : [])
    .slice(0, GITHUB_MAX_RELEASES)
    .map((entry) => {
      const tag = cleanText(entry?.tag_name ?? "", 40);
      const name = cleanText(entry?.name ?? "", 100);
      const published = cleanText(entry?.published_at ?? "", 40);
      const notes = cleanText(entry?.body ?? "", 200);
      const url = cleanText(entry?.html_url ?? "", 220);
      return [
        `- ${tag || "untagged"}${name ? ` | ${name}` : ""} | ${published || "unknown date"} | ${url || "no link"}`,
        notes ? `  Notes: ${notes}` : null,
      ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
    });
}

export async function fetchGitHubContext(
  question,
  {
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  } = {},
) {
  const request = extractGitHubRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const base = `${GITHUB_API_BASE}/repos/${encodeURIComponent(request.owner)}/${encodeURIComponent(request.repo)}`;
  const tasks = [];

  if (request.wantsCommits) {
    tasks.push(fetchJson(`${base}/commits?per_page=${GITHUB_MAX_COMMITS}`, fetchImpl).then((value) => ["commits", value]));
  }
  if (request.wantsIssues) {
    tasks.push(fetchJson(`${base}/issues?state=open&per_page=${GITHUB_MAX_ISSUES + 2}`, fetchImpl).then((value) => ["issues", value]));
  }
  if (request.wantsReleases) {
    tasks.push(fetchJson(`${base}/releases?per_page=${GITHUB_MAX_RELEASES}`, fetchImpl).then((value) => ["releases", value]));
  }

  const resolved = await Promise.all(tasks);
  const sections = [
    "Public GitHub API data fetched for this request only:",
    `Repository: ${request.owner}/${request.repo}`,
  ];

  for (const [kind, value] of resolved) {
    if (kind === "commits") {
      const lines = summarizeCommits(value);
      sections.push(lines.length ? `Recent commits:\n${lines.join("\n")}` : "Recent commits: none returned.");
    } else if (kind === "issues") {
      const lines = summarizeIssues(value);
      sections.push(lines.length ? `Open issues:\n${lines.join("\n")}` : "Open issues: none returned.");
    } else if (kind === "releases") {
      const lines = summarizeReleases(value);
      sections.push(lines.length ? `Recent releases:\n${lines.join("\n")}` : "Recent releases: none returned.");
    }
  }

  sections.push(`Limits: timeout ${GITHUB_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Commits ${GITHUB_MAX_COMMITS}, issues ${GITHUB_MAX_ISSUES}, releases ${GITHUB_MAX_RELEASES}. Use only this bounded snapshot.`);
  return sections.join("\n\n");
}

If the supplied knowledge says something IS required, it IS required, period. For facts NOT covered by the supplied knowledge, say so instead of guessing.",
  "When useful, direct users to the official source URL included with the relevant knowledge.",
  "Keep the final answer practical and under 3,500 characters.",
].join(" ");

export class GroqApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message,
    {
      status = null,
      retryAfterSeconds = null,
    } = {},
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "GroqApiError";
    this.status = status;
    this.retryAfterSeconds = retryAfterSeconds;
  }
}

export class AiConfigurationError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "AiConfigurationError";
  }
}

function retryAfterSeconds(response) {
  const seconds = Number.parseFloat(
    response?.headers?.get?.("retry-after") ?? "",
  );

  return Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds > 0
    ? Math.ceil(seconds)
    : null;
}

function boundedConversationMessages(messages) {
  if (!Array.isArray(messages)) return [];

  const clean = messages
    .filter(
      (message) =>
        message
        && (
          message.role === "user"
          || message.role === "assistant"
        )
        && typeof message.content === "string"
        && message.content.trim(),
    )
    .slice(-10)
    .map((message) => ({
      role: message.role,
      content: message.content.trim().slice(0, 1_500),
    }));

  if (clean[0]?.role === "assistant") {
    clean.shift();
  }

  return clean;
}

function normalizeProvider(provider) {
  return String(provider ?? "groq").trim().toLowerCase();
}

function normalizedAllowedModels(allowedModels) {
  const models = Array.isArray(allowedModels) && allowedModels.length > 0
    ? allowedModels
    : DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_FREE_MODELS;
  return new Set(
    models
      .map((value) => String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())
      .filter(Boolean),
  );
}

function userMessageContent(question, imageUrls = []) {
  const cleanQuestion = String(question ?? "").trim();
  const cleanImages = (Array.isArray(imageUrls) ? imageUrls : [])
    .map((value) => String(value ?? "").trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (cleanImages.length === 0) {
    return cleanQuestion;
  }

  return [
    {
      type: "text",
      text: cleanQuestion,
    },
    ...cleanImages.map((url) => ({
      type: "image_url",
      image_url: { url },
    })),
  ];
}

export async function askGroq(
  question,
  {
    provider = "groq",
    apiKey,
    pollinationsApiKey = null,
    model = "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
    allowedModels = DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_FREE_MODELS,
    modelProfile = "chat",
    imageUrls = [],
    requesterContext =
      "The requester's LC status is unknown. Do not assume member access.",
    requesterIdentity = "",
    knowledgeQuestion = question,
    routingContext = "",
    agentPlanContext = "",
    discussionContext = "",
    conversationMessages = [],
    playerProfileContext = "",
    matchedMemberContext = "",
    communityKnowledgeContext = "",
    continuityContext = "",
    preferenceContext = "",
    liveGameStatusContext = "",
    liveLegendModStatusContext = "",
    weatherContext = "",
    downdetectorContext = "",
    boredContext = "",
    wikipediaContext = "",
    wikidataContext = "",
    crossrefContext = "",
    openAlexContext = "",
    openLibraryContext = "",
    githubContext = "",
    webSearchContext = "",
    webpageContext = "",
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  },
) {
  const selectedProvider = normalizeProvider(provider);
  const effectiveApiKey = selectedProvider === "pollinations"
    ? (pollinationsApiKey || null)
    : (apiKey || null);

  if (selectedProvider === "groq" && !effectiveApiKey) {
    throw new GroqApiError("Groq is not configured");
  }

  if (selectedProvider === "pollinations" && !effectiveApiKey) {
    throw new AiConfigurationError("Pollinations is not configured");
  }

  if (selectedProvider !== "groq" && selectedProvider !== "pollinations") {
    throw new AiConfigurationError(`Unsupported AI provider: ${provider}`);
  }

  if (selectedProvider === "pollinations") {
    const safeModel = String(model ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!normalizedAllowedModels(allowedModels).has(safeModel)) {
      throw new AiConfigurationError(
        "That Pollinations model is not in the free-only allowlist.",
      );
    }
  }
  if (selectedProvider === "groq" && Array.isArray(imageUrls) && imageUrls.length > 0) {
    throw new AiConfigurationError(
      "Image questions require the Pollinations backend right now. Set AI_PROVIDER=pollinations to analyze images.",
    );
  }

  const requestUrl = selectedProvider === "pollinations"
    ? (process.env.POLLINATIONS_CHAT_URL || POLLINATIONS_CHAT_URL)
    : GROQ_CHAT_URL;
  const headers = {
    accept: "application/json",
    "content-type": "application/json",
  };
  if (effectiveApiKey) {
    headers.authorization = `Bearer ${effectiveApiKey}`;
  }
  const requestBody = {
    model,
    messages: [
      {
        role: "system",
        content: [
          SYSTEM_PROMPT,
          `Requester context: ${requesterContext}`,
          routingContext
            ? `Routing context:\n${routingContext}`
            : null,
          agentPlanContext
            ? `${agentPlanContext}`
            : null,
          requesterIdentity
            ? `Requester identity:\n${requesterIdentity}`
            : null,
          knowledgeForQuestion(knowledgeQuestion),
          weatherContext
            ? `${weatherContext}`
            : null,
          downdetectorContext
            ? `${downdetectorContext}`
            : null,
          boredContext
            ? `${boredContext}`
            : null,
          liveGameStatusContext
            ? `Live server data fetched locally for this request:\n${liveGameStatusContext}`
            : null,
          liveLegendModStatusContext
            ? `Legend Mod player data fetched live from the Snez websocket feed for this request:\n${liveLegendModStatusContext}`
            : null,
          wikipediaContext
            ? `Wikipedia data fetched for this request:\n${wikipediaContext}`
            : null,
          wikidataContext
            ? `Wikidata data fetched for this request:\n${wikidataContext}`
            : null,
          crossrefContext
            ? `Crossref data fetched for this request:\n${crossrefContext}`
            : null,
          openAlexContext
            ? `OpenAlex data fetched for this request:\n${openAlexContext}`
            : null,
          openLibraryContext
            ? `Open Library data fetched for this request:\n${openLibraryContext}`
            : null,
          githubContext
            ? `Public GitHub API data fetched for this request:\n${githubContext}`
            : null,
          webSearchContext
            ? `Public web search results fetched for this request:\n${webSearchContext}`
            : null,
          webpageContext
            ? `Public webpage content fetched for this request:\n${webpageContext}`
            : null,
          discussionContext
            ? `Untrusted recent excerpts from approved public rooms:\n${discussionContext}`
            : null,
          continuityContext
            ? `Recent requester thread summary:\n${continuityContext}`
            : null,
          preferenceContext
            ? `Light preference signals inferred from recent requester chat:\n${preferenceContext}`
            : null,
          playerProfileContext
            ? `Voluntary player card for this same requester:\n${playerProfileContext}`
            : null,
          matchedMemberContext
            ? `Known member identity context relevant to the question:\n${matchedMemberContext}`
            : null,
          communityKnowledgeContext
            ? `Community knowledge (facts taught by members):\n${communityKnowledgeContext}`
            : null,
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join("\n\n"),
      },
      ...boundedConversationMessages(
        conversationMessages,
      ),
      {
        role: "user",
        content: userMessageContent(question, imageUrls),
      },
    ],
  };
  if (selectedProvider === "pollinations") {
    requestBody.max_tokens = 400;
    if (modelProfile === "reasoning") {
      requestBody.reasoning_effort = "high";
    } else if (modelProfile === "code" || modelProfile === "vision") {
      requestBody.reasoning_effort = "medium";
    } else {
      requestBody.reasoning_effort = "low";
    }
  } else {
    requestBody.max_completion_tokens = 400;
    requestBody.reasoning_effort = modelProfile === "reasoning"
      ? "medium"
      : "low";
  }

  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(requestUrl, {
      method: "POST",
      headers,
      body: JSON.stringify(requestBody),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(12_000),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new GroqApiError(
      error.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? `${selectedProvider === "pollinations" ? "Pollinations" : "Groq"} request timed out`
        : `${selectedProvider === "pollinations" ? "Pollinations" : "Groq"} request failed`,
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new GroqApiError(
      `${selectedProvider === "pollinations" ? "Pollinations" : "Groq"} returned HTTP ${response.status}`,
      {
        status: response.status,
        retryAfterSeconds: retryAfterSeconds(response),
      },
    );
  }

  const payload = await response.json();

  const answer =
    payload?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim();

  if (!answer) {
    throw new GroqApiError(
      "Groq returned an empty answer",
      { status: response.status },
    );
  }

  return answer;
}

import { createChannelMessage } from "./discord-api.js";

const ALERT_COLOR = 0xed4245;
const RECOVERY_COLOR = 0x57f287;

function cleanString(value, maxLength = 1_000) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, maxLength);
}

export class HealthAlertManager {
  constructor({
    token,
    channelId = null,
    sendMessage = createChannelMessage,
    logger = console,
  } = {}) {
    this.token = token;
    this.channelId = cleanString(channelId, 64) || null;
    this.sendMessage = sendMessage;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.activeAlerts = new Map();
  }

  configured() {
    return Boolean(this.token && this.channelId);
  }

  activeCount() {
    return this.activeAlerts.size;
  }

  async reportFailure(key, title, description) {
    const normalizedKey = cleanString(key, 120);
    if (!normalizedKey) return false;

    let alert =
      this.activeAlerts.get(normalizedKey);

    if (alert?.notified || alert?.notifying) {
      return false;
    }

    if (!alert) {
      alert = {
        title: cleanString(title, 200),
        description: cleanString(
          description,
          4_000,
        ),
        notified: false,
        notifying: false,
      };

      this.activeAlerts.set(
        normalizedKey,
        alert,
      );
    }

    if (!this.configured()) return false;

    alert.notifying = true;

    try {
      await this.sendMessage(
        this.token,
        this.channelId,
        {
          content: "",
          embeds: [{
            title:
              alert.title
              || "Bot health alert",
            description:
              alert.description
              || "A bot health issue was detected.",
            color: ALERT_COLOR,
          }],
          allowed_mentions: {
            parse: [],
          },
        },
      );

      alert.notified = true;
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn(
        "Health alert post failed",
        error.message,
      );
      return false;
    } finally {
      alert.notifying = false;
    }
  }

  async clearFailure(key, recoveryTitle = "", recoveryDescription = "") {
    const normalizedKey = cleanString(key, 120);
    if (!normalizedKey || !this.activeAlerts.has(normalizedKey)) return false;

    this.activeAlerts.delete(normalizedKey);

    if (!this.configured()) return false;
    if (!recoveryTitle && !recoveryDescription) return true;

    try {
      await this.sendMessage(this.token, this.channelId, {
        content: "",
        embeds: [{
          title: cleanString(recoveryTitle, 200) || "Bot health recovered",
          description: cleanString(recoveryDescription, 4_000) || "A previously failing bot health check recovered.",
          color: RECOVERY_COLOR,
        }],
        allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
      });
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn("Health recovery post failed", error.message);
      return false;
    }
  }
}

import { createServer } from "node:http";

function writeJson(response, statusCode, body) {
  response.writeHead(statusCode, {
    "cache-control": "no-store",
    "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
  });
  response.end(`${JSON.stringify(body)}\n`);
}

export function startHealthServer({ host, port, getStatus }) {
  const server = createServer((request, response) => {
    const isStatusPath = request.method === "GET" && (request.url === "/health" || request.url === "/status");
    if (!isStatusPath) {
      writeJson(response, 404, { error: "not_found" });
      return;
    }

    const status = getStatus();
    writeJson(response, status.ready ? 200 : 503, {
      service: "discord-bot-server",
      state: status.ready ? "ok" : "starting",
      ...status,
    });
  });

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    server.once("error", reject);
    server.listen(port, host, () => {
      server.off("error", reject);
      resolve(server);
    });
  });
}

export function stopHealthServer(server) {
  if (!server?.listening) {
    return Promise.resolve();
  }

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    server.close((error) => (error ? reject(error) : resolve()));
  });
}

  }
}

async function handleInteraction(interaction) {
  if (playerProfiles) {
    try {
      const profileResponse = await handlePlayerProfileInteraction(interaction, playerProfiles);
      if (profileResponse) {
        await respondToInteraction(interaction, profileResponse);
        return;
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Player profile interaction failed", error);
      try {
        await respondToInteraction(interaction, playerProfileError());
      } catch (responseError) {
        console.error("Player profile error response failed", responseError);
      }
      return;
    }
  }

  const isLegendCommand =
    interaction.type === 2
    && interaction.data?.name === "legend";
  const isLegendComponent =
    interaction.type === 3
    && /^(?:legend:refresh(?::details)?|legend:details|legend:overview)$/.test(
      String(interaction.data?.custom_id ?? ""),
    );

  if (isLegendCommand || isLegendComponent) {
    try {
      const response = await buildLegendResponse(interaction, {
        gameStatusUrl: config.gameStatusUrl,
        gameWebsiteUrl: config.gameWebsiteUrl,
        gamePlayingCapacity: config.gamePlayingCapacity,
        gameSpectatorCapacity: config.gameSpectatorCapacity,
        gameBotCount: config.gameBotCount,
        getBotStatus: getStatus,
        liveStatusFailureReporter: healthAlerts,
      });

      await respondToInteraction(interaction, response);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "Legend dashboard interaction failed",
        error,
      );

      try {
        await respondToInteraction(
          interaction,
          ephemeralResponse(
            "The Legend FFA dashboard is temporarily unavailable.",
          ),
        );
      } catch (responseError) {
        console.error(
          "Legend dashboard error response failed",
          responseError,
        );
      }
    }

    return;
  }

  const isAskCommand =
    interaction.type === 2
    && interaction.data?.name === "lc";

  if (!isAskCommand) return;

  try {
    await respondToInteraction(interaction, deferredAskResponse());
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Ask interaction could not be deferred", error);
    return;
  }

  let message;
  try {
    const requesterContext = await requesterRoles.describe(interaction);
    const requesterTier = await requesterRoles.tierForInteraction(interaction);
    const requesterLocation = await requesterLocations.describe(interaction);
    const rawQuestion = optionValue(interaction, "question");
    if (isRestartRequest(rawQuestion)) {
      if (isAllowedTier(requesterTier)) {
        const username = interaction.member?.user?.username ?? interaction.member?.user?.global_name ?? "unknown";
        const result = await restartExpandingLand(username);
        message = { content: "", embeds: [{ description: result, color: 0xf55036 }], allowed_mentions: { parse: [] } };
      } else {
        message = { content: "", embeds: [{ description: "\ud83d\udd12 Only LC candidates and members can restart the server.", color: 0xed4245 }], allowed_mentions: { parse: [] } };
      }
    } else {
      message = await buildAskMessage(interaction, {
        aiProvider: config.aiProvider,
        apiKey: config.aiApiKey,
        groqApiKey: config.groqApiKey,
        pollinationsApiKey: config.pollinationsApiKey,
        recentImageMemory,
        model: config.aiModel,
        aiModelRoutingEnabled: config.aiModelRoutingEnabled,
        pollinationsAllowedModels: config.pollinationsAllowedModels,
        pollinationsRouteModels: config.pollinationsRouteModels,
        requesterContext,
        requesterIdentity: requesterIdentity(interaction, requesterLocation),
        discussionMemory: publicDiscussions,
        userQuestionMemory: userQuestions,
        playerProfiles,
        communityKnowledge,
        limiter: askLimiter,
        gameStatusUrl: config.gameStatusUrl,
        gamePlayingCapacity: config.gamePlayingCapacity,
        gameSpectatorCapacity: config.gameSpectatorCapacity,
        gameBotCount: config.gameBotCount,
        downdetectorApiToken: config.downdetectorApiToken,
        downdetectorClientId: config.downdetectorClientId,
        downdetectorClientSecret: config.downdetectorClientSecret,
        downdetectorDefaultCountry: config.downdetectorDefaultCountry,
        channelName: requesterLocation.channelName,
        liveStatusFailureReporter: healthAlerts,
        legendModStatusFailureReporter: healthAlerts,
        deltaChatWatcher,
        allowedDomains: config.webAllowedDomains,
      });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Groq ask request failed", error);
    message = buildAskErrorMessage(error);
  }

  try {
    await editOriginalInteractionResponse(interaction, message);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Ask interaction response failed", error);
  }
}

async function shutdown(signal, exitCode = 0) {
  if (shuttingDown) return;
  shuttingDown = true;

  console.log(`Received ${signal}; stopping Discord bot`);
  gateway.stop();
  await publicDiscussions?.stop();
  await userQuestions?.stop();
  await playerProfiles?.stop();
  await communityKnowledge?.stop();
  await auditLog?.stop();
  await deltaChatWatcher?.stop("service shutdown", { notify: false });
  await stopHealthServer(healthServer);
  process.exit(exitCode);
}

gateway.on("ready", (user) => {
  console.log(`Discord bot connected as ${user.username}`);
});

gateway.on("resumed", () => {
  console.log("Discord Gateway session resumed");
});

gateway.on("interaction", (interaction) => {
  void handleInteraction(interaction);
});

gateway.on("messageCreate", (message) => {
  publicDiscussions?.handleCreate(message);
  jsonMessages.handle(message).then((handled) => {
    if (!handled) {
      chatActions?.handle(message).then((actionHandled) => {
        if (!actionHandled) {
          profileInviter?.consider(message).catch((error) => {
            console.error("Player profile invitation failed", error);
          });
          autoAnswer?.handle(message).catch((error) => {
            console.error("Auto-answer failed", error);
          });
        }
      }).catch((error) => {
        console.error("Chat action handling failed", error);
      });
    }
  }).catch((error) => {
    console.error("JSON message handling failed", error);
  });
});

gateway.on("messageUpdate", (message) => {
  publicDiscussions?.handleUpdate(message);
});

gateway.on("messageDelete", (message) => {
  publicDiscussions?.handleDelete(message);
});

gateway.on("memberJoin", (member) => {
  const username = member.user?.username ?? member.user?.global_name ?? "Someone";
  console.log(`Member joined: ${username} (ID: ${member.user?.id ?? "unknown"})`);
  playerProfiles?.observeJoin(member).catch((error) => {
    console.error("Member join observation failed", error);
  });
  const welcomeChannelId = resolveWelcomeChannelId(config, autoAnswer);
  if (!welcomeChannelId) return;
  sendWelcomeMessage({
    token: config.token,
    channelId: welcomeChannelId,
    member,
    config,
  }).then((sent) => auditLog.record({
    type: "welcome_join",
    actorId: "system",
    actorName: "member_join",
    sourceChannelId: null,
    targetChannelId: welcomeChannelId,
    messageId: sent?.id ?? null,
    targetUserId: member.user?.id ?? null,
  })).catch((error) => {
    console.error("Member welcome message failed", error);
  });
});

gateway.on("fatal", (error) => {
  console.error("Discord Gateway connection cannot recover", error);
  void shutdown("fatal Gateway error", 1);
});

for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGTERM"]) {
  process.once(signal, () => {
    shutdown(signal).catch((error) => {
      console.error("Graceful shutdown failed", error);
      process.exit(1);
    });
  });
}

async function main() {
  healthServer = await startHealthServer({
    host: config.healthHost,
    port: config.healthPort,
    getStatus: getFullStatus,
  });
  console.log(`Health endpoint listening on http://${config.healthHost}:${config.healthPort}/health`);

  await publicDiscussions?.start();
  await userQuestions?.start();
  await playerProfiles?.start();
  await communityKnowledge?.start();
  await auditLog?.start();
  await autoAnswer?.resolveChannel();
  console.log(`Bot commit ${commitSha}`);
  console.log(`Bot features ${JSON.stringify(featureStatus())}`);

  try {
    await gateway.start();
  } catch (error) {
    await stopHealthServer(healthServer);
    throw error;
  }
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error("Discord bot failed to start", error);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});

import { createChannelMessage } from "./discord-api.js";

const TITLE_LIMIT = 256;
const DESCRIPTION_LIMIT = 4096;
const FOOTER_TEXT_LIMIT = 2048;
const URL_LIMIT = 2_000;
const FIELD_NAME_LIMIT = 256;
const FIELD_VALUE_LIMIT = 1024;
const MAX_FIELDS = 25;
const MAX_MESSAGES = 10;
const DEFAULT_COLOR = 0xf55036;

function cleanString(value, maxLength) {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return "";
  return value.trim().slice(0, maxLength);
}

function parseColor(value) {
  if (Number.isInteger(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 0xffffff) return value;
  if (typeof value !== "string") return null;

  const normalized = value.trim().replace(/^#/, "").replace(/^0x/i, "");
  if (!/^[a-f0-9]{6}$/i.test(normalized)) return null;
  return Number.parseInt(normalized, 16);
}

function cleanUrl(value) {
  return cleanString(value, URL_LIMIT);
}

function parseJsonContent(content) {
  const trimmed = String(content ?? "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) return { matches: false, payload: null, error: null };

  const fencedMatch = trimmed.match(/^```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```$/i);
  const candidate = fencedMatch ? fencedMatch[1].trim() : trimmed;
  const looksLikeJson = candidate.startsWith("{") || candidate.startsWith("[");
  if (!looksLikeJson) {
    return { matches: false, payload: null, error: null };
  }

  try {
    return {
      matches: true,
      payload: JSON.parse(candidate),
      error: null,
    };
  } catch {
    return {
      matches: true,
      payload: null,
      error: "Invalid JSON. Use embed fields such as `title`, `message`, `fields`, `image`, `thumbnail`, `footer`, `url`, and optional `buttonLabel` + `buttonUrl`.",
    };
  }
}

function normalizeEntries(payload) {
  if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload;
  if (payload && typeof payload === "object" && Array.isArray(payload.messages)) {
    return payload.messages;
  }
  return [payload];
}

function buildComponents(entry) {
  const label = cleanString(entry.buttonLabel ?? entry.button_label ?? "", 80);
  const url = cleanUrl(entry.buttonUrl ?? entry.button_url ?? "");
  if (!label || !url) return [];

  return [
    {
      type: 1,
      components: [
        {
          type: 2,
          style: 5,
          label,
          url,
        },
      ],
    },
  ];
}

function buildThumbnail(value) {
  const url = cleanUrl(
    typeof value === "string"
      ? value
      : value?.url ?? value?.imageUrl ?? value?.image_url ?? "",
  );
  return url ? { url } : undefined;
}

function buildFooter(value) {
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const text = cleanString(value, FOOTER_TEXT_LIMIT);
    return text ? { text } : undefined;
  }
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return undefined;

  const text = cleanString(value.text ?? value.label ?? "", FOOTER_TEXT_LIMIT);
  const iconUrl = cleanUrl(value.iconUrl ?? value.icon_url ?? "");
  if (!text) return undefined;

  return {
    text,
    icon_url: iconUrl || undefined,
  };
}

function normalizeFieldEntries(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return [];
  return Object.entries(value).map(([name, entry]) => (
    entry && typeof entry === "object" && !Array.isArray(entry)
      ? { name, ...entry }
      : { name, value: entry }
  ));
}

function buildFields(value) {
  return normalizeFieldEntries(value)
    .slice(0, MAX_FIELDS)
    .map((entry) => {
      const name = cleanString(entry?.name ?? entry?.label ?? "", FIELD_NAME_LIMIT);
      const rawValue = entry?.value ?? entry?.message ?? entry?.description ?? "";
      const fieldValue = cleanString(String(rawValue), FIELD_VALUE_LIMIT);
      if (!name || !fieldValue) return null;
      return {
        name,
        value: fieldValue,
        inline: Boolean(entry?.inline),
      };
    })
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function buildPostBody(entry) {
  if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object" || Array.isArray(entry)) return null;

  const title = cleanString(entry.title, TITLE_LIMIT);
  const description = cleanString(
    entry.message ?? entry.description ?? entry.text ?? "",
    DESCRIPTION_LIMIT,
  );
  const embedUrl = cleanUrl(entry.url);
  const imageUrl = cleanUrl(entry.image ?? entry.imageUrl ?? entry.image_url ?? "");
  const thumbnail = buildThumbnail(entry.thumbnail ?? entry.thumbnailUrl ?? entry.thumbnail_url);
  const footer = buildFooter(entry.footer);
  const fields = buildFields(entry.fields);
  const color = parseColor(entry.color);
  const components = buildComponents(entry);
  const hasEmbedContent = Boolean(
    title
      || description
      || embedUrl
      || imageUrl
      || thumbnail
      || footer
      || fields.length > 0,
  );

  if (!hasEmbedContent && components.length === 0) return null;

  return {
    content: "",
    embeds: hasEmbedContent
      ? [{
          title: title || undefined,
          description: description || undefined,
          url: embedUrl || undefined,
          color: color ?? DEFAULT_COLOR,
          image: imageUrl ? { url: imageUrl } : undefined,
          thumbnail,
          footer,
          fields: fields.length > 0 ? fields : undefined,
        }]
      : [],
    components,
    allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
  };
}

function normalizeRoleIds(message) {
  return new Set(Array.isArray(message.member?.roles) ? message.member.roles : []);
}

export function parseJsonMessage(content) {
  const parsed = parseJsonContent(content);
  if (!parsed.matches || parsed.error) return parsed;

  const posts = normalizeEntries(parsed.payload)
    .slice(0, MAX_MESSAGES)
    .map(buildPostBody)
    .filter(Boolean);

  if (posts.length === 0) {
    return {
      matches: true,
      payload: null,
      error: "JSON matched, but no valid embed or button fields were found.",
    };
  }

  return {
    matches: true,
    payload: posts,
    error: null,
  };
}

export function prefixedJsonContent(content, prefix = "!json") {
  const trimmed = String(content ?? "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;

  const normalizedPrefix = prefix.trim();
  if (!normalizedPrefix) return null;
  if (!trimmed.toLowerCase().startsWith(normalizedPrefix.toLowerCase())) return null;

  const remainder = trimmed.slice(normalizedPrefix.length).trim();
  return remainder || "";
}

export function buildPreviewInteractionResponse(posts, note) {
  return {
    type: 4,
    data: {
      content: note,
      embeds: posts.flatMap((post) => post.embeds ?? []),
      components: posts.length === 1 ? posts[0].components ?? [] : [],
      flags: 64,
      allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
    },
  };
}

export class JsonMessageHandler {
  constructor({
    token,
    prefix = "!json",
    allowedChannelIds = [],
    allowedRoleIds = [],
    targetChannelIds = [],
    authorizeMessage = null,
    sendMessage = createChannelMessage,
    auditLog = null,
    logger = console,
  }) {
    this.token = token;
    this.prefix = prefix;
    this.allowedChannelIds = new Set(allowedChannelIds);
    this.allowedRoleIds = new Set(allowedRoleIds);
    this.targetChannelIds = new Set(targetChannelIds);
    this.authorizeMessage = authorizeMessage;
    this.sendMessage = sendMessage;
    this.auditLog = auditLog;
    this.logger = logger;
  }

  eligible(message) {
    return !message.author?.bot
      && !message.webhook_id
      && (message.type === undefined || message.type === 0)
      && typeof message.content === "string"
      && message.content.trim().length > 0;
  }

  isAllowed(message) {
    const channelAllowed = this.allowedChannelIds.size === 0 || this.allowedChannelIds.has(message.channel_id);
    const roleAllowed = this.allowedRoleIds.size === 0
      || [...normalizeRoleIds(message)].some((roleId) => this.allowedRoleIds.has(roleId));
    return channelAllowed && roleAllowed;
  }

  resolveTargetChannelId(requestedChannelId = null, fallbackChannelId = null) {
    const requested = String(requestedChannelId ?? "").trim();
    if (requested) return requested;

    const configuredTarget = this.targetChannelIds.values().next().value;
    const fallback = String(fallbackChannelId ?? "").trim();
    return configuredTarget ?? (fallback || null);
  }

  isAllowedTarget(channelId) {
    return Boolean(channelId) && (
      this.targetChannelIds.size === 0 || this.targetChannelIds.has(channelId)
    );
  }

  async postBodies(channelId, posts, auditEntry = null, replyToMessageId = null) {
    for (const [index, post] of posts.entries()) {
      const response = await this.sendMessage(this.token, channelId, {
        ...post,
        message_reference: index === 0 && replyToMessageId ? { message_id: replyToMessageId } : undefined,
        allowed_mentions: {
          parse: [],
          replied_user: false,
        },
      });

      if (auditEntry) {
        await this.auditLog?.record({
          ...auditEntry,
          targetChannelId: channelId,
          messageId: response?.id ?? null,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  async handle(message) {
    if (!this.eligible(message)) return false;

    const content = prefixedJsonContent(message.content, this.prefix);
    if (content === null) return false;

    if (this.authorizeMessage && !await this.authorizeMessage(message)) {
      await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
        content: "Only LC staff can use JSON announcements from chat.",
        message_reference: { message_id: message.id },
        allowed_mentions: {
          parse: [],
          replied_user: false,
        },
      });
      return true;
    }

    if (!this.isAllowed(message)) {
      await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
        content: "You are not allowed to use JSON announcements here.",
        message_reference: { message_id: message.id },
        allowed_mentions: {
          parse: [],
          replied_user: false,
        },
      });
      return true;
    }

    const targetChannelId = this.resolveTargetChannelId(null, message.channel_id);
    if (!this.isAllowedTarget(targetChannelId)) {
      await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
        content: "No valid announcement channel is configured for JSON posts.",
        message_reference: { message_id: message.id },
        allowed_mentions: {
          parse: [],
          replied_user: false,
        },
      });
      return true;
    }

    const parsed = parseJsonMessage(content);
    if (!parsed.matches || parsed.error) {
      await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
        content: parsed.error ?? "JSON announcements must start with a JSON object or array after the prefix.",
        message_reference: { message_id: message.id },
        allowed_mentions: {
          parse: [],
          replied_user: false,
        },
      });
      return true;
    }

    await this.postBodies(targetChannelId, parsed.payload, {
      type: "json_message",
      actorId: message.author?.id ?? null,
      actorName: message.author?.username ?? null,
      sourceChannelId: message.channel_id,
    }, targetChannelId === message.channel_id ? message.id : null);

    if (targetChannelId !== message.channel_id) {
      await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, {
        content: `Posted ${parsed.payload.length} announcement message(s) to <#${targetChannelId}>.`,
        message_reference: { message_id: message.id },
        allowed_mentions: {
          parse: [],
          replied_user: false,
        },
      });
    }

    this.logger.log(
      `Rendered ${parsed.payload.length} JSON message embed(s) from ${message.channel_id} to ${targetChannelId}`,
    );
    return true;
  }
}

const DEFAULT_TOPIC_IDS = new Set(["clan-overview", "mod-overview"]);

function normalizedText(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .toLowerCase();
}

function scoreTopicWeighted(topic, text, words) {
  let score = 0;

  if (topic.requiredKeywords && topic.requiredKeywords.length > 0) {
    const hasRequired = topic.requiredKeywords.some((kw) => text.includes(kw));
    if (!hasRequired) return 0;
    score += 12;
  }

  const exclusions = topic.excludedKeywords || topic.exclusions;
  if (exclusions && exclusions.length > 0) {
    const hasExclusion = exclusions.some((ex) => text.includes(ex));
    if (hasExclusion) return 0;
  }

  if (topic.entities && topic.entities.length > 0) {
    if (topic.entities.some((ent) => text.includes(ent))) score += 6;
  }

  if (topic.intents && topic.intents.length > 0) {
    if (topic.intents.some((intent) => text.includes(intent))) score += 5;
  }

  const priorityBoost = Number.isFinite(topic.priority) ? topic.priority : 0;
  score += priorityBoost;

  if (Array.isArray(topic.keywords)) {
    for (const keyword of topic.keywords) {
      const kwLower = keyword.toLowerCase();
      if (kwLower.includes(" ") || kwLower.includes(".")) {
        if (text.includes(kwLower)) score += 8;
      } else if (words.has(kwLower)) {
        score += 4;
      }
    }
  }

  return score;
}

export function selectLegendKnowledge(question, { maxTopics = 3, hasLiveContext = true } = {}) {
  const text = normalizedText(question);
  const words = new Set(text.match(/[a-z0-9]+/g) ?? []);
  const scores = new Map();

  const ranked = TOPICS.map((topic, index) => {
    const score = scoreTopicWeighted(topic, text, words);
    scores.set(topic.id, score);
    return { topic, index, score };
  })
    .filter(({ score }) => score > 0)
    .sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score || left.index - right.index)
    .slice(0, maxTopics)
    .map(({ topic }) => topic);

  const selected = ranked.length > 0
    ? ranked
    : TOPICS.filter(({ id }) => DEFAULT_TOPIC_IDS.has(id));

  let liveNote = "";
  const needsLive = selected.some((t) => t.freshness === "live_required");
  if (needsLive && !hasLiveContext) {
    liveNote = "\n\n[Note: Live status context was required for this query but was not supplied. Do not fabricate live statistics.]";
  }

  const selectedTopicIds = selected.map((t) => t.id);
  const context = [
    CORE_KNOWLEDGE,
    ...selected.map(({ id, content }) => `[${id}] ${content}`),
  ].join("\n\n") + liveNote;

  return {
    context,
    selectedTopicIds,
    scores,
    truncated: false,
  };
}

export function knowledgeForQuestion(question, options = {}) {
  return selectLegendKnowledge(question, options).context;
}

export const DEFAULT_LEGEND_MOD_STATUS_URL = "wss://agar.snez.org:63051/?client=istoselida";

const STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS = 4_000;
const MAX_VISIBLE_NAMES = 80;
const MAX_SERVER_LINES = 10;
const MAX_PLAYER_DETAILS = 12;

function normalizedText(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9.?]+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

function cleanString(value, maxLength = 120) {
  const cleaned = String(value ?? "").replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, " ").trim();
  return cleaned ? cleaned.slice(0, maxLength) : "";
}

function unique(values) {
  return [...new Set(values.filter(Boolean))];
}

function parseServer(server) {
  const raw = cleanString(server, 200);
  if (!raw) {
    return {
      raw: "unknown",
      key: "unknown",
      region: "unknown",
      mode: "unknown",
    };
  }

  const [base] = raw.split("&?");
  const regionMatch = raw.match(/(?:^|[?&])\??r=([^&]+)/i);
  const modeMatch = raw.match(/(?:^|[?&])\??m=([^&]+)/i);

  return {
    raw,
    key: base || raw,
    region: cleanString(regionMatch?.[1] ?? "unknown", 40),
    mode: cleanString(modeMatch?.[1] ?? "unknown", 40),
  };
}

function normalizePlayer(entry) {
  if (!entry || typeof entry !== "object" || Array.isArray(entry)) return null;

  const nickname = cleanString(entry.nickname, 40);
  const tag = cleanString(entry.tag, 24);
  const server = parseServer(entry.server);
  const country = cleanString(entry.extra?.ip_info?.country, 8).toUpperCase() || "unknown";

  if (!nickname && server.key === "unknown") return null;

  return {
    nickname: nickname || "unknown",
    tag: tag || "",
    hideCountry: Boolean(entry.hidecountry),
    country,
    server,
  };
}

function integer(value) {
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? Math.trunc(parsed).toLocaleString("en-US") : "unknown";
}

function wantsLegendModFeed(question) {
  const text = normalizedText(question);
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const wordSet = new Set(words);

  const mentionsLegendMod = text.includes("legend mod")
    || text.includes("legendmod")
    || text.includes("legend express")
    || text.includes("lmexpress")
    || text.includes("lm express")
    || text.includes("snez");

  const mentionsLmShorthand = /\blm\b/.test(text)
    && (wordSet.has("player")
      || wordSet.has("players")
      || wordSet.has("online")
      || wordSet.has("names")
      || wordSet.has("name"));

  if (!mentionsLegendMod && !mentionsLmShorthand) return false;

  const asksQuantity = /\bhow (many|much)\b/.test(text)
    || wordSet.has("count")
    || wordSet.has("population");
  const asksCurrentState = wordSet.has("now")
    || wordSet.has("current")
    || wordSet.has("currently")
    || wordSet.has("online")
    || wordSet.has("offline")
    || wordSet.has("status");
  const asksWho = wordSet.has("who");
  const asksFeedTarget = wordSet.has("player")
    || wordSet.has("players")
    || wordSet.has("play")
    || wordSet.has("playing")
    || wordSet.has("name")
    || wordSet.has("names")
    || wordSet.has("server")
    || wordSet.has("servers");
  const asksSnapshotDirectly = wordSet.has("show")
    || wordSet.has("list")
    || wordSet.has("which")
    || /\ball info\b/.test(text)
    || /\bgeneral info\b/.test(text);

  if (asksWho && asksCurrentState) return true;

  return asksFeedTarget && (
    asksQuantity
    || asksCurrentState
    || asksSnapshotDirectly
  );
}

function summarizeServers(players) {
  const counts = new Map();

  for (const player of players) {
    const key = `${player.server.key}|${player.server.region}|${player.server.mode}`;
    const current = counts.get(key) ?? {
      server: player.server.key,
      region: player.server.region,
      mode: player.server.mode,
      count: 0,
    };
    current.count += 1;
    counts.set(key, current);
  }

  return [...counts.values()]
    .sort((left, right) => right.count - left.count || left.server.localeCompare(right.server))
    .slice(0, MAX_SERVER_LINES);
}

function playerDetailLines(players) {
  return players
    .slice(0, MAX_PLAYER_DETAILS)
    .map((player) => {
      const fields = [
        `Nick: ${player.nickname}`,
        player.tag ? `Tag: ${player.tag}` : null,
        `Server: ${player.server.key}`,
        `Region: ${player.server.region}`,
        `Mode: ${player.server.mode}`,
        player.hideCountry ? "Country: hidden" : `Country: ${player.country}`,
      ].filter(Boolean);
      return `- ${fields.join(" | ")}`;
    });
}

export function needsLegendModPlayerStatus(question) {
  return wantsLegendModFeed(question);
}

export async function fetchLegendModPlayerSnapshot(
  statusUrl = DEFAULT_LEGEND_MOD_STATUS_URL,
  {
    webSocketCtor = WebSocket,
    timeoutMs = STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS,
  } = {},
) {
  if (!statusUrl) throw new Error("Legend Mod status URL is required");

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let settled = false;
    let socket;

    const finish = (callback, value) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      try {
        socket?.close();
      } catch {
        // no-op
      }
      callback(value);
    };

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      finish(reject, new Error("Legend Mod status request timed out"));
    }, timeoutMs);

    try {
      socket = new webSocketCtor(statusUrl);
    } catch (error) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(error);
      return;
    }

    socket.onerror = () => {
      finish(reject, new Error("Legend Mod status websocket failed"));
    };

    socket.onclose = (event) => {
      if (!settled) {
        finish(reject, new Error(`Legend Mod status websocket closed (${event?.code ?? "unknown"})`));
      }
    };

    socket.onmessage = (event) => {
      try {
        const payload = JSON.parse(String(event.data ?? ""));
        if (payload?.type !== "players_list") return;

        const rawPlayers = JSON.parse(String(payload.data ?? "[]"));
        if (!Array.isArray(rawPlayers)) {
          throw new Error("Legend Mod players_list payload was not an array");
        }

        const players = rawPlayers.map(normalizePlayer).filter(Boolean);
        finish(resolve, {
          players,
          totalPlayers: players.length,
          distinctNames: unique(players.map((player) => player.nickname)).length,
          distinctServers: unique(players.map((player) => player.server.key)).length,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        finish(reject, error);
      }
    };
  });
}

export function formatLegendModPlayerStatusContext(snapshot) {
  const players = Array.isArray(snapshot?.players) ? snapshot.players : [];
  const totalPlayers = Number.isFinite(snapshot?.totalPlayers) ? snapshot.totalPlayers : players.length;
  const distinctNames = Number.isFinite(snapshot?.distinctNames)
    ? snapshot.distinctNames
    : unique(players.map((player) => player.nickname)).length;
  const distinctServers = Number.isFinite(snapshot?.distinctServers)
    ? snapshot.distinctServers
    : unique(players.map((player) => player.server.key)).length;

  if (totalPlayers === 0) {
    return [
      "Current Legend Mod snapshot from the Snez websocket feed (authoritative for this request only):",
      "Tracked Legend Mod players online: 0",
      "No player names or server details were visible in this snapshot.",
      "Limits: this feed represents players visible through the Snez Legend Mod network, not every Agar.io player worldwide.",
    ].join("\n");
  }

  const visibleNames = unique(players.map((player) => player.nickname)).slice(0, MAX_VISIBLE_NAMES);
  const serverLines = summarizeServers(players).map((server) => (
    `- ${server.server} | Region: ${server.region} | Mode: ${server.mode} | Players: ${integer(server.count)}`
  ));

  return [
    "Current Legend Mod snapshot from the Snez websocket feed (authoritative for this request only):",
    `Tracked Legend Mod players online: ${integer(totalPlayers)} (use this for questions about how many Legend Mod players are online right now)`,
    `Distinct visible nicknames: ${integer(distinctNames)}`,
    `Distinct servers: ${integer(distinctServers)}`,
    `Visible player names (${integer(visibleNames.length)} shown): ${visibleNames.join(", ")}`,
    "Top visible servers:",
    ...serverLines,
    "Sample player records:",
    ...playerDetailLines(players),
    "Limits: this feed represents players visible through the Snez Legend Mod network, not every Agar.io player worldwide. Nicknames and tags are user-controlled, countries may be hidden or unavailable, and omitted names must not be invented.",
  ].join("\n");
}

export async function liveLegendModStatusContextForQuestion(
  question,
  {
    statusUrl = DEFAULT_LEGEND_MOD_STATUS_URL,
    webSocketCtor = WebSocket,
    onStatusSuccess = null,
    onStatusFailure = null,
  } = {},
) {
  if (!statusUrl || !needsLegendModPlayerStatus(question)) return "";

  try {
    const snapshot = await fetchLegendModPlayerSnapshot(statusUrl, { webSocketCtor });
    await onStatusSuccess?.(snapshot);
    return formatLegendModPlayerStatusContext(snapshot);
  } catch (error) {
    await onStatusFailure?.(error);
    return "Current Legend Mod player data could not be read from the Snez websocket feed. Say that live Legend Mod player data is temporarily unavailable; do not estimate names or counts.";
  }
}

import { createChannelMessage } from "./discord-api.js";

export function resolveWelcomeChannelId(config, autoAnswer) {
  return config.welcomeChannelId ?? autoAnswer?.channelId ?? config.autoAnswerChannelId ?? null;
}

export function buildWelcomeMessage(member, config = {}) {
  const userId = member.user?.id;
  if (!userId) return null;

  const introName = config.welcomeIntroChannelName ?? "introduce-yourself";
  const helpName = config.welcomeHelpChannelName ?? "lobby";

  return {
    content: `Welcome <@${userId}> to the server. Use /lc for questions, introduce yourself in #${introName}, and ask for help in #${helpName}.`,
    allowed_mentions: {
      parse: [],
      users: [userId],
    },
  };
}

export async function sendWelcomeMessage({
  token,
  channelId,
  member,
  config,
  sendMessage = createChannelMessage,
}) {
  if (!channelId) return false;

  const message = buildWelcomeMessage(member, config);
  if (!message) return false;

  return sendMessage(token, channelId, message);
}

export const OPEN_LIBRARY_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 6_000;
export const OPEN_LIBRARY_MAX_RESULTS = 3;
const OPEN_LIBRARY_SEARCH_API = "https://openlibrary.org/search.json";
const OPEN_LIBRARY_USER_AGENT = "discord-bot-server/1.0 (+https://github.com/kyriakidisdimitrios/discord-bot-server)";
const ISBN_PATTERN = /\b(?:97[89][-\s]?)?\d(?:[-\s]?\d){8,16}\b/;

export class OpenLibraryContextError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "OpenLibraryContextError";
  }
}

function cleanText(value, maxLength = 280) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
}

function normalizeQuery(value) {
  return cleanText(value, 220);
}

function normalizeIsbn(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/[-\s]/g, "");
}

function stripExplicitOpenLibraryPrompt(text) {
  let query = String(text ?? "").trim();

  const patterns = [
    /^(?:please\s+)?search\s+open\s+library\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?look\s+up\s+(?:on\s+)?open\s+library\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?check\s+open\s+library\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+|on\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?what\s+does\s+open\s+library\s+say\s+about\s+/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?open\s+library\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?find\s+(?:this\s+)?isbn\s+(?:on\s+open\s+library\s+)?/i,
  ];

  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    query = query.replace(pattern, "");
  }

  query = query
    .replace(/\bon\s+open\s+library\b/gi, "")
    .replace(/[?]+$/g, "")
    .trim();

  return normalizeQuery(query);
}

export function extractOpenLibraryRequest(question) {
  const text = cleanText(question, 500);
  if (!text) return null;

  const hasOpenLibrary = /\bopen\s+library\b/i.test(text);
  const hasIsbn = ISBN_PATTERN.test(text);
  const hasLookupVerb = /\b(?:search|look\s+up|lookup|check|find|show|what\s+does)\b/i.test(text);
  if (!hasOpenLibrary && !(hasIsbn && hasLookupVerb)) return null;

  const query = stripExplicitOpenLibraryPrompt(text);
  if (!query) return null;

  const isbnMatch = query.match(ISBN_PATTERN);
  return {
    query,
    isbn: isbnMatch ? normalizeIsbn(isbnMatch[0]) : "",
  };
}

async function fetchJson(url, fetchImpl) {
  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(url, {
      headers: {
        accept: "application/json",
        "user-agent": OPEN_LIBRARY_USER_AGENT,
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(OPEN_LIBRARY_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new OpenLibraryContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "The Open Library lookup timed out."
        : "The Open Library lookup could not be completed right now.",
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new OpenLibraryContextError(`The Open Library lookup returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

function summarizeDoc(item) {
  const title = cleanText(item?.title ?? "", 180);
  const authors = Array.isArray(item?.author_name)
    ? item.author_name.slice(0, 3).map((name) => cleanText(name, 80)).filter(Boolean).join(", ")
    : "";
  const firstPublishYear = cleanText(item?.first_publish_year ?? "", 20);
  const editionCount = cleanText(item?.edition_count ?? "", 20);
  const isbn = Array.isArray(item?.isbn) && item.isbn[0]
    ? normalizeIsbn(item.isbn[0]).slice(0, 20)
    : "";
  const key = cleanText(item?.key ?? "", 80);
  const coverId = cleanText(item?.cover_i ?? "", 20);

  return [
    `- ${title || "Untitled book"}`,
    authors ? `Authors ${authors}` : null,
    firstPublishYear ? `First published ${firstPublishYear}` : null,
    editionCount ? `Editions ${editionCount}` : null,
    isbn ? `ISBN ${isbn}` : null,
    key ? `Work ${key}` : null,
    coverId ? `Cover ${coverId}` : null,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" | ");
}

export async function fetchOpenLibraryContext(
  question,
  {
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  } = {},
) {
  const request = extractOpenLibraryRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const searchUrl = new URL(OPEN_LIBRARY_SEARCH_API);
  if (request.isbn) {
    searchUrl.searchParams.set("isbn", request.isbn);
  } else {
    searchUrl.searchParams.set("q", request.query);
  }
  searchUrl.searchParams.set(
    "fields",
    "key,title,author_name,first_publish_year,edition_count,isbn,cover_i,ebook_access",
  );
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("limit", String(OPEN_LIBRARY_MAX_RESULTS));

  const payload = await fetchJson(searchUrl, fetchImpl);
  const docs = Array.isArray(payload?.docs)
    ? payload.docs.slice(0, OPEN_LIBRARY_MAX_RESULTS)
    : [];

  if (docs.length === 0) {
    throw new OpenLibraryContextError("Open Library did not return a matching book or work.");
  }

  const topDoc = docs[0];
  const topTitle = cleanText(topDoc?.title ?? "", 180);
  const topAuthors = Array.isArray(topDoc?.author_name)
    ? topDoc.author_name.slice(0, 3).map((name) => cleanText(name, 80)).filter(Boolean).join(", ")
    : "";
  const topYear = cleanText(topDoc?.first_publish_year ?? "", 20);
  const topIsbn = Array.isArray(topDoc?.isbn) && topDoc.isbn[0]
    ? normalizeIsbn(topDoc.isbn[0]).slice(0, 20)
    : request.isbn;
  const topWork = cleanText(topDoc?.key ?? "", 80);

  const lines = [
    "Open Library data fetched for this request only:",
    `Query: ${request.query}`,
    topTitle ? `Top work: ${topTitle}` : null,
    topAuthors ? `Top authors: ${topAuthors}` : null,
    topYear ? `First publish year: ${topYear}` : null,
    topIsbn ? `Top ISBN: ${topIsbn}` : null,
    topWork ? `Work key: ${topWork}` : null,
    `Results:\n${docs.map(summarizeDoc).join("\n")}`,
    `Limits: timeout ${OPEN_LIBRARY_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Results ${OPEN_LIBRARY_MAX_RESULTS}. Use only this bounded Open Library snapshot.`,
  ];

  return lines.filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
}

function summarizeWork(item) {
  const title = cleanText(item?.display_name ?? "", 180);
  const year = cleanText(item?.publication_year ?? "", 20);
  const doi = cleanText(item?.doi ?? "", 160);
  const type = cleanText(item?.type ?? "", 80);
  const citedBy = cleanText(item?.cited_by_count ?? "", 20);
  const authors = Array.isArray(item?.authorships)
    ? item.authorships
      .slice(0, 3)
      .map((entry) => cleanText(entry?.author?.display_name ?? "", 80))
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(", ")
    : "";
  const source = cleanText(item?.primary_location?.source?.display_name ?? "", 120);

export async function fetchOpenAlexContext(
  question,
  {
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  } = {},
) {

      .slice(0, 3)

      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(", ")
    : "";

  const lines = [
    "OpenAlex data fetched for this request only:",

    topAuthors ? `Top authors: ${topAuthors}` : null,

import {
  playerProfileFields,
  playerProfileModal,
  playerProfileOptedOut,
  playerProfileSaved,
} from "./player-profile-ui.js";

export async function handlePlayerProfileInteraction(interaction, profiles) {
  const customId = interaction.data?.custom_id;
  const isProfileComponent = (interaction.type === 3 || interaction.type === 5)
    && typeof customId === "string"
    && customId.startsWith("profile:");
  if (!isProfileComponent) return null;

  if (customId === "profile:open") {
    return playerProfileModal(profiles.profileFor(interaction));
  }

  if (customId === "profile:save") {
    const profile = await profiles.save(interaction, playerProfileFields(interaction));
    return playerProfileSaved(profile);
  }

  if (customId === "profile:optout") {
    await profiles.optOut(interaction);
    return playerProfileOptedOut();
  }

  return null;
}

import { createChannelMessage } from "./discord-api.js";
import { playerKey } from "./player-profile-store.js";
import { playerProfileInvitation } from "./player-profile-ui.js";

export class PlayerProfileInviter {
  constructor({
    token,
    publicDiscussions,
    profiles,
    minimumMessages = 5,
    globalCooldownMs = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
    userCooldownMs = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
    dailyLimit = 2,
    maxPromptsPerUser = 2,
    sendMessage = createChannelMessage,
  }) {
    this.token = token;
    this.publicDiscussions = publicDiscussions;
    this.profiles = profiles;
    this.minimumMessages = minimumMessages;
    this.globalCooldownMs = globalCooldownMs;
    this.userCooldownMs = userCooldownMs;
    this.dailyLimit = dailyLimit;
    this.maxPromptsPerUser = maxPromptsPerUser;
    this.sendMessage = sendMessage;
    this.activity = new Map();
    this.sending = false;
  }

  eligibleMessage(message) {
    return this.publicDiscussions.accepts(message)
      && !message.author?.bot
      && !message.webhook_id
      && typeof message.content === "string"
      && message.content.trim().length >= 5
      && !message.content.trim().startsWith("/");
  }

  async consider(message) {
    if (!this.eligibleMessage(message)) return false;
    const key = playerKey(message);
    if (!key) return false;

    const state = this.profiles.promptState(message);
    if (state.known || state.optedOut || state.count >= this.maxPromptsPerUser) return false;

    const count = (this.activity.get(key) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.activity.set(key, count);
    if (this.activity.size > 1_000) this.activity.delete(this.activity.keys().next().value);
    if (count < this.minimumMessages || this.sending) return false;

    const now = this.profiles.now();
    if (state.lastAt !== null && now - state.lastAt < this.userCooldownMs) return false;
    if (!this.profiles.invitationAvailable({
      globalCooldownMs: this.globalCooldownMs,
      dailyLimit: this.dailyLimit,
    })) return false;

    this.sending = true;
    try {
      await this.sendMessage(this.token, message.channel_id, playerProfileInvitation(message.author.id));
      await this.profiles.recordPrompt(message);
      this.activity.delete(key);
      return true;
    } finally {
      this.sending = false;
    }
  }
}
