import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";

import { sanitizePublicMessage } from "./public-discussion-memory.js";

const SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 2;
const HASH_PATTERN = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/;
const RECENT_MEMBER_LIMIT = 3;
const JOIN_QUESTION_PATTERN = /\b(?:who|which|what)\b.*\b(?:joined|new)\b|\b(?:joined|new)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:server|discord|guild|member)\b|\bwho\s+is\s+the\s+new\b/i;
const COMPATIBLE_SNAPSHOT_VERSIONS = new Set([1, SNAPSHOT_VERSION]);

function identity(input) {
  return {
    guildId: input.guild_id,
    userId: input.member?.user?.id ?? input.user?.id ?? input.author?.id,
  };
}

export function playerKey(input) {
  const { guildId, userId } = identity(input);
  if (!guildId || !userId) return null;
  return createHash("sha256").update(`${guildId}:${userId}`).digest("hex");
}

function cleanField(value, maxLength) {
  return sanitizePublicMessage(value).slice(0, maxLength);
}

function validTimestamp(value) {
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0;
}

function cleanIdentityName(value, maxLength = 80) {
  return cleanField(value, maxLength);
}

function words(text) {
  return String(text ?? "")
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .toLowerCase()
    .match(/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g) ?? [];
}

function identityLabels(observedIdentity) {
  if (!observedIdentity) return [];
  return [
    observedIdentity.username,
    observedIdentity.globalName,
    observedIdentity.nick,
  ].filter(Boolean);
}

function describeObservedIdentity(observedIdentity) {
  if (!observedIdentity) return "";

  const lines = [
    observedIdentity.username ? `Discord username: ${observedIdentity.username}` : null,
    observedIdentity.globalName ? `Display name at join: ${observedIdentity.globalName}` : null,
    observedIdentity.nick ? `Server nickname at join: ${observedIdentity.nick}` : null,
    validTimestamp(observedIdentity.joinedAt)
      ? `Observed joining the server at: ${new Date(observedIdentity.joinedAt).toISOString()}`
      : null,
  ].filter(Boolean);

  return lines.join("; ");
}

export class PlayerProfileStore {
  constructor({
    dataPath = "data/player-profiles.json",
    maxUsers = 1_000,
    maxContextChars = 400,
    profileRetentionMs = 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
    now = Date.now,
    logger = console,
  } = {}) {
    this.dataPath = resolve(dataPath);
    this.maxUsers = maxUsers;
    this.maxContextChars = maxContextChars;
    this.profileRetentionMs = profileRetentionMs;
    this.now = now;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.snapshot = {
      version: SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
      updatedAt: null,
      invitationWindow: { day: null, count: 0, lastAt: null },
      users: {},
    };
    this.persistQueue = Promise.resolve();
  }

  prune() {
    for (const [key, user] of Object.entries(this.snapshot.users)) {
      if (!HASH_PATTERN.test(key) || !user || typeof user !== "object") {
        delete this.snapshot.users[key];
        continue;
      }

      const profile = user.profile;
      if (profile && (
        typeof profile.preferredName !== "string"
        || typeof profile.region !== "string"
        || typeof profile.interests !== "string"
        || !validTimestamp(profile.updatedAt)
      )) {
        user.profile = null;
      } else if (profile && profile.updatedAt < this.now() - this.profileRetentionMs) {
        user.profile = null;
        if (user.optedOut !== true) {
          user.promptCount = 0;
          user.lastPromptAt = null;
        }
      } else if (profile) {
        user.profile = {
          preferredName: cleanField(profile.preferredName, 40),
          region: cleanField(profile.region, 80),
          interests: cleanField(profile.interests, 200),
          updatedAt: profile.updatedAt,
        };
        if (!user.profile.preferredName) user.profile = null;
      }
      user.promptCount = Math.min(Math.max(Number.parseInt(user.promptCount, 10) || 0, 0), 2);
      user.lastPromptAt = validTimestamp(user.lastPromptAt) ? user.lastPromptAt : null;
      user.optedOut = user.optedOut === true;
      const observedIdentity = user.observedIdentity;
      if (observedIdentity && typeof observedIdentity === "object") {
        const cleanedIdentity = {
          username: cleanIdentityName(observedIdentity.username),
          globalName: cleanIdentityName(observedIdentity.globalName),
          nick: cleanIdentityName(observedIdentity.nick),
          joinedAt: validTimestamp(observedIdentity.joinedAt) ? observedIdentity.joinedAt : null,
        };
        if (!cleanedIdentity.username && !cleanedIdentity.globalName && !cleanedIdentity.nick) {
          user.observedIdentity = null;
        } else {
          user.observedIdentity = cleanedIdentity;
        }
      } else {
        user.observedIdentity = null;
      }

      if (!user.profile && !user.observedIdentity && !user.optedOut && user.promptCount === 0) {
        delete this.snapshot.users[key];
      }
    }

    const entries = Object.entries(this.snapshot.users);
    if (entries.length > this.maxUsers) {
      entries.sort((left, right) => {
        const leftAt = left[1].profile?.updatedAt ?? left[1].observedIdentity?.joinedAt ?? left[1].lastPromptAt ?? 0;
        const rightAt = right[1].profile?.updatedAt ?? right[1].observedIdentity?.joinedAt ?? right[1].lastPromptAt ?? 0;
        return rightAt - leftAt;
      });
      this.snapshot.users = Object.fromEntries(entries.slice(0, this.maxUsers));
    }

    const window = this.snapshot.invitationWindow;
    if (!window || typeof window !== "object") {
      this.snapshot.invitationWindow = { day: null, count: 0, lastAt: null };
    } else {
      window.day = typeof window.day === "string" ? window.day : null;
      window.count = Math.max(Number.parseInt(window.count, 10) || 0, 0);
      window.lastAt = validTimestamp(window.lastAt) ? window.lastAt : null;
    }
  }

  async load() {
    try {
      const snapshot = JSON.parse(await readFile(this.dataPath, "utf8"));
      if (COMPATIBLE_SNAPSHOT_VERSIONS.has(snapshot?.version) && snapshot.users && typeof snapshot.users === "object") {
        this.snapshot = snapshot;
        this.snapshot.version = SNAPSHOT_VERSION;
        this.prune();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code !== "ENOENT") this.logger.warn("Player profiles could not be loaded", error.message);
    }
  }

  async persist() {
    await mkdir(dirname(this.dataPath), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    const temporaryPath = `${this.dataPath}.tmp`;
    await writeFile(temporaryPath, `${JSON.stringify(this.snapshot)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    await rename(temporaryPath, this.dataPath);
  }

  persistCurrent() {
    this.persistQueue = this.persistQueue.catch(() => {}).then(() => this.persist());
    return this.persistQueue;
  }

  async start() {
    await this.load();
  }

  async stop() {
    await this.persistCurrent();
  }

  entryFor(input) {
    this.prune();
    const key = playerKey(input);
    return key ? this.snapshot.users[key] ?? null : null;
  }

  profileFor(input) {
    return this.entryFor(input)?.profile ?? null;
  }

  contextFor(input) {
    const profile = this.profileFor(input);
    if (!profile) return "";

    const lines = [
      `Preferred name: ${profile.preferredName}`,
      profile.region ? `Broad country/region or time zone: ${profile.region}` : null,
      profile.interests ? `Games and interests: ${profile.interests}` : null,
    ].filter(Boolean);
    return lines.join("\n").slice(0, this.maxContextChars);
  }

  searchByQuestion(question, excludeKey = null) {
    const queryWords = new Set(words(question));
    const wantsRecentJoinContext = JOIN_QUESTION_PATTERN.test(String(question ?? ""));

    if (queryWords.size === 0 && !wantsRecentJoinContext) return "";

    this.prune();
    const matches = [];
    let length = 0;
    const recentCandidates = [];

    for (const [key, user] of Object.entries(
      this.snapshot.users,
    )) {
      if (key === excludeKey || !user) continue;

      const candidateWords = new Set([
        ...words(user.profile?.preferredName),
        ...identityLabels(user.observedIdentity).flatMap(words),
      ]);
      const overlap = [...queryWords].filter((word) => candidateWords.has(word)).length;
      const hasNameMatch = overlap > 0;
      const hasJoinObservation = Boolean(user.observedIdentity);
      if (!hasNameMatch && !hasJoinObservation) continue;

      const lines = [
        user.profile?.preferredName ? `Preferred name: ${user.profile.preferredName}` : null,
        user.profile?.region
          ? `Broad country/region or time zone: ${user.profile.region}`
          : null,
        user.profile?.interests
          ? `Games and interests: ${user.profile.interests}`
          : null,
        describeObservedIdentity(user.observedIdentity),
      ].filter(Boolean);

      const entry = lines.join("; ");
      if (!entry) continue;

      if (hasNameMatch) {
        if (
          matches.length >= 3
          || length + entry.length > this.maxContextChars
        ) {
          continue;
        }

        matches.push(entry);
        length += entry.length + 1;
        continue;
      }

      if (wantsRecentJoinContext) {
        recentCandidates.push({
          entry,
          joinedAt: user.observedIdentity?.joinedAt ?? 0,
        });
      }
    }

    if (matches.length === 0 && wantsRecentJoinContext) {
      recentCandidates
        .sort((left, right) => right.joinedAt - left.joinedAt)
        .slice(0, RECENT_MEMBER_LIMIT)
        .forEach((candidate) => {
          if (
            matches.length >= RECENT_MEMBER_LIMIT
            || length + candidate.entry.length > this.maxContextChars
          ) {
            return;
          }

          matches.push(candidate.entry);
          length += candidate.entry.length + 1;
        });
    }

    return matches.join("\n");
  }

  async observeJoin(input) {
    const key = playerKey(input);
    if (!key) return false;

    const user = input.member?.user ?? input.user;
    const username = cleanIdentityName(user?.username);
    const globalName = cleanIdentityName(user?.global_name);
    const nick = cleanIdentityName(input.nick);
    if (!username && !globalName && !nick) return false;

    const now = this.now();
    const previous = this.snapshot.users[key] ?? {};
    this.snapshot.users[key] = {
      ...previous,
      observedIdentity: {
        username,
        globalName,
        nick,
        joinedAt: now,
      },
    };
    this.prune();
    this.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date(now).toISOString();
    await this.persistCurrent();
    return true;
  }

  async save(input, fields) {
    const key = playerKey(input);
    const preferredName = cleanField(fields.preferredName, 40);
    if (!key || !preferredName) throw new Error("A preferred name is required");

    const previous = this.snapshot.users[key] ?? {};
    this.snapshot.users[key] = {
      ...previous,
      optedOut: false,
      profile: {
        preferredName,
        region: cleanField(fields.region, 80),
        interests: cleanField(fields.interests, 200),
        updatedAt: this.now(),
      },
    };
    this.prune();
    this.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date(this.now()).toISOString();
    await this.persistCurrent();
    return this.snapshot.users[key].profile;
  }

  async delete(input) {
    const key = playerKey(input);
    if (!key) return false;
    const existed = Boolean(this.snapshot.users[key]);
    delete this.snapshot.users[key];
    if (existed) {
      this.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date(this.now()).toISOString();
      await this.persistCurrent();
    }
    return existed;
  }

  async optOut(input) {
    const key = playerKey(input);
    if (!key) return false;
    const previous = this.snapshot.users[key] ?? {};
    this.snapshot.users[key] = { ...previous, optedOut: true };
    this.prune();
    this.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date(this.now()).toISOString();
    await this.persistCurrent();
    return true;
  }

  promptState(input) {
    const entry = this.entryFor(input);
    return {
      known: Boolean(entry?.profile),
      optedOut: entry?.optedOut === true,
      count: entry?.promptCount ?? 0,
      lastAt: entry?.lastPromptAt ?? null,
    };
  }

  invitationAvailable({ globalCooldownMs, dailyLimit }) {
    const now = this.now();
    const day = new Date(now).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const window = this.snapshot.invitationWindow;
    const count = window.day === day ? window.count : 0;
    const cooldownPassed = window.lastAt === null || now - window.lastAt >= globalCooldownMs;
    return cooldownPassed && count < dailyLimit;
  }

  async recordPrompt(input) {
    const key = playerKey(input);
    if (!key) return false;
    const now = this.now();
    const day = new Date(now).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const previous = this.snapshot.users[key] ?? {};
    this.snapshot.users[key] = {
      ...previous,
      promptCount: Math.min((previous.promptCount ?? 0) + 1, 2),
      lastPromptAt: now,
    };
    const window = this.snapshot.invitationWindow;
    this.snapshot.invitationWindow = {
      day,
      count: window.day === day ? window.count + 1 : 1,
      lastAt: now,
    };
    this.prune();
    this.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date(now).toISOString();
    await this.persistCurrent();
    return true;
  }
}

const EPHEMERAL_FLAG = 1 << 6;
const RESPONSE_MESSAGE = 4;
const RESPONSE_MODAL = 9;
const ACTION_ROW = 1;
const BUTTON = 2;
const BUTTON_PRIMARY = 1;
const BUTTON_SECONDARY = 2;
const TEXT_INPUT = 4;
const TEXT_SHORT = 1;
const TEXT_PARAGRAPH = 2;
const LABEL = 18;

function label(labelText, customId, { value = "", style = TEXT_SHORT, maxLength, required = false, description } = {}) {
  const component = {
    type: TEXT_INPUT,
    custom_id: customId,
    style,
    max_length: maxLength,
    required,
  };
  if (value) component.value = value;

  return {
    type: LABEL,
    label: labelText,
    ...(description ? { description } : {}),
    component,
  };
}

export function playerProfileInvitation(userId) {
  return {
    content: `<@${userId}>, want LC to remember a little about you for friendlier /lc replies? Share only what you are comfortable using in public answers.`,
    components: [
      {
        type: ACTION_ROW,
        components: [
          {
            type: BUTTON,
            style: BUTTON_PRIMARY,
            custom_id: "profile:open",
            label: "Introduce myself",
          },
          {
            type: BUTTON,
            style: BUTTON_SECONDARY,
            custom_id: "profile:optout",
            label: "Don't ask again",
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
    allowed_mentions: { parse: [], users: [userId] },
  };
}

export function playerProfileModal(profile = null) {
  return {
    type: RESPONSE_MODAL,
    data: {
      custom_id: "profile:save",
      title: "Your LC player card",
      components: [
        label("Name or nickname", "preferred_name", {
          value: profile?.preferredName,
          maxLength: 40,
          required: true,
        }),
        label("Country/region or time zone (optional)", "region", {
          value: profile?.region,
          maxLength: 80,
          description: "Keep it broad. Never enter an address.",
        }),
        label("Games and interests (optional)", "interests", {
          value: profile?.interests,
          style: TEXT_PARAGRAPH,
          maxLength: 200,
        }),
      ],
    },
  };
}

function valuesFromComponents(components, values = {}) {
  for (const item of components ?? []) {
    if (item.custom_id && typeof item.value === "string") values[item.custom_id] = item.value;
    if (item.component) valuesFromComponents([item.component], values);
    if (item.components) valuesFromComponents(item.components, values);
  }
  return values;
}

export function playerProfileFields(interaction) {
  const values = valuesFromComponents(interaction.data?.components);
  return {
    preferredName: values.preferred_name ?? "",
    region: values.region ?? "",
    interests: values.interests ?? "",
  };
}

function privateMessage(content) {
  return {
    type: RESPONSE_MESSAGE,
    data: {
      content,
      flags: EPHEMERAL_FLAG,
      allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
    },
  };
}

export function playerProfileSaved(profile) {
  return privateMessage(`Nice to meet you, **${profile.preferredName}**. Your LC player card is saved.`);
}

export function playerProfileOptedOut() {
  return privateMessage("LC will not invite you to introduce yourself again.");
}

export function playerProfileError() {
  return privateMessage("LC could not update your player card right now. Please try again later.");
}

import { mkdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";

import { diagnosePublicDiscussionAccess } from "./discord-diagnostics.js";
import { getChannelMessages, getGuildChannels } from "./discord-api.js";

const SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 1;
const TEXT_CHANNEL_TYPE = 0;
const CATEGORY_TYPE = 4;
const STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  "about", "after", "again", "also", "and", "are", "can", "did", "does", "for", "from",
  "have", "how", "into", "just", "our", "that", "the", "their", "then", "there", "they",
  "this", "was", "what", "when", "where", "which", "who", "why", "will", "with", "you", "your",
]);

function normalizedWords(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .toLowerCase()
    .match(/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g) ?? [];
}

function channelName(value) {
  return String(value ?? "room").replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}_-]+/gu, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "").slice(0, 60) || "room";
}

export function sanitizePublicMessage(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/gi, "[link]")
    .replace(/(?:gsk[_-]|sk-)[a-z0-9_-]{20,}/gi, "[secret]")
    .replace(/[a-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[a-z0-9_-]{6,}\.[a-z0-9_-]{20,}/gi, "[secret]")
    .replace(/<@!?\d+>|<@&\d+>/g, "@user")
    .replace(/<#\d+>/g, "#channel")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 500);
}

function safeMessages(messages) {
  return messages
    .filter((message) => !message.author?.bot && !message.webhook_id)
    .map((message) => ({
      id: String(message.id),
      timestamp: message.timestamp,
      content: sanitizePublicMessage(message.content),
    }))
    .filter((message) => message.content.length >= 3)
    .sort((left, right) => left.id.localeCompare(right.id));
}

function safeMessage(message) {
  if (message.author?.bot || message.webhook_id || typeof message.content !== "string") return null;
  const content = sanitizePublicMessage(message.content);
  if (content.length < 3) return null;
  return {
    id: String(message.id),
    timestamp: message.timestamp,
    content,
  };
}

function isRecentDiscussionQuestion(question) {
  const text = String(question ?? "").toLowerCase();
  return ["recent", "lately", "discussion", "discussing", "talking about", "happening in discord"]
    .some((phrase) => text.includes(phrase));
}

export class PublicDiscussionMemory {
  constructor({
    token,
    guildId,
    dataPath = "data/public-discussions.json",
    categoryName = "PUBLIC ROOMS",
    channelRefreshIntervalMs = 60 * 60 * 1000,
    persistIntervalMs = 10 * 60 * 1000,
    maxMessagesPerChannel = 100,
    maxContextChars = 1_200,
    fetchChannels = getGuildChannels,
    fetchMessages = getChannelMessages,
    onDisabled = null,
    onEnabled = null,
    logger = console,
  }) {
    this.token = token;
    this.guildId = guildId;
    this.dataPath = resolve(dataPath);
    this.categoryName = categoryName;
    this.channelRefreshIntervalMs = channelRefreshIntervalMs;
    this.persistIntervalMs = persistIntervalMs;
    this.maxMessagesPerChannel = maxMessagesPerChannel;
    this.maxContextChars = maxContextChars;
    this.fetchChannels = fetchChannels;
    this.fetchMessages = fetchMessages;
    this.onDisabled = onDisabled;
    this.onEnabled = onEnabled;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.snapshot = { version: SNAPSHOT_VERSION, syncedAt: null, channels: {} };
    this.publicChannels = new Map();
    this.channelTimer = null;
    this.persistTimer = null;
    this.persistQueue = Promise.resolve();
    this.revision = 0;
    this.persistedRevision = 0;
    this.disabledReason = null;
    this.disabledDetail = null;
  }

  async disableForMissingAccess(error) {
    this.disabledReason = "missing_access";
    this.disabledDetail = diagnosePublicDiscussionAccess(error, this.categoryName);
    this.logger.warn(this.disabledDetail);
    try {
      await this.onDisabled?.({
        reason: this.disabledReason,
        detail: this.disabledDetail,
        error,
      });
    } catch (callbackError) {
      this.logger.warn("Public discussion disable callback failed", callbackError.message);
    }
  }

  markDirty() {
    this.revision += 1;
  }

  async load() {
    try {
      const snapshot = JSON.parse(await readFile(this.dataPath, "utf8"));
      if (snapshot?.version === SNAPSHOT_VERSION && snapshot.channels && typeof snapshot.channels === "object") {
        this.snapshot = snapshot;
        this.publicChannels = new Map(
          Object.entries(snapshot.channels).map(([id, channel]) => [id, channel.name]),
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code !== "ENOENT") this.logger.warn("Public discussion snapshot could not be loaded", error.message);
    }
  }

  async persist(snapshot) {
    await mkdir(dirname(this.dataPath), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    const temporaryPath = `${this.dataPath}.tmp`;
    await writeFile(temporaryPath, `${JSON.stringify(snapshot)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    await rename(temporaryPath, this.dataPath);
  }

  persistCurrent() {
    const revision = this.revision;
    this.persistQueue = this.persistQueue
      .catch(() => {})
      .then(async () => {
        await this.persist(this.snapshot);
        this.persistedRevision = Math.max(this.persistedRevision, revision);
      });
    return this.persistQueue;
  }

  persistIfDirty() {
    return this.revision === this.persistedRevision
      ? this.persistQueue
      : this.persistCurrent();
  }

  async refreshChannels() {
    const channels = await this.fetchChannels(this.token, this.guildId);
    const category = channels.find((channel) =>
      channel.type === CATEGORY_TYPE && channel.name.trim().toUpperCase() === this.categoryName.trim().toUpperCase());
    if (!category) throw new Error(`Discord category not found: ${this.categoryName}`);

    const nextPublicChannels = new Map(channels
      .filter((channel) => channel.type === TEXT_CHANNEL_TYPE && channel.parent_id === category.id)
      .map((channel) => [channel.id, channelName(channel.name)]));

    const channelsChanged = nextPublicChannels.size !== this.publicChannels.size
      || [...nextPublicChannels].some(([id, name]) => this.publicChannels.get(id) !== name);
    this.publicChannels = nextPublicChannels;

    const recovered = Boolean(this.disabledReason);
    this.disabledReason = null;
    this.disabledDetail = null;

    if (recovered) {
      try {
        await this.onEnabled?.();
      } catch (callbackError) {
        this.logger.warn(
          "Public discussion enable callback failed",
          callbackError.message,
        );
      }
    }

    this.snapshot = {
      ...this.snapshot,
      channels: Object.fromEntries([...this.publicChannels].map(([id, name]) => [id, {
        name,
        messages: this.snapshot.channels[id]?.messages ?? [],
      }])),
    };
    if (channelsChanged) this.markDirty();
    return this.publicChannels;
  }

  async sync() {
    await this.refreshChannels();
    const entries = await Promise.all([...this.publicChannels].map(async ([id, name]) => {
      const messages = await this.fetchMessages(this.token, id, this.maxMessagesPerChannel);
      return [id, {
        name,
        messages: safeMessages(messages.slice(0, this.maxMessagesPerChannel)),
      }];
    }));

    const snapshot = {
      version: SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
      syncedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      channels: Object.fromEntries(entries),
    };
    this.snapshot = snapshot;
    this.markDirty();
    await this.persistIfDirty();
    return snapshot;
  }

  async start() {
    await this.load();
    try {
      await this.sync();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.status === 403) {
        await this.disableForMissingAccess(error);
      } else {
        this.logger.warn(
          "Public discussion sync failed",
          error.message,
        );
      }
    }

    this.channelTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.refreshChannels()
        .catch(async (error) => {
          if (error.status === 403) {
            await this.disableForMissingAccess(error);
            return;
          }
          this.logger.warn("Public discussion channel refresh failed", error.message);
        });
    }, this.channelRefreshIntervalMs);
    this.channelTimer.unref?.();

    this.persistTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.persistIfDirty().catch((error) => this.logger.warn("Public discussion snapshot save failed", error.message));
    }, this.persistIntervalMs);
    this.persistTimer.unref?.();
  }

  async stop() {
    if (this.channelTimer) clearInterval(this.channelTimer);
    if (this.persistTimer) clearInterval(this.persistTimer);
    this.channelTimer = null;
    this.persistTimer = null;
    await this.persistIfDirty();
  }

  accepts(message) {
    return !this.disabledReason
      && message.guild_id === this.guildId
      && this.publicChannels.has(message.channel_id);
  }

  upsert(message) {
    if (!this.accepts(message)) return false;
    const record = safeMessage(message);
    if (!record) return false;

    const channel = this.snapshot.channels[message.channel_id];
    const previous = channel.messages.find((existing) => existing.id === record.id);
    if (!record.timestamp && previous?.timestamp) record.timestamp = previous.timestamp;
    const messages = channel.messages.filter((existing) => existing.id !== record.id);
    messages.push(record);
    messages.sort((left, right) => left.id.localeCompare(right.id));
    channel.messages = messages.slice(-this.maxMessagesPerChannel);
    this.markDirty();
    return true;
  }

  handleCreate(message) {
    return this.upsert(message);
  }

  handleUpdate(message) {
    if (!this.accepts(message) || typeof message.content !== "string") return false;
    if (sanitizePublicMessage(message.content).length < 3) {
      return this.handleDelete(message);
    }
    return this.upsert(message);
  }

  handleDelete(message) {
    if (!this.accepts(message)) return false;
    const channel = this.snapshot.channels[message.channel_id];
    const messages = channel.messages.filter((existing) => existing.id !== String(message.id));
    if (messages.length === channel.messages.length) return false;
    channel.messages = messages;
    this.markDirty();
    return true;
  }

  contextFor(question) {
    if (this.disabledReason) return "";

    const queryWords = new Set(normalizedWords(question).filter((word) => !STOP_WORDS.has(word)));
    const useRecent = isRecentDiscussionQuestion(question);
    const candidates = Object.values(this.snapshot.channels).flatMap((channel) =>
      channel.messages.map((message) => {
        const messageWords = new Set(normalizedWords(message.content));
        const overlap = [...queryWords].filter((word) => messageWords.has(word)).length;
        return { ...message, channel: channel.name, score: overlap };
      }));

    const ranked = candidates
      .filter((message) => useRecent || message.score > 0)
      .sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score || right.id.localeCompare(left.id));

    const selected = [];
    let length = 0;
    for (const message of ranked) {
      const line = `[#${message.channel}] ${message.content}`;
      if (selected.length >= 4 || length + line.length > this.maxContextChars) continue;
      selected.push(line);
      length += line.length + 1;
    }

    return selected.join("\n");
  }
}

const DEFAULT_TTL_MS = 3 * 60 * 1000; // 3 minutes
const MAX_IMAGES_PER_KEY = 4;

export function isImageReferencingPrompt(prompt) {
  if (!prompt || typeof prompt !== "string") return false;
  const text = prompt.trim();
  if (!text) return false;
  const patterns = [
    /\bimage\b/i,
    /\bimages\b/i,
    /\bphoto\b/i,
    /\bphotos\b/i,
    /\bpicture\b/i,
    /\bpictures\b/i,
    /\bpic\b/i,
    /\bpics\b/i,
    /\bupload\b/i,
    /\buploaded\b/i,
    /\babove\b/i,
    /\bscreenshot\b/i,
    /\bscreenshots\b/i,
    /\bicon\b/i,
    /\bicons\b/i,
    /\bgraphic\b/i,
    /\bwhat is this\b/i,
    /\bwhat icon\b/i,
    /\bwhat picture\b/i,
    /\blook\b/i,
    /\bsee\b/i,
    /\bshow\b/i,
    /\banalyze\b/i,
  ];
  return patterns.some((pattern) => pattern.test(text));
}

export class RecentImageMemory {
  constructor({ ttlMs = DEFAULT_TTL_MS, maxImages = MAX_IMAGES_PER_KEY } = {}) {
    this.ttlMs = ttlMs;
    this.maxImages = maxImages;
    this.memory = new Map();
  }

  keyFor({ guildId, channelId, userId }) {
    if (!channelId || !userId) return null;
    const guildKey = guildId ? String(guildId) : "dm";
    return `${guildKey}:${channelId}:${userId}`;
  }

  rememberImages({ guildId, channelId, userId, imageUrls }, now = Date.now()) {
    const key = this.keyFor({ guildId, channelId, userId });
    if (!key) return [];

    const urls = (Array.isArray(imageUrls) ? imageUrls : [])
      .map((url) => String(url ?? "").trim())
      .filter(Boolean);

    if (urls.length === 0) return this.getRecentImages({ guildId, channelId, userId }, now);

    const current = this.getRecentEntries({ guildId, channelId, userId }, now);
    const updated = [];

    for (const url of urls) {
      if (!updated.some((item) => item.url === url)) {
        updated.push({ url, timestamp: now });
      }
    }

    for (const item of current) {
      if (item && item.url && !updated.some((entry) => entry.url === item.url)) {
        updated.push(item);
      }
    }

    const capped = updated.slice(0, this.maxImages);
    this.memory.set(key, capped);

    // Prune expired keys periodically
    if (this.memory.size > 200) {
      this.prune(now);
    }

    return capped.map((item) => item.url);
  }

  getRecentEntries({ guildId, channelId, userId }, now = Date.now()) {
    const key = this.keyFor({ guildId, channelId, userId });
    if (!key) return [];

    const entries = this.memory.get(key) ?? [];
    const valid = entries.filter((entry) => entry && typeof entry === "object" && entry.url && (now - entry.timestamp < this.ttlMs));

    if (valid.length !== entries.length) {
      if (valid.length === 0) {
        this.memory.delete(key);
      } else {
        this.memory.set(key, valid);
      }
    }

    return valid;
  }

  getRecentImages({ guildId, channelId, userId }, now = Date.now()) {
    return this.getRecentEntries({ guildId, channelId, userId }, now).map((item) => item.url);
  }

  prune(now = Date.now()) {
    for (const [key, entries] of this.memory.entries()) {
      const valid = entries.filter((entry) => entry && typeof entry === "object" && entry.url && (now - entry.timestamp < this.ttlMs));
      if (valid.length === 0) {
        this.memory.delete(key);
      } else if (valid.length !== entries.length) {
        this.memory.set(key, valid);
      }
    }
  }

  clear() {
    this.memory.clear();
  }
}

export const recentImageMemory = new RecentImageMemory();

import { getGuild, getGuildChannels, getGuildRoles } from "./discord-api.js";

function appendLocationLines(lines, location) {
  if (!location) return lines;

  if (location.guildName) {
    lines.push(`Discord server name: ${location.guildName}`);
  } else if (location.guildId) {
    lines.push(`Discord server ID: ${location.guildId}`);
  }

  if (location.channelName) {
    lines.push(`Discord channel name: #${location.channelName}`);
  } else if (location.channelId) {
    lines.push(`Discord channel ID: ${location.channelId}`);
  }

  return lines;
}

export function requesterIdentity(interaction, location = null) {
  const user = interaction.member?.user ?? interaction.user;
  const userId = user?.id;
  if (!userId) return "";

  const lines = [
    `Discord user ID: ${userId} (authoritative, immutable identity)`,
  ];

  const username = user.username;
  if (username) {
    lines.push(`Discord username: ${username}`);
  }

  const globalName = user.global_name;
  if (globalName && globalName !== username) {
    lines.push(`Display name: ${globalName} (user-chosen, can change)`);
  }

  const nick = interaction.member?.nick;
  if (nick && nick !== globalName && nick !== username) {
    lines.push(`Server nickname: ${nick} (server-specific, can change)`);
  }

  appendLocationLines(lines, location);
  return lines.join("\n");
}

const CONTEXT_BY_TIER = {
  staff: "The requester is LC staff. Be concise and operational, but do not reveal omitted or private information.",
  member: "The requester is an official LC member. You may assume familiarity with LC basics, but do not reveal omitted or private information.",
  candidate: "The requester is an LC candidate. Be welcoming and explain clan expectations and next steps clearly.",
  friend: "The requester is a friend of LC. Be welcoming, but do not assume official member access.",
  visitor: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
};

function normalizedRoleName(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").normalize("NFKD").toLowerCase().trim();
}

export function requesterContextForRoleNames(roleNames) {
  return CONTEXT_BY_TIER[requesterTierForRoleNames(roleNames)];
}

export function requesterTierForRoleNames(roleNames) {
  const names = roleNames.map(normalizedRoleName);

  if (names.some((name) => name === "admins" || name === "moderator" || name.includes("lc-recruiter"))) {
    return "staff";
  }

  if (names.some((name) => name === "originals" || name.includes("beginner") || name.includes("gem") || name.includes("members"))) {
    return "member";
  }

  if (names.some((name) => name.includes("candidate"))) {
    return "candidate";
  }

  if (names.some((name) => name === "friends of clan")) {
    return "friend";
  }

  return "visitor";
}

export class DiscordRoleContext {
  constructor(token, {
    fetchRoles = getGuildRoles,
    cacheTtlMs = 60 * 60 * 1000,
    now = Date.now,
    logger = console,
  } = {}) {
    this.token = token;
    this.fetchRoles = fetchRoles;
    this.cacheTtlMs = cacheTtlMs;
    this.now = now;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = new Map();
  }

  async rolesForGuild(guildId) {
    const cached = this.cache.get(guildId);
    if (cached && cached.expiresAt > this.now()) return cached.roles;

    const roles = await this.fetchRoles(this.token, guildId);
    if (!Array.isArray(roles)) throw new Error("Discord roles response was not an array");

    this.cache.set(guildId, {
      roles,
      expiresAt: this.now() + this.cacheTtlMs,
    });
    return roles;
  }

  async describe(interaction) {
    const tier = await this.tierForInteraction(interaction);
    return CONTEXT_BY_TIER[tier];
  }

  async tierForInteraction(interaction) {
    const guildId = interaction.guild_id;
    const assignedRoleIds = new Set(interaction.member?.roles ?? []);
    if (!guildId || assignedRoleIds.size === 0) return "visitor";

    try {
      const roles = await this.rolesForGuild(guildId);
      const assignedNames = roles
        .filter((role) => assignedRoleIds.has(role.id))
        .map((role) => role.name);
      return requesterTierForRoleNames(assignedNames);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn("Discord role context unavailable", error.message);
      return "visitor";
    }
  }

  async describeFromMessage(message) {
    const tier = await this.tierForMessage(message);
    return CONTEXT_BY_TIER[tier];
  }

  async tierForMessage(message) {
    const guildId = message.guild_id;
    const assignedRoleIds = new Set(message.member?.roles ?? []);
    if (!guildId || assignedRoleIds.size === 0) return "visitor";

    try {
      const roles = await this.rolesForGuild(guildId);
      const assignedNames = roles
        .filter((role) => assignedRoleIds.has(role.id))
        .map((role) => role.name);
      return requesterTierForRoleNames(assignedNames);
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn("Discord role context unavailable", error.message);
      return "visitor";
    }
  }
}

export class DiscordLocationContext {
  constructor(token, {
    fetchGuild = getGuild,
    fetchGuildChannels = getGuildChannels,
    cacheTtlMs = 60 * 60 * 1000,
    now = Date.now,
    logger = console,
  } = {}) {
    this.token = token;
    this.fetchGuild = fetchGuild;
    this.fetchGuildChannels = fetchGuildChannels;
    this.cacheTtlMs = cacheTtlMs;
    this.now = now;
    this.logger = logger;
    this.cache = new Map();
  }

  async namesForGuild(guildId) {
    const cached = this.cache.get(guildId);
    if (cached && cached.expiresAt > this.now()) return cached.value;

    const [guild, channels] = await Promise.all([
      this.fetchGuild(this.token, guildId),
      this.fetchGuildChannels(this.token, guildId),
    ]);
    const value = {
      guildName: typeof guild?.name === "string" ? guild.name : null,
      channelNames: new Map(
        Array.isArray(channels)
          ? channels
            .filter((channel) => typeof channel?.id === "string" && typeof channel?.name === "string")
            .map((channel) => [channel.id, channel.name])
          : [],
      ),
    };

    this.cache.set(guildId, {
      value,
      expiresAt: this.now() + this.cacheTtlMs,
    });
    return value;
  }

  async describe(input) {
    const guildId = input.guild_id;
    const channelId = input.channel_id;
    if (!guildId) {
      return {
        guildId: null,
        guildName: null,
        channelId: channelId ?? null,
        channelName: null,
      };
    }

    try {
      const names = await this.namesForGuild(guildId);
      return {
        guildId,
        guildName: names.guildName,
        channelId: channelId ?? null,
        channelName: channelId ? names.channelNames.get(channelId) ?? null : null,
      };
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn("Discord location context unavailable", error.message);
      return {
        guildId,
        guildName: null,
        channelId: channelId ?? null,
        channelName: null,
      };
    }
  }
}

}

import { exec } from "node:child_process";

const RESTART_PATTERNS = [
  /\brestart\b.*\bserver\b/i,
  /\bserver\b.*\brestart\b/i,
  /\brestart\b.*\b(expanding|game|el)\b/i,
  /\b(expanding|game|el)\b.*\brestart\b/i,
  /\breboot\b.*\bserver\b/i,
  /\bserver\b.*\breboot\b/i,
  /\brestart expanding/i,
  /\brestart the server/i,
  /\brestart server/i,
];

const ALLOWED_TIERS = new Set(["candidate", "member", "staff"]);

const RESTART_COOLDOWN_MS = 60_000;
let lastRestartAt = 0;
let lastRestartUser = "";
let restartInFlight = false;

export function isRestartRequest(question) {
  return RESTART_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(question));
}

export function isAllowedTier(tier) {
  return ALLOWED_TIERS.has(
    String(tier ?? "").trim().toLowerCase(),
  );
}

export function restartExpandingLand(
  username,
  {
    execImpl = exec,
    now = Date.now,
  } = {},
) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const requestedAt = now();

    if (restartInFlight) {
      resolve(
        "⏳ A server restart is already in progress. Please wait for it to finish.",
      );
      return;
    }

    if (
      requestedAt - lastRestartAt
      < RESTART_COOLDOWN_MS
    ) {
      const waitSec = Math.ceil(
        (
          RESTART_COOLDOWN_MS
          - (requestedAt - lastRestartAt)
        ) / 1000,
      );

      resolve(
        `⏳ Server was restarted ${waitSec}s ago by ${lastRestartUser}. Please wait before trying again.`,
      );
      return;
    }

    restartInFlight = true;
    const requestedBy =
      username || "unknown";

    const complete = (error) => {
      restartInFlight = false;

      if (error) {
        console.error(
          "Server restart failed:",
          error.message,
        );

        resolve(
          `❌ Restart failed: ${error.message}`,
        );
        return;
      }

      lastRestartAt = now();
      lastRestartUser = requestedBy;

      console.log(
        `Expanding Land restarted by Discord user: ${requestedBy}`,
      );

      resolve(
        "✅ Expanding Land server has been restarted successfully. It should be back online in a few seconds.",
      );
    };

    try {
      execImpl(
        "systemctl restart expanding-land",
        {
          timeout: 15_000,
        },
        complete,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      complete(error);
    }
  });
}

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { mkdir, readFile, rename, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";

const SNAPSHOT_VERSION = 2;
const HASH_PATTERN = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/;
const MAX_QUESTION_CHARS = 500;
const MAX_ANSWER_CHARS = 1_500;
const MAX_STATE_CHARS = 1_000;

const SUMMARY_STOP_WORDS = new Set([
  "about", "after", "again", "also", "and", "are", "because", "been", "between",
  "could", "does", "each", "from", "have", "here", "into", "just", "like", "more",
  "only", "same", "than", "that", "their", "them", "then", "there", "these", "this",
  "those", "through", "very", "what", "when", "where", "which", "while", "with", "would",
  "your", "legend", "mod",
]);

function requesterKey(interaction) {
  const userId = interaction.member?.user?.id ?? interaction.user?.id;
  if (!userId) return null;

  const guildId = interaction.guild_id ?? "direct-message";

  return createHash("sha256")
    .update(`${guildId}:${userId}`)
    .digest("hex");
}

function sanitizeConversationText(value, maxLength) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/gi, "[link]")
    .replace(/(?:gsk[_-]|sk-)[a-z0-9_-]{20,}/gi, "[secret]")
    .replace(
      /[a-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[a-z0-9_-]{6,}\.[a-z0-9_-]{20,}/gi,
      "[secret]",
    )
    .replace(/<@!?\d+>|<@&\d+>/g, "@user")
    .replace(/<#\d+>/g, "#channel")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
}

function normalizedWords(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .normalize("NFKD")
    .toLowerCase()
    .match(/[a-z0-9]{3,}/g) ?? [];
}

function validTurn(turn, cutoff) {
  if (
    !turn
    || typeof turn !== "object"
    || !Number.isFinite(turn.at)
    || turn.at < cutoff
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const question = sanitizeConversationText(
    turn.question,
    MAX_QUESTION_CHARS,
  );

  const answer = sanitizeConversationText(
    turn.answer,
    MAX_ANSWER_CHARS,
  );

  if (!question || !answer) return null;

  return {
    question,
    answer,
    at: turn.at,
  };
}

export class UserQuestionMemory {
  constructor({
    dataPath = "data/user-lc-memory.json",
    retentionMs = 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
    maxTurnsPerUser = 5,
    maxUsers = 1_000,
    maxContextChars = 6_000,
    now = Date.now,
    logger = console,
  } = {}) {
    this.dataPath = resolve(dataPath);
    this.retentionMs = retentionMs;
    this.maxTurnsPerUser = maxTurnsPerUser;
    this.maxUsers = maxUsers;
    this.maxContextChars = maxContextChars;
    this.now = now;
    this.logger = logger;

    this.snapshot = {
      version: SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
      updatedAt: null,
      users: {},
    };

    this.persistQueue = Promise.resolve();
  }

  prune() {
    const cutoff = this.now() - this.retentionMs;

    for (const [key, user] of Object.entries(this.snapshot.users)) {
      if (
        !HASH_PATTERN.test(key)
        || !user
        || !Array.isArray(user.turns)
      ) {
        delete this.snapshot.users[key];
        continue;
      }

      user.turns = user.turns
        .map((turn) => validTurn(turn, cutoff))
        .filter(Boolean)
        .slice(-this.maxTurnsPerUser);

      if (user.turns.length === 0) {
        delete this.snapshot.users[key];
      }
    }

    const entries = Object.entries(this.snapshot.users);

    if (entries.length > this.maxUsers) {
      entries.sort((left, right) => {
        const leftAt = left[1].turns.at(-1)?.at ?? 0;
        const rightAt = right[1].turns.at(-1)?.at ?? 0;
        return rightAt - leftAt;
      });

      this.snapshot.users = Object.fromEntries(
        entries.slice(0, this.maxUsers),
      );
    }
  }

  async load() {
    try {
      const snapshot = JSON.parse(
        await readFile(this.dataPath, "utf8"),
      );

      if (
        snapshot?.version === SNAPSHOT_VERSION
        && snapshot.users
        && typeof snapshot.users === "object"
      ) {
        this.snapshot = snapshot;
        this.prune();
        return;
      }

      if (snapshot?.version === 1) {
        this.logger.warn(
          "Old question-only memory was reset because it contained no assistant answers",
        );

        this.snapshot = {
          version: SNAPSHOT_VERSION,
          updatedAt: null,
          users: {},
        };

        await this.persist();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code !== "ENOENT") {
        this.logger.warn(
          "User conversation memory could not be loaded",
          error.message,
        );
      }
    }
  }

  async persist() {
    await mkdir(dirname(this.dataPath), {
      recursive: true,
      mode: 0o700,
    });

    const temporaryPath = `${this.dataPath}.tmp`;

    await writeFile(
      temporaryPath,
      `${JSON.stringify(this.snapshot)}\n`,
      { mode: 0o600 },
    );

    await rename(temporaryPath, this.dataPath);
  }

  persistCurrent() {
    this.persistQueue = this.persistQueue
      .catch(() => {})
      .then(() => this.persist());

    return this.persistQueue;
  }

  async start() {
    await this.load();
  }

  async stop() {
    await this.persistCurrent();
  }

  keyFor(interaction) {
    return requesterKey(interaction);
  }

  messagesForKey(key) {
    if (!key) return [];

    this.prune();

    const turns = this.snapshot.users[key]?.turns ?? [];
    const selected = [];
    let usedCharacters = 0;

    for (let index = turns.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const turn = turns[index];

      const estimatedCharacters =
        turn.question.length
        + turn.answer.length
        + 32;

      if (
        usedCharacters + estimatedCharacters
        > this.maxContextChars
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      selected.unshift(turn);
      usedCharacters += estimatedCharacters;
    }

    return selected.flatMap((turn) => [
      {
        role: "user",
        content: turn.question,
      },
      {
        role: "assistant",
        content: turn.answer,
      },
    ]);
  }

  messagesFor(interaction) {
    return this.messagesForKey(requesterKey(interaction));
  }

  stateForKey(key) {
    if (!key) return null;
    this.prune();

    const user = this.snapshot.users[key];
    if (!user || !Array.isArray(user.turns) || user.turns.length === 0) {
      return null;
    }

    const latestTurn = user.turns.at(-1);
    const words = normalizedWords(latestTurn.question);
    const activeSubject = words[0] ?? "general";
    const activeEntities = words.slice(0, 3);

    const state = {
      activeSubject,
      activeEntities,
      lastIntent: "knowledge_question",
      lastAnswerMode: "direct",
      unresolvedQuestion: latestTurn.question.slice(0, 150),
      lastSuccessfulCapabilities: ["core_knowledge"],
      lastUpdatedAt: new Date(latestTurn.at).toISOString(),
    };

    const serialized = JSON.stringify(state);
    if (serialized.length > MAX_STATE_CHARS) {
      state.unresolvedQuestion = state.unresolvedQuestion.slice(0, 80);
    }

    return state;
  }

  continuitySummaryForKey(key) {
    if (!key) return "";

    this.prune();

    const turns = this.snapshot.users[key]?.turns ?? [];
    if (turns.length === 0) return "";

    const latestTurn = turns.at(-1);
    const termCounts = new Map();

    for (const turn of turns.slice(-3)) {
      for (const word of normalizedWords(`${turn.question} ${turn.answer}`)) {
        if (SUMMARY_STOP_WORDS.has(word)) continue;
        termCounts.set(word, (termCounts.get(word) ?? 0) + 1);
      }
    }

    const recurringTerms = [...termCounts.entries()]
      .sort((left, right) => right[1] - left[1] || left[0].localeCompare(right[0]))
      .slice(0, 4)
      .map(([word]) => word);

    const lines = [
      latestTurn?.question
        ? `Latest thread question: ${latestTurn.question}`
        : null,
      latestTurn?.answer
        ? `Latest thread answer: ${latestTurn.answer.slice(0, 220)}`
        : null,
      recurringTerms.length > 0
        ? `Recurring thread terms: ${recurringTerms.join(", ")}`
        : null,
    ].filter(Boolean);

    return lines.join("\n");
  }

  contextFor(interaction) {
    return this.messagesFor(interaction)
      .map((message) => `${message.role}: ${message.content}`)
      .join("\n");
  }

  async rememberByKey(key, question, answer) {
    const cleanQuestion = sanitizeConversationText(
      question,
      MAX_QUESTION_CHARS,
    );

    const cleanAnswer = sanitizeConversationText(
      answer,
      MAX_ANSWER_CHARS,
    );

    if (!key || !cleanQuestion || !cleanAnswer) {
      return false;
    }

    // Do not save error messages or clarification-only prompts as valid user turns
    if (/^I mainly help here with|The question must contain|is not configured|failed/i.test(cleanAnswer)) {
      return false;
    }

    this.prune();

    const turns = this.snapshot.users[key]?.turns ?? [];
    const at = this.now();
    const previous = turns.at(-1);

    if (
      previous?.question === cleanQuestion
      && previous.answer === cleanAnswer
    ) {
      previous.at = at;
    } else {
      turns.push({
        question: cleanQuestion,
        answer: cleanAnswer,
        at,
      });
    }

    this.snapshot.users[key] = {
      turns: turns.slice(-this.maxTurnsPerUser),
    };

    this.prune();

    this.snapshot.updatedAt = new Date(at).toISOString();

    try {
      await this.persistCurrent();
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn(
        "User conversation memory could not be saved",
        error.message,
      );
    }

    return true;
  }

  async remember(interaction, question, answer) {
    return this.rememberByKey(
      requesterKey(interaction),
      question,
      answer,
    );
  }
}

const WEATHER_TRIGGER_PATTERN =
  /\b(?:weather|meteo|forecast|temperature|temp|degrees|rain|raining|wind|humidity|sunrise|sunset|hot|cold)\b/i;

const WEATHER_CODE_LABELS = new Map([
  [0, "clear sky"],
  [1, "mainly clear"],
  [2, "partly cloudy"],
  [3, "overcast"],
  [45, "fog"],
  [48, "depositing rime fog"],
  [51, "light drizzle"],
  [53, "moderate drizzle"],
  [55, "dense drizzle"],
  [56, "light freezing drizzle"],
  [57, "dense freezing drizzle"],
  [61, "slight rain"],
  [63, "moderate rain"],
  [65, "heavy rain"],
  [66, "light freezing rain"],
  [67, "heavy freezing rain"],
  [71, "slight snow fall"],
  [73, "moderate snow fall"],
  [75, "heavy snow fall"],
  [77, "snow grains"],
  [80, "slight rain showers"],
  [81, "moderate rain showers"],
  [82, "violent rain showers"],
  [85, "slight snow showers"],
  [86, "heavy snow showers"],
  [95, "thunderstorm"],
  [96, "thunderstorm with slight hail"],
  [99, "thunderstorm with heavy hail"],
]);

const LOCATION_PATTERNS = [
  /(?:weather|meteo|forecast|temperature|temp|degrees|rain(?:ing)?|wind|humidity|sunrise|sunset)\s+(?:in|for|at)\s+(.+)$/i,
  /(?:what(?:'s| is)\s+the\s+)?(?:weather|meteo|forecast|temperature|temp)\s+(?:like\s+)?(?:in|for|at)\s+(.+)$/i,
  /^(?:weather|meteo|forecast|temperature|temp)\s+(.+)$/i,
  /^(.+?)\s+(?:weather|meteo|forecast)$/i,
  /\b(?:in|for|at)\s+(.+)$/i,
];

function compact(value) {
  return String(value ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
}

function formatNumber(value, digits = 1) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "n/a";
  const formatted = Number(value).toFixed(digits);
  return formatted.endsWith(".0")
    ? formatted.slice(0, -2)
    : formatted;
}

function cleanWeatherCode(code) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(code)) return "unknown";
  return WEATHER_CODE_LABELS.get(code) ?? `weather code ${code}`;
}

function cleanLocationCandidate(value) {
  const normalized = compact(value)
    .replace(/^["'`([{<]+/, "")
    .replace(/["'`)\]}>]+$/, "");

  const withoutTail = normalized
    .replace(/\b(?:right now|currently|today|tomorrow|now|please|pls|plz)\b.*$/i, "")
    .replace(/[?!.,;:]+$/g, "")
    .trim();

  if (!withoutTail) return "";

  return withoutTail
    .replace(/^the\s+/i, "")
    .replace(/^city of\s+/i, "")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 120);
}

function extractLocation(question) {
  const trimmed = compact(question);

  for (const pattern of LOCATION_PATTERNS) {
    const match = trimmed.match(pattern);
    if (!match?.[1]) continue;

    const candidate = cleanLocationCandidate(match[1]);
    if (candidate) return candidate;
  }

  return "";
}

function timingHint(question) {
  const text = String(question ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (text.includes("tomorrow")) return "tomorrow";
  if (text.includes("today")) return "today";
  if (text.includes("right now") || text.includes("currently") || text.includes("now")) {
    return "current";
  }
  return "general";
}

function formatResolvedPlace(result) {
  return [
    result?.name,
    result?.admin1,
    result?.country,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
}

function dailyLine(index, daily) {
  const date = daily?.time?.[index];
  if (!date) return null;

  const code = Number(daily?.weather_code?.[index]);
  const maxTemp = formatNumber(Number(daily?.temperature_2m_max?.[index]));
  const minTemp = formatNumber(Number(daily?.temperature_2m_min?.[index]));
  const rainChance = formatNumber(Number(daily?.precipitation_probability_max?.[index]), 0);
  const rainTotal = formatNumber(Number(daily?.precipitation_sum?.[index]));
  const windMax = formatNumber(Number(daily?.wind_speed_10m_max?.[index]));
  const sunrise = daily?.sunrise?.[index] ?? "n/a";
  const sunset = daily?.sunset?.[index] ?? "n/a";

  return `${date}: ${cleanWeatherCode(code)}. Max ${maxTemp}C, min ${minTemp}C, rain chance ${rainChance}%, rain ${rainTotal} mm, max wind ${windMax} km/h, sunrise ${sunrise}, sunset ${sunset}.`;
}

function dailySummary(index, daily) {
  const date = daily?.time?.[index];
  if (!date) return null;

  const code = Number(daily?.weather_code?.[index]);
  const maxTemp = formatNumber(Number(daily?.temperature_2m_max?.[index]));
  const minTemp = formatNumber(Number(daily?.temperature_2m_min?.[index]));
  const rainChance = formatNumber(Number(daily?.precipitation_probability_max?.[index]), 0);
  const windMax = formatNumber(Number(daily?.wind_speed_10m_max?.[index]));

  return {
    date,
    conditions: cleanWeatherCode(code),
    maxTemp,
    minTemp,
    rainChance,
    windMax,
    sunrise: daily?.sunrise?.[index] ?? "n/a",
    sunset: daily?.sunset?.[index] ?? "n/a",
  };
}

export class WeatherContextError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "WeatherContextError";
  }
}

export function extractWeatherRequest(question) {
  const text = compact(question);
  if (!WEATHER_TRIGGER_PATTERN.test(text)) {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    question: text,
    location: extractLocation(text),
    timing: timingHint(text),
  };
}

async function fetchWeatherSnapshot(request, { fetchImpl = fetch } = {}) {
  if (!request.location) {
    throw new WeatherContextError(
      "Ask for weather with a location, for example: weather in Athens.",
    );
  }

  const geocodingUrl = new URL("https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search");
  geocodingUrl.searchParams.set("name", request.location);
  geocodingUrl.searchParams.set("count", "5");
  geocodingUrl.searchParams.set("language", "en");
  geocodingUrl.searchParams.set("format", "json");

  let geocodingResponse;
  try {
    geocodingResponse = await fetchImpl(geocodingUrl, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8_000),
    });
  } catch {
    throw new WeatherContextError("Open-Meteo geocoding is temporarily unavailable.");
  }

  if (!geocodingResponse.ok) {
    throw new WeatherContextError("Open-Meteo geocoding is temporarily unavailable.");
  }

  const geocodingPayload = await geocodingResponse.json();
  const place = Array.isArray(geocodingPayload?.results)
    ? geocodingPayload.results[0]
    : null;

  if (
    !Number.isFinite(Number(place?.latitude))
    || !Number.isFinite(Number(place?.longitude))
  ) {
    throw new WeatherContextError(
      "I could not find that place in Open-Meteo. Try a clearer city or country name.",
    );
  }

  const forecastUrl = new URL("https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast");
  forecastUrl.searchParams.set("latitude", String(place.latitude));
  forecastUrl.searchParams.set("longitude", String(place.longitude));
  forecastUrl.searchParams.set("timezone", "auto");
  forecastUrl.searchParams.set("forecast_days", "2");
  forecastUrl.searchParams.set(
    "current",
    [
      "temperature_2m",
      "apparent_temperature",
      "relative_humidity_2m",
      "precipitation",
      "rain",
      "showers",
      "snowfall",
      "weather_code",
      "wind_speed_10m",
      "wind_direction_10m",
      "wind_gusts_10m",
    ].join(","),
  );
  forecastUrl.searchParams.set(
    "daily",
    [
      "weather_code",
      "temperature_2m_max",
      "temperature_2m_min",
      "precipitation_probability_max",
      "precipitation_sum",
      "wind_speed_10m_max",
      "sunrise",
      "sunset",
    ].join(","),
  );

  let forecastResponse;
  try {
    forecastResponse = await fetchImpl(forecastUrl, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8_000),
    });
  } catch {
    throw new WeatherContextError("Open-Meteo forecast is temporarily unavailable.");
  }

  if (!forecastResponse.ok) {
    throw new WeatherContextError("Open-Meteo forecast is temporarily unavailable.");
  }

  const forecastPayload = await forecastResponse.json();
  const current = forecastPayload?.current ?? {};
  const daily = forecastPayload?.daily ?? {};
  const resolvedPlace = formatResolvedPlace(place);

  return {
    request,
    place,
    resolvedPlace: resolvedPlace || request.location,
    timezone: forecastPayload?.timezone ?? place?.timezone ?? "n/a",
    current,
    today: dailySummary(0, daily),
    tomorrow: dailySummary(1, daily),
    daily,
  };
}

export function formatWeatherAnswer(snapshot) {
  if (!snapshot) return "";

  const {
    request,
    resolvedPlace,
    current,
    today,
    tomorrow,
  } = snapshot;

  const currentLine = [
    `${resolvedPlace}: currently ${formatNumber(Number(current?.temperature_2m))}C`,
    `${cleanWeatherCode(Number(current?.weather_code))}`,
    `feels like ${formatNumber(Number(current?.apparent_temperature))}C`,
    `humidity ${formatNumber(Number(current?.relative_humidity_2m), 0)}%`,
    `wind ${formatNumber(Number(current?.wind_speed_10m))} km/h`,
  ].join(", ");

  if (request?.timing === "tomorrow" && tomorrow) {
    return `${resolvedPlace} tomorrow: ${tomorrow.conditions}. Max ${tomorrow.maxTemp}C, min ${tomorrow.minTemp}C, rain chance ${tomorrow.rainChance}%, max wind ${tomorrow.windMax} km/h. Sunrise ${tomorrow.sunrise}, sunset ${tomorrow.sunset}.`;
  }

  if (request?.timing === "today" && today) {
    return `${currentLine}. Today: max ${today.maxTemp}C, min ${today.minTemp}C, rain chance ${today.rainChance}%, max wind ${today.windMax} km/h. Sunrise ${today.sunrise}, sunset ${today.sunset}.`;
  }

  if (today) {
    return `${currentLine}. Today reaches ${today.maxTemp}C / ${today.minTemp}C with ${today.rainChance}% rain chance.`;
  }

  return `${currentLine}.`;
}

export async function fetchWeatherContext(
  question,
  { fetchImpl = fetch } = {},
) {
  const request = extractWeatherRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const snapshot = await fetchWeatherSnapshot(request, { fetchImpl });
  const { current, daily, request: normalizedRequest, resolvedPlace, timezone } = snapshot;
  const today = dailyLine(0, daily);
  const tomorrow = dailyLine(1, daily);

  return [
    "Weather data fetched from Open-Meteo for this request:",
    `Requested weather location: ${normalizedRequest.location}`,
    `Resolved place: ${resolvedPlace}`,
    `Timezone: ${timezone}`,
    `Timing hint from requester: ${normalizedRequest.timing}`,
    "Current weather:",
    `- Observation time: ${current?.time ?? "n/a"}`,
    `- Conditions: ${cleanWeatherCode(Number(current?.weather_code))}`,
    `- Temperature: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.temperature_2m))}C`,
    `- Feels like: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.apparent_temperature))}C`,
    `- Humidity: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.relative_humidity_2m), 0)}%`,
    `- Precipitation now: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.precipitation))} mm`,
    `- Rain now: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.rain))} mm`,
    `- Showers now: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.showers))} mm`,
    `- Snowfall now: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.snowfall))} cm`,
    `- Wind: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.wind_speed_10m))} km/h at ${formatNumber(Number(current?.wind_direction_10m), 0)} degrees`,
    `- Wind gusts: ${formatNumber(Number(current?.wind_gusts_10m))} km/h`,
    today ? `Today: ${today}` : null,
    tomorrow ? `Tomorrow: ${tomorrow}` : null,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join("\n");
}

export async function fetchWeatherAnswer(
  question,
  { fetchImpl = fetch } = {},
) {
  const request = extractWeatherRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const snapshot = await fetchWeatherSnapshot(request, { fetchImpl });
  return formatWeatherAnswer(snapshot);
}

const SEARCH_URL = "https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/";
export const WEB_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 6_000;
const MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 220;
export const WEB_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS = 5;
const MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS = 3_500;

export class WebSearchError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "WebSearchError";
  }
}

function decodeEntities(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, "\"")
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'")
    .replace(/&#x27;/gi, "'")
    .replace(/&#x2F;/gi, "/")
    .replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_match, code) => String.fromCharCode(Number.parseInt(code, 10)))
    .replace(/&#x([0-9a-f]+);/gi, (_match, code) => String.fromCharCode(Number.parseInt(code, 16)));
}

function cleanText(value, maxLength = 280) {
  const normalized = decodeEntities(value)
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
  return normalized ? normalized.slice(0, maxLength) : "";
}

function hasUrl(text) {
  return /https?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+/i.test(text);
}

function normalizeSearchQuery(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, MAX_QUERY_LENGTH);
}

function stripLeadingSearchPrompt(text) {
  let query = String(text ?? "").trim();

  const patterns = [
    /^(?:please\s+)?google\s+(?:for\s+|whether\s+|if\s+|about\s+|this\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?search\s+(?:google|the\s+web|the\s+internet|online|web)?\s*(?:for\s+|whether\s+|if\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?look\s+up\s+(?:online\s+|on\s+google\s+|on\s+the\s+web\s+)?(?:whether\s+|if\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?verify\s+(?:online\s+|on\s+google\s+|on\s+the\s+web\s+)?(?:whether\s+|if\s+|that\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?check\s+(?:online\s+|on\s+google\s+|on\s+the\s+web\s+)?(?:whether\s+|if\s+|that\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:is\s+it\s+true\s+that\s+)/i,
  ];

  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    query = query.replace(pattern, "");
  }

  return normalizeSearchQuery(query.replace(/[?]+$/g, ""));
}

export function extractWebSearchRequest(question) {
  const text = String(question ?? "").trim();
  if (!text || hasUrl(text)) return null;

  const explicitSearchIntent =
    /\bgoogle\b/i.test(text)
    || /\bsearch\b[\s\S]{0,20}\b(?:web|internet|online|google|for)\b/i.test(text)
    || /\blook\s+up\b/i.test(text)
    || /\bverify\b[\s\S]{0,20}\b(?:online|web|internet|google|true)\b/i.test(text)
    || /\bcheck\b[\s\S]{0,20}\b(?:online|web|internet|google|true)\b/i.test(text);

  if (!explicitSearchIntent) return null;

  const query = stripLeadingSearchPrompt(text);
  if (!query) return null;

  return { query };
}

function resolveDuckDuckGoRedirect(url) {
  try {
    const parsed = new URL(url, SEARCH_URL);
    const direct = parsed.searchParams.get("uddg");
    return direct || parsed.toString();
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
}

function parseSearchResults(html) {
  const source = String(html ?? "");
  const titlePattern = /<a\b[^>]*class="[^"]*result__a[^"]*"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi;
  const snippetPattern = /<(?:a|div)\b[^>]*class="[^"]*result__snippet[^"]*"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/(?:a|div)>/gi;
  const snippets = [...source.matchAll(snippetPattern)].map((match) => cleanText(match[1], 260));
  const results = [];

  let match;
  while ((match = titlePattern.exec(source)) !== null && results.length < WEB_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS) {
    const url = cleanText(resolveDuckDuckGoRedirect(decodeEntities(match[1])), 400);
    const title = cleanText(match[2], 160);
    if (!url || !title) continue;
    results.push({
      title,
      url,
      snippet: snippets[results.length] ?? "",
    });
  }

  return results;
}

export async function fetchWebSearchContext(
  question,
  {
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  } = {},
) {
  const request = extractWebSearchRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(`${SEARCH_URL}?q=${encodeURIComponent(request.query)}`, {
      headers: {
        accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml",
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(WEB_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new WebSearchError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "The web search timed out."
        : "The web search could not be completed right now.",
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new WebSearchError(`The web search returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }

  const contentType = String(response.headers?.get?.("content-type") ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (contentType && !contentType.includes("html")) {
    throw new WebSearchError("The web search did not return readable results.");
  }

  const results = parseSearchResults(await response.text());
  if (results.length === 0) {
    throw new WebSearchError("The web search did not return usable results.");
  }

  const context = [
    "Public web search results fetched for this request only:",
    `Query: ${request.query}`,
    ...results.map((result, index) => [
      `${index + 1}. ${result.title}`,
      `URL: ${result.url}`,
      result.snippet ? `Snippet: ${result.snippet}` : null,
    ].filter(Boolean).join("\n")),
    `Limits: these are bounded search-result snippets, not full webpages. Timeout: ${WEB_SEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Max results: ${WEB_SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS}. If the results disagree or do not prove the claim, say so plainly.`,
  ].join("\n\n");

  return context.slice(0, MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS);
}

import { lookup as dnsLookup } from "node:dns/promises";
import { isIP } from "node:net";

const LOOPBACK_HOSTS = new Set(["127.0.0.1", "::1", "localhost"]);
export const WEBPAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 6_000;
export const WEBPAGE_MAX_PAGE_CHARS = 12_000;
export const WEBPAGE_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS = 3_500;
export const WEBPAGE_MAX_REDIRECTS = 3;
const ACCEPTED_CONTENT_TYPES = [
  "text/html",
  "application/xhtml+xml",
  "text/plain",
];

const REDIRECT_STATUSES =
  new Set([301, 302, 303, 307, 308]);

async function readBoundedResponseText(
  response,
  maxCharacters,
) {
  const reader =
    response.body?.getReader?.();

  if (!reader) {
    return String(
      await response.text(),
    ).slice(0, maxCharacters);
  }

  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let text = "";

  try {
    while (text.length < maxCharacters) {
      const {
        done,
        value,
      } = await reader.read();

      if (done) break;

      text += decoder.decode(
        value,
        {
          stream: true,
        },
      );
    }

    text += decoder.decode();
  } finally {
    if (text.length >= maxCharacters) {
      await reader.cancel().catch(() => {});
    }
  }

  return text.slice(0, maxCharacters);
}

export class WebpageFetchError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "WebpageFetchError";
  }
}

function decodeEntities(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/&nbsp;/gi, " ")
    .replace(/&amp;/gi, "&")
    .replace(/&lt;/gi, "<")
    .replace(/&gt;/gi, ">")
    .replace(/&quot;/gi, "\"")
    .replace(/&#39;/gi, "'")
    .replace(/&#x27;/gi, "'")
    .replace(/&#x2F;/gi, "/")
    .replace(/&#(\d+);/g, (_match, code) => String.fromCharCode(Number.parseInt(code, 10)))
    .replace(/&#x([0-9a-f]+);/gi, (_match, code) => String.fromCharCode(Number.parseInt(code, 16)));
}

function cleanText(value, maxLength = WEBPAGE_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS) {
  const normalized = decodeEntities(value)
    .replace(/\r/g, "\n")
    .replace(/\t/g, " ")
    .replace(/\u00a0/g, " ")
    .replace(/[ ]{2,}/g, " ")
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
    .trim();
  return normalized ? normalized.slice(0, maxLength) : "";
}

function htmlToText(html) {
  return cleanText(
    String(html ?? "")
      .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, " ")
      .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, " ")
      .replace(/<noscript\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/noscript>/gi, " ")
      .replace(/<svg\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/svg>/gi, " ")
      .replace(/<template\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/template>/gi, " ")
      .replace(/<iframe\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/iframe>/gi, " ")
      .replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, "\n")
      .replace(/<\/(?:p|div|section|article|li|ul|ol|h[1-6]|main|header|footer|nav|tr|table)>/gi, "\n")
      .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
      .slice(0, WEBPAGE_MAX_PAGE_CHARS),
  );
}

function extractTitle(html) {
  const match = String(html ?? "").match(/<title\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
  return cleanText(match?.[1] ?? "", 200);
}

function extractMetaDescription(html) {
  const source = String(html ?? "");
  const patterns = [
    /<meta\b[^>]*name=["']description["'][^>]*content=["']([\s\S]*?)["'][^>]*>/i,
    /<meta\b[^>]*content=["']([\s\S]*?)["'][^>]*name=["']description["'][^>]*>/i,
  ];
  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    const match = source.match(pattern);
    const value = cleanText(match?.[1] ?? "", 300);
    if (value) return value;
  }
  return "";
}

function isPrivateIpv4(address) {
  const parts = address.split(".").map((value) => Number.parseInt(value, 10));
  if (parts.length !== 4 || parts.some((value) => !Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0 || value > 255)) {
    return true;
  }

  const [first, second] = parts;
  return first === 10
    || first === 127
    || first === 0
    || (first === 169 && second === 254)
    || (first === 172 && second >= 16 && second <= 31)
    || (first === 192 && second === 168)
    || (first === 100 && second >= 64 && second <= 127);
}

function isPrivateIpv6(address) {
  const normalized = address.toLowerCase();
  return normalized === "::1"
    || normalized.startsWith("fc")
    || normalized.startsWith("fd")
    || normalized.startsWith("fe8")
    || normalized.startsWith("fe9")
    || normalized.startsWith("fea")
    || normalized.startsWith("feb")
    || normalized.startsWith("::ffff:127.")
    || normalized.startsWith("::ffff:10.")
    || normalized.startsWith("::ffff:192.168.")
    || /^::ffff:172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[0-1])\./.test(normalized);
}

function isPrivateAddress(address) {
  const family = isIP(address);
  if (family === 4) return isPrivateIpv4(address);
  if (family === 6) return isPrivateIpv6(address);
  return true;
}

async function ensurePublicUrl(url, resolveHostname = dnsLookup, allowedDomains = []) {
  let parsed;

  try {
    parsed = new URL(url);
  } catch {
    throw new WebpageFetchError("That webpage URL is invalid.");
  }

  if (!new Set(["http:", "https:"]).has(parsed.protocol)) {
    throw new WebpageFetchError("Only public HTTP or HTTPS webpages can be read.");
  }

  const hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (!hostname || LOOPBACK_HOSTS.has(hostname) || hostname.endsWith(".local")) {
    throw new WebpageFetchError("Local or private webpages are not allowed.");
  }

  if (Array.isArray(allowedDomains) && allowedDomains.length > 0) {
    const allowed = allowedDomains.some((domain) => {
      const normalized = String(domain ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
      return normalized
        && (hostname === normalized || hostname.endsWith(`.${normalized}`));
    });
    if (!allowed) {
      throw new WebpageFetchError("That domain is not in the trusted allowlist.");
    }
  }

  if (isIP(hostname)) {
    if (isPrivateAddress(hostname)) {
      throw new WebpageFetchError("Local or private webpages are not allowed.");
    }
    return parsed.toString();
  }

  let resolved;
  try {
    resolved = await resolveHostname(hostname, { all: true });
  } catch {
    throw new WebpageFetchError("That webpage host could not be resolved.");
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(resolved) || resolved.length === 0) {
    throw new WebpageFetchError("That webpage host could not be resolved.");
  }

  if (resolved.some((entry) => isPrivateAddress(entry.address))) {
    throw new WebpageFetchError("Local or private webpages are not allowed.");
  }

  return parsed.toString();
}

function extractUrl(question) {
  return String(question ?? "").match(/https?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+/i)?.[0] ?? "";
}

export function extractWebpageRequest(question) {
  const text = String(question ?? "").trim();
  if (!text) return null;

  const url = extractUrl(text);
  if (!url) return null;

  const withoutUrl = text.replace(url, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  const explicitReadIntent = /\b(?:read|check|open|visit|look(?:\s+at)?|see|summari[sz]e|review|scan|tell me|what(?:'s| is)|does .+ say|from this (?:page|webpage|website|article|link|url)|about this (?:page|webpage|website|article|link|url)|webpage|website|article|page|link|url)\b/i.test(withoutUrl);

  if (!withoutUrl) {
    return { url };
  }

  if (explicitReadIntent || /\?/.test(withoutUrl)) {
    return { url };
  }

  return null;
}

export async function fetchWebpageContext(
  question,
  {
    fetchImpl = fetch,
    resolveHostname = dnsLookup,
    allowedDomains = [],
  } = {},
) {
  const request = extractWebpageRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const timeoutSignal = AbortSignal.timeout(
    WEBPAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS,
  );

  let publicUrl = request.url;
  let response;

  for (
    let redirectCount = 0;
    redirectCount <= WEBPAGE_MAX_REDIRECTS;
    redirectCount += 1
  ) {
    publicUrl = await ensurePublicUrl(
      publicUrl,
      resolveHostname,
      allowedDomains,
    );

    try {
      response = await fetchImpl(publicUrl, {
        headers: {
          accept:
            "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,text/plain;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.1",
        },
        redirect: "manual",
        signal: timeoutSignal,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      throw new WebpageFetchError(
        error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        || error?.name === "AbortError"
          ? "Reading that webpage timed out."
          : "That webpage could not be read right now.",
      );
    }

    if (
      !REDIRECT_STATUSES.has(
        response.status,
      )
    ) {
      break;
    }

    if (
      redirectCount
      === WEBPAGE_MAX_REDIRECTS
    ) {
      throw new WebpageFetchError(
        "That webpage redirected too many times.",
      );
    }

    const location =
      response.headers?.get?.("location");

    if (!location) {
      throw new WebpageFetchError(
        "That webpage returned an invalid redirect.",
      );
    }

    publicUrl = new URL(
      location,
      publicUrl,
    ).toString();
  }

  if (!response?.ok) {
    throw new WebpageFetchError(
      `That webpage returned HTTP ${
        response?.status ?? "unknown"
      }.`,
    );
  }

  const contentType = String(response.headers?.get?.("content-type") ?? "").toLowerCase();
  if (contentType && !ACCEPTED_CONTENT_TYPES.some((value) => contentType.includes(value))) {
    throw new WebpageFetchError("That URL does not look like a readable webpage.");
  }

  const raw =
    await readBoundedResponseText(
      response,
      WEBPAGE_MAX_PAGE_CHARS,
    );
  const title = extractTitle(raw);
  const description = extractMetaDescription(raw);
  const text = contentType.includes("text/plain")
    ? cleanText(raw)
    : htmlToText(raw);

  const lines = [
    "Public webpage extract fetched for this request only:",
    `URL: ${publicUrl}`,
    title ? `Title: ${title}` : null,
    description ? `Description: ${description}` : null,
    text ? `Page extract:\n${text}` : null,
    `Limits: this is a bounded extract, not the whole page. Timeout: ${WEBPAGE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. If the needed detail is absent, say the extract did not show it.`,
  ].filter(Boolean);

  return lines.join("\n");
}
