export const WIKIDATA_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 6_000;
export const WIKIDATA_MAX_RESULTS = 3;
const WIKIDATA_SEARCH_API = "https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php";
const WIKIDATA_ENTITY_DATA_API = "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Special:EntityData";
const WIKIDATA_USER_AGENT = "discord-bot-server/1.0 (+https://github.com/kyriakidisdimitrios/discord-bot-server)";

export class WikidataContextError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "WikidataContextError";
  }
}

function cleanText(value, maxLength = 280) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
}

function normalizeQuery(value) {
  return cleanText(value, 220);
}

function stripExplicitWikidataPrompt(text) {
  let query = String(text ?? "").trim();

  const patterns = [
    /^(?:please\s+)?search\s+wikidata\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?look\s+up\s+(?:on\s+)?wikidata\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?check\s+wikidata\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+|on\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?what\s+does\s+wikidata\s+say\s+about\s+/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?wikidata\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
  ];

  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    query = query.replace(pattern, "");
  }

  query = query
    .replace(/\bon\s+wikidata\b/gi, "")
    .replace(/[?]+$/g, "")
    .trim();

  return normalizeQuery(query);
}

export function extractWikidataRequest(question) {
  const text = cleanText(question, 500);
  if (!text) return null;
  if (!/\bwikidata\b/i.test(text)) return null;

  const query = stripExplicitWikidataPrompt(text);
  if (!query) return null;

  return { query };
}

async function fetchJson(url, fetchImpl) {
  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(url, {
      headers: {
        accept: "application/json",
        "user-agent": WIKIDATA_USER_AGENT,
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(WIKIDATA_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new WikidataContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "The Wikidata lookup timed out."
        : "The Wikidata lookup could not be completed right now.",
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new WikidataContextError(`The Wikidata lookup returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

function summarizeSearchResult(entry) {
  const id = cleanText(entry?.id ?? "", 20);
  const label = cleanText(entry?.label ?? "", 120);
  const description = cleanText(entry?.description ?? "", 220);
  const url = cleanText(entry?.concepturi ?? "", 260);
  return [
    `- ${label || "Unlabeled entity"}`,
    id ? `ID ${id}` : null,
    description ? description : null,
    url ? `URL ${url}` : null,
  ].filter(Boolean).join(" | ");
}

function firstAliasList(entity) {
  const aliases = Array.isArray(entity?.aliases?.en)
    ? entity.aliases.en
    : [];
  return aliases
    .slice(0, 5)
    .map((entry) => cleanText(entry?.value ?? "", 80))
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(", ");
}

function firstSitelink(entity, key) {
  return cleanText(entity?.sitelinks?.[key]?.title ?? "", 140);
}

export async function fetchWikidataContext(
  question,
  {
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  } = {},
) {
  const request = extractWikidataRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const searchUrl = new URL(WIKIDATA_SEARCH_API);
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("action", "wbsearchentities");
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("format", "json");
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("language", "en");
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("limit", String(WIKIDATA_MAX_RESULTS));
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("search", request.query);

  const searchPayload = await fetchJson(searchUrl, fetchImpl);
  const results = Array.isArray(searchPayload?.search)
    ? searchPayload.search.slice(0, WIKIDATA_MAX_RESULTS)
    : [];

  if (results.length === 0) {
    throw new WikidataContextError("Wikidata did not return a matching entity.");
  }

  const topResult = results[0];
  const entityId = cleanText(topResult?.id ?? "", 20);
  const entityUrl = `${WIKIDATA_ENTITY_DATA_API}/${encodeURIComponent(entityId)}.json`;
  const entityPayload = await fetchJson(entityUrl, fetchImpl);
  const entity = entityPayload?.entities?.[entityId] ?? {};

  const aliases = firstAliasList(entity);
  const englishWikipedia = firstSitelink(entity, "enwiki");
  const commons = firstSitelink(entity, "commonswiki");
  const lines = [
    "Wikidata data fetched for this request only:",
    `Query: ${request.query}`,
    entityId ? `Top entity ID: ${entityId}` : null,
    topResult?.label ? `Label: ${cleanText(topResult.label, 140)}` : null,
    topResult?.description
      ? `Description: ${cleanText(topResult.description, 220)}`
      : null,
    topResult?.concepturi
      ? `Concept URL: ${cleanText(topResult.concepturi, 260)}`
      : null,
    aliases ? `Aliases: ${aliases}` : null,
    englishWikipedia ? `English Wikipedia title: ${englishWikipedia}` : null,
    commons ? `Commons title: ${commons}` : null,
    `Search results:\n${results.map(summarizeSearchResult).join("\n")}`,
    `Limits: timeout ${WIKIDATA_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Results ${WIKIDATA_MAX_RESULTS}. Use only this bounded Wikidata snapshot.`,
  ];

  return lines.filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
}

export const WIKIPEDIA_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 6_000;
export const WIKIPEDIA_MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS = 3;

const WIKIPEDIA_REST_API = "https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1";
const WIKIPEDIA_USER_AGENT = "discord-bot-server/1.0 (+https://github.com/kyriakidisdimitrios/discord-bot-server)";

export class WikipediaContextError extends Error {
  constructor(message) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "WikipediaContextError";
  }
}

function cleanText(value, maxLength = 280) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);
}

function normalizeQuery(value) {
  return cleanText(value, 220);
}

function stripExplicitWikipediaPrompt(text) {
  let query = String(text ?? "").trim();

  const patterns = [
    /^(?:please\s+)?search\s+wikipedia\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?look\s+up\s+(?:on\s+)?wikipedia\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?check\s+wikipedia\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+|on\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?what\s+does\s+wikipedia\s+say\s+about\s+/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?who\s+is\s+(.+?)\s+on\s+wikipedia$/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?what\s+is\s+(.+?)\s+on\s+wikipedia$/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?wikipedia\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
    /^(?:please\s+)?wikimedia\s+(?:for\s+|about\s+)?/i,
  ];

  for (const pattern of patterns) {
    const match = query.match(pattern);
    if (match?.[1]) {
      query = match[1];
      break;
    }
    query = query.replace(pattern, "");
  }

  query = query
    .replace(/\bon\s+wikipedia\b/gi, "")
    .replace(/\bon\s+wikimedia\b/gi, "")
    .replace(/[?]+$/g, "")
    .trim();

  return normalizeQuery(query);
}

export function extractWikipediaRequest(question) {
  const text = cleanText(question, 500);
  if (!text) return null;

  const explicitIntent =
    /\bwikipedia\b/i.test(text)
    || /\bwikimedia\b/i.test(text)
    || /\bwiki\b[\s\S]{0,30}\b(?:page|article|summary|search)\b/i.test(text);

  if (!explicitIntent) return null;

  const query = stripExplicitWikipediaPrompt(text);
  if (!query) return null;

  return { query };
}

async function fetchJson(url, fetchImpl) {
  let response;
  try {
    response = await fetchImpl(url, {
      headers: {
        accept: "application/json",
        "user-agent": WIKIPEDIA_USER_AGENT,
      },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(WIKIPEDIA_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new WikipediaContextError(
      error?.name === "TimeoutError"
        ? "The Wikipedia lookup timed out."
        : "The Wikipedia lookup could not be completed right now.",
    );
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    if (response.status === 404) {
      throw new WikipediaContextError("That Wikipedia page was not found.");
    }
    throw new WikipediaContextError(`The Wikipedia lookup returned HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

function summarizeSearchResults(payload) {
  const results = Array.isArray(payload?.query?.search)
    ? payload.query.search.slice(0, WIKIPEDIA_MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS)
    : [];

  return results.map((entry) => {
    const title = cleanText(entry?.title ?? "", 120);
    const snippet = cleanText(entry?.snippet ?? "", 220)
      .replace(/&quot;/g, "\"")
      .replace(/&#39;/g, "'");
    const pageId = cleanText(entry?.pageid ?? "", 20);
    return `- ${title || "Untitled"}${pageId ? ` | pageid ${pageId}` : ""}${snippet ? ` | ${snippet}` : ""}`;
  });
}

export async function fetchWikipediaContext(
  question,
  {
    fetchImpl = fetch,
  } = {},
) {
  const request = extractWikipediaRequest(question);
  if (!request) return "";

  const searchUrl = new URL(WIKIPEDIA_ACTION_API);
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("action", "query");
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("format", "json");
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("list", "search");
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("srsearch", request.query);
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("srlimit", String(WIKIPEDIA_MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS));
  searchUrl.searchParams.set("srprop", "snippet");

  const searchPayload = await fetchJson(searchUrl, fetchImpl);
  const topResult = Array.isArray(searchPayload?.query?.search)
    ? searchPayload.query.search[0]
    : null;

  if (!topResult?.title) {
    throw new WikipediaContextError("Wikipedia did not return a matching article.");
  }

  const summaryUrl = `${WIKIPEDIA_REST_API}/page/summary/${encodeURIComponent(topResult.title)}`;
  const summaryPayload = await fetchJson(summaryUrl, fetchImpl);
  const lines = [
    "Wikipedia data fetched for this request only:",
    `Query: ${request.query}`,
    `Top article: ${cleanText(summaryPayload?.title ?? topResult.title, 140)}`,
    summaryPayload?.content_urls?.desktop?.page
      ? `Article URL: ${cleanText(summaryPayload.content_urls.desktop.page, 260)}`
      : null,
    summaryPayload?.description
      ? `Description: ${cleanText(summaryPayload.description, 180)}`
      : null,
    summaryPayload?.extract
      ? `Summary: ${cleanText(summaryPayload.extract, 900)}`
      : "Summary: not returned.",
  ];

  const resultLines = summarizeSearchResults(searchPayload);
  if (resultLines.length > 0) {
    lines.push(`Search results:\n${resultLines.join("\n")}`);
  }

  lines.push(
    `Limits: timeout ${WIKIPEDIA_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS}ms. Search results ${WIKIPEDIA_MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS}. Use only this bounded Wikipedia snapshot.`,
  );

  return lines.filter(Boolean).join("\n\n");
}

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS,
  resolveAiRoute,
} from "../src/ai-routing.js";

const ALLOWED_MODELS = [
  "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
  "yoanndev90/llama-3.1-8b-fast:free",
  "yoanndev90/laguna-s-2.1:free",
  "yoanndev90/gemma-4-31b:free",
];

test("resolveAiRoute keeps Groq on the configured model", () => {
  const route = resolveAiRoute({
    provider: "groq",
    configuredModel: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
    allowedModels: ALLOWED_MODELS,
    question: "How do I install Legend Mod?",
  });

  assert.equal(route.provider, "groq");
  assert.equal(route.model, "openai/gpt-oss-20b");
  assert.equal(route.routingEnabled, false);
});

test("resolveAiRoute sends simple Pollinations chat to the chat model", () => {
  const route = resolveAiRoute({
    provider: "pollinations",
    configuredModel: "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
    allowedModels: ALLOWED_MODELS,
    routeModels: DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS,
    question: "How do I install Legend Mod on Firefox?",
    routing: { intent: "new_question" },
  });

  assert.equal(route.profile, "chat");
  assert.equal(route.model, "yoanndev90/llama-3.1-8b-fast:free");
  assert.equal(route.routingEnabled, true);
});

test("resolveAiRoute sends coding questions to the coding model", () => {
  const route = resolveAiRoute({
    provider: "pollinations",
    configuredModel: "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
    allowedModels: ALLOWED_MODELS,
    routeModels: DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS,
    question: "Fix this websocket bug in index.js and explain the code path.",
    routing: { intent: "new_question" },
  });

  assert.equal(route.profile, "code");
  assert.equal(route.model, "yoanndev90/laguna-s-2.1:free");
});

test("resolveAiRoute sends live or research questions to the reasoning model", () => {
  const route = resolveAiRoute({
    provider: "pollinations",
    configuredModel: "yoanndev90/llama-3.1-8b-fast:free",
    allowedModels: ALLOWED_MODELS,
    routeModels: DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS,
    question: "How many LM players are online now and which servers are active?",
    routing: { intent: "live_data_request" },
  });

  assert.equal(route.profile, "reasoning");
  assert.equal(route.model, "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free");
});

test("resolveAiRoute falls back when a preferred route model is not allowed", () => {
  const route = resolveAiRoute({
    provider: "pollinations",
    configuredModel: "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
    allowedModels: [
      "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
      "yoanndev90/llama-3.1-8b-fast:free",

    routeModels: DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_ROUTE_MODELS,

    routing: { intent: "new_question" },
  });

});

import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { validateAnswer } from "../src/answer-validator.js";

test("validateAnswer sanitizes @everyone and role mentions", () => {
  const result = validateAnswer("Hello @everyone and <@&123456789>!");
  assert.equal(result.cleanAnswer, "Hello @everyone-disabled and @role!");
  assert.ok(result.issues.includes("sanitized_mentions"));
});

test("validateAnswer removes unextracted LEARN markers", () => {
  const result = validateAnswer("Legend Mod is awesome <!--LEARN:{\"action\":\"store\"}-->");
  assert.equal(result.cleanAnswer, "Legend Mod is awesome");
  assert.ok(result.issues.includes("unextracted_learn_marker"));
});

test("validateAnswer handles OFF_TOPIC redirect", () => {
  const result = validateAnswer("OFF_TOPIC: I cannot answer that");
  assert.ok(result.cleanAnswer.includes("I mainly help here with Legend Mod"));
  assert.ok(result.issues.includes("off_topic_redirect"));
});

test("validateAnswer deduplicates consecutive identical paragraphs", () => {
  const result = validateAnswer("Paragraph 1\n\nParagraph 1\n\nParagraph 2");
  assert.equal(result.cleanAnswer, "Paragraph 1\n\nParagraph 2");
  assert.ok(result.issues.includes("duplicate_paragraph_removed"));
});

function interaction(userId = "user-1", question = "What is FFA?", extra = {}) {
  return {
    id: "interaction-1",
    member: { user: { id: userId } },
    data: { options: [{ name: "question", value: question }] },
    ...extra,
  };
}

function groqResponse(answer) {
  return {
    ok: true,
    status: 200,
    headers: new Headers(),
    json: async () => ({ choices: [{ message: { content: answer } }] }),
  };
}

test("ask grounds explicit Downdetector outage questions with enterprise data", async () => {
  let groqBody;
  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "is discord down in greece right now?"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      downdetectorApiToken: "dd-token",
      fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
        if (String(url).includes("/companies/search")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            json: async () => ([
              {
                id: 321,
                name: "Discord",
                slug: "discord",
                url: "https://downdetector.com/status/discord/",
                country_iso: "GR",
              },
            ]),
          };
        }

        if (String(url).includes("/companies/321/status")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            json: async () => "danger",
          };
        }

        if (String(url).includes("/companies/321/last_15")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            json: async () => 428,
          };
        }

        if (String(url).includes("/companies/321?")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            json: async () => ({
              id: 321,
              name: "Discord",
              slug: "discord",
              url: "https://downdetector.com/status/discord/",
              country_iso: "GR",
              description: "Voice, chat, and community platform.",
              status: "warning",
              baseline_current: 23,
              stats_24: [12, 21, 390],
            }),
          };
        }

        groqBody = JSON.parse(options.body);
        return groqResponse("Downdetector currently shows Discord in danger status in Greece.");
      },
    },
  );

  const prompt = groqBody.messages[0].content;
  assert.match(prompt, /Downdetector Enterprise data fetched for this request only/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Current status endpoint: danger/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Reports in last 15 minutes: 428/);
  assert.equal(
    response.embeds[0].description,
    "Downdetector currently shows Discord in danger status in Greece.",
  );
});

test("ask routes Pollinations image questions to the vision model and sends image content", async () => {
  let request;

  await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "what is in this screenshot?", {
      data: {
        options: [
          { name: "question", value: "what is in this screenshot?" },
          { name: "image", value: "attachment-1" },
        ],
        resolved: {
          attachments: {
            "attachment-1": {
              id: "attachment-1",
              url: "https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/example/screenshot.png",
              content_type: "image/png",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    }),
    {
      aiProvider: "pollinations",
      pollinationsApiKey: "pollinations-key",
      model: "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
      pollinationsAllowedModels: [
        "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
        "yoanndev90/llama-3.1-8b-fast:free",
        "yoanndev90/laguna-s-2.1:free",
        "yoanndev90/gemma-4-31b:free",
      ],
      pollinationsRouteModels: {
        chat: "yoanndev90/llama-3.1-8b-fast:free",
        reasoning: "vendouple/nemotron-3-ultra:free",
        code: "yoanndev90/laguna-s-2.1:free",
        vision: "yoanndev90/gemma-4-31b:free",
      },
      requesterContext: "The requester is an official LC member.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
        request = { url, options };
        return groqResponse("It looks like a game screenshot.");
      },
    },
  );

  const body = JSON.parse(request.options.body);
  assert.equal(body.model, "yoanndev90/gemma-4-31b:free");
  assert.equal(body.reasoning_effort, "medium");
  assert.deepEqual(body.messages.at(-1).content, [
    { type: "text", text: "what is in this screenshot?" },
    {
      type: "image_url",
      image_url: { url: "https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/example/screenshot.png" },
    },
  ]);
});

test("ask does not attach cached images to unrelated questions", async () => {
  let request;
  const recentImageMemory = new RecentImageMemory({ ttlMs: 60_000, maxImages: 4 });

  recentImageMemory.rememberImages({
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelId: "chan-1",
    userId: "user-1",
    imageUrls: ["https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/example/screenshot.png"],
  });

  await buildAskMessageFromText("how much mass does food have?", {
    aiProvider: "groq",
    apiKey: "groq-key",

test("ask understands EL shorthand for explicit live Expanding Land requests", async () => {
  let statusRequests = 0;
  let groqBody;

  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "how many players are online on EL now?"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is an official LC member.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      gameStatusUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status",
      gamePlayingCapacity: 1_024,
      gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
      gameBotCount: 960,
      fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
        if (url === "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status") {
          statusRequests += 1;
          return {
            ok: true,
            json: async () => ({
              status: "online",
              alive: 100,
              connected: 105,
              spectators: 2,
              food: 10_000,
              viruses: 220,
              uptime: 10,
              map_scale: 800,
              version: "1.2.62",
            }),
          };
        }

        groqBody = JSON.parse(options.body);
        return groqResponse("Expanding Land currently shows 100 players online.");
      },
    },
  );

  assert.equal(statusRequests, 1);
  assert.match(groqBody.messages[0].content, /EL = Expanding Land/);
  assert.match(groqBody.messages[0].content, /Players: 100\/1,024/);
  assert.equal(response.embeds[0].description, "Expanding Land currently shows 100 players online.");
});

test("ask grounds Legend Mod player questions with live websocket data", async () => {
  let groqBody;

  class LegendModWebSocket {
    constructor() {
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.onmessage?.({
          data: JSON.stringify({
            type: "players_list",
            data: JSON.stringify([
              {
                nickname: "Alpha",
                tag: "LC",
                server: "wss://snez.org/ws?r=eu-west&m=:party",
                hidecountry: false,
                extra: { ip_info: { country: "gr" } },
              },
              {
                nickname: "Beta",
                tag: "",
                server: "wss://snez.org/ws?r=us-east&m=:ffa",
                hidecountry: true,
                extra: { ip_info: { country: "us" } },
              },
            ]),
          }),
        });
      }, 0);
    }

    close() {}
  }

  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "how many players play legend mod now and what names are online?"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is an official LC member. You may assume familiarity with LC basics, but do not reveal omitted or private information.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      legendModWebSocketCtor: LegendModWebSocket,
      fetchImpl: async (_url, options) => {
        groqBody = JSON.parse(options.body);
        return groqResponse("Legend Mod currently shows 2 players online: Alpha and Beta.");
      },
    },
  );

  const prompt = groqBody.messages[0].content;
  assert.match(prompt, /Legend Mod player data fetched live from the Snez websocket feed/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Tracked Legend Mod players online: 2/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Visible player names \(2 shown\): Alpha, Beta/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Distinct servers: 2/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Nick: Alpha \| Tag: LC/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Country: hidden/);
  assert.match(prompt, /never invent hidden or omitted player names, tags, servers, or countries/i);
  assert.equal(
    response.embeds[0].description,
    "Legend Mod currently shows 2 players online: Alpha and Beta.",
  );
});

      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),

          return {
            ok: true,

  );

test("ask grounds explicit GitHub repo questions with bounded public API data", async () => {
  let groqBody;
  const fetchCalls = [];

  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "show me the latest commits and open issues for repo openai/openai-node"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
        fetchCalls.push(String(url));

        if (String(url) === "https://api.github.com/repos/openai/openai-node/commits?per_page=3") {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ([
              {
                sha: "abcdef123456",
                html_url: "https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/abcdef1",
                commit: {
                  message: "Fix response parsing\n\nMore details",
                  author: { date: "2026-07-25T10:00:00Z" },
                },
              },
            ]),
          };
        }

        if (String(url) === "https://api.github.com/repos/openai/openai-node/issues?state=open&per_page=5") {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ([
              {
                number: 101,
                title: "Connection drops on retries",
                state: "open",
                html_url: "https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/101",
              },
            ]),
          };
        }

        groqBody = JSON.parse(options.body);
        return groqResponse("The GitHub snapshot shows a recent parsing fix and one open retry issue.");
      },
    },
  );

  const prompt = groqBody.messages[0].content;
  assert.deepEqual(fetchCalls.slice(0, 2), [
    "https://api.github.com/repos/openai/openai-node/commits?per_page=3",
    "https://api.github.com/repos/openai/openai-node/issues?state=open&per_page=5",
  ]);
  assert.match(prompt, /Public GitHub API data fetched for this request only/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Repository: openai\/openai-node/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Recent commits:/);
  assert.match(prompt, /abcdef1 \| Fix response parsing \| 2026-07-25T10:00:00Z/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Open issues:/);
  assert.match(prompt, /#101 \| Connection drops on retries \| open/);
  assert.equal(
    response.embeds[0].description,
    "The GitHub snapshot shows a recent parsing fix and one open retry issue.",
  );
});

test("ask grounds explicit Wikipedia questions with a bounded Wikimedia snapshot", async () => {
  let groqBody;
  const fetchCalls = [];

  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "what does wikipedia say about Alan Turing?"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
        fetchCalls.push(String(url));

        if (String(url).startsWith("https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ({
              query: {
                search: [
                  {
                    title: "Alan Turing",
                    pageid: 736,
                    snippet: "English mathematician and computer scientist.",
                  },
                ],
              },
            }),
          };
        }

        if (String(url) === "https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/Alan%20Turing") {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ({
              title: "Alan Turing",
              description: "English mathematician and logician",
              extract: "Alan Turing was a pioneering computer scientist.",
              content_urls: {
                desktop: {
                  page: "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alan_Turing",
                },
              },
            }),
          };
        }

        groqBody = JSON.parse(options.body);
        return groqResponse("Wikipedia describes Alan Turing as an English mathematician and a pioneering computer scientist.");
      },
    },
  );

  const prompt = groqBody.messages[0].content;
  assert.deepEqual(fetchCalls.slice(0, 2), [
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&format=json&list=search&srsearch=Alan+Turing&srlimit=3&srprop=snippet",
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/Alan%20Turing",
  ]);
  assert.match(prompt, /USE Wikipedia lookup/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Wikipedia data fetched for this request:/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Wikipedia data fetched for this request only:/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Query: Alan Turing/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Top article: Alan Turing/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Description: English mathematician and logician/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Summary: Alan Turing was a pioneering computer scientist\./);
  assert.equal(
    response.embeds[0].description,
    "Wikipedia describes Alan Turing as an English mathematician and a pioneering computer scientist.",
  );
});

test("ask grounds explicit Wikidata questions with a bounded entity snapshot", async () => {
  let groqBody;
  const fetchCalls = [];

  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "search wikidata for Alan Turing"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
        fetchCalls.push(String(url));

        if (String(url).startsWith("https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php?")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ({
              search: [
                {
                  id: "Q7251",
                  label: "Alan Turing",
                  description: "English mathematician and computer scientist",
                  concepturi: "https://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q7251",
                },
              ],
            }),
          };
        }

        if (String(url) === "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Special:EntityData/Q7251.json") {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ({
              entities: {
                Q7251: {
                  aliases: {
                    en: [{ value: "A. M. Turing" }],
                  },
                  sitelinks: {
                    enwiki: { title: "Alan Turing" },
                  },
                },
              },
            }),
          };
        }

        groqBody = JSON.parse(options.body);
        return groqResponse("Wikidata identifies Alan Turing as entity Q7251 and describes him as an English mathematician and computer scientist.");
      },
    },
  );

  const prompt = groqBody.messages[0].content;
  assert.deepEqual(fetchCalls.slice(0, 2), [
    "https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php?action=wbsearchentities&format=json&language=en&limit=3&search=Alan+Turing",
    "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Special:EntityData/Q7251.json",
  ]);
  assert.match(prompt, /USE Wikidata lookup/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Wikidata data fetched for this request:/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Top entity ID: Q7251/);
  assert.equal(
    response.embeds[0].description,

  );
});

test("ask grounds explicit Crossref questions with a bounded metadata snapshot", async () => {
  let groqBody;
  const fetchCalls = [];

  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "search crossref for attention is all you need"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
        fetchCalls.push(String(url));

        if (String(url).startsWith("https://api.crossref.org/works?")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ({
              message: {
                items: [
                  {
                    DOI: "10.5555/attention",
                    title: ["Attention Is All You Need"],
                    author: [
                      { given: "Ashish", family: "Vaswani" },
                      { given: "Noam", family: "Shazeer" },
                    ],
                    publisher: "NeurIPS",
                    type: "proceedings-article",
                    URL: "https://doi.org/10.5555/attention",
                    issued: { "date-parts": [[2017, 6, 12]] },
                    "container-title": ["Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems"],
                  },
                ],
              },
            }),
          };
        }

        groqBody = JSON.parse(options.body);
        return groqResponse("Crossref lists Attention Is All You Need as a 2017 proceedings article with DOI 10.5555/attention.");
      },
    },
  );

  const prompt = groqBody.messages[0].content;
  assert.deepEqual(fetchCalls.slice(0, 1), [
    "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=attention+is+all+you+need&rows=3&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cauthor%2Cpublisher%2Ctype%2CURL%2Cissued%2Cpublished%2Ccontainer-title",
  ]);
  assert.match(prompt, /USE Crossref lookup/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Crossref data fetched for this request:/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Crossref data fetched for this request only:/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Query: attention is all you need/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Top work: Attention Is All You Need/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Top DOI: 10.5555\/attention/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Journal or container: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems/);
  assert.equal(
    response.embeds[0].description,
    "Crossref lists Attention Is All You Need as a 2017 proceedings article with DOI 10.5555/attention.",
  );
});

test("ask returns a clean error when a GitHub repo is not found", async () => {

  const response = await buildAskMessage(

    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      fetchImpl: async (url) => {
        if (String(url).includes("groq")) {
          groqCalls += 1;
          return groqResponse("This should not run.");
        }

        return {
          ok: false,
          status: 404,
          headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
          json: async () => ({ message: "Not Found" }),
        };
      },
    },
  );

  assert.equal(groqCalls, 0);
  assert.equal(response.content, "That GitHub repository or resource was not found.");
});

  const response = await buildAskMessage(

    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
        if (String(url).startsWith("https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }),
            text: async () => `
              <html><body>
                <a class="result__a" href="https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/legend-express/id123">Legend Express - Chrome Web Store</a>
                <a class="result__snippet">Install Legend Express directly from the Chrome Web Store.</a>
                <a class="result__a" href="https://www.legendmod.ml/">Legend Mod official site</a>
                <a class="result__snippet">Official Legend Mod links and install guidance.</a>
              </body></html>`,
          };

        groqBody = JSON.parse(options.body);

      },
    },
  );

  assert.match(prompt, /Public web search results fetched for this request/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Query: legend mod express is on the chrome web store/);

  assert.match(prompt, /https:\/\/chromewebstore\.google\.com\/detail\/legend-express\/id123/);
  assert.match(prompt, /Official Legend Mod links and install guidance\./);
  assert.equal(
    response.embeds[0].description,
    "Yes. The search results show Legend Express on the Chrome Web Store and also point to the official Legend Mod site.",
  );
});

test("ask blocks local or private webpage URLs without calling Groq", async () => {
  let groqCalls = 0;

  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "read this page http://127.0.0.1:8080/private"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      requesterContext: "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      fetchImpl: async (url) => {
        if (String(url).includes("groq")) {
          groqCalls += 1;
          return groqResponse("This should not run.");
        }
        throw new Error("web fetch should not run");
      },
    },
  );

  assert.equal(groqCalls, 0);
  assert.equal(response.content, "Local or private webpages are not allowed.");
});

        if (String(url).includes("groq")) {
          groqCalls += 1;
          return groqResponse("This should not run.");

        throw new Error("web fetch should not run");
      },
    },

});

test("members can start a live Delta chat watch from /lc", async () => {
  let started;

  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "show me the chat of this server: l4zfx0e"),
    {
      requesterContext: "The requester is an official LC member.",
      deltaChatWatcher: {
        async startWatch(input) {
          started = input;
          return {
            serverToken: "l4zfx0e",
            displayServer: "l4zfx0e",
            clanTag: "",
            watchChat: true,
            watchParticipants: false,
            replaced: false,
            replacedServerToken: null,
          };
        },
      },
    },
  );

  assert.deepEqual(started, {
    channelId: null,
    requesterId: "user-1",
    requesterName: "unknown",
    serverToken: "l4zfx0e",
    displayServer: "l4zfx0e",
    clanTag: "",
    durationMs: null,
    watchChat: true,
    watchParticipants: false,
  });
  assert.equal(
    response.content,
    "Starting a live Delta chat watch for `l4zfx0e` for up to 5 minutes. New chat and command lines will appear here as they arrive. Anyone can stop the current watch by asking to close or stop the Delta chat connection.",
  );
});

test("ask forwards continuity summaries when available", async () => {
  let request;

  await buildAskMessage(interaction("user-1", "and on firefox?"), {
    apiKey: "test-key",
    model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
    requesterContext: "The requester is an official LC member.",
    requesterIdentity: "Discord user ID: 123",
    discussionMemory: { contextFor() { return ""; } },
    userQuestionMemory: {
      keyFor() {
        return "summary-key";
      },
      messagesForKey() {
        return [
          { role: "user", content: "How do I install Legend Mod?" },
          { role: "assistant", content: "Use Tampermonkey first." },
        ];
      },
      continuitySummaryForKey() {
        return "Latest thread question: How do I install Legend Mod?\nRecurring thread terms: firefox, install";
      },
      async rememberByKey() {},
    },
    limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
    fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
      request = { url, options };
      return groqResponse("Use Tampermonkey on Firefox too.");
    },
  });

  const body = JSON.parse(request.options.body);
  assert.match(body.messages[0].content, /Recent requester thread summary/);
  assert.match(body.messages[0].content, /Recurring thread terms: firefox, install/);
});

});

test("extractLearnMarkers parses store markers and strips them from the answer", () => {
  const answer = 'Got it! I\'ll remember that.<!--LEARN:{"action":"store","subject":"AnotherZone","content":"Members admin","tags":["people"]}-->';
  const { cleanAnswer, markers } = extractLearnMarkers(answer);

  assert.equal(cleanAnswer, "Got it! I'll remember that.");
  assert.equal(markers.length, 1);
  assert.equal(markers[0].action, "store");
  assert.equal(markers[0].subject, "AnotherZone");
  assert.equal(markers[0].content, "Members admin");
  assert.deepEqual(markers[0].tags, ["people"]);
});

test("extractLearnMarkers parses delete markers", () => {
  const answer = 'Done, I\'ve forgotten that.<!--LEARN:{"action":"delete","subject":"OldTopic"}-->';
  const { cleanAnswer, markers } = extractLearnMarkers(answer);

  assert.equal(cleanAnswer, "Done, I've forgotten that.");
  assert.equal(markers.length, 1);
  assert.equal(markers[0].action, "delete");
  assert.equal(markers[0].subject, "OldTopic");
});

test("extractLearnMarkers ignores malformed JSON and answers without markers", () => {
  const noMarkers = extractLearnMarkers("Just a normal answer.");
  assert.equal(noMarkers.cleanAnswer, "Just a normal answer.");
  assert.equal(noMarkers.markers.length, 0);

  const badJson = extractLearnMarkers("Answer<!--LEARN:not json-->.");
  assert.equal(badJson.markers.length, 0);
  assert.equal(badJson.cleanAnswer, "Answer.");
});

test("ask processes LEARN markers and stores facts via communityKnowledge", async () => {
  let storedFact;
  const response = await buildAskMessage(
    interaction("user-1", "remember that Sky is a pro player"),
    {
      apiKey: "test-key",
      model: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
      limiter: new AskRateLimiter(),
      communityKnowledge: {
        contextFor() { return ""; },
        async store(subject, content, tags, inter) {
          storedFact = { subject, content, tags };
        },
      },
      fetchImpl: async () => groqResponse(
        'Got it!<!--LEARN:{"action":"store","subject":"Sky","content":"A pro player","tags":["people"]}-->',
      ),
    },
  );

  assert.equal(response.embeds[0].description, "Got it!");
  assert.deepEqual(storedFact, {
    subject: "Sky",
    content: "A pro player",
    tags: ["people"],
  });
});

function makeMessage({
  channelId = "qa-channel-id",
  authorId = "user-1",
  authorBot = false,
  content = "What key is popsplit?",
  guildId = "guild-1",
  type = 0,
  messageReference = undefined,
  mentions = [],
  attachments = [],
} = {}) {
  return {
    id: "msg-1",
    channel_id: channelId,
    guild_id: guildId,
    type,
    content,
    author: {
      id: authorId,
      bot: authorBot,
      username: "testuser",
      global_name: "Test User",
    },
    member: {
      nick: null,
      roles: [],
    },
    message_reference: messageReference,
    mentions,
    attachments,
  };
}

function makeAutoAnswer({
  channelId = "qa-channel-id",

      async describeFromMessage() {
        return "The requester is a Discord community visitor.";
      },
    },
    gameStatusUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status",
    gamePlayingCapacity: 1024,
    gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
    gameBotCount: 960,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: channelId, name: "questions-answers", type: 0 },
      { id: "other-channel", name: "general", type: 0 },
    ],
    sendMessage: async (_token, _channelId, body) => {
      sentMessages.push({ channelId: _channelId, body });
    },
    logger: { log() {}, warn() {} },
    ...extraOptions,
  });

  // Override the internal limiter fetchImpl so AI calls go through our mock
  if (fetchImpl) {
    // We need to replace how buildAnswerFromText calls fetch
    // The simplest approach: give the auto-answer a custom send that captures
    // For the test, we hook at the sendMessage level
  }

  return aa;
}

function groqResponse(answer) {
  return {
    ok: true,
    status: 200,
    headers: new Headers(),
    json: async () => ({ choices: [{ message: { content: answer } }] }),
  };
}

  await aa.resolveChannel();

  assert.equal(aa.shouldHandle(question), true);

test("auto-answer sends a reply with message_reference and no ping", async () => {
  const sentMessages = [];
  const aa = new AutoAnswer({
    token: "test-token",
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelName: "questions-answers",
    minLength: 10,
    groqApiKey: "test-key",
    groqModel: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
    requesterRoles: {
      async describeFromMessage() {
        return "The requester is a Discord community visitor.";
      },
    },
    gameStatusUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status",
    gamePlayingCapacity: 1024,
    gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
    gameBotCount: 960,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: "qa-channel-id", name: "questions-answers", type: 0 },
    ],
    sendMessage: async (_token, channelId, body) => {
      sentMessages.push({ channelId, body });
    },
    logger: { log() {}, warn() {} },
  });

  // Patch global fetch for the Groq call
  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  globalThis.fetch = async (url) => {
    if (url.includes("groq")) {
      return groqResponse("Alt+Q is the popsplit key.");
    }
    // Game status endpoint
    return { ok: false, status: 500 };
  };

  try {
    await aa.resolveChannel();
    await aa.handle(makeMessage());

    assert.equal(sentMessages.length, 1);
    const sent = sentMessages[0];
    assert.equal(sent.channelId, "qa-channel-id");
    assert.equal(sent.body.message_reference.message_id, "msg-1");
    assert.equal(sent.body.allowed_mentions.replied_user, false);
    assert.equal(sent.body.embeds[0].description, "Alt+Q is the popsplit key.");
    assert.equal(sent.body.embeds[0].color, 0xf55036);
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = originalFetch;
  }
});

test("explicit /lc can start a Delta chat watch across rooms", async () => {
  const sentMessages = [];
  let started;
  const aa = makeAutoAnswer({
    sentMessages,
    extraOptions: {
      requesterRoles: {
        async describeFromMessage() {
          return "The requester is an official LC member.";
        },
      },
      deltaChatWatcher: {
        async startWatch(input) {
          started = input;
          return {
            serverToken: "l4zfx0e",
            displayServer: "l4zfx0e",
            clanTag: "",
            replaced: false,
            replacedServerToken: null,
          };
        },
      },
    },
  });

  await aa.resolveChannel();
  await aa.handle(makeMessage({
    channelId: "other-channel",
    content: "/lc show me the chat of this server: l4zfx0e dont use tag",
  }));

  assert.deepEqual(started, {
    channelId: "other-channel",
    requesterId: "user-1",
    requesterName: "testuser",
    serverToken: "l4zfx0e",
    displayServer: "l4zfx0e",
    clanTag: "",
    durationMs: null,
    watchChat: true,
    watchParticipants: false,
  });
  assert.equal(sentMessages.length, 1);
  assert.match(sentMessages[0].body.content, /Starting a live Delta chat watch for `l4zfx0e`/);
});

test("plain stop wording can close the active Delta chat watch in the same room", async () => {
  const sentMessages = [];
  let stopCall;
  const aa = makeAutoAnswer({
    sentMessages,
    extraOptions: {
      deltaChatWatcher: {
        isActiveInChannel(channelId) {
          return channelId === "other-channel";
        },
        status() {
          return {
            displayServer: "l4zfx0e",
          };
        },
        async stop(reason, options) {
          stopCall = { reason, options };
        },
      },
    },
  });

  await aa.resolveChannel();
  await aa.handle(makeMessage({
    channelId: "other-channel",
    content: "close the delta chat connection",
  }));

  assert.deepEqual(stopCall, {
    reason: "stopped by testuser",
    options: { notify: true },
  });
  assert.equal(sentMessages.length, 1);
  assert.equal(
    sentMessages[0].body.content,
    "Closed the live Delta chat watch for `l4zfx0e`.",
  );
});

    token: "test-token",
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelName: "questions-answers",
    minLength: 10,

    groqModel: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",

      async describeFromMessage() {
        return "The requester is a Discord community visitor.";
      },
    },
    gameStatusUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status",
    gamePlayingCapacity: 1024,
    gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
    gameBotCount: 960,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: "qa-channel-id", name: "questions-answers", type: 0 },
    ],

      sentMessages.push({ channelId, body });
    },
    logger: { log() {}, warn() {} },
  });

  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  let groqCalls = 0;
  globalThis.fetch = async (url) => {

  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = originalFetch;
  }
});

test("auto-answer never reuses a personalized answer across different users", async () => {
  const sentMessages = [];
  const aa = new AutoAnswer({
    token: "test-token",
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelName: "questions-answers",
    minLength: 10,
    groqApiKey: "test-key",
    groqModel: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
    requesterRoles: {
      async describeFromMessage(message) {
        return `Requester ${message.author.id}`;
      },
    },
    gameStatusUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status",
    gamePlayingCapacity: 1024,
    gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
    gameBotCount: 960,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      {
        id: "qa-channel-id",
        name: "questions-answers",
        type: 0,
      },
    ],
    sendMessage: async (_token, channelId, body) => {
      sentMessages.push({
        channelId,
        body,
      });
    },
    logger: {
      log() {},
      warn() {},
    },
  });

  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  let groqCalls = 0;

  globalThis.fetch = async (url) => {
    if (url.includes("groq")) {
      groqCalls += 1;
      return groqResponse(
        `Personalized answer ${groqCalls}`,
      );
    }

    return {
      ok: false,
      status: 500,
    };
  };

  try {
    await aa.resolveChannel();

    await aa.handle(makeMessage({
      authorId: "user-1",
      content: "How do I install legend mod?",
    }));

    await aa.handle(makeMessage({
      authorId: "user-2",
      content: "how do i install legend mod",
    }));

    assert.equal(groqCalls, 2);
    assert.equal(sentMessages.length, 2);

    assert.equal(
      sentMessages[0].body.embeds[0].description,
      "Personalized answer 1",
    );

    assert.equal(
      sentMessages[1].body.embeds[0].description,
      "Personalized answer 2",
    );
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = originalFetch;
  }
});

  );
});

test("auto-answer sends follow-up context to the model after a recent answer", async () => {
  const sentMessages = [];
  const fetchCalls = [];
  const aa = new AutoAnswer({
    token: "test-token",
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelName: "questions-answers",
    minLength: 10,
    groqApiKey: "test-key",
    groqModel: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
    requesterRoles: {
      async describeFromMessage() {
        return "The requester is a Discord community visitor.";
      },
    },
    gameStatusUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status",
    gamePlayingCapacity: 1024,
    gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
    gameBotCount: 960,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: "qa-channel-id", name: "questions-answers", type: 0 },
    ],
    sendMessage: async (_token, channelId, body) => {
      sentMessages.push({ channelId, body });
    },
    logger: { log() {}, warn() {} },
  });

  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  globalThis.fetch = async (url, options) => {
    if (url.includes("groq")) {
      fetchCalls.push(JSON.parse(options.body));
      return groqResponse(fetchCalls.length === 1
        ? "Install it with Tampermonkey first."
        : "Firefox works too. Use Tampermonkey there as well.");
    }
    return { ok: false, status: 500 };
  };

  try {
    await aa.resolveChannel();
    await aa.handle(makeMessage({ content: "how do i install legend mod?" }));
    await aa.handle(makeMessage({ content: "and on firefox?" }));

    assert.equal(sentMessages.length, 2);
    assert.equal(fetchCalls.length, 2);

    const followUpPayload = JSON.stringify(fetchCalls[1]);
    assert.ok(followUpPayload.includes("Previous user question: how do i install legend mod?"));
    assert.ok(followUpPayload.includes("Previous bot answer: Install it with Tampermonkey first."));
    assert.ok(followUpPayload.includes("Current user follow-up: and on firefox?"));
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = originalFetch;
  }
});

test("auto-answer sends long answer in a single embed (within 4096 limit)", async () => {
  const sentMessages = [];
  const aa = new AutoAnswer({
    token: "test-token",
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelName: "questions-answers",
    minLength: 10,
    groqApiKey: "test-key",
    groqModel: "openai/gpt-oss-20b",
    requesterRoles: {
      async describeFromMessage() {
        return "visitor";
      },
    },
    gameStatusUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status",
    gamePlayingCapacity: 1024,
    gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
    gameBotCount: 960,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: "qa-channel-id", name: "questions-answers", type: 0 },
    ],
    sendMessage: async (_token, channelId, body) => {
      sentMessages.push({ channelId, body });
    },
    logger: { log() {}, warn() {} },
  });

  // Generate a moderately long answer (under 4000 chars after AI truncation)
  const longAnswer = "Here is step " + "X".repeat(3500) + " of the guide.";

  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  globalThis.fetch = async (url) => {
    if (url.includes("groq")) return groqResponse(longAnswer);
    return { ok: false, status: 500 };
  };

  try {
    await aa.resolveChannel();
    await aa.handle(makeMessage());

    // Should send exactly 1 message (fits in one embed)
    assert.equal(sentMessages.length, 1, "single embed for answer under 4096");
    assert.ok(sentMessages[0].body.embeds[0].description.length > 0, "has content");
    assert.ok(sentMessages[0].body.embeds[0].description.length <= 4096, "fits in one embed");
    assert.ok(sentMessages[0].body.message_reference, "is a reply");
  } finally {
    globalThis.fetch = originalFetch;
  }
});

    token: "test-token",
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelName: "questions-answers",
    minLength: 10,

      async describeFromMessage() {
        return "visitor";
      },
    },
    gameStatusUrl: "http://127.0.0.1:8081/status",
    gamePlayingCapacity: 1024,
    gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
    gameBotCount: 960,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: "qa-channel-id", name: "questions-answers", type: 0 },

    sendMessage: async (_token, channelId, body) => {
      sentMessages.push({ channelId, body });
    },
    logger: { log() {}, warn() {} },

  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  globalThis.fetch = async () => {

  }

// ── splitMessage unit tests ───────────────────────────────────────

test("splitMessage: short text returns single chunk", () => {
  const result = splitMessage("Hello world");
  assert.equal(result.length, 1);
  assert.equal(result[0], "Hello world");
});

test("splitMessage: text at exact limit returns single chunk", () => {
  const text = "A".repeat(2000);
  const result = splitMessage(text);
  assert.equal(result.length, 1);
  assert.equal(result[0].length, 2000);
});

test("splitMessage: text over limit splits into multiple chunks", () => {
  const text = "A".repeat(2001);
  const result = splitMessage(text);
  assert.ok(result.length >= 2, "should split into at least 2 chunks");
  for (const chunk of result) {
    assert.ok(chunk.length <= 2000, `chunk length ${chunk.length} exceeds 2000`);
  }
  // All content preserved
  assert.equal(result.join(""), text);
});

test("splitMessage: prefers paragraph breaks (double newline)", () => {
  const para1 = "First paragraph. ".repeat(50).trim();  // ~850 chars
  const para2 = "Second paragraph. ".repeat(50).trim();  // ~900 chars
  const para3 = "Third paragraph. ".repeat(50).trim();   // ~850 chars
  const text = `${para1}\n\n${para2}\n\n${para3}`;

  const result = splitMessage(text);
  assert.ok(result.length >= 2, "should split at paragraph boundaries");
  // First chunk should end cleanly (not mid-sentence)
  assert.ok(!result[0].endsWith(" "), "first chunk is cleanly trimmed");
});

test("splitMessage: falls back to line breaks when no paragraphs", () => {
  const lines = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, i) => `Line ${i}: some content`);
  const text = lines.join("\n");

  const result = splitMessage(text);
  assert.ok(result.length >= 2, "should split at line boundaries");
  for (const chunk of result) {
    assert.ok(chunk.length <= 2000, `chunk ${chunk.length} exceeds 2000`);
  }
});

test("splitMessage: custom maxLength works", () => {
  const text = "A".repeat(100);
  const result = splitMessage(text, 50);
  assert.equal(result.length, 2);
  assert.equal(result[0].length, 50);
  assert.equal(result[1].length, 50);
});

test("splitMessage: no chunk ever exceeds maxLength (stress test)", () => {
  // Random-ish long text with various break types
  const parts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
    parts.push(`Section ${i}: ${"word ".repeat(20)}`);
    if (i % 5 === 0) parts.push(""); // paragraph break
  }
  const text = parts.join("\n");

  const result = splitMessage(text, 500);
  for (let i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
    assert.ok(
      result[i].length <= 500,
      `chunk ${i} is ${result[i].length} chars, exceeds 500`,
    );
    assert.ok(result[i].length > 0, `chunk ${i} is empty`);
  }
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";

  assert.deepEqual(
    extractBoredRequest("suggest an education activity for 2 people"),
    {
      text: "suggest an education activity for 2 people",
      type: "education",
      participants: 2,
    },
  );

test("fetchBoredContext returns bounded activity suggestions", async () => {
  const context = await fetchBoredContext("suggest an education activity for 2 people", {
    fetchImpl: async () => ({
      ok: true,
      json: async () => ([
        {
          activity: "Build a small web app together",
          type: "education",
          participants: 2,
          price: 0.2,
          accessibility: "Some challenges",
          duration: "hours",
          kidFriendly: true,
          link: "https://example.com/project",
        },
      ]),
    }),
  });

  assert.match(context, /Bored API activity data fetched for this request only/);
  assert.match(context, /Filter type: education/);
  assert.match(context, /Participants: 2/);
  assert.match(context, /Build a small web app together/);
});

test("fetchBoredContext reports empty filter results cleanly", async () => {
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchBoredContext("suggest a busywork activity for 8 people", {
      fetchImpl: async () => ({
        ok: true,
        json: async () => [],
      }),
    }),
    (error) => error instanceof BoredContextError
      && error.message === "The Bored API did not return activities for that filter.",
  );
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFile, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";

import { BotAuditLog } from "../src/bot-audit-log.js";

function testPath() {
  return join(tmpdir(), `discord-bot-audit-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}.json`);
}

test("bot audit log stores recent bot-authored events on disk", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  const auditLog = new BotAuditLog({ dataPath, maxEntries: 2 });

  await auditLog.record({ type: "json_message", actorId: "user-1", messageId: "message-1" });
  await auditLog.record({ type: "welcome_join", actorId: "system", messageId: "message-2" });
  await auditLog.record({ type: "json_command", actorId: "user-2", messageId: "message-3" });

  const stored = JSON.parse(await readFile(dataPath, "utf8"));
  assert.equal(stored.entries.length, 2);
  assert.equal(stored.entries[0].messageId, "message-2");
  assert.equal(stored.entries[1].messageId, "message-3");
});

test("bot audit log can return the latest matching entry", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  const auditLog = new BotAuditLog({ dataPath });

  await auditLog.record({ type: "chat_welcome", actorName: "Sky", messageId: "welcome-1" });
  await auditLog.record({ type: "chat_announcement", actorName: "Jim", messageId: "announcement-1" });
  await auditLog.record({ type: "chat_announcement", actorName: "Alex", messageId: "announcement-2" });

  const latestAnnouncement = auditLog.latestEntry(["chat_announcement"]);
  assert.equal(latestAnnouncement.actorName, "Alex");
  assert.equal(latestAnnouncement.messageId, "announcement-2");
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";

import {

  inferConversationPreferences,
  projectGlossaryForQuestion,
} from "../src/chat-intelligence.js";

test("canonicalizeProjectTerms expands LM LC EL and Snez aliases", () => {
  const canonical = canonicalizeProjectTerms("How many LM players are online on EL via snez for LC?");

  assert.match(canonical, /legend mod/);
  assert.match(canonical, /expanding land/);
  assert.match(canonical, /snez legend mod feed/);
  assert.match(canonical, /legend clan/);
});

test("projectGlossaryForQuestion reports alias hints only when present", () => {
  assert.match(projectGlossaryForQuestion("How do I install LM for LC?"), /LM = Legend Mod/);
  assert.match(projectGlossaryForQuestion("How do I install LM for LC?"), /LC = Legend Clan/);
  assert.equal(projectGlossaryForQuestion("How do I install Legend Mod?"), "");
});

test("analyzeQuestionRouting identifies live data requests and public lobby style", () => {
  const routing = analyzeQuestionRouting("How many LM players are online now?", {
    channelName: "lobby",
  });

  assert.equal(routing.intent, "live_data_request");
  assert.equal(routing.answerStyle, "public_brief");
  assert.match(routing.routingContext, /only use live status or websocket data/i);
});

test("analyzeQuestionRouting requests clarification for ambiguous support issues", () => {
  const routing = analyzeQuestionRouting("it does not work", {
    channelName: "lobby",
  });

  assert.equal(routing.needsClarification, true);
  assert.equal(routing.emotion, "frustrated");
  assert.match(routing.clarificationPrompt, /Sounds like something is failing/);
  assert.match(routing.clarificationPrompt, /Legend Mod install|Expanding Land live status/);
  assert.equal(routing.confidence, "low");
});

test("inferConversationPreferences extracts recent browser and topic signals", () => {
  const preferences = inferConversationPreferences([
    { role: "user", content: "I use Firefox for Legend Mod." },
    { role: "assistant", content: "Use Tampermonkey there." },
    { role: "user", content: "Legend Mod still lags sometimes." },
  ]);

  assert.match(preferences, /firefox/i);
  assert.match(preferences, /legend mod/i);
});

test("analyzeQuestionRouting detects grateful and excited tones", () => {
  const grateful = analyzeQuestionRouting("thanks, how do I install LM?", {});
  const excited = analyzeQuestionRouting("this is awesome!! how do i use LM?", {});

  assert.equal(grateful.emotion, "grateful");
  assert.match(grateful.routingContext, /Emotion: grateful or friendly/);
  assert.equal(excited.emotion, "excited");
  assert.match(excited.routingContext, /Emotion: excited/);
});

test("inferRecentThreadContext captures recent topic, browser, and server hints", () => {
  const context = inferRecentThreadContext([
    { role: "user", content: "How do I install Legend Mod on Firefox?" },
    { role: "assistant", content: "Use Tampermonkey there." },
    { role: "user", content: "Show me the chat of this server: l4zfx0e use tag LC" },
  ]);

  assert.equal(context.topic, "legend mod");
  assert.equal(context.browser, "firefox");
  assert.equal(context.serverToken, "l4zfx0e");
  assert.equal(context.clanTag, "LC");
});

  const routing = analyzeQuestionRouting("and on firefox?", {
    hasRecentAnswer: true,

    hasRecentAnswer: true,

  gameWebsiteUrl: "https://expanding.land/",
  gamePlayingCapacity: 1024,
  gameSpectatorCapacity: 200,
  gameBotCount: 960,
  getBotStatus: () => ({
    ready: true,
    uptimeSeconds: 65,
    discord: { gatewayPingMs: 42, guilds: 1 },
  }),
  fetchImpl: async () => ({ ok: true, json: async () => gameStatus }),
};

test("the bot publishes /legend and /lc slash commands", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(commandData, [
    {
      name: "legend",
      description: "Open the live Legend FFA server dashboard",
      type: 1,
    },
    {
      name: "lc",
      description: "Ask LC about Legend Clan, Legend Mod, or Expanding Land",
      type: 1,
      options: [
        {
          type: 3,
          name: "question",
          description: "What do you want to ask?",
          required: true,
          max_length: 500,
        },
        {
          type: 11,
          name: "image",
          description: "Optional screenshot or image for LC to analyze",
          required: false,
        },
      ],
    },
  ]);
});

test("legend command returns an ephemeral server dashboard", async () => {
  const response = await buildLegendResponse({ type: 2, data: { name: "legend" } }, options);

  assert.equal(response.type, 4);
  assert.equal(response.data.flags, 64);
  assert.match(response.data.embeds[0].description, /Online/);
  assert.deepEqual(response.data.embeds[0].fields, [
    { name: "958/1024", value: "Players", inline: true },
    { name: "3/200", value: "Spectators", inline: true },
    { name: "1m", value: "Uptime", inline: true },
    { name: "960", value: "Bots", inline: true },
    { name: "Tier 5 (8\u00d7 area)", value: "Map tier", inline: true },
    { name: "1.2.62", value: "Version", inline: true },
  ]);
  assert.equal(response.data.components[0].components[0].custom_id, "legend:refresh");
});

test("details button updates the existing dashboard", async () => {
  const response = await buildLegendResponse(
    { type: 3, data: { custom_id: "legend:details" } },
    options,
  );

  assert.equal(response.type, 7);
  assert.equal(response.data.flags, undefined);
  assert.equal(response.data.embeds[0].fields[0].name, "Food");
  assert.deepEqual(
    response.data.embeds[0].fields.map(({ name }) => name),
    ["Food", "Viruses", "Bot gateway"],
  );
  assert.equal(response.data.embeds[0].fields[2].value, "42ms");
  assert.equal(
    response.data.components[0].components[0].custom_id,
    "legend:refresh:details",
  );
  assert.equal(
    response.data.components[0].components[1].label,
    "Back",
  );
});

test("refreshing the details dashboard preserves the details view", async () => {
  const response = await buildLegendResponse(
    {
      type: 3,
      data: {
        custom_id: "legend:refresh:details",
      },
    },
    options,
  );

  assert.deepEqual(
    response.data.embeds[0].fields.map(
      ({ name }) => name,
    ),
    [
      "Food",
      "Viruses",
      "Bot gateway",
    ],
  );

  assert.equal(
    response.data.components[0].components[0].custom_id,
    "legend:refresh:details",
  );
});

test("dashboard reports offline when the local status request fails", async () => {
  const response = await buildLegendResponse(
    { type: 2, data: { name: "legend" } },
    {
      ...options,
      fetchImpl: async () => {
        throw new Error("offline");
      },
    },
  );

  assert.match(response.data.embeds[0].description, /Offline/);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  readFile,
  rm,
} from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  CommunityKnowledge,
} from "../src/community-knowledge.js";

function interaction(userId = "user-1") {
  return {
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    member: {
      user: {
        id: userId,
        username: `name-${userId}`,
        global_name: `Display-${userId}`,
      },
    },
  };
}

function testPath() {
  return join(
    tmpdir(),
    [
      "discord-community-knowledge",
      process.pid,
      Date.now(),
      Math.random(),
    ].join("-") + ".json",
  );
}

test(
  "community knowledge stores, retrieves, and persists facts",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();
    t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));

    const knowledge = new CommunityKnowledge({
      dataPath,
    });

    await knowledge.store(
      "AnotherZone",
      "Members admin who handles recruitment and onboarding. See https://example.com/private",
      ["people", "staff"],
      interaction("jimboy"),
    );

    await knowledge.store(
      "Jimboy3100",
      "Founder of LC, from Greece.",
      ["people"],
      interaction("jimboy"),
    );

    const context = knowledge.contextFor(
      "who is AnotherZone?",
    );

    assert.match(context, /AnotherZone/);
    assert.match(context, /recruitment/);
    assert.match(context, /\[link\]/);
    assert.match(context, /shared by Display-jimboy/);

    assert.doesNotMatch(
      context,
      /example\.com/,
    );

    const jimContext = knowledge.contextFor(
      "tell me about Jimboy3100",
    );

    assert.match(jimContext, /Jimboy3100/);
    assert.match(jimContext, /Founder/);

    // Persist and reload
    const reloaded = new CommunityKnowledge({
      dataPath,
    });

    await reloaded.start();

    assert.match(
      reloaded.contextFor("AnotherZone"),
      /recruitment/,
    );

    assert.equal(reloaded.factCount(), 2);
  },
);

test(
  "community knowledge updates existing facts",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();
    t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));

    const knowledge = new CommunityKnowledge({
      dataPath,
    });

    await knowledge.store(
      "AnotherZone",
      "A member.",
      [],
      interaction(),
    );

    await knowledge.store(
      "AnotherZone",
      "Members admin handling recruitment.",
      ["staff"],
      interaction(),
    );

    assert.equal(knowledge.factCount(), 1);

    assert.match(
      knowledge.contextFor("AnotherZone"),
      /recruitment/,
    );
  },
);

test(
  "community knowledge deletes facts",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();
    t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));

    const knowledge = new CommunityKnowledge({
      dataPath,
    });

    await knowledge.store(
      "OldFact",
      "Some old info.",
      [],
      interaction(),
    );

    assert.equal(knowledge.factCount(), 1);
    assert.equal(
      await knowledge.remove("OldFact"),
      true,
    );

    assert.equal(knowledge.factCount(), 0);
    assert.equal(
      await knowledge.remove("OldFact"),
      false,
    );
  },
);

test(
  "community knowledge respects max facts cap",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();
    t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));

    let now = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 21);
    const knowledge = new CommunityKnowledge({
      dataPath,
      maxFacts: 3,
      now: () => now,
    });

    for (let index = 0; index < 5; index += 1) {
      now += 1000;
      await knowledge.store(
        `Topic${index}`,
        `Content for topic ${index}`,
        [],
        interaction(),
      );
    }

    assert.equal(knowledge.factCount(), 3);

    // Should keep the 3 most recent
    assert.match(
      knowledge.contextFor("Topic4"),
      /Topic4/,
    );

    assert.equal(
      knowledge.contextFor("Topic0"),
      "",
    );
  },
);

test(
  "community knowledge keyword retrieval matches subject and content",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();
    t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));

    const knowledge = new CommunityKnowledge({
      dataPath,
    });

    await knowledge.store(
      "Expanding Land",
      "A browser-based agar.io inspired game with custom mechanics.",
      ["games"],
      interaction(),
    );

    await knowledge.store(
      "Legend Mod",
      "A browser extension for agar.io with FPS improvements.",
      ["mods"],
      interaction(),
    );

    const result = knowledge.contextFor(
      "tell me about agar.io mods",
    );

    // Both match "agar" but Legend Mod also matches "mods"
    assert.match(result, /Legend Mod/);
    assert.match(result, /Expanding Land/);
  },
);

  "community knowledge returns empty for unrelated questions",

      dataPath,

    await knowledge.store(
      "AnotherZone",

    );

    assert.equal(
      knowledge.contextFor("what is the weather?"),
      "",
    );
  },
);

test(
  "community knowledge stores no raw Discord identity on disk",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();
    t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));

    const knowledge = new CommunityKnowledge({
      dataPath,
    });

    await knowledge.store(
      "TestFact",
      "Some info.",
      [],
      {
        guild_id: "guild-id",
        member: {
          user: {
            id: "9876543210",
            username: "testplayer",
            global_name: "TestPlayer",
          },
        },
      },
    );

    const stored = await readFile(
      dataPath,
      "utf8",
    );

    assert.doesNotMatch(
      stored,
      /9876543210/,
    );

    assert.match(stored, /TestPlayer/);
    assert.match(stored, /[a-f0-9]{64}/);
  },
);

test(
  "community knowledge accepts Discord message-shaped attribution",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();

    t.after(() => rm(dataPath, {
      force: true,
    }));

    const knowledge = new CommunityKnowledge({
      dataPath,
    });

    await knowledge.store(
      "Sky",
      "A pro player.",
      ["people"],
      {
        guild_id: "guild-id",
        author: {
          id: "user-message",
          username: "message-author",
          global_name: "Message Author",
        },
      },
    );

    assert.match(
      knowledge.contextFor("who is Sky"),
      /shared by Message Author/,
    );
  },
);

test("extractCrossrefRequest ignores unrelated questions", () => {

  assert.equal(extractCrossrefRequest("show latest commits for openai/openai-node"), null);

test("extractCrossrefRequest parses explicit Crossref prompts", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    extractCrossrefRequest("search crossref for attention is all you need"),
    { query: "attention is all you need" },

test("fetchCrossrefContext returns a bounded Crossref snapshot", async () => {
  const fetchCalls = [];

  const context = await fetchCrossrefContext("search crossref for attention is all you need", {
    fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
      fetchCalls.push({ url: String(url), options });

      return {
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        json: async () => ({
          message: {
            items: [
              {
                DOI: "10.5555/attention",
                title: ["Attention Is All You Need"],
                author: [
                  { given: "Ashish", family: "Vaswani" },
                  { given: "Noam", family: "Shazeer" },
                ],
                publisher: "NeurIPS",
                type: "proceedings-article",
                URL: "https://doi.org/10.5555/attention",
                issued: { "date-parts": [[2017, 6, 12]] },
                "container-title": ["Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems"],
              },
              {
                DOI: "10.5555/transformers",
                title: ["Transformers and Beyond"],
                author: [{ given: "Jane", family: "Doe" }],
                publisher: "Example Press",
                type: "journal-article",
                URL: "https://doi.org/10.5555/transformers",
                issued: { "date-parts": [[2019]] },
                "container-title": ["Journal of Example Results"],
              },
            ],
          },
        }),
      };
    },
  });

  assert.equal(fetchCalls.length, 1);
  assert.match(fetchCalls[0].url, /query=attention\+is\+all\+you\+need/);
  assert.match(fetchCalls[0].url, new RegExp(`rows=${CROSSREF_MAX_RESULTS}`));
  assert.equal(fetchCalls[0].options.headers.accept, "application/json");
  assert.ok(fetchCalls[0].options.signal);
  assert.match(context, /Crossref data fetched for this request only:/);
  assert.match(context, /Query: attention is all you need/);
  assert.match(context, /Top work: Attention Is All You Need/);
  assert.match(context, /Top DOI: 10.5555\/attention/);
  assert.match(context, /Journal or container: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems/);
  assert.match(context, /Results:/);
  assert.match(context, /Attention Is All You Need/);
  assert.match(context, /Authors Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer/);
  assert.match(context, new RegExp(`Limits: timeout ${CROSSREF_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS}ms\\. Results ${CROSSREF_MAX_RESULTS}\\.`));
});
