import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  DeltaChatWatchManager,
  extractDeltaChatWatchRequest,
  extractDeltaChatWatchStopRequest,
} from "../src/delta-chat-watch.js";

class FakeScheduler {
  constructor() {
    this.nowValue = 0;
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.tasks = new Map();
  }

  now = () => this.nowValue;

  setTimeout = (fn, delay) => {
    const id = this.nextId++;
    this.tasks.set(id, {
      fn,
      dueAt: this.nowValue + delay,
    });
    return id;
  };

  clearTimeout = (id) => {
    this.tasks.delete(id);
  };

  advance(ms) {
    this.nowValue += ms;
    let ranTask = true;

    while (ranTask) {
      ranTask = false;
      const due = [...this.tasks.entries()]
        .filter(([, task]) => task.dueAt <= this.nowValue)
        .sort((left, right) => left[1].dueAt - right[1].dueAt);

      for (const [id, task] of due) {
        this.tasks.delete(id);
        task.fn();
        ranTask = true;
      }
    }
  }
}

class FakeWebSocket {
  static instances = [];

  static CONNECTING = 0;
  static OPEN = 1;
  static CLOSING = 2;
  static CLOSED = 3;

  constructor(url, protocol) {
    this.url = url;
    this.protocol = protocol;
    this.readyState = FakeWebSocket.CONNECTING;
    this.sent = [];
    this.closed = false;
    FakeWebSocket.instances.push(this);
  }

  send(payload) {
    const bytes = payload instanceof Uint8Array ? payload : new Uint8Array(payload);
    this.sent.push([...bytes]);
  }

  close(code = 1000, reason = "") {
    this.closed = true;
    this.readyState = FakeWebSocket.CLOSED;
    this.onclose?.({ code, reason });
  }

  open() {
    this.readyState = FakeWebSocket.OPEN;
    this.onopen?.();
  }

  emit(bytes) {
    const view = bytes instanceof Uint8Array ? bytes : new Uint8Array(bytes);
    this.onmessage?.({
      data: view.buffer.slice(view.byteOffset, view.byteOffset + view.byteLength),
    });
  }
}

function utf16Bytes(value) {
  const bytes = [];
  for (const char of value) {
    const code = char.charCodeAt(0);
    bytes.push(code & 0xff, code >> 8);
  }
  return bytes;
}

function stringPacket(opcode, value = "") {
  return new Uint8Array([opcode, ...utf16Bytes(value)]);
}

function roomPacket(serverToken, clanTag = "", region = "", gameMode = "", partyToken = "") {
  const encode = (value = "") => [value.length & 0xff, ...utf16Bytes(value)];
  return new Uint8Array([
    9,
    ...encode(serverToken),
    ...encode(clanTag),
    ...encode(region),
    ...encode(gameMode),
    ...encode(partyToken),
  ]);
}

function legacyChatPacket(type, message) {
  return new Uint8Array([100, type, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ...utf16Bytes(message), 0, 0]);
}

function deltaChatPacket(type, name, text) {
  return new Uint8Array([
    25,
    type,
    1,
    0,
    2,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    name.length,
    ...utf16Bytes(name),
    text.length,
    ...utf16Bytes(text),
  ]);
}

function uint16Bytes(value) {
  return [value & 0xff, (value >> 8) & 0xff];
}

function deltaPresenceEstablishedPacket(connectionId) {
  return new Uint8Array([0, ...uint16Bytes(connectionId)]);
}

function deltaPresenceUpdatePacket(players) {
  const bytes = [16];
  for (const player of players) {
    bytes.push(...uint16Bytes(player.playerId));
    bytes.push(5); // top-level: nested flags + isAlive
    bytes.push(2); // nested flags: nick only
    bytes.push(player.nick.length, ...utf16Bytes(player.nick));
    bytes.push(player.isAlive === false ? 0 : 1);
  }
  bytes.push(0, 0);
  return new Uint8Array(bytes);
}

function deltaPresenceRemovePacket(playerIds) {
  const bytes = [12];
  for (const playerId of playerIds) {
    bytes.push(...uint16Bytes(playerId));
  }
  bytes.push(0, 0);
  return new Uint8Array(bytes);
}

test("Delta chat watch streams unique chat lines and stops after the configured window", async () => {
  FakeWebSocket.instances.length = 0;
  const scheduler = new FakeScheduler();
  const sent = [];

  const watcher = new DeltaChatWatchManager({
    token: "bot-token",
    relayUrl: "wss://relay.example/ws",
    durationMs: 1_000,
    idleTimeoutMs: 900,
    connectTimeoutMs: 500,
    postMessage: async (_token, channelId, body) => {
      sent.push({ channelId, body });
    },
    webSocketCtor: FakeWebSocket,
    now: scheduler.now,
    setTimeoutFn: scheduler.setTimeout,
    clearTimeoutFn: scheduler.clearTimeout,
    logger: { warn() {} },
  });

  await watcher.startWatch({
    channelId: "room-1",
    requesterId: "user-1",
    requesterName: "Sky",
    serverToken: "l4zfx0e",
    displayServer: "l4zfx0e",
  });

  assert.equal(sent.length, 0);

  const socket = FakeWebSocket.instances[0];
  assert.equal(socket.url, "wss://relay.example/ws");
  assert.equal(socket.protocol, "lc-watch");

  socket.open();
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[0], [...stringPacket(10, "LC Watch")]);
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[1], [...stringPacket(15, "")]);
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[2], [...stringPacket(16, "l4zfx0e")]);
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[3], [...roomPacket("l4zfx0e")]);
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[4], [3]);

  socket.emit(new Uint8Array([1]));
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[5], [1]);

  socket.emit(legacyChatPacket(101, "Sky: hello there"));
  socket.emit(legacyChatPacket(101, "Sky: hello there"));
  socket.emit(deltaChatPacket(2, "Sky", "/split now"));

  assert.equal(sent.length, 2);
  assert.equal(sent[0].body.content, "[chat] Sky: hello there");
  assert.equal(sent[1].body.content, "[cmd] Sky: /split now");

  scheduler.advance(1_000);
  await Promise.resolve();

  assert.equal(socket.closed, true);
  assert.equal(sent.length, 3);
  assert.match(sent[2].body.content, /Stopped the Delta chat watch/);
  assert.match(sent[2].body.content, /Unique lines shown: 2/);
});

test("Delta participant watch reports the baseline, joins, and leaves", async () => {
  FakeWebSocket.instances.length = 0;
  const scheduler = new FakeScheduler();
  const sent = [];

  const watcher = new DeltaChatWatchManager({
    token: "bot-token",
    presenceUrl: "wss://delta.example/delta7?protocol=v1",
    participantBaselineMs: 50,
    durationMs: 5_000,
    idleTimeoutMs: 5_000,
    connectTimeoutMs: 500,
    postMessage: async (_token, channelId, body) => {
      sent.push({ channelId, body });
    },
    webSocketCtor: FakeWebSocket,
    now: scheduler.now,
    setTimeoutFn: scheduler.setTimeout,
    clearTimeoutFn: scheduler.clearTimeout,
    logger: { warn() {}, info() {} },
  });

  await watcher.startWatch({
    channelId: "room-1",
    requesterId: "user-1",
    requesterName: "Sky",
    serverToken: "l4zfx0e",
    displayServer: "l4zfx0e",
    watchChat: false,
    watchParticipants: true,
  });

  const socket = FakeWebSocket.instances[0];
  assert.equal(socket.url, "wss://delta.example/delta7?protocol=v1");
  assert.equal(socket.protocol, "00000000000000000000000000000000");

  socket.open();
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[0], [0, 0]);
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[1], [134, 0, 0, 0, 0]);
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[2], [133, 0]);

  socket.emit(deltaPresenceEstablishedPacket(42));
  assert.deepEqual(socket.sent[3], [9, 1, ...utf16Bytes("l4zfx0e"), 0, 0]);

  socket.emit(deltaPresenceUpdatePacket([
    { playerId: 11, nick: "Alpha" },
    { playerId: 12, nick: "Beta" },
  ]));

  scheduler.advance(50);
  await Promise.resolve();

  assert.equal(sent.length, 1);
  assert.match(sent[0].body.content, /\[participants\] Tracking 2 live Delta users/);
  assert.match(sent[0].body.content, /Alpha, Beta/);

  socket.emit(deltaPresenceUpdatePacket([
    { playerId: 13, nick: "Gamma" },
  ]));
  await Promise.resolve();

  assert.equal(sent.length, 2);
  assert.match(sent[1].body.content, /Tracked now: 3/);
  assert.match(sent[1].body.content, /Joined: Gamma/);

  socket.emit(deltaPresenceRemovePacket([12]));
  await Promise.resolve();

  assert.equal(sent.length, 3);
  assert.match(sent[2].body.content, /Tracked now: 2/);
  assert.match(sent[2].body.content, /Left: Beta/);
});

  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
  let requestOptions;

  globalThis.fetch = async (_url, options) => {
    requestOptions = options;

    const error = new Error("timed out");
    error.name = "TimeoutError";
    throw error;
  };

  t.after(() => {
    globalThis.fetch = originalFetch;
  });

  await assert.rejects(
    () => getGuildChannels(
      "bot-secret",
      "guild-id",
    ),
    (error) => {
      assert.equal(
        error.message,
        "Discord API request timed out: /guilds/guild-id/channels",
      );

      assert.equal(
        error.path,
        "/guilds/guild-id/channels",
      );

      return true;
    },
  );

  assert.ok(
    requestOptions.signal instanceof AbortSignal,
  );
});

  const requests = [];
  const context = await fetchDowndetectorContext("is discord down in greece right now?", {
    apiToken: "dd-token",
    fetchImpl: async (url) => {
      requests.push(String(url));

      if (String(url).includes("/companies/search")) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          json: async () => ([
            {
              id: 321,
              name: "Discord",
              slug: "discord",
              url: "https://downdetector.com/status/discord/",
              country_iso: "GR",
            },
          ]),
        };
      }

      if (String(url).includes("/companies/321/status")) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          json: async () => "danger",
        };
      }

      if (String(url).includes("/companies/321/last_15")) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          json: async () => 428,
        };
      }

      return {
        ok: true,
        json: async () => ({
          id: 321,
          name: "Discord",
          slug: "discord",
          url: "https://downdetector.com/status/discord/",
          country_iso: "GR",
          description: "Voice, chat, and community platform.",
          status: "warning",
          baseline_current: 23,
          stats_24: [12, 21, 390],
        }),
      };
    },
  });

  assert.equal(requests.length, 4);
  assert.match(context, /Downdetector Enterprise data fetched for this request only/);
  assert.match(context, /Requested service: discord/);
  assert.match(context, /Country filter: GR/);
  assert.match(context, /Current status endpoint: danger/);
  assert.match(context, /Reports in last 15 minutes: 428/);
  assert.match(context, /Latest cached 15-minute bucket: 390/);

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { DiscordGateway, MEMBER_JOIN_INTENTS, PUBLIC_DISCUSSION_INTENTS } from "../src/gateway-client.js";

class FakeWebSocket extends EventTarget {
  static CONNECTING = 0;
  static OPEN = 1;
  static CLOSING = 2;
  static CLOSED = 3;
  static instances = [];

  constructor(url) {
    super();
    this.url = url;
    this.readyState = FakeWebSocket.OPEN;
    this.sent = [];
    FakeWebSocket.instances.push(this);
  }

  send(data) {
    this.sent.push(JSON.parse(data));
  }

  close(code = 1000, reason = "") {
    this.readyState = FakeWebSocket.CLOSED;
    const event = new Event("close");
    Object.defineProperties(event, {
      code: { value: code },
      reason: { value: reason },
    });
    this.dispatchEvent(event);
  }

  receive(payload) {
    const event = new Event("message");
    Object.defineProperty(event, "data", { value: JSON.stringify(payload) });
    this.dispatchEvent(event);
  }
}

function nextTurn() {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve));
}

test("Gateway identifies, becomes ready, and emits interactions", async () => {
  FakeWebSocket.instances = [];
  const gateway = new DiscordGateway("secret", {
    WebSocketClass: FakeWebSocket,
    fetchGatewayUrl: async () => "wss://gateway.discord.test",
  });

  const ready = new Promise((resolve) => gateway.once("ready", resolve));
  const interaction = new Promise((resolve) => gateway.once("interaction", resolve));
  const createdMessage = new Promise((resolve) => gateway.once("messageCreate", resolve));
  const updatedMessage = new Promise((resolve) => gateway.once("messageUpdate", resolve));
  const deletedMessage = new Promise((resolve) => gateway.once("messageDelete", resolve));
  const memberJoin = new Promise((resolve) => gateway.once("memberJoin", resolve));

  await gateway.start();
  const socket = FakeWebSocket.instances[0];
  assert.equal(socket.url, "wss://gateway.discord.test/?v=10&encoding=json");

  socket.receive({ op: 10, d: { heartbeat_interval: 60000 }, s: null, t: null });
  await nextTurn();

  assert.equal(socket.sent[0].op, 2);
  assert.equal(socket.sent[0].d.token, "secret");
  assert.equal(socket.sent[0].d.intents, 1);

  socket.receive({
    op: 0,
    s: 1,
    t: "READY",
    d: {
      session_id: "session",
      resume_gateway_url: "wss://resume.discord.test",
      user: { id: "1", username: "Test Bot" },
      guilds: [{ id: "guild-1" }],
    },
  });

  assert.equal((await ready).username, "Test Bot");
  assert.equal(gateway.getStatus(Date.now()).ready, true);
  assert.equal(gateway.getStatus(Date.now()).discord.guilds, 1);

  const interactionPayload = { id: "interaction", token: "token", type: 2, data: { name: "ping" } };
  socket.receive({ op: 0, s: 2, t: "INTERACTION_CREATE", d: interactionPayload });
  assert.deepEqual(await interaction, interactionPayload);

  socket.receive({ op: 0, s: 3, t: "MESSAGE_CREATE", d: { id: "message-1" } });
  socket.receive({ op: 0, s: 4, t: "MESSAGE_UPDATE", d: { id: "message-1" } });
  socket.receive({ op: 0, s: 5, t: "MESSAGE_DELETE", d: { id: "message-1" } });
  socket.receive({ op: 0, s: 6, t: "GUILD_MEMBER_ADD", d: { guild_id: "guild-1", user: { id: "user-1", username: "Sky" } } });
  assert.deepEqual(await createdMessage, { id: "message-1" });
  assert.deepEqual(await updatedMessage, { id: "message-1" });
  assert.deepEqual(await deletedMessage, { id: "message-1" });
  assert.deepEqual(await memberJoin, { guild_id: "guild-1", user: { id: "user-1", username: "Sky" } });

  gateway.stop();
});

test("Gateway accepts the bounded public discussion intent set", async () => {
  FakeWebSocket.instances = [];
  const gateway = new DiscordGateway("secret", {
    WebSocketClass: FakeWebSocket,
    fetchGatewayUrl: async () => "wss://gateway.discord.test",
    intents: PUBLIC_DISCUSSION_INTENTS,
  });

  await gateway.start();
  const socket = FakeWebSocket.instances[0];
  socket.receive({ op: 10, d: { heartbeat_interval: 60000 }, s: null, t: null });
  await nextTurn();

  assert.equal(socket.sent[0].d.intents, 33281);
  gateway.stop();
});

test("Gateway accepts the member-join intent set", async () => {
  FakeWebSocket.instances = [];
  const gateway = new DiscordGateway("secret", {
    WebSocketClass: FakeWebSocket,
    fetchGatewayUrl: async () => "wss://gateway.discord.test",
    intents: MEMBER_JOIN_INTENTS,
  });

  await gateway.start();
  const socket = FakeWebSocket.instances[0];
  socket.receive({ op: 10, d: { heartbeat_interval: 60000 }, s: null, t: null });
  await nextTurn();

  assert.equal(socket.sent[0].d.intents, 3);
  gateway.stop();

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  extractGitHubRequest,
  fetchGitHubContext,
  GitHubContextError,
} from "../src/github-context.js";

test("extractGitHubRequest matches explicit repo lookups", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    extractGitHubRequest("show recent commits for repo openai/openai-node"),
    {
      owner: "openai",
      repo: "openai-node",
      wantsCommits: true,
      wantsIssues: false,
      wantsReleases: false,
    },
  );

  assert.deepEqual(
    extractGitHubRequest("github.com/openai/openai-node release notes"),
    {
      owner: "openai",
      repo: "openai-node",
      wantsCommits: false,
      wantsIssues: false,
      wantsReleases: true,
    },
  );

  assert.equal(
    extractGitHubRequest("tell me about openai/openai-node"),
    null,
  );
});

test("fetchGitHubContext returns bounded commit, issue, and release summaries", async () => {
  const requestedUrls = [];

  const context = await fetchGitHubContext(
    "show recent commits, issues, and release notes for repo openai/openai-node",
    {
      fetchImpl: async (url) => {
        requestedUrls.push(String(url));

        if (String(url).endsWith("/commits?per_page=3")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ([
              {
                sha: "abcdef123456",
                html_url: "https://github.com/openai/openai-node/commit/abcdef1",
                commit: {
                  message: "Fix response parsing",
                  author: { date: "2026-07-25T10:00:00Z" },
                },
              },
            ]),
          };
        }

        if (String(url).includes("/issues?")) {
          return {
            ok: true,
            status: 200,
            headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
            json: async () => ([
              {
                number: 101,
                title: "Connection drops on retries",
                state: "open",
                html_url: "https://github.com/openai/openai-node/issues/101",
              },
              {
                number: 102,
                title: "Pull request placeholder",
                state: "open",
                html_url: "https://github.com/openai/openai-node/pull/102",
                pull_request: {},
              },
            ]),
          };
        }

        return {
          ok: true,
          status: 200,
          headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
          json: async () => ([
            {
              tag_name: "v1.2.3",
              name: "July release",
              published_at: "2026-07-24T12:00:00Z",
              body: "Critical fixes shipped.",
              html_url: "https://github.com/openai/openai-node/releases/tag/v1.2.3",
            },
          ]),
        };
      },
    },
  );

  assert.deepEqual(requestedUrls, [
    "https://api.github.com/repos/openai/openai-node/commits?per_page=3",
    "https://api.github.com/repos/openai/openai-node/issues?state=open&per_page=5",
    "https://api.github.com/repos/openai/openai-node/releases?per_page=2",
  ]);
  assert.match(context, /Public GitHub API data fetched for this request only/);
  assert.match(context, /Repository: openai\/openai-node/);
  assert.match(context, /abcdef1 \| Fix response parsing \| 2026-07-25T10:00:00Z/);
  assert.match(context, /#101 \| Connection drops on retries \| open/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(context, /#102/);
  assert.match(context, /v1\.2\.3 \| July release \| 2026-07-24T12:00:00Z/);
  assert.match(context, /Notes: Critical fixes shipped\./);
});

test("fetchGitHubContext raises clean not-found errors", async () => {
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchGitHubContext("show recent commits for repo missing/repo", {
      fetchImpl: async () => ({
        ok: false,
        status: 404,
        headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "application/json" }),
        json: async () => ({ message: "Not Found" }),
      }),
    }),
    (error) => error instanceof GitHubContextError && error.message === "That GitHub repository or resource was not found.",
  );
});

    provider: "pollinations",
    pollinationsApiKey: "pollinations-key",
    model: "yoanndev90/laguna-s-2.1:free",
    allowedModels: DEFAULT_POLLINATIONS_FREE_MODELS,
    fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
      request = { url, options };
      return aiResponse("Use Tampermonkey first.");
    },
  });

  const body = JSON.parse(request.options.body);
  assert.equal(request.url, "https://text.pollinations.ai/openai");
  assert.equal(request.options.headers.authorization, "Bearer pollinations-key");
  assert.equal(body.model, "yoanndev90/laguna-s-2.1:free");
  assert.equal(body.max_tokens, 400);
  assert.equal(body.max_completion_tokens, undefined);
  assert.equal(body.messages.at(-1).content, "How do I install Legend Mod?");
  assert.equal(answer, "Use Tampermonkey first.");
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { HealthAlertManager } from "../src/health-alert-manager.js";

test("health alert manager posts a failure only once until cleared", async () => {
  const sent = [];
  const alerts = new HealthAlertManager({
    token: "bot-token",
    channelId: "staff-room",
    sendMessage: async (_token, channelId, body) => {
      sent.push({ channelId, body });
      return { id: `sent-${sent.length}` };
    },
    logger: { warn() {} },
  });

  const first = await alerts.reportFailure("expanding-land-status", "Status down", "Endpoint failed.");
  const second = await alerts.reportFailure("expanding-land-status", "Status down", "Endpoint failed.");

  assert.equal(first, true);
  assert.equal(second, false);
  assert.equal(sent.length, 1);
  assert.equal(alerts.activeCount(), 1);

  await alerts.clearFailure("expanding-land-status");
  assert.equal(alerts.activeCount(), 0);

  const third = await alerts.reportFailure("expanding-land-status", "Status down", "Endpoint failed again.");
  assert.equal(third, true);
  assert.equal(sent.length, 2);
});

test(
  "health alert manager retries a notification that previously failed",
  async () => {
    let attempts = 0;

    const alerts = new HealthAlertManager({
      token: "bot-token",
      channelId: "staff-room",
      sendMessage: async () => {
        attempts += 1;

        if (attempts === 1) {
          throw new Error(
            "temporary Discord failure",
          );
        }

        return {
          id: "sent-2",
        };
      },
      logger: {
        warn() {},
      },
    });

    assert.equal(
      await alerts.reportFailure(
        "status",
        "Status down",
        "Endpoint failed.",
      ),
      false,
    );

    assert.equal(
      alerts.activeCount(),
      1,
    );

    assert.equal(
      await alerts.reportFailure(
        "status",
        "Status down",
        "Endpoint failed.",
      ),
      true,
    );

    assert.equal(attempts, 2);

    assert.equal(
      await alerts.reportFailure(
        "status",
        "Status down",
        "Endpoint failed.",
      ),
      false,
    );

    assert.equal(attempts, 2);
  },
);

test("health alert manager suppresses concurrent duplicate posts", async () => {
  let releaseSend;
  let attempts = 0;

  const alerts =
    new HealthAlertManager({
      token: "bot-token",
      channelId: "staff-room",
      sendMessage: async () => {
        attempts += 1;

        await new Promise((resolve) => {
          releaseSend = resolve;
        });

        return {
          id: "sent-1",
        };
      },
      logger: {
        warn() {},
      },
    });

  const first = alerts.reportFailure(
    "status",
    "Status down",
    "Endpoint failed.",
  );

  const second =
    await alerts.reportFailure(
      "status",
      "Status down",
      "Endpoint failed.",
    );

  assert.equal(second, false);
  assert.equal(attempts, 1);

  releaseSend();

  assert.equal(await first, true);
  assert.equal(attempts, 1);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { startHealthServer, stopHealthServer } from "../src/health-server.js";

test("health endpoint reports readiness and rejects other paths", async (t) => {
  const server = await startHealthServer({
    host: "127.0.0.1",
    port: 0,
    getStatus: () => ({
      ready: true,
      uptimeSeconds: 12,
      discord: { gatewayPingMs: 42, guilds: 1 },
      commitSha: "abc123",
      features: { autoAnswerEnabled: false },
    }),
  });
  t.after(() => stopHealthServer(server));

  const { port } = server.address();
  const healthResponse = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/health`);
  const health = await healthResponse.json();

  assert.equal(healthResponse.status, 200);
  assert.equal(health.service, "discord-bot-server");
  assert.equal(health.state, "ok");
  assert.equal(health.discord.gatewayPingMs, 42);
  assert.equal(health.commitSha, "abc123");
  assert.equal(health.features.autoAnswerEnabled, false);

  const statusResponse = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/status`);
  const status = await statusResponse.json();
  assert.equal(statusResponse.status, 200);
  assert.equal(status.service, "discord-bot-server");
  assert.equal(status.commitSha, "abc123");

  const missingResponse = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/missing`);
  assert.equal(missingResponse.status, 404);
});

test("health endpoint returns 503 until Discord is connected", async (t) => {
  const server = await startHealthServer({
    host: "127.0.0.1",
    port: 0,
    getStatus: () => ({
      ready: false,
      uptimeSeconds: 1,
      discord: { gatewayPingMs: null, guilds: 0 },
    }),
  });
  t.after(() => stopHealthServer(server));

  const { port } = server.address();
  const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/health`);
  assert.equal(response.status, 503);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";

function message(content, overrides = {}) {
  return {
    id: "msg-1",
    channel_id: "channel-1",
    guild_id: "guild-1",
    type: 0,
    content,
    author: {
      id: "user-1",
      username: "Sky",
      bot: false,
    },
    member: {
      roles: ["role-1"],
    },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

test("parseJsonMessage accepts a single object with title, message, and image", () => {
  const parsed = parseJsonMessage(JSON.stringify({
    title: "Server Update",
    message: "Legend is online.",
    image: "https://cdn.example/image.png",
  }));

  assert.equal(parsed.matches, true);
  assert.equal(parsed.error, null);
  assert.equal(parsed.payload.length, 1);
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].title, "Server Update");
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].description, "Legend is online.");
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].image.url, "https://cdn.example/image.png");
});

test("parseJsonMessage supports richer embed fields", () => {
  const parsed = parseJsonMessage(JSON.stringify({
    title: "Server Update",
    url: "https://example.com/post",
    thumbnail: "https://cdn.example/thumb.png",
    footer: { text: "Legend Clan", iconUrl: "https://cdn.example/icon.png" },
    fields: [
      { name: "Status", value: "Online", inline: true },
      { name: "Mode", value: "FFA" },
    ],
  }));

  assert.equal(parsed.matches, true);
  assert.equal(parsed.error, null);
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].url, "https://example.com/post");
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].thumbnail.url, "https://cdn.example/thumb.png");
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].footer.text, "Legend Clan");
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].footer.icon_url, "https://cdn.example/icon.png");
  assert.deepEqual(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].fields, [
    { name: "Status", value: "Online", inline: true },
    { name: "Mode", value: "FFA", inline: false },
  ]);
});

test("parseJsonMessage accepts object-style embed fields", () => {
  const parsed = parseJsonMessage(JSON.stringify({
    title: "Summary",
    fields: {
      Players: 120,
      Region: { value: "Europe", inline: true },
    },
  }));

  assert.equal(parsed.error, null);
  assert.deepEqual(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].fields, [
    { name: "Players", value: "120", inline: false },
    { name: "Region", value: "Europe", inline: true },
  ]);
});

{"messages":[{"title":"One","message":"First"},{"title":"Two","image":"https://cdn.example/two.png"}]}
\`\`\``);

  assert.equal(parsed.matches, true);
  assert.equal(parsed.error, null);
  assert.equal(parsed.payload.length, 2);
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[0].embeds[0].title, "One");
  assert.equal(parsed.payload[1].embeds[0].image.url, "https://cdn.example/two.png");
});

  assert.match(parsed.error, /Invalid JSON/);
});

  assert.equal(parsed.payload, null);
});

test("JsonMessageHandler posts embeds to the channel and replies to the source message", async () => {
  const sent = [];
  const auditEntries = [];
  const handler = new JsonMessageHandler({
    token: "bot-token",
    sendMessage: async (...args) => {
      sent.push(args);
      return { id: `message-${sent.length}` };
    },
    auditLog: {
      async record(entry) {
        auditEntries.push(entry);
      },
    },
    logger: { log() {} },
  });

  const handled = await handler.handle(message(`!json ${JSON.stringify({
    messages: [
      { title: "One", message: "First", buttonLabel: "More", buttonUrl: "https://example.com" },
      { title: "Two", image: "https://cdn.example/two.png", color: "#00ff00" },
    ],
  })}`));

  assert.equal(handled, true);
  assert.equal(sent.length, 2);
  assert.equal(sent[0][1], "channel-1");
  assert.equal(sent[0][2].message_reference.message_id, "msg-1");
  assert.equal(sent[0][2].embeds[0].title, "One");
  assert.equal(sent[1][2].embeds[0].color, 0x00ff00);
  assert.equal(sent[0][2].components[0].components[0].label, "More");
  assert.equal(auditEntries.length, 2);
  assert.equal(auditEntries[0].type, "json_message");
  assert.equal(auditEntries[0].messageId, "message-1");
});

});

  liveLegendModStatusContextForQuestion,
  needsLegendModPlayerStatus,
} from "../src/legend-mod-status.js";

class SuccessfulLegendModWebSocket {
  constructor(url) {
    this.url = url;
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.onmessage?.({
        data: JSON.stringify({
          type: "players_list",
          data: JSON.stringify([
            {
              nickname: "Alpha",
              tag: "LC",
              server: "wss://snez.org/ws?r=eu-west&m=:party",
              hidecountry: false,
              extra: { ip_info: { country: "gr" } },
            },
            {
              nickname: "Beta",
              tag: "",
              server: "wss://snez.org/ws?r=eu-west&m=:party",
              hidecountry: true,
              extra: { ip_info: { country: "us" } },
            },
            {
              nickname: "Gamma",
              tag: "MOD",
              server: "wss://snez.org/ws?r=us-east&m=:ffa",
              hidecountry: false,
              extra: { ip_info: { country: "ca" } },
            },
          ]),
        }),
      });
    }, 0);
  }

  close() {}
}

  constructor() {
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.onerror?.(new Error("offline"));
    }, 0);
  }

  close() {}

test("Legend Mod live-status detection recognizes direct player questions", () => {
  assert.equal(needsLegendModPlayerStatus("how many players play legend mod now?"), true);
  assert.equal(needsLegendModPlayerStatus("who is online on snez right now?"), true);
  assert.equal(needsLegendModPlayerStatus("show lm names and servers"), true);
  assert.equal(needsLegendModPlayerStatus("list legend mod players"), true);
  assert.equal(needsLegendModPlayerStatus("legend mod update when?"), false);
  assert.equal(needsLegendModPlayerStatus("how do legend mod players install skins?"), false);
  assert.equal(needsLegendModPlayerStatus("legend mod server issue"), false);
  assert.equal(needsLegendModPlayerStatus("I like LM themes"), false);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  buildWelcomeMessage,
  resolveWelcomeChannelId,
  sendWelcomeMessage,
} from "../src/member-welcome.js";

test("buildWelcomeMessage mentions the new member and points them to /lc", () => {
  const message = buildWelcomeMessage({
    user: { id: "user-1", username: "Sky" },
  }, {
    welcomeIntroChannelName: "introduce-yourself",
    welcomeHelpChannelName: "lobby",
  });

  assert.equal(
    message.content,
    "Welcome <@user-1> to the server. Use /lc for questions, introduce yourself in #introduce-yourself, and ask for help in #lobby.",
  );
  assert.deepEqual(message.allowed_mentions, {
    parse: [],
    users: ["user-1"],
  });
});

test("resolveWelcomeChannelId prefers explicit welcome channel and falls back to auto-answer channel", () => {
  assert.equal(
    resolveWelcomeChannelId(
      { welcomeChannelId: "welcome-1", autoAnswerChannelId: "auto-1" },
      { channelId: "auto-2" },
    ),
    "welcome-1",
  );
  assert.equal(
    resolveWelcomeChannelId(
      { welcomeChannelId: null, autoAnswerChannelId: "auto-1" },
      { channelId: "auto-2" },
    ),
    "auto-2",
  );
  assert.equal(
    resolveWelcomeChannelId(
      { welcomeChannelId: null, autoAnswerChannelId: "auto-1" },
      null,
    ),
    "auto-1",
  );
});

test("sendWelcomeMessage posts to the resolved channel", async () => {
  const sent = [];
  const result = await sendWelcomeMessage({
    token: "bot-token",
    channelId: "channel-1",
    member: { user: { id: "user-1", username: "Sky" } },
    config: {
      welcomeIntroChannelName: "introduce-yourself",
      welcomeHelpChannelName: "lobby",
    },
    sendMessage: async (...args) => {
      sent.push(args);
      return { id: "message-1" };
    },
  });

  assert.equal(result.id, "message-1");
  assert.equal(sent.length, 1);
  assert.equal(sent[0][0], "bot-token");
  assert.equal(sent[0][1], "channel-1");
  assert.match(sent[0][2].content, /Welcome <@user-1>/);
});

test("sendWelcomeMessage skips when there is no channel or user id", async () => {
  assert.equal(await sendWelcomeMessage({
    token: "bot-token",
    channelId: null,
    member: { user: { id: "user-1" } },
    sendMessage: async () => {
      throw new Error("should not be called");
    },
  }), false);

  assert.equal(await sendWelcomeMessage({
    token: "bot-token",
    channelId: "channel-1",
    member: { user: {} },
    sendMessage: async () => {
      throw new Error("should not be called");
    },
  }), false);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  OPEN_LIBRARY_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS,
  OPEN_LIBRARY_MAX_RESULTS,
  extractOpenLibraryRequest,
  fetchOpenLibraryContext,
} from "../src/open-library-context.js";

test("extractOpenLibraryRequest ignores unrelated questions", () => {
  assert.equal(extractOpenLibraryRequest("what is the weather in Thessaloniki?"), null);
  assert.equal(extractOpenLibraryRequest("show latest commits for openai/openai-node"), null);
});

test("extractOpenLibraryRequest parses explicit Open Library and ISBN prompts", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    extractOpenLibraryRequest("search open library for the lord of the rings"),
    { query: "the lord of the rings", isbn: "" },
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    extractOpenLibraryRequest("find this isbn on open library 9780261102385"),
    { query: "9780261102385", isbn: "9780261102385" },
  );
});

test("fetchOpenLibraryContext returns a bounded Open Library snapshot", async () => {
  const fetchCalls = [];

  const context = await fetchOpenLibraryContext("search open library for the lord of the rings", {
    fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
      fetchCalls.push({ url: String(url), options });
      return {
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        json: async () => ({
          docs: [
            {
              key: "/works/OL27448W",
              title: "The Lord of the Rings",
              author_name: ["J. R. R. Tolkien"],
              first_publish_year: 1954,
              edition_count: 120,
              isbn: ["9780261102385"],
              cover_i: 258027,
            },
            {
              key: "/works/OL99999W",
              title: "The Lord of the Rings Companion",
              author_name: ["Example Author"],
              first_publish_year: 2000,
              edition_count: 3,
              isbn: ["9780000000001"],
              cover_i: 999,
            },
          ],
        }),
      };
    },
  });

  assert.equal(fetchCalls.length, 1);
  assert.match(fetchCalls[0].url, /q=the\+lord\+of\+the\+rings/);
  assert.match(fetchCalls[0].url, new RegExp(`limit=${OPEN_LIBRARY_MAX_RESULTS}`));
  assert.equal(fetchCalls[0].options.headers.accept, "application/json");
  assert.ok(fetchCalls[0].options.signal);
  assert.match(context, /Open Library data fetched for this request only:/);
  assert.match(context, /Query: the lord of the rings/);
  assert.match(context, /Top work: The Lord of the Rings/);
  assert.match(context, /Top authors: J\. R\. R\. Tolkien/);
  assert.match(context, /First publish year: 1954/);
  assert.match(context, /Top ISBN: 9780261102385/);
  assert.match(context, /Work key: \/works\/OL27448W/);
  assert.match(context, new RegExp(`Limits: timeout ${OPEN_LIBRARY_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS}ms\\. Results ${OPEN_LIBRARY_MAX_RESULTS}\\.`));
});

test("fetchOpenLibraryContext returns a clean error when no work matches", async () => {
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchOpenLibraryContext("search open library for asdfghjkl", {
      fetchImpl: async () => ({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        json: async () => ({ docs: [] }),
      }),
    }),
    /Open Library did not return a matching book or work\./,
  );
});

FILE: C:\Github_repos\discord-bot-server\test\player-profile.test.js

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFile, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";

import { handlePlayerProfileInteraction } from "../src/player-profile-handler.js";
import { PlayerProfileInviter } from "../src/player-profile-inviter.js";
import { playerKey, PlayerProfileStore } from "../src/player-profile-store.js";
import {
  playerProfileFields,
  playerProfileInvitation,
  playerProfileModal,
} from "../src/player-profile-ui.js";

function testPath() {
  return join(tmpdir(), `discord-player-profiles-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}.json`);
}

function interaction(userId, overrides = {}) {
  return {
    id: "interaction-id",
    token: "token",
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    member: { user: { id: userId, username: `name-${userId}` } },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function message(userId, content = "A normal public conversation message") {
  return {
    id: `${userId}-${content}`,
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    channel_id: "public-channel",
    author: { id: userId, username: `name-${userId}`, bot: false },
    content,
  };
}

test("player cards are separated, capped, sanitized, and contain no raw Discord identity", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  const profiles = new PlayerProfileStore({ dataPath });

  await profiles.save(interaction("alice"), {
    preferredName: "Alice",
    region: "Europe https://example.com/private",
    interests: `Agar.io ${"x".repeat(250)}`,
  });
  await profiles.save(interaction("bob"), {
    preferredName: "Bob",
    region: "UTC+2",
    interests: "Expanding Land",
  });

  const alice = profiles.contextFor(interaction("alice"));
  assert.match(alice, /Preferred name: Alice/);
  assert.match(alice, /\[link\]/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(alice, /Bob|Expanding Land|example\.com/);
  assert.ok(alice.length <= 400);
  assert.ok(profiles.profileFor(interaction("alice")).interests.length <= 200);

  const stored = await readFile(dataPath, "utf8");
  assert.doesNotMatch(stored, /"alice"|"bob"|name-alice|name-bob|example\.com/);
  assert.equal(Object.keys(JSON.parse(stored).users).every((key) => /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(key)), true);
});

test("Discord user IDs provide stable per-server player identity without being stored raw", () => {
  const first = interaction("same-user");
  const repeated = interaction("same-user");
  const anotherUser = interaction("another-user");
  const anotherServer = { ...interaction("same-user"), guild_id: "another-guild" };

  assert.equal(playerKey(first), playerKey(repeated));
  assert.notEqual(playerKey(first), playerKey(anotherUser));
  assert.notEqual(playerKey(first), playerKey(anotherServer));
  assert.doesNotMatch(playerKey(first), /same-user|guild-id/);
});

test("player cards support opt-out and deletion", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  const profiles = new PlayerProfileStore({ dataPath });
  const user = interaction("user-id");

  await profiles.optOut(user);
  assert.equal(profiles.promptState(user).optedOut, true);
  await profiles.save(user, { preferredName: "Legend", region: "", interests: "" });
  assert.equal(profiles.promptState(user).optedOut, false);
  assert.equal(await profiles.delete(user), true);
  assert.equal(profiles.profileFor(user), null);
});

test("member join observations are stored without raw Discord IDs and are searchable by name or recent join intent", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  let now = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 21, 12, 0, 0);
  const profiles = new PlayerProfileStore({ dataPath, now: () => now });

  await profiles.observeJoin({
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    user: {
      id: "joiner-1",
      username: "newbie",
      global_name: "Sky Rider",
    },
    nick: "Sky",
  });
  now += 1_000;
  await profiles.observeJoin({
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    user: {
      id: "joiner-2",
      username: "legendfan",
      global_name: "Legend Fan",
    },
  });

  const byName = profiles.searchByQuestion("Who is Sky?");
  assert.match(byName, /Sky Rider|Sky|newbie/);
  assert.match(byName, /Observed joining the server at/);

  const recent = profiles.searchByQuestion("Who just joined the server?");
  assert.match(recent, /legendfan/);

  const stored = await readFile(dataPath, "utf8");
  assert.doesNotMatch(stored, /joiner-1|joiner-2|guild-id/);
});

test("player cards expire after one year while permanent invitation opt-out remains", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  let now = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 21);
  const profiles = new PlayerProfileStore({ dataPath, now: () => now });
  const user = interaction("user-id");

  await profiles.save(user, { preferredName: "Sky", region: "Europe", interests: "Agar.io" });
  now += 366 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  assert.equal(profiles.profileFor(user), null);

  await profiles.optOut(user);
  now += 366 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  assert.equal(profiles.promptState(user).optedOut, true);
});

test("profile UI collects only optional broad location and parses current modal components", () => {
  const invitation = playerProfileInvitation("user-id");
  assert.deepEqual(invitation.allowed_mentions, { parse: [], users: ["user-id"] });
  assert.equal(invitation.components[0].components[1].custom_id, "profile:optout");

  const modal = playerProfileModal({ preferredName: "Sky", region: "Europe", interests: "Agar.io" });
  assert.equal(modal.type, 9);
  assert.match(modal.data.components[1].description, /Never enter an address/i);
  assert.doesNotMatch(JSON.stringify(modal), /street|postcode|postal code/i);

  const fields = playerProfileFields({
    data: {
      components: modal.data.components.map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        component: { ...item.component, value: item.component.value ?? "" },
      })),
    },
  });
  assert.deepEqual(fields, { preferredName: "Sky", region: "Europe", interests: "Agar.io" });
});

test("profile buttons open, save, and opt out privately without another slash command", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  const profiles = new PlayerProfileStore({ dataPath });
  const user = "user-id";

  const edit = await handlePlayerProfileInteraction(interaction(user, {
    type: 3,
    data: { custom_id: "profile:open" },
  }), profiles);
  assert.equal(edit.type, 9);

  const saved = await handlePlayerProfileInteraction(interaction(user, {
    type: 5,
    data: {
      custom_id: "profile:save",
      components: [
        { type: 18, component: { type: 4, custom_id: "preferred_name", value: "Sky" } },
        { type: 18, component: { type: 4, custom_id: "region", value: "UTC+2" } },
        { type: 18, component: { type: 4, custom_id: "interests", value: "Agar.io" } },
      ],
    },
  }), profiles);
  assert.equal(saved.type, 4);
  assert.equal(saved.data.flags, 64);

  const stop = await handlePlayerProfileInteraction(interaction(user, {
    type: 3,
    data: { custom_id: "profile:optout" },
  }), profiles);
  assert.match(stop.data.content, /not invite/i);
  assert.equal(profiles.promptState(interaction(user)).optedOut, true);

  const removedCommand = await handlePlayerProfileInteraction(interaction(user, {
    type: 2,
    data: { name: "lc-profile" },
  }), profiles);
  assert.equal(removedCommand, null);
});

test("inviter uses only qualifying public messages and obeys user and global caps", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  let now = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 21);
  const profiles = new PlayerProfileStore({ dataPath, now: () => now });
  const sent = [];
  const inviter = new PlayerProfileInviter({
    token: "token",
    publicDiscussions: {
      accepts(candidate) {
        return candidate.channel_id === "public-channel";
      },
    },
    profiles,
    minimumMessages: 3,
    globalCooldownMs: 10,
    userCooldownMs: 100,
    dailyLimit: 2,
    sendMessage: async (...args) => sent.push(args),
  });

  assert.equal(await inviter.consider(message("alice", "no")), false);
  assert.equal(await inviter.consider({ ...message("alice"), channel_id: "private-channel" }), false);
  assert.equal(await inviter.consider({ ...message("alice"), author: { id: "alice", bot: true } }), false);
  assert.equal(await inviter.consider(message("alice")), false);
  assert.equal(await inviter.consider(message("alice", "another normal message")), false);
  assert.equal(await inviter.consider(message("alice", "third normal message")), true);
  assert.equal(sent.length, 1);
  assert.equal(sent[0][1], "public-channel");

  await inviter.consider(message("bob"));
  await inviter.consider(message("bob", "another normal message"));
  assert.equal(await inviter.consider(message("bob", "third normal message")), false);
  now += 10;
  assert.equal(await inviter.consider(message("bob", "fourth normal message")), true);
  assert.equal(sent.length, 2);

  now += 10;
  await inviter.consider(message("charlie"));
  await inviter.consider(message("charlie", "another normal message"));
  assert.equal(await inviter.consider(message("charlie", "third normal message")), false);
  assert.equal(sent.length, 2);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFile, rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  PublicDiscussionMemory,
  sanitizePublicMessage,
} from "../src/public-discussion-memory.js";

function testPath() {
  return join(tmpdir(), `discord-public-memory-${process.pid}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}.json`);
}

test("public message sanitizing removes links, mentions, and common API secrets", () => {
  const sanitized = sanitizePublicMessage(
    `Ask <@123456> in <#987654> at https://example.com/path using ${["gsk", "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz123456"].join("_")}`,
  );

  assert.equal(sanitized, "Ask @user in #channel at [link] using [secret]");
});

test("startup snapshots request and retain only public category text channels", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  const requestedChannels = [];
  const memory = new PublicDiscussionMemory({
    token: "secret",
    guildId: "guild-id",
    dataPath,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: "public-category", type: 4, name: "PUBLIC ROOMS", parent_id: null },
      { id: "private-category", type: 4, name: "PRIVATE", parent_id: null },
      { id: "lobby", type: 0, name: "lobby", parent_id: "public-category" },
      { id: "private-chat", type: 0, name: "private-chat", parent_id: "private-category" },
      { id: "public-voice", type: 2, name: "voice", parent_id: "public-category" },
    ],
    fetchMessages: async (_token, channelId, limit) => {
      requestedChannels.push({ channelId, limit });
      return [
        {
          id: "2",
          timestamp: "2026-07-21T03:00:00.000Z",
          content: "Legend Mod FPS help at https://example.com <@123>",
          author: { id: "user-id", username: "PrivateName", bot: false },
        },
        {
          id: "3",
          timestamp: "2026-07-21T03:01:00.000Z",
          content: "Bot response",
          author: { bot: true },
        },
        {
          id: "4",
          timestamp: "2026-07-21T03:02:00.000Z",
          content: "Webhook response",
          webhook_id: "webhook-id",
          author: { bot: false },
        },
      ];
    },
  });

  const snapshot = await memory.sync();
  const stored = await readFile(dataPath, "utf8");

  assert.deepEqual(requestedChannels, [{ channelId: "lobby", limit: 100 }]);
  assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(snapshot.channels), ["lobby"]);
  assert.equal(snapshot.channels.lobby.messages.length, 1);
  assert.match(snapshot.channels.lobby.messages[0].content, /\[link\] @user/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(stored, /private-chat|PrivateName|user-id/);
});

test("real-time events update only public text and never retain artifact metadata", async (t) => {
  const dataPath = testPath();
  t.after(() => rm(dataPath, { force: true }));
  const memory = new PublicDiscussionMemory({
    token: "secret",
    guildId: "guild-id",
    dataPath,
    maxMessagesPerChannel: 2,
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: "public-category", type: 4, name: "PUBLIC ROOMS", parent_id: null },
      { id: "private-category", type: 4, name: "PRIVATE", parent_id: null },
      { id: "lobby", type: 0, name: "lobby", parent_id: "public-category" },
      { id: "private-chat", type: 0, name: "private-chat", parent_id: "private-category" },
    ],
    fetchMessages: async () => [],
  });
  await memory.sync();

  assert.equal(memory.handleCreate({
    id: "1",
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    channel_id: "private-chat",
    content: "Private text",
    author: { bot: false },
  }), false);
  assert.equal(memory.handleCreate({
    id: "1",
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    channel_id: "lobby",
    content: "Public gameplay screenshot discussion",
    attachments: [{ id: "file-id", filename: "photo.png", url: "https://cdn.example/photo.png" }],
    embeds: [{ title: "Never store this" }],
    author: { id: "user-id", username: "PrivateName", bot: false },
  }), true);
  memory.handleCreate({ id: "2", guild_id: "guild-id", channel_id: "lobby", content: "Second message", author: {} });
  memory.handleCreate({ id: "3", guild_id: "guild-id", channel_id: "lobby", content: "Third message", author: {} });

  assert.equal(memory.snapshot.channels.lobby.messages.length, 2);
  assert.equal(memory.snapshot.channels.lobby.messages.some((message) => message.id === "1"), false);
  assert.equal(memory.handleUpdate({ id: "2", guild_id: "guild-id", channel_id: "lobby", content: "Edited second message" }), true);
  assert.match(memory.snapshot.channels.lobby.messages[0].content, /Edited/);
  assert.equal(memory.handleDelete({ id: "2", guild_id: "guild-id", channel_id: "lobby" }), true);

  await memory.persistCurrent();
  const stored = await readFile(dataPath, "utf8");
  assert.doesNotMatch(stored, /photo\.png|cdn\.example|Never store this|PrivateName|user-id|Private text/);
});

test("disk snapshots are skipped when public memory has not changed", async () => {
  let writes = 0;
  const memory = new PublicDiscussionMemory({
    token: "token",
    guildId: "guild-id",
    fetchChannels: async () => [
      { id: "category", type: 4, name: "PUBLIC ROOMS", parent_id: null },
      { id: "lobby", type: 0, name: "lobby", parent_id: "category" },
    ],
    fetchMessages: async () => [],
  });
  memory.persist = async () => {
    writes += 1;
  };

  await memory.sync();
  assert.equal(writes, 1);
  await memory.persistIfDirty();
  assert.equal(writes, 1);

  memory.handleCreate({
    id: "message-id",
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    channel_id: "lobby",
    timestamp: "2026-07-21T00:00:00.000Z",
    author: { bot: false },
    content: "A changed public message",
  });
  await memory.persistIfDirty();
  assert.equal(writes, 2);
  await memory.persistIfDirty();
  assert.equal(writes, 2);
});

test("public discussion memory disables itself after Discord Missing Access", async () => {
  const memory = new PublicDiscussionMemory({
    token: "token",
    guildId: "guild-id",
    fetchChannels: async () => {
      const error = new Error("Missing Access");
      error.status = 403;
      throw error;
    },
    fetchMessages: async () => [],
    logger: { warn() {} },
  });

  await memory.start();

  assert.equal(memory.disabledReason, "missing_access");
  assert.match(memory.disabledDetail, /Missing Access|View Channel and Read Message History/);

    channel_id: "lobby",
  }), false);

test("disabled public memory exposes no stale context and recovers after access returns", async () => {
  let hasAccess = false;
  let enabledCalls = 0;

  const memory = new PublicDiscussionMemory({
    token: "token",
    guildId: "guild-id",
    dataPath: "data/test-disabled-recovery-nonexistent.json",
    fetchChannels: async () => {
      if (!hasAccess) {
        const error = new Error("Missing Access");
        error.status = 403;
        throw error;
      }

      return [
        {
          id: "public-category",
          type: 4,
          name: "PUBLIC ROOMS",
          parent_id: null,
        },
        {
          id: "lobby",
          type: 0,
          name: "lobby",
          parent_id: "public-category",
        },
      ];
    },
    fetchMessages: async () => [],
    onEnabled: async () => {
      enabledCalls += 1;
    },
    logger: {
      warn() {},
    },
  });

  memory.snapshot = {
    version: 1,
    syncedAt: null,
    channels: {
      lobby: {
        name: "lobby",
        messages: [{
          id: "1",
          timestamp: "2026-07-21T00:00:00.000Z",
          content: "Legend Mod private stale text",
        }],
      },
    },
  };

  await memory.start();

  assert.equal(
    memory.disabledReason,
    "missing_access",
  );
  assert.equal(
    memory.contextFor("Legend Mod"),
    "",
  );

  hasAccess = true;
  await memory.refreshChannels();

  assert.equal(memory.disabledReason, null);
  assert.equal(memory.disabledDetail, null);
  assert.equal(enabledCalls, 1);
  assert.match(
    memory.contextFor("Legend Mod"),
    /stale text/,
  );

  await memory.stop();
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import { RecentImageMemory, isImageReferencingPrompt } from "../src/recent-image-memory.js";

test("RecentImageMemory remembers images per key and caps at maxImages", () => {
  const memory = new RecentImageMemory({ ttlMs: 60000, maxImages: 4 });

  const urls1 = memory.rememberImages({
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelId: "chan-1",
    userId: "user-1",
    imageUrls: ["https://example.com/img1.png", "https://example.com/img2.png"],
  });

  assert.deepEqual(urls1, ["https://example.com/img1.png", "https://example.com/img2.png"]);

  // Consecutive message upload accumulates correctly without type mixing
  const urls2 = memory.rememberImages({
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelId: "chan-1",
    userId: "user-1",
    imageUrls: ["https://example.com/img3.png"],
  });

  assert.deepEqual(urls2, [
    "https://example.com/img3.png",
    "https://example.com/img1.png",
    "https://example.com/img2.png",
  ]);

  const fetched = memory.getRecentImages({
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelId: "chan-1",
    userId: "user-1",
  });

  assert.deepEqual(fetched, [
    "https://example.com/img3.png",
    "https://example.com/img1.png",
    "https://example.com/img2.png",
  ]);
});

test("RecentImageMemory expires old images and isolates users", () => {
  const memory = new RecentImageMemory({ ttlMs: 100, maxImages: 4 });
  const start = 1_000;

  memory.rememberImages({
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelId: "chan-1",
    userId: "user-1",
    imageUrls: ["https://example.com/user1.png"],
  }, start);
  memory.rememberImages({
    guildId: "guild-1",
    channelId: "chan-1",
    userId: "user-2",
    imageUrls: ["https://example.com/user2.png"],
  }, start);

  assert.deepEqual(
    memory.getRecentImages({
      guildId: "guild-1",
      channelId: "chan-1",
      userId: "user-1",
    }, start + 50),
    ["https://example.com/user1.png"],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    memory.getRecentImages({
      guildId: "guild-1",
      channelId: "chan-1",
      userId: "user-2",
    }, start + 50),
    ["https://example.com/user2.png"],
  );
  assert.deepEqual(
    memory.getRecentImages({
      guildId: "guild-1",
      channelId: "chan-1",
      userId: "user-1",
    }, start + 101),
    [],
  );
});

test("isImageReferencingPrompt detects image references correctly", () => {
  assert.equal(isImageReferencingPrompt("what is in this picture?"), true);
  assert.equal(isImageReferencingPrompt("what icon is this?"), true);
  assert.equal(isImageReferencingPrompt("analyze the photo above"), true);
  assert.equal(isImageReferencingPrompt("/lc look at this image"), true);
  assert.equal(isImageReferencingPrompt("how much mass does food have?"), false);
  assert.equal(isImageReferencingPrompt("how to install Legend Mod"), false);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  isAllowedTier,
  restartExpandingLand,
} from "../src/server-actions.js";

test("restart authorization accepts only exact allowed tiers", () => {
  assert.equal(isAllowedTier("staff"), true);
  assert.equal(isAllowedTier("member"), true);
  assert.equal(isAllowedTier("candidate"), true);

  assert.equal(isAllowedTier("visitor"), false);
  assert.equal(isAllowedTier("friend"), false);
  assert.equal(
    isAllowedTier(
      "The requester is a Discord community visitor. Explain LC-specific terms and do not assume member access.",
    ),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(
    isAllowedTier(
      "The requester is a friend of LC. Be welcoming, but do not assume official member access.",
    ),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(isAllowedTier(null), false);
  assert.equal(isAllowedTier(undefined), false);
});

test("failed restarts do not start cooldowns and concurrent restarts are blocked", async () => {
  let callback;
  let executions = 0;

  const execImpl = (
    _command,
    _options,
    done,
  ) => {
    executions += 1;
    callback = done;
  };

  const now = () => 100_000;

  const first = restartExpandingLand(
    "first-user",
    {
      execImpl,
      now,
    },
  );

  const concurrent =
    await restartExpandingLand(
      "second-user",
      {
        execImpl,
        now,
      },
    );

  assert.match(
    concurrent,
    /already in progress/i,
  );
  assert.equal(executions, 1);

  callback(
    new Error("systemctl failed"),
  );

  assert.match(
    await first,
    /Restart failed/,
  );

  const retry = restartExpandingLand(
    "third-user",
    {
      execImpl,
      now,
    },
  );

  assert.equal(executions, 2);

  callback(
    new Error("still failing"),
  );

  assert.match(
    await retry,
    /Restart failed/,
  );
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import {
  readFile,
  rm,
  writeFile,
} from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  UserQuestionMemory,
} from "../src/user-question-memory.js";

function interaction(userId) {
  return {
    guild_id: "guild-id",
    member: {
      user: {
        id: userId,
        username: `name-${userId}`,
      },
    },
  };
}

function testPath() {
  return join(
    tmpdir(),
    [
      "discord-user-memory",
      process.pid,
      Date.now(),
      Math.random(),
    ].join("-") + ".json",
  );
}

test(
  "conversation memory separates users and stores no raw Discord identity",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();

    t.after(() =>
      rm(dataPath, { force: true }),
    );

    const memory =
      new UserQuestionMemory({ dataPath });

    await memory.remember(
      interaction("user-alice"),
      "Who founded LC?",
      "Jimboy3100 founded LC. See https://example.com/private",
    );

    await memory.remember(
      interaction("user-bob"),
      "What is Expanding Land?",
      "It is an independent browser game.",
    );

    assert.deepEqual(
      memory.messagesFor(
        interaction("user-alice"),
      ),
      [
        {
          role: "user",
          content: "Who founded LC?",
        },
        {
          role: "assistant",
          content:
            "Jimboy3100 founded LC. See [link]",
        },
      ],
    );

    assert.doesNotMatch(
      memory.contextFor(
        interaction("user-alice"),
      ),
      /Expanding Land/,
    );

    const stored =
      await readFile(dataPath, "utf8");

    assert.doesNotMatch(
      stored,
      /user-alice|user-bob|name-user|example\.com/,
    );

    assert.equal(
      Object.keys(
        JSON.parse(stored).users,
      ).every(
        (key) => /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(key),
      ),
      true,
    );
  },
);

test(
  "conversation memory caps each user and expires old turns",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();

    t.after(() =>
      rm(dataPath, { force: true }),
    );

    let now = Date.UTC(2026, 6, 21);

    const memory = new UserQuestionMemory({
      dataPath,
      maxTurnsPerUser: 2,
      retentionMs:
        30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
      now: () => now,
    });

    const user = interaction("user-id");

    await memory.remember(
      user,
      "First question",
      "First answer",
    );

    await memory.remember(
      user,
      "Second question",
      "Second answer",
    );

    await memory.remember(
      user,
      "Third question",
      "Third answer",
    );

    const messages =
      memory.messagesFor(user);

    assert.equal(messages.length, 4);

    assert.doesNotMatch(
      JSON.stringify(messages),
      /First/,
    );

    assert.match(
      JSON.stringify(messages),
      /Second/,
    );

    assert.match(
      JSON.stringify(messages),
      /Third/,
    );

    now +=
      31 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

    assert.deepEqual(
      memory.messagesFor(user),
      [],
    );
  },
);

test(
  "conversation memory obeys its character budget and reloads from disk",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();

    t.after(() =>
      rm(dataPath, { force: true }),
    );

    const user = interaction("user-id");

    const memory = new UserQuestionMemory({
      dataPath,
      maxContextChars: 120,
    });

    await memory.remember(
      user,
      "Earlier question about Agar.io",
      "Earlier answer about Agar.io strategy",
    );

    await memory.remember(
      user,
      "Latest question about Legend Mod",
      "Latest answer about Legend Mod FPS",
    );

    const reloaded =
      new UserQuestionMemory({
        dataPath,
        maxContextChars: 120,
      });

    await reloaded.start();

    const messages =
      reloaded.messagesFor(user);

    assert.match(
      JSON.stringify(messages),
      /Latest question/,
    );

    assert.match(
      JSON.stringify(messages),
      /Latest answer/,
    );

    assert.ok(
      messages.reduce(
        (sum, message) =>
          sum + message.content.length,
        0,
      ) <= 120,
    );
  },
);

test(
  "old question-only snapshots are replaced safely",
  async (t) => {
    const dataPath = testPath();

    t.after(() =>
      rm(dataPath, { force: true }),
    );

    await writeFile(
      dataPath,
      JSON.stringify({
        version: 1,
        users: {
          ["a".repeat(64)]: {
            questions: [
              {
                text: "Old question",
                at: Date.now(),
              },
            ],
          },
        },
      }),
    );

    const memory =
      new UserQuestionMemory({
        dataPath,
        logger: {
          warn() {},
        },
      });

    await memory.start();

    assert.deepEqual(
      memory.snapshot.users,
      {},
    );

    assert.equal(
      JSON.parse(
        await readFile(dataPath, "utf8"),
      ).version,
      2,
    );
  },
);

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  extractWeatherRequest,
  fetchWeatherAnswer,
  fetchWeatherContext,
  WeatherContextError,
} from "../src/weather-context.js";

test("extractWeatherRequest ignores non-weather questions", () => {
  assert.equal(extractWeatherRequest("how do i install legend mod?"), null);
});

test("extractWeatherRequest pulls location and timing from explicit weather questions", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    extractWeatherRequest("what is the weather in Athens today?"),
    {
      question: "what is the weather in Athens today?",
      location: "Athens",
      timing: "today",
    },
  );
});

test("fetchWeatherContext rejects weather questions without a location", async () => {
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchWeatherContext("what is the weather today?"),
    (error) => error instanceof WeatherContextError
      && error.message === "Ask for weather with a location, for example: weather in Athens.",
  );
});

test("fetchWeatherContext returns bounded Open-Meteo context", async () => {
  const calls = [];
  const context = await fetchWeatherContext("weather in Athens today", {
    fetchImpl: async (url) => {
      calls.push(String(url));

      if (String(url).startsWith("https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/")) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          json: async () => ({
            results: [
              {
                name: "Athens",
                admin1: "Attica",
                country: "Greece",
                latitude: 37.98,
                longitude: 23.72,
                timezone: "Europe/Athens",
              },
            ],
          }),
        };
      }

      return {
        ok: true,
        json: async () => ({
          timezone: "Europe/Athens",
          current: {
            time: "2026-07-26T15:00",
            weather_code: 1,
            temperature_2m: 32.4,
            apparent_temperature: 34.1,
            relative_humidity_2m: 38,
            precipitation: 0,
            rain: 0,
            showers: 0,
            snowfall: 0,
            wind_speed_10m: 14.2,
            wind_direction_10m: 270,
            wind_gusts_10m: 22.5,
          },
          daily: {
            time: ["2026-07-26", "2026-07-27"],
            weather_code: [1, 3],
            temperature_2m_max: [34.2, 33.1],
            temperature_2m_min: [24.4, 23.8],
            precipitation_probability_max: [5, 20],
            precipitation_sum: [0, 0.8],
            wind_speed_10m_max: [24, 28],
            sunrise: ["2026-07-26T06:18", "2026-07-27T06:19"],
            sunset: ["2026-07-26T20:39", "2026-07-27T20:38"],
          },
        }),
      };
    },
  });

  assert.equal(calls.length, 2);
  assert.match(context, /Weather data fetched from Open-Meteo/);
  assert.match(context, /Resolved place: Athens, Attica, Greece/);
  assert.match(context, /Timing hint from requester: today/);
  assert.match(context, /Conditions: mainly clear/);
  assert.match(context, /Temperature: 32\.4C/);
  assert.match(context, /Today: 2026-07-26: mainly clear/);
  assert.match(context, /Tomorrow: 2026-07-27: overcast/);
});

test("fetchWeatherAnswer returns a deterministic direct answer", async () => {
  const answer = await fetchWeatherAnswer("weather in Thessaloniki today", {
    fetchImpl: async (url) => {
      if (String(url).startsWith("https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/")) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          json: async () => ({
            results: [
              {
                name: "Thessaloniki",
                admin1: "Central Macedonia",
                country: "Greece",
                latitude: 40.64,
                longitude: 22.94,
                timezone: "Europe/Athens",
              },
            ],
          }),
        };
      }

      return {
        ok: true,
        json: async () => ({
          timezone: "Europe/Athens",
          current: {
            time: "2026-07-27T18:00",
            weather_code: 1,
            temperature_2m: 31.2,
            apparent_temperature: 33.5,
            relative_humidity_2m: 41,
            wind_speed_10m: 18.4,
          },
          daily: {
            time: ["2026-07-27", "2026-07-28"],
            weather_code: [1, 2],
            temperature_2m_max: [32.8, 31.9],
            temperature_2m_min: [23.1, 22.7],
            precipitation_probability_max: [10, 20],
            wind_speed_10m_max: [26, 24],
            sunrise: ["2026-07-27T06:20", "2026-07-28T06:21"],
            sunset: ["2026-07-27T20:51", "2026-07-28T20:50"],
          },
        }),
      };
    },
  });

  assert.match(answer, /^Thessaloniki, Central Macedonia, Greece: currently 31\.2C, mainly clear/);
  assert.match(answer, /Today: max 32\.8C, min 23\.1C, rain chance 10%, max wind 26 km\/h\./);
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  extractWebSearchRequest,
  fetchWebSearchContext,
  WebSearchError,
} from "../src/web-search-context.js";

test("extractWebSearchRequest only matches explicit search wording", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    extractWebSearchRequest("google whether legend mod express is on the chrome web store"),
    { query: "legend mod express is on the chrome web store" },
  );

  assert.deepEqual(
    extractWebSearchRequest("search the web for agar.io anti team rules"),
    { query: "agar.io anti team rules" },
  );

  assert.equal(
    extractWebSearchRequest("is legend mod safe"),
    null,
  );
});

test("fetchWebSearchContext returns bounded result snippets", async () => {
  const context = await fetchWebSearchContext(
    "google whether legend mod express is on the chrome web store",
    {
      fetchImpl: async () => ({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }),
        text: async () => `
          <html><body>
            <a class="result__a" href="https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/legend-express/id123">Legend Express - Chrome Web Store</a>
            <a class="result__snippet">Install Legend Express directly from the Chrome Web Store.</a>
            <a class="result__a" href="https://www.legendmod.ml/">Legend Mod official site</a>
            <a class="result__snippet">Official Legend Mod links and install guidance.</a>
          </body></html>`,
      }),
    },
  );

  assert.match(context, /Public web search results fetched for this request only/);
  assert.match(context, /Query: legend mod express is on the chrome web store/);
  assert.match(context, /1\. Legend Express - Chrome Web Store/);
  assert.match(context, /URL: https:\/\/chromewebstore\.google\.com\/detail\/legend-express\/id123/);
  assert.match(context, /Snippet: Install Legend Express directly from the Chrome Web Store\./);
});

test("fetchWebSearchContext reports unusable results cleanly", async () => {
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchWebSearchContext("search the web for legend mod express", {
      fetchImpl: async () => ({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }),
        text: async () => "<html><body>No results here</body></html>",
      }),
    }),
    (error) => error instanceof WebSearchError && error.message === "The web search did not return usable results.",
  );
});

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  extractWebpageRequest,
  fetchWebpageContext,
  WebpageFetchError,
} from "../src/webpage-context.js";

test("extractWebpageRequest only matches explicit public webpage questions", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    extractWebpageRequest("read this page https://example.com/post"),
    { url: "https://example.com/post" },
  );

  assert.deepEqual(
    extractWebpageRequest("https://example.com/post"),
    { url: "https://example.com/post" },
  );

  assert.equal(
    extractWebpageRequest("legend mod update without a link"),
    null,
  );
});

test("fetchWebpageContext returns a bounded extract for public HTML pages", async () => {
  const context = await fetchWebpageContext(
    "what does this page say https://example.com/news",
    {
      resolveHostname: async () => [{ address: "93.184.216.34" }],
      fetchImpl: async () => ({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        headers: new Headers({ "content-type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" }),
        text: async () => `
          <html>
            <head>
              <title>Legend News</title>
              <meta name="description" content="Short public summary.">
            </head>
            <body>
              <h1>Patch Notes</h1>
              <p>Critical fixes are under development.</p>
              <script>window.secret = "ignore me"</script>
            </body>
          </html>`,
      }),
    },
  );

  assert.match(context, /Public webpage extract fetched for this request only/);
  assert.match(context, /URL: https:\/\/example\.com\/news/);
  assert.match(context, /Title: Legend News/);
  assert.match(context, /Description: Short public summary\./);
  assert.match(context, /Patch Notes/);
  assert.match(context, /Critical fixes are under development\./);
  assert.doesNotMatch(context, /window\.secret/);
});

test("fetchWebpageContext rejects localhost and private pages", async () => {
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchWebpageContext("read this page http://localhost:8080/secret"),
    (error) => error instanceof WebpageFetchError && error.message === "Local or private webpages are not allowed.",
  );
});

test("fetchWebpageContext enforces the trusted domain allowlist", async () => {
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchWebpageContext("read this page https://example.com/news", {
      allowedDomains: ["legendmod.ml", "github.com"],
      resolveHostname: async () => [{ address: "93.184.216.34" }],
      fetchImpl: async () => {
        throw new Error("fetch should not run");
      },
    }),
    (error) => error instanceof WebpageFetchError && error.message === "That domain is not in the trusted allowlist.",
  );
});

test(
  "fetchWebpageContext revalidates redirects and blocks a redirect to localhost",
  async () => {
    let calls = 0;

    await assert.rejects(
      () => fetchWebpageContext(
        "read this page https://example.com/start",
        {
          resolveHostname:
            async (hostname) => (
              hostname === "example.com"
                ? [{
                    address:
                      "93.184.216.34",
                  }]
                : [{
                    address:
                      "127.0.0.1",
                  }]
            ),
          fetchImpl: async () => {
            calls += 1;

            return {
              ok: false,
              status: 302,
              headers: new Headers({
                location:
                  "http://localhost:8080/private",
              }),
              text: async () => "",
            };
          },
        },
      ),
      (error) =>
        error instanceof WebpageFetchError
        && error.message
          === "Local or private webpages are not allowed.",
    );

    assert.equal(calls, 1);
  },
);

test(
  "fetchWebpageContext requests manual redirect handling",
  async () => {
    let requestOptions;

    await fetchWebpageContext(
      "read this page https://example.com/start",
      {
        resolveHostname:
          async () => [{
            address: "93.184.216.34",
          }],
        fetchImpl:
          async (_url, options) => {
            requestOptions = options;

            return {
              ok: true,
              status: 200,
              headers: new Headers({
                "content-type":
                  "text/plain",
              }),
              text:
                async () => "hello",
            };
          },
      },
    );

    assert.equal(
      requestOptions.redirect,
      "manual",
    );
  },
);

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import test from "node:test";

import {
  WIKIDATA_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS,
  WIKIDATA_MAX_RESULTS,
  extractWikidataRequest,
  fetchWikidataContext,
} from "../src/wikidata-context.js";

test("extractWikidataRequest ignores unrelated questions", () => {
  assert.equal(extractWikidataRequest("what is the weather in Thessaloniki?"), null);
  assert.equal(extractWikidataRequest("show latest commits for openai/openai-node"), null);
});

test("extractWikidataRequest parses explicit Wikidata prompts", () => {
  assert.deepEqual(
    extractWikidataRequest("search wikidata for Alan Turing"),
    { query: "Alan Turing" },
  );
});

test("fetchWikidataContext returns a bounded Wikidata snapshot", async () => {
  const fetchCalls = [];

  const context = await fetchWikidataContext("search wikidata for Alan Turing", {
    fetchImpl: async (url, options) => {
      fetchCalls.push({ url: String(url), options });

      if (String(url).startsWith("https://www.wikidata.org/w/api.php?")) {
        return {
          ok: true,
          status: 200,
          json: async () => ({
            search: [
              {
                id: "Q7251",
                label: "Alan Turing",
                description: "English mathematician and computer scientist",
                concepturi: "https://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q7251",
              },
            ],
          }),
        };
      }

      if (String(url) === "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Special:EntityData/Q7251.json") {
        return {
          ok: true,
          status: 200,
          json: async () => ({
            entities: {
              Q7251: {
                aliases: {
                  en: [
                    { value: "A. M. Turing" },
                  ],
                },
                sitelinks: {
                  enwiki: { title: "Alan Turing" },
                  commonswiki: { title: "Alan Turing" },
                },
              },
            },
          }),
        };
      }

      throw new Error(`Unexpected URL: ${url}`);
    },
  });

  assert.equal(fetchCalls.length, 2);
  assert.match(fetchCalls[0].url, /search=Alan\+Turing/);
  assert.match(fetchCalls[0].url, new RegExp(`limit=${WIKIDATA_MAX_RESULTS}`));
  assert.equal(fetchCalls[0].options.headers.accept, "application/json");
  assert.ok(fetchCalls[0].options.signal);
  assert.match(context, /Wikidata data fetched for this request only:/);
  assert.match(context, /Query: Alan Turing/);
  assert.match(context, /Top entity ID: Q7251/);
  assert.match(context, /Label: Alan Turing/);
  assert.match(context, /Description: English mathematician and computer scientist/);
  assert.match(context, /Aliases: A\. M\. Turing/);
  assert.match(context, /English Wikipedia title: Alan Turing/);
  assert.match(context, new RegExp(`Limits: timeout ${WIKIDATA_LOOKUP_TIMEOUT_MS}ms\\. Results ${WIKIDATA_MAX_RESULTS}\\.`));
});

test("fetchWikidataContext returns a clean error when no entity matches", async () => {
  await assert.rejects(
    () => fetchWikidataContext("search wikidata for asdfghjkl", {
      fetchImpl: async () => ({
        ok: true,
        status: 200,
        json: async () => ({ search: [] }),
      }),
    }),
    /Wikidata did not return a matching entity\./,
  );
});
