    /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     *  INIT
     * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
    var readyTimer = setInterval(function () {
        if (!document.getElementById('canvas')) return;
        clearInterval(readyTimer);
        boot(); /* Boot immediately — canvas is ready */
    }, 250);

    function boot() {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
        if (!canvas) return;

        /* ── Lock down browser zoom ── */
        // Force viewport meta (iOS 10+ ignores user-scalable=no, so we also use gesturestart)
        var vp = document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]');
        if (vp) {
            vp.setAttribute('content',
                'width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,maximum-scale=1.0,user-scalable=no');
        }
        // Safari/iOS: prevent native pinch-zoom gesture

        /* ── Scale #helloContainer to fit viewport (preserves internal layout) ── */
        (function fitHelloContainer() {
            function fit() {
                var hc = document.getElementById('helloContainer');
                if (!hc) return;
                /* Skip re-fit when an input/textarea inside helloContainer is focused.
                 * The mobile keyboard shrinks innerHeight, which would rescale the
                 * container to a tiny size, effectively hiding it. */
                var active = document.activeElement;
                if (active && (active.tagName === 'INPUT' || active.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || active.tagName === 'SELECT')) {
                    if (hc.contains(active)) return;
                }
                var vw = window.innerWidth;
                var vh = window.innerHeight;
                var baseW = 740; // original width from legend.css
                var baseH = hc.scrollHeight || 600; // actual content height
                var ratioW = (vw - 16) / baseW;
                var ratioH = (vh - 16) / baseH;
                var ratio = Math.min(1, ratioW, ratioH);
                hc.style.transform = 'translate(-50%,-50%) scale(' + ratio + ')';
                hc.style.transformOrigin = 'center center';
                hc.style.position = 'fixed';
                hc.style.top = '50%';
                hc.style.left = '50%';
                hc.style.maxHeight = Math.floor(vh / ratio) + 'px';
                hc.style.overflowY = 'auto';
            }
            /* Expose globally so other code (menu toggle) can call it instantly */
            window._lm_fitHC = fit;
            fit();
            setInterval(fit, 4000); /* slow fallback — main triggers are events below */
            window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
            window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { requestAnimationFrame(fit); });
        })();
        /* ── Mobile visual overrides: proportional to user settings ── */
        (function mobileVisuals() {
            function apply() {
                if (typeof defaultSettings !== 'undefined') {
                    // Grid: keep user's color, reduce opacity proportionally (×0.3)
                    var gc = defaultSettings.gridColor || '#00243e';
                    if (gc.indexOf('rgba') === 0) {
                        // Extract rgba components, multiply alpha by 0.3
                        var parts = gc.replace(/rgba?\(/, '').replace(')', '').split(',');
                        var a = parseFloat(parts[3] || 1) * 0.3;
                        defaultSettings.gridColor = 'rgba(' + parts[0].trim() + ',' +
                            parts[1].trim() + ',' + parts[2].trim() + ',' + a.toFixed(2) + ')';
                    } else {
                        // Hex or named color — wrap in rgba with low alpha
                        defaultSettings.gridColor = 'rgba(0,36,62,.15)';
                    }

                    // FoodSize: proportional (60% of user's setting, min 1)
                    var userFood = defaultSettings.foodSize || 5;
                    defaultSettings.foodSize = Math.max(1, Math.round(userFood * 0.6));
                }
                if (typeof defaultmapsettings !== 'undefined') {
                    defaultmapsettings.showBgSectors = false; // no sector background
                }
            }
            apply();
            /* Re-apply after theme loads — observe for defaultSettings changes */
            if (typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined') {
              var _themeObs = new MutationObserver(function() { apply(); });
              _themeObs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
              setTimeout(function() { _themeObs.disconnect(); }, 10000);
            }
        })();

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  MOBILE INPUT FIX — disable autocomplete on ALL inputs/textareas
         *  Prevents browser from suggesting passwords/cards/GPS on mobile.
         *  Does NOT set readonly — inputs stay fully clickable and pasteable.
         *  Only runs on mobile (this file is gated by touch check).
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        (function mobileInputFix() {
            function fixInput(el) {
                if (!el || el._lmFixed) return;
                el._lmFixed = true;
                /* Android Autofill Framework ignores autocomplete="off".
                 * Using "one-time-code" tricks it into suppressing all
                 * autofill suggestions (passwords, cards, GPS). Paste still works. */
                el.setAttribute('autocomplete', 'one-time-code');
                el.setAttribute('autocorrect', 'off');
                el.setAttribute('autocapitalize', 'off');
                el.setAttribute('spellcheck', 'false');
                /* Suppress third-party password managers */
                el.setAttribute('data-lpignore', 'true');      /* LastPass */
                el.setAttribute('data-1p-ignore', '');          /* 1Password */
                el.setAttribute('data-form-type', 'other');     /* Dashlane */
            }

            function scanAll() {
                var inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input, textarea');
                for (var i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) fixInput(inputs[i]);
            }

            /* Remove autofocus from nick input so keyboard doesn't open on load */
            var nickInput = document.getElementById('nick');
            if (nickInput) { nickInput.removeAttribute('autofocus'); nickInput.blur(); }

            /* Scan now + re-scan for dynamically created inputs */
            scanAll();
            /* MutationObserver already re-scans on DOM changes — no extra delays needed */

            /* MutationObserver for inputs created after DOM ready (e.g. #skin by ogario) */
            var obs = new MutationObserver(function () { scanAll(); });
            obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
            /* stop observing after 30s to save resources */
            setTimeout(function () { obs.disconnect(); }, 30000);
        })();

        document.addEventListener('gesturestart', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
        document.addEventListener('gesturechange', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });
        document.addEventListener('gestureend', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); }, { passive: false });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  DEVICE TIERING
         *  Low-end (≤2 cores): disable expensive effects
         *  Everyone else: full quality
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var cores = navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4;
        if (cores <= 2) {
            window.LM_LOW_END = true;
            var lowCSS = document.createElement('style');
            lowCSS.textContent = '*{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}';
            document.head.appendChild(lowCSS);
        }
        /* (HiDPI canvas requires changes to ogario.v4.js resizeCanvas — cannot be patched externally) */

        /* ── Fullscreen + Landscape helper ──
         * Works in browser; gracefully degrades in Google Play WebView/TWA
         * where fullscreen/orientation are handled by AndroidManifest instead */
        function goFullscreenLandscape() {
            try {
                var el = document.documentElement;
                var rfs = el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen || el.msRequestFullscreen;
                if (rfs && !document.fullscreenElement && !document.webkitFullscreenElement) {
                    rfs.call(el).then(function () {
                        try { screen.orientation.lock('landscape').catch(function () { }); } catch (e) { }
                    }).catch(function () { });
                }
            } catch (e) { }
        }

        /* ── Auto-fullscreen on Play button tap ── */
        (function hookPlayButtons() {
            function hook(btn) {
                if (!btn || btn._lmHooked) return;
                btn._lmHooked = true;
                btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                    goFullscreenLandscape();
                }, { passive: true });
                btn.addEventListener('touchstart', function () {
                    goFullscreenLandscape();
                }, { passive: true });
            }
            function scan() {
                // Hook all Play-type buttons
                var selectors = ['.btn-play', '.btn-play-guest', '.btn-login-play',
                    '#btn-play', '#btn-play-guest', '#btn-login-play'];
                selectors.forEach(function (s) {
                    var btns = document.querySelectorAll(s);
                    for (var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) hook(btns[i]);
                });
            }
            scan();
            /* MutationObserver handles late-loading buttons */
            var _btnObs = new MutationObserver(function() { scan(); });
            _btnObs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
            setTimeout(function() { _btnObs.disconnect(); }, 30000);
        })();

        /* ── Persistent portrait overlay (replaces one-time toast) ── */
        var portOv = mk('div'); portOv.id = 'lm-portrait-ov';
        portOv.innerHTML = '<div class="icon">📱</div>' +
            'Rotate your phone<br>for better gameplay' +
            '<div style="font-size:13px;opacity:.6;margin-top:8px">Landscape mode required</div>';
        document.body.appendChild(portOv);

        function checkOrientation() {
            var isPortrait = window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth;
            var isPlaying = !isMenuVisible();
            if (isPortrait && isPlaying) {
                portOv.classList.add('on');
            } else {
                portOv.classList.remove('on');
            }
        }
        window.addEventListener('resize', checkOrientation);
        window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { requestAnimationFrame(checkOrientation); });
        /* No recurring fallback needed — resize + orientationchange events cover it */

        /* ── Wake Lock (prevent screen from sleeping during gameplay) ── */
        var wakeLock = null;
        function requestWakeLock() {
            try {
                if ('wakeLock' in navigator) {
                    navigator.wakeLock.request('screen').then(function (wl) {
                        wakeLock = wl;
                    }).catch(function () { });
                }
            } catch (e) { }
        }
        requestWakeLock();
        // Re-acquire on tab becoming visible again
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
            if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') requestWakeLock();
        });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  DOM — Game-controller layout
         *
         *  LEFT  (#lm-mc-l) — utilities:  ☰ 💬 ⛶  /  🤖 ⏸
         *  RIGHT (#lm-mc-r) — actions:    [2×][16×] / ⚔ / ⬤
         *
         *  Left thumb  = joystick (canvas touch)
         *  Right thumb = combat actions (split / feed)
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  USER PREFERENCES (localStorage)
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var PREF_KEY = 'lm-mobile-prefs';
        var prefs = { jsSensitivity: 300, btnOpacity: 0.65, btnScale: 1.0, hudFade: 0.5, targetMode: false };
        try {
            var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PREF_KEY));
            if (saved) {
                if (saved.jsSensitivity !== undefined) prefs.jsSensitivity = saved.jsSensitivity;
                if (saved.btnOpacity !== undefined) prefs.btnOpacity = saved.btnOpacity;
                if (saved.btnScale !== undefined) prefs.btnScale = saved.btnScale;
                if (saved.hudFade !== undefined) prefs.hudFade = saved.hudFade;
                if (saved.targetMode !== undefined) prefs.targetMode = saved.targetMode;
            }
        } catch (e) { }
        function savePrefs() {
            try { localStorage.setItem(PREF_KEY, JSON.stringify(prefs)); } catch (e) { }
        }

        /* ── LEFT side: ☰ menu + hidden drawer ── */
        var rootL = mk('div'); rootL.id = 'lm-mc-l';
        document.body.appendChild(rootL);

        /* drawer: secondary buttons (hidden by default, opens right) */
        var drawer = mk('div'); drawer.id = 'lm-drawer';

        function mkd(label) {
            var b = mk('div'); b.className = 'lm-d lm-b';
            b.textContent = label;
            return b;
        }
        var bChat = mkd('💬');
        var bAI = mkd('►');
        var bPaus = mkd('❚❚');
        
        drawer.appendChild(bAI);
        drawer.appendChild(bPaus);
        drawer.appendChild(bChat);

        var bStop = mkd(prefs.targetMode ? '⌖' : '⇶');
        bStop.style.display = 'none';
        drawer.appendChild(bStop);
        
        bStop.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            prefs.targetMode = !prefs.targetMode;
            bStop.textContent = prefs.targetMode ? '⌖' : '⇶';
            savePrefs();
        }, { passive: false });

        /* ☰ menu button: leftmost, always visible, toggles helloContainer */
        var bMenu = mkb('☰', null, true);
        rootL.appendChild(bMenu);
        rootL.appendChild(drawer);

        /* ── Settings panel: inside drawer (no fixed position) ── */
        var sp = mk('div'); sp.id = 'lm-sp';
        sp.innerHTML =
            '<label>Joystick <span id="lm-js-v">' + prefs.jsSensitivity + '</span></label>' +
            '<input type="range" id="lm-js" min="100" max="600" step="25" value="' + prefs.jsSensitivity + '">' +
            '<label>Opacity <span id="lm-op-v">' + Math.round(prefs.btnOpacity * 100) + '%</span></label>' +
            '<input type="range" id="lm-op" min="20" max="100" step="5" value="' + Math.round(prefs.btnOpacity * 100) + '">' +
            '<label>Btn Size <span id="lm-bs-v">' + Math.round(prefs.btnScale * 100) + '%</span></label>' +
            '<input type="range" id="lm-bs" min="50" max="150" step="5" value="' + Math.round(prefs.btnScale * 100) + '">' +
            '<label>HUD Fade <span id="lm-hf-v">' + Math.round(prefs.hudFade * 100) + '%</span></label>' +
            '<input type="range" id="lm-hf" min="20" max="100" step="5" value="' + Math.round(prefs.hudFade * 100) + '">';
        drawer.appendChild(sp);

        function applyPrefs() {
            rootL.style.opacity = prefs.btnOpacity;
            rootR.style.opacity = prefs.btnOpacity;
            smallR.style.opacity = prefs.btnOpacity;
            rootL.style.transform = 'scale(' + prefs.btnScale + ')';
            rootL.style.transformOrigin = 'bottom left';
            rootR.style.transform = 'scale(' + prefs.btnScale + ')';
            rootR.style.transformOrigin = 'bottom right';
            smallR.style.transform = 'scale(' + prefs.btnScale + ')';
            smallR.style.transformOrigin = 'bottom right';
        }

        /* slider handlers */
        sp.querySelector('#lm-js').addEventListener('input', function () {
            prefs.jsSensitivity = parseInt(this.value);
            sp.querySelector('#lm-js-v').textContent = this.value;
            savePrefs();
        });
        sp.querySelector('#lm-op').addEventListener('input', function () {
            prefs.btnOpacity = parseInt(this.value) / 100;
            sp.querySelector('#lm-op-v').textContent = this.value + '%';
            applyPrefs(); savePrefs();
        });
        sp.querySelector('#lm-bs').addEventListener('input', function () {
            prefs.btnScale = parseInt(this.value) / 100;
            sp.querySelector('#lm-bs-v').textContent = this.value + '%';
            applyPrefs(); savePrefs();
        });
        sp.querySelector('#lm-hf').addEventListener('input', function () {
            prefs.hudFade = parseInt(this.value) / 100;
            sp.querySelector('#lm-hf-v').textContent = this.value + '%';
            savePrefs();
        });

        /* ── RIGHT side: SPLIT + FEED (positioned by JS relative to minimap) ── */
        var rootR = mk('div'); rootR.id = 'lm-mc-r';
        document.body.appendChild(rootR);

        var bSplit = mkb('⚔', 'SPLIT', false);
        var bFeed = mkb('⬤', 'FEED', false);
        rootR.appendChild(bSplit);
        rootR.appendChild(bFeed);

        /* ── SMALL ROW: 4× + 16× (positioned by JS above minimap) ── */
        var smallR = mk('div'); smallR.id = 'lm-mc-sm';
        document.body.appendChild(smallR);

        var bDbl = mks('4×');
        var b16 = mks('16×');
        smallR.appendChild(bDbl);
        smallR.appendChild(b16);

        var jO = mk('div'); jO.className = 'lm-jo'; document.body.appendChild(jO);
        var jI = mk('div'); jI.className = 'lm-ji'; document.body.appendChild(jI);

        var zP = mk('div'); zP.className = 'lm-z'; document.body.appendChild(zP);
        var zT = null;

        var cBar = mk('div'); cBar.id = 'lm-cb';
        cBar.innerHTML = '';
        document.body.appendChild(cBar);

        /* apply initial prefs */
        applyPrefs();

        /* ── Press effects ── */
        [bMenu, bChat, bSplit, bFeed, bDbl, b16, bAI, bPaus].forEach(function (b) {
            b.addEventListener('touchstart', function () { b.classList.add('p'); }, { passive: true });
            b.addEventListener('touchend', function () { b.classList.remove('p'); }, { passive: true });
            b.addEventListener('touchcancel', function () { b.classList.remove('p'); }, { passive: true });
        });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  MENU — toggles helloContainer (show/hide game menu)
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        bMenu.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            // Restore opacity immediately so button responds on first tap
            rootL.style.opacity = prefs.btnOpacity;
            var hc = document.getElementById('helloContainer');
            if (hc) {
                if (hc.style.display === 'none' || hc.style.display === '') {
                    hc.style.display = 'block';
                    if (window._lm_fitHC) window._lm_fitHC(); /* scale instantly */
                    if (typeof application !== 'undefined' && application.showMenu) {
                        application.showMenu();
                    }
                } else {
                    hc.style.display = 'none';
                }
            } else {
                emitKey(27); // fallback: ESC
            }
        }, { passive: false });

        /* (fullscreen toggled via goFullscreenLandscape on Play button tap) */

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  BUTTON DEBOUNCE — prevents accidental double-fires
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var lastAction = 0;
        var DEBOUNCE = 150; // ms
        function debounced(fn) {
            var now = Date.now();
            if (now - lastAction < DEBOUNCE) return;
            lastAction = now;
            fn();
        }

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  SPLIT — Space (keyCode 32)
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        bSplit.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            debounced(function () { emitKey(32); });
        }, { passive: false });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  DOUBLE SPLIT — calls application.doubleSplit()
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        bDbl.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            debounced(function () {
                if (typeof application !== 'undefined' && application.doubleSplit)
                    application.doubleSplit();
            });
        }, { passive: false });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  SPLIT 16 — calls application.split16()
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        b16.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            debounced(function () {
                if (typeof application !== 'undefined' && application.split16)
                    application.split16();
            });
        }, { passive: false });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  AUTOPLAY — calls application.setAutoPlay()
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        bAI.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            if (typeof application !== 'undefined' && application.setAutoPlay) {
                application.setAutoPlay();
                bAI.classList.toggle('lm-active');
            }
        }, { passive: false });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  PAUSE — calls application.setPause()
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        bPaus.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            if (typeof application !== 'undefined' && application.setPause) {
                application.setPause();
                bPaus.classList.toggle('lm-active');
            }
        }, { passive: false });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  FEED — W (keyCode 87), hold to repeat
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var feedIv = null;
        bFeed.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            emitKey(87);
            feedIv = setInterval(function () { emitKey(87); }, 50);
        }, { passive: false });
        bFeed.addEventListener('touchend', function () { clearInterval(feedIv); feedIv = null; }, { passive: true });
        bFeed.addEventListener('touchcancel', function () { clearInterval(feedIv); feedIv = null; }, { passive: true });

        /* (game menu is accessed via the drawer — ☰ now only toggles the drawer) */

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  CHAT — Enter (keyCode 13)
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var chatOn = false;

        bChat.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
            chatOn ? chatClose() : chatOpen();
        }, { passive: false });

        function chatOpen() {
            chatOn = true;
            // Open chat box — dispatch Enter on document to open game's chat
            emitKey(13);
            // Focus immediately (user gesture context) for Firefox
            var inp = document.getElementById('message');
            if (inp) {
                inp.focus();
            }
            // Re-focus after game finishes setup + add Enter handler
            setTimeout(function () {
                var inp2 = document.getElementById('message');
                if (inp2) {
                    inp2.focus();
                    inp2.addEventListener('keydown', function onEnter(ev) {
                        if (ev.keyCode === 13 || ev.key === 'Enter') {
                            inp2.removeEventListener('keydown', onEnter);
                            setTimeout(function () { chatClose(); }, 50);
                        }
                    });
                }
            }, 120);
        }

        function chatClose() {
            var inp = document.getElementById('message');
            if (inp && inp.value.length > 0) {
                // Send the message by dispatching Enter on the input
                var ev = document.createEvent('Event');
                ev.initEvent('keydown', true, true);
                ev.keyCode = 13;
                ev.which = 13;
                ev.key = 'Enter';
                inp.dispatchEvent(ev);
            }
            if (inp) inp.blur();
            chatOn = false;

            /* LW: After 50ms, check if the game's chat UI is still visible.
             * Mobile keyboard "OK" sends the message but the chat box stays open
             * because the game expects a document-level Enter to close it. */
            setTimeout(function () {
                var msgBox = document.getElementById('message');
                if (msgBox && (msgBox.offsetParent !== null || msgBox.offsetHeight > 0)) {
                    emitKey(13);
                }
            }, 50);
        }

        // Tap canvas while chatting → send & close
        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            if (chatOn) {
                e.preventDefault();
                chatClose();
            }
        }, { passive: false });

        /* (fullscreen toggle handled by bFull listener above) */

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  SWIPE GESTURES (left half of canvas)
         *  swipe right → split | swipe up → double split
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var swStart = null;
        var SW_THRESH = 50; // min px to count as swipe
        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            if (chatOn || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
            var t = e.changedTouches[0];
            if (t.clientX < window.innerWidth * 0.5) {
                swStart = { x: t.clientX, y: t.clientY, id: t.identifier };
            } else {
                swStart = null;
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
            if (!swStart) return;
            for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
                var t = e.changedTouches[i];
                if (t.identifier !== swStart.id) continue;
                var dx = t.clientX - swStart.x;
                var dy = t.clientY - swStart.y;
                // swipe right → split
                if (dx > SW_THRESH && Math.abs(dy) < dx) {
                    emitKey(32);
                }
                // swipe up → double split
                else if (-dy > SW_THRESH && Math.abs(dx) < -dy) {
                    if (typeof application !== 'undefined' && application.doubleSplit)
                        application.doubleSplit();
                }
                swStart = null;
                break;
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  JOYSTICK — direction persists after finger lift
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var org = { x: 0, y: 0 }; // joystick origin
        var jId = null;
        var asp = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        // JS sensitivity now comes from prefs (live-updated by slider)
        var JR = 55;

        window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
            asp = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            if (chatOn || e.touches.length !== 1) return;
            var t = e.changedTouches[0];
            jId = t.identifier;
            org.x = t.clientX; org.y = t.clientY;
            mouseAt(t.clientX, t.clientY);
            
            jShow(org.x, org.y, org.x, org.y);
            swStart = null; // cancel any swipe tracking when joystick starts
        }, { passive: true });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
            for (var i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
                if (e.changedTouches[i].identifier === jId) {
                    jId = null;
                    jHide();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchcancel', function () {
            jId = null;
            jHide();
        }, { passive: true });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
            if (e.touches.length >= 2) return;
            var t = tById(e.changedTouches, jId);
            if (!t) return;

            // Both modes use virtual joystick scaling
            var rx0 = t.clientX - org.x, ry0 = t.clientY - org.y;
            var rawD = Math.sqrt(rx0 * rx0 + ry0 * ry0);
            if (rawD < 8) return;

            var dx = rx0 * prefs.jsSensitivity;
            var dy = ry0 * prefs.jsSensitivity;
            var cx = window.innerWidth / 2 + dx / asp;
            var cy = window.innerHeight / 2 + dy;
            mouseAt(cx, cy);

            var rx = t.clientX - org.x, ry = t.clientY - org.y;
            var d = Math.sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry);
            if (d > JR) {
                var a = Math.atan2(ry, rx);
                jShow(org.x, org.y, org.x + Math.cos(a) * JR, org.y + Math.sin(a) * JR);
            } else {
                jShow(org.x, org.y, t.clientX, t.clientY);
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  PINCH-TO-ZOOM  (dual mode)
         *    Menu visible  → scale HUD  (hudScale, 0.3 – 1.0)
         *    In-game       → zoom map   (WheelEvent)
         *    Spread fingers = zoom IN for both
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var pDist = 0, pOn = false;

        function isMenuVisible() {
            var ov = document.getElementById('overlays');
            if (!ov) return false;
            if (ov.style.display === 'none') return false;
            // overlays is hidden via .stop().hide() when in-game
            return ov.offsetParent !== null || ov.offsetHeight > 0;
        }

        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
            if (e.touches.length === 2) {
                pOn = true;
                pDist = dist(e.touches[0], e.touches[1]);
                jHide(); jId = null;
            }
        }, { passive: true });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
            if (!(e.touches.length === 2 && pOn)) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            var nd = dist(e.touches[0], e.touches[1]);
            var delta = nd - pDist;   // >0 = spread, <0 = pinch
            if (Math.abs(delta) > 4) {
                if (isMenuVisible()) {
                    /* ── HUD scale mode ── */
                    var step = delta * 0.003;
                    if (typeof defaultSettings !== 'undefined' && defaultSettings.hudScale !== undefined) {
                        var ns = Math.min(1, Math.max(0.3, defaultSettings.hudScale + step));
                        defaultSettings.hudScale = ns;
                        if (typeof ogario !== 'undefined') ogario.hudScale = ns;
                        if (typeof ogarhusettings === 'function') ogarhusettings();
                        zP.textContent = '🔍 HUD ' + Math.round(ns * 100) + '%';
                    }
                } else {
                    /* ── Map zoom mode ── */
                    var cx = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2;
                    var cy = (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2;
                    // spread (delta>0) → positive deltaY → zoom in (ogario convention)
                    wheel(canvas, delta * 2, cx, cy);
                    zP.textContent = delta > 0 ? '🔍 +' : '🔍 −';
                }
                pDist = nd;
                zP.classList.add('on');
                clearTimeout(zT);
                zT = setTimeout(function () { zP.classList.remove('on'); }, 400);
            }
        }, { passive: false });

        canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
            if (e.touches.length < 2) { pOn = false; pDist = 0; }
        }, { passive: true });

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  HAPTIC FEEDBACK
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        function vibrate(pattern) {
            try { if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(pattern); } catch (e) { }
        }

        /* Death / losing — watch #stats becoming visible */
        (function () {
            var statsEl = document.getElementById('stats');
            if (!statsEl) return;
            var wasHidden = statsEl.style.display === 'none' || !statsEl.offsetParent;
            new MutationObserver(function () {
                var isVisible = statsEl.style.display !== 'none' && statsEl.offsetParent !== null;
                if (isVisible && wasHidden) {
                    vibrate([100, 50, 100]); // double buzz — "ouch"
                }
                wasHidden = !isVisible;
            }).observe(statsEl, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style', 'class'] });
        })();

        /* New chat message — watch #messages for new children */
        (function () {
            var msgList = document.getElementById('messages');
            if (!msgList) return;
            new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
                for (var i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
                    if (mutations[i].addedNodes.length > 0) {
                        vibrate([30, 20, 30]); // light double tap
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }).observe(msgList, { childList: true });
        })();

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  MINIMAP TAP-TO-TOGGLE (70% ↔ 100%)
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        (function () {
            var mm = document.getElementById('minimap-hud');
            if (!mm) return;
            var expanded = false;
            mm.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
            mm.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                expanded = !expanded;
                mm.style.transform = expanded ? 'scale(1)' : 'scale(0.7)';
            }, { passive: true });
        })();


        /* HUD auto-fade removed — only mobile buttons fade, not leaderboard/teamboard/minimap */

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  HELPERS
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        function mk(tag) { return document.createElement(tag); }

        function mkb(icon, label, isUtil) {
            var b = mk('div');
            b.className = 'lm-b ' + (isUtil ? 'lm-u' : 'lm-a');
            if (label)
                b.innerHTML = '<div class="lm-bi"><span class="i">' + icon + '</span><span class="l">' + label + '</span></div>';
            else
                b.textContent = icon;
            return b;
        }

        function mks(icon) {
            var b = mk('div');
            b.className = 'lm-b lm-s';
            b.textContent = icon;
            return b;
        }

        /**
         * Emit keydown + keyup on document.
         * Uses Object.defineProperty to FORCE keyCode / which values,
         * because some browsers ignore them from the KeyboardEvent constructor.
         * ogario's getPressedKey() reads event.keyCode via a switch statement.
         */
        function emitKey(kc) {
            fire('keydown', kc);
            fire('keyup', kc);
        }

        function fire(type, kc) {
            var ev;
            try {
                ev = new KeyboardEvent(type, {
                    bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window
                });
            } catch (e) {
                ev = document.createEvent('KeyboardEvent');
                ev.initEvent(type, true, true);
            }
            // Force keyCode and which — this is the critical fix
            Object.defineProperty(ev, 'keyCode', { get: function () { return kc; } });
            Object.defineProperty(ev, 'which', { get: function () { return kc; } });
            Object.defineProperty(ev, 'key', { get: function () { return kn(kc); } });
            document.dispatchEvent(ev);
        }

        function kn(c) {
            return c === 13 ? 'Enter' : c === 27 ? 'Escape' : c === 32 ? ' ' : String.fromCharCode(c);
        }

        function mouseAt(x, y) {
            canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove', {
                clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, cancelable: true
            }));
        }

        function wheel(t, dy, cx, cy) {
            var o = { deltaY: dy, deltaMode: 0, clientX: cx, clientY: cy, bubbles: true, cancelable: true };
            t.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', o));
            o.detail = dy > 0 ? 1 : -1;
            t.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('mousewheel', o));
            // Firefox: game listens for DOMMouseScroll on document (ogario.v4.js:15358)
            try {
                var ff = new Event('DOMMouseScroll', {bubbles:true, cancelable:true});
                ff.detail = dy > 0 ? -1 : 1;
                ff.axis = 2; // vertical
                document.dispatchEvent(ff);
            } catch(e) {}
        }

        function dist(a, b) {
            var dx = a.clientX - b.clientX, dy = a.clientY - b.clientY;
            return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        }

        function tById(list, id) {
            if (id === null) return null;
            for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) if (list[i].identifier === id) return list[i];
            return null;
        }

        function jShow(ox, oy, ix, iy) {
            jO.style.display = 'block'; jO.style.left = ox + 'px'; jO.style.top = oy + 'px';
            jI.style.display = 'block'; jI.style.left = ix + 'px'; jI.style.top = iy + 'px';
        }
        function jHide() { jO.style.display = 'none'; jI.style.display = 'none'; }

        document.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
        document.body.addEventListener('touchmove', function (e) {
            if (e.target === canvas || e.target === document.body) e.preventDefault();
        }, { passive: false });

        console.log('%c LM Mobile v4.0 %c Touch controls loaded ',
            'background:linear-gradient(135deg,#01d9cc,#00243e);color:#fff;font-weight:bold;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px 0 0 4px;font-family:Ubuntu,sans-serif',
            'background:#00243e;color:#01d9cc;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;font-family:Ubuntu,sans-serif');

        /* (double-tap split removed — user preference) */

        /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
         *  AUTO-HIDE LEFT BUTTONS DURING GAMEPLAY
         *  Fade to 10% when touching canvas, restore after 3s idle
         * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
        var _fadeTimer = null;
        rootL.style.transition = 'opacity .4s ease';

        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', function () {
            if (isMenuVisible()) return;
            rootL.style.opacity = '0.35';
            if (_fadeTimer) clearTimeout(_fadeTimer);
            _fadeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                rootL.style.opacity = prefs.btnOpacity;
            }, 3000);
        }, { passive: true });
        canvas.addEventListener('touchend', function () {
            if (_fadeTimer) clearTimeout(_fadeTimer);
            _fadeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                rootL.style.opacity = prefs.btnOpacity;
            }, 3000);
        }, { passive: true });

/*
 * async_log.c — Non-blocking logging + deferred token file writes.
 *
 * Architecture:
 *   Main thread → async_log() → formats into ring buffer (fast, ~1μs)
 *   Background thread → wakes every 100ms → writes buffered data to stdout
 *
 * The ring buffer is 256KB. If the main thread produces logs faster than
 * the flush thread can write them, oldest messages are silently dropped
 * (game performance > log completeness).
 */

#include "async_log.h"
#include "config.h"  /* LOG_BUF_SIZE */
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

/* Forward declarations — avoids pulling in the entire server.h chain */
extern const char *g_data_dir;
const char *server_data_path(const char *filename);

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <pthread.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

/* ── Log ring buffer ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* LOG_BUF_SIZE defined in config.h */

static char log_buf[LOG_BUF_SIZE];
static int log_len = 0; /* bytes written (not yet flushed) */

/* Double buffer: flush thread copies log_buf → flush_buf, then writes
 * flush_buf to stdout while the main thread continues writing to log_buf. */
static char flush_buf[LOG_BUF_SIZE];

#ifdef _WIN32
static CRITICAL_SECTION log_cs;
static HANDLE log_thread_handle = NULL;
#else
static pthread_mutex_t log_mutex = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_t log_thread_id;
#endif

static _Atomic int log_running = 0;
static int dropped_logs = 0;    /* messages dropped due to full buffer */
static int dropped_tokens = 0;  /* token entries dropped due to full buffer */

/* ── Token buffer ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define TOKEN_MAX 64
#define TOKEN_ENTRY_SIZE 512
#define TOKEN_LOG_MAX_BYTES (1024 * 1024)

static char token_entries[TOKEN_MAX][TOKEN_ENTRY_SIZE];
static int token_count = 0;

static bool token_log_prepare_file(size_t incoming_bytes) {
  char token_path[1024];
  char backup_path[1024];

  int path_len = snprintf(
      token_path,
      sizeof(token_path),
      "%s",
      server_data_path("tokens.txt"));
  if (path_len < 0 || path_len >= (int)sizeof(token_path))
    return false;

  int backup_len = snprintf(
      backup_path,
      sizeof(backup_path),
      "%s.1",
      token_path);
  if (backup_len < 0 || backup_len >= (int)sizeof(backup_path))
    return false;

  FILE *existing = fopen(token_path, "rb");
  if (!existing)
    return true;

  long current_size = -1;
  if (fseek(existing, 0, SEEK_END) == 0)
    current_size = ftell(existing);
  fclose(existing);

  if (current_size < 0 ||
      (size_t)current_size + incoming_bytes <= TOKEN_LOG_MAX_BYTES) {
    return true;
  }

  remove(backup_path);
  if (rename(token_path, backup_path) != 0) {
    FILE *truncated = fopen(token_path, "wb");
    if (!truncated)
      return false;
    fclose(truncated);
  }

  async_log(
      "[TokenLog] Rotated tokens.txt at %ld bytes (1 MiB cap)\n",
      current_size);
  return true;
}

/* ── Lock helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void log_lock(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  EnterCriticalSection(&log_cs);
#else
  pthread_mutex_lock(&log_mutex);
#endif
}

static void log_unlock(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  LeaveCriticalSection(&log_cs);
#else
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&log_mutex);
#endif
}

/* ── Public: non-blocking printf replacement ─────────────────── */

void async_log(const char *fmt, ...) {
  char tmp[2048];
  va_list ap;
  va_start(ap, fmt);
  int n = vsnprintf(tmp, sizeof(tmp), fmt, ap);
  va_end(ap);

  if (n <= 0)
    return;
  if (n >= (int)sizeof(tmp))
    n = (int)sizeof(tmp) - 1;

  log_lock();
  /* If there were drops and we now have space, prepend a summary */
  if (dropped_logs > 0 && log_len + 80 + n <= LOG_BUF_SIZE) {
    char drop_msg[80];
    int dn = snprintf(drop_msg, sizeof(drop_msg),
                      "[LOG] %d messages dropped (buffer full)\n", dropped_logs);
    memcpy(log_buf + log_len, drop_msg, dn);
    log_len += dn;
    dropped_logs = 0;
  }
  if (log_len + n <= LOG_BUF_SIZE) {
    memcpy(log_buf + log_len, tmp, n);
    log_len += n;
  } else {
    dropped_logs++;
  }
  log_unlock();
}

/* ── Public: buffer a REDACTED token for deferred write ──────── */
/* Security: only log first 8 chars of the token to enable debugging
 * auth issues without storing full bearer credentials on disk. */

void token_log_add(const char *uid, const char *token, int token_len) {
  log_lock();
  if (token_count < TOKEN_MAX) {
    int preview = token_len < 8 ? token_len : 8;
    snprintf(token_entries[token_count], TOKEN_ENTRY_SIZE, "%s|%.*s***\n", uid,
             preview, token);
    token_count++;
  } else {
    dropped_tokens++;
  }
  log_unlock();
}

/* ── Public: flush tokens to disk (call from background thread) ─ */

void token_log_flush(void) {
  log_lock();
  int count = token_count;
  int dropped = dropped_tokens;
  char local_tokens[TOKEN_MAX][TOKEN_ENTRY_SIZE];
  if (count > 0) {
    memcpy(local_tokens, token_entries, count * TOKEN_ENTRY_SIZE);
    token_count = 0;
  }
  dropped_tokens = 0;
  log_unlock();

  if (dropped > 0) {
    async_log(
        "[TokenLog] %d token entries dropped (buffer full)\n",
        dropped);
  }

  if (count > 0) {
    size_t incoming_bytes = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
      incoming_bytes += strlen(local_tokens[i]);

    if (!token_log_prepare_file(incoming_bytes)) {
      async_log("[TokenLog] Unable to prepare bounded token log\n");
      return;
    }

    FILE *tf = fopen(server_data_path("tokens.txt"), "a");
    if (tf) {
      for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        fputs(local_tokens[i], tf);
      }
      fclose(tf);
    }
  }
}

/* ── Background flush thread ─────────────────────────────────── */

#ifdef _WIN32
static DWORD WINAPI log_flush_thread(LPVOID arg) {
#else
static void *log_flush_thread(void *arg) {
#endif
  (void)arg;
  while (atomic_load(&log_running)) {
    /* Sleep 100ms between flushes */
#ifdef _WIN32
    Sleep(100);
#else
    usleep(100000);
#endif

    /* Swap buffer: copy log_buf → flush_buf, reset log_len */
    log_lock();
    int len = log_len;
    if (len > 0) {
      memcpy(flush_buf, log_buf, len);
      log_len = 0;
    }
    log_unlock();

    /* Write to stdout WITHOUT holding the lock */
    if (len > 0) {
      fwrite(flush_buf, 1, len, stdout);
      fflush(stdout);
    }

    /* Also flush any buffered tokens */
    token_log_flush();
  }

  /* Final flush on shutdown */
  log_lock();
  int len = log_len;
  if (len > 0) {
    memcpy(flush_buf, log_buf, len);
    log_len = 0;
  }
  log_unlock();
  if (len > 0) {
    fwrite(flush_buf, 1, len, stdout);
    fflush(stdout);
  }
  token_log_flush();

  return 0;
}

/* ── Init / Shutdown ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

void async_log_init(void) {
  log_len = 0;
  token_count = 0;
  atomic_store(&log_running, 1);

#ifdef _WIN32
  InitializeCriticalSection(&log_cs);
  log_thread_handle = CreateThread(NULL, 0, log_flush_thread, NULL, 0, NULL);
#else
  pthread_create(&log_thread_id, NULL, log_flush_thread, NULL);
#endif
}

void async_log_shutdown(void) {
  atomic_store(&log_running, 0);

#ifdef _WIN32
  if (log_thread_handle) {
    WaitForSingleObject(log_thread_handle, 2000);
    CloseHandle(log_thread_handle);
    log_thread_handle = NULL;
  }
  DeleteCriticalSection(&log_cs);
#else
  pthread_join(log_thread_id, NULL);
#endif
}

/*
 * async_log.h — Non-blocking logging for game servers.
 *
 * Replaces printf() so the main game thread never blocks on stdout I/O.
 * Messages are buffered in memory and flushed to stdout by a background
 * thread every 100ms.
 *
 * Also provides a deferred token-file writer (token_log_add/flush) so
 * auth token logging doesn't hit disk on the main thread.
 */

#ifndef ASYNC_LOG_H
#define ASYNC_LOG_H

#include <stdarg.h>

/* Initialize the async log system (call once at startup) */
void async_log_init(void);

/* Shut down: flush remaining logs and stop background thread */
void async_log_shutdown(void);

/* Non-blocking printf replacement. Formats into a ring buffer;
 * a background thread flushes to stdout periodically. */
#ifdef __GNUC__
void async_log(const char *fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
#else
void async_log(const char *fmt, ...);
#endif

/* Buffer an auth token for deferred file write.
 * Called from the main thread; actual disk I/O happens on background thread. */
void token_log_add(const char *uid, const char *token, int token_len);

/* Flush buffered tokens to tokens.txt (call from background thread only). */
void token_log_flush(void);

/* ── Conditional log macros for release builds ──────────────
 * INFO_LOG: non-essential informational logs (handshake, join, auth success).
 *           Compiles out in NDEBUG release builds to reduce overhead.
 * WARN_LOG: always active — unexpected but non-fatal conditions.
 * async_log: always active — fatal errors, startup, shutdown. */
#ifdef NDEBUG
#define INFO_LOG(...) ((void)0)
#else
#ifdef __GNUC__
#define INFO_LOG(...) async_log(__VA_ARGS__)
#else
#define INFO_LOG(...) async_log(__VA_ARGS__)
#endif
#endif

#endif /* ASYNC_LOG_H */

#include "buffer.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

/* ── Binary Writer ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define BW_INIT_CAP 4096

/* Returns false on OOM. Sets w->oom permanently — all subsequent
 * writes become no-ops until bw_reset() or bw_free(). */
static bool bw_ensure(BinaryWriter *w, size_t extra) {
  if (w->oom)
    return false;
  size_t needed = w->length + extra;
  if (needed <= w->capacity)
    return true;
  size_t new_cap = w->capacity * 2;
  if (new_cap < needed)
    new_cap = needed;
  uint8_t *new_data = (uint8_t *)realloc(w->data, new_cap);
  if (!new_data) {
    w->oom = true;
    return false;
  }
  w->data = new_data;
  w->capacity = new_cap;
  return true;
}

void bw_init(BinaryWriter *w) {
  w->data = (uint8_t *)malloc(BW_INIT_CAP);
  w->length = 0;
  w->capacity = BW_INIT_CAP;
  w->oom = (w->data == NULL);
}

void bw_free(BinaryWriter *w) {
  free(w->data);
  w->data = NULL;
  w->length = 0;
  w->capacity = 0;
  w->oom = false;
}

void bw_reset(BinaryWriter *w) {
  w->length = 0;
  /* Keep oom flag — buffer is still valid if it was allocated. */
  if (w->data)
    w->oom = false;
}

void bw_write_u8(BinaryWriter *w, uint8_t v) {
  if (!bw_ensure(w, 1))
    return;
  w->data[w->length++] = v;
}

void bw_write_u16_le(BinaryWriter *w, uint16_t v) {
  if (!bw_ensure(w, 2))
    return;
  w->data[w->length++] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFF);
  w->data[w->length++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
}

void bw_write_u32_le(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t v) {
  if (!bw_ensure(w, 4))
    return;
  w->data[w->length++] = (uint8_t)(v & 0xFF);
  w->data[w->length++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
  w->data[w->length++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
  w->data[w->length++] = (uint8_t)((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
}

void bw_write_i32_le(BinaryWriter *w, int32_t v) {
  bw_write_u32_le(w, (uint32_t)v);
}

void bw_write_f32_le(BinaryWriter *w, float v) {
  if (!bw_ensure(w, 4))
    return;
  memcpy(w->data + w->length, &v, 4);
  w->length += 4;
}

void bw_write_f64_le(BinaryWriter *w, double v) {
  if (!bw_ensure(w, 8))
    return;
  memcpy(w->data + w->length, &v, 8);
  w->length += 8;
}

void bw_write_bytes(BinaryWriter *w, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (!bw_ensure(w, len))
    return;
  memcpy(w->data + w->length, data, len);
  w->length += len;
}

void bw_write_string_utf8_zero(BinaryWriter *w, const char *str) {
  if (str) {
    size_t len = strlen(str);
    bw_write_bytes(w, (const uint8_t *)str, len);
  }
  bw_write_u8(w, 0); /* zero terminator */
}

void bw_write_string_unicode_zero(BinaryWriter *w, const char *str) {
  /* Write each byte as a uint16 (basic latin only, matching MultiOgarII
   * behavior) */
  if (str) {
    for (const char *p = str; *p; p++) {
      bw_write_u16_le(w, (uint16_t)(uint8_t)*p);
    }
  }
  bw_write_u16_le(w, 0); /* zero terminator */
}

uint8_t *bw_data(BinaryWriter *w) { return w->data; }

size_t bw_length(BinaryWriter *w) { return w->length; }

/* ── Binary Reader ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void br_init(BinaryReader *r, const uint8_t *data, size_t length) {
  r->data = data;
  r->length = length;
  r->offset = 0;
}

bool br_has_bytes(const BinaryReader *r, size_t count) {
  return r->offset + count <= r->length;
}

void br_skip(BinaryReader *r, size_t count) {
  r->offset += count;
  if (r->offset > r->length)
    r->offset = r->length;
}

uint8_t br_read_u8(BinaryReader *r) {
  if (!br_has_bytes(r, 1))
    return 0;
  return r->data[r->offset++];
}

uint16_t br_read_u16_le(BinaryReader *r) {
  if (!br_has_bytes(r, 2))
    return 0;
  uint16_t v =
      (uint16_t)r->data[r->offset] | ((uint16_t)r->data[r->offset + 1] << 8);
  r->offset += 2;
  return v;
}

uint32_t br_read_u32_le(BinaryReader *r) {
  if (!br_has_bytes(r, 4))
    return 0;
  uint32_t v = (uint32_t)r->data[r->offset] |
               ((uint32_t)r->data[r->offset + 1] << 8) |
               ((uint32_t)r->data[r->offset + 2] << 16) |
               ((uint32_t)r->data[r->offset + 3] << 24);
  r->offset += 4;
  return v;
}

int32_t br_read_i32_le(BinaryReader *r) { return (int32_t)br_read_u32_le(r); }

float br_read_f32_le(BinaryReader *r) {
  if (!br_has_bytes(r, 4))
    return 0.0f;
  float v;
  memcpy(&v, r->data + r->offset, 4);
  r->offset += 4;
  return v;
}

double br_read_f64_le(BinaryReader *r) {
  if (!br_has_bytes(r, 8))
    return 0.0;
  double v;
  memcpy(&v, r->data + r->offset, 8);
  r->offset += 8;
  return v;
}

size_t br_read_string_utf8_safe(BinaryReader *r, char *out, size_t max_len) {
  size_t copied = 0;
  while (r->offset < r->length && r->data[r->offset] != 0 && copied + 1 < max_len) {
    if (out) out[copied] = (char)r->data[r->offset];
    copied++;
    r->offset++;
  }
  if (out && max_len > 0) out[copied] = '\0';
  
  /* Consume remaining string up to null terminator */
  while (r->offset < r->length && r->data[r->offset] != 0) {
    r->offset++;
  }
  if (r->offset < r->length)
    r->offset++; /* skip zero terminator */
    
  return copied;
}

#include "cell.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef __GNUC__
#define LIKELY(x)   __builtin_expect(!!(x), 1)
#define UNLIKELY(x) __builtin_expect(!!(x), 0)
#else
#define LIKELY(x)   (x)
#define UNLIKELY(x) (x)
#endif

void cell_init(
    Cell *cell,
    uint32_t id,
    CellType type,
    Vec2 position,
    double size) {
  /*
   * server_alloc_cell() assigns the slot generation before cell_init().
   * Preserve it while clearing all gameplay state.
   */
  uint32_t generation =
      cell->generation;

  if (generation == 0)
    generation = 1;

  memset(
      cell,
      0,
      sizeof(*cell));

  cell->generation = generation;
  cell->id = id;
  cell->type = type;
  cell->position = position;
  cell->owner_id = -1;
  cell->food_index = -1;
  cell->virus_index = -1;
  cell->dynamic_index = -1;
  cell->moving_index = -1;
  cell->killer_id = 0;
  cell->is_virus = (type == CELL_VIRUS);

  cell_set_size(
      cell,
      size);
}


#define SPEED_LUT_SIZE 4096
static double g_speed_lut[SPEED_LUT_SIZE];
static bool g_speed_lut_inited = false;

static void init_speed_lut(void) {
  for (int i = 0; i < SPEED_LUT_SIZE; i++) {
    double s = (i < 1) ? 1.0 : (double)i;
    g_speed_lut[i] = 88.0 * pow(s, -0.4396754);
  }
  g_speed_lut_inited = true;
}

static inline double get_cached_speed(double size) {
  if (UNLIKELY(!g_speed_lut_inited)) init_speed_lut();
  if (LIKELY(size >= 0.0 && size < (double)(SPEED_LUT_SIZE - 1))) {
    int idx = (int)size;
    double frac = size - (double)idx;
    return g_speed_lut[idx] + frac * (g_speed_lut[idx + 1] - g_speed_lut[idx]);
  }
  return 88.0 * pow(size, -0.4396754);
}

void cell_set_size(Cell *c, double size) {
  if (UNLIKELY(!isfinite(size) || size < 1.0))
    size = 1.0;
  c->radius = size;
  c->radius2 = size * size;
  c->mass = c->radius2 / 100.0;
  c->cached_speed = get_cached_speed(size);
}

void cell_eat(Cell *c, const Cell *prey) {
  double new_r2 = c->radius2 + prey->radius2;
  double new_r = sqrt(new_r2);
  c->radius2 = new_r2;
  c->radius = new_r;
  c->mass = new_r2 / 100.0;
  c->cached_speed = get_cached_speed(new_r);
}

void cell_set_boost(Cell *c, double distance, double angle) {
  c->boost_dist = distance;
  c->boost_dir = vec2_from_angle(angle);
  c->is_moving = true;
}

bool cell_move_boost(Cell *c, double bminx, double bminy, double bmaxx,
                     double bmaxy) {
  if (!c->is_moving || c->boost_dist <= 0) {
    c->is_moving = false;
    return false;
  }

  /* Decay boost distance — per-cell friction if set, else default 1/9 */
  double decay = (c->boost_friction > 0) ? c->boost_friction : (1.0 / 9.0);
  double move_dist = c->boost_dist;
  c->boost_dist -= c->boost_dist * decay;

  if (c->boost_dist < 1.0) {
    c->boost_dist = 0;
    c->is_moving = false;
  }

  /* Move cell */
  c->position.x += c->boost_dir.x * move_dist * decay;
  c->position.y += c->boost_dir.y * move_dist * decay;

  /* Border bounce */
  double r = c->radius / 2.0;
  if (c->position.x < bminx + r || c->position.x > bmaxx - r) {
    c->boost_dir.x *= -1.0;
    if (c->position.x < bminx + r)
      c->position.x = bminx + r;
    if (c->position.x > bmaxx - r)
      c->position.x = bmaxx - r;
  }
  if (c->position.y < bminy + r || c->position.y > bmaxy - r) {
    c->boost_dir.y *= -1.0;
    if (c->position.y < bminy + r)
      c->position.y = bminy + r;
    if (c->position.y > bmaxy - r)
      c->position.y = bmaxy - r;
  }

  return c->is_moving;
}

double cell_get_speed(const Cell *c, double player_speed_mult) {
  /* Uses cached_speed from cell_set_size — same formula, avoids pow() per tick
   */
  return c->cached_speed * player_speed_mult;
}

#ifndef CELL_H
#define CELL_H

#include "vec2.h"
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

/* Cell type constants */
typedef enum {
  CELL_PLAYER = 0,
  CELL_FOOD = 1,
  CELL_VIRUS = 2,
  CELL_EJECTED = 3,
  CELL_MOTHER = 4,
  CELL_POTION = 5,
} CellType;

typedef struct {
  uint8_t r, g, b;
} Color;

/* Cell struct layout optimized for cache-friendliness.
 * Hot fields (touched every tick in visibility/collision) are grouped in
 * the first cache line (64 bytes). Cold fields are at the end. */
typedef struct Cell {
  /* ── HOT: visibility + collision (every tick) ─────────────── */
  uint32_t id;           /* 4B  — packet serialization, diff sort */
  CellType type;         /* 4B  — type checks in diff/collision */
  Vec2 position;         /* 16B — collision, packet pos, qt_query */
  double radius;         /* 8B  — collision, packet size */
  double radius2;        /* 8B  — cached radius*radius for collision */
  double mass;           /* 8B  — cached radius2 / 100 */
  bool is_removed;       /* 1B  — checked everywhere */
  bool is_moving;        /* 1B  — movement + diff checks */
  bool is_virus;         /* 1B  — packet flags */
  bool is_agitated;      /* 1B  — packet flags */
  int owner_id;          /* 4B  — player ownership, packet flags */
  /* ── 56 bytes above — fits in one cache line ──────────────── */

  /* ── WARM: movement + boost ───────────────────────────────── */
  double cached_speed;   /* cached 2.2 * pow(radius, -0.45) * 40.0 */
  Vec2 boost_dir;
  double boost_dist;
  double boost_friction;   /* 0 = use default (1/9), else per-cell override */
  uint32_t killer_id;    /* cell that ate this cell */
  Color color;

  /* ── COLD: indexing + tracking (rarely touched in hot paths) ─ */
  int food_index;        /* index in srv->food_nodes[], -1 if not food */
  int virus_index;       /* index in srv->virus_nodes[], -1 if not virus */
  int dynamic_index;     /* index in srv->dynamic_nodes[], -1 if food */
  int moving_index;      /* index in srv->moving_nodes[], -1 if not tracked */
  uint32_t created_tick;
  uint32_t visible_tick; /* tick when last added to a visible[] array */

  /*
   * Incremented whenever this cells[] slot is reused.
   *
   * A Cell pointer alone is not a stable identity because the same slot can
   * later represent another protocol cell. View tracking stores:
   *
   *   pointer + generation + protocol ID
   *
   * and removes stale handles lazily when that viewer is next updated.
   */
  uint32_t generation;

  /* ── DIRTY: coalescing flag (dirty cell pull model) ─────────── */
  uint32_t last_evt_tick; /* tick when cell was last marked dirty */
  bool needs_name_refresh; /* split/pop parent: include name in UPDATE */
  bool is_pending_free; /* queued for deferred return to the cell pool */

  /* ── SPAWN GROW ANIMATION & SPATIAL QUERY DEDUPLICATION ────── */
  double spawn_target_radius;  /* final radius after grow-in animation */
  uint32_t spawn_grow_end_tick; /* tick when grow-in animation finishes (0 = no animation) */
  uint32_t grid_qid[4]; /* per-thread query dedup — must match MAX_OMP_THREADS */
} Cell;

static inline uint64_t cell_handle_value(const Cell *cell) {
  if (!cell)
    return 0;

  return ((uint64_t)cell->generation << 32) |
         (uint64_t)cell->id;
}

/* Initialize a cell with position and size */
void cell_init(Cell *c, uint32_t id, CellType type, Vec2 pos, double size);

/* Set cell size (updates radius, radius2, mass) */
void cell_set_size(Cell *c, double size);

/* Grow cell by eating another cell's area */
void cell_eat(Cell *c, const Cell *prey);

/* Apply boost to cell */
void cell_set_boost(Cell *c, double distance, double angle);

/* Move cell (boost movement), returns true if still moving */
bool cell_move_boost(Cell *c, double border_minx, double border_miny,
                     double border_maxx, double border_maxy);

/* Get cell speed for player cells */
double cell_get_speed(const Cell *c, double player_speed_mult);

/* Pool sizes and map scale are defined in config.h (MAP_SCALE).
 * #include "config.h" is pulled in via vec2.h → stdint.h chain,
 * but we include it explicitly here for clarity. */
#include "config.h"

#endif /* CELL_H */

#include "client.h"
#include "async_log.h"
#include "packet.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <sys/stat.h>
#endif

#include "net.h"

/* potion_open is defined in server.c (non-static) */
struct GameServer;
extern void potion_open(Player *player, Potion *potion, struct GameServer *srv);

/* ── Flush client view: send deletes for all tracked cells ─── */
/* Call before setting client_count = 0 on mode transitions.
 * This ensures the client removes stale cells from the display. */
static int flush_client_view(
    ClientHandler *handler,
    PlayerViewTrackingSource source) {
  (void)source;

  if (!handler ||
      handler->player_id < 0 ||
      !handler->server) {
    return -1;
  }

  Player *player =
      &handler->server->players[
          handler->player_id];

  /*
   * Send explicit DELETE records for all tracked cells via standard
   * UpdateNodes (opcode 0x10) packets.  DO NOT use opcode 0x12 (ClearAll) —
   * it triggers LegendMod / OGARio to reconnect/reset the socket, causing
   * blank screens on Join and World Spectate transitions.
   *
   * The DELETE IDs come from:
   *   - client_handles[]: lower 32 bits = unscrambled protocol cell ID
   *   - compacted_drop_ids[]: stale generation protocol IDs
   *
   * World Spectate can track up to 65536 cells but the u16 remove_count
   * field only holds 65535, so we emit multiple packets when needed.
   */
  int total_tracked = player->client_count;
  int total_drops   = player->compacted_drop_count;
  int total_all     = total_tracked + total_drops;

  if (total_all > 0) {
    uint32_t scr = player->scramble_id;
    int sent = player->clear_view_sent;
    if (sent < 0 || sent >= total_all) sent = 0;

    while (sent < total_all) {
      int remaining = total_all - sent;
      int batch = remaining > 65535 ? 65535 : remaining;
      int batch_start_sent = sent;

      BinaryWriter *writer =
          &handler->send_writer;
      bw_reset(writer);

      /* Opcode 0x10 — UpdateNodes */
      bw_write_u8(writer, 0x10);

      /* Eat count: 0 */
      bw_write_u16_le(writer, 0);

      /* Add records terminator (no adds) */
      bw_write_u32_le(writer, 0);

      /* Remove count */
      bw_write_u16_le(writer, (uint16_t)batch);

      int written = 0;

      /* DELETEs from client_handles[] */
      while (written < batch && sent < total_tracked) {
        uint32_t proto_id = (uint32_t)(player->client_handles[sent]);
        bw_write_u32_le(writer, proto_id ^ scr);
        sent++;
        written++;
      }

      /* DELETEs from compacted_drop_ids[] */
      while (written < batch && sent < total_all) {
        int drop_idx = sent - total_tracked;
        bw_write_u32_le(writer, player->compacted_drop_ids[drop_idx] ^ scr);
        sent++;
        written++;
      }

      if (!net_try_queue_to_player(
              handler->conn_id,
              bw_data(writer),
              bw_length(writer))) {
        async_log(
            "[Client %d] Flush DELETEs enqueue failed (%d/%d sent)\n",
            handler->conn_id, sent, total_all);

        player->clear_view_sent = batch_start_sent; /* resume from unqueued batch on next retry */
        return -1;
      }
    }

    player->clear_view_sent = 0;
    net_flush_player(
        handler->conn_id);
  }

  player_clear_view_tracking(
      player);

  player->full_map_resync_pending =
      false;

  return 0;
}


/*
 * Leave either World Spectate variant without destroying the exact
 * per-connection tracking snapshot or changing the current scramble.
 *
 * The next grouped/free-roam/play update performs one transactional
 * old-world -> destination-view diff. This prevents a synchronous mass-delete
 * operation from blocking the user's mode-change command.
 */
static void leave_world_spectate_mode(
    Player *player) {
  if (!player)
    return;

  player->full_map_spectate = false;
  player->full_map_resync_pending = false;
  player->clear_view_sent = 0;
}


/* ── Generate UID for player (auth token or fallback) ────────── */

static void generate_player_uid(ClientHandler *ch, Player *player) {
  if (player->uid[0])
    return; /* already set by opcode 102 */

  /* Fallback: use connection ID as identifier */
  char fallback[64];
  snprintf(fallback, sizeof(fallback), "conn_%d_%u", ch->conn_id,
           ch->handshake_key);
  playerdb_hash_uid(player->uid, fallback, (int)strlen(fallback));
  INFO_LOG("[Client %d] No auth token, using fallback UID: %s\n", ch->conn_id,
            player->uid);
}

/* ── Init ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void client_init(ClientHandler *ch, int conn_id, GameServer *server) {
  memset(ch, 0, sizeof(*ch));
  ch->conn_id = conn_id;
  ch->player_id = -1;
  ch->protocol = 0;
  ch->state = HS_WAIT_PROTOCOL;
  ch->server = server;
  bw_init(&ch->send_writer);
}

/* ── Allocate a player slot ──────────────────────────────────── */

static int alloc_player(GameServer *srv, int conn_id) {
  /* O(1) allocation: pop from free-slot stack */
  if (srv->free_player_top < 0)
    return -1; /* no free slots */

  int i = srv->free_player_stack[srv->free_player_top--];
  Player *p = &srv->players[i];
  player_init(p, i);

  /*
   * Assign a monotonic identity after player_init() clears the reusable
   * slot. Zero remains reserved for inactive/unallocated state.
   */
  srv->next_player_lifecycle_generation++;

  if (srv->next_player_lifecycle_generation == 0)
    srv->next_player_lifecycle_generation++;

  p->lifecycle_generation =
      srv->next_player_lifecycle_generation;

  if (player_alloc_buffers(p) < 0) { /* OOM — view_state/client_nodes calloc failed */
    async_log("[FATAL] OOM allocating player %d buffers (connected=%d)\n",
              i, srv->connected_count);
    player_free_buffers(p);
    p->active = false;
    srv->free_player_stack[++srv->free_player_top] = i; /* push back */
    return -1;
  }
  p->active = true;
  p->conn_id = conn_id;
  /* is_local is reserved for embedded headless bots (conn_id < 0) which
   * skip the network pipeline entirely.  Real socket connections — even
   * from localhost — must receive full-fidelity updates. */
  p->is_local = false;
  /* Add to connected list (NOT active/simulation list — that happens on spawn) */
  if (srv->connected_count < MAX_PLAYERS) {
    srv->connected_ids[srv->connected_count++] = i;
  } else {
    async_log("[FATAL] connected_ids overflow at %d\n", srv->connected_count);
    player_free_buffers(p);  /* prevent leak */
    p->active = false;
    srv->free_player_stack[++srv->free_player_top] = i; /* push back */
    return -1;
  }
  return i;
}

/* ── Handshake: protocol (opcode 0xFE) ───────────────────────── */

static void on_handshake_protocol(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data,
                                  size_t len) {
  if (len != 5)
    return;
  uint32_t proto = (uint32_t)data[1] | ((uint32_t)data[2] << 8) |
                   ((uint32_t)data[3] << 16) | ((uint32_t)data[4] << 24);

  if (proto < 1 || (proto > 25 && proto != 102 && proto != 254)) {
    async_log("[Client %d] Unsupported protocol: %u\n", ch->conn_id, proto);
    return;
  }
  ch->protocol = (int)proto;
  ch->state = HS_WAIT_KEY;
}

/* ── Handshake: key (opcode 0xFF) ────────────────────────────── */

static void on_handshake_key(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data,
                             size_t len) {
  if (len != 5)
    return;
  uint32_t key = (uint32_t)data[1] | ((uint32_t)data[2] << 8) |
                 ((uint32_t)data[3] << 16) | ((uint32_t)data[4] << 24);

  /* Delta sends client_version (e.g. 31129) as the key — accept any value */
  ch->handshake_key = key;
  ch->state = HS_READY;

  /* Allocate player */
  ch->player_id = alloc_player(ch->server, ch->conn_id);
  if (ch->player_id < 0) {
    async_log("[Client %d] Server full (%d max users)\n", ch->conn_id,
              MAX_PLAYERS);
    BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
    Color warn_color = {0xFF, 0x44, 0x44};
    char full_msg[128];
    snprintf(full_msg, sizeof(full_msg), "Server has maximum %d users.",
             MAX_PLAYERS);
    pkt_chat_message(w, "SERVER", warn_color, 0x80, full_msg);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    net_kick_connection(ch->conn_id, "Server full");
    return;
  }

  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];
  player->protocol = ch->protocol;

  INFO_LOG("[Client %d] Handshake OK (proto %d) → Player %d\n", ch->conn_id,
            ch->protocol, ch->player_id);

  BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;

  /* PERF: batch all handshake packets into one send.
   * Queue: ClearAll + SetBorder + version + welcome into send buffer,
   * then flush once instead of 4+ separate net_send_to_player calls. */
  GameServer *srv = ch->server;
  pkt_clear_all(w);
  net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));

  pkt_set_border(w, player, srv->border.minx, srv->border.miny,
                 srv->border.maxx, srv->border.maxy,
                 srv->config.server_gamemode, srv->config.server_name);
  net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));

  Color server_color = {0x9B, 0x9B, 0x9B};
  pkt_chat_message(w, "SERVER", server_color, 0x80, SERVER_VERSION_STRING);
  net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));

  if (srv->config.server_welcome2[0]) {
    pkt_chat_message(w, "SERVER", server_color, 0x80,
                     srv->config.server_welcome2);
    net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
  }

  /* Send LW (Legend World) handshake beacon — opcode 0xF0 + "LW" */
  {
    uint8_t lw_beacon[3] = {0xF0, 0x4C, 0x57}; /* 'L','W' */
    net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, lw_beacon, sizeof(lw_beacon));

    /* Send current tier AND active phase so the client displays it immediately.
     * Derive tier from the ACTUAL border width (not ms->current_tier) to
     * guarantee tier display always matches the real map size. */
    MapScaler *ms = &srv->map_scaler;
    uint8_t real_tier = (uint8_t)mapscaler_tier_for_size(ms, srv->border.maxx - srv->border.minx);
    MapEventType evt;
    switch (ms->phase) {
      case PHASE_EXPANDING: evt = MAP_EVENT_EXPANSION_START;       break;
      case PHASE_WARNING:   evt = MAP_EVENT_CONTRACTION_WARNING;   break;
      case PHASE_DANGER:    evt = MAP_EVENT_CONTRACTION_DANGER;    break;
      case PHASE_SHRINKING: evt = MAP_EVENT_SHRINK_START;          break;
      default:              evt = MAP_EVENT_RESIZE_COMPLETE;       break;
    }
    pkt_map_event(w, (uint8_t)evt,
                  ms->current_size, ms->target_size, 0.0, 0.0,
                  (uint32_t)ms->transition_duration,
                  (uint32_t)ms->warning_duration,
                  real_tier);
    net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));

    /* Flush entire handshake batch as one send */
    net_flush_player(ch->conn_id);
  }
}

/* ── Operational: Join (opcode 0) ────────────────────────────── */

static void on_join(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (ch->player_id < 0)
    return;
  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];

  /* If the player is already alive, silently ignore the join request */
  if (player->cell_count > 0)
    return;

  /*
   * A Play click must always be allowed to leave an established World
   * Spectate session. The ordinary one-second respawn throttle otherwise
   * swallows the only click and makes the button appear dead.
   */
  bool leaving_world_spectate =
      player->full_map_spectate;

  /* Throttle ordinary joins, not a World -> Play mode transition. */
  uint32_t dt = ch->server->ticks - ch->last_join_tick;
  if (dt < 25 &&
      !leaving_world_spectate)
    return;

  /* Enforce gameplay cap: count players actually alive with cells */
  if (server_alive_count(ch->server) >= ch->server->config.max_active_players) {
    BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
    Color warn_color = {0xFF, 0x44, 0x44}; /* red */
    char full_msg[128];
    snprintf(full_msg, sizeof(full_msg),
             "Server has maximum %d players. You can spectate.",
             ch->server->config.max_active_players);
    pkt_chat_message(w, "SERVER", warn_color, 0x80, full_msg);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    player->spectate = true;
    player->free_roam = true;
    return;
  }

  /* Parse name: ogario sends UTF-8 null-terminated to private servers */
  char name[128] = {0};
  char skin[128] = {0};

  if (len > 1) {
    /* Read UTF-8 string safely bounded to a local buffer instead of raw pointer */
    BinaryReader r;
    br_init(&r, data, len);
    br_skip(&r, 1); /* skip opcode */

    char text_buf[256];
    br_read_string_utf8_safe(&r, text_buf, sizeof(text_buf));
    const char *text = text_buf;
    
    if (text[0]) {
      /* Parse <skin>name format */
      if (text[0] == '<') {
        const char *end = strchr(text + 1, '>');
        if (end) {
          size_t skin_len = end - text - 1;
          if (skin_len < sizeof(skin)) {
            memcpy(skin, text + 1, skin_len);
            skin[skin_len] = '\0';
          }
          text = end + 1;
        }
      }
      strncpy(name, text, sizeof(name) - 1);
      name[sizeof(name) - 1] = '\0';
    }
  }

  PlayerViewTrackingSource previous_view =
      player_view_tracking_source(
          player);

  /*
   * World Spectate owns exact individual tracking. Preserve both that tracking
   * and whichever scramble is currently active, then let the next active-player
   * full diff reconcile old world cells against the gameplay viewport.
   */
  if (!leaving_world_spectate &&
      flush_client_view(
          ch,
          previous_view) < 0) {
    async_log(
        "[Client %d] Join aborted: unable to flush previous view\n",
        ch->conn_id);

    return;
  }

  player_set_identity(
      player,
      name,
      skin);

  INFO_LOG("[Join] Player %d name='%s' skin='%s' (raw parse: name='%s' skin='%s')\n",
           player->id, player->name, player->skin, name, skin);

  player->color =
      server_random_color();

  player->spectate = false;
  player->free_roam = false;
  leave_world_spectate_mode(player);
  player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;

  /*
   * Do not change scramble during World -> Play. The retained exact tracking
   * contains IDs encoded with the current scramble, so the transactional diff
   * must use that same value for its DELETE records.
   */
  if (!leaving_world_spectate) {
    player_scramble(
        player,
        player->is_local
            ? 0
            : ch->server->config.server_scramble_level,
        ch->server->config.border_width,
        ch->server->config.border_height);
  }

  /* PERF: batch all join packets — queue all, flush once at the end */
  BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
  bw_reset(w);

  /* No ClearAll here — opcode 0x12 triggers LM/ogario client reconnect.
   * The handshake already sent ClearAll, and player->client_count = 0
   * below handles the server-side view diff reset. */

  if (ch->server->config.server_scramble_level < 2) {
    pkt_set_border(w, player, ch->server->border.minx, ch->server->border.miny,
                   ch->server->border.maxx, ch->server->border.maxy, -1, NULL);
    net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
  }

  /* Generate UID BEFORE spawning so starting_mass_bonus is available */
  generate_player_uid(ch, player);

  /* Spawn: prefer spawning at a random food cell's position (like real
   * Agar.io). This gives the visual effect of "growing from a food dot".
   * During contraction, only pick food INSIDE the safe zone (not in
   * warning/danger area). Fallback to random safe position.
   * In both cases reject positions that overlap an existing player cell. */
  Vec2 pos;
  Cell *spawn_food = NULL;
  if (ch->server->food_count > 0) {
    /* Try up to 10 random food cells to find one in the safe zone
     * and NOT inside an existing player cell. */
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 10 && !spawn_food; attempt++) {
      int fi = rand() % ch->server->food_count;
      Cell *food = ch->server->food_nodes[fi];
      if (mapscaler_is_in_outer_zone(&ch->server->map_scaler,
                                      food->position.x, food->position.y))
        continue;
      /* Check that the food position is not inside any player cell */
      double start_r = ch->server->config.player_start_size;
      double check_r = start_r + 150.0;
      Rect area = {food->position.x - check_r, food->position.y - check_r,
                   food->position.x + check_r, food->position.y + check_r};
      Cell *sp_nearby[64];
      int sp_n = bot_grid_query(&ch->server->bot_grid, area, sp_nearby, 64);
      bool inside_player = false;
      for (int si = 0; si < sp_n && !inside_player; si++) {
        Cell *other = sp_nearby[si];
        if (other->is_removed || other->type != CELL_PLAYER) continue;
        double dx = other->position.x - food->position.x;
        double dy = other->position.y - food->position.y;
        double thr = other->radius + start_r;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy < thr * thr)
          inside_player = true;
      }
      if (!inside_player)
        spawn_food = food;
    }
