  }
  if (spawn_food) {
    pos = spawn_food->position;
    server_remove_cell(ch->server, spawn_food); /* consume the food */
  } else {
    /* Fallback: find a random position not overlapping any player cell */
    double start_r = ch->server->config.player_start_size;
    pos = server_random_pos_padded(ch->server, start_r);
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 20; attempt++) {
      Vec2 candidate = server_random_pos_padded(ch->server, start_r);
      double check_r = start_r + 150.0;
      Rect area = {candidate.x - check_r, candidate.y - check_r,
                   candidate.x + check_r, candidate.y + check_r};
      Cell *sp_nearby2[64];
      int sp_n2 = bot_grid_query(&ch->server->bot_grid, area, sp_nearby2, 64);
      bool inside_player = false;
      for (int si = 0; si < sp_n2 && !inside_player; si++) {
        Cell *other = sp_nearby2[si];
        if (other->is_removed || other->type != CELL_PLAYER) continue;
        double dx = other->position.x - candidate.x;
        double dy = other->position.y - candidate.y;
        double thr = other->radius + start_r;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy < thr * thr)
          inside_player = true;
      }
      if (!inside_player) {
        pos = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  server_spawn_player(ch->server, player, pos);
  /* Force a full world snapshot on the next update tick so ALL visible cells
   * are ADDed with their names/skins. Without this, the dirty path misses
   * stationary cells (e.g. 3000 settled bots) and they appear nameless. */
  player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;

  /* Check if spawn actually succeeded (cell pool might be full) */
  if (player->cell_count == 0) {
    /* Spawn failed — revert to spectate and notify player */
    player->spectate = true;
    player->free_roam = true;
    BinaryWriter *w2 = &ch->send_writer;
    Color warn_color = {0xFF, 0x44, 0x44};
    pkt_chat_message(w2, "SERVER", warn_color, 0x80,
                     "Too many entities! Try again in a moment.");
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w2), bw_length(w2));
    return;
  }

  /* Reset mouse to spawn point — without this, the spectate mouse position
   * carries over and the cell flies across the map at max speed on first tick. */
  player->mouse = pos;
  player->mouse_target = pos;
  player->center = pos;
  /* Player is now alive — add to simulation list (if not already present) */
  {
    bool already_active = false;
    for (int ai = 0; ai < ch->server->active_player_count; ai++) {
      if (ch->server->active_player_ids[ai] == ch->player_id) {
        already_active = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!already_active) {
      if (ch->server->active_player_count < MAX_PLAYERS) {
        ch->server->active_player_ids[ch->server->active_player_count++] = ch->player_id;
      } else {
        async_log("[FATAL] active_player_ids overflow at %d\n",
                  ch->server->active_player_count);
      }
    }
  }
  ch->last_join_tick = ch->server->ticks; /* throttle: update only on success */

  /* Kick any other connection with the same UID (duplicate login).
   * Only enforce after ROBUST auth (linked == true) — fallback UIDs are
   * too weak to trust and could cause reconnect-kick storms under bot churn. */
  if (player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
    /* PERF: iterate connected_ids instead of all MAX_PLAYERS (1280) slots */
    for (int ci = 0; ci < ch->server->connected_count; ci++) {
      Player *other = &ch->server->players[ch->server->connected_ids[ci]];
      if (other == player || other->is_removed || other->conn_id < 0)
        continue;
      if (player_profile_is_persistent(other) &&
          strcmp(other->uid, player->uid) == 0) {
        INFO_LOG("[AntiBot] Duplicate UID '%s': kicking conn %d (player %d) "
                  "in favor of conn %d (player %d)\n",
                  player->uid, other->conn_id, other->id, ch->conn_id,
                  player->id);
        net_kick_connection(other->conn_id,
                            "Disconnected: logged in from another place");
      }
    }
  }

  /* Look up persistent profile and show level */
  if (player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
    PlayerRecord *rec = player->cached_rec
        ? player->cached_rec
        : playerdb_lookup(&ch->server->player_db, player->uid);
    if (rec) {
      if (!player->name[0] && rec->display_name[0]) {
        strncpy(player->name, rec->display_name, sizeof(player->name) - 1);
        player->name[sizeof(player->name) - 1] = '\0';
      }
      if (!player->skin[0] && rec->equipped_skin[0]) {
        const char *sk = rec->equipped_skin;
        if (strncmp(sk, "skin_", 5) == 0) sk += 5;
        if (sk[0] && sk[0] != 'e' && strcmp(sk, "empty") != 0) {
          if (sk[0] == '%' || strncmp(sk, "http", 4) == 0) {
            strncpy(player->skin, sk, sizeof(player->skin) - 1);
          } else {
            snprintf(player->skin, sizeof(player->skin), "%%%s", sk);
          }
          player->skin[sizeof(player->skin) - 1] = '\0';
        }
      }
      BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
      Color level_color = {0x00, 0xBF, 0xFF}; /* DeepSkyBlue */
      char level_msg[128];
      if (rec->games_played > 0) {
        snprintf(level_msg, sizeof(level_msg),
                 "Welcome back! Level %u (XP: %u | Games: %u | Peak: %u)",
                 rec->level, rec->total_xp, rec->games_played,
                 rec->all_time_peak_mass);
      } else {
        snprintf(level_msg, sizeof(level_msg),
                 "Welcome! You are Level %u. Play to earn XP!", rec->level);
      }
      pkt_chat_message(w, "SERVER", level_color, 0x80, level_msg);
      net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));

      /* Show coin/DNA balance */
      if (rec->coins > 0 || rec->dna > 0) {
        char coin_msg[128];
        snprintf(coin_msg, sizeof(coin_msg), "Coins: %u | DNA: %u", rec->coins,
                 rec->dna);
        Color coin_color = {0xFF, 0xD7, 0x00}; /* Gold */
        pkt_chat_message(w, "WALLET", coin_color, 0x80, coin_msg);
        net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
      }
    }
  }

  /* Flush all queued join packets as one send */
  net_flush_player(ch->conn_id);

#if LOG_LEVEL >= 3
  INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Joined: '%s' (skin: '%s') cellCount=%d\n",
            ch->player_id, name, skin, player->cell_count);
  if (player->cell_count > 0) {
    INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Own cell ID=%u pos=(%.0f, %.0f) size=%.1f\n",
              ch->player_id, player->cells[0]->id, player->cells[0]->position.x,
              player->cells[0]->position.y, player->cells[0]->radius);
  }
#endif
}

/* ── Operational: Spectate (opcode 1) ────────────────────────── */

static void on_spectate(
    ClientHandler *ch,
    const uint8_t *data,
    size_t len) {
  (void)data;

  if (len != 1 ||
      ch->player_id < 0) {
    return;
  }

  Player *player =
      &ch->server->players[
          ch->player_id];

  if (player->cell_count > 0)
    return;

  bool leaving_world_spectate =
      player->full_map_spectate;

  PlayerViewTrackingSource previous_view =
      player_view_tracking_source(
          player);

  if (!leaving_world_spectate &&
      flush_client_view(
          ch,
          previous_view) < 0) {
    async_log(
        "[Client %d] Spectate flush pending, retrying next tick\n",
        ch->conn_id);
    return;
  }

  player->spectate = true;
  player->free_roam = false;
  leave_world_spectate_mode(player);
  player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
}


/* ── Operational: Mouse (opcode 16) ──────────────────────────── */

static void on_mouse(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (ch->player_id < 0)
    return;
  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];

  BinaryReader r;
  br_init(&r, data, len);
  br_skip(&r, 1);

  double tx = 0.0, ty = 0.0;

  if (len == 13) {
    /* Protocol 6/7: 2x int32 */
    tx = (double)br_read_i32_le(&r) - player->scramble_x;
    ty = (double)br_read_i32_le(&r) - player->scramble_y;
  } else if (len == 9) {
    /* Protocol 5: 2x int16 */
    int16_t mx = (int16_t)br_read_u16_le(&r);
    int16_t my = (int16_t)br_read_u16_le(&r);
    tx = (double)mx - player->scramble_x;
    ty = (double)my - player->scramble_y;
  } else if (len == 21) {
    /* Protocol 4: 2x double */
    tx = br_read_f64_le(&r) - player->scramble_x;
    ty = br_read_f64_le(&r) - player->scramble_y;
  } else {
    INFO_LOG("[Mouse] UNKNOWN len=%llu from player %d\n", (unsigned long long)len, ch->player_id);
    return;
  }

  if (isfinite(tx) && isfinite(ty)) {
    player->mouse_target.x = tx;
    player->mouse_target.y = ty;
  }

  /* Stamp input arrival tick for adaptive tick rate */
  player->last_input_tick = ch->server->ticks;
}

/* ── Operational: Split (opcode 17) ──────────────────────────── */

static void on_split(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (ch->player_id < 0)
    return;
  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];

  if (player->spectate) {
    /* Toggle spectate target */
    if (ch->server->ticks - player->last_keypress_tick < 40)
      return;
    player->last_keypress_tick = ch->server->ticks;
  } else {
    /* SPLIT QUEUE: don't execute immediately — queue for batch processing.
     * All pending splits are processed in one tick before collisions,
     * so rapid space presses (1→2→4→8→16) happen atomically.
     * This prevents viruses from popping partially-split cells.
     *
     * OLD (immediate, one split per tick):
     * server_split_player_cells(ch->server, player);
     */
    /* Cap queued split bursts. One full split-chain needs at most 4 queued
     * split actions: 1->2->4->8->16. Anything above that only creates a combat
     * spike and stale visual state. */
    if (player->pending_splits < 4)
      player->pending_splits++;
    else
      player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
  }
}

/* ── Operational: Spectate toggle (opcode 18) ────────────────── */

static void on_spectate_toggle(
    ClientHandler *ch,
    const uint8_t *data,
    size_t len) {
  (void)data;

  if (len != 1 ||
      ch->player_id < 0) {
    return;
  }

  Player *player =
      &ch->server->players[
          ch->player_id];

  if (player->cell_count > 0)
    return;

  /*
   * Not spectating -> free roam.
   * Grouped -> free roam.
   * Free roam/full map -> grouped.
   */
  bool entering_free_roam =
      !player->spectate ||
      !player->free_roam;

  bool leaving_world_spectate =
      player->full_map_spectate;

  PlayerViewTrackingSource previous_view =
      player_view_tracking_source(
          player);

  if (!leaving_world_spectate &&
      flush_client_view(
          ch,
          previous_view) < 0) {
    async_log(
        "[Client %d] Spectate-toggle flush pending, retrying next tick\n",
        ch->conn_id);
    return;
  }

  player->spectate = true;
  player->free_roam =
      entering_free_roam;

  /*
   * Q leaves full-map mode immediately. Exact tracking is retained so the
   * destination spectator path can produce one atomic old->new diff.
   */
  leave_world_spectate_mode(player);
  player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;

  if (entering_free_roam) {
    if (ch->server->largest_player &&
        ch->server->largest_player->cell_count > 0) {
      player_update_view_center(
          ch->server->largest_player,
          ch->server->ticks);

      player->center =
          ch->server->largest_player->center;
    } else {
      player->center =
          (Vec2){0, 0};
    }
  }

  INFO_LOG(
      "[Player %d] Q: toggled to %s spectate\n",
      ch->player_id,
      player->free_roam
          ? "free"
          : "grouped");
}


/* ── Operational: Full map spectate (opcode 55) ──────────────── */

static void on_full_map_spectate(
    ClientHandler *ch,
    const uint8_t *data,
    size_t len) {
  (void)data;

  if (len != 1 ||
      ch->player_id < 0) {
    return;
  }

  Player *player =
      &ch->server->players[
          ch->player_id];

  if (player->cell_count > 0)
    return;

  if (player->full_map_spectate)
    return;

  if (player_ensure_client_capacity(
          player,
          WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES) < 0) {
    async_log(
        "[FullMap] Player %d: unable to grow client tracking to %d\n",
        player->id,
        WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES);

    return;
  }

  /*
   * Do not flush or clear the previous view.
   *
   * Grouped spectate, free-roam spectate and World Spectate all maintain an
   * exact per-connection tracking snapshot. The dedicated World Spectate path
   * can therefore produce one transactional old-view -> world-view diff.
   *
   * Also preserve the existing scramble. The ordinary UpdateNodes packet
   * serializers already apply the viewer's scramble correctly.
   */
  player->spectate = true;
  player->free_roam = true;
  player->full_map_spectate = true;

  player->full_map_resync_pending = false;
  player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
  player->clear_view_sent = 0;

  Vec2 map_center = {
      (ch->server->border.minx +
       ch->server->border.maxx) * 0.5,

      (ch->server->border.miny +
       ch->server->border.maxy) * 0.5,
  };

  player->center = map_center;
  player->mouse = map_center;
  player->mouse_target = map_center;

  INFO_LOG(
      "[Player %d] Full map spectate: ON capacity=%d tracked=%d\n",
      player->id,
      player->client_capacity,
      player->client_count);
}


/* ── Operational: Quit game (opcode 57) ──────────────────────── */

static void on_quit_game(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  (void)data;
  (void)len;
  if (ch->player_id < 0)
    return;
  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];

  /* Only meaningful while alive */
  if (player->cell_count == 0)
    return;

  /* Orphan all cells: they remain on the map as ownerless blobs.
   * Other players can eat them — no mass denied (not a cheat).
   * The death detection (prev_cell_count > 0 && cell_count == 0)
   * will fire on the next tick, sending ghost cells, session stats,
   * game over packet — the full death sequence. */
  INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Quit game — orphaning %d cells\n",
           ch->player_id, player->cell_count);
  for (int i = 0; i < player->cell_count; i++) {
    Cell *c = player->cells[i];
    c->owner_id = -1;
  }
  player->cell_count = 0;
  ch->server->lb_dirty = true;
}

/* ── Operational: Eject (opcode 21) ──────────────────────────── */

static void on_eject(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (ch->player_id < 0)
    return;
  /* Accept any len — vanilla sends 1 byte, some clients send more */
  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];
  if (player->spectate)
    return;

  /* Throttle: real Agar.io allows 1 eject per 5 ticks (200ms) */
  uint32_t dt = ch->server->ticks - player->last_eject_tick;
  if (dt < 5)
    return;
  player->last_eject_tick = ch->server->ticks;

  server_eject_mass(ch->server, player);
}

/* ── Operational: Chat (opcode 99) ───────────────────────────── */

static void on_chat(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (len < 3 || ch->player_id < 0)
    return;

  uint32_t dt = ch->server->ticks - ch->last_chat_tick;
  ch->last_chat_tick = ch->server->ticks;
  if (dt < 50)
    return; /* throttle */

  uint8_t flags = data[1];
  int rv_len = (flags & 0x0E) * 2;
  if ((int)len < 3 + rv_len)
    return;

  BinaryReader r;
  br_init(&r, data, len);
  br_skip(&r, 2 + rv_len);

  char text_buf[256];
  br_read_string_utf8_safe(&r, text_buf, sizeof(text_buf));
  const char *text = text_buf[0] ? text_buf : NULL;
  
  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];

  if (text && strncmp(text, "/color ", 7) == 0) {
    int target_id, r_val, g_val, b_val;
    if (sscanf(text + 7, "%d %d %d %d", &target_id, &r_val, &g_val, &b_val) ==
        4) {
      if (target_id == player->id &&
          ch->server->players[target_id].active) {
        Player *target = &ch->server->players[target_id];
        target->color = (Color){r_val & 0xFF, g_val & 0xFF, b_val & 0xFF};
        for (int i = 0; i < target->cell_count; i++) {
          target->cells[i]->color = target->color;
        }
        server_send_chat(ch->server, NULL, player, "Your color updated.");
      } else {
        server_send_chat(ch->server, NULL, player, "You can only change your own color.");
      }
    } else if (sscanf(text + 7, "%d %d %d", &r_val, &g_val, &b_val) == 3) {
      player->color = (Color){r_val & 0xFF, g_val & 0xFF, b_val & 0xFF};
      for (int i = 0; i < player->cell_count; i++) {
        player->cells[i]->color = player->color;
      }
      server_send_chat(ch->server, NULL, player, "Your color updated.");
    } else {
      server_send_chat(ch->server, NULL, player,
                       "Usage: /color [id] r g b  OR  /color r g b");
    }
    return;
  }

  server_send_chat(ch->server, player, NULL, text);
}

/* ── Operational: Admin Live Property Control (Opcode 251 / 0xFB) ── */

static void on_admin_command(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (len < 5)
    return;

  BinaryReader r;
  br_init(&r, data, len);
  br_skip(&r, 1); /* skip opcode 0xFB */

  /* Parse ONLY the password first — don't touch prop/val until authenticated */
  char pass[64] = {0};
  br_read_string_utf8_safe(&r, pass, sizeof(pass));

  /* Fail-closed: if no admin password is configured, reject ALL admin commands */
  const char *expected = ch->server->config.admin_password;
  if (!expected[0]) {
    async_log("[ADMIN] Rejected from conn_id %d (admin commands disabled)\n", ch->conn_id);
    BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
    bw_reset(w);
    bw_write_u8(w, 0xFB);
    bw_write_u8(w, 1);
    bw_write_string_utf8_zero(w, "Admin commands disabled on this server");
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  /* Constant-time-ish comparison to avoid timing side-channels on the password.
   * Not truly constant-time (strcmp short-circuits), but sufficient for this
   * use case since the attacker can't measure sub-ms WebSocket latency. */
  if (strcmp(pass, expected) != 0) {
    async_log("[ADMIN] Auth failure from conn_id %d\n", ch->conn_id);
    BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
    bw_reset(w);
    bw_write_u8(w, 0xFB);
    bw_write_u8(w, 1); /* 1 = Auth Failure */
    bw_write_string_utf8_zero(w, "Auth failed: Incorrect password");
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  /* Authenticated — NOW parse property and value */
  char prop[64] = {0};
  char val[128] = {0};
  br_read_string_utf8_safe(&r, prop, sizeof(prop));
  br_read_string_utf8_safe(&r, val, sizeof(val));

  /* Execute property modification */
  char response_msg[256] = {0};
  uint8_t status = 0;

  if (strcmp(prop, "mode") == 0) {
    if (strcmp(val, "manual") == 0) {
      ch->server->map_scaler.enabled = true;  /* MapScaler is ALWAYS enabled */
      ch->server->map_scaler.manual_override = true; /* Pause player-count tier checks */
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "SUCCESS: mode = MANUAL (player-count auto scaling paused, proportional map scaler remains ALWAYS active)");
    } else {
      ch->server->map_scaler.enabled = true;
      ch->server->map_scaler.manual_override = false;
      int default_bots = 960;
      bots_set_count(&ch->server->bot_mgr, ch->server, default_bots);
      int total_players = server_alive_count(ch->server);
      MapTier target_tier = mapscaler_find_tier_for_players(&ch->server->map_scaler, total_players);
      if (target_tier != ch->server->map_scaler.current_tier) {
        mapscaler_trigger_tier_change(&ch->server->map_scaler, ch->server, target_tier);
      }
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "SUCCESS: mode = AUTOMATIC (dynamic map scaling re-enabled to Tier %d, bots reset to %d)", (int)target_tier, default_bots);
    }
  } else if (strcmp(prop, "tier") == 0 || strcmp(prop, "maptier") == 0) {
    int t = atoi(val);
    if (t >= 0 && t <= 12) {
      ch->server->map_scaler.manual_override = true;
      ch->server->map_scaler.enabled = true;
      mapscaler_trigger_tier_change(&ch->server->map_scaler, ch->server, (MapTier)t);

      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg),
               "SUCCESS: Initiated smooth gradual transition to Tier %d (target size=%.0f)",
               t, ch->server->map_scaler.tiers[t].map_size);
    } else {
      status = 2;
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "ERROR: tier range 0..12");
    }
  } else if (strcmp(prop, "map_size") == 0 || strcmp(prop, "border_size") == 0) {
    double new_sz = atof(val);
    if (new_sz >= 2000.0 && new_sz <= 452548.0) {
      ch->server->border.width = new_sz;
      ch->server->border.height = new_sz;
      ch->server->border.minx = -new_sz / 2.0;
      ch->server->border.miny = -new_sz / 2.0;
      ch->server->border.maxx = new_sz / 2.0;
      ch->server->border.maxy = new_sz / 2.0;
      
      ch->server->map_scaler.current_size = new_sz;
      ch->server->map_scaler.target_size = new_sz;
      MapTier derived_t = mapscaler_tier_for_size(&ch->server->map_scaler, new_sz);
      ch->server->map_scaler.current_tier = derived_t;
      ch->server->map_scaler.target_tier = derived_t;

      /* Proportional food & virus scaling for new map size */
      double area_ratio = (new_sz * new_sz) / ch->server->map_scaler.base_map_area;
      ch->server->config.food_amount = (int)(ch->server->map_scaler.base_food_amount * area_ratio + 0.5);
      ch->server->config.virus_amount = (int)(ch->server->map_scaler.base_virus_amount * area_ratio + 0.5);
      ch->server->food_target = ch->server->config.food_amount;

      /* Broadcast opcode 64 map border update to all connected clients */
      BinaryWriter bw;
      bw_init(&bw);
      for (int i = 0; i < ch->server->connected_count; i++) {
        Player *p = &ch->server->players[ch->server->connected_ids[i]];
        if (p->conn_id < 0) continue;
        bw_reset(&bw);
        pkt_set_border_simple(&bw, p, ch->server->border.minx, ch->server->border.miny,
                              ch->server->border.maxx, ch->server->border.maxy);
        net_queue_to_player(p->conn_id, bw_data(&bw), bw_length(&bw));
      }
      bw_free(&bw);

      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "SUCCESS: map_size = %.0f (proportional food = %d, virus = %d)", new_sz, ch->server->config.food_amount, ch->server->config.virus_amount);
    } else {
      status = 2;
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "ERROR: map_size range 2000..452548");
    }
  } else if (strcmp(prop, "bot_count") == 0 || strcmp(prop, "bots") == 0) {
    int new_bots = atoi(val);
    if (new_bots >= 0 && new_bots <= MAX_BOTS) {
      bots_set_count(&ch->server->bot_mgr, ch->server, new_bots);
      if (ch->server->map_scaler.enabled && !ch->server->map_scaler.manual_override) {
        int total_players = server_alive_count(ch->server);
        MapTier target_tier = mapscaler_find_tier_for_players(&ch->server->map_scaler, total_players);
        if (target_tier != ch->server->map_scaler.current_tier) {
          mapscaler_trigger_tier_change(&ch->server->map_scaler, ch->server, target_tier);
        }
        snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "SUCCESS: bot_count updated to %d live bots (auto scaling map smoothly to Tier %d)", new_bots, (int)target_tier);
      } else {
        snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "SUCCESS: bot_count updated to %d live bots on the fly (manual mode)", new_bots);
      }
    } else {
      status = 2;
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "ERROR: bot_count range 0..%d", MAX_BOTS);
    }
  } else if (strcmp(prop, "food_amount") == 0 || strcmp(prop, "food") == 0) {
    int new_food = atoi(val);
    if (new_food >= 0 && new_food <= MAX_FOOD) {
      double sz = ch->server->border.width;
      double area_ratio = (sz * sz) / ch->server->map_scaler.base_map_area;
      if (area_ratio <= 0.01) area_ratio = 1.0;
      ch->server->map_scaler.base_food_amount = (int)(new_food / area_ratio + 0.5);
      if (ch->server->map_scaler.base_food_amount < 10) ch->server->map_scaler.base_food_amount = 10;
      ch->server->config.food_amount = new_food;
      ch->server->food_target = new_food;
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "SUCCESS: food_amount updated to %d (proportional base food = %d)", new_food, ch->server->map_scaler.base_food_amount);
    } else {
      status = 2;
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "ERROR: food_amount invalid");
    }
  } else if (strcmp(prop, "virus_amount") == 0 || strcmp(prop, "virus") == 0) {
    int new_v = atoi(val);
    if (new_v >= 0 && new_v <= MAX_VIRUSES) {
      double sz = ch->server->border.width;
      double area_ratio = (sz * sz) / ch->server->map_scaler.base_map_area;
      if (area_ratio <= 0.01) area_ratio = 1.0;
      ch->server->map_scaler.base_virus_amount = (int)(new_v / area_ratio + 0.5);
      if (ch->server->map_scaler.base_virus_amount < 2) ch->server->map_scaler.base_virus_amount = 2;
      ch->server->config.virus_amount = new_v;
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "SUCCESS: virus_amount updated to %d (proportional base virus = %d)", new_v, ch->server->map_scaler.base_virus_amount);
    } else {
      status = 2;
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "ERROR: virus_amount invalid");
    }
  } else if (strcmp(prop, "setlevel") == 0 || strcmp(prop, "level") == 0) {
    int target_lvl = atoi(val);
    if (target_lvl < 1) target_lvl = 1;
    if (target_lvl > 100) target_lvl = 100;

    Player *player = (ch->player_id >= 0 && ch->player_id < MAX_PLAYERS) ? &ch->server->players[ch->player_id] : NULL;
    if (player && player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
      PlayerRecord *rec = player->cached_rec ? player->cached_rec : playerdb_lookup(&ch->server->player_db, player->uid);
      if (rec) {
        rec->level = (uint32_t)target_lvl;
        uint32_t req_xp = (target_lvl <= 1) ? 0 : (target_lvl == 2 ? 35 : (target_lvl == 3 ? 125 : (target_lvl == 4 ? 250 : (target_lvl == 5 ? 500 : (50 * (uint32_t)target_lvl * ((uint32_t)target_lvl - 1) - 500)))));
        if (rec->total_xp < req_xp)
          rec->total_xp = req_xp;
        uint32_t bonus = rec->level > 1 ? rec->level - 1 : 0;
        rec->starting_mass_bonus = bonus < 28 ? bonus : 28;

        if (target_lvl >= 100) {
          if (rec->coins < 50000) rec->coins = 50000;
          if (rec->dna < 1000) rec->dna = 1000;
          if (rec->all_time_peak_mass < 22500) rec->all_time_peak_mass = 22500;
          if (rec->games_played < 100) rec->games_played = 100;
          if (rec->trophies < 100) rec->trophies = 100;
        }
        playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);

        BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
        bw_reset(w);
        pkt_102_login_response(w, rec, player, &ch->server->economy,
                               (uint64_t)time(NULL), ch->server->ticks);
        net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));

        bw_reset(w);
        pkt_102_wallet_update(w, rec->coins, rec->dna);
        net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));

        Color level_color = {0x00, 0xBF, 0xFF};
        char level_msg[128];
        snprintf(level_msg, sizeof(level_msg), "Admin set your profile: Level %u (XP: %u | Coins: %u | DNA: %u)", rec->level, rec->total_xp, rec->coins, rec->dna);
        pkt_chat_message(w, "SERVER", level_color, 0x80, level_msg);
        net_queue_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
        net_flush_player(ch->conn_id);

        snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "SUCCESS: Set level %d (XP=%u, Coins=%u, DNA=%u) for '%s'", target_lvl, rec->total_xp, rec->coins, rec->dna, rec->display_name[0] ? rec->display_name : player->uid);
      } else {
        status = 2;
        snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "ERROR: Persistent profile not found");
      }
    } else {
      status = 2;
      snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "ERROR: Connection not linked to a persistent profile");
    }
  } else if (strcmp(prop, "get_config") == 0 || strcmp(prop, "status") == 0) {
    snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "STATUS: mode=%s bots=%d food=%d virus=%d map_size=%.0f players=%d",
             ch->server->map_scaler.manual_override ? "MANUAL" : "AUTOMATIC",
             ch->server->bot_mgr.count, ch->server->config.food_amount,
             ch->server->config.virus_amount, ch->server->border.width,
             server_alive_count(ch->server));
  } else {
    status = 2;
    snprintf(response_msg, sizeof(response_msg), "ERROR: Unknown property '%s'", prop);
  }

  if (status == 0 && strcmp(prop, "get_config") != 0 && strcmp(prop, "status") != 0) {
    char toast_msg[256];
    snprintf(toast_msg, sizeof(toast_msg), "ADMIN: Changed %s to %s", prop, val);
    server_broadcast_admin_notice(ch->server, 1 /* warning toast */, toast_msg);
  }

  async_log("[ADMIN] Auth OK from conn %d: prop='%s' val='%s' -> %s\n",
            ch->conn_id, prop, val, response_msg);

  BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
  bw_reset(w);
  bw_write_u8(w, 0xFB);
  bw_write_u8(w, status);
  bw_write_string_utf8_zero(w, response_msg);
  net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
  net_flush_player(ch->conn_id);
}

/* ── Operational: ServerStat (opcode 254) ────────────────────── */

static void on_stat(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (len != 1)
    return;
  uint32_t dt = ch->server->ticks - ch->last_stat_tick;
  ch->last_stat_tick = ch->server->ticks;
  if (dt < 25)
    return;

  BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
  int active = server_alive_count(ch->server);
  pkt_server_stat(w, active, MAX_PLAYERS, 0, (int)(ch->server->ticks / 25));
  net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
}

/* ── Operational: Skin URL (opcode 12 / 0x0C) ──────────────────── */

static void on_skin(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (ch->player_id < 0 || len < 1)
    return;
  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];

  /* Reject skin changes while alive — prevents "play again" click from
   * overwriting the current skin even though the join is rejected. */
  if (player->cell_count > 0)
    return;

  BinaryReader r;
  br_init(&r, data, len);
  br_skip(&r, 1); /* skip opcode */

  size_t str_len = (len - 1) / 2;
  if (str_len > MAX_PLAYER_SKIN) {
    str_len = MAX_PLAYER_SKIN;
  }

  /* ogario.v4.js transmits skin URLs as UTF-16LE without a null terminator */
  for (size_t i = 0; i < str_len; i++) {
    if (!br_has_bytes(&r, 2)) {
      str_len = i;
      break;
    }
    uint16_t c = br_read_u16_le(&r);
    player->skin[i] = (char)(c & 0xFF); /* safe truncation: URLs are ASCII */
  }
  player->skin[str_len] = '\0';

  if (str_len > 0) {
    INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Received skin URL: '%s'\n", ch->player_id,
              player->skin);
  } else {
    player->skin[0] = '\0';
  }
}

/* ── Operational: Opcode 102 (auth + protobuf requests) ──────── */

/* Strict protobuf reader for opcode 102 requests. The old scanner guessed the
 * request type and product from printable byte runs, which allowed malformed
 * payloads to be misclassified. */
typedef struct {
  uint32_t type;
  const uint8_t *message;
  size_t message_len;
  bool valid;
} Pb102Request;

static bool pb_read_varint_checked(const uint8_t *data, size_t len,
                                   size_t *pos, uint64_t *out) {
  if (!data || !pos || !out)
    return false;
  uint64_t value = 0;
  for (unsigned shift = 0; shift < 64 && *pos < len; shift += 7) {
    uint8_t b = data[(*pos)++];
    value |= (uint64_t)(b & 0x7fu) << shift;
    if (!(b & 0x80u)) {
      *out = value;
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/* Compatibility wrapper used by the legacy login fallback below. */
static uint32_t pb_read_varint(const uint8_t *data, size_t len, size_t *pos) {
  uint64_t value = 0;
  if (!pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, pos, &value) || value > UINT32_MAX)
    return 0;
  return (uint32_t)value;
}

static bool pb_skip_value(const uint8_t *data, size_t len, size_t *pos,
                          uint32_t wire) {
  uint64_t value = 0;
  switch (wire) {
  case 0:
    return pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, pos, &value);
  case 1:
    if (*pos > len || len - *pos < 8)
      return false;
    *pos += 8;
    return true;
  case 2:
    if (!pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, pos, &value) || value > len - *pos)
      return false;
    *pos += (size_t)value;
    return true;
  case 5:
    if (*pos > len || len - *pos < 4)
      return false;
    *pos += 4;
    return true;
  default:
    return false;
  }
}

static bool pb_find_len_field(const uint8_t *data, size_t len,
                              uint32_t wanted_field, const uint8_t **out,
                              size_t *out_len) {
  size_t pos = 0;
  while (pos < len) {
    uint64_t tag = 0;
    if (!pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, &pos, &tag) || tag == 0)
      return false;
    uint32_t field = (uint32_t)(tag >> 3);
    uint32_t wire = (uint32_t)(tag & 7u);
    if (wire == 2) {
      uint64_t n = 0;
      if (!pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, &pos, &n) || n > len - pos)
        return false;
      if (field == wanted_field) {
        if (out)
          *out = data + pos;
        if (out_len)
          *out_len = (size_t)n;
        return true;
      }
      pos += (size_t)n;
    } else if (!pb_skip_value(data, len, &pos, wire)) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

static bool pb_find_varint_field(const uint8_t *data, size_t len,
                                 uint32_t wanted_field, uint64_t *out) {
  size_t pos = 0;
  while (pos < len) {
    uint64_t tag = 0;
    if (!pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, &pos, &tag) || tag == 0)
      return false;
    uint32_t field = (uint32_t)(tag >> 3);
    uint32_t wire = (uint32_t)(tag & 7u);
    if (wire == 0) {
      uint64_t value = 0;
      if (!pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, &pos, &value))
        return false;
      if (field == wanted_field) {
        if (out)
          *out = value;
        return true;
      }
    } else if (!pb_skip_value(data, len, &pos, wire)) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

static bool pb_copy_string_field(const uint8_t *data, size_t len,
                                 uint32_t field, char *out,
                                 size_t out_size) {
  const uint8_t *value = NULL;
  size_t value_len = 0;
  if (!out || out_size == 0 ||
      !pb_find_len_field(data, len, field, &value, &value_len) ||
      value_len >= out_size)
    return false;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < value_len; i++) {
    if (value[i] < 0x20 || value[i] >= 0x7f)
      return false;
  }
  memcpy(out, value, value_len);
  out[value_len] = '\0';
  return true;
}

static size_t pb_collect_string_field(
    const uint8_t *data, size_t len, uint32_t wanted_field,
    char out[][ECONOMY_PRODUCT_ID_LEN], size_t max_items) {
  if (!data || !out || max_items == 0)
    return 0;
  size_t pos = 0, count = 0;
  while (pos < len) {
    uint64_t tag = 0;
    if (!pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, &pos, &tag) || tag == 0)
      break;
    uint32_t field = (uint32_t)(tag >> 3);
    uint32_t wire = (uint32_t)(tag & 7u);
    if (wire != 2) {
      if (!pb_skip_value(data, len, &pos, wire))
        break;
      continue;
    }
    uint64_t n = 0;
    if (!pb_read_varint_checked(data, len, &pos, &n) || n > len - pos)
      break;
    if (field == wanted_field && count < max_items &&
        n > 0 && n < ECONOMY_PRODUCT_ID_LEN) {
      bool printable = true;
      for (size_t i = 0; i < (size_t)n; i++) {
        if (data[pos + i] < 0x20 || data[pos + i] >= 0x7f) {
          printable = false;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (printable) {
        memcpy(out[count], data + pos, (size_t)n);
        out[count][n] = '\0';
        count++;
      }
    }
    pos += (size_t)n;
  }
  return count;
}

static uint32_t client_saturating_add_u32(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
  return UINT32_MAX - a < b ? UINT32_MAX : a + b;
}

static bool pb102_parse_request(const uint8_t *data, size_t len,
                                Pb102Request *request) {
  if (!request)
    return false;
  memset(request, 0, sizeof(*request));
  if (!data || len < 2 || data[0] != 102)
    return false;

  const uint8_t *inner = NULL;
  size_t inner_len = 0;
  if (!pb_find_len_field(data + 1, len - 1, 2, &inner, &inner_len))
    return false;

  uint64_t type = 0;
  if (!pb_find_varint_field(inner, inner_len, 1, &type) || type > UINT32_MAX)
    return false;

  const uint8_t *message = NULL;
  size_t message_len = 0;
  if (!pb_find_len_field(inner, inner_len, (uint32_t)type, &message,
                         &message_len))
    return false;

  request->type = (uint32_t)type;
  request->message = message;
  request->message_len = message_len;
  request->valid = true;
  return true;
}

static PlayerRecord *client_profile_record(ClientHandler *ch, Player *player) {
  if (!ch || !player || !player_profile_is_persistent(player))
    return NULL;
  PlayerRecord *rec = player->cached_rec;
  if (!rec) {
    rec = playerdb_lookup(&ch->server->player_db, player->uid);
    player->cached_rec = rec;
  }
  return rec;
}

static bool parse_custom_skin_id(const char *id, uint64_t *hash) {
  if (!id || strncmp(id, "custom_", 7) != 0 || strlen(id) != 23)
    return false;
  uint64_t value = 0;
  for (int i = 7; i < 23; i++) {
    unsigned char c = (unsigned char)id[i];
    unsigned digit;
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
      digit = c - '0';
    else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
      digit = c - 'a' + 10;
    else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
      digit = c - 'A' + 10;
    else
      return false;
    value = (value << 4) | digit;
  }
  if (value == 0)
    return false;
  if (hash)
    *hash = value;
  return true;
}

static bool parse_potion_skip_slot(const char *product_id, int *slot_out) {
  if (!product_id || !strstr(product_id, "skip") ||
      !strstr(product_id, "brew"))
    return false;

  const char *marker = strstr(product_id, "_slot_");
  if (!marker)
    return false;
  marker += 6;
  if (*marker < '0' || *marker > '9')
    return false;

  unsigned long slot = 0;
  while (*marker >= '0' && *marker <= '9') {
    slot = slot * 10u + (unsigned long)(*marker - '0');
    if (slot > MAX_POTIONS)
      return false;
    marker++;
  }
  if (*marker != '\0' || slot < 1 || slot > MAX_POTIONS)
    return false;
  if (slot_out)
    *slot_out = (int)slot;
  return true;
}

static bool custom_skin_png_valid(const uint8_t *png, size_t len) {
  static const uint8_t signature[8] = {0x89, 'P', 'N', 'G', 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a,
                                        0x0a};
  if (!png || len < 33 || len > 512u * 1024u ||
      memcmp(png, signature, sizeof(signature)) != 0 ||
      memcmp(png + 12, "IHDR", 4) != 0)
    return false;
  uint32_t width = ((uint32_t)png[16] << 24) | ((uint32_t)png[17] << 16) |
                   ((uint32_t)png[18] << 8) | png[19];
  uint32_t height = ((uint32_t)png[20] << 24) | ((uint32_t)png[21] << 16) |
                    ((uint32_t)png[22] << 8) | png[23];
  return width >= 32 && height >= 32 && width <= 1024 && height <= 1024;
}

static bool ensure_custom_skin_directory(void) {
  const char *path = server_data_path("custom_skins");
#ifdef _WIN32
  if (CreateDirectoryA(path, NULL) || GetLastError() == ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS)
    return true;
#else
  if (mkdir(path, 0755) == 0 || errno == EEXIST)
    return true;
#endif
  return false;
}

static bool custom_skin_write_file(const char *skin_id, const uint8_t *png,
                                   size_t png_len) {
  if (!ensure_custom_skin_directory())
    return false;
  char relative[160];
  int n = snprintf(relative, sizeof(relative), "custom_skins/%s.png", skin_id);
  if (n <= 0 || n >= (int)sizeof(relative))
    return false;
  FILE *f = fopen(server_data_path(relative), "wb");
  if (!f)
    return false;
  bool ok = fwrite(png, 1, png_len, f) == png_len && fflush(f) == 0;
  fclose(f);
  if (!ok)
    remove(server_data_path(relative));
  return ok;
}

static void custom_skin_delete_file(const char *skin_id) {
  char relative[160];
  int n = snprintf(relative, sizeof(relative), "custom_skins/%s.png", skin_id);
  if (n > 0 && n < (int)sizeof(relative))
    remove(server_data_path(relative));
}

static void on_opcode_102(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (ch->player_id < 0 || len < 6)
    return;

  /* Shop screens legitimately burst several profile requests. Keep a firm
   * per-second ceiling without dropping normal purchase/open/equip traffic. */
  uint32_t now = ch->server->ticks;
  if (now - ch->last_op102_tick >= 25) {
    ch->last_op102_tick = now;
    ch->op102_count = 0;
  }
  if (++ch->op102_count > 24 || len > 1024u * 1024u)
    return; /* rate/payload limited */

  Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];

  Pb102Request request;
  bool parsed_request = pb102_parse_request(data, len, &request);
  uint32_t type = parsed_request ? request.type : 0;
  int slot = 0;
  if (parsed_request && (type == 30 || type == 122 || type == 124)) {
    uint64_t value = 0;
    if (pb_find_varint_field(request.message, request.message_len, 1, &value) &&
        value <= INT_MAX)
      slot = (int)value;
  }

  /* Type 10 = Login Request (auth token) — process even if late (spectating,
   * pre-spawn, or alive). The bonus applies on the NEXT spawn. */
  if (type == 10 || type == 0) {
    if (player->linked)
      return; /* Already authenticated */

    /* Extract auth token via protobuf field parsing.
     * The login message structure is:
     *   Data { contentType=1, uncompressedData=2 {
     *     type=1:10,
     *     field_10 (login sub-msg) {
     *       string fields contain the auth token
     *     }
     *   }}
     * We parse the protobuf properly by field tags, extracting the FIRST
     * length-delimited string >= 10 chars from the login sub-message.
     * This replaces the old "longest printable ASCII" heuristic which was
     * fragile and could misidentify tokens under certain payloads. */
    int best_start = -1, best_len = 0;

    /* Step 1: Find the uncompressedData sub-message (outer field 2) */
    size_t pos = 1; /* skip opcode byte */
    const uint8_t *inner = NULL;
    size_t inner_len = 0;

    while (pos < len) {
      uint32_t tag = pb_read_varint(data, len, &pos);
      uint32_t field = tag >> 3;
      uint32_t wire = tag & 7;
      if (wire == 0) {
        pb_read_varint(data, len, &pos); /* skip varint */
      } else if (wire == 2) {
        uint32_t sub_len = pb_read_varint(data, len, &pos);
        if (field == 2 && sub_len > 0 && pos + sub_len <= len) {
          inner = data + pos;
          inner_len = sub_len;
        }
        pos += sub_len;
      } else {
        break;
      }
    }

    /* Step 2: Inside uncompressedData, find the login sub-message (field 10) */
    if (inner) {
      const uint8_t *login_msg = NULL;
      size_t login_len = 0;
      size_t sp = 0;

      while (sp < inner_len) {
        uint32_t tag = pb_read_varint(inner, inner_len, &sp);
        uint32_t field = tag >> 3;
        uint32_t wire = tag & 7;
        if (wire == 0) {
          pb_read_varint(inner, inner_len, &sp);
        } else if (wire == 2) {
          uint32_t sub_len = pb_read_varint(inner, inner_len, &sp);
          if (field == 10 && sub_len > 0 && sp + sub_len <= inner_len) {
            login_msg = inner + sp;
            login_len = sub_len;
          }
          sp += sub_len;
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }

      /* Step 3: Inside the login sub-message, find the FIRST string field
       * that is >= 10 printable chars (the auth token). */
      if (login_msg) {
        size_t lp = 0;
        while (lp < login_len && best_len < 10) {
          uint32_t tag = pb_read_varint(login_msg, login_len, &lp);
          uint32_t wire = tag & 7;
          if (wire == 0) {
            pb_read_varint(login_msg, login_len, &lp);
          } else if (wire == 2) {
            uint32_t str_len = pb_read_varint(login_msg, login_len, &lp);
            if (str_len >= 10 && lp + str_len <= login_len) {
              /* Verify it's printable ASCII */
              bool valid = true;
              for (uint32_t ci = 0; ci < str_len && ci < 512; ci++) {
                uint8_t c = login_msg[lp + ci];
                if (c < 0x20 || c >= 0x7F) { valid = false; break; }
              }
              if (valid) {
                best_start = (int)(login_msg + lp - data);
                best_len = (int)str_len;
              }
            }
            lp += str_len;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    /* Fallback: if protobuf parsing didn't find a token, try the old
     * "longest printable ASCII run" heuristic as last resort. */
    if (best_len < 10) {
      int run_start = -1, run_len = 0;
      for (size_t i = 1; i < len; i++) {
        uint8_t c = data[i];
        if (c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7F) {
          if (run_start < 0) run_start = (int)i;
          run_len = (int)i - run_start + 1;
        } else {
          if (run_len > best_len) { best_start = run_start; best_len = run_len; }
          run_start = -1; run_len = 0;
        }
      }
      if (run_len > best_len) { best_start = run_start; best_len = run_len; }
    }

    if (best_len >= 10) {
      /* Parse SID: and NAME: prefixes if present in the raw payload.
       * Format: "SID:<socialId>\nNAME:<displayName>\n<token>"
       * The prefixes are added by the client for expanding.land logins. */
      {
        const char *raw = (const char *)&data[1]; /* skip opcode byte */
        int raw_len = (int)(len - 1);
        int scan = 0;
        while (scan < raw_len) {
          if (scan + 4 <= raw_len && raw[scan] == 'S' && raw[scan+1] == 'I' &&
              raw[scan+2] == 'D' && raw[scan+3] == ':') {
            scan += 4; /* skip "SID:" */
            int vstart = scan;
            while (scan < raw_len && raw[scan] != '\n') scan++;
            int vlen = scan - vstart;
            if (vlen > 0 && vlen < 31) {
              memcpy(player->social_id, &raw[vstart], vlen);
              player->social_id[vlen] = '\0';
            }
            if (scan < raw_len) scan++; /* skip \n */
          } else if (scan + 5 <= raw_len && raw[scan] == 'N' && raw[scan+1] == 'A' &&
                     raw[scan+2] == 'M' && raw[scan+3] == 'E' && raw[scan+4] == ':') {
            scan += 5; /* skip "NAME:" */
            int vstart = scan;
            while (scan < raw_len && raw[scan] != '\n') scan++;
            int vlen = scan - vstart;
            if (vlen > 0 && vlen < 63) {
              memcpy(player->display_name, &raw[vstart], vlen);
              player->display_name[vlen] = '\0';
              if (!player->name[0]) {
                strncpy(player->name, player->display_name, sizeof(player->name) - 1);
                player->name[sizeof(player->name) - 1] = '\0';
              }
            }
            if (scan < raw_len) scan++; /* skip \n */
          } else {
            break; /* no more prefixes */
          }
        }
      }

      if (player->social_id[0]) {
        playerdb_hash_uid(
            player->uid,
            player->social_id,
            (int)strlen(player->social_id));
      } else {
        playerdb_hash_uid(
            player->uid,
            (const char *)&data[best_start],
            best_len);
      }

      player->linked = true;
      player->cached_rec = NULL;
      player->db_index = -1;

      /* Detect auth provider from token format + social ID:
       * - Google tokens start with "ya29." (OAuth2 access token prefix)
       * - Discord OAuth2 tokens are short random alphanumeric (NO dots!)
       *   Detected by SID format: Discord snowflake = 17-19 digit numeric
       * - Facebook tokens are long hex-ish strings
       * Default to google (1) if unknown. */
      if (best_len >= 5 &&
          data[best_start] == 'y' && data[best_start+1] == 'a' &&
          data[best_start+2] == '2' && data[best_start+3] == '9' &&
          data[best_start+4] == '.') {
        player->auth_provider = 1; /* Google */
      } else if (player->social_id[0]) {
        /* SID was parsed from prefix — check if it's a Discord snowflake.
         * Discord user IDs are 17-19 digit numeric strings. */
        int sid_len = (int)strlen(player->social_id);
        bool all_digits = true;
        for (int ci = 0; ci < sid_len; ci++) {
          if (player->social_id[ci] < '0' || player->social_id[ci] > '9') {
            all_digits = false; break;
          }
        }
        if (all_digits && sid_len >= 17 && sid_len <= 20) {
          player->auth_provider = 3; /* Discord (snowflake SID) */
        } else if (all_digits && sid_len >= 21) {
          player->auth_provider = 1; /* Google (sub ID is 21+ digits) */
        } else {
          player->auth_provider = 1; /* Unknown — default Google */
        }
      } else {
        player->auth_provider = 1; /* No SID → default Google */
      }

      INFO_LOG("[LOGIN] player=%d uid='%s' social_id='%s' name='%s' "
                "linked=%d token_len=%d auth_provider=%d alive=%d\n",
                player->id, player->uid, player->social_id, player->display_name,
                player->linked ? 1 : 0, best_len, player->auth_provider,
                player->cell_count > 0 ? 1 : 0);

      /* Save raw token → tokens.txt (deferred: background thread writes) */
      token_log_add(player->uid, (const char *)&data[best_start], best_len);

      /* Calculate login bonus mass */
      PlayerRecord *rec = NULL;

      if (player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
        rec = player->cached_rec;

        if (!rec) {
          rec = playerdb_lookup(
              &ch->server->player_db,
              player->uid);

          player->cached_rec = rec;
        }
      }
      double bonus_mass = 5.0; /* linked account bonus */
      if (rec && rec->starting_mass_bonus > 0)
        bonus_mass += (double)rec->starting_mass_bonus;
      if (bonus_mass > 33.0)
        bonus_mass = 33.0; /* cap so total doesn't exceed 43 */

      /* If player is alive and hasn't received bonus yet, apply immediately.
       * This handles the common case where spawn happens before auth arrives.
       * The bonus is added to the player's first (largest) cell. */
      INFO_LOG("[LOGIN] Bonus check: player=%d cells=%d bonus_applied=%d "
                "bonus_mass=%.0f linked=%d\n",
                player->id, player->cell_count,
                player->login_bonus_applied ? 1 : 0,
                bonus_mass, player->linked ? 1 : 0);
      if (player->cell_count > 0 && !player->login_bonus_applied) {
        Cell *first_cell = player->cells[0];
        double current_mass = first_cell->mass;
        double new_mass = current_mass + bonus_mass;
        double new_size = sqrt(new_mass * 100.0);
        cell_set_size(first_cell, new_size);
        player->login_bonus_applied = true;
        INFO_LOG("[LOGIN] Applied bonus +%.0f mass to alive player=%d "
                  "(%.0f -> %.0f)\n",
                  bonus_mass, player->id, current_mass, new_mass);
      }
      /* If not alive, login_bonus_applied stays false →
       * server_spawn_player() will apply it at next spawn. */

      /* Load equipped vanilla skin from PlayerRecord → player->skin.
       * This makes the skin visible to other clients via flags & 4. */
      if (rec && rec->equipped_skin[0]) {
        const char *skin_id = rec->equipped_skin;
        if (strncmp(skin_id, "skin_", 5) == 0)
          skin_id += 5;
        if (skin_id[0] && skin_id[0] != 'e' && strcmp(skin_id, "empty") != 0) {
          snprintf(player->skin, sizeof(player->skin), "%%%s", skin_id);
          INFO_LOG("[LOGIN] Loaded skin '%s' for player=%d\n", player->skin,
                    player->id);

          /* Force all viewers to re-add this player's cells on the next
           * tick so the add_node packet includes the newly loaded skin.
           * The client treats add_node for existing IDs as a property
           * update (name, skin) — no visual flicker. */
          server_invalidate_player_cells(ch->server, player->id);
        }
      }

      /* Restore persistent potion timers and active boost expirations before
       * the authoritative login snapshot is serialized. */
      if (rec) {
        economy_restore_player_state(player, rec, ch->server->ticks,
                                     (uint64_t)time(NULL));
        player->quest_session_start_mass = player->mass_consumed;
        if (rec->equipped_skin[0] &&
            !economy_skin_product_owned(&ch->server->economy, rec,
                                        rec->equipped_skin)) {
          uint64_t custom_hash = 0;
          if (!parse_custom_skin_id(rec->equipped_skin, &custom_hash) ||
              !economy_custom_skin_contains(rec, custom_hash)) {
            snprintf(rec->equipped_skin, sizeof(rec->equipped_skin),
                     "skin_empty");
            player->skin[0] = '\0';
            server_invalidate_player_cells(ch->server, player->id);
          }
        }
        playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);
      }

      /* Send protobuf Login Response (sub-op 11) immediately,
       * regardless of player state (alive, spectating, pre-spawn). */
      if (rec) {
        BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
        bw_reset(w);
        pkt_102_login_response(w, rec, player, &ch->server->economy,
                               (uint64_t)time(NULL), ch->server->ticks);
        net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
        INFO_LOG("[LOGIN] Sent login response to conn=%d (level=%u total_xp=%u pkt_len=%llu)\n",
                  ch->conn_id, rec->level, rec->total_xp, (unsigned long long)bw_length(w));
      }
    } else {
      INFO_LOG(
          "[LOGIN] conn=%d type=%u NO valid token (best_len=%d, payload=%llu)\n",
          ch->conn_id, type, best_len, (unsigned long long)len);
    }
    return;
  }

  /* All remaining profile, wallet, potion, skin and boost requests require a
   * persistent authenticated account. Client-supplied prices/rewards are never
   * accepted; every transaction is resolved from server-owned state. */
  PlayerRecord *rec = client_profile_record(ch, player);
  if (!rec)
    return;

  BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
  uint64_t unix_now = (uint64_t)time(NULL);

  if (type == 30) {
    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_pong(w, (uint32_t)slot);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  char product_id[ECONOMY_PURCHASE_ID_LEN] = {0};
  if (parsed_request && type != 80)
    pb_copy_string_field(request.message, request.message_len, 1, product_id,
                         sizeof(product_id));

  if (type == 70) { /* Soft_purchase_request */
    PlayerRecord before = *rec;
    EconomyTransaction tx;

    /* Potion-skip prices fall as brewing progresses. The client derives the
     * displayed value from Wallet - Time-Variable Prices; reproduce the same
     * calculation from server-owned timer state and catalog metadata. */
    uint32_t effective_price = 0;
    bool use_effective_price = false;
    int requested_skip_slot = 0;
    uint32_t base_price = 0, step_seconds = 0, decrease_per_step = 0;
    if (parse_potion_skip_slot(product_id, &requested_skip_slot) &&
        economy_soft_purchase_pricing(
            &ch->server->economy, product_id, &base_price, &step_seconds,
            &decrease_per_step) &&
        step_seconds > 0 && decrease_per_step > 0 &&
        requested_skip_slot >= 1 && requested_skip_slot <= MAX_POTIONS) {
      Potion *p = &player->potions[requested_skip_slot - 1];
      if (p->rarity != POTION_NONE && p->brew_start_tick != 0 && !p->ready) {
        uint32_t elapsed_ticks = ch->server->ticks - p->brew_start_tick;
        if (elapsed_ticks > p->brew_duration)
          elapsed_ticks = p->brew_duration;
        uint32_t total_seconds = (p->brew_duration + 24u) / 25u;
        uint32_t remaining_ticks = p->brew_duration - elapsed_ticks;
        uint32_t remaining_seconds = (remaining_ticks + 24u) / 25u;
        uint32_t elapsed_seconds = total_seconds > remaining_seconds
                                       ? total_seconds - remaining_seconds
                                       : 0;
        uint64_t discount =
            (uint64_t)(elapsed_seconds / step_seconds) * decrease_per_step;
        effective_price = discount >= base_price
                              ? 0
                              : base_price - (uint32_t)discount;
        use_effective_price = true;
      }
    }

    EconomyResult result =
        use_effective_price
            ? economy_apply_soft_purchase_at_price(
                  &ch->server->economy, rec, product_id, effective_price, &tx)
            : economy_apply_soft_purchase(
                  &ch->server->economy, rec, product_id, &tx);

    /* Potion brew skips are catalog purchases, but the purchased wallet item
     * is a transient command rather than durable inventory. Resolve the exact
     * target slot from the server-owned catalog product, mark only that potion
     * ready, then consume the command in the same atomic transaction. */
    if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK) {
      int skip_update = -1;
      int skip_slot = 0;
      bool malformed_skip = false;

      for (uint32_t i = 0; i < tx.update_count; i++) {
        if (tx.updates[i].wallet_type != 9 || tx.updates[i].delta <= 0)
          continue;

        int parsed_slot = 0;
        if (skip_update >= 0) {
          malformed_skip = true;
          break;
        }

        if (!parse_potion_skip_slot(tx.updates[i].product_id, &parsed_slot) &&
            !parse_potion_skip_slot(product_id, &parsed_slot)) {
          malformed_skip = true;
          break;
        }

        skip_update = (int)i;
        skip_slot = parsed_slot;
      }

      if (malformed_skip ||
          (skip_update >= 0 &&
           (skip_slot < 1 || skip_slot > MAX_POTIONS ||
            player->potions[skip_slot - 1].rarity == POTION_NONE ||
            player->potions[skip_slot - 1].brew_start_tick == 0 ||
            player->potions[skip_slot - 1].ready ||
            !economy_misc_consume(rec, 9, 1)))) {
        *rec = before;
        economy_transaction_init(&tx);
        result = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE;
      } else if (skip_update >= 0) {
        Potion *p = &player->potions[skip_slot - 1];

        if (p->brew_start_tick == 0)
          p->brew_start_tick = ch->server->ticks ? ch->server->ticks : 1;

        p->ready = true;
        economy_store_potion_slots(player, rec, ch->server->ticks, unix_now);

        if (!economy_transaction_add(
                &tx, 9, tx.updates[skip_update].product_id,
                economy_misc_amount(rec, 9), -1)) {
          *rec = before;
          economy_restore_player_state(player, rec, ch->server->ticks,
                                       unix_now);
          economy_transaction_init(&tx);
          result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
        }
      }
    }

    if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK)
      playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);

    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_soft_purchase_response(w, product_id, result, &tx);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 77) { /* Offer_bundle_request */
    EconomyTransaction tx;
    EconomyResult result = economy_apply_offer_bundle(
        &ch->server->economy, rec, product_id, &tx);

    if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK)
      playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);

    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_offer_bundle_response(w, product_id, result, &tx);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 80) { /* Update_user_settings_request */
    const uint8_t *setting = NULL;
    size_t setting_len = 0;
    if (!parsed_request ||
        !pb_find_len_field(request.message, request.message_len, 1, &setting,
                           &setting_len) ||
        !pb_copy_string_field(setting, setting_len, 3, product_id,
                              sizeof(product_id)))
      return;

    bool owned = economy_skin_product_owned(&ch->server->economy, rec,
                                             product_id);
    uint64_t custom_hash = 0;
    if (!owned && parse_custom_skin_id(product_id, &custom_hash))
      owned = economy_custom_skin_contains(rec, custom_hash);
    if (!owned) {
      async_log("[Economy] Rejected unowned skin equip '%s' for conn=%d\n",
                product_id, ch->conn_id);
      return;
    }

    snprintf(rec->equipped_skin, sizeof(rec->equipped_skin), "%s", product_id);
    playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);

    const char *skin_id = product_id;
    if (strncmp(skin_id, "skin_", 5) == 0)
      skin_id += 5;
    if (parse_custom_skin_id(product_id, NULL)) {
      /* The client resolves custom_<hash> through LM_CUSTOM_SKINS_CDN. */
      snprintf(player->skin, sizeof(player->skin), "%%%s", product_id);
    } else if (skin_id[0] && strcmp(skin_id, "empty") != 0) {
      snprintf(player->skin, sizeof(player->skin), "%%%s", skin_id);
    } else {
      player->skin[0] = '\0';
    }
    server_invalidate_player_cells(ch->server, player->id);

    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_update_user_settings_response(w, product_id);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 110) { /* Activate_timed_event_request */
    const char *event_id = product_id[0] ? product_id : "hourlyBonus";
    EconomyTransaction tx;
    economy_transaction_init(&tx);
    uint32_t remaining = 0;

    if (strcmp(event_id, "potionSkipBrew") == 0) {
      /* This request activates the UI event only. The following type-70
       * slot-specific catalog purchase performs and pays for the actual skip. */
      bw_reset(w);
      pkt_102_activate_timed_event_response(w, event_id, 0, &tx);
      net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
      return;
    }

    if (strcmp(event_id, "dailyQuest") == 0) {
      if (rec->active_quest[0] && rec->active_quest_until > unix_now) {
        uint64_t wait = rec->active_quest_until - unix_now;
        remaining = wait > UINT32_MAX ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)wait;
      } else if (rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at > unix_now) {
        uint64_t wait = rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at - unix_now;
        remaining = wait > UINT32_MAX ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)wait;
      } else if (economy_misc_amount(rec, 4) == 0 &&
                 economy_misc_add(rec, 4, 1)) {
        economy_transaction_add(&tx, 4, "quest_activation_24h",
                                economy_misc_amount(rec, 4), 1);
        playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);
      }

      bw_reset(w);
      pkt_102_activate_timed_event_response(w, event_id, remaining, &tx);
      net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
      return;
    }

    if (strcmp(event_id, "hourlyBonus") != 0)
      return;

    if (rec->hourly_bonus_available_at > unix_now) {
      uint64_t wait = rec->hourly_bonus_available_at - unix_now;
      remaining = wait > UINT32_MAX ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)wait;
    } else {
      uint32_t reward = ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_MIN_COINS +
                        (uint32_t)(rand() %
                                   (ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_MAX_COINS -
                                    ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_MIN_COINS + 1u));
      rec->coins = client_saturating_add_u32(rec->coins, reward);
      rec->hourly_bonus_available_at =
          unix_now + ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_COOLDOWN;
      remaining = ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_COOLDOWN;
      economy_transaction_add(&tx, 1, "coin", rec->coins, (int32_t)reward);
      playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);
    }

    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_activate_timed_event_response(w, event_id, remaining, &tx);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 112) { /* Activate_boost_request */
    int is_xp = 0, boost_idx = -1;
    uint32_t duration = 0;
    uint8_t multiplier = 1;
    if (!economy_parse_boost_product(product_id, &is_xp, &boost_idx,
                                     &duration, &multiplier) ||
        !prec_boost_sub(rec, is_xp, boost_idx))
      return;

    uint64_t until = unix_now + duration;
    if (is_xp) {
      rec->active_xp_boost_idx = (uint8_t)boost_idx;
      rec->active_xp_boost_until = until;
      player->xp_boost = multiplier;
    } else {
      rec->active_mass_boost_idx = (uint8_t)boost_idx;
      rec->active_mass_boost_until = until;
      player->mass_boost = multiplier;
    }
    playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);

    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_activate_boost_response(
        w, economy_boost_product_id(is_xp, boost_idx), duration,
        prec_boost_count(rec, is_xp, boost_idx));
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 114) { /* Activate_quest_request */
    const char *quest_id = product_id[0] ? product_id : "quest_activation_24h";
    if (strcmp(quest_id, "quest_activation_24h") != 0 &&
        !economy_catalog_has_product(&ch->server->economy, 4, quest_id))
      return;

    /* Do not consume a second token by overwriting an active quest. */
    if (rec->active_quest[0] && rec->active_quest_until > unix_now) {
      uint64_t remaining64 = rec->active_quest_until - unix_now;
      uint32_t remaining = remaining64 > UINT32_MAX
                               ? UINT32_MAX
                               : (uint32_t)remaining64;
      bw_reset(w);
      pkt_102_activate_quest_response(
          w, rec->active_quest, "mass_consumed", rec->quest_goal, remaining,
          economy_misc_amount(rec, 4), 0);
      net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
      return;
    }

    if (!economy_misc_consume(rec, 4, 1)) {
      uint32_t remaining = 0;
      if (rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at > unix_now) {
        uint64_t wait = rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at - unix_now;
        remaining = wait > UINT32_MAX ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)wait;
      }
      bw_reset(w);
      pkt_102_activate_quest_response(
          w, quest_id, "mass_consumed", 0, remaining,
          economy_misc_amount(rec, 4), 0);
      net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
      return;
    }

    snprintf(rec->active_quest, sizeof(rec->active_quest), "%s", quest_id);
    rec->active_quest_until = unix_now + ECONOMY_QUEST_DURATION;
    rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at =
        unix_now + ECONOMY_DAILY_QUEST_COOLDOWN;
    rec->quest_goal = ECONOMY_QUEST_GOAL_MASS;
    rec->quest_progress = 0;
    player->quest_session_start_mass = player->mass_consumed;
    playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);

    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_activate_quest_response(
        w, quest_id, "mass_consumed", rec->quest_goal, ECONOMY_QUEST_DURATION,
        economy_misc_amount(rec, 4), -1);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 117) { /* Activate_user_rewards_request */
    enum { REWARD_HOURLY = 1u, REWARD_DAILY_QUEST = 2u, REWARD_FREE_COINS = 4u };
    uint32_t requested = 0;
    uint32_t response_for = 0;
    uint64_t reward_enum = 0;

    /* Official clients send field 1 as an enum. Legend Mod also has a bulk
     * string-ID helper, so accept repeated field-1 strings without trusting
     * any amount supplied by the client. */
    if (parsed_request &&
        pb_find_varint_field(request.message, request.message_len, 1,
                             &reward_enum)) {
      response_for = reward_enum > UINT32_MAX ? 0 : (uint32_t)reward_enum;
      if (reward_enum == 1)
        requested |= REWARD_HOURLY;
      else if (reward_enum == 2)
        requested |= REWARD_DAILY_QUEST;
      else if (reward_enum == 3)
        requested |= REWARD_FREE_COINS;
      else if (reward_enum == 0)
        requested |= REWARD_HOURLY | REWARD_DAILY_QUEST | REWARD_FREE_COINS;
    }

    char reward_ids[8][ECONOMY_PRODUCT_ID_LEN] = {{0}};
    size_t reward_count = parsed_request
        ? pb_collect_string_field(request.message, request.message_len, 1,
                                  reward_ids, 8)
        : 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < reward_count; i++) {
      if (strcmp(reward_ids[i], "hourlyBonus") == 0)
        requested |= REWARD_HOURLY;
      else if (strcmp(reward_ids[i], "dailyQuest") == 0)
        requested |= REWARD_DAILY_QUEST;
      else if (strcmp(reward_ids[i], "freeCoins") == 0)
        requested |= REWARD_FREE_COINS;
    }

    EconomyTransaction tx;
    economy_transaction_init(&tx);
    uint32_t coin_delta = 0;
    uint32_t quest_delta = 0;

    if ((requested & REWARD_HOURLY) &&
        rec->hourly_bonus_available_at <= unix_now) {
      uint32_t reward = ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_MIN_COINS +
               (uint32_t)(rand() % (ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_MAX_COINS -
                                    ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_MIN_COINS + 1u));
      rec->coins = client_saturating_add_u32(rec->coins, reward);
      coin_delta = client_saturating_add_u32(coin_delta, reward);
      rec->hourly_bonus_available_at =
          unix_now + ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_COOLDOWN;
    }
    if ((requested & REWARD_DAILY_QUEST) &&
        rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at <= unix_now &&
        economy_misc_add(rec, 4, 1)) {
      quest_delta = 1;
      rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at =
          unix_now + ECONOMY_DAILY_QUEST_COOLDOWN;
    }
    if ((requested & REWARD_FREE_COINS) &&
        rec->free_coins_reward_available_at <= unix_now) {
      const uint32_t reward = ECONOMY_FREE_COINS_AMOUNT;
      rec->coins = client_saturating_add_u32(rec->coins, reward);
      coin_delta = client_saturating_add_u32(coin_delta, reward);
      rec->free_coins_reward_available_at =
          unix_now + ECONOMY_FREE_COINS_COOLDOWN;
    }

    if (coin_delta)
      economy_transaction_add(&tx, 1, "coin", rec->coins,
                              (int32_t)coin_delta);
    if (quest_delta)
      economy_transaction_add(&tx, 4, "quest_activation_24h",
                              economy_misc_amount(rec, 4),
                              (int32_t)quest_delta);
    if (tx.update_count)
      playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);

    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_activate_user_rewards_response(w, response_for, 0, &tx);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 120) { /* Open_potion_for_product_request */
    EconomyTransaction tx;
    uint32_t coins_reward = 0, dna_reward = 0;
    EconomyResult result = economy_open_premium_potion(
        rec, product_id, &tx, &coins_reward, &dna_reward);
    if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK) {
      player->coins_session += coins_reward;
      playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);
    }
    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_open_potion_for_product_response(w, product_id, result, &tx);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 122) { /* Brew_potion_for_slot_request */
    int32_t result = 1; /* success */
    Potion *target = NULL;
    if (slot < 1 || slot > MAX_POTIONS) {
      result = 2; /* potion_not_collected */
    } else {
      target = &player->potions[slot - 1];
      if (target->rarity == POTION_NONE || target->ready) {
        result = 2;
      } else if (target->brew_start_tick > 0) {
        result = 3; /* potion_being_brewed */
      } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POTIONS; i++) {
          const Potion *other = &player->potions[i];
          if (i != slot - 1 && other->rarity != POTION_NONE &&
              other->brew_start_tick > 0 && !other->ready) {
            result = 3;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    if (result == 1 && target) {
      target->brew_start_tick = ch->server->ticks ? ch->server->ticks : 1;
      target->brew_duration = potion_brew_duration(target->rarity);
      economy_store_potion_slots(player, rec, ch->server->ticks, unix_now);
      playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);
    }
    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_brew_potion_response(w, player, ch->server->ticks, result);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 124) { /* Open_potion_for_slot_request */
    if (slot >= 1 && slot <= MAX_POTIONS) {
      Potion *p = &player->potions[slot - 1];
      if (p->rarity != POTION_NONE && p->ready) {
        potion_open(player, p, ch->server);
        return;
      }
    }
    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_open_potion_response(w, player, ch->server->ticks,
                                 2, /* potion_not_ready */
                                 rec->coins, rec->dna, 0, 0);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 150) { /* User_skins_create_request */
    const uint8_t *png = NULL;
    size_t png_len = 0;
    EconomyResult result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
    char skin_id[ECONOMY_PRODUCT_ID_LEN] = {0};

    if (parsed_request &&
        pb_find_len_field(request.message, request.message_len, 1, &png,
                          &png_len) &&
        custom_skin_png_valid(png, png_len)) {
      if (economy_misc_amount(rec, 10) == 0) {
        result = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_ENOUGH_CURRENCY;
      } else {
        uint64_t hash = economy_hash_custom_skin(player->uid, png, png_len);
        economy_custom_skin_id(skin_id, sizeof(skin_id), hash);
        if (economy_custom_skin_contains(rec, hash)) {
          result = ECONOMY_RESULT_ALREADY_OWNED;
        } else if (!economy_custom_skin_add(rec, hash)) {
          result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVENTORY_FULL;
        } else if (!custom_skin_write_file(skin_id, png, png_len)) {
          economy_custom_skin_remove(rec, hash);
          result = ECONOMY_RESULT_IO_ERROR;
        } else if (!economy_misc_consume(rec, 10, 1)) {
          economy_custom_skin_remove(rec, hash);
          custom_skin_delete_file(skin_id);
          result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
        } else {
          rec->skins_created++;
          playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);
          result = ECONOMY_RESULT_OK;
        }
      }
    }

    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_custom_skin_create_response(
        w, result, skin_id, economy_misc_amount(rec, 10));
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }

  if (type == 152) { /* User_skins_delete */
    uint64_t hash = 0;
    if (!parse_custom_skin_id(product_id, &hash) ||
        !economy_custom_skin_remove(rec, hash))
      return;
    if (strcmp(rec->equipped_skin, product_id) == 0) {
      snprintf(rec->equipped_skin, sizeof(rec->equipped_skin), "skin_empty");
      player->skin[0] = '\0';
      server_invalidate_player_cells(ch->server, player->id);
    }
    custom_skin_delete_file(product_id);
    playerdb_mark_dirty(&ch->server->player_db, rec);
    bw_reset(w);
    pkt_102_custom_skin_delete(w, product_id);
    net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));
    return;
  }
}

/* ── Main dispatch ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

void client_handle_message(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len) {
  if (len == 0)
    return;
  uint8_t opcode = data[0];

  /* Live Admin Command (Opcode 251 / 0xFB) — accessible in any handshake state */
  if (opcode == 251) {
    on_admin_command(ch, data, len);
    return;
  }

  switch (ch->state) {
  case HS_WAIT_PROTOCOL:
    if (opcode == 0xFE)
      on_handshake_protocol(ch, data, len);
    break;

  case HS_WAIT_KEY:
    if (opcode == 0xFF)
      on_handshake_key(ch, data, len);
    break;

  case HS_READY:
    switch (opcode) {
    case 0:
      on_join(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 1:
      on_spectate(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 12:
      on_skin(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 16:
      on_mouse(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 17:
      on_split(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 18:
      on_spectate_toggle(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 21:
      on_eject(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 55:
    case 56:
      on_full_map_spectate(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 57:
      on_quit_game(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 99:
      on_chat(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 102:
      on_opcode_102(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 201: /* LM identification: [201, type] — 1=client, 2=bot */
      if (len >= 2 && ch->player_id >= 0) {
        Player *p = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];
        if (data[1] == 1) {
          p->is_lm_client = true;
        } else if (data[1] == 2) {
          p->is_lm_bot = true;
          p->linked = false;
          p->cached_rec = NULL;
          p->db_index = -1;
        }
      }
      break;
    case 202: { /* Team message: [202][u8 type][UTF-16LE message...] */
      if (ch->player_id < 0 || len < 4)
        break;
      Player *sender = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];
      if (!sender->clan_tag[0])
        break; /* no tag = no team messages */

      /* Rate limit: same as chat (50 ticks = 2 sec) */
      uint32_t dt202 = ch->server->ticks - ch->last_chat_tick;
      if (dt202 < 50)
        break;
      ch->last_chat_tick = ch->server->ticks;

      /* Read UTF-16LE message starting at byte 2 (skip opcode + type) */
      char text[256];
      int ti = 0;
      for (size_t i = 2; i + 1 < len && ti < 255; i += 2) {
        uint16_t ch16 = data[i] | (data[i + 1] << 8);
        if (ch16 == 0)
          break;
        if (ch16 < 128)
          text[ti++] = (char)ch16;
      }
      text[ti] = '\0';
      if (ti == 0)
        break;

      server_send_team_chat(ch->server, sender, text);
      break;
    }
    case 203: { /* Set clan tag: [203][UTF-8 tag, null-terminated] */
      if (ch->player_id < 0 || len < 2)
        break;
      Player *tp = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];
      /* Read tag from byte 1 onward, max 15 chars */
      int tlen = 0;
      for (size_t i = 1; i < len && tlen < 15; i++) {
        if (data[i] == 0)
          break;
        tp->clan_tag[tlen++] = (char)data[i];
      }
      tp->clan_tag[tlen] = '\0';
      break;
    }
    case 204: { /* Profile info: [204][provider][socialId\0][displayName\0]
                 * Avatar is NOT sent — profile picture is rendered client-side only. */
      if (ch->player_id < 0 || len < 3)
        break;
      Player *dp = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];
      dp->auth_provider = (int)data[1];
      if (dp->auth_provider < 0 || dp->auth_provider > 3)
        dp->auth_provider = 0;

      /* Parse null-terminated fields starting at byte 2 */
      size_t pos = 2;
      int field = 0; /* 0=socialId, 1=displayName */
      char *targets[2] = { dp->social_id, dp->display_name };
      int max_lens[2] = { 31, 63 };    /* leave room for \0 */

      while (field < 2 && pos < len) {
        int wlen = 0;
        while (pos < len && data[pos] != 0 && wlen < max_lens[field]) {
          targets[field][wlen++] = (char)data[pos++];
        }
        targets[field][wlen] = '\0';
        while (pos < len && data[pos] != 0) pos++; /* Skip remainder of string to prevent bleeding */
        if (pos < len && data[pos] == 0) pos++; /* skip null terminator */
        field++;
      }

      INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Profile 204: provider=%d social_id='%s' "
                "name='%s'\n",
                dp->id, dp->auth_provider, dp->social_id,
                dp->display_name);

      /* ── CRITICAL FIX: Push refreshed profile to client after 204 ──
       * The first pkt_102_login_response (from opcode 102 login) is sent
       * before opcode 204 arrives, so it contains incomplete profile data
       * (no avatar, possibly no social_id/display_name yet).
