       * Now that 204 has updated the player's profile fields, resend the
       * login response so the client's updateUserInfo() gets the full data.
       * This eliminates the need for client-side DOM patching. */
      {
        PlayerRecord *rec204 = NULL;

        if (player_profile_is_persistent(dp)) {
          rec204 = dp->cached_rec
              ? dp->cached_rec
              : playerdb_lookup(
                    &ch->server->player_db,
                    dp->uid);

          dp->cached_rec = rec204;
        }
        if (rec204) {
          BinaryWriter *w = &ch->send_writer;
          bw_reset(w);
          pkt_102_login_response(w, rec204, dp, &ch->server->economy,
                                 (uint64_t)time(NULL), ch->server->ticks);
          net_send_to_player(ch->conn_id, bw_data(w), bw_length(w));

          /* Login UI notification is now handled client-side in ogario.v4.js
           * after the confirmed protobuf type-11 response arrives, styled
           * to match agar.io's native blue notification panel. */

          INFO_LOG("[204->102] Sent refreshed login response to conn=%d "
                    "(uid='%s' social='%s' name='%s' pkt_len=%u)\n",
                    ch->conn_id, dp->uid,
                    dp->social_id, dp->display_name, (unsigned)bw_length(w));
        } else {
          async_log("[204] WARN: No PlayerRecord for uid='%s', cannot resend profile\n",
                    dp->uid);
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    case 205: { /* Team Command: [205][u8 cmd][i32 x LE][i32 y LE] = 10 bytes
                 * cmd: 1=Attack, 2=Fight, 3=Run
                 * Broadcasts same packet to all players with matching clan tag. */
      if (ch->player_id < 0 || len < 10)
        break;
      Player *tc_sender = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];
      if (!tc_sender->clan_tag[0])
        break; /* no tag = no team */

      /* Rate limit: 12 ticks (~0.5s) between commands */
      uint32_t dt205 = ch->server->ticks - ch->last_chat_tick;
      if (dt205 < 12)
        break;
      ch->last_chat_tick = ch->server->ticks;

      uint8_t cmd_type = data[1];
      if (cmd_type < 1 || cmd_type > 3)
        break; /* invalid command type */

      /* Broadcast to all connected players with same clan tag (skip sender) */
      for (int i = 0; i < ch->server->connected_count; i++) {
        int pid = ch->server->connected_ids[i];
        if (pid == ch->player_id)
          continue;
        Player *target = &ch->server->players[pid];
        if (target->conn_id < 0 || !target->clan_tag[0])
          continue;
        if (strcmp(target->clan_tag, tc_sender->clan_tag) != 0)
          continue;
        net_send_to_player(target->conn_id, data, 10);
      }
      break;
    }
    case 240: /* LM handshake response: [0xF0, 'L', 'M'] */
      if (len >= 3 && data[1] == 0x4C && data[2] == 0x4D) {
        ch->is_legendmod = true;
      }
      break;
    case 206: {
      /*
       * View reconciliation request after the browser tab becomes visible.
       *
       * World Spectate must NOT receive opcode 0x12 ClearAll. The WebSocket is
       * ordered and reliable, and the transactional exact diff can reconcile
       * the connection without wiping every rendered cell and replaying a
       * multi-tick baseline.
       */
      Player *p =
          &ch->server->players[
              ch->player_id];

      if (p->full_map_spectate) {
        p->full_map_resync_pending = true;
        p->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;

        INFO_LOG(
            "[Client %d] World Spectate exact resync requested "
            "(player %d, no ClearAll)\n",
            ch->conn_id,
            p->id);

        break;
      }

      /*
       * Preserve the existing non-World-Spectate behaviour in this patch.
       */
      if (p->full_map_resync_pending) {
        break;
      }

      uint8_t clear_pkt =
          0x12;

      bw_write_u8(
          &ch->send_writer,
          clear_pkt);

      bool queued =
          net_try_queue_to_player(
              ch->conn_id,
              bw_data(&ch->send_writer),
              bw_length(&ch->send_writer));

      bw_reset(
          &ch->send_writer);

      if (!queued) {
        INFO_LOG(
            "[Client %d] Resync ClearAll FAILED to queue "
            "(backpressure), skipping\n",
            ch->conn_id);

        break;
      }

      player_clear_view_tracking(
          p);

      p->full_map_resync_pending = true;
      p->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;

      INFO_LOG(
          "[Client %d] Non-world resync requested with ClearAll "
          "(player %d)\n",
          ch->conn_id,
          p->id);

      break;
    }
    case 86: /* Recaptcha token — not needed for private servers */
      break;
    case 254:
      on_stat(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 251: /* Live Admin Property Control (Opcode 0xFB) */
      on_admin_command(ch, data, len);
      break;
    case 227: /* Pong response — client echoes our ping */
      break;
    default:
      break;
    }
    break;
  }
}

/* ── Disconnect ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void client_disconnect(ClientHandler *ch) {
  if (ch->player_id >= 0 && ch->player_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
    Player *player = &ch->server->players[ch->player_id];

    /* Save session stats before clearing name (disconnect = session end) */
    if (player->uid[0] && player->spawn_tick > 0) {
      uint32_t alive_secs = (ch->server->ticks - player->spawn_tick) / 25;
      playerdb_update(&ch->server->player_db, player->uid, player->session_xp,
                      player->highest_mass, player->food_eaten,
                      player->players_eaten, alive_secs,
                      player->mass_consumed, player->name);
    }

    /* Remove from connected list ALWAYS (do not linger just for dead cells) */
    for (int i = 0; i < ch->server->connected_count; i++) {
      if (ch->server->connected_ids[i] == ch->player_id) {
        ch->server->connected_ids[i] =
            ch->server->connected_ids[--ch->server->connected_count];
        break;
      }
    }

    if (player->cell_count > 0) {
      GameServer *srv = ch->server;

      /* Preserve the owner record so these remain ordinary player cells:
       * eating, being eaten, merging, collision, virus popping, decay,
       * 16 cells maximum and PLAYER_MAX_CELL_MASS maximum per cell. */
      server_invalidate_player_cells(srv, player->id);
      player->conn_id = -1;
      player->frozen = true;
      player->spectate = false;
      player->free_roam = false;
      player->full_map_spectate = false;
      player->spectate_target_id = -1;
      player->merge_override = false;
      player->pending_splits = 0;
      player->split_requested = false;
      player->eject_requested = false;
      player->client_count = 0;
      player->name[0] = '\0';
      player->skin[0] = '\0';
      player->clan_tag[0] = '\0';

      for (int i = 0; i < player->cell_count; i++) {
        Cell *cell = player->cells[i];
        if (cell && !cell->is_removed)
          server_mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks);
      }

      player_free_buffers(player);
      srv->lb_dirty = true;
      INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Disconnected (normal frozen cells retained)\n",
               ch->player_id);
    } else {
      server_remove_active_player(ch->server, ch->player_id);
      player_reset(player);
      /* Return slot to free stack for O(1) reallocation */
      GameServer *srv = ch->server;
      if (srv->free_player_top < MAX_PLAYERS - 1) {
        srv->free_player_stack[++srv->free_player_top] = ch->player_id;
      }
      INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Disconnected\n", ch->player_id);
    }
  }
  bw_free(&ch->send_writer);
}

typedef enum {
  HS_WAIT_PROTOCOL, /* Waiting for opcode 0xFE */
  HS_WAIT_KEY,      /* Waiting for opcode 0xFF */
  HS_READY          /* Handshake complete, operational */
} HandshakeState;

typedef struct {
  int conn_id;
  int player_id;
  int protocol;
  uint32_t handshake_key;
  HandshakeState state;
  bool is_legendmod;        /* client responded to LW handshake with "LM" */
  GameServer *server;
  uint32_t last_join_tick;
  uint32_t last_chat_tick;
  uint32_t last_stat_tick;
  uint32_t last_op102_tick;   /* tick of last opcode 102 burst window */
  int op102_count;            /* opcode 102 count in current window */
  BinaryWriter send_writer; /* per-client send buffer */
} ClientHandler;

/* Initialize a client handler */
void client_init(ClientHandler *ch, int conn_id, GameServer *server);

/* Process an incoming binary message */
void client_handle_message(ClientHandler *ch, const uint8_t *data, size_t len);

/* Called when client disconnects */
void client_disconnect(ClientHandler *ch);

#endif /* CLIENT_H */

/* Expanding Land Server Configuration — deploy trigger */
#ifndef CONFIG_H
#define CONFIG_H

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <math.h>

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * MAP SCALE — Change this ONE number to resize the entire map.
 *
 * MAP_SCALE is an area multiplier applied to the x1 (base) map.
 * It controls border size, cell pool sizes, food/virus counts,
 * and quadtree node capacity. Everything scales together automatically.
 *
 * "xN" means N times the AREA of the base map, not N times the side
 * length. Side length scales by sqrt(MAP_SCALE):
 *
 *   Scale  Side length    Area        Food    Virus   Cell pool
 *   ─────  ───────────    ─────────   ─────   ─────   ─────────
 *    x1    14142          200M         4000      50      8192
 *    x4    28284          800M        16000     200     32768
 *    x8    40000         1.6B         32000     400     65536
 *   x16    56569         3.2B         64000     800    131072
 *
 * Border formula: 14142.135... * sqrt(MAP_SCALE)   (= 10000*sqrt(2*S))
 * Food/virus/pools: base_value * MAP_SCALE
 *
 * ── Relationship to MapScaler tiers ─────────────────────────────────
 * The MapScaler (mapscaler.h) dynamically resizes the map at runtime
 * based on player count. Scale 1.0 = 14142×14142 = real Agar.io size.
 * The mapscaler always starts at its smallest tier (7071, scale 0.25)
 * and expands as players join:
 *
 *   Tier  Side   Area    Scale   Expand >N   Shrink <N
 *   ────  ─────  ──────  ──────  ──────────  ──────────
 *    0    7071    50M    0.25    (base)      (never)
 *    1    10000   100M   0.50    0 (instant) 0 (never)
 *    2    14142   200M   1.00    30          20
 *    3    20000   400M   2.00    120         90
 *    4    28284   800M   4.00    240         180
 *    5    40000  1600M   8.00    480         360
 *    6    56569  3200M  16.00    960         720
 *    7    80000  6400M  32.00    1920        1440
 *    8   113137 12.8B  64.00    3840        2880
 *    9   160000 25.6B 128.00    7680        5760
 *
 * Each tier scales by ×√2 from the previous. Scale = (side / 14142)².
 * A "scale 1" map is the standard real Agar.io map (14142×14142).
 * The server starts at scale 0.25 (7071×7071 = ¼ area) and instantly
 * expands to tier 1 when any player connects.
 *
 * After changing MAP_SCALE, recompile. The runtime defaults in config.c
 * auto-derive border/food/virus from this value.
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#define MAP_SCALE 1  /* deploy: all fixes + profile stats + mass bonus */
#define MAP_TIER_COUNT 13  /* number of map scaler tiers (0..12) */

/* ── Private-server economy defaults ────────────────────────────────
 * These values are authoritative server policy, not client input. Replace
 * them with the exact values from the GameConfiguration version deployed
 * with your client when strict production parity is required. */
#define ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_MIN_COINS 50u
#define ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_MAX_COINS 100u
#define ECONOMY_HOURLY_BONUS_COOLDOWN 3600u
#define ECONOMY_DAILY_QUEST_COOLDOWN 86400u
#define ECONOMY_FREE_COINS_AMOUNT 25u
#define ECONOMY_FREE_COINS_COOLDOWN 14400u
#define ECONOMY_QUEST_GOAL_MASS 5000u
#define ECONOMY_QUEST_DURATION 86400u
#define ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_COINS 250u
#define ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_DNA 5u


/* ── Log verbosity (compile-time) ────────────────────────────────────
 * 0 = silent (no logs at all — maximum performance)
 * 1 = errors only (FATAL, overflow, kick)
 * 2 = warnings + errors (auth, duplicate UID, unusual events)
 * 3 = verbose (join/leave details, cell spawns, debug info)
 * Logs guarded by `#if LOG_LEVEL >= N` are compiled out entirely
 * when the level is below N — zero runtime cost. */
#define LOG_LEVEL 1  /* production: errors and essential warnings only */

/* ── Root scaling constant ──────────────────────────────────────────
 * SERVER_CAPACITY is the SINGLE root constant that controls all player,
 * bot, connection, and entity array sizes. Change this ONE number to
 * scale the server for more bots/players (e.g. 65536 for 50K bots).
 * Everything else derives from it automatically. */
#define SERVER_CAPACITY    32768

/* ── OpenMP thread limit ────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Hard cap on parallel threads.  Used to size per-thread deduplication
 * arrays in BotGrid queries.  The CPX32 has 4 vCPUs; 3 workers + 1 main
 * is the practical limit. */
#define MAX_OMP_THREADS    4

/* ── Hard player limits ─────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Defined early because cell pool headroom derives from these. */
#define PLAYER_MAX_CELLS_LIMIT 16
#define PLAYER_MAX_CELL_MASS   22500.0
#define ENTITY_EJECT_RESERVE_PER_PLAYER 8
#define ENTITY_CELL_SAFETY_RESERVE      (SERVER_CAPACITY / 2)  /* scales with capacity */
#define ENTITY_FOOD_CULL_BATCH           2048

/* ── Cell pool sizes (derived from highest tier) ─────────────────────
 * Supports up to Tier 12 (452,548px).
 * Food and viruses scale strictly linearly with area ratio.
 * MAX_CELLS headroom scales with SERVER_CAPACITY automatically. */
#define MAX_TIER_RATIO  4096                                 /* supports up to Tier 12 (4096x area) */
#define MAX_FOOD        (512  * MAX_TIER_RATIO * MAP_SCALE)  /* 2,097,152 food cap */
#define MAX_VIRUSES     (16   * MAX_TIER_RATIO * MAP_SCALE)  /* 65,536 viruses cap */
#define MAX_CELLS       (MAX_FOOD + MAX_VIRUSES + SERVER_CAPACITY * (PLAYER_MAX_CELLS_LIMIT + ENTITY_EJECT_RESERVE_PER_PLAYER))

/* ── 2-bit packed view_state ─────────────────────────────────────────
 * view_state tracks cell visibility per player: 0=unseen, 1=seen, 2=current.
 * Only 2 bits needed per cell. Pack 4 cells per byte → 4x memory savings.
 * 262144 cells × 2 bits = 65536 bytes per player (was 262144 bytes). */
#define VIEW_STATE_BYTES  ((MAX_CELLS + 3) / 4)   /* 65536 bytes */

static inline uint8_t vs_get(const uint8_t *vs, int idx) {
  return (vs[idx >> 2] >> ((idx & 3) * 2)) & 3;
}
static inline void vs_set(uint8_t *vs, int idx, uint8_t val) {
  int b = idx >> 2, s = (idx & 3) * 2;
  vs[b] = (vs[b] & ~(3 << s)) | ((val & 3) << s);
}

/* ── Quadtree tuning and bounded storage ───────────────────────
 *
 * The old pool allocated MAX_CELLS/2 complete QTNode structures. Each node
 * contains 128 pointers, so that reserved well over 100 MiB.
 *
 * A balanced four-way tree needs roughly:
 *
 *   leaves + internal nodes ~= N / leaf_capacity × 4/3
 *
 * Four times N/leaf_capacity plus a fixed reserve gives substantial headroom.
 * Any pathological clustering, maximum-depth overflow or pool exhaustion is
 * stored in the separate pointer-only overflow array and remains queryable.
 */
#define QT_LEAF_MAX  128
#define QT_DEPTH_MAX 8

#define QT_POOL_DYNAMIC \
  ((MAX_CELLS / QT_LEAF_MAX) * 4 + 64)

#define QT_OVERFLOW_DYNAMIC MAX_CELLS

/* ── Food spatial grid ─────────────────────────────────────────
 *
 * Food uses FoodGrid rather than the dynamic-cell quadtree.
 */
#define FOOD_GRID_DIM 256

#define FOOD_BUCKET_CAP \
  (MAX_FOOD / (FOOD_GRID_DIM * FOOD_GRID_DIM) * 32 < 64 ? 64 : MAX_FOOD / (FOOD_GRID_DIM * FOOD_GRID_DIM) * 32)

/* ── View/query limits ───────────────────────────────────────────
 * MAX_VIEW_NODES limits per-player tracked cells. A normal viewport shows
 * ~200-500 cells; 16384 gives 30x headroom without the 65K OOM on 4GB.
 * Food/dynamic POOLS can be larger — this only caps the view diff. */
#define MAX_VIEW_NODES      65536
#define CLIENT_NODES_INIT   1024   /* initial per-player alloc; grows geometrically via player_ensure_client_capacity */
#define QT_QUERY_MAX        65536  /* quadtree collision query buffer */
#define MAX_REMOVED_PER_TICK (MAX_FOOD + MAX_DYNAMIC)

/* ── Network buffer sizes ────────────────────────────────────────
 * RECV_BUF_SIZE: incoming WebSocket frames (client → server). Client
 *   packets are small (mouse, spawn, split), 8KB is always enough.
 * SEND_BUF_SIZE: per-player send batch buffer. Must fit the largest
 *   update packet. Each visible cell = ~30 bytes (pos, size, color,
 *   name). Worst case = MAX_VIEW_NODES cells changing in one tick.
 *   Formula: MAX_VIEW_NODES * 32 bytes, capped at minimum 64KB. */
#define RECV_BUF_SIZE 8192

/*
 * Outbound buffers are allocated on demand.
 *
 * Initial capacity:
 *   256 KiB. This fits ordinary update bursts without repeated reallocations.
 *
 * High-water mark:
 *   At 256 KiB pending, stop generating more simulation frames until the
 *   socket drains. World Spectate must never accumulate seconds of stale
 *   full-map frames behind the user's mode-change input.
 *
 * Hard limit:
 *   The maximum packet calculation remains the absolute per-client queue
 *   limit. Complete WebSocket frames are never partially discarded.
 */
#define SEND_BUF_INITIAL      262144U
#define SEND_BUF_HIGH_WATER   262144U
#define SEND_BUF_SIZE \
  ((MAX_VIEW_NODES * 32) > 65536 ? (MAX_VIEW_NODES * 32) : 65536)
#define SEND_BUF_HARD_LIMIT   ((size_t)SEND_BUF_SIZE)

#define NET_WRITE_CHUNK_BYTES      262144U
#define NET_WRITE_BUDGET_BYTES    1048576U
#define NET_WRITE_CALL_BUDGET          32
#define NET_WRITE_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS  10000ULL
#define NET_SEND_SHRINK_IDLE_MS      30000ULL

/*
 * Discord OAuth2 code exchange — pure C, using runtime-loaded OpenSSL.
 *
 * The game server handles GET /auth/discord/callback?code=XXX:
 *   1. POST to discord.com/api/oauth2/token to exchange code for access_token
 *   2. GET discord.com/api/users/@me to fetch real user profile
 *   3. Return HTML relay page with real id/username/avatar
 *
 * Uses the same dynamically-loaded OpenSSL that tls.c uses (no compile-time
 * dependency). For outbound HTTPS we need TLS_client_method + SSL_connect
 * in addition to the server-side functions already loaded.
 *
 * THREADING: discord_oauth_handle_callback() does blocking I/O. The caller
 * in net.c runs this on the accept thread's connection (before it enters the
 * game loop), so the main game thread is NOT blocked. The connection is
 * closed immediately after returning the HTML — it never becomes a WebSocket.
 */

#include "discord_oauth.h"
#include "async_log.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
typedef SOCKET dc_socket_t;
#define DC_CLOSESOCKET closesocket
#define DC_INVALID_SOCKET INVALID_SOCKET
typedef HMODULE dc_lib_handle;
#define DC_LOAD_LIB(name) LoadLibraryA(name)
#define DC_LOAD_SYM(lib, name) (void *)GetProcAddress(lib, name)
#define DC_FREE_LIB(h) FreeLibrary(h)
#else
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <netdb.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
typedef int dc_socket_t;
#define DC_CLOSESOCKET close
#define DC_INVALID_SOCKET (-1)
typedef void *dc_lib_handle;
#define DC_LOAD_LIB(name) dlopen(name, RTLD_NOW)
#define DC_LOAD_SYM(lib, name) dlsym(lib, name)
#define DC_FREE_LIB(h) dlclose(h)
#endif

/* ── Configuration ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define DISCORD_CLIENT_ID "1483502380661346396"
/* redirect_uri MUST be URL-encoded in the POST body.
 * Full encoding: https%3A%2F%2Fexpanding.land%2Fauth%2Fdiscord%2Fcallback%2F */
#define DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI_ENCODED "https%3A%2F%2Fexpanding.land%2Fauth%2Fdiscord%2Fcallback%2F"
#define DISCORD_API_HOST "discord.com"
#define DISCORD_API_PORT "443"
#define RESPONSE_BUF_SIZE 16384
#define CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECS 5
#define READ_TIMEOUT_SECS 5

static char discord_client_secret[256] = {0};
static bool discord_oauth_ready = false;

/* ── OpenSSL function pointers (client-side) ────────────────── */

typedef void *(*fn_TLS_client_method)(void);
typedef void *(*fn_SSL_CTX_new)(void *method);
typedef void (*fn_SSL_CTX_free)(void *ctx);
typedef void *(*fn_SSL_new)(void *ctx);
typedef void (*fn_SSL_free)(void *ssl);
typedef int (*fn_SSL_set_fd)(void *ssl, int fd);
typedef int (*fn_SSL_connect)(void *ssl);
typedef int (*fn_SSL_read)(void *ssl, void *buf, int num);
typedef int (*fn_SSL_write)(void *ssl, const void *buf, int num);
typedef int (*fn_SSL_shutdown)(void *ssl);
typedef int (*fn_SSL_get_error)(void *ssl, int ret);
/* SSL_ctrl: generic control. SSL_set_tlsext_host_name = SSL_ctrl(ssl, 55, 0, name) */
typedef long (*fn_SSL_ctrl)(void *ssl, int cmd, long larg, void *parg);
/* Certificate verification */
typedef void (*fn_SSL_CTX_set_verify)(void *ctx, int mode, void *cb);
typedef int (*fn_SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths)(void *ctx);
typedef long (*fn_SSL_get_verify_result)(void *ssl);
/* Hostname verification */
typedef void *(*fn_SSL_get1_peer_certificate)(void *ssl);
typedef int (*fn_X509_check_host)(void *cert, const char *name, size_t namelen, unsigned int flags, void *peername);
typedef void (*fn_X509_free)(void *cert);

static struct {
  dc_lib_handle libssl;
  dc_lib_handle libcrypto;
  bool loaded;
  fn_TLS_client_method TLS_client_method;
  fn_SSL_CTX_new SSL_CTX_new;
  fn_SSL_CTX_free SSL_CTX_free;
  fn_SSL_new SSL_new;
  fn_SSL_free SSL_free;
  fn_SSL_set_fd SSL_set_fd;
  fn_SSL_connect SSL_connect;
  fn_SSL_read SSL_read;
  fn_SSL_write SSL_write;
  fn_SSL_shutdown SSL_shutdown;
  fn_SSL_get_error SSL_get_error;
  fn_SSL_ctrl SSL_ctrl;
  fn_SSL_CTX_set_verify SSL_CTX_set_verify;
  fn_SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths;
  fn_SSL_get_verify_result SSL_get_verify_result;
  fn_SSL_get1_peer_certificate SSL_get1_peer_certificate;
  fn_X509_check_host X509_check_host;
  fn_X509_free X509_free;
} dc_ssl = {0};

void discord_oauth_shutdown(void) {
  if (dc_ssl.libssl) {
    DC_FREE_LIB(dc_ssl.libssl);
    dc_ssl.libssl = NULL;
  }
  if (dc_ssl.libcrypto) {
    DC_FREE_LIB(dc_ssl.libcrypto);
    dc_ssl.libcrypto = NULL;
  }
  memset(&dc_ssl, 0, sizeof(dc_ssl));
  discord_oauth_ready = false;
}

static bool dc_load_openssl(void) {
  if (dc_ssl.loaded) return true;

#ifdef _WIN32
  dc_ssl.libcrypto = DC_LOAD_LIB("libcrypto-3-x64.dll");
  dc_ssl.libssl = DC_LOAD_LIB("libssl-3-x64.dll");
  if (!dc_ssl.libssl || !dc_ssl.libcrypto) {
    if (dc_ssl.libssl) DC_FREE_LIB(dc_ssl.libssl);
    if (dc_ssl.libcrypto) DC_FREE_LIB(dc_ssl.libcrypto);
    dc_ssl.libcrypto = DC_LOAD_LIB("libcrypto-1_1-x64.dll");
    dc_ssl.libssl = DC_LOAD_LIB("libssl-1_1-x64.dll");
  }
#else
  dc_ssl.libcrypto = DC_LOAD_LIB("libcrypto.so");
  dc_ssl.libssl = DC_LOAD_LIB("libssl.so");
#endif

  if (!dc_ssl.libssl || !dc_ssl.libcrypto) {
    discord_oauth_shutdown();
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Cannot load OpenSSL for outbound HTTPS\n");
    return false;
  }

#define LOAD_FN(lib, name) \
  dc_ssl.name = (fn_##name)DC_LOAD_SYM(dc_ssl.lib, #name); \
  if (!dc_ssl.name) { async_log("[Discord OAuth] Missing: %s\n", #name); discord_oauth_shutdown(); return false; }

  LOAD_FN(libssl, TLS_client_method);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_CTX_new);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_CTX_free);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_new);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_free);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_set_fd);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_connect);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_read);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_write);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_shutdown);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_get_error);
  LOAD_FN(libssl, SSL_ctrl);

  /* Cert verification — not fatal if missing (older OpenSSL) */
  dc_ssl.SSL_CTX_set_verify = (fn_SSL_CTX_set_verify)DC_LOAD_SYM(dc_ssl.libssl, "SSL_CTX_set_verify");
  dc_ssl.SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths = (fn_SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths)DC_LOAD_SYM(dc_ssl.libssl, "SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths");
  dc_ssl.SSL_get_verify_result = (fn_SSL_get_verify_result)DC_LOAD_SYM(dc_ssl.libssl, "SSL_get_verify_result");

  /* Hostname verification — try both OpenSSL 3.x and 1.1.x names */
  dc_ssl.SSL_get1_peer_certificate = (fn_SSL_get1_peer_certificate)DC_LOAD_SYM(dc_ssl.libssl, "SSL_get1_peer_certificate");
  if (!dc_ssl.SSL_get1_peer_certificate)
    dc_ssl.SSL_get1_peer_certificate = (fn_SSL_get1_peer_certificate)DC_LOAD_SYM(dc_ssl.libssl, "SSL_get_peer_certificate");
  dc_ssl.X509_check_host = (fn_X509_check_host)DC_LOAD_SYM(dc_ssl.libcrypto, "X509_check_host");
  dc_ssl.X509_free = (fn_X509_free)DC_LOAD_SYM(dc_ssl.libcrypto, "X509_free");

#undef LOAD_FN

  dc_ssl.loaded = true;
  async_log("[Discord OAuth] OpenSSL loaded for outbound HTTPS\n");
  return true;
}

/* ── Low-level cleanup helper ───────────────────────────────── */

static void dc_cleanup(void *ssl, void *ctx, dc_socket_t sock) {
  if (ssl) {
    dc_ssl.SSL_shutdown(ssl);
    dc_ssl.SSL_free(ssl);
  }
  if (ctx) dc_ssl.SSL_CTX_free(ctx);
  if (sock != DC_INVALID_SOCKET) DC_CLOSESOCKET(sock);
}

/* ── Low-level HTTPS request ────────────────────────────────── */

/* Make a blocking HTTPS request to discord.com.
 * Returns malloc'd response body (caller frees), or NULL on error.
 * response_len is set to the body length.
 *
 * NOTE: This is blocking I/O. It runs on a non-game-loop path
 * (the HTTP callback connection is one-shot, not a WebSocket player). */
static char *dc_https_request(const char *method, const char *path,
                               const char *headers_extra,
                               const char *body, int *response_len) {
  /* Resolve discord.com */
  struct addrinfo hints = {0}, *res = NULL;
  hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
  hints.ai_socktype = SOCK_STREAM;
  if (getaddrinfo(DISCORD_API_HOST, DISCORD_API_PORT, &hints, &res) != 0 || !res) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] DNS resolve failed for %s\n", DISCORD_API_HOST);
    return NULL;
  }

  dc_socket_t sock = socket(res->ai_family, res->ai_socktype, res->ai_protocol);
#ifdef _WIN32
  if (sock == INVALID_SOCKET) {
#else
  if (sock < 0) {
#endif
    freeaddrinfo(res);
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Socket creation failed\n");
    return NULL;
  }

  /* Set socket timeouts to prevent blocking forever */
  struct timeval tv = {CONNECT_TIMEOUT_SECS, 0};
  setsockopt(sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, (const char *)&tv, sizeof(tv));
  setsockopt(sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, (const char *)&tv, sizeof(tv));

  if (connect(sock, res->ai_addr, (int)res->ai_addrlen) != 0) {
    freeaddrinfo(res);
    DC_CLOSESOCKET(sock);
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] TCP connect to %s:%s failed\n",
              DISCORD_API_HOST, DISCORD_API_PORT);
    return NULL;
  }
  freeaddrinfo(res);

  /* TLS handshake */
  void *ctx = dc_ssl.SSL_CTX_new(dc_ssl.TLS_client_method());
  if (!ctx) {
    DC_CLOSESOCKET(sock);
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] SSL_CTX_new failed\n");
    return NULL;
  }

  /* ★ Certificate verification ★
   * SSL_VERIFY_PEER = 0x01. Reject connections with invalid certs. */
  if (dc_ssl.SSL_CTX_set_verify) {
    dc_ssl.SSL_CTX_set_verify(ctx, 0x01 /* SSL_VERIFY_PEER */, NULL);
  }
  if (dc_ssl.SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths) {
    if (dc_ssl.SSL_CTX_set_default_verify_paths(ctx) != 1) {
      async_log("[Discord OAuth] Warning: failed to load system CA certs\n");
    }
  }

  void *ssl = dc_ssl.SSL_new(ctx);
  if (!ssl) {
    dc_cleanup(NULL, ctx, sock);
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] SSL_new failed\n");
    return NULL;
  }

  /* ★ SNI (Server Name Indication) — CRITICAL ★
   * SSL_ctrl(ssl, 55, 0, hostname) == SSL_set_tlsext_host_name() */
  dc_ssl.SSL_ctrl(ssl, 55, 0, (void *)DISCORD_API_HOST);

  dc_ssl.SSL_set_fd(ssl, (int)sock);

  if (dc_ssl.SSL_connect(ssl) != 1) {
    int err = dc_ssl.SSL_get_error(ssl, -1);
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] TLS handshake failed (ssl_err=%d)\n", err);
    dc_cleanup(ssl, ctx, sock);
    return NULL;
  }

  /* ★ Verify certificate chain after handshake ★ */
  if (dc_ssl.SSL_get_verify_result) {
    long vr = dc_ssl.SSL_get_verify_result(ssl);
    if (vr != 0 /* X509_V_OK */) {
      async_log("[Discord OAuth] Certificate verification failed: %ld\n", vr);
      dc_cleanup(ssl, ctx, sock);
      return NULL;
    }
  }

  /* ★ Hostname verification — prevents MITM with valid cert for wrong domain ★ */
  if (dc_ssl.SSL_get1_peer_certificate && dc_ssl.X509_check_host && dc_ssl.X509_free) {
    void *cert = dc_ssl.SSL_get1_peer_certificate(ssl);
    if (!cert) {
      async_log("[Discord OAuth] No peer certificate\n");
      dc_cleanup(ssl, ctx, sock);
      return NULL;
    }
    if (dc_ssl.X509_check_host(cert, DISCORD_API_HOST, 0, 0, NULL) != 1) {
      async_log("[Discord OAuth] Hostname verification failed (cert is not for %s)\n", DISCORD_API_HOST);
      dc_ssl.X509_free(cert);
      dc_cleanup(ssl, ctx, sock);
      return NULL;
    }
    dc_ssl.X509_free(cert);
  }

  /* Build HTTP request */
  char request[4096];
  int body_len = body ? (int)strlen(body) : 0;
  int rlen;

  if (body_len > 0) {
    rlen = snprintf(request, sizeof(request),
      "%s %s HTTP/1.1\r\n"
      "Host: %s\r\n"
      "Connection: close\r\n"
      "%s"
      "Content-Length: %d\r\n"
      "\r\n"
      "%s",
      method, path, DISCORD_API_HOST,
      headers_extra ? headers_extra : "",
      body_len,
      body);
  } else {
    rlen = snprintf(request, sizeof(request),
      "%s %s HTTP/1.1\r\n"
      "Host: %s\r\n"
      "Connection: close\r\n"
      "%s"
      "\r\n",
      method, path, DISCORD_API_HOST,
      headers_extra ? headers_extra : "");
  }

  /* Fix #3: snprintf truncation check */
  if (rlen < 0 || rlen >= (int)sizeof(request)) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] HTTP request truncated (%d >= %d)\n", rlen, (int)sizeof(request));
    dc_cleanup(ssl, ctx, sock);
    return NULL;
  }

  /* SSL_write loop — handle partial sends */
  int total_written = 0;
  while (total_written < rlen) {
    int w = dc_ssl.SSL_write(ssl, request + total_written, rlen - total_written);
    if (w <= 0) {
      async_log("[Discord OAuth] SSL_write failed at %d/%d bytes\n", total_written, rlen);
      dc_cleanup(ssl, ctx, sock);
      return NULL;
    }
    total_written += w;
  }

  /* Read full response with DYNAMIC BUFFER GROWTH.
   * We use Connection: close, so Discord closes after sending.
   * Start at 16KB, grow via realloc — never truncate. */
  int buf_cap = RESPONSE_BUF_SIZE;
  char *buf = (char *)malloc(buf_cap);
  if (!buf) {
    dc_cleanup(ssl, ctx, sock);
    return NULL;
  }

  int total = 0;
  while (1) {
    /* Grow buffer if less than 4KB remaining */
    if (total + 4096 > buf_cap) {
      buf_cap *= 2;
      if (buf_cap > 1024 * 1024) { /* 1MB hard safety cap */
        async_log("[Discord OAuth] Response exceeds 1MB, aborting\n");
        break;
      }
      char *newbuf = (char *)realloc(buf, buf_cap);
      if (!newbuf) {
        async_log("[Discord OAuth] realloc failed at %d bytes\n", buf_cap);
        break; /* use what we have */
      }
      buf = newbuf;
    }
    int n = dc_ssl.SSL_read(ssl, buf + total, buf_cap - 1 - total);
    if (n > 0) {
      total += n;
    } else if (n == 0) {
      break; /* clean EOF — Discord closed connection */
    } else {
      int err = dc_ssl.SSL_get_error(ssl, n);
      if (err == 6 /* SSL_ERROR_ZERO_RETURN */) break;
      async_log("[Discord OAuth] SSL_read error (ssl_err=%d after %d bytes)\n", err, total);
      break;
    }
  }
  buf[total] = '\0';

  dc_cleanup(ssl, ctx, sock);

  if (total == 0) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Empty response\n");
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
  }

  /* ── Validate HTTP status code ──────────────────────────── */
  /* Must be 2xx, otherwise Discord returned an error */
  char status_line[64] = {0};
  const char *eol = strstr(buf, "\r\n");
  if (eol) {
    int slen = (int)(eol - buf);
    if (slen > 63) slen = 63;
    memcpy(status_line, buf, slen);
    status_line[slen] = '\0';
  }
  async_log("[Discord OAuth] Response: %s (%d bytes)\n", status_line, total);

  /* Fix #1: Parse HTTP status with sscanf (handles HTTP/1.0 and 1.1) */
  int http_status = 0;
  if (sscanf(buf, "HTTP/%*d.%*d %d", &http_status) != 1) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Failed to parse HTTP status from response\n");
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
  }
  if (http_status < 200 || http_status >= 300) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] HTTP %d — Discord rejected request\n", http_status);
    char *dbg_body = strstr(buf, "\r\n\r\n");
    if (dbg_body) async_log("[Discord OAuth] Body: %.300s\n", dbg_body + 4);
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
  }

  /* Fix #9: Defensive header/body separator detection */
  char *body_start = strstr(buf, "\r\n\r\n");
  if (!body_start || body_start >= buf + total) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Invalid HTTP response (no body separator)\n");
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
  }
  body_start += 4;
  int blen = total - (int)(body_start - buf);
  if (blen <= 0) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Empty response body\n");
    free(buf);
    return NULL;
  }

  /* ── Handle chunked transfer encoding ──────────────────── */
  const char *te = strstr(buf, "Transfer-Encoding: chunked");
  if (!te) te = strstr(buf, "transfer-encoding: chunked");

  if (te && te < body_start) {
    /* Strict chunked decoder:
     * Format: <hex-size>\r\n<data>\r\n  ... repeated ...  0\r\n\r\n */
    int dec_cap = blen + 1; /* decoded can't be larger than wire data */
    char *decoded = (char *)malloc(dec_cap);
    if (!decoded) { free(buf); return NULL; }
    int decoded_len = 0;
    char *cp = body_start;
    char *end = buf + total;

    while (cp < end) {
      /* Parse chunk size with strict validation */
      char *endptr = NULL;
      unsigned long chunk_size = strtoul(cp, &endptr, 16);
      if (endptr == cp) break; /* not a valid hex number */

      /* Final chunk (size 0) */
      if (chunk_size == 0) break;

      /* endptr must point to \r\n */
      if (endptr + 2 > end || endptr[0] != '\r' || endptr[1] != '\n') {
        async_log("[Discord OAuth] Chunked: missing CRLF after size\n");
        break;
      }
      char *data_start = endptr + 2;

      /* Validate chunk data fits in buffer */
      if (data_start + chunk_size > end) {
        async_log("[Discord OAuth] Chunked: truncated chunk (need %lu, have %d)\n",
                  chunk_size, (int)(end - data_start));
        chunk_size = (unsigned long)(end - data_start);
      }

      /* Grow decoded buffer if needed */
      if (decoded_len + (int)chunk_size >= dec_cap) {
        dec_cap = decoded_len + (int)chunk_size + 4096;
        char *newdec = (char *)realloc(decoded, dec_cap);
        if (!newdec) {
          free(decoded);
          free(buf);
          return NULL;
        }
        decoded = newdec;
      }

      memcpy(decoded + decoded_len, data_start, chunk_size);
      decoded_len += (int)chunk_size;

      /* Skip data + trailing \r\n */
      cp = data_start + chunk_size;
      if (cp + 2 <= end && cp[0] == '\r' && cp[1] == '\n') {
        cp += 2;
      } else {
        break; /* malformed: missing trailing CRLF */
      }
    }

    decoded[decoded_len] = '\0';
    free(buf);
    /* Fix #10: limit decoded JSON size */
    if (decoded_len > 65536) {
      async_log("[Discord OAuth] Decoded body too large (%d bytes)\n", decoded_len);
      free(decoded);
      return NULL;
    }
    if (response_len) *response_len = decoded_len;
    return decoded;
  }

  /* Non-chunked: move body to start of buffer */
  memmove(buf, body_start, blen);
  buf[blen] = '\0';
  if (response_len) *response_len = blen;
  return buf;
}

/* ── Minimal JSON field extraction ──────────────────────────── */

/* Extract a string value for a given key from JSON.
 * Writes to dst (max dst_len). Returns true if found.
 * Handles: "key": "value", "key": null, "key" : "value" (with spaces) */
static bool json_get_string(const char *json, const char *key,
                             char *dst, int dst_len) {
  /* Fix #6: null guards */
  if (!json || !key || !dst || dst_len <= 0) return false;

  /* Build pattern: "key" */
  char pattern[128];
  snprintf(pattern, sizeof(pattern), "\"%s\"", key);
  const char *p = strstr(json, pattern);
  if (!p) return false;
  p += strlen(pattern);

  /* Skip whitespace and colon: ": " or " : " etc. */
  while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == ':') p++;

  /* Check for null */
  if (*p == 'n' && strncmp(p, "null", 4) == 0) {
    dst[0] = '\0';
    return true;
  }

  /* Must be a quoted string */
  if (*p != '"') return false;
  p++; /* skip opening quote */

  int i = 0;
  while (*p && *p != '"' && i < dst_len - 1) {
    if (*p == '\\' && *(p+1)) {
      p++; /* skip backslash, take next char */
      /* Handle common JSON escapes */
      switch (*p) {
        case 'n': dst[i++] = '\n'; break;
        case 't': dst[i++] = '\t'; break;
        case '"': dst[i++] = '"'; break;
        case '\\': dst[i++] = '\\'; break;
        case '/': dst[i++] = '/'; break;
        case 'u': /* Fix #7: skip \uXXXX unicode escapes */
          if (*(p+1) && *(p+2) && *(p+3) && *(p+4)) {
            p += 4; /* skip XXXX (the loop p++ handles the last) */
          }
          break;
        default: dst[i++] = *p; break;
      }
      p++;
    } else {
      dst[i++] = *p++;
    }
  }
  dst[i] = '\0';
  return true;
}

/* ── HTML-safe string escaping ──────────────────────────────── */

/* Escape a string for safe embedding in HTML/JS.
 * Replaces ' " < > & with safe equivalents.
 * Writes to dst (max dst_len). */
static void js_escape(const char *src, char *dst, int dst_len) {
  int i = 0;
  while (*src && i < dst_len - 6) { /* leave room for longest escape */
    switch (*src) {
      case '\'': dst[i++] = '\\'; dst[i++] = '\''; break;
      case '"':  dst[i++] = '\\'; dst[i++] = '"'; break;
      case '\\': dst[i++] = '\\'; dst[i++] = '\\'; break;
      case '<':  dst[i++] = '\\'; dst[i++] = 'x'; dst[i++] = '3'; dst[i++] = 'c'; break;
      case '>':  dst[i++] = '\\'; dst[i++] = 'x'; dst[i++] = '3'; dst[i++] = 'e'; break;
      default:   dst[i++] = *src; break;
    }
    src++;
  }
  dst[i] = '\0';
}

/* ── Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

bool discord_oauth_init(void) {
  const char *secret = getenv("DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET");
  if (!secret || !secret[0]) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET not set — Discord login disabled\n");
    return false;
  }
  strncpy(discord_client_secret, secret, sizeof(discord_client_secret) - 1);
  discord_client_secret[sizeof(discord_client_secret) - 1] = '\0';

  if (!dc_load_openssl()) return false;

  discord_oauth_ready = true;
  async_log("[Discord OAuth] Initialized (client_id=%s)\n", DISCORD_CLIENT_ID);
  return true;
}

bool discord_oauth_available(void) {
  return discord_oauth_ready;
}

char *discord_oauth_handle_callback(const char *code, const char **error_out) {
  static const char *err_exchange = "Token exchange failed";
  static const char *err_profile = "Profile fetch failed";
  static const char *err_nossl = "OpenSSL not available";

  if (!discord_oauth_ready || !dc_ssl.loaded) {
    *error_out = err_nossl;
    return NULL;
  }

  async_log("[Discord OAuth] Exchanging code (len=%d)...\n", (int)strlen(code));

  /* ── Step 1: Exchange code for access_token ─────────────── */
  char post_body[2048];
  int pb_len = snprintf(post_body, sizeof(post_body),
    "client_id=%s&client_secret=%s&grant_type=authorization_code"
    "&code=%s&redirect_uri=%s",
    DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, discord_client_secret, code,
    DISCORD_REDIRECT_URI_ENCODED);
  /* Fix #5: POST body overflow check */
  if (pb_len < 0 || pb_len >= (int)sizeof(post_body)) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] POST body too large (%d >= %d)\n", pb_len, (int)sizeof(post_body));
    *error_out = err_exchange;
    return NULL;
  }

  int token_len = 0;
  char *token_json = dc_https_request("POST", "/api/oauth2/token",
    "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\r\n",
    post_body, &token_len);

  if (!token_json) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Token exchange: no response from Discord\n");
    *error_out = err_exchange;
    return NULL;
  }

  char access_token[512] = {0};
  if (!json_get_string(token_json, "access_token", access_token, sizeof(access_token))
      || !access_token[0]) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Token exchange failed, response: %.500s\n", token_json);
    free(token_json);
    *error_out = err_exchange;
    return NULL;
  }
  free(token_json);
  async_log("[Discord OAuth] Got access_token (len=%d)\n", (int)strlen(access_token));

  /* ── Step 2: Fetch user profile ─────────────────────────── */
  char auth_header[600];
  snprintf(auth_header, sizeof(auth_header),
    "Authorization: Bearer %s\r\n", access_token);

  int user_len = 0;
  char *user_json = dc_https_request("GET", "/api/users/@me",
    auth_header, NULL, &user_len);

  if (!user_json) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] User profile fetch: no response from Discord\n");
    *error_out = err_profile;
    return NULL;
  }

  /* Extract fields */
  char user_id[32] = {0};
  char username[64] = {0};
  char global_name[64] = {0};
  char avatar_hash[64] = {0};

  json_get_string(user_json, "id", user_id, sizeof(user_id));
  json_get_string(user_json, "username", username, sizeof(username));
  json_get_string(user_json, "global_name", global_name, sizeof(global_name));
  json_get_string(user_json, "avatar", avatar_hash, sizeof(avatar_hash));

  async_log("[Discord OAuth] Raw profile: id=%s username=%s global_name=%s avatar=%s\n",
            user_id, username, global_name, avatar_hash[0] ? avatar_hash : "(null)");
  free(user_json);

  /* Fix #4: validate BOTH required fields */
  if (!user_id[0] || !username[0]) {
    async_log("[Discord OAuth] Missing required fields (id=%s username=%s)\n",
              user_id[0] ? user_id : "(empty)", username[0] ? username : "(empty)");
    *error_out = err_profile;
    return NULL;
  }

  /* If global_name is empty, use username */
  if (!global_name[0]) {
    strncpy(global_name, username, sizeof(global_name) - 1);
    global_name[sizeof(global_name) - 1] = '\0';
  }

  /* Build avatar URL — with fallback for users without custom avatar */
  char avatar_url[256];
  if (avatar_hash[0]) {
    const char *ext = (avatar_hash[0] == 'a' && avatar_hash[1] == '_') ? "gif" : "png";
    snprintf(avatar_url, sizeof(avatar_url),
      "https://cdn.discordapp.com/avatars/%s/%s.%s?size=128",
      user_id, avatar_hash, ext);
  } else {
    /* Default avatar: index = user_id % 5 (Discord's formula) */
    unsigned long long uid_num = strtoull(user_id, NULL, 10);
    int index = (int)(uid_num % 5);
    snprintf(avatar_url, sizeof(avatar_url),
      "https://cdn.discordapp.com/embed/avatars/%d.png", index);
  }

  async_log("[Discord OAuth] ✓ Login: %s (%s) avatar=%s\n",
            global_name, user_id, avatar_url);

  /* ── Step 3: Build relay HTML ───────────────────────────── */
  /* Escape user-supplied strings to prevent XSS / JS injection */
  char esc_id[64], esc_username[128], esc_globalname[128], esc_avatar[512];
  js_escape(user_id, esc_id, sizeof(esc_id));
  js_escape(username, esc_username, sizeof(esc_username));
  js_escape(global_name, esc_globalname, sizeof(esc_globalname));
  js_escape(avatar_url, esc_avatar, sizeof(esc_avatar));

  char *html = (char *)malloc(8192);
  if (!html) {
    *error_out = err_profile;
    return NULL;
  }

  snprintf(html, 8192,
    "<!DOCTYPE html>\n"
    "<html lang=\"en\">\n"
    "<head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><title>Discord Login</title>\n"
    "<style>*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}"
    "body{font-family:sans-serif;background:#0a0e17;color:#c8d6e5;"
    "min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}"
    ".card{background:#111827;border-radius:12px;padding:40px;"
    "border:1px solid #1e293b;text-align:center;max-width:400px;width:90%%}"
    "h2{color:#5865F2;margin-bottom:8px}"
    ".status{color:#64748b;margin-bottom:20px}"
    ".uname{color:#e2e8f0;font-size:1.1em;margin-bottom:4px}"
    ".btn{display:inline-block;padding:8px 16px;background:#5865F2;"
    "color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border-radius:8px;font-size:0.9em}"
    ".info{color:#64748b;font-size:0.85em;margin-top:16px}"
    "</style></head>\n"
    "<body><div class=\"card\">\n"
    "<h2>&#10004; Discord Linked!</h2>\n"
    "<p class=\"uname\">%s</p>\n"
    "<p class=\"status\">Closing this window...</p>\n"
    "<p class=\"info\">If this window doesn't close, "
    "<a href=\"javascript:window.close()\" class=\"btn\">Close Window</a></p>\n"
    "</div>\n"
    "<script>\n"
    "var d={id:'%s',username:'%s',globalName:'%s',avatar:'%s',email:'',token:'%s'};\n"
    "var msg={type:'legendmod_discord_login',data:d};\n"
    "try{var bc=new BroadcastChannel('legendmod_discord');bc.postMessage(msg);bc.close();}catch(e){}\n"
    "try{localStorage.setItem('legendmod_discord',JSON.stringify(d));}catch(e){}\n"
    "if(window.opener){try{window.opener.postMessage(msg,'*');\n"
    "try{var f=window.opener.frames;for(var i=0;i<f.length;i++)f[i].postMessage(msg,'*');}catch(e2){}\n"
    "}catch(e){}}\n"
    "setTimeout(function(){window.close();},1500);\n"
    "</script></body></html>",
    esc_globalname,  /* visible name in the card */
    esc_id, esc_username, esc_globalname, esc_avatar, esc_id  /* JS data */
  );

  /* Fix #8: final success log */
  async_log("[Discord OAuth] ✓ Flow complete for user %s (%s) — relay HTML built\n",
            global_name, user_id);

  return html;
}

#ifndef DISCORD_OAUTH_H
#define DISCORD_OAUTH_H

#include <stdbool.h>

/*
 * Discord OAuth2 callback handler.
 *
 * Called from do_ws_handshake() when the HTTP request path matches
 * /auth/discord/callback. Exchanges the authorization code for an
 * access token, fetches the real Discord user profile, and returns
 * an HTML relay page with the real user data.
 *
 * Returns a malloc'd HTML string (caller must free), or NULL on error.
 * On error, *error_out is set to a static error message string.
 */
char *discord_oauth_handle_callback(const char *code, const char **error_out);

/* Initialize Discord OAuth with client secret.
 * Must be called once at startup (reads DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET env var). */
bool discord_oauth_init(void);

/* Shutdown Discord OAuth. */
void discord_oauth_shutdown(void);

/* Check if Discord OAuth is available (secret configured). */
bool discord_oauth_available(void);

#endif /* DISCORD_OAUTH_H */

#include "economy.h"

#include <ctype.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

static uint32_t saturating_add_u32(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
  return UINT32_MAX - a < b ? UINT32_MAX : a + b;
}

void economy_transaction_init(EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  if (tx)
    memset(tx, 0, sizeof(*tx));
}

bool economy_transaction_add(EconomyTransaction *tx, uint8_t wallet_type,
                   const char *product_id, uint32_t amount, int32_t delta) {
  if (!tx || tx->update_count >= ECONOMY_MAX_TX_UPDATES)
    return false;
  EconomyProductUpdate *u = &tx->updates[tx->update_count++];
  memset(u, 0, sizeof(*u));
  u->wallet_type = wallet_type;
  snprintf(u->product_id, sizeof(u->product_id), "%s",
           product_id ? product_id : "");
  u->amount = amount;
  u->delta = delta;
  return true;
}

static int parse_currency(const char *s) {
  if (!s || !s[0] || strcmp(s, "none") == 0)
    return ECONOMY_CURRENCY_NONE;
  if (strcmp(s, "coin") == 0 || strcmp(s, "coins") == 0)
    return ECONOMY_CURRENCY_COIN;
  if (strcmp(s, "dna") == 0)
    return ECONOMY_CURRENCY_DNA;
  return -1;
}

static uint8_t parse_flags(const char *s) {
  uint8_t flags = 0;
  if (!s)
    return flags;
  if (strstr(s, "repeatable"))
    flags |= ECONOMY_FLAG_REPEATABLE;
  if (strstr(s, "disabled"))
    flags |= ECONOMY_FLAG_DISABLED;
  if (strstr(s, "once"))
    flags |= ECONOMY_FLAG_ONCE;
  return flags;
}

static bool catalog_add(EconomyCatalog *catalog, const char *purchase_id,
                        const char *bundle_id, EconomyCurrency currency,
                        uint32_t price, uint8_t wallet_type,
                        const char *product_id, uint32_t amount,
                        uint16_t skin_index, uint8_t flags,
                        uint32_t time_step_seconds,
                        uint32_t time_price_decrease) {
  if (!catalog || catalog->count >= ECONOMY_MAX_CATALOG_ROWS ||
      !product_id || !product_id[0] || wallet_type == 0 || amount == 0 ||
      price > INT32_MAX)
    return false;
  EconomyCatalogRow *row = &catalog->rows[catalog->count++];
  memset(row, 0, sizeof(*row));
  snprintf(row->purchase_id, sizeof(row->purchase_id), "%s",
           purchase_id ? purchase_id : "");
  snprintf(row->bundle_id, sizeof(row->bundle_id), "%s",
           bundle_id ? bundle_id : "");
  snprintf(row->product_id, sizeof(row->product_id), "%s", product_id);
  row->currency = (uint8_t)currency;
  row->price = price;
  row->wallet_type = wallet_type;
  row->amount = amount;
  row->time_step_seconds = time_step_seconds;
  row->time_price_decrease = time_price_decrease;
  row->skin_index = skin_index;
  row->flags = flags;
  return true;
}

static void add_builtin_boost(EconomyCatalog *catalog, const char *id,
                              uint32_t dna_price) {
  char prefixed[ECONOMY_PURCHASE_ID_LEN];
  snprintf(prefixed, sizeof(prefixed), "1_%s", id);
  catalog_add(catalog, id, "", ECONOMY_CURRENCY_DNA, dna_price, 2, id, 1,
              ECONOMY_NO_SKIN_INDEX, ECONOMY_FLAG_REPEATABLE, 0, 0);
  catalog_add(catalog, prefixed, "", ECONOMY_CURRENCY_DNA, dna_price, 2, id,
              1, ECONOMY_NO_SKIN_INDEX, ECONOMY_FLAG_REPEATABLE, 0, 0);
}

void economy_catalog_init(EconomyCatalog *catalog) {
  if (!catalog)
    return;
  memset(catalog, 0, sizeof(*catalog));

  /* Fallback prices match the current Legend Mod boost selector. An external
   * shop_catalog.tsv overrides/extends these entries and should be generated
   * from the exact GameConfiguration version deployed with the client. */
  add_builtin_boost(catalog, "mass_boost_2x_1h", 90);
  add_builtin_boost(catalog, "mass_boost_2x_24h", 290);
  add_builtin_boost(catalog, "mass_boost_3x_1h", 180);
  add_builtin_boost(catalog, "mass_boost_3x_24h", 490);
  add_builtin_boost(catalog, "xp_boost_2x_1h", 60);
  add_builtin_boost(catalog, "xp_boost_2x_24h", 190);
  add_builtin_boost(catalog, "xp_boost_3x_1h", 120);
  add_builtin_boost(catalog, "xp_boost_3x_24h", 390);

  catalog_add(catalog, "quest_activation_24h", "", ECONOMY_CURRENCY_DNA, 40,
              4, "quest_activation_24h", 1, ECONOMY_NO_SKIN_INDEX,
              ECONOMY_FLAG_REPEATABLE, 0, 0);
}

static void catalog_remove_builtin_purchase(EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                            uint32_t *builtin_count,
                                            const char *purchase_id) {
  if (!catalog || !builtin_count || !purchase_id || !purchase_id[0])
    return;
  uint32_t prefix = *builtin_count;
  if (prefix > catalog->count)
    prefix = catalog->count;
  uint32_t out = 0;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < catalog->count; i++) {
    bool remove = i < prefix && catalog->rows[i].purchase_id[0] &&
                  strcmp(catalog->rows[i].purchase_id, purchase_id) == 0;
    if (!remove) {
      if (out != i)
        catalog->rows[out] = catalog->rows[i];
      out++;
    }
  }
  uint32_t removed = catalog->count - out;
  catalog->count = out;
  *builtin_count = prefix >= removed ? prefix - removed : 0;
}

/* Split tab-separated columns without strtok_r, which is not available in
 * the Windows CRT. Empty columns are preserved. */
static int split_tsv(char *line, char **cols, int max_cols) {
  if (!line || !cols || max_cols <= 0)
    return 0;
  int count = 0;
  char *start = line;
  for (char *p = line;; p++) {
    if (*p == '\t' || *p == '\0') {
      char terminal = *p;
      *p = '\0';
      if (count < max_cols)
        cols[count++] = start;
      if (terminal == '\0' || count >= max_cols)
        break;
      start = p + 1;
    }
  }
  return count;
}

static char *trim(char *s) {
  if (!s)
    return s;
  while (*s && isspace((unsigned char)*s))
    s++;
  char *end = s + strlen(s);
  while (end > s && isspace((unsigned char)end[-1]))
    *--end = '\0';
  return s;
}

int economy_catalog_load_tsv(EconomyCatalog *catalog, const char *path) {
  if (!catalog || !path)
    return -1;
  FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
  if (!f)
    return errno == ENOENT ? 0 : -1;

  char line[2048];
  int added = 0;
  uint32_t builtin_count = catalog->count;
  while (fgets(line, sizeof(line), f)) {
    char *p = trim(line);
    if (!p[0] || p[0] == '#')
      continue;

    char *cols[11] = {0};
    int n = split_tsv(p, cols, 11);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
      cols[i] = trim(cols[i]);
    if (n < 7) {
      catalog->rejected_rows++;
      continue;
    }

    char *end = NULL;
    int parsed_currency = parse_currency(cols[2]);
    unsigned long price = strtoul(cols[3], &end, 10);
    if (parsed_currency < 0 || !end || *end || price > UINT32_MAX) {
      catalog->rejected_rows++;
      continue;
    }
    unsigned long wallet_type = strtoul(cols[4], &end, 10);
    if (!end || *end || wallet_type == 0 || wallet_type > UINT8_MAX) {
      catalog->rejected_rows++;
      continue;
    }
    unsigned long amount = strtoul(cols[6], &end, 10);
    if (!end || *end || amount == 0 || amount > UINT32_MAX) {
      catalog->rejected_rows++;
      continue;
    }

    uint16_t skin_index = ECONOMY_NO_SKIN_INDEX;
    if (n >= 8 && cols[7] && cols[7][0] && strcmp(cols[7], "-") != 0) {
      unsigned long idx = strtoul(cols[7], &end, 10);
      if (!end || *end || idx >= PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_BITS) {
        catalog->rejected_rows++;
        continue;
      }
      skin_index = (uint16_t)idx;
    }

    uint8_t flags = n >= 9 ? parse_flags(cols[8]) : 0;
    uint32_t time_step_seconds = 0;
    uint32_t time_price_decrease = 0;
    if (n >= 10 && cols[9] && cols[9][0]) {
      unsigned long value = strtoul(cols[9], &end, 10);
      if (!end || *end || value > UINT32_MAX) {
        catalog->rejected_rows++;
        continue;
      }
      time_step_seconds = (uint32_t)value;
    }
    if (n >= 11 && cols[10] && cols[10][0]) {
      unsigned long value = strtoul(cols[10], &end, 10);
      if (!end || *end || value > UINT32_MAX) {
        catalog->rejected_rows++;
        continue;
      }
      time_price_decrease = (uint32_t)value;
    }
    if ((time_step_seconds == 0) != (time_price_decrease == 0)) {
      catalog->rejected_rows++;
      continue;
    }
    /* An external purchase entry replaces the built-in fallback with the same
     * purchase ID. Bundles may legitimately span multiple rows, so they are
     * never removed while reading subsequent lines. */
    if (cols[0] && cols[0][0])
      catalog_remove_builtin_purchase(catalog, &builtin_count, cols[0]);
    if (!catalog_add(catalog, cols[0], cols[1],
                     (EconomyCurrency)parsed_currency, (uint32_t)price,
                     (uint8_t)wallet_type, cols[5], (uint32_t)amount,
                     skin_index, flags, time_step_seconds,
                     time_price_decrease)) {
      catalog->rejected_rows++;
      continue;
    }
    added++;
  }
  fclose(f);
  catalog->loaded_external_catalog = added > 0;
  return added;
}

bool economy_skin_owned(const PlayerRecord *rec, uint16_t skin_index) {
  if (!rec || skin_index >= PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_BITS)
    return false;
  uint32_t word = skin_index / 64u;
  uint32_t bit = skin_index % 64u;
  return (rec->owned_skin_bits[word] & (UINT64_C(1) << bit)) != 0;
}

bool economy_skin_set_owned(PlayerRecord *rec, uint16_t skin_index, bool owned) {
  if (!rec || skin_index >= PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_BITS)
    return false;
  uint32_t word = skin_index / 64u;
  uint32_t bit = skin_index % 64u;
  uint64_t mask = UINT64_C(1) << bit;
  if (owned)
    rec->owned_skin_bits[word] |= mask;
  else
    rec->owned_skin_bits[word] &= ~mask;
  return true;
}

bool economy_skin_is_free(const char *product_id) {
  if (!product_id || !product_id[0])
    return false;
  return strcmp(product_id, "skin_empty") == 0 ||
         strcmp(product_id, "empty") == 0 ||
         strncmp(product_id, "country_", 8) == 0 ||
         strncmp(product_id, "skin_country_", 13) == 0;
}

static const EconomyCatalogRow *find_skin_row(const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                               const char *product_id) {
  if (!catalog || !product_id)
    return NULL;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < catalog->count; i++) {
    const EconomyCatalogRow *row = &catalog->rows[i];
    if (row->wallet_type == 3 && row->skin_index != ECONOMY_NO_SKIN_INDEX &&
        strcmp(row->product_id, product_id) == 0)
      return row;
  }
  return NULL;
}

bool economy_skin_product_owned(const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                const PlayerRecord *rec,
                                const char *product_id) {
  if (economy_skin_is_free(product_id))
    return true;
  const EconomyCatalogRow *row = find_skin_row(catalog, product_id);
  return row && economy_skin_owned(rec, row->skin_index);
}

bool economy_catalog_has_product(const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                 uint8_t wallet_type,
                                 const char *product_id) {
  if (!catalog || !product_id || !product_id[0])
    return false;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < catalog->count; i++) {
    const EconomyCatalogRow *row = &catalog->rows[i];
    if (!(row->flags & ECONOMY_FLAG_DISABLED) &&
        row->wallet_type == wallet_type &&
        strcmp(row->product_id, product_id) == 0)
      return true;
  }
  return false;
}

const char *economy_boost_product_id(int is_xp, int boost_idx) {
  static const char *mass[] = {"mass_boost_2x_1h", "mass_boost_2x_24h",
                               "mass_boost_3x_1h", "mass_boost_3x_24h"};
  static const char *xp[] = {"xp_boost_2x_1h", "xp_boost_2x_24h",
                             "xp_boost_3x_1h", "xp_boost_3x_24h"};
  if (boost_idx < 0 || boost_idx > 3)
    return "";
  return is_xp ? xp[boost_idx] : mass[boost_idx];
}

bool economy_parse_boost_product(const char *product_id, int *is_xp,
                                 int *boost_idx, uint32_t *duration_secs,
                                 uint8_t *multiplier) {
  if (!product_id)
    return false;
  const char *id = product_id;
  if (strncmp(id, "1_", 2) == 0)
    id += 2;
  int xp = strncmp(id, "xp_boost_", 9) == 0;
  int mass = strncmp(id, "mass_boost_", 11) == 0;
  if (!xp && !mass)
    return false;
  int idx = -1;
  if (strstr(id, "2x_1h"))
    idx = 0;
  else if (strstr(id, "2x_24h"))
    idx = 1;
  else if (strstr(id, "3x_1h"))
    idx = 2;
  else if (strstr(id, "3x_24h"))
    idx = 3;
  if (idx < 0)
    return false;
  if (is_xp)
    *is_xp = xp;
  if (boost_idx)
    *boost_idx = idx;
  if (duration_secs)
    *duration_secs = (idx == 0 || idx == 2) ? 3600u : 86400u;
  if (multiplier)
    *multiplier = (idx == 2 || idx == 3) ? 3u : 2u;
  return true;
}

static int potion_inventory_index(const char *product_id) {
  if (!product_id)
    return -1;
  if (strstr(product_id, "common") || strcmp(product_id, "potion_superior") == 0)
    return 0;
  if (strstr(product_id, "uncommon") || strcmp(product_id, "potion_epic") == 0)
    return 1;
  if (strstr(product_id, "exotic") || strcmp(product_id, "potion_legendary") == 0)
    return 2;
  if (strstr(product_id, "legendary") || strcmp(product_id, "potion_mystical") == 0)
    return 3;
  return -1;
}

static int misc_index(uint8_t wallet_type) {
  if (wallet_type == 4)
    return 0; /* quest token */
  if (wallet_type == 9)
    return 1; /* brew skip */
  if (wallet_type == 10)
    return 2; /* skin create token */
  return -1;
}

static uint8_t misc_count(const PlayerRecord *rec, int idx) {
  return (uint8_t)((rec->misc_inventory >> (idx * 8)) & 0xffu);
}

static void misc_set(PlayerRecord *rec, int idx, uint8_t count) {
  uint32_t mask = ~(0xffu << (idx * 8));
  rec->misc_inventory =
      (rec->misc_inventory & mask) | ((uint32_t)count << (idx * 8));
}

uint32_t economy_product_amount(const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                const PlayerRecord *rec,
                                uint8_t wallet_type,
                                const char *product_id,
                                uint16_t skin_index) {
  (void)catalog;
  if (!rec)
    return 0;
  if (wallet_type == 1) {
    if (product_id && strcmp(product_id, "dna") == 0)
      return rec->dna;
    return rec->coins;
  }
  if (wallet_type == 2) {
    int xp = 0, idx = -1;
    if (!economy_parse_boost_product(product_id, &xp, &idx, NULL, NULL))
      return 0;
    return prec_boost_count(rec, xp, idx);
  }
  if (wallet_type == 3) {
    return economy_skin_owned(rec, skin_index) ? 1u : 0u;
  }
  if (wallet_type == 6) {
    int idx = potion_inventory_index(product_id);
    return idx >= 0 ? prec_potion_count(rec, idx) : 0;
  }
  if (wallet_type == 7)
    return rec->trophies;
  int mi = misc_index(wallet_type);
  return mi >= 0 ? misc_count(rec, mi) : 0;
}

static bool can_grant_row(const PlayerRecord *rec,
                          const EconomyCatalogRow *row,
                          EconomyResult *failure) {
  if (!rec || !row || (row->flags & ECONOMY_FLAG_DISABLED)) {
    *failure = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE;
    return false;
  }
  if (row->wallet_type == 3) {
    if (row->skin_index == ECONOMY_NO_SKIN_INDEX) {
      *failure = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
      return false;
    }
    if (!(row->flags & ECONOMY_FLAG_REPEATABLE) &&
        economy_skin_owned(rec, row->skin_index)) {
      *failure = ECONOMY_RESULT_ALREADY_OWNED;
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (row->wallet_type == 2) {
    int xp = 0, idx = -1;
    if (!economy_parse_boost_product(row->product_id, &xp, &idx, NULL, NULL)) {
      *failure = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  if (row->wallet_type == 1 || row->wallet_type == 4 ||
      row->wallet_type == 6 || row->wallet_type == 7 ||
      row->wallet_type == 9 || row->wallet_type == 10)
    return true;
  *failure = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
  return false;
}

static bool grant_row(PlayerRecord *rec, const EconomyCatalogRow *row,
                      EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  uint32_t before = economy_product_amount(NULL, rec, row->wallet_type,
                                           row->product_id, row->skin_index);
  uint32_t after = before;
  if (row->wallet_type == 1) {
    if (strcmp(row->product_id, "dna") == 0)
      rec->dna = after = saturating_add_u32(rec->dna, row->amount);
    else
      rec->coins = after = saturating_add_u32(rec->coins, row->amount);
  } else if (row->wallet_type == 2) {
    int xp = 0, idx = -1;
    if (!economy_parse_boost_product(row->product_id, &xp, &idx, NULL, NULL))
      return false;
    uint32_t nv = saturating_add_u32(before, row->amount);
    if (nv > 255)
      nv = 255;
    prec_boost_set(rec, xp, idx, (uint8_t)nv);
    after = nv;
  } else if (row->wallet_type == 3) {
    if (!economy_skin_set_owned(rec, row->skin_index, true))
      return false;
    after = 1;
  } else if (row->wallet_type == 6) {
    int idx = potion_inventory_index(row->product_id);
    if (idx < 0)
      return false;
    uint32_t nv = saturating_add_u32(before, row->amount);
    if (nv > 255)
      nv = 255;
    prec_potion_set(rec, idx, (uint8_t)nv);
    after = nv;
  } else if (row->wallet_type == 7) {
    rec->trophies = after = saturating_add_u32(rec->trophies, row->amount);
  } else {
    int mi = misc_index(row->wallet_type);
    if (mi < 0)
      return false;
    uint32_t nv = saturating_add_u32(before, row->amount);
    if (nv > 255)
      nv = 255;
    misc_set(rec, mi, (uint8_t)nv);
    after = nv;
  }
  int64_t delta64 = (int64_t)after - (int64_t)before;
  int32_t delta = delta64 > INT32_MAX ? INT32_MAX : (int32_t)delta64;
  return economy_transaction_add(tx, row->wallet_type, row->product_id, after, delta);
}

static uint64_t redeemed_id_hash(const char *id, bool by_bundle) {
  uint64_t hash = UINT64_C(1469598103934665603);
  const unsigned char prefix = by_bundle ? 'B' : 'P';
  hash ^= prefix;
  hash *= UINT64_C(1099511628211);
  for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)id; p && *p; p++) {
    hash ^= *p;
    hash *= UINT64_C(1099511628211);
  }
  return hash ? hash : UINT64_C(1);
}

static bool redeemed_contains(const PlayerRecord *rec, uint64_t hash) {
  for (int i = 0; rec && i < PLAYERDB_REDEEMED_PURCHASE_SLOTS; i++)
    if (rec->redeemed_purchase_hashes[i] == hash)
      return true;
  return false;
}

static bool redeemed_add(PlayerRecord *rec, uint64_t hash) {
  if (!rec || hash == 0)
    return false;
  if (redeemed_contains(rec, hash))
    return true;
  for (int i = 0; i < PLAYERDB_REDEEMED_PURCHASE_SLOTS; i++) {
    if (rec->redeemed_purchase_hashes[i] == 0) {
      rec->redeemed_purchase_hashes[i] = hash;
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

static EconomyResult apply_rows(const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                PlayerRecord *rec, const char *id,
                                bool by_bundle, bool override_price,
                                uint32_t effective_price,
                                EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  economy_transaction_init(tx);
  if (!catalog || !rec || !id || !id[0] || !tx)
    return ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;

  const EconomyCatalogRow *matched[ECONOMY_MAX_TX_UPDATES - 1];
  uint32_t matched_count = 0;
  EconomyCurrency currency = ECONOMY_CURRENCY_NONE;
  uint32_t price = 0;
  bool one_time = false;
  bool one_time_initialized = false;

  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < catalog->count; i++) {
    const EconomyCatalogRow *row = &catalog->rows[i];
    const char *candidate = by_bundle ? row->bundle_id : row->purchase_id;
    if (!candidate[0] || strcmp(candidate, id) != 0)
      continue;
    if (matched_count >= ECONOMY_MAX_TX_UPDATES - 1) {
      tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
      return tx->result;
    }
    bool row_one_time = (row->flags & ECONOMY_FLAG_ONCE) != 0;
    if (matched_count == 0) {
      currency = (EconomyCurrency)row->currency;
      price = row->price;
      one_time = row_one_time;
      one_time_initialized = true;
    } else if (currency != (EconomyCurrency)row->currency ||
               price != row->price ||
               (one_time_initialized && one_time != row_one_time)) {
      tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
      return tx->result;
    }
    matched[matched_count++] = row;
  }
  if (matched_count == 0) {
    tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE;
    return tx->result;
  }
  /* Time-variable prices may only reduce a soft purchase's authoritative base
   * price. Bundles and client-provided increases are never accepted. */
  if (override_price) {
    if (by_bundle || effective_price > price || effective_price > INT32_MAX) {
      tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
      return tx->result;
    }
    price = effective_price;
  }

  uint64_t redemption_hash = redeemed_id_hash(id, by_bundle);
  if (one_time && redeemed_contains(rec, redemption_hash)) {
    tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE;
    return tx->result;
  }

  EconomyResult failure = ECONOMY_RESULT_OK;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < matched_count; i++) {
    if (!can_grant_row(rec, matched[i], &failure)) {
      tx->result = failure;
      return failure;
    }
  }

  if (currency == ECONOMY_CURRENCY_COIN && rec->coins < price) {
    tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_ENOUGH_CURRENCY;
    return tx->result;
  }
  if (currency == ECONOMY_CURRENCY_DNA && rec->dna < price) {
    tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_ENOUGH_CURRENCY;
    return tx->result;
  }

  PlayerRecord before_record = *rec;

  if (currency == ECONOMY_CURRENCY_COIN) {
    rec->coins -= price;
    if (!economy_transaction_add(tx, 1, "coin", rec->coins, -(int32_t)price)) {
      *rec = before_record;
      economy_transaction_init(tx);
      tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
      return tx->result;
    }
  } else if (currency == ECONOMY_CURRENCY_DNA) {
    rec->dna -= price;
    if (!economy_transaction_add(tx, 1, "dna", rec->dna, -(int32_t)price)) {
      *rec = before_record;
      economy_transaction_init(tx);
      tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
      return tx->result;
    }
  }

  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < matched_count; i++) {
    if (!grant_row(rec, matched[i], tx)) {
      /* Transactions are atomic: no charged currency or partial grants survive
       * an unexpected catalog/encoding failure. */
      *rec = before_record;
      economy_transaction_init(tx);
      tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;
      return tx->result;
    }
  }
  if (one_time && !redeemed_add(rec, redemption_hash)) {
    *rec = before_record;
    economy_transaction_init(tx);
    tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVENTORY_FULL;
    return tx->result;
  }
  tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_OK;
  return tx->result;
}

EconomyResult economy_apply_soft_purchase(const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                          PlayerRecord *rec,
                                          const char *purchase_id,
                                          EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  return apply_rows(catalog, rec, purchase_id, false, false, 0, tx);
}

EconomyResult economy_apply_soft_purchase_at_price(
    const EconomyCatalog *catalog, PlayerRecord *rec,
    const char *purchase_id, uint32_t effective_price,
    EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  return apply_rows(catalog, rec, purchase_id, false, true, effective_price,
                    tx);
}

bool economy_soft_purchase_pricing(const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                   const char *purchase_id,
                                   uint32_t *base_price,
                                   uint32_t *time_step_seconds,
                                   uint32_t *time_price_decrease) {
  if (!catalog || !purchase_id || !purchase_id[0])
    return false;
  bool found = false;
  uint32_t price = 0, step = 0, decrease = 0;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < catalog->count; i++) {
    const EconomyCatalogRow *row = &catalog->rows[i];
    if (!row->purchase_id[0] || strcmp(row->purchase_id, purchase_id) != 0)
      continue;
    if (!found) {
      price = row->price;
      step = row->time_step_seconds;
      decrease = row->time_price_decrease;
      found = true;
    } else if (price != row->price || step != row->time_step_seconds ||
               decrease != row->time_price_decrease) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  if (!found)
    return false;
  if (base_price)
    *base_price = price;
  if (time_step_seconds)
    *time_step_seconds = step;
  if (time_price_decrease)
    *time_price_decrease = decrease;
  return true;
}

EconomyResult economy_apply_offer_bundle(const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                                         PlayerRecord *rec,
                                         const char *bundle_id,
                                         EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  return apply_rows(catalog, rec, bundle_id, true, false, 0, tx);
}

static uint32_t random_range(uint32_t min, uint32_t max) {
  if (max <= min)
    return min;
  return min + (uint32_t)(rand() % (int)(max - min + 1));
}

EconomyResult economy_open_premium_potion(PlayerRecord *rec,
                                          const char *product_id,
                                          EconomyTransaction *tx,
                                          uint32_t *coins_reward,
                                          uint32_t *dna_reward) {
  economy_transaction_init(tx);
  if (coins_reward)
    *coins_reward = 0;
  if (dna_reward)
    *dna_reward = 0;
  if (!rec || !product_id || !tx)
    return ECONOMY_RESULT_INVALID_REQUEST;

  uint32_t cost = 0, coins = 0, dna = 0;
  if (strcmp(product_id, "potion_superior") == 0) {
    cost = 60;
    coins = random_range(100, 250);
    dna = random_range(1, 3);
  } else if (strcmp(product_id, "potion_epic") == 0) {
    cost = 120;
    coins = random_range(250, 600);
    dna = random_range(3, 7);
  } else if (strcmp(product_id, "potion_legendary") == 0) {
    cost = 350;
    coins = random_range(700, 1800);
    dna = random_range(8, 18);
  } else if (strcmp(product_id, "potion_mystical") == 0) {
    cost = 750;
    coins = random_range(1800, 5000);
    dna = random_range(20, 50);
  } else {
    tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE;
    return tx->result;
  }
  if (rec->dna < cost) {
    tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_ENOUGH_CURRENCY;
    return tx->result;
  }

  PlayerRecord before = *rec;
  rec->dna -= cost;
  rec->coins = saturating_add_u32(rec->coins, coins);
  rec->dna = saturating_add_u32(rec->dna, dna);
  rec->potions_opened = saturating_add_u32(rec->potions_opened, 1);

  if (!economy_transaction_add(tx, 1, "dna", rec->dna,
                               (int32_t)dna - (int32_t)cost) ||
      !economy_transaction_add(tx, 1, "coin", rec->coins,
                               (int32_t)coins)) {
    *rec = before;
    economy_transaction_init(tx);
    tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_INVENTORY_FULL;
    return tx->result;
  }
  tx->result = ECONOMY_RESULT_OK;
  if (coins_reward)
    *coins_reward = coins;
  if (dna_reward)
    *dna_reward = dna;
  return tx->result;
}

void economy_store_potion_slots(const Player *player, PlayerRecord *rec,
                                uint32_t server_tick, uint64_t now_unix) {
  if (!player || !rec)
    return;
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POTIONS && i < PLAYERDB_POTION_SLOTS; i++) {
    const Potion *p = &player->potions[i];
    rec->potion_slot_rarity[i] = (uint8_t)p->rarity;
    if (p->rarity == POTION_NONE) {
      rec->potion_slot_status[i] = 0;
      rec->potion_slot_ready_at[i] = 0;
    } else if (p->ready) {
      rec->potion_slot_status[i] = 3;
      rec->potion_slot_ready_at[i] = now_unix;
    } else if (p->brew_start_tick > 0) {
      uint32_t elapsed = server_tick - p->brew_start_tick;
      uint32_t remaining_ticks = elapsed >= p->brew_duration
                                     ? 0
                                     : p->brew_duration - elapsed;
      rec->potion_slot_status[i] = remaining_ticks == 0 ? 3 : 2;
      rec->potion_slot_ready_at[i] =
          now_unix + (uint64_t)((remaining_ticks + 24u) / 25u);
    } else {
      rec->potion_slot_status[i] = 1;
      rec->potion_slot_ready_at[i] = 0;
    }
  }
}

void economy_restore_player_state(Player *player, PlayerRecord *rec,
                                  uint32_t server_tick, uint64_t now_unix) {
  if (!player || !rec)
    return;
  player->potion_count = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POTIONS && i < PLAYERDB_POTION_SLOTS; i++) {
    Potion *p = &player->potions[i];
    memset(p, 0, sizeof(*p));
    uint8_t rarity = rec->potion_slot_rarity[i];
    uint8_t status = rec->potion_slot_status[i];
    if (rarity == 0 || rarity > POTION_LEGENDARY || status == 0)
      continue;
    p->rarity = (PotionRarity)rarity;
    p->brew_duration = potion_brew_duration(p->rarity);
    player->potion_count++;
    if (status == 3 ||
        (status == 2 && rec->potion_slot_ready_at[i] <= now_unix)) {
      p->ready = true;
      p->brew_start_tick = server_tick > 0 ? server_tick : 1;
      rec->potion_slot_status[i] = 3;
      rec->potion_slot_ready_at[i] = now_unix;
    } else if (status == 2) {
      uint64_t remaining_secs = rec->potion_slot_ready_at[i] - now_unix;
      uint64_t ticks = remaining_secs * 25u;
      if (ticks > UINT32_MAX)
        ticks = UINT32_MAX;
      p->brew_start_tick = server_tick > 0 ? server_tick : 1;
      p->brew_duration = (uint32_t)ticks;
      p->ready = false;
    }
  }
  economy_refresh_expirations(player, rec, now_unix);
}

void economy_refresh_expirations(Player *player, PlayerRecord *rec,
                                 uint64_t now_unix) {
  if (!player || !rec)
    return;
  if (rec->active_mass_boost_until > now_unix &&
      rec->active_mass_boost_idx < 4) {
    player->mass_boost = rec->active_mass_boost_idx >= 2 ? 3.0 : 2.0;
  } else {
    player->mass_boost = 1.0;
    rec->active_mass_boost_until = 0;
    rec->active_mass_boost_idx = 0xff;
  }
  if (rec->active_xp_boost_until > now_unix &&
      rec->active_xp_boost_idx < 4) {
    player->xp_boost = rec->active_xp_boost_idx >= 2 ? 3.0 : 2.0;
  } else {
    player->xp_boost = 1.0;
    rec->active_xp_boost_until = 0;
    rec->active_xp_boost_idx = 0xff;
  }
  if (rec->active_quest_until && rec->active_quest_until <= now_unix) {
    rec->active_quest_until = 0;
    rec->active_quest[0] = '\0';
    rec->quest_goal = 0;
    rec->quest_progress = 0;
  }
}

void economy_custom_skin_id(char *out, size_t out_size, uint64_t hash) {
  if (!out || out_size == 0)
    return;
  snprintf(out, out_size, "custom_%016llx", (unsigned long long)hash);
}

bool economy_custom_skin_contains(const PlayerRecord *rec, uint64_t hash) {
  if (!rec || hash == 0)
    return false;
  for (int i = 0; i < PLAYERDB_CUSTOM_SKIN_SLOTS; i++)
    if (rec->custom_skin_hashes[i] == hash)
      return true;
  return false;
}

bool economy_custom_skin_add(PlayerRecord *rec, uint64_t hash) {
  if (!rec || hash == 0)
    return false;
  if (economy_custom_skin_contains(rec, hash))
    return true;
  for (int i = 0; i < PLAYERDB_CUSTOM_SKIN_SLOTS; i++) {
    if (rec->custom_skin_hashes[i] == 0) {
      rec->custom_skin_hashes[i] = hash;
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

bool economy_custom_skin_remove(PlayerRecord *rec, uint64_t hash) {
  if (!rec || hash == 0)
    return false;
  for (int i = 0; i < PLAYERDB_CUSTOM_SKIN_SLOTS; i++) {
    if (rec->custom_skin_hashes[i] == hash) {
      rec->custom_skin_hashes[i] = 0;
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

uint32_t economy_misc_amount(const PlayerRecord *rec, uint8_t wallet_type) {
  if (!rec)
    return 0;
  int idx = misc_index(wallet_type);
  return idx >= 0 ? misc_count(rec, idx) : 0;
}

bool economy_misc_add(PlayerRecord *rec, uint8_t wallet_type,
                      uint32_t amount) {
  if (!rec || amount == 0 || amount > 255)
    return false;
  int idx = misc_index(wallet_type);
  if (idx < 0)
    return false;
  uint8_t before = misc_count(rec, idx);
  uint32_t total = (uint32_t)before + amount;
  misc_set(rec, idx, (uint8_t)(total > 255 ? 255 : total));
  return true;
}

bool economy_misc_consume(PlayerRecord *rec, uint8_t wallet_type,
                          uint32_t amount) {
  if (!rec || amount == 0 || amount > 255)
    return false;
  int idx = misc_index(wallet_type);
  if (idx < 0)
    return false;
  uint8_t before = misc_count(rec, idx);
  if (before < amount)
    return false;
  misc_set(rec, idx, (uint8_t)(before - amount));
  return true;
}

uint64_t economy_hash_custom_skin(const char *uid, const uint8_t *content,
                                  size_t content_len) {
  uint64_t hash = UINT64_C(1469598103934665603);
  if (uid) {
    for (const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)uid; *p; p++) {
      hash ^= *p;
      hash *= UINT64_C(1099511628211);
    }
  }
  for (size_t i = 0; content && i < content_len; i++) {
    hash ^= content[i];
    hash *= UINT64_C(1099511628211);
  }
  return hash ? hash : UINT64_C(1);
}
