#    define LZ4_DEPRECATED(message) [[deprecated(message)]]
#  elif defined(_MSC_VER)
#    define LZ4_DEPRECATED(message) __declspec(deprecated(message))
#  elif defined(__clang__) || (defined(__GNUC__) && (__GNUC__ * 10 + __GNUC_MINOR__ >= 45))
#    define LZ4_DEPRECATED(message) __attribute__((deprecated(message)))
#  elif defined(__GNUC__) && (__GNUC__ * 10 + __GNUC_MINOR__ >= 31)
#    define LZ4_DEPRECATED(message) __attribute__((deprecated))
#  else
#    pragma message("WARNING: LZ4_DEPRECATED needs custom implementation for this compiler")
#    define LZ4_DEPRECATED(message)   /* disabled */
#  endif
#endif /* LZ4_DISABLE_DEPRECATE_WARNINGS */

/*! Obsolete LZ4_decompress_fast variants (since v1.9.0) :
 *  These functions used to be faster than LZ4_decompress_safe(),
 *  but this is no longer the case. They are now slower.
 *  This is because LZ4_decompress_fast() doesn't know the input size,
 *  and therefore must progress more cautiously into the input buffer to not read beyond the end of block.
 *  On top of that `LZ4_decompress_fast()` is not protected vs malformed or malicious inputs, making it a security liability.
 *  As a consequence, LZ4_decompress_fast() is strongly discouraged, and deprecated.
 *
 *  The last remaining LZ4_decompress_fast() specificity is that
 *  it can decompress a block without knowing its compressed size.
 *  Such functionality can be achieved in a more secure manner
 *  by employing LZ4_decompress_safe_partial().
 *
 *  Parameters:
 *  originalSize : is the uncompressed size to regenerate.
 *                 `dst` must be already allocated, its size must be >= 'originalSize' bytes.
 * @return : number of bytes read from source buffer (== compressed size).
 *           The function expects to finish at block's end exactly.
 *           If the source stream is detected malformed, the function stops decoding and returns a negative result.
 *  note : LZ4_decompress_fast*() requires originalSize. Thanks to this information, it never writes past the output buffer.
 *         However, since it doesn't know its 'src' size, it may read an unknown amount of input, past input buffer bounds.
 *         Also, since match offsets are not validated, match reads from 'src' may underflow too.
 *         These issues never happen if input (compressed) data is correct.
 *         But they may happen if input data is invalid (error or intentional tampering).
 *         As a consequence, use these functions in trusted environments with trusted data **only**.
 */
LZ4_DEPRECATED("This function is deprecated and unsafe. Consider using LZ4_decompress_safe_partial() instead")
LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_fast (const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize);
LZ4_DEPRECATED("This function is deprecated and unsafe. Consider migrating towards LZ4_decompress_safe_continue() instead. "
               "Note that the contract will change (requires block's compressed size, instead of decompressed size)")

LZ4_DEPRECATED("This function is deprecated and unsafe. Consider using LZ4_decompress_safe_partial_usingDict() instead")
LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_fast_usingDict (const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize, const char* dictStart, int dictSize);

#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include "async_log.h"
#include "net.h"
#include "server.h"
#include "version.h"
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#ifdef _OPENMP
#include <omp.h>
#endif

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#define SLEEP_MS(ms) Sleep(ms)
#else
#include <sched.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/resource.h>

#define SLEEP_MS(ms) usleep((ms) * 1000)

/* Raise file descriptor limit to support thousands of WebSocket connections.
 * Default Linux ulimit is 1024, which caps us at ~600 TLS connections. */
static void raise_fd_limit(void) {
  struct rlimit rl;
  if (getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &rl) == 0) {
    rlim_t target = 65535;
    if (rl.rlim_max < target) target = rl.rlim_max;
    if (rl.rlim_cur < target) {
      rl.rlim_cur = target;
      setrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &rl);
    }
  }
}
#endif

/* ── Global server ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

static GameServer *g_server_ptr = NULL;

/*
 * The signal handler writes only sig_atomic_t. All ordinary cross-thread
 * communication uses C11 atomics.
 */
static volatile sig_atomic_t g_stop_requested = 0;
static atomic_bool g_running = true;
static atomic_uint_fast64_t g_watchdog_heartbeat_ms = 0;
static atomic_int g_watchdog_connected = 0;

/* ── Watchdog thread ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

#define WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_SEC 15
#define WATCHDOG_CHECK_SEC 5

static void *watchdog_thread(void *arg) {
  (void)arg;

  uint64_t last_warning_heartbeat = 0;

  while (!g_stop_requested &&
         atomic_load_explicit(
             &g_running, memory_order_acquire)) {
    SLEEP_MS(WATCHDOG_CHECK_SEC * 1000);

    if (g_stop_requested ||
        !atomic_load_explicit(
            &g_running, memory_order_acquire)) {
      break;
    }

    uint64_t now = server_time_ms();
    uint64_t heartbeat = atomic_load_explicit(
        &g_watchdog_heartbeat_ms,
        memory_order_acquire);
    int connected = atomic_load_explicit(
        &g_watchdog_connected,
        memory_order_relaxed);

    if (connected <= 0 || heartbeat == 0) {
      last_warning_heartbeat = heartbeat;
      continue;
    }

    uint64_t stalled_ms =
        now >= heartbeat ? now - heartbeat : 0;

    if (stalled_ms >=
        (uint64_t)WATCHDOG_CHECK_SEC * 1000ULL) {
      if (last_warning_heartbeat != heartbeat) {
        async_log(
            "[Watchdog] WARNING: simulation heartbeat stalled "
            "for %llums (connected=%d)\n",
            (unsigned long long)stalled_ms,
            connected);
        last_warning_heartbeat = heartbeat;
      }
    } else {
      last_warning_heartbeat = heartbeat;
    }

    if (stalled_ms >=
        (uint64_t)WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_SEC * 1000ULL) {
      async_log(
          "[Watchdog] FATAL: simulation frozen for %llums; "
          "forcing systemd restart\n",
          (unsigned long long)stalled_ms);
      _exit(1);
    }
  }

  return NULL;
}

/* ── Async-signal-safe stop request ──────────────────────────── */

static void on_signal(int sig) {
  (void)sig;

  /*
   * Do not lock, allocate, format or log in a signal handler.
   * The main loop observes this flag and performs orderly shutdown.
   */
  g_stop_requested = 1;
}

/* ── CLI argument parsing ────────────────────────────────────── */

static int g_bot_count = 3840;

static void parse_args(int argc, char **argv, ServerConfig *cfg) {
  for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
    if (strcmp(argv[i], "--tls") == 0) {
      cfg->tls_enabled = true;
    } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "--cert") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
      strncpy(cfg->tls_cert_path, argv[++i], sizeof(cfg->tls_cert_path) - 1);
    } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "--key") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
      strncpy(cfg->tls_key_path, argv[++i], sizeof(cfg->tls_key_path) - 1);
    } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "--port") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
      int port = atoi(argv[++i]);
      if (port > 0 && port < 65536)
        cfg->server_port = (uint16_t)port;
    } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "--bots") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
      g_bot_count = atoi(argv[++i]);
    } else {
      /* Legacy: bare number = port */
      int port = atoi(argv[i]);
      if (port > 0 && port < 65536)
        cfg->server_port = (uint16_t)port;
    }
  }
}

/* ── Main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
  setvbuf(stdout, NULL, _IONBF, 0);
#ifndef _WIN32
  raise_fd_limit();
#endif
  async_log_init();
#ifdef _OPENMP
  omp_set_num_threads(3);
  async_log("[Main] OpenMP multi-threading enabled: max 3 CPU cores\n");
#endif

  async_log("=============================================\n");
  async_log("  %s\n", SERVER_VERSION_STRING);
#ifdef GIT_HASH
  async_log("  Build: %.12s\n", GIT_HASH);
#endif
  async_log("  The Highest Performance Agar.io Server\n");
  async_log("  Based on MultiOgarII by Barbosik\n");
  async_log("  By jimboy3100 / Expanding Land\n");
  async_log("  www.expanding.land\n");
  async_log("=============================================\n");
#ifdef NDEBUG
  async_log("  Build: RELEASE (NDEBUG, INFO_LOG stripped)\n");
#else
  async_log("  Build: DEBUG (INFO_LOG active)\n");
#endif
  async_log("[Limits] Capacity=%d Active=%d Spectators=%d Connections=%d\n",
            SERVER_CAPACITY, MAX_ACTIVE_PLAYERS, MAX_SPECTATORS,
            MAX_CONNECTIONS);
#ifndef _WIN32
  {
    struct rlimit rl;
    if (getrlimit(RLIMIT_NOFILE, &rl) == 0)
      async_log("[Limits] File descriptors: soft=%lu hard=%lu\n",
                (unsigned long)rl.rlim_cur, (unsigned long)rl.rlim_max);
  }
#endif
  async_log("\n");

  g_server_ptr = (GameServer *)calloc(1, sizeof(GameServer));
  if (!g_server_ptr) {
    printf("[Main] ERROR: Failed to allocate GameServer memory\n");
    async_log_shutdown();
    return 1;
  }
  printf("[Main] Allocated GameServer heap memory (%zu MB)\n", sizeof(GameServer) / (1024*1024));

  /* Init server */
  server_init(g_server_ptr);
  printf("[Main] server_init complete\n");

  /* Parse CLI arguments */
  parse_args(argc, argv, &g_server_ptr->config);
  printf("[Main] parse_args complete (port=%d, bots=%d)\n", g_server_ptr->config.server_port, g_bot_count);

  /* Read admin password from environment (fail-closed: empty = disabled) */
  {
    const char *admin_pw = getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD");
    if (admin_pw && admin_pw[0]) {
      strncpy(g_server_ptr->config.admin_password, admin_pw,
              sizeof(g_server_ptr->config.admin_password) - 1);
      g_server_ptr->config.admin_password[sizeof(g_server_ptr->config.admin_password) - 1] = '\0';
      async_log("[Main] ADMIN_PASSWORD set (%d chars) — admin commands enabled\n",
                (int)strlen(g_server_ptr->config.admin_password));
    } else {
      g_server_ptr->config.admin_password[0] = '\0';
      async_log("[Main] WARNING: ADMIN_PASSWORD not set — admin commands DISABLED\n");
    }
  }

  /* Determine TLS cert/key paths */
  const char *cert_path = NULL;
  const char *key_path = NULL;
  if (g_server_ptr->config.tls_enabled) {
    if (g_server_ptr->config.tls_cert_path[0] == '\0' ||
        g_server_ptr->config.tls_key_path[0] == '\0') {
      printf("[Main] ERROR: --tls requires --cert and --key\n");
      server_shutdown(g_server_ptr);
      free(g_server_ptr);
      g_server_ptr = NULL;
      async_log_shutdown();
      return 1;
    }
    cert_path = g_server_ptr->config.tls_cert_path;
    key_path = g_server_ptr->config.tls_key_path;
    printf("[Main] TLS mode enabled\n");
  }

  /* Init networking */
  if (net_init(g_server_ptr, g_server_ptr->config.server_port, cert_path, key_path) <
      0) {
    printf("[Main] Failed to init networking\n");
    server_shutdown(g_server_ptr);
    free(g_server_ptr);
    g_server_ptr = NULL;
    async_log_shutdown();
    return 1;
  }
  printf("[Main] net_init complete\n");

  /* Setup signal handlers */
  signal(SIGINT, on_signal);
  signal(SIGTERM, on_signal);

  /* Spawn initial food and viruses */
  server_spawn_food(g_server_ptr);
  server_spawn_viruses(g_server_ptr);

  /* Init embedded C bots if requested */
  if (g_bot_count > 0) {
    bots_init(&g_server_ptr->bot_mgr, g_server_ptr, g_bot_count);
  }

  /*
   * Build the initial completed-world BotGrid snapshot.
   *
   * From this point onward:
   * - bot AI reads the grid completed by the previous simulation tick;
   * - server_tick() rebuilds the grid exactly once after current-tick
   *   movement, spawning, splitting and ejection;
   * - collision and visibility queries use that current-tick rebuild.
   *
   * This removes the former pre-movement BotGrid rebuild from bot_pool_tick().
   */
  bot_grid_rebuild(&g_server_ptr->bot_grid, g_server_ptr);

  /*
   * Outbound traffic is handled by nonblocking socket readiness in net_run().
   * No fork-join write workers are created and the simulation never waits for
   * a slow client.
   */
  async_log(
      "[Main] Event-driven outbound I/O enabled\n");

#ifdef __linux__
  /* NOTE: Do NOT pin the main thread to core 0 with sched_setaffinity().
   * sched_setaffinity(0, ...) applies to ALL threads in the process,
   * including OpenMP workers, forcing them all onto core 0 and limiting
   * total CPU to 100%. The Linux scheduler's cache-affinity heuristics
   * handle core placement well enough without manual pinning. */
#endif

  /* Start watchdog thread on 2nd core */
  {
    pthread_t wd_thread;
    atomic_store_explicit(
        &g_watchdog_heartbeat_ms,
        server_time_ms(),
        memory_order_release);
    atomic_store_explicit(
        &g_watchdog_connected,
        0,
        memory_order_relaxed);

    if (pthread_create(
            &wd_thread,
            NULL,
            watchdog_thread,
            NULL) == 0) {
      pthread_detach(wd_thread);
      async_log("[Main] Watchdog thread started (timeout=%ds)\n",
                WATCHDOG_TIMEOUT_SEC);
    } else {
      async_log("[Main] WARNING: Failed to create watchdog thread\n");
    }
  }

  async_log("[Main] Game loop started (25 Hz)\n");
  async_log("[Main] Connect: %s://localhost:%d\n\n",
            g_server_ptr->config.tls_enabled ? "wss" : "ws",
            g_server_ptr->config.server_port);

  /* ── Fixed-deadline 25 Hz main loop ─────────────────────────── */

  const uint64_t tick_interval_ms = 40;
  const uint64_t max_lag_ms = tick_interval_ms * 5;

  uint64_t next_tick_ms = server_time_ms();
  uint64_t stats_start_ms = next_tick_ms;
  uint32_t fps_counter = 0;

  double tick_us_sum = 0.0;
  double tick_us_max = 0.0;
  double tick_us_min = 1e30;

  while (!g_stop_requested &&
         atomic_load_explicit(
             &g_running, memory_order_acquire)) {
    uint64_t now_ms = server_time_ms();

    if (now_ms >= next_tick_ms) {
      /*
       * Drain all available input before simulation. This remains nonblocking
       * and therefore cannot shift the fixed tick deadline.
       */
      net_run(g_server_ptr, 0);

      uint64_t tick_start_us = server_time_us();
      server_tick(g_server_ptr);
      uint64_t tick_end_us = server_time_us();

      /*
       * Post-tick I/O pass (nonblocking):
       * 1. Reads mouse packets that arrived during server_tick() computation,
       *    so they're ready for the very next tick (saves up to 40ms latency).
       * 2. Eagerly drains viewport update packets queued by send_player_updates,
       *    pushing them to the kernel TCP stack immediately instead of waiting
       *    for the sleep-phase epoll_wait.
       */
      net_run(g_server_ptr, 0);

      double tick_us =
          (double)(tick_end_us - tick_start_us);

      tick_us_sum += tick_us;
      if (tick_us > tick_us_max)
        tick_us_max = tick_us;
      if (tick_us < tick_us_min)
        tick_us_min = tick_us;

      fps_counter++;

      atomic_store_explicit(
          &g_watchdog_heartbeat_ms,
          server_time_ms(),
          memory_order_release);
      atomic_store_explicit(
          &g_watchdog_connected,
          g_server_ptr->connected_count,
          memory_order_relaxed);

      /*
       * Advance from the previous deadline, not from tick start. This prevents
       * ordinary execution time from accumulating as scheduler drift.
       */
      next_tick_ms += tick_interval_ms;

      uint64_t after_tick_ms = server_time_ms();

      /*
       * If the process is severely behind, discard excessive catch-up debt.
       * All arithmetic is ordered and unsigned underflow is impossible.
       */
      if (after_tick_ms > next_tick_ms &&
          after_tick_ms - next_tick_ms > max_lag_ms) {
        next_tick_ms = after_tick_ms + tick_interval_ms;
      }
    }

    uint64_t stats_now_ms = server_time_ms();

    if (stats_now_ms - stats_start_ms >= 5000) {
#if LOG_LEVEL >= 2
      double avg_ms =
          fps_counter > 0
              ? (tick_us_sum / (double)fps_counter) / 1000.0
              : 0.0;

      double min_ms =
          fps_counter > 0 ? tick_us_min / 1000.0 : 0.0;

      double max_ms = tick_us_max / 1000.0;

      double elapsed_secs =
          (double)(stats_now_ms - stats_start_ms) / 1000.0;

      double tps =
          elapsed_secs > 0.0
              ? (double)fps_counter / elapsed_secs
              : 0.0;

      async_log(
          "[Perf] Tick: avg=%.2fms min=%.2fms max=%.2fms | "
          "Connected: %d Alive: %d | Cells: %d | Food: %d | "
          "TPS: %.1f\n",
          avg_ms,
          min_ms,
          max_ms,
          g_server_ptr->connected_count,
          server_alive_count(g_server_ptr),
          g_server_ptr->cell_count,
          g_server_ptr->food_count,
          tps);
#endif

      /* Always update prof.txt every 5s with CPU % breakdown */
      server_print_profile();

      fps_counter = 0;
      stats_start_ms = stats_now_ms;
      tick_us_sum = 0.0;
      tick_us_max = 0.0;
      tick_us_min = 1e30;
    }

    uint64_t sleep_now_ms = server_time_ms();
    int wait_ms = 0;

    if (next_tick_ms > sleep_now_ms) {
      uint64_t remaining = next_tick_ms - sleep_now_ms;
      if (remaining > tick_interval_ms)
        remaining = tick_interval_ms;
      wait_ms = (int)remaining;
    }

    net_run(g_server_ptr, wait_ms);
  }

  atomic_store_explicit(
      &g_running, false, memory_order_release);
  net_stop();

  /* Shutdown — broadcast message to all players first */
  async_log("[Main] Stopping...\n");
  server_send_chat(g_server_ptr, NULL, NULL, "Server updating...");
  net_flush_all(); /* make sure the message reaches clients */
  net_shutdown();
  bots_shutdown(&g_server_ptr->bot_mgr, g_server_ptr);
  server_shutdown(g_server_ptr);
  free(g_server_ptr);
  g_server_ptr = NULL;

  async_log("[Main] Done.\n");
  async_log_shutdown();
  return 0;
}

/* Expanding Land — Dynamic Map Scaler Implementation
 * See config.h and mapscaler.h for specification. */

#include "mapscaler.h"
#include "async_log.h"
#include "entity_budget.h"
#include "net.h"
#include "packet.h"
#include "server.h"

#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

/* ── Tier definitions (now read from config, see config.c) ──── */

/* Legacy accessor — returns pointer to the tiers inside the MapScaler.
 * Caller must have a pointer to the active MapScaler instance. */
const MapTierDef *mapscaler_get_tiers_from(const MapScaler *ms) {
  return ms->tiers;
}

/* ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

MapTier mapscaler_tier_for_size(const MapScaler *ms, double size) {
  /* Find the closest tier for a given size */
  for (int i = MAP_TIER_COUNT - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (size >= ms->tiers[i].map_size - 1.0) /* small epsilon */
      return (MapTier)i;
  }
  return MAP_7071;
}

MapTier mapscaler_find_tier_for_players(const MapScaler *ms, int players) {
  for (int t = MAP_TIER_COUNT - 1; t >= 0; t--) {
    if (players >= ms->tiers[t].expand_threshold)
      return (MapTier)t;
  }
  return MAP_7071;
}

void set_border_from_size(GameServer *srv, double size) {
  double half = size / 2.0;
  srv->border.minx = -half;
  srv->border.miny = -half;
  srv->border.maxx = half;
  srv->border.maxy = half;
  srv->border.width = size;
  srv->border.height = size;
}

/* Count active playing players (with cells alive AND connected).
 * Excludes: removed players, frozen disconnected players, conn_id < 0.
 * Critical: frozen cells from disconnected bots must NOT inflate the
 * count, or the map will expand/stay expanded after bots leave. */
static int count_active_players(const GameServer *srv) {
  int count = 0;
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
    const Player *p = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
    if (!p->is_removed && !p->frozen && p->cell_count > 0 &&
        (p->is_bot || p->conn_id >= 0))
      count++;
  }
  return count;
}

/* Find the lowest tier that fits the current player count.
 * Used for shrink to jump directly to the right tier instead of crawling. */
static MapTier find_target_tier(const MapScaler *ms, int players) {
  for (int t = ms->current_tier; t > MAP_7071; t--) {
    if (players >= ms->tiers[t].shrink_threshold)
      return (MapTier)t;
  }
  return MAP_7071;
}

/* Broadcast map event opcode 200 to all connected players */
static void broadcast_map_event(GameServer *srv, MapEventType event_type,
                                double current_size, double target_size,
                                int transition_ticks, int warning_ticks) {
  BinaryWriter w;
  bw_init(&w);
  /* Derive tier from actual current_size, not current_tier (can be stale
   * during interpolation — border is mid-way but tier hasn't updated yet) */
  uint8_t tier = (uint8_t)mapscaler_tier_for_size(&srv->map_scaler, current_size);
  pkt_map_event(&w, (uint8_t)event_type, current_size, target_size, 0.0, 0.0,
                (uint32_t)transition_ticks, (uint32_t)warning_ticks, tier);

  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->connected_count; ap++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[ap]];
    if (p->conn_id >= 0) {
      net_queue_to_player(p->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
    }
  }
  bw_free(&w);
}

static int desired_food_for_size(
    const MapScaler *ms,
    double map_size) {
  double area =
      map_size * map_size;

  double ratio =
      area / ms->base_map_area;

  int value =
      (int)(
          ms->base_food_amount *
              ratio +
          0.5);

  if (value < 10)
    value = 10;

  return value;
}


static int desired_food_spawn_for_size(
    const MapScaler *ms,
    double map_size) {
  double area =
      map_size * map_size;

  double ratio =
      area / ms->base_map_area;

  int value =
      (int)(
          ms->base_food_spawn_amount *
              ratio +
          0.5);

  if (value < 1)
    value = 1;

  return value;
}


static int desired_viruses_for_size(
    const MapScaler *ms,
    double map_size) {
  double area = map_size * map_size;
  double ratio = area / ms->base_map_area;
  int value = (int)(ms->base_virus_amount * ratio + 0.5);
  if (value < 2)
    value = 2;
  return value;
}


/*
 * Because expansion uses a strict "players > threshold" test, tier N must
 * safely support up to the expansion threshold of tier N+1.
 */
static int tier_player_ceiling(
    const MapScaler *ms,
    MapTier tier) {
  int ceiling;

  if (tier <
      MAP_TIER_COUNT - 1) {
    ceiling =
        ms->tiers[tier + 1]
            .expand_threshold;
  } else {
    ceiling =
        MAX_ACTIVE_PLAYERS;
  }

  if (ceiling < 1)
    ceiling = 1;

  if (ceiling >
      MAX_ACTIVE_PLAYERS) {
    ceiling =
        MAX_ACTIVE_PLAYERS;
  }

  return ceiling;
}


/*
 * Reduce excess food in a bounded batch.
 *
 * Normal target reductions remove at most ENTITY_FOOD_CULL_BATCH per tick.
 * If the live world has already consumed the emergency reserve, enough food
 * is removed immediately to restore that reserve for the following tick.
 */
static void cull_food_toward_target(
    GameServer *srv,
    int target) {
  int excess =
      srv->food_count - target;

  if (excess <= 0)
    return;

  int live_cells =
      srv->food_count +
      srv->dynamic_count;

  int physical_free =
      MAX_CELLS - live_cells;

  int emergency_removal =
      ENTITY_CELL_SAFETY_RESERVE -
      physical_free;

  if (emergency_removal < 0)
    emergency_removal = 0;

  int removal_limit =
      ENTITY_FOOD_CULL_BATCH;

  if (emergency_removal >
      removal_limit) {
    removal_limit =
        emergency_removal;
  }

  if (removal_limit > excess)
    removal_limit = excess;

  int removed = 0;
  int attempts = 0;
  int max_attempts = removal_limit * 3; /* prevent infinite loop on sparse arrays */

  while (removed < removal_limit &&
         srv->food_count > target &&
         attempts < max_attempts) {
    attempts++;
    int index =
        rand() % srv->food_count;

    Cell *food =
        srv->food_nodes[index];

    if (!food ||
        food->is_removed) {
      continue;
    }

    server_remove_cell(
        srv,
        food);
    removed++;
  }
}


static EntityBudget apply_entity_targets(
    MapScaler *ms,
    GameServer *srv,
    int desired_food,
    int desired_spawn,
    int desired_viruses,
    MapTier capacity_tier,
    bool allow_food_spawn) {
  int active_players =
      count_active_players(srv);

  int player_ceiling =
      tier_player_ceiling(
          ms,
          capacity_tier);

  EntityBudget budget =
      entity_budget_compute(
          desired_food,
          desired_spawn,
          desired_viruses,
          player_ceiling,
          active_players,
          srv->dynamic_count);

  srv->config.food_amount =
      budget.food_target;

  srv->config.food_spawn_amount =
      allow_food_spawn
          ? budget.food_spawn_target
          : 0;

  srv->config.virus_amount =
      budget.virus_target;

  cull_food_toward_target(
      srv,
      budget.food_target);

  return budget;
}


static void scale_entity_counts(
    MapScaler *ms,
    GameServer *srv,
    MapTier tier,
    bool allow_food_spawn) {
  double map_size =
      ms->tiers[tier].map_size;

  apply_entity_targets(
      ms,
      srv,
      desired_food_for_size(
          ms,
          map_size),
      desired_food_spawn_for_size(
          ms,
          map_size),
      desired_viruses_for_size(
          ms,
          map_size),
      tier,
      allow_food_spawn);
}


/*
 * Area-proportional targets during border interpolation, followed by the same
 * capacity governor used for stable tiers.
 */
static void scale_entity_counts_by_size(
    MapScaler *ms,
    GameServer *srv,
    double map_size,
    MapTier capacity_tier,
    bool allow_food_spawn) {
  apply_entity_targets(
      ms,
      srv,
      desired_food_for_size(
          ms,
          map_size),
      desired_food_spawn_for_size(
          ms,
          map_size),
      desired_viruses_for_size(
          ms,
          map_size),
      capacity_tier,
      allow_food_spawn);
}

/* Remove excess viruses when the target count decreased (map shrank).
 * Without this, old viruses survive inside the new border and the
 * smaller area appears overcrowded with viruses. */
static void cull_excess_viruses(GameServer *srv) {
  int excess = srv->virus_count - srv->config.virus_amount;
  for (int i = srv->virus_count - 1; i >= 0 && excess > 0; i--) {
    Cell *v = srv->virus_nodes[i];
    if (!v->is_removed) {
      server_remove_cell(srv, v);
      excess--;
    }
  }
}

static inline double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  return v < lo ? lo : (v > hi ? hi : v);
}

/* Remove food, viruses, ejected mass outside the current border */
static void cleanup_outside_border(GameServer *srv) {
  double minx = srv->border.minx;
  double miny = srv->border.miny;
  double maxx = srv->border.maxx;
  double maxy = srv->border.maxy;

  /* DELETE food outside current border */
  for (int i = srv->food_count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    Cell *c = srv->food_nodes[i];
    if (c->is_removed) continue;
    if (c->position.x < minx || c->position.x > maxx ||
        c->position.y < miny || c->position.y > maxy) {
      server_remove_cell(srv, c);
    }
  }

  /* DELETE viruses outside current border */
  for (int i = srv->virus_count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    Cell *c = srv->virus_nodes[i];
    if (c->is_removed) continue;
    if (c->position.x < minx || c->position.x > maxx ||
        c->position.y < miny || c->position.y > maxy) {
      server_remove_cell(srv, c);
    }
  }

  /* Clean ejected mass and mother cells outside border */
  for (int i = srv->dynamic_count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    Cell *c = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
    if (c->is_removed)
      continue;
    if (c->type == CELL_EJECTED || c->type == CELL_MOTHER) {
      if (c->position.x < minx || c->position.x > maxx ||
          c->position.y < miny || c->position.y > maxy) {
        server_remove_cell(srv, c);
      }
    } else if (c->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
      /* CLAMP player cells to border — do NOT remove them.
       * Old code deleted player cells here, which killed the player
       * when the map shrank. Now cells slide inward to stay in bounds. */
      double r = c->radius / 2.0;
      if (c->position.x < minx + r) c->position.x = minx + r;
      if (c->position.x > maxx - r) c->position.x = maxx - r;
      if (c->position.y < miny + r) c->position.y = miny + r;
      if (c->position.y > maxy - r) c->position.y = maxy - r;
    }
  }

  /* Clamp player camera centers, mouse, and mouse_target to prevent
   * "black map" effect and stop cells from rushing toward old coordinates
   * outside the shrunken border. */
  for (int i = 0; i < srv->connected_count; i++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[i]];
    if (p->center.x < minx) p->center.x = minx;
    if (p->center.x > maxx) p->center.x = maxx;
    if (p->center.y < miny) p->center.y = miny;
    if (p->center.y > maxy) p->center.y = maxy;
    if (p->mouse.x < minx) p->mouse.x = minx;
    if (p->mouse.x > maxx) p->mouse.x = maxx;
    if (p->mouse.y < miny) p->mouse.y = miny;
    if (p->mouse.y > maxy) p->mouse.y = maxy;
    if (p->mouse_target.x < minx) p->mouse_target.x = minx;
    if (p->mouse_target.x > maxx) p->mouse_target.x = maxx;
    if (p->mouse_target.y < miny) p->mouse_target.y = miny;
    if (p->mouse_target.y > maxy) p->mouse_target.y = maxy;
  }
}

/* Apply anti-team penalty to players with ANY cell in the danger zone.
 * Called every 5th tick (0.2s) during PHASE_DANGER.
 * Rate: +0.0008 per call = +0.004/sec = 0.4%/sec.
 * 4 seconds in danger = 0.016 = 1.6%/4s = same as one virus pop.
 * Flat per player (not per cell) — independent of split count.
 * Penalty is accumulated into anti_danger_accum and batched into a
 * discrete ANTI_DANGER event each decay cycle (see server_decay_cells). */
static void apply_danger_zone_penalty(MapScaler *ms, GameServer *srv) {
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
    bool in_zone = false;
    for (int c = 0; c < p->cell_count; c++) {
      Cell *cell = p->cells[c];
      if (!cell->is_removed &&
          mapscaler_is_in_outer_zone(ms, cell->position.x, cell->position.y)) {
        in_zone = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (in_zone)
      p->anti_danger_accum += 0.0008;  /* 0.4%/sec (called 5×/sec) */
  }
}


static void rebalance_entities_step(GameServer *srv) {
  MapScaler *ms = &srv->map_scaler;
  ms->rebalance_food_left = 0;

  int virus_step = ms->rebalance_virus_left > 0 ? 4 : 0;
  while (virus_step-- > 0 && ms->rebalance_virus_left > 0) {
    if (srv->virus_count == 0) break;
    int i = rand() % srv->virus_count;
    Cell *v = srv->virus_nodes[i];
    if (!v || v->is_removed) {
        ms->rebalance_virus_left--;
        continue;
    }
    v->position = server_random_pos_in_expand_ring_padded(srv, v->radius * 0.5);
    server_mark_cell_dirty(v, srv->ticks);
    ms->rebalance_virus_left--;
  }
}

/* ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void mapscaler_init(MapScaler *ms, ServerConfig *cfg) {
  memset(ms, 0, sizeof(*ms));
  ms->enabled = cfg->lw_enabled != 0;

  /* Copy tier definitions from config */
  for (int i = 0; i < MAP_TIER_COUNT; i++) {
    ms->tiers[i].map_size = cfg->lw_tier_size[i];
    ms->tiers[i].expand_threshold = cfg->lw_tier_expand[i];
    ms->tiers[i].shrink_threshold = cfg->lw_tier_shrink[i];
  }

  /* Start at tier 0 (smallest) — expands as players join.
   * Old code started at tier 1 but shrink_threshold[1]=0 meant
   * the map could never shrink back to tier 0 with 0 players. */
  ms->current_tier = MAP_7071;
  ms->target_tier = MAP_7071;
  ms->current_size = ms->tiers[MAP_7071].map_size;
  ms->target_size = ms->current_size;
  ms->pre_change_size = ms->current_size;
  ms->phase = PHASE_NORMAL;

  ms->warning_duration =
      cfg->lw_warning_duration > 0 ? (cfg->lw_warning_duration * 25 / 1000) : 75; /* 3.0s = 75 ticks at 25Hz */
  ms->danger_duration =
      cfg->lw_danger_duration > 0 ? (cfg->lw_danger_duration * 25 / 1000) : 75;  /* 3.0s = 75 ticks at 25Hz */
  ms->transition_duration =
      cfg->lw_transition_duration > 0 ? (cfg->lw_transition_duration * 25 / 1000) : 150; /* 6.0s = 150 ticks at 25Hz */

  /* The config food_amount / virus_amount are for the config border_width.
   * Scale them DOWN to what the base tier (tier 1) should have, so that
   * scale_entity_counts() can scale UP proportionally from there. */
  double config_area = (double)cfg->border_width * cfg->border_width;
  double base_area =
      ms->tiers[MAP_10000].map_size * ms->tiers[MAP_10000].map_size;
  double ratio = base_area / config_area;
  if (ratio > 1.0)
    ratio = 1.0; /* if config is smaller than base tier */

  ms->base_food_amount = (int)(cfg->food_amount * ratio);
  ms->base_virus_amount = (int)(cfg->virus_amount * ratio);
  ms->base_food_spawn_amount = (int)(cfg->food_spawn_amount * ratio);
  if (ms->base_food_amount < 10)
    ms->base_food_amount = 10;
  if (ms->base_virus_amount < 2)
    ms->base_virus_amount = 2;
  if (ms->base_food_spawn_amount < 1)
    ms->base_food_spawn_amount = 1;
  ms->base_map_area = base_area;
  ms->event_sent = false;

  /* Set initial food/virus counts for the starting tier.
   * Without this, the config defaults (for 14142 map) are used
   * which is 4x too much food for the 7071 starting map. */
  {
    double initial_size =
        ms->tiers[ms->current_tier].map_size;

    EntityBudget initial_budget =
        entity_budget_compute(
            desired_food_for_size(
                ms,
                initial_size),
            desired_food_spawn_for_size(
                ms,
                initial_size),
            desired_viruses_for_size(
                ms,
                initial_size),
            tier_player_ceiling(
                ms,
                ms->current_tier),
            0,
            0);

    cfg->food_amount =
        initial_budget.food_target;

    cfg->food_spawn_amount =
        initial_budget.food_spawn_target;

    cfg->virus_amount =
        initial_budget.virus_target;
  }

  async_log(
      "[MapScaler] Init: tier=%d (%.0f), food=%d, virus=%d, base_food=%d, base_virus=%d\n",
      ms->current_tier, ms->current_size,
      cfg->food_amount, cfg->virus_amount,
      ms->base_food_amount, ms->base_virus_amount);
}

bool mapscaler_tick(MapScaler *ms, GameServer *srv) {
  if (!ms->enabled)
    return false;

  int players = count_active_players(srv);
  bool border_changed = false;

  /*
   * Refresh stable-phase capacity every tick. Actual ejected, potion and
   * disconnected-cell occupancy may change without a tier transition.
   */
  if (ms->phase == PHASE_NORMAL ||
      ms->phase == PHASE_WARNING ||
      ms->phase == PHASE_DANGER) {
    scale_entity_counts(
        ms,
        srv,
        ms->current_tier,
        true);
  }

  switch (ms->phase) {

  case PHASE_NORMAL: {
    if (!ms->manual_override) {
      /* Check for expansion */
      MapTier target_t = mapscaler_find_tier_for_players(ms, players);
      if (target_t > ms->current_tier) {
        ms->target_tier = target_t;
        ms->target_size = ms->tiers[target_t].map_size;
        ms->pre_change_size = ms->current_size;
        ms->phase = PHASE_EXPANDING;
        ms->transition_start_tick = srv->ticks;
        ms->event_sent = false;
        ms->rebalance_food_left = srv->food_count / 4;
        ms->rebalance_virus_left = srv->virus_count / 4;

        ms->ring_food_target = 0;
        ms->ring_virus_target = 0;
        ms->ring_food_spawned = 0;
        ms->ring_virus_spawned = 0;

        async_log("[MapScaler] EXPAND: %d players -> tier %d (%.0f)\n", players,
                  (int)target_t, ms->target_size);
        broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_EXPANSION_START, ms->current_size,
                            ms->target_size, ms->transition_duration, 0);
      }

      /* Check for contraction (only if not expanding) */
      if (ms->phase == PHASE_NORMAL && ms->current_tier > MAP_7071) {
        if (players < ms->tiers[ms->current_tier].shrink_threshold) {
          /* Jump directly to the correct tier instead of one step at a time */
          ms->target_tier = find_target_tier(ms, players);
          ms->target_size = ms->tiers[ms->target_tier].map_size;
          ms->pre_change_size = ms->current_size;
          ms->phase = PHASE_WARNING;
          ms->phase_start_tick = srv->ticks;
          ms->event_sent = false;

          async_log("[MapScaler] WARNING: %d players -> tier %d (%.0f)\n",
                    players, ms->target_tier, ms->target_size);
          broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_CONTRACTION_WARNING,
                              ms->current_size, ms->target_size, 0,
                              ms->warning_duration);
        }
      }
    }
    break;
  }

  case PHASE_EXPANDING: {
    rebalance_entities_step(srv);

    /* Interpolate border outward */
    uint32_t elapsed = srv->ticks - ms->transition_start_tick;
    double t = (double)elapsed / (double)ms->transition_duration;

    if (t >= 1.0) {
      t = 1.0;
      ms->current_size = ms->target_size;
      ms->current_tier = ms->target_tier;
      ms->pre_change_size = ms->current_size;
      ms->phase = PHASE_NORMAL;
      ms->event_sent = false;

      scale_entity_counts(ms, srv, ms->current_tier, true);
      async_log("[MapScaler] EXPAND COMPLETE: tier %d (%.0f)\n",
                ms->current_tier, ms->current_size);
      broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_RESIZE_COMPLETE, ms->current_size,
                          ms->current_size, 0, 0);
    } else {
      ms->current_size =
          ms->pre_change_size + t * (ms->target_size - ms->pre_change_size);
    }
    /* Update food/virus targets proportionally to the current interpolated
     * border area EVERY tick. The normal spawner fills the gap uniformly. */
    scale_entity_counts_by_size(
        ms,
        srv,
        ms->current_size,
        ms->target_tier,
        true);
    set_border_from_size(srv, ms->current_size);
    /*
     * FoodGrid uses permanent maximum-tier world coordinates, therefore its
     * bucket mapping remains exact throughout the expansion animation.
     */
    border_changed = true;
    break;
  }

  case PHASE_WARNING: {
    uint32_t elapsed = srv->ticks - ms->phase_start_tick;

    /* If players come back above the expansion threshold, cancel contraction */
    if (players > ms->tiers[ms->current_tier].expand_threshold ||
        players >= ms->tiers[ms->current_tier].shrink_threshold + 10) {
      /* Cancel: return to normal */
      ms->phase = PHASE_NORMAL;
      ms->target_tier = ms->current_tier;
      ms->target_size = ms->current_size;
      ms->event_sent = false;
      async_log("[MapScaler] WARNING CANCELLED: %d players returned\n",
                players);
      broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_RESIZE_COMPLETE, ms->current_size,
                          ms->current_size, 0, 0);
      break;
    }

    if ((int)elapsed >= ms->warning_duration) {
      /* Transition to danger phase & spawn 6 Experimental Mother Cells in danger zone */
      ms->phase = PHASE_DANGER;
      ms->phase_start_tick = srv->ticks;
      ms->event_sent = false;

      int base_count = MOTHER_BASE_COUNT;
      double scale_ratio = ms->current_size / 10000.0;
      int mother_count = (int)(base_count * scale_ratio);
      if (mother_count < MOTHER_BASE_COUNT) mother_count = MOTHER_BASE_COUNT;

      /* Place mothers on the perimeter of the midpoint square between
       * the target and current borders.  This guarantees every mother
       * is in the danger zone (outside the future border).
       *
       * The midpoint square has half-size = (inner_half + outer_half) / 2.
       * Mothers are distributed evenly along the 4 edges. */
      double inner_half = ms->target_size / 2.0;
      double outer_half = ms->current_size / 2.0;
      double mid_half = (inner_half + outer_half) / 2.0;

      /* Total perimeter = 4 * 2 * mid_half = 8 * mid_half.
       * Distribute mother_count mothers evenly along it. */
      double perimeter = 8.0 * mid_half;
      double spacing = perimeter / (double)mother_count;

      for (int i = 0; i < mother_count; i++) {
        /* Walk along the perimeter: 0..perimeter */
        double dist = spacing * (double)i + spacing * 0.5; /* offset by half-spacing for centering */
        double edge_len = 2.0 * mid_half;
        Vec2 pos;

        if (dist < edge_len) {
          /* Top edge: y = -mid_half, x goes from -mid_half to +mid_half */
          pos.x = -mid_half + dist;
          pos.y = -mid_half;
        } else if (dist < 2.0 * edge_len) {
          /* Right edge: x = +mid_half, y goes from -mid_half to +mid_half */
          double d = dist - edge_len;
          pos.x = mid_half;
          pos.y = -mid_half + d;
        } else if (dist < 3.0 * edge_len) {
          /* Bottom edge: y = +mid_half, x goes from +mid_half to -mid_half */
          double d = dist - 2.0 * edge_len;
          pos.x = mid_half - d;
          pos.y = mid_half;
        } else {
          /* Left edge: x = -mid_half, y goes from +mid_half to -mid_half */
          double d = dist - 3.0 * edge_len;
          pos.x = -mid_half;
          pos.y = mid_half - d;
        }

        Cell *m = server_alloc_cell(srv);
        if (!m) break;

        cell_init(m, m->id, CELL_MOTHER, pos, MOTHER_SPAWN_RADIUS);
        m->color = (Color){0xce, 0x63, 0x63}; /* MultiOgarII canonical red/magenta color */
        m->is_virus = true;
        m->created_tick = srv->ticks;

        if (!server_add_cell(srv, m)) {
          server_release_untracked_cell(srv, m);
        }
      }

      async_log("[MapScaler] DANGER: starting danger phase with %d Experimental Mother Cells\n", mother_count);
      broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_CONTRACTION_DANGER, ms->current_size,
                          ms->target_size, 0, ms->danger_duration);
    }
    break;
  }

  case PHASE_DANGER: {
    uint32_t elapsed = srv->ticks - ms->phase_start_tick;

    /* Apply anti-team penalty to cells in the danger zone (every 5 ticks) */
    if ((srv->ticks % 5) == 0)
      apply_danger_zone_penalty(ms, srv);

    if ((int)elapsed >= ms->danger_duration) {
      /* Transition to shrinking */
      ms->phase = PHASE_SHRINKING;
      ms->transition_start_tick = srv->ticks;
      ms->pre_change_size = ms->current_size;
      ms->event_sent = false;

      /* Compute per-tick cleanup batch so the entire food/virus population
       * outside the border is swept by the time the animation completes.
       * transition_duration ticks — spread food_count and virus_count evenly. */
      int dur = ms->transition_duration > 0 ? ms->transition_duration : 1;
      ms->food_cleanup_batch  = (srv->food_count  / dur) + 1;
      ms->virus_cleanup_batch = (srv->virus_count / dur) + 1;
      ms->food_cleanup_cursor  = 0;
      ms->virus_cleanup_cursor = 0;

      /* Pause food spawning for the duration of the shrink animation. */
      srv->config.food_spawn_amount = 0;

      async_log("[MapScaler] SHRINKING: starting shrink animation\n");
      broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_SHRINK_START, ms->current_size,
                          ms->target_size, ms->transition_duration, 0);
    }
    break;
  }

  case PHASE_SHRINKING: {
    /* Interpolate border inward */
    uint32_t elapsed = srv->ticks - ms->transition_start_tick;
    double t = (double)elapsed / (double)ms->transition_duration;

    /* Incremental per-tick cleanup: remove a batch of food/virus nodes
     * that are now outside the current (moving) border each tick.
     * This spreads the DELETE work evenly across the animation duration
     * instead of spiking the entire scan into one tick at SHRINK_COMPLETE. */
    {
      double minx = srv->border.minx, miny = srv->border.miny;
      double maxx = srv->border.maxx, maxy = srv->border.maxy;

      /* Food: scan up to food_cleanup_batch entries per tick */
      int fbatch = ms->food_cleanup_batch > 0 ? ms->food_cleanup_batch : 64;
      for (int n = 0; n < fbatch && ms->food_cleanup_cursor < srv->food_count; n++) {
        Cell *c = srv->food_nodes[ms->food_cleanup_cursor];
        if (c && !c->is_removed &&
            (c->position.x < minx || c->position.x > maxx ||
             c->position.y < miny || c->position.y > maxy)) {
          server_remove_cell(srv, c);
          /* Do not increment cursor: new cell was swap-moved into this index */
        } else {
          ms->food_cleanup_cursor++;
        }
      }
      /* Wrap cursor so repeated shrinks cover fresh additions */
      if (ms->food_cleanup_cursor >= srv->food_count)
        ms->food_cleanup_cursor = 0;

      /* Virus: smaller batch (fewer nodes) */
      int vbatch = ms->virus_cleanup_batch > 0 ? ms->virus_cleanup_batch : 8;
      for (int n = 0; n < vbatch && ms->virus_cleanup_cursor < srv->virus_count; n++) {
        Cell *c = srv->virus_nodes[ms->virus_cleanup_cursor];
        if (c && !c->is_removed &&
            (c->position.x < minx || c->position.x > maxx ||
             c->position.y < miny || c->position.y > maxy)) {
          server_remove_cell(srv, c);
          /* Do not increment cursor: new cell was swap-moved into this index */
        } else {
          ms->virus_cleanup_cursor++;
        }
      }
      if (ms->virus_cleanup_cursor >= srv->virus_count)
        ms->virus_cleanup_cursor = 0;
    }

    if (t >= 1.0) {
      t = 1.0;
      ms->current_size = ms->target_size;
      ms->current_tier = ms->target_tier;
      ms->phase = PHASE_NORMAL;
      ms->event_sent = false;

      /* Final pass: catch any remaining outliers the incremental loop
       * may have missed (e.g. cells spawned mid-animation at old positions).
       * Also clamps players and ejected mass. */
      set_border_from_size(srv, ms->current_size);
      cleanup_outside_border(srv);
      scale_entity_counts(ms, srv, ms->current_tier, true);
      cull_excess_viruses(srv);

      /* Reset cursors for next shrink */
      ms->food_cleanup_cursor = 0;
      ms->virus_cleanup_cursor = 0;
      /* Full food grid rebuild now that border is at its final size */

      async_log("[MapScaler] SHRINK COMPLETE: tier %d (%.0f)\n",
                ms->current_tier, ms->current_size);
      broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_RESIZE_COMPLETE, ms->current_size,
                          ms->current_size, 0, 0);
    } else {
      ms->current_size =
          ms->pre_change_size + t * (ms->target_size - ms->pre_change_size);
    }
    set_border_from_size(srv, ms->current_size);
    scale_entity_counts_by_size(
        ms,
        srv,
        ms->current_size,
        ms->current_tier,
        ms->phase != PHASE_SHRINKING);

    /* Per-tick dynamic cell processing during shrink:
     * - Mother cells: remove when the border passes them
     * - Player cells: clamp inward to stay in bounds */
    {
      double minx = srv->border.minx, miny = srv->border.miny;
      double maxx = srv->border.maxx, maxy = srv->border.maxy;
      for (int i = srv->dynamic_count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        Cell *c = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
        if (c->is_removed) continue;

        if (c->type == CELL_MOTHER) {
          /* Remove mothers as the border sweeps past them */
          if (c->position.x < minx || c->position.x > maxx ||
              c->position.y < miny || c->position.y > maxy) {
            server_remove_cell(srv, c);
          }
          continue;
        }

        if (c->type != CELL_PLAYER) continue;
        double r = c->radius;
        bool moved = false;
        if (c->position.x < minx + r) { c->position.x = minx + r; moved = true; }
        if (c->position.x > maxx - r) { c->position.x = maxx - r; moved = true; }
        if (c->position.y < miny + r) { c->position.y = miny + r; moved = true; }
        if (c->position.y > maxy - r) { c->position.y = maxy - r; moved = true; }
        if (moved) {
          c->is_moving = true;
          server_mark_cell_dirty(c, srv->ticks);
        }
      }
      /* Mouse target is NOT clamped here — clamping distorts the
       * player's aim direction and causes sudden inward jerks.
       * The cell position clamping above is sufficient. */
    }

    border_changed = true;
    break;
  }

  } /* switch */

  return border_changed;
}

void mapscaler_get_spawn_border(const MapScaler *ms, double *minx, double *miny,
                                double *maxx, double *maxy) {
  /* Always spawn within the SAFE playable border.
   * During contraction, spawn in the future smaller zone so new players
   * and new food/viruses do not land in the red danger ring. */
  double size = ms->current_size;
  if (ms->phase == PHASE_WARNING || ms->phase == PHASE_DANGER || ms->phase == PHASE_SHRINKING) {
    size = ms->target_size;
  }
  double half = size / 2.0;
  *minx = -half;
  *miny = -half;
  *maxx = half;
  *maxy = half;
}

bool mapscaler_is_in_outer_zone(const MapScaler *ms, double x, double y) {
  if (ms->phase != PHASE_WARNING && ms->phase != PHASE_DANGER &&
      ms->phase != PHASE_SHRINKING) {
    return false;
  }
  /* Outer zone = inside current border but outside target border */
  double target_half = ms->target_size / 2.0;
  return (x < -target_half || x > target_half || y < -target_half ||
          y > target_half);
}

void mapscaler_trigger_tier_change(MapScaler *ms, GameServer *srv, MapTier target_tier) {
  if (!ms || !srv) return;
  if ((int)target_tier < 0) target_tier = (MapTier)0;
  if ((int)target_tier >= MAP_TIER_COUNT) target_tier = (MapTier)(MAP_TIER_COUNT - 1);

  double target_size = ms->tiers[target_tier].map_size;
  if (target_size > ms->current_size) {
    /* Initiate smooth gradual expansion transition */
    ms->target_tier = target_tier;
    ms->target_size = target_size;
    ms->pre_change_size = ms->current_size;
    ms->phase = PHASE_EXPANDING;
    ms->transition_start_tick = srv->ticks;
    ms->event_sent = false;
    ms->rebalance_food_left = srv->food_count / 4;
    ms->rebalance_virus_left = srv->virus_count / 4;

    ms->ring_food_target = 0;
    ms->ring_virus_target = 0;
    ms->ring_food_spawned = 0;
    ms->ring_virus_spawned = 0;

    async_log("[MapScaler] MANUAL EXPAND: -> tier %d (%.0f)\n", (int)target_tier, ms->target_size);
    broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_EXPANSION_START, ms->current_size,
                        ms->target_size, ms->transition_duration, 0);
  } else if (target_size < ms->current_size) {
    /* Initiate canonical 3-stage shrink sequence: WARNING -> DANGER -> SHRINKING */
    ms->target_tier = target_tier;
    ms->target_size = target_size;
    ms->phase = PHASE_WARNING;
    ms->phase_start_tick = srv->ticks;
    ms->event_sent = false;

    async_log("[MapScaler] SHRINK SEQUENCE INITIATED: -> tier %d (%.0f)\n",
              (int)target_tier, ms->target_size);
    broadcast_map_event(srv, MAP_EVENT_CONTRACTION_WARNING, ms->current_size,
                        ms->target_size, 0, ms->warning_duration);
  } else {
    ms->current_tier = target_tier;
    ms->target_tier = target_tier;
    ms->target_size = target_size;
    ms->phase = PHASE_NORMAL;
  }
}

/* Expanding Land — Dynamic Map Scaler
 * Scales the playable map based on active player count.
 * See config.h for full specification. */
#ifndef MAPSCALER_H
#define MAPSCALER_H

#include <stdbool.h>
/* MAP_TIER_COUNT is defined in config.h */
#include "config.h"

typedef enum {
  MAP_7071 = 0,    /* scale 0.25 — boot tier (instantly expands to tier 1) */
  MAP_10000 = 1,   /* scale 0.50 — minimum playable tier */
  MAP_14142 = 2,   /* scale 1.00 — real Agar.io size */
  MAP_20000 = 3,   /* scale 2.00 */
  MAP_28284 = 4,   /* scale 4.00 */
  MAP_40000 = 5,   /* scale 8.00 */
  MAP_56569 = 6,   /* scale 16.00 */
  MAP_80000 = 7,   /* scale 32.00 */
  MAP_113137 = 8,  /* scale 64.00 */
  MAP_160000 = 9,  /* scale 128.00 — max tier */
} MapTier;

/* ── Contraction / expansion phases ─────────────────────────── */

typedef enum {
  PHASE_NORMAL = 0,    /* Stable — no resize in progress */
  PHASE_EXPANDING,     /* Border growing toward target */
  PHASE_WARNING,       /* Light-green zone: contraction announced */
  PHASE_DANGER,        /* Red zone: anti penalty in outer area */
  PHASE_SHRINKING,     /* Border contracting toward target */
} MapPhase;

/* ── Map event types (sent to clients via opcode 200) ──────── */

typedef enum {
  MAP_EVENT_EXPANSION_START = 1,
  MAP_EVENT_CONTRACTION_WARNING = 2,
  MAP_EVENT_CONTRACTION_DANGER = 3,
  MAP_EVENT_SHRINK_START = 4,
  MAP_EVENT_RESIZE_COMPLETE = 5,
} MapEventType;

/* ── Tier definition ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
  double map_size;       /* side length (square map) */
  int expand_threshold;  /* expand TO this tier when players > threshold */
  int shrink_threshold;  /* shrink FROM this tier when players < threshold */
} MapTierDef;

/* ── Map scaler state ────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
  /* Current state */
  MapTier current_tier;
  MapTier target_tier;
  MapPhase phase;

  /* Sizes */
  double current_size;   /* current active map side length */
  double target_size;    /* target map side length */

  /* Previous border (before contraction started) — for zone rendering */
  double pre_change_size;

  /* Phase timing */
  uint32_t phase_start_tick;
  uint32_t transition_start_tick;

  /* Configurable durations (in ticks, 25Hz) */
  int warning_duration;     /* default 3000 = 120s */
  int danger_duration;      /* default 750 = 30s */
  int transition_duration;  /* default 150 = 6s (expand/shrink animation) */

  /* Whether the system is enabled */
  bool enabled;
  bool manual_override;    /* manual mode: run smooth transitions but disable auto player-count threshold checks */

  /* Suppress repeated event sends */
  bool event_sent;

  /* Base food/virus amounts (from initial config) */
  int base_food_amount;
  int base_virus_amount;
  int base_food_spawn_amount;
  double base_map_area;    /* area of the initial map tier */

  /* Entity counts at expansion start — only entities ABOVE these counts
   * spawn in the outer ring; replacements spawn normally. */
  int pre_expand_food_count;
  int pre_expand_virus_count;

  /* Ring spawn counters (used during expansion) */
  int ring_food_target;
  int ring_virus_target;
  int ring_food_spawned;
  int ring_virus_spawned;

  /* Rebalance state */
  int rebalance_food_left;
  int rebalance_virus_left;

  /* Incremental cleanup cursors (per-tick border cleanup during PHASE_SHRINKING).
   * Each tick advances through food_nodes/virus_nodes by a small batch,
   * spreading DELETE load evenly with zero per-tick spikes.
   * Batch size is computed at shrink entry proportional to the area delta
   * (large-tier maps have proportionally more food to remove). */
  int food_cleanup_cursor;
  int virus_cleanup_cursor;
  int food_cleanup_batch;   /* computed: cells/tick to finish in transition_duration */
  int virus_cleanup_batch;

  /* Tier definitions (copied from config at init) */
  MapTierDef tiers[MAP_TIER_COUNT];
} MapScaler;

/* Forward declare GameServer (defined in server.h) */
typedef struct GameServer GameServer;

/* ── API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Initialize the map scaler. Call after config_defaults() and border setup.
 * Reads all settings (tiers, durations, food/virus) from cfg. */
void mapscaler_init(MapScaler *ms, ServerConfig *cfg);

/* Main tick: check player count, manage phases, update border.
 * Returns true if the border was changed this tick (caller should
 * send updated border packet to clients). */
bool mapscaler_tick(MapScaler *ms, GameServer *srv);

/* Get the spawn-safe border (future safe area during contraction).
 * During normal/expansion, returns the current border.
 * During warning/danger/shrink, returns the target (smaller) border. */
void mapscaler_get_spawn_border(const MapScaler *ms, double *minx,
                                double *miny, double *maxx, double *maxy);

/* Check if a position is in the warning/danger zone
 * (outside target border but inside current border). */
bool mapscaler_is_in_outer_zone(const MapScaler *ms, double x, double y);

/* Derive the map tier from a given size */
MapTier mapscaler_tier_for_size(const MapScaler *ms, double size);

/* Derive the map tier from a given player count */
MapTier mapscaler_find_tier_for_players(const MapScaler *ms, int players);

/* Set the server border to a square of the given side length, centered at origin */
void set_border_from_size(GameServer *srv, double size);

/* Trigger a smooth, multi-second map tier transition (expand or shrink animation) */
void mapscaler_trigger_tier_change(MapScaler *ms, GameServer *srv, MapTier target_tier);

#endif /* MAPSCALER_H */

#ifndef MOVING_SET_H
#define MOVING_SET_H

#include "cell.h"

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>


static inline bool moving_set_counts_as_dynamic(
    const Cell *cell) {
  return
      cell &&
      cell->type != CELL_PLAYER &&
      cell->type != CELL_FOOD;
}


static inline bool moving_set_add(
    Cell **nodes,
    int *count,
    int capacity,
    int *moving_dynamic_count,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!nodes ||
      !count ||
      !moving_dynamic_count ||
      !cell ||
      capacity <= 0) {
    return false;
  }

  if (cell->moving_index >= 0) {
    int index =
        cell->moving_index;

    return
        index < *count &&
        nodes[index] == cell;
  }

  if (*count < 0)
    *count = 0;

  if (*count >= capacity)
    return false;

  int index =
      (*count)++;

  nodes[index] =
      cell;

  cell->moving_index =
      index;

  if (moving_set_counts_as_dynamic(
          cell)) {
    (*moving_dynamic_count)++;
  }

  return true;
}


static inline bool moving_set_remove(
    Cell **nodes,
    int *count,
    int *moving_dynamic_count,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!nodes ||
      !count ||
      !moving_dynamic_count ||
      !cell) {
    return false;
  }

  int index =
      cell->moving_index;

  if (index < 0 ||
      index >= *count ||
      nodes[index] != cell) {
    return false;
  }

  if (moving_set_counts_as_dynamic(
          cell)) {
    if (*moving_dynamic_count <= 0)
      return false;

    (*moving_dynamic_count)--;
  }

  int last_index =
      --(*count);

  Cell *last =
      nodes[last_index];

  if (index != last_index) {
    nodes[index] =
        last;

    if (!last)
      return false;

    last->moving_index =
        index;
  }

  nodes[last_index] = NULL;

  cell->moving_index = -1;

  return true;
}


#endif /* MOVING_SET_H */

/* ── SHA-1 (minimal, for WebSocket handshake only) ────────────── */

static void sha1_transform(uint32_t state[5], const uint8_t buffer[64]) {
  uint32_t a, b, c, d, e, w[80];
  for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
    w[i] = ((uint32_t)buffer[i * 4] << 24) |
           ((uint32_t)buffer[i * 4 + 1] << 16) |
           ((uint32_t)buffer[i * 4 + 2] << 8) | buffer[i * 4 + 3];
  }
  for (int i = 16; i < 80; i++) {
    uint32_t t = w[i - 3] ^ w[i - 8] ^ w[i - 14] ^ w[i - 16];
    w[i] = (t << 1) | (t >> 31);
  }
  a = state[0];
  b = state[1];
  c = state[2];
  d = state[3];
  e = state[4];
  for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    uint32_t f, k;
    if (i < 20) {
      f = (b & c) | ((~b) & d);
      k = 0x5A827999;
    } else if (i < 40) {
      f = b ^ c ^ d;
      k = 0x6ED9EBA1;
    } else if (i < 60) {
      f = (b & c) | (b & d) | (c & d);
      k = 0x8F1BBCDC;
    } else {
      f = b ^ c ^ d;
      k = 0xCA62C1D6;
    }
    uint32_t t = ((a << 5) | (a >> 27)) + f + e + k + w[i];
    e = d;
    d = c;
    c = (b << 30) | (b >> 2);
    b = a;
    a = t;
  }
  state[0] += a;
  state[1] += b;
  state[2] += c;
  state[3] += d;
  state[4] += e;
}

static void sha1(const uint8_t *data, size_t len, uint8_t hash[20]) {
  uint32_t state[5] = {0x67452301, 0xEFCDAB89, 0x98BADCFE, 0x10325476,
                       0xC3D2E1F0};
  uint8_t block[64];
  size_t i;
  for (i = 0; i + 64 <= len; i += 64)
    sha1_transform(state, data + i);
  size_t rem = len - i;
  memcpy(block, data + i, rem);
  block[rem++] = 0x80;
  if (rem > 56) {
    memset(block + rem, 0, 64 - rem);
    sha1_transform(state, block);
    rem = 0;
  }
  memset(block + rem, 0, 56 - rem);
  uint64_t bits = (uint64_t)len * 8;
  for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++)
    block[56 + j] = (uint8_t)(bits >> (56 - j * 8));
  sha1_transform(state, block);
  for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
    hash[j * 4] = (uint8_t)(state[j] >> 24);
    hash[j * 4 + 1] = (uint8_t)(state[j] >> 16);
    hash[j * 4 + 2] = (uint8_t)(state[j] >> 8);
    hash[j * 4 + 3] = (uint8_t)(state[j]);
  }
}

/* ── Base64 encode ────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static const char b64[] =
    "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";

static int base64_encode(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, char *out) {
  int j = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i += 3) {
    uint32_t v = (uint32_t)in[i] << 16;
    if (i + 1 < len)
      v |= (uint32_t)in[i + 1] << 8;
    if (i + 2 < len)
      v |= in[i + 2];
    out[j++] = b64[(v >> 18) & 0x3F];
    out[j++] = b64[(v >> 12) & 0x3F];
    out[j++] = (i + 1 < len) ? b64[(v >> 6) & 0x3F] : '=';
    out[j++] = (i + 2 < len) ? b64[v & 0x3F] : '=';
  }
  out[j] = '\0';
  return j;
}

/* ── Connection state ────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* RECV_BUF_SIZE and SEND_BUF_SIZE are defined in config.h */

typedef struct {
  socket_t sock;
  bool active;
  bool ws_ready;
  ClientHandler handler;

  tls_conn *tls;
  uint32_t client_ip;

  uint8_t *recv_buf;
  int recv_len;

  /*
   * Complete WebSocket frames are appended to this queue.
   * send_offset is the first unsent byte.
   */
  uint8_t *send_buf;
  size_t send_len;
  size_t send_offset;
  size_t send_capacity;

  /*
   * OpenSSL requires a retry after WANT_READ/WANT_WRITE to use the same
   * application bytes and length. The buffer address may move because
   * SSL_MODE_ACCEPT_MOVING_WRITE_BUFFER is enabled.
   */
  size_t tls_retry_len;

  bool write_interest;
  bool write_wait_read;
  bool read_wait_write;
  bool write_failed;

  uint64_t write_blocked_since;
  uint64_t last_buffer_growth;
  uint64_t last_activity;
} Connection;

/* Allocate recv/send buffers for a connection slot */
static inline bool conn_alloc_buffers(Connection *connection) {
  if (!connection)
    return false;

  connection->recv_buf =
      calloc(1, RECV_BUF_SIZE);

  connection->send_buf =
      malloc(SEND_BUF_INITIAL);

  if (!connection->recv_buf ||
      !connection->send_buf) {
    free(connection->recv_buf);
    free(connection->send_buf);

    connection->recv_buf = NULL;
    connection->send_buf = NULL;
    connection->send_capacity = 0;

    async_log(
        "[Net] Connection-buffer allocation failed\n");

    return false;
  }

  connection->send_capacity =
      SEND_BUF_INITIAL;

  return true;
}


/* Free recv/send buffers for a connection slot */
static inline void conn_free_buffers(Connection *connection) {
  if (!connection)
    return;

  free(connection->recv_buf);
  free(connection->send_buf);

  connection->recv_buf = NULL;
  connection->send_buf = NULL;
  connection->recv_len = 0;
  connection->send_len = 0;
  connection->send_offset = 0;
  connection->send_capacity = 0;
  connection->tls_retry_len = 0;
}

/* ── Server status (written by main thread, read by do_ws_handshake) ── */
