void net_update_status(int alive, int connected, int spectators,
                       int food, int viruses, uint32_t uptime_secs,
                       int map_scale_x100) {
  atomic_store_explicit(&g_status.alive, alive, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&g_status.connected, connected, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&g_status.spectators, spectators, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&g_status.food, food, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&g_status.viruses, viruses, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(
      &g_status.uptime_secs, uptime_secs, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(
      &g_status.map_scale_x100, map_scale_x100, memory_order_relaxed);
}

/*
 * The stress-test configuration currently permits the complete connection
 * capacity from one IP. Compile the cross-thread connection scan only if a
 * real per-IP limit is enabled. This avoids reading Connection.active and
 * client_ip concurrently from the accept and simulation threads.
 */
#if MAX_CONNS_PER_IP < MAX_CONNECTIONS
static int count_connections_from_ip(uint32_t ip) {
  int count = 0;

  /*
   * A production per-IP limit should ultimately use an accept-thread-owned
   * counter table. This scan is retained only for lower-cap configurations.
   */
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNECTIONS; i++) {
    if (connections[i].active &&
        connections[i].client_ip == ip) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}
#endif

/* TLS state */
static tls_ctx *g_tls_ctx = NULL;
static bool g_use_tls = false;

/* ── Accept thread: ready connection queue ────────────────────── */
/* Connections are accepted and TLS-handshaked on a background thread,
 * then placed into this queue for the main game thread to pick up.
 * This means the game loop NEVER blocks on accept() or SSL_accept(). */

#define READY_QUEUE_SIZE MAX_CONNECTIONS /* scale with connection cap */

typedef struct {
  socket_t sock;
  tls_conn *tls;
  uint32_t client_ip;
} ReadyConn;

static ReadyConn ready_queue[READY_QUEUE_SIZE];
/* Both indices are protected by rq_cs/rq_mutex. */
static int rq_head = 0;
static int rq_tail = 0;

#ifdef _WIN32
static CRITICAL_SECTION rq_cs;
static HANDLE accept_thread_handle = NULL;
static bool rq_sync_initialized = false;
#else
static pthread_mutex_t rq_mutex = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_t accept_thread_id;
static atomic_int accept_thread_running = 0;
static atomic_int accept_thread_started = 0;
#endif

static void rq_push(socket_t sock, tls_conn *tc, uint32_t ip) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  EnterCriticalSection(&rq_cs);
#else
  pthread_mutex_lock(&rq_mutex);
#endif
  int next = (rq_head + 1) % READY_QUEUE_SIZE;
  if (next != rq_tail) { /* not full */
    ready_queue[rq_head].sock = sock;
    ready_queue[rq_head].tls = tc;
    ready_queue[rq_head].client_ip = ip;
    rq_head = next;
  } else {
    /* Queue full — reject this connection */
    async_log("[Net] Accept queue full, rejecting connection\n");
    if (tc)
      tls_close(tc);
    CLOSESOCKET(sock);
  }
#ifdef _WIN32
  LeaveCriticalSection(&rq_cs);
#else
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&rq_mutex);
#endif
}

static int rq_pop(ReadyConn *out) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  EnterCriticalSection(&rq_cs);
#else
  pthread_mutex_lock(&rq_mutex);
#endif
  int got = 0;
  if (rq_tail != rq_head) {
    *out = ready_queue[rq_tail];
    rq_tail = (rq_tail + 1) % READY_QUEUE_SIZE;
    got = 1;
  }
#ifdef _WIN32
  LeaveCriticalSection(&rq_cs);
#else
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&rq_mutex);
#endif
  return got;
}

/* ── TLS failure rate limiter ────────────────────────────────── */
/* Track per-IP TLS handshake failures. If an IP fails too many times
 * in a short window, auto-ban it temporarily. Runs on accept thread only. */

/* TLS_BAN_MAX_ENTRIES, TLS_BAN_MAX_FAILURES, TLS_BAN_WINDOW_SECS,
 * TLS_BAN_DURATION_SECS all defined in config.h */

typedef struct {
  uint32_t ip;
  int fail_count;
  time_t first_fail;   /* timestamp of first failure in current window */
  time_t banned_until; /* 0 = not banned */
} TlsBanEntry;

static TlsBanEntry tls_ban_table[TLS_BAN_MAX_ENTRIES];

static TlsBanEntry *tls_ban_find(uint32_t ip) {
  /* Simple linear probe — table is small (256 entries) */
  uint32_t idx = (ip * 2654435761u) % TLS_BAN_MAX_ENTRIES;
  for (int i = 0; i < TLS_BAN_MAX_ENTRIES; i++) {
    uint32_t slot = (idx + i) % TLS_BAN_MAX_ENTRIES;
    if (tls_ban_table[slot].ip == ip)
      return &tls_ban_table[slot];
    if (tls_ban_table[slot].ip == 0)
      return &tls_ban_table[slot]; /* empty slot */
  }
  return &tls_ban_table[idx]; /* table full, overwrite */
}

/* Returns true if this IP is currently banned */
static bool tls_ban_check(uint32_t ip) {
  TlsBanEntry *e = tls_ban_find(ip);
  if (e->ip != ip)
    return false;
  if (e->banned_until > 0) {
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    if (now < e->banned_until)
      return true; /* still banned */
    /* Ban expired — reset */
    e->ip = 0;
    e->fail_count = 0;
    e->banned_until = 0;
    return false;
  }
  return false;
}

/* Record a TLS failure for this IP. Returns true if IP is now banned. */
static bool tls_ban_record_failure(uint32_t ip) {
  time_t now = time(NULL);
  TlsBanEntry *e = tls_ban_find(ip);

  if (e->ip != ip) {
    /* New entry */
    e->ip = ip;
    e->fail_count = 1;
    e->first_fail = now;
    e->banned_until = 0;
    return false;
  }

  /* Reset window if expired */
  if (now - e->first_fail > TLS_BAN_WINDOW_SECS) {
    e->fail_count = 1;
    e->first_fail = now;
    return false;
  }

  e->fail_count++;
  if (e->fail_count >= TLS_BAN_MAX_FAILURES) {
    e->banned_until = now + TLS_BAN_DURATION_SECS;
    async_log("[Net] IP %u.%u.%u.%u banned for %d seconds (%d TLS failures)\n",
              ip & 0xFF, (ip >> 8) & 0xFF, (ip >> 16) & 0xFF, (ip >> 24) & 0xFF,
              TLS_BAN_DURATION_SECS, e->fail_count);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/* Accept thread function: blocks on accept(), does TLS handshake,
 * pushes ready connections into the queue for the main thread. */
#ifdef _WIN32
static DWORD WINAPI accept_thread_func(LPVOID arg) {
  (void)arg;
  while (atomic_load_explicit(&running, memory_order_acquire)) {
#else
static void *accept_thread_func(void *arg) {
  (void)arg;
  while (atomic_load_explicit(
      &accept_thread_running, memory_order_acquire)) {
#endif
    /* Use select() to wait on both TLS and plain sockets */
    fd_set rfds;
    FD_ZERO(&rfds);
    FD_SET(listen_sock, &rfds);
    int max_fd = (int)listen_sock;
    if (plain_listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
      FD_SET(plain_listen_sock, &rfds);
      if ((int)plain_listen_sock > max_fd) max_fd = (int)plain_listen_sock;
    }
    struct timeval tv = {0, 100000}; /* 100ms timeout */
    int sel = select(max_fd + 1, &rfds, NULL, NULL, &tv);
    if (sel <= 0) continue;

    /* Determine which socket is ready */
    bool is_plain = (plain_listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID &&
                     FD_ISSET(plain_listen_sock, &rfds));
    socket_t accept_sock = is_plain ? plain_listen_sock : listen_sock;
    if (!is_plain && !FD_ISSET(listen_sock, &rfds)) continue;

    struct sockaddr_in client_addr;
    socklen_t addr_len = sizeof(client_addr);
    socket_t client_sock =
        accept(accept_sock, (struct sockaddr *)&client_addr, &addr_len);

    if (client_sock == SOCKET_INVALID) {
      continue;
    }

    /* Anti-bot: per-IP connection limit */
    uint32_t cip = client_addr.sin_addr.s_addr;
#if MAX_CONNS_PER_IP < MAX_CONNECTIONS
    if (count_connections_from_ip(cip) >= MAX_CONNS_PER_IP) {
      CLOSESOCKET(client_sock);
      continue;
    }
#endif

    tls_conn *tc = NULL;
    if (!is_plain && g_use_tls) {
      /* Check if this IP is banned from TLS failures */
      if (tls_ban_check(cip)) {
        CLOSESOCKET(client_sock);
        continue;
      }

      /* Set socket timeout to prevent slow handshake from blocking
       * this thread for too long (2 seconds — generous but bounded) */
      struct timeval handshake_tv = {2, 0};
      setsockopt(client_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, (const char *)&handshake_tv,
                 sizeof(handshake_tv));
      setsockopt(client_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, (const char *)&handshake_tv,
                 sizeof(handshake_tv));

      tc = tls_accept(g_tls_ctx, client_sock);
      if (!tc) {
        tls_ban_record_failure(cip);
        CLOSESOCKET(client_sock);
        continue;
      }

      /* Clear timeouts after successful handshake */
      struct timeval notv = {0, 0};
      setsockopt(client_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, (const char *)&notv,
                 sizeof(notv));
      setsockopt(client_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, (const char *)&notv,
                 sizeof(notv));
    }

    /* Set non-blocking + TCP_NODELAY + socket buffer tunings before handing to main thread */
    set_nonblocking(client_sock);
    int tcp_nodelay = 1;
    setsockopt(client_sock, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY,
               (const char *)&tcp_nodelay, sizeof(tcp_nodelay));

    /* Kernel socket memory cap (64KB send / 32KB recv) for high connection density */
    int sndbuf = 65536;
    int rcvbuf = 32768;
    setsockopt(client_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDBUF, (const char *)&sndbuf, sizeof(sndbuf));
    setsockopt(client_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVBUF, (const char *)&rcvbuf, sizeof(rcvbuf));

#ifdef __linux__
    /* Disable TCP delayed ACK timer for immediate client input response */
#ifndef TCP_QUICKACK
#define TCP_QUICKACK 12
#endif
    int quickack = 1;
    setsockopt(client_sock, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_QUICKACK, (const char *)&quickack, sizeof(quickack));
#endif

    /* Push to queue — main thread picks it up next tick */
    rq_push(client_sock, tc, cip);
  }
  return 0;
}

/* Linux epoll state */
#ifdef __linux__
static int epoll_fd = -1;

#define EPOLL_MAX_EVENTS MAX_CONNECTIONS

#define CONNECTION_BASE_EVENTS \
  (EPOLLIN | EPOLLRDHUP | EPOLLERR | EPOLLHUP)

static void epoll_add_conn(
    int fd,
    uint32_t events,
    int conn_idx) {
  struct epoll_event event;
  memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));

  event.events = events;
  event.data.fd = conn_idx;

  if (epoll_ctl(
          epoll_fd,
          EPOLL_CTL_ADD,
          fd,
          &event) != 0) {
    async_log(
        "[Net] epoll ADD failed for connection %d: %s\n",
        conn_idx,
        strerror(errno));
  }
}

static void epoll_del_fd(int fd) {
  if (epoll_fd >= 0 && fd >= 0) {
    epoll_ctl(
        epoll_fd,
        EPOLL_CTL_DEL,
        fd,
        NULL);
  }
}

static void epoll_refresh_connection(
    int conn_idx) {
  if (conn_idx < 0 ||
      conn_idx >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
    return;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_idx];

  if (!connection->active ||
      connection->sock == SOCKET_INVALID) {
    return;
  }

  uint32_t events =
      CONNECTION_BASE_EVENTS;

  if (connection->write_interest ||
      connection->read_wait_write) {
    events |= EPOLLOUT;
  }

  struct epoll_event event;
  memset(&event, 0, sizeof(event));

  event.events = events;
  event.data.fd = conn_idx;

  if (epoll_ctl(
          epoll_fd,
          EPOLL_CTL_MOD,
          connection->sock,
          &event) != 0) {
    connection->write_failed = true;

    async_log(
        "[Net] epoll MOD failed for connection %d: %s\n",
        conn_idx,
        strerror(errno));
  }
}
#endif

/* ── I/O helpers (TLS-aware, inlined for hot-path perf) ───────── */

static inline int net_recv(Connection *conn, void *buf, int len) {
  if (conn->tls)
    return tls_read(conn->tls, buf, len);
  return recv(conn->sock, (char *)buf, len, 0);
}

static inline int net_send(Connection *conn, const void *buf, int len) {
  if (conn->tls)
    return tls_write(conn->tls, buf, len);
  return send(conn->sock, (const char *)buf, len, 0);
}

/* ── WebSocket handshake ─────────────────────────────────────── */

#include <ctype.h>

static const char *WS_MAGIC = "258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11";

static const char *strcasestr_custom(const char *haystack, const char *needle) {
  if (!haystack || !needle) return NULL;
  if (!*needle) return haystack;
  for (; *haystack; haystack++) {
    if (tolower((unsigned char)*haystack) == tolower((unsigned char)*needle)) {
      const char *h = haystack + 1;
      const char *n = needle + 1;
      while (*h && *n && tolower((unsigned char)*h) == tolower((unsigned char)*n)) {
        h++;
        n++;
      }
      if (!*n) return haystack;
    }
  }
  return NULL;
}

static int find_header(const char *req, const char *header, char *out,
                       int max_len) {
  const char *p = strcasestr_custom(req, header);
  if (!p)
    return 0;
  p += strlen(header);
  while (*p == ' ' || *p == ':')
    p++;
  int i = 0;
  while (*p && *p != '\r' && *p != '\n' && i < max_len - 1) {
    out[i++] = *p++;
  }
  out[i] = '\0';
  return i;
}

static int do_ws_handshake(Connection *conn) {
  conn->recv_buf[conn->recv_len] = '\0';
  char *req = (char *)conn->recv_buf;

  /* Handle OPTIONS preflight for Private Network Access.
   * Chrome sends this before WebSocket from public sites to localhost. */
  if (strstr(req, "OPTIONS ") == req) {
    const char *preflight = "HTTP/1.1 204 No Content\r\n"
                            "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\n"
                            "Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, OPTIONS\r\n"
                            "Access-Control-Allow-Headers: *\r\n"
                            "Access-Control-Allow-Private-Network: true\r\n"
                            "Access-Control-Max-Age: 86400\r\n"
                            "Connection: close\r\n"
                            "\r\n";
    net_send(conn, preflight, (int)strlen(preflight));
    INFO_LOG("[Net] Responded to PNA preflight\n");
    return -1;
  }

  /* Check it's an HTTP GET */
  if (strstr(req, "GET ") != req) {
    /* Not even HTTP — send a 400 so the browser doesn't hang */
    const char *bad = "HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n";
    net_send(conn, bad, (int)strlen(bad));
    return -1;
  }

  /* Check for WebSocket upgrade (case-insensitive) */
  if (!strcasestr_custom(req, "upgrade: websocket")) {

    /* ── /status JSON endpoint ───────────────────────────────── */
    if (strstr(req, "GET /status")) {
      char json[256];
      int alive =
          atomic_load_explicit(&g_status.alive, memory_order_relaxed);
      int connected =
          atomic_load_explicit(&g_status.connected, memory_order_relaxed);
      int spectators =
          atomic_load_explicit(&g_status.spectators, memory_order_relaxed);
      int food =
          atomic_load_explicit(&g_status.food, memory_order_relaxed);
      int viruses =
          atomic_load_explicit(&g_status.viruses, memory_order_relaxed);
      uint32_t uptime = (uint32_t)atomic_load_explicit(
          &g_status.uptime_secs, memory_order_relaxed);
      int map_scale = atomic_load_explicit(
          &g_status.map_scale_x100, memory_order_relaxed);

      int jlen = snprintf(
          json, sizeof(json),
          "{\"alive\":%d,\"connected\":%d,\"spectators\":%d,"
          "\"food\":%d,\"viruses\":%d,\"uptime\":%u,"
          "\"map_scale\":%d,"
          "\"status\":\"online\",\"version\":\"" SERVER_VERSION "\"}",
          alive, connected, spectators, food, viruses, uptime, map_scale);
      char resp[512];
      int rlen = snprintf(resp, sizeof(resp),
          "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"
          "Content-Type: application/json\r\n"
          "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\n"
          "Cache-Control: no-cache, max-age=30\r\n"
          "Connection: close\r\n"
          "Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s", jlen, json);
      net_send(conn, resp, rlen);
      return -1;
    }

    /* ── Discord OAuth callback ──────────────────────────────── */
    if (strstr(req, "GET /auth/discord/callback") && discord_oauth_available()) {
      /* Extract ?code= parameter from URL */
      char *code_start = strstr(req, "code=");
      char discord_code[128] = {0};
      if (code_start) {
        code_start += 5; /* skip "code=" */
        int ci = 0;
        while (*code_start && *code_start != '&' && *code_start != ' '
               && *code_start != '\r' && ci < (int)sizeof(discord_code) - 1) {
          discord_code[ci++] = *code_start++;
        }
        discord_code[ci] = '\0';
      }

      if (discord_code[0]) {
        const char *err_msg = NULL;
        char *html = discord_oauth_handle_callback(discord_code, &err_msg);
        if (html) {
          char header[256];
          int hlen = snprintf(header, sizeof(header),
            "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"
            "Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8\r\n"
            "Cache-Control: no-store\r\n"
            "Connection: close\r\n"
            "Content-Length: %d\r\n"
            "\r\n", (int)strlen(html));
          net_send(conn, header, hlen);
          net_send(conn, html, (int)strlen(html));
          free(html);
        } else {
          char errbuf[512];
          int elen = snprintf(errbuf, sizeof(errbuf),
            "HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error\r\n"
            "Content-Type: text/html\r\n"
            "Connection: close\r\n"
            "\r\n"
            "<html><body style='background:#111;color:#f87171;font-family:sans-serif;"
            "text-align:center;padding:40px'>"
            "<h2>Discord Login Failed</h2><p>%s</p>"
            "<a href='https://expanding.land' style='color:#5865F2'>Back to Game</a>"
            "</body></html>",
            err_msg ? err_msg : "Unknown error");
          net_send(conn, errbuf, elen);
        }
      } else {
        const char *bad = "HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request\r\n"
          "Content-Type: text/plain\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
          "Missing code parameter";
        net_send(conn, bad, (int)strlen(bad));
      }
      return -1; /* close after sending */
    }

    /* Regular HTTP request (browser navigating to accept cert).
     * Send a simple page so Chrome shows it and the user can accept. */
    const char *html =
        "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n"
        "Content-Type: text/html\r\n"
        "Connection: close\r\n"
        "\r\n"
        "<!DOCTYPE html><html><body style='font-family:sans-serif;"
        "background:#111;color:#0f0;text-align:center;padding-top:40px'>"
        "<h1>Expanding Land</h1>"
        "<p>WSS server running. Testing WebSocket...</p>"
        "<pre id='log'></pre>"
        "<script>"
        "var l=document.getElementById('log');"
        "function log(s){l.textContent+=s+'\\n';}"
        "try{"
        "var ws=new WebSocket(location.origin.replace('http','ws'));"
        "ws.binaryType='arraybuffer';"
        "ws.onopen=function(){log('WS OPEN - sending proto handshake');"
        "var b=new ArrayBuffer(5);var v=new DataView(b);"
        "v.setUint8(0,254);v.setUint32(1,6,true);ws.send(b);"
        "var b2=new ArrayBuffer(5);var v2=new DataView(b2);"
        "v2.setUint8(0,255);v2.setUint32(1,1,true);ws.send(b2);"
        "log('Sent 0xFE proto=6 + 0xFF key=1');};"
        "ws.onmessage=function(e){var d=new Uint8Array(e.data);"
        "log('Got '+d.length+' bytes, opcode=0x'+d[0].toString(16));};"
        "ws.onerror=function(){log('WS ERROR');};"
        "ws.onclose=function(e){log('WS CLOSE code='+e.code+' "
        "reason='+e.reason);};"
        "}catch(e){log('Exception: '+e.message);}"
        "</script></body></html>";
    net_send(conn, html, (int)strlen(html));
    return -1; /* close after sending — not a WS connection */
  }

  /* Extract Sec-WebSocket-Key */
  char key[64] = {0};
  if (!find_header(req, "Sec-WebSocket-Key", key, sizeof(key)))
    return -1;

  /* Compute accept key: SHA1(key + MAGIC) then Base64 */
  char combined[128];
  int clen = snprintf(combined, sizeof(combined), "%s%s", key, WS_MAGIC);

  uint8_t hash[20];
  sha1((uint8_t *)combined, (size_t)clen, hash);

  char accept[40];
  base64_encode(hash, 20, accept);

  /* Send HTTP 101 response — keep minimal to match working ws module behavior
   */
  char response[256];
  int rlen = snprintf(response, sizeof(response),
                      "HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\r\n"
                      "Upgrade: websocket\r\n"
                      "Connection: Upgrade\r\n"
                      "Sec-WebSocket-Accept: %s\r\n"
                      "\r\n",
                      accept);

  int sent = net_send(conn, response, rlen);
  INFO_LOG("[WS] Handshake: key='%s' accept='%s' sent=%d/%d\n",
           key, accept, sent, rlen);

  /*
   * Do not mark the connection WebSocket-ready unless the complete HTTP 101
   * response was accepted. A partial nonblocking handshake cannot be mixed
   * with subsequent WebSocket frames.
   */
  if (sent != rlen)
    return -1;

  conn->recv_len = 0;
  conn->ws_ready = true;
  return 0;
}

/* ── WebSocket frame reading ─────────────────────────────────── */

enum {
  WS_PARSE_NEED_MORE = -1,
  WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR = -2
};

/*
 * Parse one complete RFC 6455 client frame.
 *
 * This server deliberately supports non-fragmented binary game messages and
 * standard close/ping/pong controls. Text, continuation and fragmented data
 * are rejected instead of being misinterpreted as game packets.
 */
static int ws_read_frame(uint8_t *buf, int buf_len,
                         const uint8_t **payload_out,
                         int *frame_total_len,
                         int *opcode_out) {
  if (!buf || !payload_out || !frame_total_len || !opcode_out)
    return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;

  if (buf_len < 2)
    return WS_PARSE_NEED_MORE;

  bool fin = (buf[0] & 0x80) != 0;
  int rsv = buf[0] & 0x70;
  int opcode = buf[0] & 0x0F;
  bool masked = (buf[1] & 0x80) != 0;
  uint64_t payload_len = (uint64_t)(buf[1] & 0x7F);
  int header_len = 2;

  if (rsv != 0)
    return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;

  if (!fin)
    return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;

  if (opcode != 0x02 &&
      opcode != 0x08 &&
      opcode != 0x09 &&
      opcode != 0x0A) {
    return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;
  }

  /* RFC 6455 requires every client-to-server frame to be masked. */
  if (!masked)
    return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;

  if (payload_len == 126) {
    if (buf_len < 4)
      return WS_PARSE_NEED_MORE;

    payload_len =
        ((uint64_t)buf[2] << 8) |
        (uint64_t)buf[3];
    header_len = 4;
  } else if (payload_len == 127) {
    if (buf_len < 10)
      return WS_PARSE_NEED_MORE;

    /* The most-significant length bit must be zero. */
    if ((buf[2] & 0x80) != 0)
      return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;

    payload_len = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
      payload_len = (payload_len << 8) | buf[2 + i];

    header_len = 10;
  }

  bool control = (opcode & 0x08) != 0;
  if (control && payload_len > 125)
    return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;

  header_len += 4; /* mandatory client mask */

  /*
   * Reject an oversized frame as soon as its header is available. Do not wait
   * for an impossible payload to fill the fixed receive buffer.
   */
  if (payload_len > (uint64_t)(RECV_BUF_SIZE - header_len))
    return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;

  if (payload_len > (uint64_t)(INT_MAX - header_len))
    return WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR;

  int total = header_len + (int)payload_len;
  if (buf_len < total)
    return WS_PARSE_NEED_MORE;

  const uint8_t *mask = buf + header_len - 4;
  uint8_t *data = buf + header_len;

  /*
   * Byte-wise unmasking is deterministic on every architecture. Game input
   * packets are small, so avoiding host-endian assumptions is preferable.
   */
  for (uint64_t i = 0; i < payload_len; i++)
    data[i] ^= mask[i & 3U];

  *payload_out = data;
  *frame_total_len = total;
  *opcode_out = opcode;

  return (int)payload_len;
}

/* ── WebSocket frame writing ─────────────────────────────────── */

static inline int ws_build_frame(uint8_t *out, const uint8_t *payload,
                                 size_t len) {
  int header_len = 2;
  out[0] = 0x82; /* FIN + binary opcode */

  if (len < 126) {
    out[1] = (uint8_t)len;
  } else if (len < 65536) {
    out[1] = 126;
    out[2] = (uint8_t)(len >> 8);
    out[3] = (uint8_t)(len & 0xFF);
    header_len = 4;
  } else {
    out[1] = 127;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
      out[2 + i] = (uint8_t)(len >> (56 - i * 8));
    header_len = 10;
  }

  memcpy(out + header_len, payload, len);
  return header_len + (int)len;
}

/* ── Internal: build WS frame header, return header length ───── */

static inline int ws_header(uint8_t *out, size_t payload_len) {
  out[0] = 0x82; /* FIN + binary */
  if (payload_len < 126) {
    out[1] = (uint8_t)payload_len;
    return 2;
  } else if (payload_len < 65536) {
    out[1] = 126;
    out[2] = (uint8_t)(payload_len >> 8);
    out[3] = (uint8_t)(payload_len & 0xFF);
    return 4;
  } else {
    out[1] = 127;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
      out[2 + i] = (uint8_t)(payload_len >> (56 - i * 8));
    return 10;
  }
}

/* ── Public send and flush layer ──────────────────────────────── */

void net_flush_player(int conn_id);

static void net_close_connection_slot(int conn_id, bool notify_game);

static inline size_t connection_pending_bytes(
    const Connection *connection) {
  if (!connection ||
      connection->send_offset >= connection->send_len) {
    return 0;
  }

  return connection->send_len -
         connection->send_offset;
}


static void connection_refresh_interest(
    int conn_id) {
#ifdef __linux__
  epoll_refresh_connection(conn_id);
#else
  (void)conn_id;
#endif
}


static bool connection_reserve_send(
    int conn_id,
    size_t additional) {
  if (conn_id < 0 ||
      conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
    return false;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (!connection->active ||
      connection->write_failed) {
    return false;
  }

  size_t pending =
      connection_pending_bytes(connection);

  /*
   * Reclaim already-sent prefix space before considering growth.
   * OpenSSL permits the buffer address to move; tls_retry_len keeps the retry
   * application length unchanged.
   */
  if (connection->send_offset > 0) {
    if (pending > 0) {
      memmove(
          connection->send_buf,
          connection->send_buf +
              connection->send_offset,
          pending);
    }

    connection->send_len = pending;
    connection->send_offset = 0;
  }

  if (additional >
          SEND_BUF_HARD_LIMIT ||
      connection->send_len >
          SEND_BUF_HARD_LIMIT - additional) {
    async_log(
        "[Net] Connection %d exceeded the %llu-byte "
        "outbound hard limit\n",
        conn_id,
        (unsigned long long)SEND_BUF_HARD_LIMIT);

    connection->write_failed = true;
    return false;
  }

  size_t required =
      connection->send_len + additional;

  if (required <= connection->send_capacity)
    return true;

  if (connection->tls_retry_len > 0) {
    /* Cannot move send_buf during active OpenSSL write retry */
    return false;
  }

  size_t capacity =
      connection->send_capacity;

  if (capacity < SEND_BUF_INITIAL)
    capacity = SEND_BUF_INITIAL;

  while (capacity < required) {
    size_t next = capacity * 2;

    if (next < capacity ||
        next > SEND_BUF_HARD_LIMIT) {
      next = SEND_BUF_HARD_LIMIT;
    }

    capacity = next;

    if (capacity == SEND_BUF_HARD_LIMIT)
      break;
  }

  if (capacity < required) {
    connection->write_failed = true;
    return false;
  }

  uint8_t *grown =
      realloc(
          connection->send_buf,
          capacity);

  if (!grown) {
    async_log(
        "[Net] Connection %d send-buffer growth "
        "to %llu bytes failed\n",
        conn_id,
        (unsigned long long)capacity);

    connection->write_failed = true;
    return false;
  }

  connection->send_buf = grown;
  connection->send_capacity = capacity;
  connection->last_buffer_growth =
      server_time_ms();

  return true;
}


static bool connection_append_bytes(
    int conn_id,
    const uint8_t *data,
    size_t length) {
  if (!data && length > 0)
    return false;

  if (!connection_reserve_send(
          conn_id,
          length)) {
    return false;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (length > 0) {
    memcpy(
        connection->send_buf +
            connection->send_len,
        data,
        length);

    connection->send_len += length;
  }

  /*
   * If SSL_write is waiting for peer TLS input, EPOLLIN—not EPOLLOUT—is the
   * required readiness event. Otherwise arm EPOLLOUT.
   */
  if (!connection->write_wait_read)
    connection->write_interest = true;

  connection_refresh_interest(conn_id);

  return true;
}


static bool net_queue_control_frame(
    Connection *connection,
    uint8_t opcode,
    const uint8_t *payload,
    size_t length) {
  if (!connection ||
      !connection->active ||
      !connection->ws_ready ||
      length > 125) {
    return false;
  }

  int conn_id =
      connection->handler.conn_id;

  uint8_t frame[127];

  frame[0] =
      (uint8_t)(0x80U | opcode);

  frame[1] =
      (uint8_t)length;

  if (length > 0) {
    memcpy(
        frame + 2,
        payload,
        length);
  }

  return connection_append_bytes(
      conn_id,
      frame,
      length + 2);
}


static size_t net_drain_connection(
    int conn_id,
    size_t byte_budget,
    int call_budget) {
  if (conn_id < 0 ||
      conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
    return 0;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (!connection->active ||
      connection->write_failed) {
    return 0;
  }

  if (connection->send_offset >
      connection->send_len) {
    connection->write_failed = true;
    return 0;
  }

  size_t progressed = 0;
  int calls = 0;

  while (connection_pending_bytes(connection) > 0 &&
         progressed < byte_budget &&
         calls < call_budget) {
    size_t pending =
        connection_pending_bytes(connection);

    size_t allowed =
        byte_budget - progressed;

    size_t attempt = pending;
    if (connection->tls_retry_len > 0) {
      attempt = connection->tls_retry_len;
      if (allowed < attempt) {
        /* OpenSSL requirement: cannot change byte length during SSL_write retry.
         * Defer write until budget permits full retry length. */
        break;
      }
    } else {
      if (attempt > NET_WRITE_CHUNK_BYTES)
        attempt = NET_WRITE_CHUNK_BYTES;

      if (attempt > allowed)
        attempt = allowed;
    }

    if (attempt == 0)
      break;

    int written;

    if (connection->tls) {
      written = tls_write(
          connection->tls,
          connection->send_buf +
              connection->send_offset,
          (int)attempt);
    } else {
      written = send(
          connection->sock,
          (const char *)(
              connection->send_buf +
              connection->send_offset),
          (int)attempt,
          0);

      if (written < 0) {
#ifdef _WIN32
        int error = WSAGetLastError();

        if (error == WSAEWOULDBLOCK)
          written = TLS_IO_WANT_WRITE;
#else
        if (errno == EAGAIN ||
            errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
          written = TLS_IO_WANT_WRITE;
        }
#endif
      }
    }

    calls++;

    if (written > 0) {
      if ((size_t)written > attempt) {
        connection->write_failed = true;
        break;
      }

      connection->send_offset +=
          (size_t)written;

      progressed +=
          (size_t)written;

      connection->tls_retry_len = 0;
      connection->write_wait_read = false;
      if (connection->write_blocked_since != 0) {
        connection->write_blocked_since = 0;
        if (g_blocked_connection_count > 0) g_blocked_connection_count--;
      }
      connection->last_activity =
          server_time_ms();

      continue;
    }

    if (written == TLS_IO_WANT_READ ||
        written == TLS_IO_WANT_WRITE) {
      /*
       * Retry with exactly the same application length after the required
       * readiness event.
       */
      connection->tls_retry_len =
          attempt;

      connection->write_wait_read =
          (written == TLS_IO_WANT_READ);

      connection->write_interest =
          (written == TLS_IO_WANT_WRITE);

      if (connection->write_blocked_since == 0) {
        connection->write_blocked_since =
            server_time_ms();
        g_blocked_connection_count++;
      }

      connection_refresh_interest(conn_id);
      return progressed;
    }

    connection->write_failed = true;
    break;
  }

  if (connection_pending_bytes(connection) == 0) {
    connection->send_len = 0;
    connection->send_offset = 0;
    connection->tls_retry_len = 0;
    connection->write_interest = false;
    connection->write_wait_read = false;
    if (connection->write_blocked_since != 0) {
      connection->write_blocked_since = 0;
      if (g_blocked_connection_count > 0) g_blocked_connection_count--;
    }

    uint64_t now =
        server_time_ms();

    if (connection->send_capacity >
            SEND_BUF_INITIAL &&
        now - connection->last_buffer_growth >=
            NET_SEND_SHRINK_IDLE_MS) {
      uint8_t *smaller =
          realloc(
              connection->send_buf,
              SEND_BUF_INITIAL);

      if (smaller) {
        connection->send_buf = smaller;
        connection->send_capacity =
            SEND_BUF_INITIAL;
      }
    }
  } else if (!connection->write_wait_read) {
    connection->write_interest = true;
  }

  connection_refresh_interest(conn_id);

  return progressed;
}


void net_send_to_player(
    int conn_id,
    const uint8_t *data,
    size_t length) {
  net_queue_to_player(
      conn_id,
      data,
      length);

  net_flush_player(conn_id);
}


bool net_try_queue_to_player(
    int conn_id,
    const uint8_t *data,
    size_t length) {
  if (conn_id < 0 ||
      conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS ||
      !data) {
    return false;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (!connection->active ||
      !connection->ws_ready ||
      connection->write_failed) {
    return false;
  }

  if (length >
          SEND_BUF_HARD_LIMIT - 14 ||
      length >
          (size_t)INT_MAX - 14) {
    async_log(
        "[Net] Oversized packet for connection %d: %llu bytes\n",
        conn_id,
        (unsigned long long)length);

    connection->write_failed = true;
    return false;
  }

  uint8_t header[14];

  int header_length =
      ws_header(
          header,
          length);

  size_t frame_length =
      (size_t)header_length + length;

  /*
   * Reserve the complete frame before copying either component. Failure cannot
   * leave a partial WebSocket frame or falsely advance application state.
   */
  if (!connection_reserve_send(
          conn_id,
          frame_length)) {
    return false;
  }

  memcpy(
      connection->send_buf +
          connection->send_len,
      header,
      (size_t)header_length);

  connection->send_len +=
      (size_t)header_length;

  memcpy(
      connection->send_buf +
          connection->send_len,
      data,
      length);

  connection->send_len +=
      length;

  if (!connection->write_wait_read)
    connection->write_interest = true;

  connection_refresh_interest(
      conn_id);

  return true;
}


void net_queue_to_player(
    int conn_id,
    const uint8_t *data,
    size_t length) {
  (void)net_try_queue_to_player(
      conn_id,
      data,
      length);
}


void net_broadcast_to_all(const uint8_t *data, size_t length) {
  if (!data || length == 0) return;

  /* Pre-frame WebSocket binary packet ONCE for all connections */
  uint8_t stack_buf[1024];
  uint8_t *frame_buf = stack_buf;
  uint8_t *heap_buf = NULL;
  int header_len = ws_header(stack_buf, length);
  size_t total_len = (size_t)header_len + length;

  if (total_len > sizeof(stack_buf)) {
    heap_buf = malloc(total_len);
    if (!heap_buf) return;
    frame_buf = heap_buf;
    header_len = ws_header(frame_buf, length);
  }
  memcpy(frame_buf + header_len, data, length);

  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNECTIONS; i++) {
    Connection *c = &connections[i];
    if (!c->active || !c->ws_ready || c->write_failed)
      continue;

    if (connection_reserve_send(i, total_len)) {
      memcpy(c->send_buf + c->send_len, frame_buf, total_len);
      c->send_len += total_len;
      if (!c->write_wait_read)
        c->write_interest = true;
      connection_refresh_interest(i);
    }
  }

  if (heap_buf) free(heap_buf);
}


void net_flush_player(int conn_id) {
  if (conn_id < 0 ||
      conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
    return;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (!connection->active ||
      connection->write_failed ||
      connection_pending_bytes(connection) == 0) {
    return;
  }

  /* Uncork first: flush any TCP_CORK batch as a single TCP segment.
   * No-op if the socket was never corked. */
  net_uncork_player(conn_id);

  if (!connection->write_wait_read)
    connection->write_interest = true;

  connection_refresh_interest(conn_id);
}


void net_flush_all(void) {
  for (int i = 0;
       i < MAX_CONNECTIONS;
       i++) {
    if (connections[i].active &&
        connection_pending_bytes(
            &connections[i]) > 0) {
      net_flush_player(i);
    }
  }

  /*
   * Bounded shutdown-only best effort. Slow clients cannot delay shutdown
   * indefinitely.
   */
  uint64_t deadline =
      server_time_ms() + 150;

  while (server_time_ms() < deadline) {
    bool pending = false;
    size_t progress = 0;

    for (int i = 0;
         i < MAX_CONNECTIONS;
         i++) {
      if (!connections[i].active)
        continue;

      if (connection_pending_bytes(
              &connections[i]) == 0) {
        continue;
      }

      pending = true;

      progress +=
          net_drain_connection(
              i,
              NET_WRITE_BUDGET_BYTES,
              NET_WRITE_CALL_BUDGET);
    }

    if (!pending || progress == 0)
      break;
  }

  net_process_write_failures();
}


size_t net_pending_bytes(int conn_id) {
  if (conn_id < 0 ||
      conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
    return 0;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (!connection->active)
    return 0;

  return connection_pending_bytes(
      connection);
}

bool net_is_backpressured(int conn_id) {
  if (conn_id < 0 ||
      conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
    return false;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (!connection->active)
    return false;

  if (connection->write_failed)
    return true;

  if (connection_pending_bytes(connection) >= SEND_BUF_HIGH_WATER)
    return true;

  if (connection->write_blocked_since != 0) {
    uint64_t now = server_time_ms();
    if (now >= connection->write_blocked_since &&
        (now - connection->write_blocked_since) >= 250) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


/* ── TCP_CORK batching ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

void net_cork_player(int conn_id) {
#ifdef __linux__
#ifndef TCP_CORK
#define TCP_CORK 3
#endif
  if (conn_id < 0 || conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS)
    return;
  Connection *c = &connections[conn_id];
  if (!c->active || c->sock == SOCKET_INVALID)
    return;
  /* Cork the underlying fd to batch TLS records + app data */
  int cork = 1;
  setsockopt(c->sock, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_CORK, &cork, sizeof(cork));
#else
  (void)conn_id;
#endif
}

void net_uncork_player(int conn_id) {
#ifdef __linux__
#ifndef TCP_CORK
#define TCP_CORK 3
#endif
  if (conn_id < 0 || conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS)
    return;
  Connection *c = &connections[conn_id];
  if (!c->active || c->sock == SOCKET_INVALID)
    return;
  int cork = 0;
  setsockopt(c->sock, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_CORK, &cork, sizeof(cork));
#else
  (void)conn_id;
#endif
}


static void net_close_connection_slot(
    int conn_id,
    bool notify_game) {
  if (conn_id < 0 ||
      conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
    return;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (!connection->active)
    return;

  if (notify_game)
    client_disconnect(&connection->handler);

#ifdef __linux__
  if (connection->sock != SOCKET_INVALID)
    epoll_del_fd(connection->sock);
#endif

  if (connection->tls) {
    tls_close(connection->tls);
    connection->tls = NULL;
  }

  if (connection->sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
    CLOSESOCKET(connection->sock);
    connection->sock = SOCKET_INVALID;
  }

  conn_free_buffers(connection);

  connection->active = false;
  connection->ws_ready = false;
  connection->write_interest = false;
  connection->write_wait_read = false;
  connection->read_wait_write = false;
  connection->write_failed = false;
  if (connection->write_blocked_since != 0) {
    connection->write_blocked_since = 0;
    if (g_blocked_connection_count > 0) g_blocked_connection_count--;
  }
  connection->last_buffer_growth = 0;
  connection->last_activity = 0;
}


void net_process_write_failures(void) {
  if (g_blocked_connection_count <= 0)
    return;

  uint64_t now =
      server_time_ms();

  for (int i = 0;
       i < MAX_CONNECTIONS;
       i++) {
    Connection *connection =
        &connections[i];

    if (!connection->active)
      continue;

    if (!connection->write_failed &&
        connection->write_blocked_since > 0) {
      uint64_t stall_dur = now - connection->write_blocked_since;
      bool is_spectator = false;
      if (connection->handler.player_id >= 0 && connection->handler.server) {
        Player *p = &connection->handler.server->players[connection->handler.player_id];
        if (p->spectate || p->full_map_spectate || p->free_roam) {
          is_spectator = true;
        }
      }

      uint64_t timeout_ms = is_spectator ? 60000ULL : NET_WRITE_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS;
      if (stall_dur >= timeout_ms) {
        connection->write_failed = true;

        async_log(
            "[Net] Connection %d (spectator=%d) exceeded the %llums "
            "write-stall timeout\n",
            i,
            is_spectator ? 1 : 0,
            (unsigned long long)timeout_ms);
      }
    }

    if (!connection->write_failed)
      continue;

    async_log(
        "[Net] Closing failed or backpressured "
        "connection %d\n",
        i);

    net_close_connection_slot(
        i,
        true);
  }
}


/* ── Kick a connection: best-effort notice + close ───────────── */

void net_kick_connection(
    int conn_id,
    const char *reason) {
  if (conn_id < 0 ||
      conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
    return;
  }

  Connection *connection =
      &connections[conn_id];

  if (!connection->active)
    return;

  if (connection->ws_ready &&
      !connection->write_failed) {
    BinaryWriter writer;
    bw_init(&writer);

    pkt_102_disconnect(&writer);

    net_queue_to_player(
        conn_id,
        bw_data(&writer),
        bw_length(&writer));

    if (reason) {
      Color color = {
          0xFF,
          0x44,
          0x44,
      };

      pkt_chat_message(
          &writer,
          "SERVER",
          color,
          0x80,
          reason);

      net_queue_to_player(
          conn_id,
          bw_data(&writer),
          bw_length(&writer));
    }

    bw_free(&writer);

    /*
     * One bounded best-effort drain. The connection is then closed even if
     * the peer is not writable.
     */
    net_drain_connection(
        conn_id,
        65536,
        4);
  }

  net_close_connection_slot(
      conn_id,
      true);
}


static void set_nonblocking(socket_t sock) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  u_long mode = 1;
  ioctlsocket(sock, FIONBIO, &mode);
#else
  int flags = fcntl(sock, F_GETFL, 0);
  fcntl(sock, F_SETFL, flags | O_NONBLOCK);
#endif
}




/* ── Process a connection ────────────────────────────────────── */

static void process_connection(Connection *conn) {
  if (!conn->recv_buf || !conn->send_buf) {
    async_log("[FATAL] process_connection: NULL buffer! recv=%p send=%p conn=%d\n",
              (void*)conn->recv_buf, (void*)conn->send_buf, conn->handler.conn_id);
    return;
  }
  /* Try to read data */
  int space = RECV_BUF_SIZE - conn->recv_len - 1;
  if (space <= 0) {
    async_log(
        "[Net] Receive buffer exhausted on conn %d; closing invalid frame\n",
        conn->handler.conn_id);
    net_close_connection_slot(conn->handler.conn_id, true);
    return;
  }

  int n = net_recv(
      conn,
      conn->recv_buf + conn->recv_len,
      space);

  if (n == TLS_IO_WANT_READ) {
    conn->read_wait_write = false;
    connection_refresh_interest(
        conn->handler.conn_id);
    return;
  }

  if (n == TLS_IO_WANT_WRITE) {
    conn->read_wait_write = true;
    connection_refresh_interest(
        conn->handler.conn_id);
    return;
  }

  if (n <= 0) {
    if (n < 0 && !conn->tls) {
#ifdef _WIN32
      if (WSAGetLastError() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK)
        return;
#else
      if (errno == EAGAIN ||
          errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
        return;
      }
#endif
    }

    net_close_connection_slot(
        conn->handler.conn_id,
        true);

    return;
  }

  conn->read_wait_write = false;
  conn->recv_len += n;
  conn->last_activity = server_time_ms();

  /* Re-arm TCP_QUICKACK: Linux reverts to delayed-ACK mode after each recv.
   * Without this, the kernel batches ACKs with a ~40ms timer, stalling the
   * client's TCP stack from sending the next mouse packet. */
#ifdef __linux__
  {
    int quickack = 1;
    setsockopt(conn->sock, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_QUICKACK,
               &quickack, sizeof(quickack));
  }
#endif

  connection_refresh_interest(
      conn->handler.conn_id);

  /* If not yet WS-ready, try handshake */
  if (!conn->ws_ready) {
    conn->recv_buf[conn->recv_len] = '\0';
    if (strstr((char *)conn->recv_buf, "\r\n\r\n")) {
      if (do_ws_handshake(conn) < 0) {
        net_close_connection_slot(conn->handler.conn_id, true);
        return;
      }
      INFO_LOG("[Net] Connection %d WebSocket ready\n", conn->handler.conn_id);
    }
    return;
  }

  /* Parse complete WebSocket frames. */
  while (conn->recv_len > 0) {
    const uint8_t *payload = NULL;
    int frame_len = 0;
    int opcode = 0;

    int payload_len = ws_read_frame(
        conn->recv_buf,
        conn->recv_len,
        &payload,
        &frame_len,
        &opcode);

    if (payload_len == WS_PARSE_NEED_MORE)
      break;

    if (payload_len == WS_PARSE_PROTOCOL_ERROR) {
      async_log(
          "[Net] Invalid WebSocket frame on conn %d; closing\n",
          conn->handler.conn_id);
      net_close_connection_slot(conn->handler.conn_id, true);
      return;
    }

    if (frame_len <= 0 || frame_len > conn->recv_len) {
      net_close_connection_slot(conn->handler.conn_id, true);
      return;
    }

    if (opcode == 0x08) {
      net_close_connection_slot(conn->handler.conn_id, true);
      return;
    }

    if (opcode == 0x09) {
      /* RFC 6455 ping → pong with identical application payload. */
      if (net_queue_control_frame(
              conn, 0x0A, payload, (size_t)payload_len)) {
        net_flush_player(conn->handler.conn_id);
      }
    } else if (opcode == 0x02) {
      client_handle_message(
          &conn->handler,
          payload,
          (size_t)payload_len);
    } else {
      /* Pong is consumed without game dispatch. */
    }

    if (!conn->active)
      return;

    int remaining = conn->recv_len - frame_len;

    if (remaining > 0) {
      memmove(
          conn->recv_buf,
          conn->recv_buf + frame_len,
          (size_t)remaining);
    }

    conn->recv_len = remaining;
  }
}

/* ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void net_cleanup_init_failure(void) {
  atomic_store_explicit(&running, 0, memory_order_release);

#ifndef _WIN32
  atomic_store_explicit(
      &accept_thread_running, 0, memory_order_release);
  atomic_store_explicit(
      &accept_thread_started, 0, memory_order_release);
#endif

  if (plain_listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
    CLOSESOCKET(plain_listen_sock);
    plain_listen_sock = SOCKET_INVALID;
  }

  if (listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
    CLOSESOCKET(listen_sock);
    listen_sock = SOCKET_INVALID;
  }

#ifdef __linux__
  if (epoll_fd >= 0) {
    close(epoll_fd);
    epoll_fd = -1;
  }
#endif

  free(connections);
  connections = NULL;

  if (g_tls_ctx) {
    tls_shutdown(g_tls_ctx);
    g_tls_ctx = NULL;
  }
  discord_oauth_shutdown();
  g_use_tls = false;

  rq_head = 0;
  rq_tail = 0;
  g_blocked_connection_count = 0;

#ifdef _WIN32
  if (rq_sync_initialized) {
    DeleteCriticalSection(&rq_cs);
    rq_sync_initialized = false;
  }
  if (g_winsock_started) {
    WSACleanup();
    g_winsock_started = false;
  }
#endif
}

int net_init(GameServer *server, uint16_t port, const char *cert_path,
             const char *key_path) {
  (void)server;
#ifdef _WIN32
  WSADATA wsa;
  if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsa) != 0) {
    async_log("[Net] WSAStartup failed\n");
    return -1;
  }
  g_winsock_started = true;
#else
  /* Ignore SIGPIPE so broken TLS/TCP writes don't kill the server */
  signal(SIGPIPE, SIG_IGN);
#endif

  if (!connections) {
    connections = (Connection *)calloc(MAX_CONNECTIONS, sizeof(Connection));
    if (!connections) {
      async_log("[Net] Failed to allocate connections memory\n");
      goto fail;
    }
  } else {
    memset(connections, 0, (size_t)MAX_CONNECTIONS * sizeof(Connection));
  }
  /* Note: buffers start NULL — allocated by conn_alloc_buffers on connect */

  /* Initialize TLS if cert/key provided */
  g_use_tls = false;
  g_tls_ctx = NULL;
  if (cert_path && key_path) {
    /* Initialize Discord OAuth (reads DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET env var) */
    discord_oauth_init();
    g_tls_ctx = tls_init(cert_path, key_path);
    if (g_tls_ctx) {
      g_use_tls = true;
      INFO_LOG("[Net] TLS enabled\n");
    } else {
      async_log("[Net] WARNING: TLS init failed, falling back to plain WS\n");
    }
  }

  listen_sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
  if (listen_sock == SOCKET_INVALID) {
    printf("[Net] Failed to create socket\n");
    goto fail;
  }

  /* Allow port reuse */
  int opt = 1;
  setsockopt(listen_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, (const char *)&opt,
             sizeof(opt));
#ifdef SO_REUSEPORT
  setsockopt(listen_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEPORT, (const char *)&opt,
             sizeof(opt));
#endif

  struct sockaddr_in addr;
  memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
  addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
  addr.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
  addr.sin_port = htons(port);

  if (bind(listen_sock, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) ==
      SOCKET_ERROR_VAL) {
    printf("[Net] Bind failed on port %d\n", port);
    goto fail;
  }

  if (listen(listen_sock, SOMAXCONN) == SOCKET_ERROR_VAL) {
    printf("[Net] Listen failed on port %d\n", port);
    goto fail;
  }

  set_nonblocking(listen_sock);
  atomic_store_explicit(
      &running, 1, memory_order_release);

#ifdef __linux__
  epoll_fd = epoll_create1(0);
  if (epoll_fd < 0) {
    async_log("[Net] epoll_create1 failed\n");
    goto fail;
  }
  /* Note: listen_sock is NOT added to epoll — accept thread owns it */
  INFO_LOG("[Net] Using epoll for I/O\n");
#endif

  /* Start accept thread — handles TCP accept + TLS handshake off main thread */
#ifdef _WIN32
  InitializeCriticalSection(&rq_cs);
  rq_sync_initialized = true;
  accept_thread_handle =
      CreateThread(NULL, 0, accept_thread_func, NULL, 0, NULL);
  if (!accept_thread_handle) {
    async_log("[Net] Failed to create accept thread\n");
    goto fail;
  } else {
    INFO_LOG("[Net] Accept thread started\n");
  }
#else
  atomic_store_explicit(
      &accept_thread_running, 1, memory_order_release);

  if (pthread_create(
          &accept_thread_id,
          NULL,
          accept_thread_func,
          NULL) != 0) {
    async_log("[Net] Failed to create accept thread\n");
    atomic_store_explicit(
        &accept_thread_running, 0, memory_order_release);
    goto fail;
  } else {
    atomic_store_explicit(
        &accept_thread_started, 1, memory_order_release);
    INFO_LOG("[Net] Accept thread started\n");
  }
#endif

  INFO_LOG("[Net] WebSocket server listening on %s://localhost:%d\n",
            g_use_tls ? "wss" : "ws", port);

  /* ── Plain WS listener on port+1 (localhost only) for local bots ── */
  if (g_use_tls) {
    plain_listen_sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (plain_listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
      int popt = 1;
      setsockopt(plain_listen_sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, (const char *)&popt,
                 sizeof(popt));
      struct sockaddr_in paddr;
      memset(&paddr, 0, sizeof(paddr));
      paddr.sin_family = AF_INET;
      paddr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(0x7F000001); /* 127.0.0.1 only */
      paddr.sin_port = htons(port + 1);
      if (bind(plain_listen_sock, (struct sockaddr *)&paddr, sizeof(paddr)) == SOCKET_ERROR_VAL ||
          listen(plain_listen_sock, SOMAXCONN) == SOCKET_ERROR_VAL) {
        async_log("[Net] Plain WS listener on port %d failed (non-fatal)\n", port + 1);
        CLOSESOCKET(plain_listen_sock);
        plain_listen_sock = SOCKET_INVALID;
      } else {
        set_nonblocking(plain_listen_sock);
        INFO_LOG("[Net] Plain WS listener on ws://127.0.0.1:%d (for local bots)\n", port + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  return 0;

fail:
  net_cleanup_init_failure();
  return -1;
}

void net_run(GameServer *server, int timeout_ms) {
  if (!atomic_load_explicit(
          &running,
          memory_order_acquire)) {
    return;
  }

  ReadyConn ready;

  while (rq_pop(&ready)) {
    int slot = -1;

    for (int i = 0;
         i < MAX_CONNECTIONS;
         i++) {
      if (!connections[i].active) {
        slot = i;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (slot < 0) {
      async_log(
          "[Net] Maximum connection capacity reached\n");

      if (ready.tls)
        tls_close(ready.tls);

      CLOSESOCKET(ready.sock);
      continue;
    }

    Connection *connection =
        &connections[slot];

    memset(
        connection,
        0,
        sizeof(*connection));

    connection->sock = ready.sock;
    connection->tls = ready.tls;
    connection->client_ip =
        ready.client_ip;

    if (!conn_alloc_buffers(connection)) {
      if (connection->tls)
        tls_close(connection->tls);

      CLOSESOCKET(connection->sock);

      memset(
          connection,
          0,
          sizeof(*connection));

      continue;
    }

    connection->active = true;
    connection->last_activity =
        server_time_ms();

    int keepalive = 1;

    setsockopt(
        ready.sock,
        SOL_SOCKET,
        SO_KEEPALIVE,
        (const char *)&keepalive,
        sizeof(keepalive));

#ifdef __linux__
    int idle = 30;
    int interval = 10;
    int count = 3;

    setsockopt(
        ready.sock,
        IPPROTO_TCP,
        TCP_KEEPIDLE,
        &idle,
        sizeof(idle));

    setsockopt(
        ready.sock,
        IPPROTO_TCP,
        TCP_KEEPINTVL,
        &interval,
        sizeof(interval));

    setsockopt(
        ready.sock,
        IPPROTO_TCP,
        TCP_KEEPCNT,
        &count,
        sizeof(count));
#endif

    client_init(
        &connection->handler,
        slot,
        server);

#ifdef __linux__
    epoll_add_conn(
        ready.sock,
        CONNECTION_BASE_EVENTS,
        slot);
#endif
  }

#ifdef __linux__
  struct epoll_event events[EPOLL_MAX_EVENTS];

  int count = epoll_wait(
      epoll_fd,
      events,
      EPOLL_MAX_EVENTS,
      timeout_ms);

  if (count < 0) {
    if (errno != EINTR) {
      async_log(
          "[Net] epoll_wait failed: %s\n",
          strerror(errno));
    }

    return;
  }

  for (int i = 0;
       i < count;
       i++) {
    int conn_id =
        events[i].data.fd;

    if (conn_id < 0 ||
        conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) {
      continue;
    }

    Connection *connection =
        &connections[conn_id];

    if (!connection->active)
      continue;

    uint32_t event_flags =
        events[i].events;

    if (event_flags &
        (EPOLLERR |
         EPOLLHUP |
         EPOLLRDHUP)) {
      net_close_connection_slot(
          conn_id,
          true);
      continue;
    }

    bool retry_read_for_write =
        (event_flags & EPOLLOUT) &&
        connection->read_wait_write;

    if ((event_flags & EPOLLIN) ||
        retry_read_for_write) {
      PROF_START_NS(net_read_ns);
      process_connection(connection);
      PROF_ADD_NS(net_read_ns);
    }

    if (!connection->active)
      continue;

    bool output_ready =
        (event_flags & EPOLLOUT) != 0;

    bool tls_input_ready =
        connection->write_wait_read &&
        (event_flags & EPOLLIN);

    if (connection_pending_bytes(connection) > 0 &&
        (output_ready || tls_input_ready)) {
      PROF_START_NS(net_write_ns);
      net_drain_connection(
          conn_id,
          NET_WRITE_BUDGET_BYTES,
          NET_WRITE_CALL_BUDGET);
      PROF_ADD_NS(net_write_ns);
    }
  }

#else
  fd_set read_fds;
  fd_set write_fds;

  FD_ZERO(&read_fds);
  FD_ZERO(&write_fds);

  socket_t max_fd = 0;
  bool has_active = false;

  for (int i = 0;
       i < MAX_CONNECTIONS;
       i++) {
    Connection *connection =
        &connections[i];

    if (!connection->active)
      continue;

#ifndef _WIN32
    /* Guard: if the fd exceeds FD_SETSIZE, close it rather than crashing on POSIX select(). */
    if ((int)connection->sock >= FD_SETSIZE) {
      async_log("[Net] WARN: fd %d >= FD_SETSIZE %d, closing connection %d\n",
                (int)connection->sock, FD_SETSIZE, i);
      close_connection(i, true);
      continue;
    }
#endif

    FD_SET(
        connection->sock,
        &read_fds);

    if (connection->write_interest ||
        connection->read_wait_write) {
      FD_SET(
          connection->sock,
          &write_fds);
    }

    if (connection->sock > max_fd)
      max_fd = connection->sock;

    has_active = true;
  }

  if (!has_active) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    Sleep(timeout_ms);
#else
    usleep(
        (useconds_t)timeout_ms * 1000U);
#endif
  } else {
    struct timeval timeout;

    timeout.tv_sec =
        timeout_ms / 1000;

    timeout.tv_usec =
        (timeout_ms % 1000) * 1000;

    int ready_count = select(
        (int)(max_fd + 1),
        &read_fds,
        &write_fds,
        NULL,
        &timeout);

    if (ready_count > 0) {
      for (int i = 0;
           i < MAX_CONNECTIONS;
           i++) {
        Connection *connection =
            &connections[i];

        if (!connection->active)
          continue;

        bool readable =
            FD_ISSET(
                connection->sock,
                &read_fds);

        bool writable =
            FD_ISSET(
                connection->sock,
                &write_fds);

        if (readable ||
            (writable &&
             connection->read_wait_write)) {
          process_connection(connection);
        }

        if (!connection->active)
          continue;

        if (connection_pending_bytes(connection) > 0 &&
            (writable ||
             (readable &&
              connection->write_wait_read))) {
          net_drain_connection(
              i,
              NET_WRITE_BUDGET_BYTES,
              NET_WRITE_CALL_BUDGET);
        }
      }
    }
  }
#endif

  net_process_write_failures();

  static uint64_t last_sweep = 0;

  uint64_t now =
      server_time_ms();

  if (now - last_sweep >= 5000) {
    last_sweep = now;

    for (int i = 0;
         i < MAX_CONNECTIONS;
         i++) {
      Connection *connection =
          &connections[i];

      if (!connection->active)
        continue;

      if (now - connection->last_activity <=
          300000) {
        continue;
      }

      net_close_connection_slot(
          i,
          true);
    }
  }
}


void net_stop(void) {
  atomic_store_explicit(&running, 0, memory_order_release);
}

uint32_t net_get_client_ip(int conn_id) {
  if (conn_id < 0 || conn_id >= MAX_CONNECTIONS) return 0;
  return connections[conn_id].client_ip;
}

void net_shutdown(void) {
  /* Stop accept thread first. */
  atomic_store_explicit(&running, 0, memory_order_release);

#ifdef _WIN32
  if (accept_thread_handle) {
    if (listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
      CLOSESOCKET(listen_sock);
      listen_sock = SOCKET_INVALID;
    }

    /* TLS handshakes have a bounded socket timeout; wait until the worker has
     * actually exited before destroying its lock or unloading OpenSSL. */
    WaitForSingleObject(accept_thread_handle, INFINITE);
    CloseHandle(accept_thread_handle);
    accept_thread_handle = NULL;
  }
#else
  atomic_store_explicit(
      &accept_thread_running, 0, memory_order_release);

  if (listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
    CLOSESOCKET(listen_sock);
    listen_sock = SOCKET_INVALID;
  }

  if (atomic_exchange_explicit(
          &accept_thread_started,
          0,
          memory_order_acq_rel)) {
    pthread_join(accept_thread_id, NULL);
  }
#endif

  /* Close plain WS listener */
  if (plain_listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
    CLOSESOCKET(plain_listen_sock);
    plain_listen_sock = SOCKET_INVALID;
  }

  /* Close all active connections */
  if (connections) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNECTIONS; i++) {
      if (connections[i].active) {
        net_close_connection_slot(i, true);
      }
    }
    free(connections);
    connections = NULL;
  }

  /* Drain any remaining connections in the accept queue */
  ReadyConn rc;
#ifdef _WIN32
  if (rq_sync_initialized) {
#endif
  while (rq_pop(&rc)) {
    if (rc.tls)
      tls_close(rc.tls);
    CLOSESOCKET(rc.sock);
  }

#ifdef _WIN32
    DeleteCriticalSection(&rq_cs);
    rq_sync_initialized = false;
  }
#endif

  rq_head = 0;
  rq_tail = 0;
  g_blocked_connection_count = 0;

  if (listen_sock != SOCKET_INVALID) {
#ifdef __linux__
    epoll_del_fd(listen_sock);
#endif
    CLOSESOCKET(listen_sock);
    listen_sock = SOCKET_INVALID;
  }

#ifdef __linux__
  if (epoll_fd >= 0) {
    close(epoll_fd);
    epoll_fd = -1;
  }
#endif

  if (g_tls_ctx) {
    tls_shutdown(g_tls_ctx);
    g_tls_ctx = NULL;
  }
  g_use_tls = false;

  discord_oauth_shutdown();

#ifdef _WIN32
  if (g_winsock_started) {
    WSACleanup();
    g_winsock_started = false;
  }
#endif
}

#ifndef NET_H

 * client and does not perform an unbounded write.

 * uncork after the burst to flush everything as a single TCP segment.
 * Eliminates packet-train fragmentation caused by TCP_NODELAY on small writes.
 */

 * for this connection. World Spectate uses this to keep at most one world
 * frame in flight instead of building a stale frame queue.
