typedef struct {
  int32_t x;
  int32_t y;
  uint32_t mass;
} GhostCell;

/* MAX_PLAYER_NAME, MAX_PLAYER_SKIN, MAX_OWN_CELLS, MAX_POTIONS,
 * COMPACTED_DROP_INIT all defined in config.h */

/* ── Anti-Teaming (Delta extra decay multiplier) ────────────── */
/* Single floating-point multiplier — actions increase it, time decreases it.
 * Effective decay = base_decay × pow(AT_BASE, extra_decay_multiplier).
 * multiplier=0 → 1× normal, multiplier=5 → ~1.5×, multiplier=10 → ~2.3×. */

/* ── Potion system ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef enum {
  POTION_NONE = 0,
  POTION_COMMON,   /* 30s brew, 10-30 coins */
  POTION_UNCOMMON, /* 2min brew, 30-80 coins, 1 DNA */
  POTION_EXOTIC,   /* 10min brew, 80-200 coins, 2-3 DNA */
  POTION_LEGENDARY /* 30min brew, 200-900 coins, 5-10 DNA */
} PotionRarity;

/* Brew durations defined in config.h (BREW_COMMON, etc.) */

typedef struct {
  PotionRarity rarity;
  uint32_t brew_start_tick; /* 0 = not brewing yet */
  uint32_t brew_duration;   /* ticks to complete */
  bool ready;               /* true = brew finished, awaiting open */
} Potion;

/* ── Potion helper functions (inline for use across modules) ── */

static inline uint32_t potion_brew_duration(PotionRarity r) {
  switch (r) {
  case POTION_COMMON:
    return BREW_COMMON;
  case POTION_UNCOMMON:
    return BREW_UNCOMMON;
  case POTION_EXOTIC:
    return BREW_EXOTIC;
  case POTION_LEGENDARY:
    return BREW_LEGENDARY;
  default:
    return BREW_COMMON;
  }
}

static inline const char *potion_rarity_name(PotionRarity r) {
  switch (r) {
  case POTION_COMMON:
    return "Common";
  case POTION_UNCOMMON:
    return "Uncommon";
  case POTION_EXOTIC:
    return "Exotic";
  case POTION_LEGENDARY:
    return "Legendary";
  default:
    return "Unknown";
  }
}

typedef struct Player {
  int id;

  /*
   * Monotonic identity for this allocation of a reusable player slot.
   * Player.id alone is not sufficient because disconnected slots are reused.
   */
  uint64_t lifecycle_generation;

  bool active;
  bool is_removed;

  /* Legend Mod identification (set via opcode 201) */
  bool is_lm_client; /* true if this connection is a Legend Mod client */
  bool is_lm_bot;    /* true if this connection is a Legend Mod bot */

  /* Identity */
  char name[MAX_PLAYER_NAME + 1];
  char skin[MAX_PLAYER_SKIN + 1];
  char clan_tag[16];  /* team group — players with same tag get team broadcasts */
  Color color;

  /* Cells owned by this player */
  Cell *cells[MAX_OWN_CELLS];
  int cell_count;

  /*
   * View tracking:
   *
   * client_nodes contains the pool-slot pointer.
   * client_handles contains generation<<32 | protocol_id for the same entry.
   *
   * If a pool slot is reused, the pointer remains equal but its generation
   * changes. The stale entry is then removed lazily for this viewer without a
   * global connected-player scan.
   */
  Cell **client_nodes;
  uint64_t *client_handles;
  uint8_t *view_state;

  /*
   * Exact number of bytes allocated for view_state.
   *
   * Do not infer this from MAX_CELLS at reset sites. The state is a packed
   * two-bit array and must be cleared using its actual allocation length.
   */
  size_t view_state_bytes;

  int client_count;
  int client_capacity;

  /*
   * Protocol IDs belonging to stale generation handles. These are serialized
   * as explicit DELETE records. The queue is dynamically allocated so inactive
   * player slots do not each reserve a fixed 1 KiB array.
   */
  uint32_t *compacted_drop_ids;
  int compacted_drop_count;
  int compacted_drop_capacity;

  int bp_stall_ticks;

  Vec2 center;
  double total_mass;
  int active_cell_count;

  /*
   * Owned-cell metadata computed together with center and total_mass.
   *
   * Bot perception and tactics read these fields instead of rescanning
   * Player.cells[] independently.
   */
  Cell *largest_cell;
  Cell *smallest_cell;
  Vec2 cell_centroid; /* arithmetic center, preserving social-engine behavior */
  Rect cell_bounds;   /* bounds of living cell center positions */
  Vec2 prev_center;  /* center from last full view diff */
  double scale;
  double last_alive_scale; /* saved viewport scale at death — keeps death view tight */
  double prev_scale;  /* scale from last full view diff */
  Rect viewbox;

  /* Input */
  Vec2 mouse;
  Vec2 mouse_target; /* raw incoming position; mouse smooths toward this */
  bool split_requested;
  int pending_splits; /* queued splits — processed all at once before collisions */
  bool eject_requested;

  /* Spectate */
  bool spectate;
  bool free_roam;
  bool full_map_spectate; /* reveal prioritized cells across the map */
  bool full_map_resync_pending; /* rebuild view after socket backpressure */
  int clear_view_sent;          /* progress cursor for multi-packet DELETE flushes */
  int spectate_target_id; /* -1 = largest */

  /* Scramble (anti-cheat) */
  double scramble_x;
  double scramble_y;
  uint32_t scramble_id;

  /* Score */
  double score;
  int place; /* leaderboard position */

  /* Timing */
  int border_counter;
  int tick_leaderboard;
  int last_keypress_tick;
  int last_input_tick; /* tick when last mouse input arrived (RTT estimate) */
  uint32_t last_eject_tick;
  uint32_t last_center_tick; /* tick when center was last computed */
  uint32_t last_ghost_send_tick;
  uint32_t last_ghost_mass_bucket;
  int last_lb_place_sent;
  uint32_t last_lb_send_tick;
  bool force_full_diff_next_tick;

  /* Persistent identity (for playerdb) */
  char uid[64]; /* hashed auth token or IP — key into PlayerDB */
  int db_index; /* cached index into playerdb (-1 = not looked up) */
  PlayerRecord *cached_rec; /* populated after auth, reused to avoid
                                    * repeated playerdb_lookup() calls */

  /* Connection reference */
  int conn_id; /* index into connection array */
  int protocol;

  /* Merge override */
  bool merge_override;
  bool frozen;
  bool is_local; /* true if connection is from localhost (127.0.0.1) — used to
                  * reduce bandwidth for same-machine bots */
  bool is_bot;   /* true if embedded C bot */

  /* Anti-Teaming (Delta extra decay multiplier) */
  double    extra_decay_multiplier; /* current AT penalty — actions increase, time decreases */
  double    anti_danger_accum;      /* danger zone penalty accumulator (bumps multiplier each decay cycle) */

  /* Ghost cells (snapshot of cells at moment of death) */
  GhostCell ghost_cells[MAX_OWN_CELLS];
  int ghost_cell_count;
  bool ghost_cells_pending; /* true = need to send opcode 69 */
  int prev_cell_count;      /* cell count from previous tick */

  /* Session stats (tracked during gameplay, sent on death) */
  uint32_t spawn_tick;    /* tick when player spawned */
  uint32_t highest_mass;  /* peak mass this session */
  uint32_t session_xp;    /* XP earned this life (mass/sec, capped 25000) */
  uint32_t food_eaten;    /* food cells consumed */
  uint32_t players_eaten; /* player cells consumed */
  uint32_t viruses_eaten; /* viruses popped */
  uint32_t mass_consumed; /* total mass absorbed */
  uint32_t quest_session_start_mass; /* mass counter at quest activation/login */
  uint32_t cells_eaten;   /* all non-player cells eaten (food+ejected) */
  int top_position;       /* best leaderboard position (1=first) */
  uint32_t time_on_lb;    /* ticks spent on leaderboard */

  /* Auth state */
  bool linked; /* true if authenticated via opcode 102 (Google/Facebook/Discord) */
  bool login_bonus_applied; /* true after login mass bonus was given this session */
  int auth_provider; /* 0=unknown, 1=google, 2=facebook, 3=discord */
  char social_id[32];       /* Raw social ID (Google sub / Discord user ID) */
  char display_name[64];    /* Real name from OAuth provider (Google/Discord) */

  /* ── Potion system ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  Potion potions[MAX_POTIONS]; /* brewing inventory */
  int potion_count;            /* active potion slots used */
  uint32_t coins_session;      /* coins earned this session (shown at death) */
  double xp_boost;             /* multiplier from potions (1.0 = no boost) */
  double mass_boost;           /* multiplier from boosts (1.0 = no boost) */
} Player;

/*
 * Spectator-mode classification used during transitions.
 *
 * Every connection now maintains an exact individual client_nodes/view_state
 * set. Grouped modes still share their spatial query, but no longer share the
 * per-connection known-cell state.
 */
typedef enum {
  PLAYER_VIEW_TRACKING_INDIVIDUAL = 0,
  PLAYER_VIEW_TRACKING_GROUPED_SHARED,
} PlayerViewTrackingSource;


static inline PlayerViewTrackingSource
player_view_tracking_source(
    const Player *player) {
  if (!player ||
      player->cell_count > 0 ||
      !player->spectate) {
    return PLAYER_VIEW_TRACKING_INDIVIDUAL;
  }

  if (!player->free_roam) {
    return PLAYER_VIEW_TRACKING_GROUPED_SHARED;
  }


  return PLAYER_VIEW_TRACKING_INDIVIDUAL;
}

/*
 * Only authenticated remote human accounts may enter PlayerDB.
 *
 * Anonymous guests retain their fallback UID for session mechanics, but that
 * UID must never create a permanent profile. Local stress-test bots and
 * clients explicitly identified as LM bots are always non-persistent.
 */
static inline bool player_profile_is_persistent(const Player *player) {
  return player &&
         player->linked &&
         !player->is_local &&
         !player->is_lm_bot &&
         player->uid[0] != '\0';
}

/* Initialize a player (zeroed, no buffers allocated) */
void player_init(Player *p, int id);

/* Allocate dynamic view/client buffers (call when player connects) */
int player_alloc_buffers(Player *p);  /* returns -1 on OOM */

/* Grow client_nodes for exceptional views such as full-map spectate.
 * Existing entries and view state remain intact. */
int player_ensure_client_capacity(Player *p, int required_capacity);

/*
 * Atomically clear every component of individual client-view tracking while
 * retaining the allocated buffers for reuse.
 */
void player_clear_view_tracking(Player *p);

/*
 * Atomically replace a viewer's exact known-cell snapshot.
 *
 * Capacity is reserved and every incoming pointer is validated before the
 * current state is modified. compacted_drop_ids are cleared only on success,
 * after the corresponding packet has entered the network queue.
 */
int player_replace_view_tracking(
    Player *player,
    Cell *const *nodes,
    int count,
    Cell *cell_base,
    int cell_capacity);

/* Refresh pointer-generation metadata after client_nodes was reordered. */
void player_refresh_tracking_metadata(Player *p);

/*
 * Remove stale reused-slot handles, clear their view_state entries and queue
 * their old protocol IDs for deletion.
 *
 * Returns the number removed, or -1 on allocation failure.
 */
int player_prune_stale_tracking(
    Player *p,
    Cell *cell_base,
    int cell_capacity);

int player_queue_compacted_drop(
    Player *p,
    uint32_t cell_id);

/* Free dynamic view/client buffers (call when player disconnects) */
void player_free_buffers(Player *p);

/* Reset a player to inactive (frees buffers) */
void player_reset(Player *p);

/* Set player name and skin from join message */
void player_set_identity(Player *p, const char *name, const char *skin);

/* Generate scramble values */
void player_scramble(Player *p, int scramble_level, double border_w,
                     double border_h);

/* Calculate player's center position from owned cells.
 * Skips recalculation if already done this tick. */
void player_update_view_center(Player *p, uint32_t tick);

/* Get living scale (zoom factor based on total cell radius) */
double player_get_living_scale(const Player *p, double min_scale,
                               double view_base_x, double view_base_y);

/* ── FNV-1a hash ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static uint32_t fnv1a(const char *data, int len) {
  uint32_t hash = 2166136261u;
  for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    hash ^= (uint8_t)data[i];
    hash *= 16777619u;
  }
  return hash;
}

/* ── Hash UID string to table index ──────────────────────────── */

static int hash_index(const char *uid) {
  uint32_t h = fnv1a(uid, (int)strlen(uid));
  return (int)(h & (PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS - 1));
}

/* ── Public: hash an input string into a hex UID ─────────────── */

void playerdb_hash_uid(char *dst, const char *input, int input_len) {
  /* Use two rounds of FNV-1a to produce a 16-char hex string */
  uint32_t h1 = fnv1a(input, input_len);
  uint32_t h2 = fnv1a(input, input_len);
  /* Mix: rotate h2 by using a different seed */
  h2 ^= 0xDEADBEEF;
  for (int i = 0; i < input_len; i++) {
    h2 ^= (uint8_t)input[i];
    h2 *= 16777619u;
  }
  snprintf(dst, PLAYERDB_UID_LEN, "%08x%08x", h1, h2);
}

/* ── CRC32 for journal validation ────────────────────────────── */

static uint32_t crc32(const void *data, size_t length) {
  const uint8_t *p = data;
  uint32_t crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    crc ^= p[i];
    for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
      crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320 & (-(crc & 1)));
    }
  }
  return ~crc;
}

/* ── Init & Free ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void playerdb_init(PlayerDB *db) {
  if (!db)
    return;

  /*
   * server_init zeroes PlayerDB. playerdb_load may call this function again,
   * so an already initialized database is preserved.
   */
  if (db->records)
    return;

  db->records = calloc(
      PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS,
      sizeof(PlayerRecord));

  db->occupied = calloc(
      PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS,
      sizeof(bool));

  db->record_dirty = calloc(
      PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS,
      sizeof(bool));

  db->dirty_indices = malloc(
      PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS *
      sizeof(int));

  if (!db->records ||
      !db->occupied ||
      !db->record_dirty ||
      !db->dirty_indices) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] FATAL: database allocation failed\n");

    playerdb_free(db);
    abort();
  }
}

void playerdb_free(PlayerDB *db) {
  if (db->records) free(db->records);
  if (db->occupied) free(db->occupied);
  if (db->record_dirty) free(db->record_dirty);
  if (db->dirty_indices) free(db->dirty_indices);
  memset(db, 0, sizeof(*db));
}

/* Clear fields that did not exist in a historical raw-struct record.
 * Legacy record sizes include tail padding, which overlaps the next field in
 * the current struct. Explicit clearing prevents those padding bytes from
 * becoming bogus boosts, names, profile stats, or economy state. */
static void playerdb_apply_migration_defaults(PlayerRecord *rec,
                                              size_t record_size) {
  if (!rec || record_size >= sizeof(*rec))
    return;

  size_t clear_from = PLAYERDB_V5_RECORD_SIZE;
  if (record_size == PLAYERDB_V1_RECORD_SIZE)
    clear_from = offsetof(PlayerRecord, boost_mass);
  else if (record_size == PLAYERDB_V2_RECORD_SIZE)
    clear_from = offsetof(PlayerRecord, display_name);
  else if (record_size == PLAYERDB_V3_RECORD_SIZE)
    clear_from = offsetof(PlayerRecord, equipped_skin);
  else if (record_size == PLAYERDB_V4_RECORD_SIZE)
    clear_from = offsetof(PlayerRecord, created_at);

  if (clear_from < sizeof(*rec))
    memset((uint8_t *)rec + clear_from, 0, sizeof(*rec) - clear_from);
  rec->active_mass_boost_idx = 0xff;
  rec->active_xp_boost_idx = 0xff;
}

/* ── Load from binary file ───────────────────────────────────── */

/* File format: [uint32_t count][PlayerRecord * count] */

int playerdb_load(PlayerDB *db, const char *path) {
  playerdb_init(db);

  int loaded = 0;
  FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
  if (!f) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] No baseline database at '%s'; "
        "checking recovery journal\n",
        path);
    goto load_journal;
  }

  uint32_t count = 0;
  if (fread(&count, sizeof(count), 1, f) != 1) {
    fclose(f);
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Failed to read baseline record count; "
        "checking recovery journal\n");
    goto load_journal;
  }

  if (count > PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS)
    count = PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS;

  /* Detect the append-only record format by exact file size. */
  fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
  long file_size = ftell(f);
  fseek(f, sizeof(uint32_t), SEEK_SET);

  long header_size = (long)sizeof(uint32_t);
  long expected_v1 = header_size + (long)count * (long)PLAYERDB_V1_RECORD_SIZE;
  long expected_v2 = header_size + (long)count * (long)PLAYERDB_V2_RECORD_SIZE;
  long expected_v3 = header_size + (long)count * (long)PLAYERDB_V3_RECORD_SIZE;
  long expected_v4 = header_size + (long)count * (long)PLAYERDB_V4_RECORD_SIZE;
  long expected_v5 = header_size + (long)count * (long)PLAYERDB_V5_RECORD_SIZE;
  long expected_v6 = header_size + (long)count * (long)sizeof(PlayerRecord);

  size_t read_size = sizeof(PlayerRecord); /* V6 */
  if (count > 0 && file_size == expected_v1 && file_size != expected_v6) {
    read_size = PLAYERDB_V1_RECORD_SIZE;
    async_log("[PlayerDB] Detected V1 format, migrating to V6\n");
  } else if (count > 0 && file_size == expected_v2 && file_size != expected_v6) {
    read_size = PLAYERDB_V2_RECORD_SIZE;
    async_log("[PlayerDB] Detected V2 format, migrating to V6\n");
  } else if (count > 0 && file_size == expected_v3 && file_size != expected_v6) {
    read_size = PLAYERDB_V3_RECORD_SIZE;
    async_log("[PlayerDB] Detected V3 format, migrating to V6\n");
  } else if (count > 0 && file_size == expected_v4 && file_size != expected_v6) {
    read_size = PLAYERDB_V4_RECORD_SIZE;
    async_log("[PlayerDB] Detected V4 format, migrating to V6\n");
  } else if (count > 0 && file_size == expected_v5 && file_size != expected_v6) {
    read_size = PLAYERDB_V5_RECORD_SIZE;
    async_log("[PlayerDB] Detected V5 format, migrating economy state to V6\n");
  } else if (count > 0 && file_size != expected_v6) {
    fclose(f);
    async_log("[PlayerDB] Unknown players.dat record size (%ld bytes); refusing unsafe load\n",
              file_size);
    goto load_journal;
  }

  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    PlayerRecord rec;
    memset(&rec, 0, sizeof(rec));

    if (fread(&rec, read_size, 1, f) != 1)
      break;

    /* Insert into hash table */
    int idx = hash_index(rec.uid);
    int attempts = 0;
    while (db->occupied[idx] && attempts < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
      idx = (idx + 1) & (PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS - 1);
      attempts++;
    }
    if (attempts >= PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS)
      break; /* table full */

    db->records[idx] = rec;
    /* Clear legacy tail padding first, then derive safe defaults. */
    if (read_size < sizeof(PlayerRecord))
      playerdb_apply_migration_defaults(&db->records[idx], read_size);
    if (db->records[idx].created_at == 0 && db->records[idx].last_seen > 0)
      db->records[idx].created_at = db->records[idx].last_seen;
    db->occupied[idx] = true;
    db->count++;
    loaded++;
  }

  fclose(f);

  /* If old format was loaded, mark dirty so next save writes new format */
  if (read_size != sizeof(PlayerRecord) && loaded > 0) {
    db->dirty_count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS; i++) {
      if (db->occupied[i]) {
        db->record_dirty[i] = true;
        if (db->dirty_count < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
          db->dirty_indices[db->dirty_count++] = i;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  async_log("[PlayerDB] Loaded %d player records from '%s'\n", loaded, path);

load_journal:
  ;
  /* Overlay append-only journal entries if it exists */
  char journal_path[512];
  snprintf(journal_path, sizeof(journal_path), "%s.journal", path);
  FILE *jf = fopen(journal_path, "rb");
  if (jf) {
    int j_loaded = 0;
    JournalEntryHeader hdr;
    PlayerRecord jrec;
    uint8_t raw_record[sizeof(PlayerRecord)];
    while (fread(&hdr, sizeof(JournalEntryHeader), 1, jf) == 1) {
      bool supported_size =
          hdr.size == sizeof(PlayerRecord) ||
          hdr.size == PLAYERDB_V5_RECORD_SIZE ||
          hdr.size == PLAYERDB_V4_RECORD_SIZE ||
          hdr.size == PLAYERDB_V3_RECORD_SIZE ||
          hdr.size == PLAYERDB_V2_RECORD_SIZE ||
          hdr.size == PLAYERDB_V1_RECORD_SIZE;
      if (hdr.magic != PLAYERDB_JOURNAL_MAGIC || !supported_size ||
          hdr.version != 1) {
        async_log("[PlayerDB] Journal header invalid, halting load.\n");
        break;
      }
      memset(raw_record, 0, sizeof(raw_record));
      if (fread(raw_record, hdr.size, 1, jf) != 1) {
        async_log("[PlayerDB] Journal torn write detected, halting load.\n");
        break;
      }
      if (crc32(raw_record, hdr.size) != hdr.crc32) {
        async_log("[PlayerDB] Journal CRC mismatch, halting load.\n");
        break;
      }
      memset(&jrec, 0, sizeof(jrec));
      memcpy(&jrec, raw_record, hdr.size);
      if (hdr.size < sizeof(PlayerRecord))
        playerdb_apply_migration_defaults(&jrec, hdr.size);

      /* Find slot */
      int idx = hash_index(jrec.uid);
      int attempts = 0;
      while (db->occupied[idx] && attempts < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
        if (strcmp(db->records[idx].uid, jrec.uid) == 0) {
          break; /* found existing */
        }
        idx = (idx + 1) & (PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS - 1);
        attempts++;
      }
      if (attempts >= PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) continue;

      if (!db->occupied[idx]) {
        db->occupied[idx] = true;
        db->count++;
      }
      db->records[idx] = jrec;
      
      /* Force a compaction since we loaded from a journal */
      db->journal_writes++;
      j_loaded++;
    }
    fclose(jf);
    if (j_loaded > 0) {
      async_log("[PlayerDB] Applied %d dirty records from journal. Compaction queued.\n", j_loaded);
    }
  }

  /*
   * Include records recovered from the journal even when no baseline existed.
   */
  return db->count;
}

/* ── Failure-safe background persistence ─────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
  PlayerRecord *records;
  uint32_t count;

  char database_path[512];

  /*
   * Number of bytes in players.dat.journal that are represented by this
   * immutable snapshot.
   */
  int64_t journal_cutoff;

  /*
   * Logical journal-entry count represented by the same snapshot.
   * Main-thread journal_writes may continue increasing while the worker runs.
   */
  uint32_t compacted_entries;
} SaveSnapshot;

static SaveSnapshot save_snapshot = {0};

static atomic_bool save_in_progress = false;

/*
 * Result published by the worker:
 *   0 = no unconsumed result
 *   1 = baseline and journal-prefix compaction succeeded
 *  -1 = snapshot failed; baseline/journal recovery data was retained
 */
static atomic_int save_result = 0;

static atomic_uint save_compacted_entries = 0;

#ifdef _WIN32
static SRWLOCK playerdb_journal_mutex =
    SRWLOCK_INIT;

static void playerdb_journal_lock(void) {
  AcquireSRWLockExclusive(
      &playerdb_journal_mutex);
}

static void playerdb_journal_unlock(void) {
  ReleaseSRWLockExclusive(
      &playerdb_journal_mutex);
}
#else
static pthread_mutex_t playerdb_journal_mutex =
    PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static void playerdb_journal_lock(void) {
  pthread_mutex_lock(
      &playerdb_journal_mutex);
}

static void playerdb_journal_unlock(void) {
  pthread_mutex_unlock(
      &playerdb_journal_mutex);
}
#endif


static int playerdb_build_path(
    char *output,
    size_t output_size,
    const char *base,
    const char *suffix) {
  int length = snprintf(
      output,
      output_size,
      "%s%s",
      base,
      suffix);

  if (length < 0 ||
      length >= (int)output_size) {
    return -1;
  }

  return 0;
}


static int playerdb_sync_file(
    FILE *file) {
  if (!file)
    return -1;

  if (fflush(file) != 0)
    return -1;

#ifdef _WIN32
  return _commit(_fileno(file));
#else
  return fsync(fileno(file));
#endif
}


#ifndef _WIN32
static int playerdb_sync_parent_directory(
    const char *path) {
  char directory[512];

  const char *slash = strrchr(
      path,
      '/');

  if (!slash) {
    strcpy(directory, ".");
  } else if (slash == path) {
    strcpy(directory, "/");
  } else {
    size_t length =
        (size_t)(slash - path);

    if (length >= sizeof(directory))
      return -1;

    memcpy(
        directory,
        path,
        length);

    directory[length] = '\0';
  }

  int descriptor = open(
      directory,
      O_RDONLY | O_DIRECTORY);

  if (descriptor < 0)
    return -1;

  int result = fsync(descriptor);
  int saved_errno = errno;

  close(descriptor);
  errno = saved_errno;

  return result;
}
#endif


static int playerdb_atomic_replace(
    const char *source,
    const char *destination) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  return MoveFileExA(
             source,
             destination,
             MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING |
                 MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
             ? 0
             : -1;
#else
  if (rename(
          source,
          destination) != 0) {
    return -1;
  }

  return playerdb_sync_parent_directory(
      destination);
#endif
}


static int playerdb_remove_file(
    const char *path) {
  if (remove(path) != 0) {
    if (errno == ENOENT)
      return 0;

    return -1;
  }

#ifdef _WIN32
  return 0;
#else
  return playerdb_sync_parent_directory(path);
#endif
}


static int playerdb_seek(
    FILE *file,
    int64_t offset,
    int origin) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  return _fseeki64(
      file,
      offset,
      origin);
#else
  return fseeko(
      file,
      (off_t)offset,
      origin);
#endif
}


static int64_t playerdb_tell(
    FILE *file) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  return (int64_t)_ftelli64(file);
#else
  return (int64_t)ftello(file);
#endif
}


/*
 * Append all currently dirty records while the journal mutex is held.
 *
 * Dirty flags are cleared only after:
 *   - every header was written;
 *   - every complete PlayerRecord was written;
 *   - fflush succeeded;
 *   - fsync/_commit succeeded;
 *   - fclose succeeded.
 *
 * If cutoff_out is non-NULL, it receives the complete journal size after the
 * durable append. This byte offset defines the prefix represented by a new
 * snapshot.
 */
static int playerdb_append_dirty_locked(
    PlayerDB *db,
    const char *database_path,
    int64_t *cutoff_out) {
  char journal_path[512];

  if (playerdb_build_path(
          journal_path,
          sizeof(journal_path),
          database_path,
          ".journal") != 0) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Journal path is too long\n");
    return -1;
  }

  FILE *journal = fopen(
      journal_path,
      "ab+");

  if (!journal) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Cannot open journal '%s': %s\n",
        journal_path,
        strerror(errno));
    return -1;
  }

  JournalEntryHeader header;
  header.magic = PLAYERDB_JOURNAL_MAGIC;
  header.version = 1;
  header.size =
      (uint16_t)sizeof(PlayerRecord);

  uint32_t appended = 0;
  bool success = true;

  for (uint32_t i = 0;
       i < db->dirty_count;
       i++) {
    int index =
        db->dirty_indices[i];

    if (index < 0 ||
        index >= PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS ||
        !db->occupied[index] ||
        !db->record_dirty[index]) {
      continue;
    }

    header.crc32 = crc32(
        &db->records[index],
        sizeof(PlayerRecord));

    if (fwrite(
            &header,
            sizeof(header),
            1,
            journal) != 1 ||
        fwrite(
            &db->records[index],
            sizeof(PlayerRecord),
            1,
            journal) != 1) {
      async_log(
          "[PlayerDB] Journal write failed: %s\n",
          strerror(errno));
      success = false;
      break;
    }

    appended++;
  }

  if (success &&
      playerdb_sync_file(journal) != 0) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Journal flush/fsync failed: %s\n",
        strerror(errno));
    success = false;
  }

  int64_t journal_end = -1;

  if (success) {
    if (playerdb_seek(
            journal,
            0,
            SEEK_END) != 0) {
      success = false;
    } else {
      journal_end =
          playerdb_tell(journal);

      if (journal_end < 0)
        success = false;
    }
  }

  if (fclose(journal) != 0) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Journal fclose failed: %s\n",
        strerror(errno));
    success = false;
  }

  if (!success) {
    /*
     * Keep every dirty flag. A later retry may append duplicate complete
     * records, which is safe because replay uses the latest record by UID.
     */
    return -1;
  }

  for (uint32_t i = 0;
       i < db->dirty_count;
       i++) {
    int index =
        db->dirty_indices[i];

    if (index >= 0 &&
        index < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
      db->record_dirty[index] = false;
    }
  }

  db->dirty_count = 0;

  if (UINT32_MAX -
          db->journal_writes <
      appended) {
    db->journal_writes =
        UINT32_MAX;
  } else {
    db->journal_writes +=
        appended;
  }

  if (cutoff_out)
    *cutoff_out = journal_end;

  return 0;
}


static int playerdb_journal_append(
    PlayerDB *db,
    const char *database_path) {
  int result;

  playerdb_journal_lock();

  result = playerdb_append_dirty_locked(
      db,
      database_path,
      NULL);

  playerdb_journal_unlock();

  return result;
}


/*
 * After a baseline snapshot has been atomically installed, remove only the
 * journal prefix represented by it.
 *
 * Entries appended after snapshot creation are copied into a temporary file
 * and atomically installed as the new active journal.
 *
 * The journal mutex prevents simultaneous appends while this short suffix
 * operation runs.
 */
static int playerdb_compact_journal_prefix(
    const char *database_path,
    int64_t cutoff) {
  char journal_path[512];
  char temporary_path[512];

  if (playerdb_build_path(
          journal_path,
          sizeof(journal_path),
          database_path,
          ".journal") != 0 ||
      playerdb_build_path(
          temporary_path,
          sizeof(temporary_path),
          database_path,
          ".journal.compact.tmp") != 0) {
    return -1;
  }

  int result = 0;

  playerdb_journal_lock();

  FILE *source = fopen(
      journal_path,
      "rb");

  if (!source) {
    if (errno != ENOENT)
      result = -1;

    playerdb_journal_unlock();
    return result;
  }

  if (playerdb_seek(
          source,
          0,
          SEEK_END) != 0) {
    fclose(source);
    playerdb_journal_unlock();
    return -1;
  }

  int64_t total_size =
      playerdb_tell(source);

  if (total_size < 0 ||
      total_size < cutoff) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Journal size is smaller than "
        "snapshot cutoff; journal retained\n");

    fclose(source);
    playerdb_journal_unlock();
    return -1;
  }

  if (playerdb_seek(
          source,
          cutoff,
          SEEK_SET) != 0) {
    fclose(source);
    playerdb_journal_unlock();
    return -1;
  }

  FILE *destination = fopen(
      temporary_path,
      "wb");

  if (!destination) {
    fclose(source);
    playerdb_journal_unlock();
    return -1;
  }

  uint8_t buffer[64 * 1024];
  int64_t suffix_bytes = 0;

  while (1) {
    size_t count = fread(
        buffer,
        1,
        sizeof(buffer),
        source);

    if (count > 0) {
      if (fwrite(
              buffer,
              1,
              count,
              destination) != count) {
        result = -1;
        break;
      }

      suffix_bytes +=
          (int64_t)count;
    }

    if (count < sizeof(buffer)) {
      if (ferror(source))
        result = -1;

      break;
    }
  }

  if (result == 0 &&
      playerdb_sync_file(destination) != 0) {
    result = -1;
  }

  if (fclose(source) != 0 &&
      result == 0) {
    result = -1;
  }

  if (fclose(destination) != 0 &&
      result == 0) {
    result = -1;
  }

  if (result == 0) {
    if (suffix_bytes == 0) {
      remove(temporary_path);

      if (playerdb_remove_file(
              journal_path) != 0) {
        result = -1;
      }
    } else if (playerdb_atomic_replace(
                   temporary_path,
                   journal_path) != 0) {
      result = -1;
    }
  }

  if (result != 0) {
    /*
     * The active journal is never replaced until the complete suffix has been
     * written and synced. Therefore failure leaves the original recovery
     * journal intact.
     */
    remove(temporary_path);
  }

  playerdb_journal_unlock();

  return result;
}


static void playerdb_consume_save_result(
    PlayerDB *db) {
  int result = atomic_exchange_explicit(
      &save_result,
      0,
      memory_order_acq_rel);

  if (result != 1 || !db)
    return;

  uint32_t compacted =
      atomic_exchange_explicit(
          &save_compacted_entries,
          0,
          memory_order_acq_rel);

  /*
   * journal_writes may include later entries appended while the snapshot
   * thread was running. Remove only the logical prefix represented by the
   * completed snapshot.
   */
  if (db->journal_writes >= compacted)
    db->journal_writes -= compacted;
  else
    db->journal_writes = 0;
}


#ifdef _WIN32
static DWORD WINAPI playerdb_save_thread(
    LPVOID argument) {
#else
static void *playerdb_save_thread(
    void *argument) {
#endif
  SaveSnapshot *snapshot =
      (SaveSnapshot *)argument;

  bool success = true;

  char temporary_path[512];

  if (playerdb_build_path(
          temporary_path,
          sizeof(temporary_path),
          snapshot->database_path,
          ".tmp") != 0) {
    success = false;
  }

  FILE *file = NULL;

  if (success) {
    file = fopen(
        temporary_path,
        "wb");

    if (!file) {
      async_log(
          "[PlayerDB] Cannot open snapshot temporary "
          "file '%s': %s\n",
          temporary_path,
          strerror(errno));

      success = false;
    }
  }

  if (success &&
      fwrite(
          &snapshot->count,
          sizeof(snapshot->count),
          1,
          file) != 1) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Failed to write snapshot count: %s\n",
        strerror(errno));

    success = false;
  }

  if (success &&
      snapshot->count > 0 &&
      fwrite(
          snapshot->records,
          sizeof(PlayerRecord),
          snapshot->count,
          file) != snapshot->count) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Incomplete snapshot record write: %s\n",
        strerror(errno));

    success = false;
  }

  if (success &&
      playerdb_sync_file(file) != 0) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Snapshot flush/fsync failed: %s\n",
        strerror(errno));

    success = false;
  }

  if (file &&
      fclose(file) != 0) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Snapshot fclose failed: %s\n",
        strerror(errno));

    success = false;
  }

  if (success &&
      playerdb_atomic_replace(
          temporary_path,
          snapshot->database_path) != 0) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Atomic snapshot replacement failed: %s\n",
        strerror(errno));

    success = false;
  }

  if (success &&
      playerdb_compact_journal_prefix(
          snapshot->database_path,
          snapshot->journal_cutoff) != 0) {
    /*
     * The new baseline is valid, but the old complete journal was intentionally
     * retained. Replaying duplicate complete records is safe.
     */
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Baseline committed, but journal prefix "
        "could not be compacted; full journal retained\n");

    success = false;
  }

  if (success) {
    atomic_store_explicit(
        &save_compacted_entries,
        snapshot->compacted_entries,
        memory_order_release);

    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Durably saved %u records to '%s'\n",
        snapshot->count,
        snapshot->database_path);
  } else {
    remove(temporary_path);

    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Snapshot operation failed; "
        "database and journal recovery data retained\n");
  }

  free(snapshot->records);
  snapshot->records = NULL;
  snapshot->count = 0;

  atomic_store_explicit(
      &save_result,
      success ? 1 : -1,
      memory_order_release);

  atomic_store_explicit(
      &save_in_progress,
      false,
      memory_order_release);

#ifdef _WIN32
  return 0;
#else
  return NULL;
#endif
}


void playerdb_wait_save(
    PlayerDB *db) {
  while (atomic_load_explicit(
      &save_in_progress,
      memory_order_acquire)) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    Sleep(10);
#else
    struct timespec delay = {
        .tv_sec = 0,
        .tv_nsec = 10000000,
    };

    nanosleep(&delay, NULL);
#endif
  }

  playerdb_consume_save_result(db);
}


int playerdb_save(
    PlayerDB *db,
    const char *path) {
  if (!db || !path)
    return -1;

  playerdb_consume_save_result(db);

  /*
   * Avoid a complete hash-table scan when there is nothing new to compact.
   */
  if (db->dirty_count == 0 &&
      db->journal_writes == 0) {
    return 0;
  }

  bool expected = false;

  if (!atomic_compare_exchange_strong_explicit(
          &save_in_progress,
          &expected,
          true,
          memory_order_acq_rel,
          memory_order_acquire)) {
    return 1;
  }

  atomic_store_explicit(
      &save_result,
      0,
      memory_order_release);

  int64_t journal_cutoff = 0;
  uint32_t compacted_entries = 0;

  /*
   * Append and measure the snapshot journal prefix under one lock.
   */
  playerdb_journal_lock();

  int journal_result =
      playerdb_append_dirty_locked(
          db,
          path,
          &journal_cutoff);

  if (journal_result == 0)
    compacted_entries =
        db->journal_writes;

  playerdb_journal_unlock();

  if (journal_result != 0) {
    atomic_store_explicit(
        &save_in_progress,
        false,
        memory_order_release);

    return -1;
  }

  if (db->count < 0 ||
      db->count > PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Invalid in-memory record count: %d\n",
        db->count);

    atomic_store_explicit(
        &save_in_progress,
        false,
        memory_order_release);

    return -1;
  }

  uint32_t expected_count =
      (uint32_t)db->count;

  PlayerRecord *records = NULL;

  if (expected_count > 0) {
    records = malloc(
        (size_t)expected_count *
        sizeof(PlayerRecord));

    if (!records) {
      /*
       * Dirty records are already durable in the journal. Nothing is cleared
       * from disk and the original baseline remains installed.
       */
      async_log(
          "[PlayerDB] Snapshot allocation failed "
          "for %u records\n",
          expected_count);

      atomic_store_explicit(
          &save_in_progress,
          false,
          memory_order_release);

      return -1;
    }
  }

  uint32_t copied = 0;

  for (int i = 0;
       i < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS;
       i++) {
    if (!db->occupied[i])
      continue;

    if (copied >= expected_count) {
      async_log(
          "[PlayerDB] occupied/count invariant mismatch\n");

      free(records);

      atomic_store_explicit(
          &save_in_progress,
          false,
          memory_order_release);

      return -1;
    }

    records[copied++] =
        db->records[i];
  }

  if (copied != expected_count) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Snapshot count mismatch: "
        "expected=%u copied=%u\n",
        expected_count,
        copied);

    free(records);

    atomic_store_explicit(
        &save_in_progress,
        false,
        memory_order_release);

    return -1;
  }

  int path_length = snprintf(
      save_snapshot.database_path,
      sizeof(save_snapshot.database_path),
      "%s",
      path);

  if (path_length < 0 ||
      path_length >=
          (int)sizeof(save_snapshot.database_path)) {
    free(records);

    atomic_store_explicit(
        &save_in_progress,
        false,
        memory_order_release);

    return -1;
  }

  save_snapshot.records = records;
  save_snapshot.count = copied;
  save_snapshot.journal_cutoff =
      journal_cutoff;
  save_snapshot.compacted_entries =
      compacted_entries;

#ifdef _WIN32
  HANDLE thread = CreateThread(
      NULL,
      0,
      playerdb_save_thread,
      &save_snapshot,
      0,
      NULL);

  if (thread) {
    CloseHandle(thread);
  } else {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Cannot create save thread; "
        "saving synchronously\n");

    playerdb_save_thread(
        &save_snapshot);
  }
#else
  pthread_t thread;
  pthread_attr_t attributes;

  int attribute_result =
      pthread_attr_init(&attributes);

  int create_result = -1;

  if (attribute_result == 0) {
    pthread_attr_setdetachstate(
        &attributes,
        PTHREAD_CREATE_DETACHED);

    create_result = pthread_create(
        &thread,
        &attributes,
        playerdb_save_thread,
        &save_snapshot);

    pthread_attr_destroy(&attributes);
  }

  if (create_result != 0) {
    async_log(
        "[PlayerDB] Cannot create save thread; "
        "saving synchronously\n");

    playerdb_save_thread(
        &save_snapshot);
  }
#endif

  return 0;
}

PlayerRecord *playerdb_lookup(PlayerDB *db, const char *uid) {
  if (!uid || !uid[0])
    return NULL;

  int idx = hash_index(uid);
  int attempts = 0;

  /* Linear probe: find existing */
  while (db->occupied[idx] && attempts < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
    if (strcmp(db->records[idx].uid, uid) == 0) {
      return &db->records[idx]; /* found */
    }
    idx = (idx + 1) & (PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS - 1);
    attempts++;
  }

  /* Not found — create new if table has space */
  if (db->count >= PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
    /*
     * Avoid a log and disk-I/O storm if many unknown authenticated users reach
     * a full table. Log the first rejection and then one per 1,024 attempts.
     */
    static uint64_t full_rejection_count = 0;
    full_rejection_count++;

    if (full_rejection_count == 1 ||
        (full_rejection_count & 1023ULL) == 0) {
      async_log(
          "[PlayerDB] Database full (%d records, rejected=%llu)\n",
          db->count,
          (unsigned long long)full_rejection_count);
    }

    return NULL;
  }

  /* Find empty slot (continue probing) */
  while (db->occupied[idx]) {
    idx = (idx + 1) & (PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS - 1);
  }

  memset(&db->records[idx], 0, sizeof(PlayerRecord));
  strncpy(db->records[idx].uid, uid, PLAYERDB_UID_LEN - 1);
  db->records[idx].uid[PLAYERDB_UID_LEN - 1] = '\0';
  db->occupied[idx] = true;
  db->count++;
  if (!db->record_dirty[idx]) {
    db->record_dirty[idx] = true;
    if (db->dirty_count < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
      db->dirty_indices[db->dirty_count++] = idx;
    }
  }

  if (db->count >
      (int)(PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS * 0.70)) {
    async_log("[PlayerDB] WARNING: High load factor! Count=%u/%u (>70%%)\n", db->count, PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS);
  }

  /* New players start at level 1 — playerdb_calc_level(0) returns 1,
   * but the record needs it explicitly set so the login response
   * sends level=1 before the first death triggers playerdb_update. */
  db->records[idx].level = 1;
  db->records[idx].active_mass_boost_idx = 0xff;
  db->records[idx].active_xp_boost_idx = 0xff;

  /* Set created_at to current time for new players */
  db->records[idx].created_at = (uint64_t)time(NULL);

  async_log("[PlayerDB] New player: '%s' (total: %d)\n", uid, db->count);
  return &db->records[idx];
}

/* ── Level calculation (exact Agar.io thresholds) ────────────── */
/* L=1→0, L=2→35, L=3→125, L=4→250, L=5→500,
 * L≥6 → 50*L*(L-1) - 500.  Max level = 100. */

static uint32_t level_xp_threshold(uint32_t level) {
  switch (level) {
  case 0:
  case 1:
    return 0;
  case 2:
    return 35;
  case 3:
    return 125;
  case 4:
    return 250;
  case 5:
    return 500;
  default:
    return 50 * level * (level - 1) - 500;
  }
}

uint32_t playerdb_calc_level(uint32_t total_xp) {
  /* Binary search: find highest L where threshold(L) <= total_xp */
  uint32_t lo = 1, hi = 100;
  while (lo < hi) {
    uint32_t mid = (lo + hi + 1) / 2;
    if (level_xp_threshold(mid) <= total_xp)
      lo = mid;
    else
      hi = mid - 1;
  }
  return lo;
}

/* ── Update after session ────────────────────────────────────── */

void playerdb_update(PlayerDB *db, const char *uid, uint32_t session_xp,
                     uint32_t session_peak_mass, uint32_t food_eaten,
                     uint32_t players_eaten, uint32_t alive_secs,
                     uint32_t mass_consumed, const char *display_name) {
  PlayerRecord *rec = playerdb_lookup(db, uid);
  if (!rec)
    return;

  rec->total_xp += session_xp;
  rec->games_played++;
  rec->total_food += food_eaten;
  rec->total_kills += players_eaten;
  rec->total_time_alive += alive_secs;
  rec->total_mass_consumed += mass_consumed;

  if (session_peak_mass > rec->all_time_peak_mass)
    rec->all_time_peak_mass = session_peak_mass;

  /* Update display name if provided */
  if (display_name && display_name[0]) {
    strncpy(rec->display_name, display_name, PLAYERDB_UID_LEN - 1);
    rec->display_name[PLAYERDB_UID_LEN - 1] = '\0';
  }

  rec->level = playerdb_calc_level(rec->total_xp);
  uint32_t bonus = rec->level > 1 ? rec->level - 1 : 0;
  rec->starting_mass_bonus = bonus < 28 ? bonus : 28;
  rec->last_seen = (uint64_t)time(NULL);

  playerdb_mark_dirty(db, rec);

  async_log("[PlayerDB] Updated '%s' (%s): XP=%u Level=%u Games=%u PeakMass=%u\n",
         uid, rec->display_name[0] ? rec->display_name : "?", rec->total_xp,
         rec->level, rec->games_played, rec->all_time_peak_mass);
}

/* ── Checked journal and autosave scheduler ───────────────────── */

void playerdb_tick(
    PlayerDB *db,
    const char *path,
    uint32_t journal_interval,
    uint32_t snapshot_interval) {
  if (!db || !path)
    return;

  playerdb_consume_save_result(db);

  db->save_counter++;
  db->snapshot_counter++;

  /*
   * Journal appends continue while the immutable baseline snapshot is being
   * written. The worker removes only the prefix measured at snapshot start.
   */
  if (journal_interval > 0 &&
      db->save_counter >= journal_interval) {
    if (playerdb_journal_append(
            db,
            path) == 0) {
      db->save_counter = 0;
    }
  }

  if (atomic_load_explicit(
          &save_in_progress,
          memory_order_acquire)) {
    return;
  }

  bool snapshot_due =
      (snapshot_interval > 0 &&
       db->snapshot_counter >=
           snapshot_interval) ||
      db->journal_writes > 15000;

  if (!snapshot_due)
    return;

  int result = playerdb_save(
      db,
      path);

  if (result == 0) {
    db->snapshot_counter = 0;
    db->save_counter = 0;
  } else if (result < 0) {
    /*
     * The old baseline, durable journal and in-memory dirty state remain
     * recoverable. Delay another expensive full snapshot attempt.
     */
    db->snapshot_counter = 0;
  }
}

#ifndef PLAYERDB_H
#define PLAYERDB_H

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>

/* ── Player Record (persistent data, stored in players.dat) ──── */

#define PLAYERDB_UID_LEN 64
#define PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS 262144 /* max unique players (power of two) */
#define PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_WORDS 16
#define PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_BITS (PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_WORDS * 64)
#define PLAYERDB_CUSTOM_SKIN_SLOTS 8
#define PLAYERDB_REDEEMED_PURCHASE_SLOTS 32
#define PLAYERDB_POTION_SLOTS 4

typedef struct {
  char uid[PLAYERDB_UID_LEN]; /* hashed auth token or IP (null-terminated) */
  uint32_t total_xp;          /* cumulative XP (sum of session peak masses) */
  uint32_t level;             /* computed from total_xp */
  uint32_t games_played;
  uint32_t all_time_peak_mass; /* best single-session peak mass */
  uint32_t total_kills;        /* total player cells eaten */
  uint32_t total_food;         /* total food eaten */
  uint32_t total_time_alive;   /* total seconds alive across all games */
  uint64_t last_seen;          /* unix timestamp of last game */
  uint32_t
      starting_mass_bonus; /* +1 per level-1, capped at 28 (base 10+28=38) */
  uint32_t coins;          /* in-game currency (from potions + gameplay) */
  uint32_t dna;            /* premium currency (earned slowly from potions) */
  uint32_t potions_opened; /* lifetime potion counter */
  /* Packed potion inventory: 4 rarity counts as bytes (max 255 each).
   * Byte 0 (LSB) = common, 1 = uncommon, 2 = exotic, 3 = legendary.
   * Backward compatible: old files have this as 0 (no potions). */
  uint32_t potion_inventory;
  /* Packed boost inventory: 4 boost type counts per category (max 255 each).
   * Index: 0=2x_1h, 1=2x_24h, 2=3x_1h, 3=3x_24h.
   * New fields: old files have 0 (no boosts). */
  uint32_t boost_mass;                 /* mass boost counts */
  uint32_t boost_xp;                   /* XP boost counts */
  char display_name[PLAYERDB_UID_LEN]; /* player's last known display name */
  char equipped_skin[PLAYERDB_UID_LEN]; /* vanilla skin ID e.g. "country_gr" */
  /* ── V5 fields (profile stats) ──────────────────────────── */
  uint64_t created_at;          /* unix timestamp of first login */
  uint32_t trophies;            /* trophy count (wins/achievements) */
  uint64_t total_mass_consumed; /* lifetime mass eaten */
  uint32_t quests_completed;    /* lifetime quests completed */
  uint32_t skins_created;       /* lifetime skins created */

  /* ── V6 fields: authoritative shop/inventory state ─────────── */
  uint64_t owned_skin_bits[PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_WORDS];
  uint64_t custom_skin_hashes[PLAYERDB_CUSTOM_SKIN_SLOTS];
  /* Stable hashes of one-time soft purchases / offer bundles already claimed. */
  uint64_t redeemed_purchase_hashes[PLAYERDB_REDEEMED_PURCHASE_SLOTS];
  uint64_t hourly_bonus_available_at;
  uint64_t daily_quest_reward_available_at;
  uint64_t free_coins_reward_available_at;
  uint64_t active_mass_boost_until;
  uint64_t active_xp_boost_until;
  uint64_t active_quest_until;
  uint64_t potion_slot_ready_at[PLAYERDB_POTION_SLOTS];
  uint32_t quest_goal;
  uint32_t quest_progress;
  uint32_t misc_inventory; /* bytes: quest token, brew skip, skin-create token */
  uint8_t active_mass_boost_idx; /* 0..3, 0xff = none */
  uint8_t active_xp_boost_idx;   /* 0..3, 0xff = none */
  uint8_t potion_slot_rarity[PLAYERDB_POTION_SLOTS];
  uint8_t potion_slot_status[PLAYERDB_POTION_SLOTS];
  char active_quest[PLAYERDB_UID_LEN];
} PlayerRecord;

/* Record sizes for backward compatibility. The legacy files stored raw C
 * structs, including each historical struct's trailing alignment padding.
 * Plain offsetof() is therefore too small for V1-V4. Reconstruct the exact
 * historical sizes from the known V5 prefix, preserving the old layout. */
#define PLAYERDB_V5_EXTRA                                                      \
  (sizeof(uint64_t) + sizeof(uint32_t) + sizeof(uint64_t) + sizeof(uint32_t) + \
   sizeof(uint32_t))
#define PLAYERDB_V5_RECORD_SIZE offsetof(PlayerRecord, owned_skin_bits)
#define PLAYERDB_V4_RECORD_SIZE (PLAYERDB_V5_RECORD_SIZE - PLAYERDB_V5_EXTRA)
#define PLAYERDB_V3_RECORD_SIZE (PLAYERDB_V4_RECORD_SIZE - PLAYERDB_UID_LEN)
#define PLAYERDB_V2_RECORD_SIZE (PLAYERDB_V3_RECORD_SIZE - PLAYERDB_UID_LEN)
#define PLAYERDB_V1_RECORD_SIZE                                                \
  (PLAYERDB_V2_RECORD_SIZE - 2 * sizeof(uint32_t))

/* Potion inventory helpers (pack/unpack from potion_inventory uint32_t) */
/* rarity: 0=common, 1=uncommon, 2=exotic, 3=legendary (matches PotionRarity-1)
 */
static inline uint8_t prec_potion_count(const PlayerRecord *r, int rarity) {
  return (uint8_t)((r->potion_inventory >> (rarity * 8)) & 0xFF);
}
static inline void prec_potion_set(PlayerRecord *r, int rarity, uint8_t count) {
  uint32_t mask = ~(0xFFu << (rarity * 8));
  r->potion_inventory =
      (r->potion_inventory & mask) | ((uint32_t)count << (rarity * 8));
}
static inline void prec_potion_add(PlayerRecord *r, int rarity,
                                   uint8_t amount) {
  uint8_t cur = prec_potion_count(r, rarity);
  uint8_t nv = (uint8_t)(cur + amount > 255 ? 255 : cur + amount);
  prec_potion_set(r, rarity, nv);
}
static inline bool prec_potion_sub(PlayerRecord *r, int rarity) {
  uint8_t cur = prec_potion_count(r, rarity);
  if (cur == 0)
    return false;
  prec_potion_set(r, rarity, cur - 1);
  return true;
}

/* Boost inventory helpers (same packing as potions) */
/* boost_idx: 0=2x_1h, 1=2x_24h, 2=3x_1h, 3=3x_24h */
static inline uint8_t prec_boost_count(const PlayerRecord *r, int is_xp,
                                       int boost_idx) {
  uint32_t packed = is_xp ? r->boost_xp : r->boost_mass;
  return (uint8_t)((packed >> (boost_idx * 8)) & 0xFF);
}
static inline void prec_boost_set(PlayerRecord *r, int is_xp, int boost_idx,
                                  uint8_t count) {
  uint32_t *packed = is_xp ? &r->boost_xp : &r->boost_mass;
  uint32_t mask = ~(0xFFu << (boost_idx * 8));
  *packed = (*packed & mask) | ((uint32_t)count << (boost_idx * 8));
}
static inline void prec_boost_add(PlayerRecord *r, int is_xp, int boost_idx,
                                  uint8_t amount) {
  uint8_t cur = prec_boost_count(r, is_xp, boost_idx);
  uint8_t nv = (uint8_t)(cur + amount > 255 ? 255 : cur + amount);
  prec_boost_set(r, is_xp, boost_idx, nv);
}
static inline bool prec_boost_sub(PlayerRecord *r, int is_xp, int boost_idx) {
  uint8_t cur = prec_boost_count(r, is_xp, boost_idx);
  if (cur == 0)
    return false;
  prec_boost_set(r, is_xp, boost_idx, cur - 1);
  return true;
}

#define PLAYERDB_JOURNAL_MAGIC 0x504A5231 // 'PJR1'

typedef struct {
  uint32_t magic;
  uint16_t version;
  uint16_t size;
  uint32_t crc32;
} JournalEntryHeader;

/* ── Player Database (in-memory hash table + file persistence) ── */

typedef struct {
  PlayerRecord *records;
  bool *occupied;                      /* slot occupancy flags */
  bool *record_dirty;                  /* per-record dirty flags */
  int *dirty_indices;                  /* list of dirtied indices for O(1) journal scanning */
  int count;                           /* number of active records */
  uint32_t dirty_count;                /* number of dirty records */
  uint32_t save_counter;               /* tick counter for auto-save (journal) */
  uint32_t snapshot_counter;           /* tick counter for full snapshot */
  uint32_t journal_writes;             /* tracks if journal needs compaction */
} PlayerDB;

/* Initialize the database (allocates memory and zeros slots) */
void playerdb_init(PlayerDB *db);

/* Free the dynamically allocated memory in PlayerDB */
void playerdb_free(PlayerDB *db);

/* Load records from binary file. Returns number of records loaded. */
int playerdb_load(PlayerDB *db, const char *path);

/* Save all records to binary file (atomic: write tmp, rename).
 * Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure. */
int playerdb_save(PlayerDB *db, const char *path);

/* Block execution until the background save thread finishes. */
void playerdb_wait_save(PlayerDB *db);

/* Look up a player by uid. Creates a new record if not found.
 * Returns pointer to the record, or NULL if database is full. */
PlayerRecord *playerdb_lookup(PlayerDB *db, const char *uid);

/* Update a player's persistent record after a game session.
 * session_xp = XP earned this session (mass/sec, capped at 25K/life).
 * Automatically recalculates level and starting_mass_bonus. */
void playerdb_update(PlayerDB *db, const char *uid, uint32_t session_xp,
                     uint32_t session_peak_mass, uint32_t food_eaten,
                     uint32_t players_eaten, uint32_t alive_secs,
                     uint32_t mass_consumed, const char *display_name);

/* Compute level from total_xp using exact Agar.io thresholds (max 100) */
uint32_t playerdb_calc_level(uint32_t total_xp);

/* Hash a string to produce a UID (FNV-1a, written as hex into dst).
 * dst must be at least PLAYERDB_UID_LEN bytes. */
void playerdb_hash_uid(char *dst, const char *input, int input_len);

/* Auto-save check: call every tick. Appends journal or full snapshots on intervals.
 */
void playerdb_tick(PlayerDB *db, const char *path, uint32_t journal_interval, uint32_t snapshot_interval);

/* Mark a specific player record as dirty so it will be saved next tick */
static inline void playerdb_mark_dirty(PlayerDB *db, PlayerRecord *rec) {
  if (!rec) return;
  int idx = (int)(rec - db->records);
  if (idx >= 0 && idx < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS && !db->record_dirty[idx]) {
    db->record_dirty[idx] = true;
    if (db->dirty_count < PLAYERDB_MAX_RECORDS) {
      db->dirty_indices[db->dirty_count++] = idx;
    }
  }
}
