#include "proto102.h"

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <inttypes.h>

/* ── Hex UID → numeric UID (Agar.io-style) ─────────────────── */
/* Converts internal 16-char hex hash (e.g. "a3f5b2c1deadbeef") to a
 * decimal numeric string (e.g. "11816432933848535791") matching
 * Agar.io's UID format. The hex is parsed as a uint64 and printed
 * as decimal. Result is written to dst (must be >= 21 bytes). */
static void uid_hex_to_numeric(char *dst, size_t dst_len, const char *hex_uid) {
  uint64_t val = 0;
  for (int i = 0; hex_uid[i] && i < 16; i++) {
    char c = hex_uid[i];
    uint64_t digit;
    if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') digit = (uint64_t)(c - '0');
    else if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') digit = (uint64_t)(c - 'a' + 10);
    else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') digit = (uint64_t)(c - 'A' + 10);
    else break;
    val = (val << 4) | digit;
  }
  snprintf(dst, dst_len, "%" PRIu64, val);
}

/* ── Low-level protobuf encoding ───────────────────────────── */

void pb_varint(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t value) {
  while (value > 0x7F) {
    bw_write_u8(w, (uint8_t)((value & 0x7F) | 0x80));
    value >>= 7;
  }
  bw_write_u8(w, (uint8_t)value);
}

static void pb_varint64(BinaryWriter *w, uint64_t value) {
  while (value > 0x7F) {
    bw_write_u8(w, (uint8_t)((value & 0x7F) | 0x80));
    value >>= 7;
  }
  bw_write_u8(w, (uint8_t)value);
}

void pb_tag(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, uint32_t wire_type) {
  pb_varint(w, (field << 3) | wire_type);
}

void pb_uint32(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, uint32_t value) {
  pb_tag(w, field, PB_VARINT);
  pb_varint(w, value);
}

void pb_int32(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, int32_t value) {
  pb_tag(w, field, PB_VARINT);
  /* protobuf int32 uses signed varint encoding */
  if (value >= 0) {
    pb_varint(w, (uint32_t)value);
  } else {
    /* negative int32 extends to 10-byte varint */
    pb_varint64(w, (uint64_t)(int64_t)value);
  }
}

void pb_uint64(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, uint64_t value) {
  pb_tag(w, field, PB_VARINT);
  pb_varint64(w, value);
}

void pb_string(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, const char *str) {
  if (!str)
    str = "";
  uint32_t len = (uint32_t)strlen(str);
  pb_tag(w, field, PB_LEN);
  pb_varint(w, len);
  if (len > 0)
    bw_write_bytes(w, (const uint8_t *)str, len);
}

void pb_bool(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, bool value) {
  if (value) {
    pb_tag(w, field, PB_VARINT);
    pb_varint(w, 1);
  }
}

void pb_submsg(BinaryWriter *parent, uint32_t field,
               const BinaryWriter *child) {
  if (!child)
    return;
  BinaryWriter *c = (BinaryWriter *)child;
  size_t len = bw_length(c);
  pb_tag(parent, field, PB_LEN);
  pb_varint(parent, (uint32_t)len);
  if (len > 0) {
    const uint8_t *data = bw_data(c);
    if (data)
      bw_write_bytes(parent, data, len);
  }
}

/* ── Submessage helpers ────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Encode a userWallet item: { type=1, productId=2, amount=3 } */
static void encode_user_wallet(BinaryWriter *w, int32_t type,
                               const char *product_id, uint32_t amount) {
  pb_int32(w, 1, type);
  pb_string(w, 2, product_id);
  pb_uint32(w, 3, amount);
}

static void encode_product_update_origin(BinaryWriter *parent, uint32_t field,
                                         int32_t origin,
                                         uint8_t wallet_type,
                                         const char *product_id,
                                         uint32_t amount, int32_t delta) {
  BinaryWriter pu;
  bw_init(&pu);
  pb_int32(&pu, 1, origin);
  {
    BinaryWriter wi;
    bw_init(&wi);
    encode_user_wallet(&wi, wallet_type, product_id, amount);
    pb_submsg(&pu, 2, &wi);
    bw_free(&wi);
  }
  if (delta != 0)
    pb_int32(&pu, 3, delta);
  pb_submsg(parent, field, &pu);
  bw_free(&pu);
}

static void encode_product_update(BinaryWriter *parent, uint32_t field,
                                  uint8_t wallet_type,
                                  const char *product_id,
                                  uint32_t amount, int32_t delta) {
  encode_product_update_origin(parent, field, 1, wallet_type, product_id,
                               amount, delta);
}

static uint32_t potion_seconds_remaining(const Potion *p,
                                         uint32_t server_tick) {
  if (!p || p->rarity == POTION_NONE || p->ready ||
      p->brew_start_tick == 0)
    return 0;
  uint32_t elapsed = server_tick - p->brew_start_tick;
  if (elapsed >= p->brew_duration)
    return 0;
  return (p->brew_duration - elapsed + 24u) / 25u;
}

/* Encode a userPotions item: { slot=1, status=2, secondsRemaining=3,
 * productId=4 } */
static void encode_user_potion(BinaryWriter *w, int32_t slot, int32_t status,
                               uint32_t seconds_remaining,
                               const char *product_id) {
  pb_int32(w, 1, slot);
  pb_int32(w, 2, status);
  pb_uint32(w, 3, seconds_remaining);
  if (product_id && product_id[0])
    pb_string(w, 4, product_id);
}

/* Encode xpLevelUpdates: { finalXpForLevel=1, deltaXp=2, finalLevel=3,
 * deltaLevel=4 } */
static void encode_xp_level(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t final_xp,
                            uint32_t delta_xp, uint32_t final_level,
                            uint32_t delta_level) {
  pb_uint32(w, 1, final_xp);
  pb_uint32(w, 2, delta_xp);
  pb_uint32(w, 3, final_level);
  pb_uint32(w, 4, delta_level);
}

/* Encode gameSessionStats */
static void encode_game_session_stats(BinaryWriter *w,
                                      const GameSessionStats102 *s) {
  pb_uint32(w, 1, s->mass_consumed);
  pb_uint32(w, 2, s->time_total);
  pb_uint32(w, 3, s->time_in_leaderboard);
  pb_uint32(w, 4, s->top_position);
  pb_uint32(w, 5, s->final_position);
  pb_uint32(w, 6, s->longest_time_alive);
  pb_uint32(w, 7, s->final_mass);
  pb_uint32(w, 8, s->highest_mass);
  pb_uint32(w, 9, s->normal_cells_eaten);
  pb_uint32(w, 10, s->food_eaten);
  pb_uint32(w, 11, s->viruses_eaten);
  pb_uint32(w, 12, s->players_eaten);
}

/* Encode userStats: { gamesPlayed=1, massConsumed=2, allTimeScore=3,
 *   highestMass=4, longestTimeAlive=5, mostCellsEaten=6 } */
static void encode_user_stats(BinaryWriter *w, const PlayerRecord *rec) {
  pb_uint32(w, 1, rec->games_played);
  pb_uint64(w, 2, rec->total_mass_consumed); /* massConsumed (real) */
  pb_uint64(w, 3, (uint64_t)rec->total_xp);  /* allTimeScore */
  pb_uint32(w, 4, rec->all_time_peak_mass);
  pb_uint32(w, 5, rec->total_time_alive);
  pb_uint32(w, 6, rec->total_food);
}

/* Map potion rarity to agar.io product ID strings */
static const char *potion_product_id(PotionRarity r) {
  switch (r) {
  case POTION_COMMON:
    return "mystery_potion_common";
  case POTION_UNCOMMON:
    return "mystery_potion_uncommon";
  case POTION_EXOTIC:
    return "mystery_potion_exotic";
  case POTION_LEGENDARY:
    return "mystery_potion_legendary";
  default:
    return "";
  }
}

/* Map potion status: 0=empty, 1=unbrewed, 2=brewing, 3=ready */
static int potion_status(const Potion *p) {
  if (p->rarity == POTION_NONE)
    return 0;
  if (p->ready)
    return 3; /* ready to open */
  if (p->brew_start_tick > 0)
    return 2; /* brewing */
  return 1;   /* unbrewed */
}

/* ── Envelope: wraps a sub-message inside Data { contentType=1,
 * uncompressedData={type=X, field_X=submsg} } ──── */

/* Build the full 102 packet: [0x66] + Data{contentType, uncompressedData}
 * The inner_field_num is the sub-opcode (e.g., 62 for gameOver)
 * The inner_data is the encoded sub-message. */
void build_102_envelope(BinaryWriter *out, uint32_t sub_opcode,
                               const BinaryWriter *inner_msg) {
  /* Build uncompressedData: { type=1:sub_opcode, field[sub_opcode]=inner_msg }
   */
  BinaryWriter uncomp;
  bw_init(&uncomp);
  pb_uint32(&uncomp, 1, sub_opcode);         /* type */
  pb_submsg(&uncomp, sub_opcode, inner_msg); /* the actual sub-field */

  /* Build Data: { contentType=1:1, uncompressedData=2:uncomp } */
  BinaryWriter data;
  bw_init(&data);
  pb_uint32(&data, 1, 1); /* contentType = 1 */
  pb_submsg(&data, 2, &uncomp);

  /* Write opcode 102 + data bytes */
  bw_write_u8(out, 102);
  const uint8_t *bytes = bw_data(&data);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < bw_length(&data); i++)
    bw_write_u8(out, bytes[i]);

  bw_free(&uncomp);
  bw_free(&data);
}

/* ── High-level packet builders ─────────────────────────────── */

size_t pkt_102_game_over_full(BinaryWriter *w, const Player *player,
                              const PlayerRecord *rec,
                              const GameSessionStats102 *stats,
                              int new_potion_slot, int new_potion_status,
                              uint32_t new_potion_seconds,
                              const char *new_potion_product_id,
                              bool would_have_won_potion,
                              const EconomyTransaction *session_rewards) {
  (void)player;
  BinaryWriter game_over;
  bw_init(&game_over);

  /* gameType = 1 (FFA = 0) */
  pb_int32(&game_over, 1, 0);
  /* reason = 2 (normal death = 0) */
  pb_int32(&game_over, 2, 0);

  /* productUpdates = 3. Quest/game rewards use origin 12; the client
   * filters game-over rewards by this exact origin before showing them. */
  if (session_rewards) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < session_rewards->update_count; i++) {
      const EconomyProductUpdate *u = &session_rewards->updates[i];
      encode_product_update_origin(&game_over, 3, 12, u->wallet_type,
                                   u->product_id, u->amount, u->delta);
    }
  }

  /* xpLevelUpdates = 4 (repeated, we send one) */
  {
    BinaryWriter xp;
    bw_init(&xp);
    encode_xp_level(&xp,
                    rec->total_xp % 1000, /* finalXpForLevel (xp into level) */
                    stats->mass_consumed > 0 ? stats->mass_consumed / 100
                                             : 10, /* deltaXp estimate */
                    rec->level,                    /* finalLevel */
                    0);                            /* deltaLevel */
    pb_submsg(&game_over, 4, &xp);
    bw_free(&xp);
  }

  /* userStats = 5 */
  {
    BinaryWriter us;
    bw_init(&us);
    encode_user_stats(&us, rec);
    pb_submsg(&game_over, 5, &us);
    bw_free(&us);
  }

  /* gameSessionStats = 6 */
  {
    BinaryWriter gs;
    bw_init(&gs);
    encode_game_session_stats(&gs, stats);
    pb_submsg(&game_over, 6, &gs);
    bw_free(&gs);
  }

  /* potionInfo = 7. Field 2 tells the client that a potion would have
   * been earned but all slots were occupied. */
  if ((new_potion_product_id && new_potion_product_id[0]) ||
      would_have_won_potion) {
    BinaryWriter pi;
    bw_init(&pi);
    if (new_potion_product_id && new_potion_product_id[0]) {
      BinaryWriter nup;
      bw_init(&nup);
      encode_user_potion(&nup, new_potion_slot, new_potion_status,
                         new_potion_seconds, new_potion_product_id);
      pb_submsg(&pi, 1, &nup);
      bw_free(&nup);
    }
    if (would_have_won_potion)
      pb_bool(&pi, 2, true);
    pb_submsg(&game_over, 7, &pi);
    bw_free(&pi);
  }

  build_102_envelope(w, 62, &game_over);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&game_over);
  return len;
}

size_t pkt_102_login_response(BinaryWriter *w, const PlayerRecord *rec,
                              const Player *player,
                              const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                              uint64_t now_unix, uint32_t server_tick) {
  BinaryWriter login;
  bw_init(&login);

  /* tokens = 1 (needed for client parsing — auth token contains '$') */
  {
    BinaryWriter tok;
    bw_init(&tok);
    /* auth string: "el$<UID>" — client splits on '$' to extract UID.
     * Must be long enough that total packet > 1000 bytes.
     * Convert hex UID to numeric (Agar.io-style). */
    char numeric_uid[32];
    if (player->uid[0])
      uid_hex_to_numeric(numeric_uid, sizeof(numeric_uid), player->uid);
    else
      snprintf(numeric_uid, sizeof(numeric_uid), "0");
    char auth_str[256];
    snprintf(auth_str, sizeof(auth_str), "el$%s", numeric_uid);
    pb_string(&tok, 1, auth_str);
    /* alt token (padding to help exceed 1000 bytes) */
    pb_string(&tok, 2, numeric_uid);
    pb_submsg(&login, 1, &tok);
    bw_free(&tok);
  }

  /* latestConfiguration = 5 */
  pb_uint32(&login, 5, 1);

  /* serverInfo = 6 */
  {
    BinaryWriter si;
    bw_init(&si);
    pb_string(&si, 1, "ffa.legendmod.ml"); /* host — must match actual WS endpoint */
    pb_uint32(&si, 2, 8080);              /* tcpPort — must match actual WS endpoint */
    pb_string(&si, 4, "EU-London");        /* awsRegion */
    pb_submsg(&login, 6, &si);
    bw_free(&si);
  }

  /* userInfo = 7 (expanded with realmInfo for profile picture) */
  {
    BinaryWriter ui;
    bw_init(&ui);
    /* userId — client does split('$')[1].substr(0,36) to get agarioUID.
     * Prefix with auth provider name so the client knows the login source.
     * Use numeric UID (Agar.io-style) instead of hex hash. */
    char user_id[128];
    const char *provider_prefix = "google"; /* default */
    if (player->auth_provider == 2) provider_prefix = "facebook";
    else if (player->auth_provider == 3) provider_prefix = "discord";
    char numeric_uid2[32];
    if (player->uid[0])
      uid_hex_to_numeric(numeric_uid2, sizeof(numeric_uid2), player->uid);
    else
      snprintf(numeric_uid2, sizeof(numeric_uid2), "00000000000000000000");
    snprintf(user_id, sizeof(user_id), "%s$%s",
             provider_prefix, numeric_uid2);
    pb_string(&ui, 1, user_id);
    /* displayName — use OAuth display name if available, else player nick */
    if (player->display_name[0])
      pb_string(&ui, 2, player->display_name);
    else if (player->name[0])
      pb_string(&ui, 2, player->name);
    else
      pb_string(&ui, 2, "Player");
    /* Compute XP within current level for progress bar.
     * Client formula (ogario.v4.js agarExp):
     *   level 1→50, 2→125, 3→250, 4→500
     *   level>4 → sum(1..level)*100 - 500
     * xp_in_level = total_xp - sum(agarExp(k) for k=1..level-1)
     * Clamped to [0, agarExp(level)]. */
    {
      uint32_t level = rec->level;
      /* Compute cumulative XP required for all previous levels */
      uint32_t cumulative_xp = 0;
      for (uint32_t k = 1; k < level; k++) {
        if (k <= 1)      cumulative_xp += 50;
        else if (k == 2)  cumulative_xp += 125;
        else if (k == 3)  cumulative_xp += 250;
        else if (k == 4)  cumulative_xp += 500;
        else              cumulative_xp += k * (k + 1) / 2 * 100 - 500;
      }
      /* XP earned inside current level */
      uint32_t xp_in_level = 0;
      if (rec->total_xp > cumulative_xp)
        xp_in_level = rec->total_xp - cumulative_xp;
      /* Clamp to current level requirement */
      uint32_t xp_for_cur;
      if (level <= 1)      xp_for_cur = 50;
      else if (level == 2) xp_for_cur = 125;
      else if (level == 3) xp_for_cur = 250;
      else if (level == 4) xp_for_cur = 500;
      else                 xp_for_cur = level * (level + 1) / 2 * 100 - 500;
      if (xp_in_level > xp_for_cur)
        xp_in_level = xp_for_cur;
      pb_uint32(&ui, 3, xp_in_level);              /* xp (within level) */
    }
    pb_uint32(&ui, 4, rec->level);               /* level */
    pb_uint32(&ui, 9, rec->starting_mass_bonus); /* extraInitialMass */
    /* actionCounters = 10 */
    {
      BinaryWriter ac;
      bw_init(&ac);
      pb_uint32(&ac, 1, rec->quests_completed);   /* questsCompleted */
      pb_uint32(&ac, 2, rec->potions_opened);    /* potionsObtained */
      pb_uint32(&ac, 3, rec->skins_created);      /* skinsCreated */
      pb_submsg(&ui, 10, &ac);
      bw_free(&ac);
    }
    /* accountAge in seconds — compute from created_at */
    pb_string(&ui, 11, "US"); /* latestCountryCode */
    {
      uint32_t age_secs = 30 * 86400; /* fallback: 30 days */
      if (rec->created_at > 0) {
        uint64_t now = (uint64_t)time(NULL);
        if (now > rec->created_at)
          age_secs = (uint32_t)(now - rec->created_at);
      }
      pb_uint32(&ui, 12, age_secs);
    }
    /* realmInfo = 8 (contains realm type and avatarUrl for profile picture) */
    {
      BinaryWriter ri;
      bw_init(&ri);
      /* realm: 1=Google, 2=Facebook, 3=Discord */
      int realm = 1; /* default Google */
      if (player->auth_provider == 2) realm = 2;
      else if (player->auth_provider == 3) realm = 3;
      pb_int32(&ri, 1, realm);
      /* userId in realmInfo = the raw social ID (Google sub / Discord user ID)
       * This is what Agar.io shows as "Social ID" in the profile panel. */
      if (player->social_id[0])
        pb_string(&ri, 2, player->social_id);
      else {
        /* Fallback: send numeric UID if no social ID available */
        char ri_uid[32];
        if (player->uid[0])
          uid_hex_to_numeric(ri_uid, sizeof(ri_uid), player->uid);
        else
          snprintf(ri_uid, sizeof(ri_uid), "anon");
        pb_string(&ri, 2, ri_uid);
      }
      /* avatarUrl — NOT sent from server. Profile picture is rendered
       * client-side only (Google userinfo.picture / Discord CDN).
       * This saves bandwidth and avoids server storing avatar URLs. */
      pb_submsg(&ui, 8, &ri);
      bw_free(&ri);
    }
    pb_submsg(&login, 7, &ui);
    bw_free(&ui);
  }

  /* userStats = 8 */
  {
    BinaryWriter us;
    bw_init(&us);
    encode_user_stats(&us, rec);
    pb_submsg(&login, 8, &us);
    bw_free(&us);
  }

  /* userWallet = 9 (repeated: coins, DNA, trophies) */
  {
    BinaryWriter wc;
    bw_init(&wc);
    encode_user_wallet(&wc, 1, "coin", rec->coins);
    pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wc);
    bw_free(&wc);
  }
  {
    BinaryWriter wd;
    bw_init(&wd);
    encode_user_wallet(&wd, 1, "dna", rec->dna);
    pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wd);
    bw_free(&wd);
  }
  {
    BinaryWriter wt;
    bw_init(&wt);
    encode_user_wallet(&wt, 7, "", rec->trophies);
    pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wt);
    bw_free(&wt);
  }

  /* userSettings = 10 (repeated — includes skin setting) */
  {
    BinaryWriter sk;
    bw_init(&sk);
    pb_int32(&sk, 1, 1); /* type = 1 */
    pb_int32(&sk, 2, 1); /* key = 1 */
    /* valueString — client looks for 'skin_' pattern */
    const char *skin_val =
        (rec->equipped_skin[0]) ? rec->equipped_skin : "skin_empty";
    pb_string(&sk, 3, skin_val);
    pb_submsg(&login, 10, &sk);
    bw_free(&sk);
  }

  /* Inventory wallet items. UserBoosts is reserved for ACTIVE boosts. */
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    uint8_t count = prec_boost_count(rec, 0, i);
    if (count) {
      BinaryWriter wi;
      bw_init(&wi);
      encode_user_wallet(&wi, 2, economy_boost_product_id(0, i), count);
      pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wi);
      bw_free(&wi);
    }
    count = prec_boost_count(rec, 1, i);
    if (count) {
      BinaryWriter wi;
      bw_init(&wi);
      encode_user_wallet(&wi, 2, economy_boost_product_id(1, i), count);
      pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wi);
      bw_free(&wi);
    }
  }
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    uint8_t count = prec_potion_count(rec, i);
    if (!count)
      continue;
    BinaryWriter wi;
    bw_init(&wi);
    encode_user_wallet(&wi, 6,
                       potion_product_id((PotionRarity)(i + 1)), count);
    pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wi);
    bw_free(&wi);
  }
  {
    static const uint8_t types[] = {4, 9, 10};
    static const char *ids[] = {"quest_activation_24h", "skip_brew",
                                "skin_create_token"};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      uint8_t count = (uint8_t)((rec->misc_inventory >> (i * 8)) & 0xffu);
      if (!count)
        continue;
      BinaryWriter wi;
      bw_init(&wi);
      encode_user_wallet(&wi, types[i], ids[i], count);
      pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wi);
      bw_free(&wi);
    }
  }

  /* Purchased catalog skins. Duplicate catalog rows share the same index. */
  if (catalog) {
    bool emitted[PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_BITS] = {false};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < catalog->count; i++) {
      const EconomyCatalogRow *row = &catalog->rows[i];
      if (row->wallet_type != 3 ||
          row->skin_index == ECONOMY_NO_SKIN_INDEX ||
          row->skin_index >= PLAYERDB_SHOP_SKIN_BITS ||
          emitted[row->skin_index] ||
          !economy_skin_owned(rec, row->skin_index))
        continue;
      emitted[row->skin_index] = true;
      BinaryWriter wi;
      bw_init(&wi);
      encode_user_wallet(&wi, 3, row->product_id, 1);
      pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wi);
      bw_free(&wi);
    }
  }
  for (int i = 0; i < PLAYERDB_CUSTOM_SKIN_SLOTS; i++) {
    if (!rec->custom_skin_hashes[i])
      continue;
    char id[ECONOMY_PRODUCT_ID_LEN];
    economy_custom_skin_id(id, sizeof(id), rec->custom_skin_hashes[i]);
    BinaryWriter wi;
    bw_init(&wi);
    encode_user_wallet(&wi, 11, id, 1);
    pb_submsg(&login, 9, &wi);
    bw_free(&wi);
  }

  /* userBoosts = 11: only currently active boost timers. */
  if (rec->active_mass_boost_until > now_unix &&
      rec->active_mass_boost_idx < 4) {
    BinaryWriter b;
    bw_init(&b);
    pb_string(&b, 1, economy_boost_product_id(0, rec->active_mass_boost_idx));
    pb_uint32(&b, 2, (uint32_t)(rec->active_mass_boost_until - now_unix));
    pb_submsg(&login, 11, &b);
    bw_free(&b);
  }
  if (rec->active_xp_boost_until > now_unix &&
      rec->active_xp_boost_idx < 4) {
    BinaryWriter b;
    bw_init(&b);
    pb_string(&b, 1, economy_boost_product_id(1, rec->active_xp_boost_idx));
    pb_uint32(&b, 2, (uint32_t)(rec->active_xp_boost_until - now_unix));
    pb_submsg(&login, 11, &b);
    bw_free(&b);
  }

  /* userTimedEvents = 12. The official menu independently queries these
   * identifiers; sending only hourlyBonus leaves quest and potion-skip UI in
   * a stale/default state after reconnect. */
  {
    const char *event_ids[3] = {"hourlyBonus", "dailyQuest", "potionSkipBrew"};
    uint32_t next_values[3] = {0, 0, 0};
    if (rec->hourly_bonus_available_at > now_unix) {
      uint64_t wait = rec->hourly_bonus_available_at - now_unix;
      next_values[0] = wait > UINT32_MAX ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)wait;
    }
    if (rec->active_quest[0] && rec->active_quest_until > now_unix) {
      uint64_t wait = rec->active_quest_until - now_unix;
      next_values[1] = wait > UINT32_MAX ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)wait;
    } else if (rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at > now_unix) {
      uint64_t wait = rec->daily_quest_reward_available_at - now_unix;
      next_values[1] = wait > UINT32_MAX ? UINT32_MAX : (uint32_t)wait;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      BinaryWriter ev;
      bw_init(&ev);
      pb_string(&ev, 1, event_ids[i]);
      pb_uint32(&ev, 2, next_values[i]);
      pb_submsg(&login, 12, &ev);
      bw_free(&ev);
    }
  }

  /* userQuests = 16 */
  if (rec->active_quest[0] && rec->active_quest_until > now_unix) {
    BinaryWriter q;
    bw_init(&q);
    pb_int32(&q, 1, 0); /* FFA */
    pb_string(&q, 2, rec->active_quest);
    pb_string(&q, 3, "mass_consumed");
    pb_uint32(&q, 4, rec->quest_goal);
    pb_uint32(&q, 5, (uint32_t)(rec->active_quest_until - now_unix));
    pb_submsg(&login, 16, &q);
    bw_free(&q);
  }

  /* userPotions = 17 (repeated, up to MAX_POTIONS) */
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POTIONS; i++) {
    const Potion *p = &player->potions[i];
    if (p->rarity == POTION_NONE)
      continue;
    BinaryWriter up;
    bw_init(&up);
    uint32_t secs_remaining = potion_seconds_remaining(p, server_tick);
    encode_user_potion(&up, i + 1, potion_status(p), secs_remaining,
                       potion_product_id(p->rarity));
    pb_submsg(&login, 17, &up);
    bw_free(&up);
  }

  /* userSessionId = 18 (long string to help exceed 1000 bytes) */
  {
    char session_id[256];
    snprintf(session_id, sizeof(session_id), "el-session-%s-%08x",
             player->uid[0] ? player->uid : "anon",
             (uint32_t)(rec->last_seen & 0xFFFFFFFF));
    pb_string(&login, 18, session_id);
  }



  build_102_envelope(w, 11, &login);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&login);
  return len;
}

size_t pkt_102_wallet_update(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t coins, uint32_t dna) {
  BinaryWriter wallet;
  bw_init(&wallet);
  pb_string(&wallet, 1, "server");
  /* Amounts are absolute. deltaAmount is intentionally omitted because this
   * packet is a state synchronization, not a transaction receipt. */
  encode_product_update(&wallet, 2, 1, "coin", coins, 0);
  encode_product_update(&wallet, 2, 1, "dna", dna, 0);
  build_102_envelope(w, 75, &wallet);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&wallet);
  return len;
}

size_t pkt_102_brew_potion_response(BinaryWriter *w, const Player *player,
                                    uint32_t server_tick, int32_t result) {
  BinaryWriter brew;
  bw_init(&brew);

  pb_int32(&brew, 1, result);

  /* userPotions = 2 (repeated) */
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POTIONS; i++) {
    const Potion *p = &player->potions[i];
    if (p->rarity == POTION_NONE)
      continue;
    BinaryWriter up;
    bw_init(&up);
    uint32_t secs = potion_seconds_remaining(p, server_tick);
    encode_user_potion(&up, i + 1, potion_status(p), secs,
                       potion_product_id(p->rarity));
    pb_submsg(&brew, 2, &up);
    bw_free(&up);
  }

  build_102_envelope(w, 123, &brew);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&brew);
  return len;
}

size_t pkt_102_open_potion_response(BinaryWriter *w, const Player *player,
                                    uint32_t server_tick, int32_t result,
                                    uint32_t coins_total, uint32_t dna_total,
                                    uint32_t coins_delta, uint32_t dna_delta) {
  BinaryWriter open_resp;
  bw_init(&open_resp);
  pb_int32(&open_resp, 1, result);
  if (coins_delta)
    encode_product_update_origin(&open_resp, 2, 14, 1, "coin", coins_total,
                                 (int32_t)coins_delta);
  if (dna_delta)
    encode_product_update_origin(&open_resp, 2, 14, 1, "dna", dna_total,
                                 (int32_t)dna_delta);
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POTIONS; i++) {
    const Potion *p = &player->potions[i];
    if (p->rarity == POTION_NONE)
      continue;
    BinaryWriter up;
    bw_init(&up);
    encode_user_potion(&up, i + 1, potion_status(p),
                       potion_seconds_remaining(p, server_tick),
                       potion_product_id(p->rarity));
    pb_submsg(&open_resp, 3, &up);
    bw_free(&up);
  }
  build_102_envelope(w, 125, &open_resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&open_resp);
  return len;
}

/* ── Pong Response (sub-op 31) ────────────────────────────────── */
/* Client expects: pongField { pingId=1 } */
size_t pkt_102_pong(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t ping_id) {
  BinaryWriter pong;
  bw_init(&pong);
  pb_uint32(&pong, 1, ping_id); /* pingId */
  pb_uint32(&pong, 2, 1);       /* previousRoundtrip (placeholder) */

  build_102_envelope(w, 31, &pong);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&pong);
  return len;
}

/* ── Activate Boost Response (sub-op 113) ─────────────────────── */
/* Client expects: activateBoostResponseField {
 *   userBoostItem = 1 { productId=1, expiresInSeconds=2 }
 *   productUpdates = 2 (repeated) { origin=1, userWalletItem=2 { type, productId, amount } }
 * } */
size_t pkt_102_activate_boost_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                       const char *boost_product_id,
                                       uint32_t expires_secs,
                                       uint32_t wallet_amount) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);

  /* userBoostItem = 1 { productId, expiresInSeconds } */
  {
    BinaryWriter bi;
    bw_init(&bi);
    pb_string(&bi, 1, boost_product_id);
    pb_uint32(&bi, 2, expires_secs);
    pb_submsg(&resp, 1, &bi);
    bw_free(&bi);
  }

  /* productUpdates = 2: absolute remaining balance plus the -1 delta. */
  encode_product_update(&resp, 2, 2, boost_product_id, wallet_amount, -1);

  build_102_envelope(w, 113, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

/* ── Activate Timed Event Response (sub-op 111) ───────────────── */
/* Client expects: activateTimedEventResponseField {
 *   userTimedEvent = 1 { eventId=1, expiresInSeconds=2 }
 *   productUpdates = 2 (repeated) { origin=1, userWalletItem=2 }
 * } */
size_t pkt_102_activate_timed_event_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                             const char *event_id,
                                             uint32_t next_available_secs,
                                             const EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);
  {
    BinaryWriter ev;
    bw_init(&ev);
    pb_string(&ev, 1, event_id);
    pb_uint32(&ev, 2, next_available_secs);
    pb_submsg(&resp, 1, &ev);
    bw_free(&ev);
  }
  if (tx) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < tx->update_count; i++) {
      const EconomyProductUpdate *u = &tx->updates[i];
      encode_product_update(&resp, 2, u->wallet_type, u->product_id,
                            u->amount, u->delta);
    }
  }
  build_102_envelope(w, 111, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

/* ── Activate Quest Response (sub-op 115) ─────────────────────── */
size_t pkt_102_activate_quest_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                       const char *quest_product_id,
                                       const char *quest_type,
                                       uint32_t goal,
                                       uint32_t expires_secs,
                                       uint32_t token_remaining,
                                       int32_t token_delta) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);

  /* User_quest schema: gameType=1, productId=2, type=3, goal=4,
   * expiresInSeconds=5. */
  {
    BinaryWriter q;
    bw_init(&q);
    pb_int32(&q, 1, 0); /* all/FFA */
    pb_string(&q, 2, quest_product_id ? quest_product_id : "");
    pb_string(&q, 3, quest_type ? quest_type : "mass_consumed");
    pb_uint32(&q, 4, goal);
    pb_uint32(&q, 5, expires_secs);
    pb_submsg(&resp, 1, &q);
    bw_free(&q);
  }

  if (token_delta != 0)
    encode_product_update(&resp, 2, 4,
                          quest_product_id ? quest_product_id
                                           : "quest_activation_24h",
                          token_remaining, token_delta);

  build_102_envelope(w, 115, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

/* ── Update User Settings Response (sub-op 81) ────────────────── */
/* Client expects: updateUserSettingsResponseField {
 *   updatedUserSettings = 1 (repeated) { type=1, key=2, valueString=3 }
 * } */
size_t pkt_102_update_user_settings_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                             const char *skin_product_id) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);

  /* updatedUserSettings = 1 */
  {
    BinaryWriter us;
    bw_init(&us);
    pb_int32(&us, 1, 1); /* type = 1 (skin) */
    pb_int32(&us, 2, 1); /* key = 1 */
    pb_string(&us, 3, skin_product_id);
    pb_submsg(&resp, 1, &us);
    bw_free(&us);
  }

  build_102_envelope(w, 81, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

static void encode_tx_updates(BinaryWriter *msg, uint32_t field,
                              const EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  if (!tx)
    return;
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < tx->update_count; i++) {
    const EconomyProductUpdate *u = &tx->updates[i];
    encode_product_update(msg, field, u->wallet_type, u->product_id,
                          u->amount, u->delta);
  }
}

size_t pkt_102_activate_user_rewards_response(
    BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t reward_for, uint32_t active_slot,
    const EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);

  /* Activate_user_rewards_response.userRewards = field 1.
   * User_rewards: for=1, activeSlot=2, userWalletItems=3 repeated. */
  {
    BinaryWriter rewards;
    bw_init(&rewards);
    pb_uint32(&rewards, 1, reward_for);
    pb_uint32(&rewards, 2, active_slot);
    if (tx) {
      for (uint32_t i = 0; i < tx->update_count; i++) {
        const EconomyProductUpdate *u = &tx->updates[i];
        BinaryWriter wi;
        bw_init(&wi);
        encode_user_wallet(&wi, u->wallet_type, u->product_id, u->amount);
        pb_submsg(&rewards, 3, &wi);
        bw_free(&wi);
      }
    }
    pb_submsg(&resp, 1, &rewards);
    bw_free(&rewards);
  }

  /* productUpdates = field 2 repeated. */
  encode_tx_updates(&resp, 2, tx);
  build_102_envelope(w, 118, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

static int32_t soft_purchase_protocol_result(EconomyResult result) {
  if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK)
    return 1;
  if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_ENOUGH_CURRENCY)
    return 2;
  return 3;
}

static int32_t offer_bundle_protocol_result(EconomyResult result) {
  if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK)
    return 1;
  if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_AVAILABLE)
    return 2;
  return 3;
}

static int32_t potion_product_protocol_result(EconomyResult result) {
  if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK)
    return 1;
  if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_NOT_ENOUGH_CURRENCY)
    return 2;
  return 3;
}

size_t pkt_102_soft_purchase_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                      const char *purchase_id,
                                      EconomyResult result,
                                      const EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);
  pb_int32(&resp, 1, soft_purchase_protocol_result(result));
  pb_string(&resp, 2, purchase_id ? purchase_id : "");
  encode_tx_updates(&resp, 3, tx);
  build_102_envelope(w, 71, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

size_t pkt_102_offer_bundle_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                     const char *bundle_id,
                                     EconomyResult result,
                                     const EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);
  pb_int32(&resp, 1, offer_bundle_protocol_result(result));
  pb_string(&resp, 2, bundle_id ? bundle_id : "");
  encode_tx_updates(&resp, 3, tx);
  build_102_envelope(w, 78, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

size_t pkt_102_open_potion_for_product_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                                const char *product_id,
                                                EconomyResult result,
                                                const EconomyTransaction *tx) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);
  pb_int32(&resp, 1, potion_product_protocol_result(result));
  pb_string(&resp, 2, product_id ? product_id : "");
  encode_tx_updates(&resp, 3, tx);
  build_102_envelope(w, 121, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

size_t pkt_102_custom_skin_create_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                           EconomyResult result,
                                           const char *custom_skin_id,
                                           uint32_t create_tokens_remaining) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);
  pb_int32(&resp, 1, result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK ? 1 : 2);
  if (result == ECONOMY_RESULT_OK && custom_skin_id && custom_skin_id[0]) {
    encode_product_update(&resp, 2, 10, "skin_create_token",
                          create_tokens_remaining, -1);
    encode_product_update(&resp, 2, 11, custom_skin_id, 1, 1);
  }
  build_102_envelope(w, 151, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

size_t pkt_102_custom_skin_delete(BinaryWriter *w,
                                  const char *custom_skin_id) {
  BinaryWriter resp;
  bw_init(&resp);
  pb_string(&resp, 1, custom_skin_id ? custom_skin_id : "");
  build_102_envelope(w, 152, &resp);
  size_t len = bw_length(w);
  bw_free(&resp);
  return len;
}

#ifndef PROTO102_H
#define PROTO102_H

#include "buffer.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "playerdb.h"
#include "economy.h"
#include <stdint.h>

/* ── Protobuf helpers for opcode 102 (agar.io mobile data) ──── */

/* Wire types */
#define PB_VARINT 0
#define PB_LEN 2

/* Write a protobuf varint */
void pb_varint(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t value);

/* Write a protobuf tag (field number + wire type) */
void pb_tag(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, uint32_t wire_type);

/* Write a varint field (tag + value) */
void pb_uint32(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, uint32_t value);

/* Write a signed int32 field */
void pb_int32(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, int32_t value);

/* Write a uint64 field */
void pb_uint64(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, uint64_t value);

/* Write a string field (tag + length + bytes) */
void pb_string(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, const char *str);

/* Write a bool field */
void pb_bool(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t field, bool value);

/* ── Submessage encoding ──────────────────────────────────────
 * Protobuf submessages need length-prefixed encoding.
 * Strategy: encode submessage to a temp BinaryWriter, then write
 * as a length-delimited field into the parent writer.
 */

/* Write a pre-encoded submessage as a length-delimited field */
void pb_submsg(BinaryWriter *parent, uint32_t field, const BinaryWriter *child);

/* ── Session stats for game over ────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct {
  uint32_t mass_consumed;
  uint32_t time_total;
  uint32_t time_in_leaderboard;
  uint32_t top_position;
  uint32_t final_position;
  uint32_t longest_time_alive;
  uint32_t final_mass;
  uint32_t highest_mass;
  uint32_t normal_cells_eaten;
  uint32_t food_eaten;
  uint32_t viruses_eaten;
  uint32_t players_eaten;
} GameSessionStats102;

/* ── Envelope builder (wraps sub-message into opcode 102 Data) ── */

/* Build the full opcode 102 packet: wraps an inner sub-message inside
 * Data { contentType=1, uncompressedData={type=sub_opcode, field=inner} } */
void build_102_envelope(BinaryWriter *out, uint32_t sub_opcode,
                        const BinaryWriter *inner_msg);

/* ── High-level packet builders ─────────────────────────────── */

/* Build opcode 102 Game Over (sub-op 62) with full protobuf:
 * gameSessionStats, xpLevelUpdates, potionInfo (optional) */
size_t pkt_102_game_over_full(BinaryWriter *w, const Player *player,
                              const PlayerRecord *rec,
                              const GameSessionStats102 *stats,
                              int new_potion_slot, int new_potion_status,
                              uint32_t new_potion_seconds,
                              const char *new_potion_product_id,
                              bool would_have_won_potion,
                              const EconomyTransaction *session_rewards);

/* Build opcode 102 Login Response (sub-op 11) with wallet + potions + info */
size_t pkt_102_login_response(BinaryWriter *w, const PlayerRecord *rec,
                              const Player *player,
                              const EconomyCatalog *catalog,
                              uint64_t now_unix, uint32_t server_tick);

/* Build opcode 102 Wallet Updates (sub-op 75) */
size_t pkt_102_wallet_update(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t coins, uint32_t dna);

/* Build opcode 102 Brew Potion Response (sub-op 123) */
size_t pkt_102_brew_potion_response(BinaryWriter *w, const Player *player,
                                    uint32_t server_tick, int32_t result);

/* Build opcode 102 Open Potion Response (sub-op 125) */
size_t pkt_102_open_potion_response(BinaryWriter *w, const Player *player,
                                    uint32_t server_tick, int32_t result,
                                    uint32_t coins_total, uint32_t dna_total,
                                    uint32_t coins_delta, uint32_t dna_delta);

/* Build opcode 102 Pong Response (sub-op 31) */
size_t pkt_102_pong(BinaryWriter *w, uint32_t ping_id);

/* Build opcode 102 Activate Boost Response (sub-op 113) */
size_t pkt_102_activate_boost_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                       const char *boost_product_id,
                                       uint32_t expires_secs,
                                       uint32_t wallet_amount);

/* Build opcode 102 Activate Timed Event Response (sub-op 111) */
size_t pkt_102_activate_timed_event_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                             const char *event_id,
                                             uint32_t next_available_secs,
                                             const EconomyTransaction *tx);

/* Build opcode 102 Activate Quest Response (sub-op 115) */
size_t pkt_102_activate_quest_response(BinaryWriter *w,
                                       const char *quest_product_id,

#include "quadtree.h"

#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>


static QTNode *qt_alloc_node(QuadTree *tree) {
  if (!tree ||
      !tree->pool ||
      tree->pool_used >= tree->pool_size) {
    return NULL;
  }

  QTNode *node =
      &tree->pool[tree->pool_used++];

  /*
   * Only fields controlling validity need initialization. items[] and
   * children[] are guarded by item_count and is_split.
   */
  node->item_count = 0;
  node->is_split = false;
  node->depth = 0;

  return node;
}


static inline bool cell_overlaps_rect_fast(
    const Cell *restrict cell,
    double minx, double miny, double maxx, double maxy) {
  if (UNLIKELY(!cell || cell->is_removed))
    return false;

  double r = cell->radius;
  double px = cell->position.x;
  double py = cell->position.y;

  return (px + r >= minx) & (px - r <= maxx) &
         (py + r >= miny) & (py - r <= maxy);
}

static bool cell_overlaps_rect(
    const Cell *cell,
    const Rect *area) {
  if (!area) return false;
  return cell_overlaps_rect_fast(cell, area->minx, area->miny, area->maxx, area->maxy);
}


/*
 * Return the one child that completely contains the cell's full-radius AABB.
 *
 * Returning -1 means the cell crosses one or both midlines. Such a cell stays
 * at the parent, where every relevant descendant query will encounter it.
 */
static inline int child_for_cell(
    const QTNode *node,
    const Cell *cell) {
  double middle_x =
      (node->bounds.minx +
       node->bounds.maxx) * 0.5;

  double middle_y =
      (node->bounds.miny +
       node->bounds.maxy) * 0.5;

  double minimum_x =
      cell->position.x -
      cell->radius;

  double maximum_x =
      cell->position.x +
      cell->radius;

  double minimum_y =
      cell->position.y -
      cell->radius;

  double maximum_y =
      cell->position.y +
      cell->radius;

  bool fits_left =
      maximum_x <= middle_x;

  bool fits_right =
      minimum_x >= middle_x;

  bool fits_top =
      maximum_y <= middle_y;

  bool fits_bottom =
      minimum_y >= middle_y;

  if (fits_left == fits_right ||
      fits_top == fits_bottom) {
    return -1;
  }

  if (fits_top)
    return fits_right ? 1 : 0;

  return fits_right ? 3 : 2;
}


static bool push_overflow(
    QuadTree *tree,
    Cell *cell,
    bool pool_exhausted) {
  if (!tree ||
      !cell ||
      !tree->overflow_items ||
      tree->overflow_count >=
          tree->overflow_capacity) {
    return false;
  }

  tree->overflow_items[
      tree->overflow_count++] =
          cell;

  if (pool_exhausted)
    tree->pool_exhaustions++;
  else
    tree->leaf_overflows++;

  return true;
}


/*
 * Splitting is transactional: reserve all four children before mutating the
 * parent. If the pool cannot provide four nodes, the caller uses overflow.
 */
static bool node_split(
    QuadTree *tree,
    QTNode *node) {
  if (!tree ||
      !node ||
      node->is_split) {
    return false;
  }

  if (tree->pool_used >
      tree->pool_size - 4) {
    return false;
  }

  QTNode *children[4];

  for (int index = 0;
       index < 4;
       index++) {
    children[index] =
        qt_alloc_node(tree);

    if (!children[index])
      return false;
  }

  double middle_x =
      (node->bounds.minx +
       node->bounds.maxx) * 0.5;

  double middle_y =
      (node->bounds.miny +
       node->bounds.maxy) * 0.5;

  int child_depth =
      node->depth + 1;

  children[0]->bounds =
      (Rect){
          node->bounds.minx,
          node->bounds.miny,
          middle_x,
          middle_y,
      };

  children[1]->bounds =
      (Rect){
          middle_x,
          node->bounds.miny,
          node->bounds.maxx,
          middle_y,
      };

  children[2]->bounds =
      (Rect){
          node->bounds.minx,
          middle_y,
          middle_x,
          node->bounds.maxy,
      };

  children[3]->bounds =
      (Rect){
          middle_x,
          middle_y,
          node->bounds.maxx,
          node->bounds.maxy,
      };

  children[0]->midx = (node->bounds.minx + middle_x) * 0.5;
  children[0]->midy = (node->bounds.miny + middle_y) * 0.5;

  children[1]->midx = (middle_x + node->bounds.maxx) * 0.5;
  children[1]->midy = (node->bounds.miny + middle_y) * 0.5;

  children[2]->midx = (node->bounds.minx + middle_x) * 0.5;
  children[2]->midy = (middle_y + node->bounds.maxy) * 0.5;

  children[3]->midx = (middle_x + node->bounds.maxx) * 0.5;
  children[3]->midy = (middle_y + node->bounds.maxy) * 0.5;

  node->midx = middle_x;
  node->midy = middle_y;

  for (int index = 0;
       index < 4;
       index++) {
    children[index]->depth =
        child_depth;

    node->children[index] =
        children[index];
  }

  Cell *existing[QT_MAX_ITEMS];
  int existing_count =
      node->item_count;

  memcpy(
      existing,
      node->items,
      (size_t)existing_count *
          sizeof(existing[0]));

  node->item_count = 0;
  node->is_split = true;

  for (int index = 0;
       index < existing_count;
       index++) {
    Cell *cell =
        existing[index];

    int child_index =
        child_for_cell(
            node,
            cell);

    if (child_index >= 0) {
      QTNode *child =
          node->children[child_index];

      /*
       * A parent contains at most QT_MAX_ITEMS before splitting, therefore no
       * child can receive more than QT_MAX_ITEMS during redistribution.
       */
      child->items[
          child->item_count++] =
              cell;
    } else {
      node->items[
          node->item_count++] =
              cell;
    }
  }

  return true;
}


static bool node_insert(
    QuadTree *tree,
    QTNode *node,
    Cell *cell) {
  while (node) {
    if (node->is_split) {
      int child_index =
          child_for_cell(
              node,
              cell);

      if (child_index < 0) {
        if (node->item_count <
            QT_MAX_ITEMS) {
          node->items[
              node->item_count++] =
                  cell;

          return true;
        }

        return push_overflow(
            tree,
            cell,
            false);
      }

      node =
          node->children[child_index];

      continue;
    }

    if (node->item_count <
        QT_MAX_ITEMS) {
      node->items[
          node->item_count++] =
              cell;

      return true;
    }

    if (node->depth >=
        QT_MAX_DEPTH) {
      return push_overflow(
          tree,
          cell,
          false);
    }

    if (!node_split(
            tree,
            node)) {
      return push_overflow(
          tree,
          cell,
          true);
    }
  }

  return false;
}


bool qt_init(
    QuadTree *tree,
    Rect bounds,
    QTNode *node_pool,
    int node_pool_size,
    Cell **overflow_pool,
    int overflow_capacity) {
  if (!tree ||
      !node_pool ||
      node_pool_size < 1 ||
      !overflow_pool ||
      overflow_capacity < 1) {
    return false;
  }

  memset(
      tree,
      0,
      sizeof(*tree));

  tree->bounds = bounds;
  tree->pool = node_pool;
  tree->pool_size = node_pool_size;
  tree->overflow_items =
      overflow_pool;
  tree->overflow_capacity =
      overflow_capacity;

  tree->root =
      qt_alloc_node(tree);

  if (!tree->root)
    return false;

  tree->root->bounds =
      bounds;
  tree->root->midx = (bounds.minx + bounds.maxx) * 0.5;
  tree->root->midy = (bounds.miny + bounds.maxy) * 0.5;

  tree->root->depth = 0;
  tree->initialized = true;

  return true;
}


bool qt_clear(QuadTree *tree) {
  if (!tree ||
      !tree->initialized ||
      !tree->pool ||
      tree->pool_size < 1) {
    return false;
  }

  tree->pool_used = 0;
  tree->overflow_count = 0;
  tree->total_items = 0;

  tree->root =
      qt_alloc_node(tree);

  if (!tree->root)
    return false;

  tree->root->bounds =
      tree->bounds;
  tree->root->midx = (tree->bounds.minx + tree->bounds.maxx) * 0.5;
  tree->root->midy = (tree->bounds.miny + tree->bounds.maxy) * 0.5;

  tree->root->depth = 0;

  return true;
}


void qt_free(QuadTree *tree) {
  if (!tree)
    return;

  tree->root = NULL;
  tree->pool = NULL;
  tree->pool_size = 0;
  tree->pool_used = 0;
  tree->overflow_items = NULL;
  tree->overflow_capacity = 0;
  tree->overflow_count = 0;
  tree->total_items = 0;
  tree->initialized = false;
}


bool qt_insert(
    QuadTree *tree,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!tree ||
      !tree->initialized ||
      !tree->root ||
      !cell ||
      cell->is_removed) {
    return false;
  }

  /*
   * Cells whose radius extends beyond the root are still indexed correctly in
   * overflow. The production root covers the largest map tier, so this path is
   * primarily a defensive invariant.
   */
  if (!cell_overlaps_rect(
          cell,
          &tree->bounds)) {
    if (!push_overflow(
            tree,
            cell,
            false)) {
      return false;
    }

    tree->total_items++;
    return true;
  }

  if (!node_insert(
          tree,
          tree->root,
          cell)) {
    return false;
  }

  tree->total_items++;

  return true;
}


void qt_remove(
    QuadTree *tree,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!tree ||
      !cell ||
      cell->is_removed) {
    return;
  }

  cell->is_removed = true;

  if (tree->total_items > 0)
    tree->total_items--;
}


#define QT_STACK_SIZE \
  (QT_MAX_DEPTH * 4 + 4)


static inline void collect_subtree(const QTNode *node, Cell **result, int *count, int max_results) {
  const QTNode *sub_stack[QT_STACK_SIZE];
  int sub_count = 0;
  sub_stack[sub_count++] = node;

  int c = *count;
  while (sub_count > 0 && c < max_results) {
    const QTNode *n = sub_stack[--sub_count];
    for (int index = 0; index < n->item_count && c < max_results; index++) {
      Cell *cell = n->items[index];
      if (LIKELY(!cell->is_removed)) {
        result[c++] = cell;
      }
    }
    if (n->is_split && sub_count < QT_STACK_SIZE - 4) {
      if (n->children[3]) sub_stack[sub_count++] = n->children[3];
      if (n->children[2]) sub_stack[sub_count++] = n->children[2];
      if (n->children[1]) sub_stack[sub_count++] = n->children[1];
      if (n->children[0]) sub_stack[sub_count++] = n->children[0];
    }
  }
  *count = c;
}


static int query_tree(
    const QTNode *root,
    Rect area,
    Cell **result,
    int count,
    int max_results) {
  if (!root ||
      !result ||
      count >= max_results) {
    return count;
  }

  const QTNode *stack[
      QT_STACK_SIZE];

  double q_minx = area.minx;
  double q_miny = area.miny;
  double q_maxx = area.maxx;
  double q_maxy = area.maxy;

  int stack_count = 0;

  stack[stack_count++] =
      root;

  while (stack_count > 0 &&
         count < max_results) {
    const QTNode *node =
        stack[--stack_count];

    if (node->item_count == 0 && !node->is_split)
      continue;

    bool node_fully_enclosed = (node->bounds.minx >= q_minx) &&
                               (node->bounds.maxx <= q_maxx) &&
                               (node->bounds.miny >= q_miny) &&
                               (node->bounds.maxy <= q_maxy);

    if (node_fully_enclosed) {
      collect_subtree(node, result, &count, max_results);
      continue;
    }

    for (int index = 0; index < node->item_count && count < max_results; index++) {
#ifdef __GNUC__
      if (index + 2 < node->item_count)
        __builtin_prefetch(node->items[index + 2], 0, 1);
#endif
      Cell *cell = node->items[index];
      if (cell_overlaps_rect_fast(cell, q_minx, q_miny, q_maxx, q_maxy)) {
        result[count++] = cell;
      }
    }

    if (!node->is_split)
      continue;

    bool overlap_left  = (q_minx <= node->midx);
    bool overlap_right = (q_maxx >= node->midx);
    bool overlap_top   = (q_miny <= node->midy);
    bool overlap_bot   = (q_maxy >= node->midy);

    if (stack_count < QT_STACK_SIZE - 4) {
      if (overlap_right && overlap_bot && node->children[3]) stack[stack_count++] = node->children[3];
      if (overlap_left  && overlap_bot && node->children[2]) stack[stack_count++] = node->children[2];
      if (overlap_right && overlap_top && node->children[1]) stack[stack_count++] = node->children[1];
      if (overlap_left  && overlap_top && node->children[0]) stack[stack_count++] = node->children[0];
    }
  }

  return count;
}


static int query_overflow(
    const QuadTree *tree,
    Rect area,
    Cell **result,
    int count,
    int max_results) {
  if (UNLIKELY(tree->overflow_count == 0))
    return count;

  double q_minx = area.minx;
  double q_miny = area.miny;
  double q_maxx = area.maxx;
  double q_maxy = area.maxy;

  for (int index = 0;
       index < tree->overflow_count &&
       count < max_results;
       index++) {
#ifdef __GNUC__
    if (index + 2 < tree->overflow_count)
      __builtin_prefetch(tree->overflow_items[index + 2], 0, 1);
#endif
    Cell *cell =
        tree->overflow_items[index];

    if (cell_overlaps_rect_fast(cell, q_minx, q_miny, q_maxx, q_maxy)) {
      result[count++] =
          cell;
    }
  }

  return count;
}


int qt_query(
    const QuadTree *restrict tree,
    Rect area,
    Cell **restrict result,
    int max_results) {
  return qt_query_from(
      tree,
      area,
      result,
      0,
      max_results);
}


int qt_query_from(
    const QuadTree *restrict tree,
    Rect area,
    Cell **restrict result,
    int start_count,
    int max_results) {
  if (!tree ||
      !tree->initialized ||
      !result ||
      max_results <= 0) {
    return start_count;
  }

  int count =
      start_count;

  if (count < 0)
    count = 0;

  if (count >= max_results)
    return count;

  /*
   * Overflow contains the cells most at risk of being missed: very large
   * cross-boundary cells and pathological dense clusters. Query it first.
   */
  count = query_overflow(
      tree,
      area,
      result,
      count,
      max_results);

  return query_tree(
      tree->root,
      area,
      result,
      count,
      max_results);
}

#ifndef QUADTREE_H
#define QUADTREE_H

#include "cell.h"

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#ifndef LIKELY
#ifdef __GNUC__
#define LIKELY(x)   __builtin_expect(!!(x), 1)
#define UNLIKELY(x) __builtin_expect(!!(x), 0)
#else
#define LIKELY(x)   (x)
#define UNLIKELY(x) (x)
#endif
#endif

/* Axis-aligned bounding box */
typedef struct {
  double minx;
  double miny;
  double maxx;
  double maxy;
} Rect;

static inline double rect_width(const Rect *rect) {
  return rect->maxx - rect->minx;
}

static inline double rect_height(const Rect *rect) {
  return rect->maxy - rect->miny;
}

static inline bool rect_contains_point(
    const Rect *rect,
    double x,
    double y) {
  return x >= rect->minx &&
         x <= rect->maxx &&
         y >= rect->miny &&
         y <= rect->maxy;
}

static inline bool rect_overlaps(
    const Rect *left,
    const Rect *right) {
  return !(
      left->maxx < right->minx ||
      left->minx > right->maxx ||
      left->maxy < right->miny ||
      left->miny > right->maxy);
}

#define QT_MAX_ITEMS QT_LEAF_MAX
#define QT_MAX_DEPTH QT_DEPTH_MAX

typedef struct QTNode {
  bool is_split;
  int item_count;
  int depth;

  Rect bounds;
  double midx, midy;
  struct QTNode *children[4];

  /*
   * Leaf cells and cells whose full radius does not fit one child.
   * Keeping cross-boundary cells at their parent prevents missed queries.
   */
  Cell *items[QT_MAX_ITEMS];
} QTNode;

typedef struct {
  Rect bounds;

  QTNode *root;
  int total_items;

  QTNode *pool;
  int pool_size;
  int pool_used;

  /*
   * Correctness fallback for:
   * - node-pool exhaustion;
   * - a full maximum-depth leaf;
   * - too many cross-quadrant cells at one parent.
   *
   * Overflow cells are queried first, then normal tree nodes.
   */
  Cell **overflow_items;
  int overflow_capacity;
  int overflow_count;

  uint64_t pool_exhaustions;
  uint64_t leaf_overflows;

  bool initialized;
} QuadTree;

bool qt_init(
    QuadTree *tree,
    Rect bounds,
    QTNode *node_pool,
    int node_pool_size,
    Cell **overflow_pool,
    int overflow_capacity);

bool qt_clear(QuadTree *tree);
void qt_free(QuadTree *tree);

bool qt_insert(
    QuadTree *tree,
    Cell *cell);

void qt_remove(
    QuadTree *tree,
    Cell *cell);

int qt_query(
    const QuadTree *restrict tree,
    Rect area,
    Cell **restrict result,
    int max_results);

int qt_query_from(
    const QuadTree *restrict tree,
    Rect area,
    Cell **restrict result,
    int start_count,
    int max_results);

#endif /* QUADTREE_H */

#else
#define DBGLOG(...) ((void)0)
#endif

#define _USE_MATH_DEFINES
#include <math.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif
#include <assert.h>

#include <sys/mman.h>  /* madvise(MADV_HUGEPAGE) for TLB optimization */
#endif

#include <omp.h>
#endif

/* ── Compiler hint macros ─────────────────────────────────────── */
/* Branch prediction hints: guide CPU branch predictor for known-
 * likely/unlikely paths. Zero overhead when prediction is correct;
 * saves ~15 cycles per misprediction on AMD EPYC. */
#ifdef __GNUC__
#define LIKELY(x)   __builtin_expect(!!(x), 1)
#define UNLIKELY(x) __builtin_expect(!!(x), 0)
#else
#define LIKELY(x)   (x)
#define UNLIKELY(x) (x)
#endif

/* Prefetch a Cell pointer for read access into L1 cache.
 * Lookahead of 4 iterations hides ~200-cycle L2 miss latency
 * behind useful computation on the current cell. */
#ifdef __GNUC__
#define PREFETCH_CELL(arr, idx, limit) \
  do { if ((idx) + 4 < (limit)) __builtin_prefetch((arr)[(idx) + 4], 0, 1); } while (0)
#else
#define PREFETCH_CELL(arr, idx, limit) ((void)0)
#endif

/* ── Global dirty cell list (pull model) ──────────────────────── */
/* Cells mark themselves dirty when they move/change. At send time,
 * each player iterates this list with a cheap viewbox AABB check.
 * This replaces the old push model (cell → watchers → event queues)
 * which had O(cells × watchers) cost. */
/* MAX_DIRTY_CELLS, MAX_QUERY_NODES, MAX_PENDING_SPLITS_PER_TICK
 * all defined in config.h */
static Cell *g_dirty_cells[MAX_DIRTY_CELLS];
static uint32_t g_dirty_count = 0;

/* ── Data directory path resolver ────────────────────────────── */

const char *g_data_dir = ".";

const char *server_data_path(const char *filename) {
  /* When data_dir is "." (default), return filename as-is to avoid
   * ugly "./players.dat" in logs and to preserve current behavior. */
  if (!g_data_dir || (g_data_dir[0] == '.' && g_data_dir[1] == '\0')) {
    return filename;
  }
  /* Thread-local buffer — each thread gets its own copy, safe for
   * concurrent use by the main thread and the async_log flush thread. */
  static _Thread_local char path_buf[512];
  snprintf(path_buf, sizeof(path_buf), "%s/%s", g_data_dir, filename);
  return path_buf;
}

/* Mark a cell as dirty (coalesced: at most once per cell per tick).
 * The counter is SATURATING — it never exceeds MAX_DIRTY_CELLS.
 * Without saturation, the counter could grow indefinitely when no
 * clients are connected, and readers would perform OOB array access. */
static inline void mark_cell_dirty(Cell *c, uint32_t tick) {
  if (UNLIKELY(c->last_evt_tick == tick))
    return; /* already dirty this tick */
  c->last_evt_tick = tick;
  uint32_t idx = __atomic_fetch_add(&g_dirty_count, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  if (LIKELY(idx < MAX_DIRTY_CELLS)) {
    g_dirty_cells[idx] = c;
  } else {
    /* Counter went past capacity — clamp it back down.
     * This is a CAS-free saturating decrement: we don't need the exact
     * count to be MAX_DIRTY_CELLS, just that it doesn't grow unbounded. */
    __atomic_fetch_sub(&g_dirty_count, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
  }
}

void server_mark_cell_dirty(Cell *c, uint32_t tick) {
  mark_cell_dirty(c, tick);
}

/* ── Food growth scheduler ───────────────────────────────────── */

static bool food_growth_schedule(GameServer *srv, Cell *cell) {
  if (!srv || !cell || cell->type != CELL_FOOD || cell->is_removed)
    return false;

  /*
   * No scheduler entry is needed when growth is disabled, invalid, or the
   * pellet already starts at its configured maximum size.
   */
  if (srv->config.food_grow_ticks <= 0 ||
      srv->config.food_max_size <= srv->config.food_min_size ||
      cell->radius >= srv->config.food_max_size - 0.05) {
    return true;
  }

  uint32_t phase =
      cell->id % FOOD_GROWTH_PHASES;

  FoodGrowthBucket *bucket =
      &srv->food_growth[phase];

  if (bucket->count >= bucket->capacity) {
    int new_capacity =
        bucket->capacity > 0
            ? bucket->capacity * 2
            : 256;

    if (new_capacity < bucket->count + 1)
      new_capacity = bucket->count + 1;

    /*
     * One phase can never legitimately contain more references than the
     * complete food pool.
     */
    if (new_capacity > MAX_FOOD)
      new_capacity = MAX_FOOD;

    if (new_capacity <= bucket->count)
      return false;

    FoodGrowthRef *new_items =
        (FoodGrowthRef *)realloc(
            bucket->items,
            (size_t)new_capacity *
                sizeof(*new_items));

    if (!new_items)
      return false;

    bucket->items = new_items;
    bucket->capacity = new_capacity;
  }

  bucket->items[bucket->count].cell =
      cell;

  bucket->items[bucket->count].generation =
      cell->generation;

  bucket->count++;

  return true;
}

static void food_growth_destroy(GameServer *srv) {
  if (!srv)
    return;

  for (int phase = 0;
       phase < FOOD_GROWTH_PHASES;
       phase++) {
    free(srv->food_growth[phase].items);

    srv->food_growth[phase].items = NULL;
    srv->food_growth[phase].count = 0;
    srv->food_growth[phase].capacity = 0;
  }
}

/*
 * Send explicit DELETE records (opcode 0x10 UpdateNodes with only removes)
 * for every cell the client currently tracks, plus compacted drops.
 *
 * DO NOT use opcode 0x12 (ClearAll) — it triggers LegendMod / OGARio to
 * reconnect/reset the socket, causing blank screens.
 *
 * Returns true on success, false if the packet couldn't be queued.
 * On success, clears client_count/compacted_drop_count and view_state.
 */
static bool server_send_explicit_deletes(Player *player) {
  int total_tracked = player->client_count;
  int total_drops   = player->compacted_drop_count;
  int total_all     = total_tracked + total_drops;

  if (total_all <= 0) {
    /* Nothing tracked — clear tracking and return success */
    player_clear_view_tracking(player);
    return true;
  }

  uint32_t scr = player->scramble_id;
  int sent = 0;  /* total IDs sent across all packets */

  /* Emit one or more UpdateNodes packets, each with up to 65535 DELETEs.
   * World Spectate can track up to 65536 cells; a single packet's u16
   * remove_count field can only hold 65535. */
  while (sent < total_all) {
    int remaining = total_all - sent;
    int batch = remaining > 65535 ? 65535 : remaining;

    BinaryWriter del_w;
    bw_init(&del_w);

    /* Opcode 0x10 — UpdateNodes */
    bw_write_u8(&del_w, 0x10);

    /* Eat count: 0 */
    bw_write_u16_le(&del_w, 0);

    /* Add records terminator (no adds) */
    bw_write_u32_le(&del_w, 0);

    /* Remove count */
    bw_write_u16_le(&del_w, (uint16_t)batch);

    int written = 0;

    /* DELETEs from client_handles[] — lower 32 bits = protocol ID */
    while (written < batch && sent < total_tracked) {
      uint32_t proto_id = (uint32_t)(player->client_handles[sent]);
      bw_write_u32_le(&del_w, proto_id ^ scr);
      sent++;
      written++;
    }

    /* DELETEs from compacted_drop_ids[] */
    while (written < batch && sent < total_all) {
      int drop_idx = sent - total_tracked;
      bw_write_u32_le(&del_w, player->compacted_drop_ids[drop_idx] ^ scr);
      sent++;
      written++;
    }

    bool ok = net_try_queue_to_player(
        player->conn_id, bw_data(&del_w), bw_length(&del_w));
    bw_free(&del_w);

    if (!ok) {
      /* Queue failed mid-stream — tracking is NOT cleared so the
       * caller can retry next tick with the remaining IDs. */
      return false;
    }
  }

  player_clear_view_tracking(player);
  return true;
}

bool server_start_cell_boost(
    GameServer *server,
    Cell *cell,
    double distance,
    double angle) {
  if (!server ||
      !cell ||
      cell->is_removed ||
      !isfinite(distance) ||
      !isfinite(angle) ||
      distance <= 0.0) {
    return false;
  }

  /* A cell is "registered" if it's in dynamic_nodes[] OR food_nodes[] */
  bool already_inserted =
      cell->dynamic_index >= 0 ||
      cell->food_index >= 0;

  if (already_inserted &&
      cell->moving_index >= 0) {
    int index =
        cell->moving_index;

    if (index >= server->moving_count ||
        server->moving_nodes[index] != cell) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  if (already_inserted &&
      cell->moving_index < 0 &&
      server->moving_count >= MAX_MOVING) {
    return false;
  }

  cell_set_boost(
      cell,
      distance,
      angle);

  if (already_inserted &&
      cell->moving_index < 0) {
    if (!moving_set_add(
            server->moving_nodes,
            &server->moving_count,
            MAX_MOVING,
            &server->moving_dynamic_count,
            cell)) {
      cell->boost_dist = 0.0;
      cell->is_moving = false;
      return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}


static void server_untrack_moving_cell(
    GameServer *server,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!server ||
      !cell ||
      cell->moving_index < 0) {
    return;
  }

  if (!moving_set_remove(
          server->moving_nodes,
          &server->moving_count,
          &server->moving_dynamic_count,
          cell)) {
    async_log(
        "[FATAL] Moving-set invariant failure for cell %u index=%d count=%d\n",
        cell->id,
        cell->moving_index,
        server->moving_count);

    abort();
  }
}

static int server_prune_tracking_group(
    GameServer *server,
    Cell **nodes,
    uint64_t *handles,
    int *count,
    uint8_t *view_state,
    uint32_t *drop_ids,
    int *drop_count) {
  if (!server ||
      !nodes ||
      !handles ||
      !count ||
      !view_state ||
      !drop_ids ||
      !drop_count) {
    return -1;
  }

  int write_index = 0;
  int removed = 0;

  for (int read_index = 0;
       read_index < *count;
       read_index++) {
    Cell *cell =
        nodes[read_index];

    uint64_t saved_handle =
        handles[read_index];

    if (!cell) {
      removed++;
      continue;
    }

    uint64_t current_handle =
        cell_handle_value(cell);

    if (saved_handle == 0)
      saved_handle = current_handle;

    if (saved_handle !=
        current_handle) {
      uint32_t old_id =
          (uint32_t)saved_handle;

      if (old_id != 0) {
        if (*drop_count >=
            MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
          return -1;
        }

        drop_ids[
            (*drop_count)++] =
                old_id;
      }

      ptrdiff_t slot =
          cell - server->cells;

      if (slot >= 0 &&
          slot < MAX_CELLS) {
        vs_set(
            view_state,
            (int)slot,
            0);
      }

      removed++;
      continue;
    }

    nodes[write_index] =
        cell;

    handles[write_index] =
        current_handle;

    write_index++;
  }

  *count =
      write_index;

  return removed;
}


static void server_refresh_tracking_group(
    Cell **nodes,
    uint64_t *handles,
    int count) {
  if (!nodes ||
      !handles)
    return;

  for (int index = 0;
       index < count;
       index++) {
    handles[index] =
        cell_handle_value(
            nodes[index]);
  }
}


int server_prune_player_tracking(
    GameServer *server,
    Player *player) {
  if (!server ||
      !player) {
    return -1;
  }

  return player_prune_stale_tracking(
      player,
      server->cells,
      MAX_CELLS);
}


int server_prune_shared_tracking(
    GameServer *server) {
  if (!server)
    return -1;

  return server_prune_tracking_group(
      server,
      server->spec_client_nodes,
      server->spec_client_handles,
      &server->spec_client_count,
      server->spec_view_state,
      server->spec_compacted_drop_ids,
      &server->spec_compacted_drop_count);
}

#endif

 * No skin URL is sent — the client renders the potion image locally. */

/* ── Monotonic time helpers ──────────────────────────────────── */

uint64_t server_time_ms(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  return (uint64_t)GetTickCount64();
#else
  struct timespec ts;
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
  return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000ULL +
         (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000000ULL;
#endif
}

uint64_t server_time_us(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  static LARGE_INTEGER frequency = {0};
  LARGE_INTEGER counter;

  if (frequency.QuadPart == 0)
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&frequency);

  QueryPerformanceCounter(&counter);

  return (uint64_t)(
      ((long double)counter.QuadPart * 1000000.0L) /
      (long double)frequency.QuadPart);
#else
  struct timespec ts;
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
  return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ULL +
         (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ULL;
#endif
}

/* ── Random helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

Color server_random_color(void) {
  /* Generate vibrant colors using HSV (Hue, Saturation=1, Value=1)
   * This matches the actual Agar.io client colors used for players and food.
   */
  Color c;
  double h = fast_random_double();
  double r, g, b;

  int i = (int)(h * 6.0);
  double f = h * 6.0 - i;
  double p = 0.0;     /* v * (1 - s) where v=1, s=1 */
  double q = 1.0 - f; /* v * (1 - f * s) */
  double t = f;       /* v * (1 - (1 - f) * s) */

  switch (i % 6) {
  case 0:
    r = 1.0;
    g = t;
    b = p;
    break;
  case 1:
    r = q;
    g = 1.0;
    b = p;
    break;
  case 2:
    r = p;
    g = 1.0;
    b = t;
    break;
  case 3:
    r = p;
    g = q;
    b = 1.0;
    break;
  case 4:
    r = t;
    g = p;
    b = 1.0;
    break;
  case 5:
    r = 1.0;
    g = p;
    b = q;
    break;
  default:
    r = 1.0;
    g = 1.0;
    b = 1.0;
    break;
  }

  c.r = (uint8_t)(r * 255.0);
  c.g = (uint8_t)(g * 255.0);
  c.b = (uint8_t)(b * 255.0);

  return c;
}

Vec2 server_random_pos_padded(GameServer *srv, double padding) {
  /* During contraction phases, use the restricted spawn border
   * (target safe area) instead of the full current border */
  double minx, miny, maxx, maxy;
  if (srv->map_scaler.enabled) {
    mapscaler_get_spawn_border(&srv->map_scaler, &minx, &miny, &maxx, &maxy);
  } else {
    minx = srv->border.minx;
    miny = srv->border.miny;
    maxx = srv->border.maxx;
    maxy = srv->border.maxy;
  }
  minx += padding;
  miny += padding;
  maxx -= padding;
  maxy -= padding;
  double x = minx + fast_random_double() * (maxx - minx);
  double y = miny + fast_random_double() * (maxy - miny);
  return vec2(x, y);
}



/* Random point inside current border but OUTSIDE the old pre-change square.
 * Falls back to normal random spawn if ring is too thin. */
Vec2 server_random_pos_in_expand_ring_padded(GameServer *srv, double padding) {
  double cur_minx = srv->border.minx + padding;
  double cur_miny = srv->border.miny + padding;
  double cur_maxx = srv->border.maxx - padding;
  double cur_maxy = srv->border.maxy - padding;

  double old_half = srv->map_scaler.pre_change_size * 0.5;
  double old_minx = -old_half + padding;
  double old_miny = -old_half + padding;
  double old_maxx = old_half - padding;
  double old_maxy = old_half - padding;

  /* If the old box almost fills the new one, no real ring yet */
  if (old_minx <= cur_minx && old_miny <= cur_miny && old_maxx >= cur_maxx &&
      old_maxy >= cur_maxy) {
    return server_random_pos_padded(srv, padding);
  }

  for (int tries = 0; tries < 64; tries++) {
    Vec2 p = server_random_pos_padded(srv, padding);
    bool inside_old = (p.x >= old_minx && p.x <= old_maxx && p.y >= old_miny &&
                       p.y <= old_maxy);
    if (!inside_old)
      return p;
  }

  return server_random_pos_padded(srv, padding);
}

bool server_should_spawn_food_in_ring(GameServer *srv) {
  /* During AND after expansion, bias spawns toward the outer ring proportional
   * to ring area fraction. Persists in PHASE_NORMAL so replacement spawns
   * (when old center food is eaten) gradually fill the outer ring. */
  if (srv->map_scaler.enabled &&
      srv->map_scaler.current_size > srv->map_scaler.pre_change_size &&
      srv->map_scaler.pre_change_size > 0) {
    double inner = srv->map_scaler.pre_change_size;
    double outer = srv->map_scaler.current_size;
    double ring_frac = 1.0 - (inner * inner) / (outer * outer);
    return ((double)rand() / RAND_MAX) < ring_frac;
  }
  return false;
}

bool server_should_spawn_virus_in_ring(GameServer *srv) {
  /* Softer ring bias for viruses than food. Viruses are sparse landmark
   * objects — players notice patterns immediately. A pure area-proportional
   * bias creates visible ring banding. Instead, use a blended probability
   * capped at 55% to keep some ring preference without dominating. */
  if (srv->map_scaler.enabled &&
      srv->map_scaler.current_size > srv->map_scaler.pre_change_size &&
      srv->map_scaler.pre_change_size > 0) {
    double inner = srv->map_scaler.pre_change_size;
    double outer = srv->map_scaler.current_size;
    double ring_frac = 1.0 - (inner * inner) / (outer * outer);
    double p = 0.20 + 0.35 * ring_frac;
    if (p > 0.55)
      p = 0.55; /* hard cap: never let ring dominate */
    return ((double)rand() / RAND_MAX) < p;
  }
  return false;
}

/* ── Static bounded spatial-index storage ────────────────────── */
#if defined(_WIN32) || defined(__WIN32__)
  #define HUGE_PAGE_ALIGN 8192
#else
  #define HUGE_PAGE_ALIGN 2097152
#endif

/* 2MB-aligned so THP can back with huge pages (guaranteed, not best-effort) */
static QTNode qt_pool_dynamic[QT_POOL_DYNAMIC]
    __attribute__((aligned(HUGE_PAGE_ALIGN)));

/*
 * Pointer-only correctness fallback. This costs roughly 2 MiB at MAX_CELLS
 * 262,144, while replacing the previous oversized node pool that reserved
 * well over 100 MiB.
 */
static Cell *qt_overflow_dynamic[QT_OVERFLOW_DYNAMIC]
    __attribute__((aligned(HUGE_PAGE_ALIGN)));

void server_init(GameServer *srv) {
  memset(srv, 0, sizeof(*srv));
  config_defaults(&srv->config);

#ifdef __linux__
  /* ── Transparent Huge Pages (THP) for hot memory regions ──
   * The Cell array (~280MB), QT node pool (~74MB), and Player array
   * are the largest memory regions. With 4KB pages, they require
   * 70K-90K TLB entries but the CPU dTLB only holds ~64 entries.
   * Result: millions of dTLB misses per second.
   *
   * madvise(MADV_HUGEPAGE) hints the kernel to back these regions
   * with 2MB pages. 280MB / 2MB = 140 TLB entries instead of 70,000.
   * Zero behavioral change — same data, same layout, just bigger pages. */
  {
    /* Cell pool — ~280MB, most frequently accessed (every collision/query) */
    uintptr_t cells_start = (uintptr_t)srv->cells;
    uintptr_t cells_aligned = cells_start & ~((uintptr_t)(2 * 1024 * 1024 - 1));
    size_t cells_len = sizeof(srv->cells) + (cells_start - cells_aligned);
    madvise((void *)cells_aligned, cells_len, MADV_HUGEPAGE);

    /* Quadtree node pool — ~74MB, traversed every query */
    uintptr_t qt_start = (uintptr_t)qt_pool_dynamic;
    uintptr_t qt_aligned = qt_start & ~((uintptr_t)(2 * 1024 * 1024 - 1));
    size_t qt_len = sizeof(qt_pool_dynamic) + (qt_start - qt_aligned);
    madvise((void *)qt_aligned, qt_len, MADV_HUGEPAGE);

    /* Player array — smaller but heavily pointer-chased */
    uintptr_t pl_start = (uintptr_t)srv->players;
    uintptr_t pl_aligned = pl_start & ~((uintptr_t)(2 * 1024 * 1024 - 1));
    size_t pl_len = sizeof(srv->players) + (pl_start - pl_aligned);
    madvise((void *)pl_aligned, pl_len, MADV_HUGEPAGE);

    async_log("[THP] madvise(HUGEPAGE): cells=%zuMB qt_pool=%zuMB players=%zuMB\n",
             sizeof(srv->cells) / (1024*1024),
             sizeof(qt_pool_dynamic) / (1024*1024),
             sizeof(srv->players) / (1024*1024));
  }
#endif

  srand((unsigned)time(NULL));

#if defined(_OPENMP)
  int num_threads = 3;
  const char *env_threads = getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS");
  if (env_threads) {
    int t = atoi(env_threads);
    if (t > 0) num_threads = t;
  }
  /* Hard cap: Cell::grid_qid[] is sized to MAX_OMP_THREADS, and the
   * CPX32 has only 4 vCPUs. Never exceed the compile-time limit. */
  if (num_threads > MAX_OMP_THREADS) {
    async_log("[OpenMP] WARNING: OMP_NUM_THREADS=%d exceeds MAX_OMP_THREADS=%d, clamping\n",
              num_threads, MAX_OMP_THREADS);
    num_threads = MAX_OMP_THREADS;
  }
  omp_set_num_threads(num_threads);
  async_log("[OpenMP] Parallel execution active: %d threads (%d00%% CPU capacity)\n", num_threads, num_threads);
#endif

  /* Setup border */
  double hw = srv->config.border_width / 2.0;
  double hh = srv->config.border_height / 2.0;
  srv->border.minx = -hw;
  srv->border.miny = -hh;
  srv->border.maxx = hw;
  srv->border.maxy = hh;
  srv->border.width = srv->config.border_width;
  srv->border.height = srv->config.border_height;

  /* Force first-tick grid rebuild (memset zeroed build_tick to 0, same as ticks) */
  srv->bot_grid.build_tick = UINT32_MAX;

  /* Initialize free-slot stack for O(1) player allocation.
   * Push in reverse so that slot 0 is popped first. */
  for (int i = MAX_PLAYERS - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    srv->free_player_stack[MAX_PLAYERS - 1 - i] = i;
  }
  srv->free_player_top = MAX_PLAYERS - 1;

  /* Init quadtree (dynamic cells) + food grid */
  Rect qt_bounds = {srv->border.minx, srv->border.miny, srv->border.maxx,
                    srv->border.maxy};
  if (!qt_init(
          &srv->quad_tree,
          qt_bounds,
          qt_pool_dynamic,
          QT_POOL_DYNAMIC,
          qt_overflow_dynamic,
          QT_OVERFLOW_DYNAMIC)) {
    async_log(
        "[FATAL] Unable to initialize dynamic quadtree\n");
    abort();
  }
  srv->quad_tree_build_tick = srv->ticks;
  fg_init(&srv->food_grid, srv->border.minx, srv->border.miny, srv->border.maxx,
          srv->border.maxy);
  srv->food_tree_dirty = true;

  /* Init players */
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++) {
    player_init(&srv->players[i], i);
  }

  srv->last_cell_id = 1;
  srv->tick_interval = 40.0;  /* 40ms = 25Hz */
  srv->leaderboard_type = 49; /* FFA */

  bw_init(&srv->send_buf);

  /* Set global data directory for file I/O (players.dat, tokens.txt, prof.txt) */
  g_data_dir = srv->config.data_dir;

  /* Load persistent player database */
  playerdb_init(&srv->player_db);
  playerdb_load(&srv->player_db, server_data_path("players.dat"));

  economy_catalog_init(&srv->economy);
  int catalog_rows = economy_catalog_load_tsv(
      &srv->economy, server_data_path("shop_catalog.tsv"));
  if (catalog_rows < 0) {
    async_log("[Economy] Failed to load shop_catalog.tsv; using built-ins only\n");
  } else {
    async_log("[Economy] Catalog ready: %u rows (%d external, %u rejected)\n",
              srv->economy.count, catalog_rows,
              srv->economy.rejected_rows);
  }

  srv->running = true;
  srv->food_target = srv->config.food_amount;
  srv->potion_cell_next_tick = (uint32_t)srv->config.potion_cell_spawn_interval;
  INFO_LOG("[Server] Initialized: %s (port %d)\n", srv->config.server_name,
           srv->config.server_port);

  /* Expanding Land dynamic map scaler */
  mapscaler_init(&srv->map_scaler, &srv->config);

  /* If LW enabled, override the border to tier 0 (7071) starting size
