   * and set food/virus amounts to the scaled-down base values.
   * The quadtree is re-initialized below with max-tier bounds
   * so cells at any tier fit without silent eviction. */
  if (srv->config.lw_enabled) {
    double half = srv->map_scaler.current_size / 2.0;
    srv->border.minx = -half;
    srv->border.miny = -half;
    srv->border.maxx = half;
    srv->border.maxy = half;
    srv->border.width = srv->map_scaler.current_size;
    srv->border.height = srv->map_scaler.current_size;
    /* Scale entity counts for actual starting tier area.
     * base_* values are for tier 1 (10000²); scale down for tier 0 (7071²). */
    double t0_ratio =
        (srv->map_scaler.current_size * srv->map_scaler.current_size) /
        srv->map_scaler.base_map_area;
    srv->config.food_amount =
        (int)(srv->map_scaler.base_food_amount * t0_ratio);
    srv->config.food_spawn_amount =
        (int)(srv->map_scaler.base_food_spawn_amount * t0_ratio);
    srv->config.virus_amount =
        (int)(srv->map_scaler.base_virus_amount * t0_ratio);
    if (srv->config.food_amount < 10)
      srv->config.food_amount = 10;
    if (srv->config.food_spawn_amount < 1)
      srv->config.food_spawn_amount = 1;
    if (srv->config.virus_amount < 2)
      srv->config.virus_amount = 2;
    INFO_LOG("[MapScaler] Border set to %.0f, food=%d/%d, virus=%d\n",
             srv->map_scaler.current_size, srv->config.food_amount,
             srv->config.food_spawn_amount, srv->config.virus_amount);
  }

  /*
   * Spatial indexes use permanent maximum-tier world coordinates.
   *
   * QuadTree already requires maximum bounds because dynamic cells can move
   * into newly expanded territory. FoodGrid must use the same policy:
   * changing its coordinate mapping only after an expansion caused all food
   * spawned beyond the previous border to collapse into edge buckets.
   */
  if (srv->config.lw_enabled) {
    double max_tier_size =
        srv->config.lw_tier_size[
            MAP_TIER_COUNT - 1];

    double max_half =
        max_tier_size / 2.0;

    if (max_half > hw) {
      Rect qt_bounds = {
          -max_half,
          -max_half,
          max_half,
          max_half,
      };

      if (!qt_init(
              &srv->quad_tree,
              qt_bounds,
              qt_pool_dynamic,
              QT_POOL_DYNAMIC,
              qt_overflow_dynamic,
              QT_OVERFLOW_DYNAMIC)) {
        async_log(
            "[FATAL] Unable to initialize dynamic quadtree\n");

        abort();
      }

      srv->quad_tree_build_tick =
          srv->ticks;
    }

    fg_init(
        &srv->food_grid,
        -max_half,
        -max_half,
        max_half,
        max_half);

    srv->food_tree_dirty =
        true;

    INFO_LOG(
        "[Server] Spatial indexes initialized to ±%.0f for max tier\n",
        max_half);
  }

  srv->spawn_border = srv->border; /* initially same as full border */

  /*
   * World Spectate now uses the ordinary transactional per-connection
   * visibility pipeline. The legacy shared World Stream is intentionally not
   * initialized.
   */
}

void server_shutdown(GameServer *srv) {
  srv->running = false;
  /* Save player database before shutting down */
  /*
   * Finish any earlier snapshot first, then persist changes that occurred
   * while it was running, and finally wait for that last durable write.
   */
  playerdb_wait_save(&srv->player_db);
  playerdb_save(&srv->player_db, server_data_path("players.dat"));
  playerdb_wait_save(&srv->player_db);
  playerdb_free(&srv->player_db);
  qt_free(&srv->quad_tree);
  bot_grid_free(&srv->bot_grid);
  food_growth_destroy(srv);
  /* food_grid is stack-allocated, no free needed */
  bw_free(&srv->send_buf);

  free(srv->world_lz4_buffer);
  srv->world_lz4_buffer = NULL;
  srv->world_lz4_capacity = 0;

  INFO_LOG("[Server] Shut down.\n");
}

/* ── Cell management ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

Cell *server_alloc_cell(GameServer *server) {
  if (!server)
    return NULL;

  Cell *cell = NULL;

  if (server->free_count > 0) {
    int index =
        server->free_list[
            --server->free_count];

    if (index < 0 ||
        index >= server->cell_count) {
      async_log(
          "[FATAL] Invalid cell free-list index: %d\n",
          index);

      abort();
    }

    cell =
        &server->cells[index];

    if (!cell->is_removed || cell->is_pending_free) {
      async_log(
          "[FATAL] Cell free-list slot %d is not safely reusable "
          "(removed=%d pending=%d)\n",
          index,
          cell->is_removed ? 1 : 0,
          cell->is_pending_free ? 1 : 0);
      abort();
    }
  } else if (server->cell_count <
             MAX_CELLS) {
    cell =
        &server->cells[
            server->cell_count++];
  } else {
    return NULL;
  }

  uint32_t generation =
      cell->generation + 1;

  if (generation == 0)
    generation = 1;

  /*
   * No connected-player scan occurs here.
   *
   * Existing viewers retain pointer+generation+ID handles. If this slot was
   * still known to a slow viewer, that stale handle is removed lazily during
   * that viewer's next update and its old protocol ID is explicitly deleted.
   */
  memset(
      cell,
      0,
      sizeof(*cell));

  cell->generation =
      generation;

  cell->id =
      ++server->last_cell_id;

  cell->created_tick =
      server->ticks;

  return cell;
}

static void server_queue_cell_free(
    GameServer *srv,
    Cell *cell) {
  int index = (int)(cell - srv->cells);

  if (index < 0 || index >= srv->cell_count) {
    async_log(
        "[FATAL] Invalid cell pointer queued for release: index=%d high=%d\n",
        index,
        srv->cell_count);
    abort();
  }

  if (!cell->is_removed || cell->is_pending_free) {
    async_log(
        "[FATAL] Duplicate or live cell release: index=%d removed=%d pending=%d\n",
        index,
        cell->is_removed ? 1 : 0,
        cell->is_pending_free ? 1 : 0);
    abort();
  }

  if (srv->pending_free_count >= MAX_CELLS) {
    async_log("[FATAL] Cell pending-free list overflow\n");
    abort();
  }

  cell->is_pending_free = true;
  srv->pending_free[srv->pending_free_count++] = index;
}

/* Returns true if cell was successfully added. Food may fail if grid bucket
 * is full — caller should retry with different position. */
void server_release_untracked_cell(
    GameServer *srv,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!srv ||
      !cell ||
      cell->is_removed) {
    return;
  }

  /*
   * Defensive ownership rollback. Normally player creation paths perform this
   * explicitly so they can also restore parent mass, but this makes every
   * independent failure safe.
   */
  if (cell->type == CELL_PLAYER &&
      cell->owner_id >= 0 &&
      cell->owner_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
    Player *owner =
        &srv->players[cell->owner_id];

    for (int i = 0;
         i < owner->cell_count;
         i++) {
      if (owner->cells[i] == cell) {
        owner->cells[i] =
            owner->cells[
                --owner->cell_count];

        owner->cells[
            owner->cell_count] = NULL;

        break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (cell->type == CELL_FOOD) {
    fg_remove(&srv->food_grid, cell);
  }

  cell->is_removed = true;
  cell->is_moving = false;
  cell->food_index = -1;
  cell->virus_index = -1;
  cell->dynamic_index = -1;
  cell->moving_index = -1;

  srv->removed_cell_count++;

  server_queue_cell_free(srv, cell);
}

void server_flush_pending_free(GameServer *srv) {
  if (!srv || srv->pending_free_count == 0)
    return;

  for (int i = 0; i < srv->pending_free_count; i++) {
    int freed_idx = srv->pending_free[i];
    if (freed_idx < 0 || freed_idx >= srv->cell_count) {
      async_log("[FATAL] Out of bounds pending free: index=%d high=%d\n", freed_idx, srv->cell_count);
      abort();
    }
    Cell *cell = &srv->cells[freed_idx];
    if (!cell->is_removed || !cell->is_pending_free) {
      async_log(
          "[FATAL] Invalid pending-free state: index=%d removed=%d pending=%d\n",
          freed_idx,
          cell->is_removed ? 1 : 0,
          cell->is_pending_free ? 1 : 0);
      abort();
    }
    if (srv->free_count >= MAX_CELLS) {
      async_log("[FATAL] Cell free-list overflow\n");
      abort();
    }
    cell->is_pending_free = false;
    srv->free_list[srv->free_count++] = freed_idx;
  }

  srv->pending_free_count = 0;
}


bool server_add_cell(
    GameServer *srv,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!srv ||
      !cell ||
      cell->is_removed) {
    return false;
  }

  /*
   * Preflight every required fixed-capacity structure before mutating any of
   * them. Once insertion starts, no remaining capacity check can fail.
   */
  if (cell->type == CELL_FOOD) {
    if (srv->food_count >= MAX_FOOD)
      return false;
  } else {
    if (srv->dynamic_count >= MAX_DYNAMIC)
      return false;
  }

  if (cell->type == CELL_VIRUS &&
      srv->virus_count >= MAX_VIRUSES) {
    return false;
  }

  if (cell->is_moving &&
      (cell->moving_index >= 0 ||
       srv->moving_count >= MAX_MOVING)) {
    return false;
  }

  if (cell->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
    if (cell->owner_id < 0 ||
        cell->owner_id >= MAX_PLAYERS) {
      return false;
    }

    Player *owner =
        &srv->players[cell->owner_id];

    bool ownership_present = false;

    for (int i = 0;
         i < owner->cell_count;
         i++) {
      if (owner->cells[i] == cell) {
        ownership_present = true;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!ownership_present ||
        owner->cell_count >
            MAX_OWN_CELLS ||
        owner->cell_count >
            srv->config.player_max_cells) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  cell->food_index = -1;
  cell->virus_index = -1;
  cell->dynamic_index = -1;
  cell->moving_index = -1;

  if (cell->type == CELL_FOOD) {
    /*
     * fg_insert either succeeds completely or leaves the grid unchanged.
     */
    if (!fg_insert(
            &srv->food_grid,
            cell)) {
      return false;
    }

    cell->food_index =
        srv->food_count;

    srv->food_nodes[
        srv->food_count++] =
            cell;

    /*
     * Register only still-growing food in the phase scheduler.
     *
     * If scheduler allocation fails, keep the world insertion valid and force
     * this newly added pellet to its maximum configured size. A scheduler OOM
     * must not leave an inserted pellet permanently half-grown or require a
     * fallback full-food scan.
     */
    if (!food_growth_schedule(
            srv,
            cell)) {
      cell_set_size(
          cell,
          srv->config.food_max_size);

      async_log(
          "[FoodGrow] Unable to schedule food %u; spawned at max size\n",
          cell->id);
    }

    srv->spawned_this_tick_count++;

    /*
     * World Spectate consumes the authoritative food grid directly through
     * the transactional visibility pipeline. Do not mirror food into the
     * legacy World Stream snapshot.
     */
    return true;
  }

  /*
   * Before the scheduled rebuild, quad_tree still represents the previous
   * tick and must not receive an additional copy of a reused slot.
   *
   * Cells created after this tick's rebuild are inserted incrementally so
   * they remain visible immediately.
   */
  if (srv->quad_tree_build_tick == srv->ticks &&
      !qt_insert(
          &srv->quad_tree,
          cell)) {
    return false;
  }

  if (cell->type == CELL_VIRUS) {
    cell->virus_index =
        srv->virus_count;

    srv->virus_nodes[
        srv->virus_count++] =
            cell;
  }

  if (cell->type == CELL_MOTHER) {
    srv->mother_count++;
  }

  cell->dynamic_index =
      srv->dynamic_count;

  srv->dynamic_nodes[
      srv->dynamic_count++] =
          cell;

  if (cell->is_moving) {
    /*
     * All capacity checks were completed before any world structure changed,
     * therefore this insertion cannot legitimately fail.
     */
    if (!moving_set_add(
            srv->moving_nodes,
            &srv->moving_count,
            MAX_MOVING,
            &srv->moving_dynamic_count,
            cell)) {
      async_log(
          "[FATAL] Unable to register moving cell %u after insertion\n",
          cell->id);

      abort();
    }
  }

  srv->spawned_this_tick_count++;

  /*
   * World Spectate consumes dynamic_nodes[] directly. Do not mirror this cell
   * into the legacy World Stream snapshot.
   */
  return true;
}


void server_remove_cell(GameServer *srv, Cell *cell) {
  if (!srv ||
      !cell ||
      cell->is_removed) {
    return;
  }

  /*
   * Remove from the moving set immediately. Do not leave a stale moving entry
   * until the following tick.
   */
  server_untrack_moving_cell(
      srv,
      cell);

  cell->is_moving = false;
  cell->boost_dist = 0.0;
  cell->is_removed = true;
  srv->removed_cell_count++;

  /*
   * The transactional World Spectate diff discovers this removal through the
   * authoritative client tracking and removed-cell lifecycle. Do not publish
   * it into the legacy shared World Stream journal.
   */

  /* PERF: view_state clearing DEFERRED to server_alloc_cell() (line ~379).
   * When the index is reused, alloc_cell iterates connected_ids and clears
   * view_state there. That's the only point where stale=1 matters (it would
   * cause UPDATE instead of ADD for the NEW cell). The diff engine's Phase 2
   * handles is_removed cells correctly via client_nodes scanning — it sends
   * DELETE/EAT regardless of view_state value.
   * Removing this per-removal O(connected_count) loop saves ~10K random
   * cache-cold writes per tick at 200 players × 50 removals. */

  /* Push freed index onto PENDING list — not reusable until after send_updates.
   * If reused immediately, client_nodes still references this index and the
   * diff logic wouldn't send DELETE for the old cell (ghost cell bug). */
  server_queue_cell_free(srv, cell);

  /* Emit EVT_EAT or EVT_REMOVE to all watchers */
  /* Removed cells are handled by removed_this_tick[] in send_updates.
   * No watcher/event system needed — dirty list is global. */

  /* Track for forced eat/del injection in send_updates */
  if (srv->removed_this_tick_count <
      (int)(sizeof(srv->removed_this_tick) / sizeof(srv->removed_this_tick[0])))
    srv->removed_this_tick[srv->removed_this_tick_count++] = cell;

  /* O(1) remove from food array using stored index */
  if (cell->type == CELL_FOOD && cell->food_index >= 0) {
    /* PERF: incremental food grid removal instead of full rebuild.
     * fg_remove scans only the cell's bucket (~1 entry average). */
    fg_remove(&srv->food_grid, cell);
    int idx = cell->food_index;
    if (idx < srv->food_count) {
      Cell *last = srv->food_nodes[--srv->food_count];
      srv->food_nodes[idx] = last;
      last->food_index = idx;
    }
    cell->food_index = -1;
  }
  /* O(1) remove from virus array using stored index */
  if (cell->type == CELL_VIRUS && cell->virus_index >= 0) {
    int idx = cell->virus_index;
    if (idx < srv->virus_count) {
      Cell *last = srv->virus_nodes[--srv->virus_count];
      srv->virus_nodes[idx] = last;
      last->virus_index = idx;
    }
    cell->virus_index = -1;
  }
  if (cell->type == CELL_MOTHER && srv->mother_count > 0) {
    srv->mother_count--;
  }
  /* O(1) remove from dynamic array using stored index */
  if (cell->dynamic_index >= 0) {
    int idx = cell->dynamic_index;
    if (idx < srv->dynamic_count) {
      Cell *last = srv->dynamic_nodes[--srv->dynamic_count];
      srv->dynamic_nodes[idx] = last;
      last->dynamic_index = idx;
    }
    cell->dynamic_index = -1;
  }
  /* Remove from player's cell list (max 16, linear scan is fine) */
  if (cell->owner_id >= 0 && cell->owner_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[cell->owner_id];
    for (int i = 0; i < p->cell_count; i++) {
      if (p->cells[i] == cell) {
        p->cells[i] = p->cells[--p->cell_count];
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ── Spawning ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* FOOD_BUCKET_SOFT_CAP defined in config.h */

Vec2 server_random_ring_food_pos_softcap(GameServer *srv, double padding) {
  Vec2 pos = server_random_pos_in_expand_ring_padded(srv, padding);

  for (int tries = 0; tries < 8; tries++) {
    pos = server_random_pos_in_expand_ring_padded(srv, padding);
    int bucket_count = fg_bucket_count_at_pos(&srv->food_grid, pos.x, pos.y);

    if (bucket_count < FOOD_BUCKET_SOFT_CAP) {
      return pos;
    }

    /* Accept slightly crowded buckets with decreasing probability */
    int excess = bucket_count - FOOD_BUCKET_SOFT_CAP;
    if (excess < 0)
      excess = 0;
    double accept_prob = 1.0 / (1.0 + excess * 0.35);
    if (((double)rand() / RAND_MAX) < accept_prob) {
      return pos;
    }
  }

  return pos;
}
/*
 * Grow only the food assigned to the current scheduler phase.
 *
 * This changes the tick cost from:
 *
 *   O(all food cells)
 *
 * to:
 *
 *   O(food that is still growing / FOOD_GROWTH_PHASES)
 *
 * Stale entries are removed lazily and safely by validating both the Cell
 * pointer and the captured pool-slot generation.
 */
static void server_grow_food(GameServer *srv) {
  if (!srv)
    return;

  int grow_ticks =
      srv->config.food_grow_ticks;

  double min_sz =
      srv->config.food_min_size;

  double max_sz =
      srv->config.food_max_size;

  /*
   * Growth configuration is not valid. Clear scheduler references so they do
   * not remain allocated and repeatedly checked forever.
   */
  if (grow_ticks <= 0 ||
      max_sz <= min_sz) {
    for (int phase = 0;
         phase < FOOD_GROWTH_PHASES;
         phase++) {
      srv->food_growth[phase].count = 0;
    }

    return;
  }

  double range =
      max_sz - min_sz;

  uint32_t phase =
      srv->ticks % FOOD_GROWTH_PHASES;

  FoodGrowthBucket *bucket =
      &srv->food_growth[phase];

  int write_index = 0;

  for (int read_index = 0;
       read_index < bucket->count;
       read_index++) {
    FoodGrowthRef ref =
        bucket->items[read_index];

    Cell *cell =
        ref.cell;

    /*
     * A removed pool slot can be reused for another entity. The generation
     * check is mandatory and must occur before modifying the cell.
     */
    if (!cell ||
        cell->generation != ref.generation ||
        cell->is_removed ||
        cell->type != CELL_FOOD) {
      continue;
    }

    uint32_t age =
        srv->ticks -
        cell->created_tick;

    bool finished =
        age >= (uint32_t)grow_ticks;

    double target_size;

    if (finished) {
      /*
       * Set the exact configured final size. The old implementation could skip
       * the final value when the staggered age jumped beyond grow_ticks.
       */
      target_size = max_sz;
    } else {
      double progress =
          (double)age /
          (double)grow_ticks;

      target_size =
          min_sz +
          progress * range;

      if (target_size > max_sz)
        target_size = max_sz;
    }

    if (target_size >
        cell->radius + 0.05) {
      uint16_t old_wire_radius =
          (uint16_t)cell->radius;

      cell_set_size(
          cell,
          target_size);

      uint16_t new_wire_radius =
          (uint16_t)cell->radius;

      /*
       * Preserve the existing network optimization: publish a dirty update
       * only when the integer radius serialized to the client changes.
       */
      if (new_wire_radius !=
          old_wire_radius) {
        mark_cell_dirty(
            cell,
            srv->ticks);
      }
    }

    /*
     * Retain only food that still requires future growth evaluations.
     * Compaction is in-place and allocation-free.
     */
    if (!finished &&
        cell->radius <
            max_sz - 0.05) {
      bucket->items[write_index++] =
          ref;
    }
  }

  bucket->count =
      write_index;
}

void server_spawn_food(GameServer *srv) {
  int spawn_limit =
      srv->config.food_spawn_amount;

  if (spawn_limit <= 0 ||
      srv->config.food_amount <= 0) {
    return;
  }

  int spawned = 0;
  int attempts = 0;

  /*
   * A permanently full grid bucket or another insertion invariant must not
   * consume the entire free-list/high-water allocator in one tick.
   */
  int max_attempts;

  if (spawn_limit >
      (MAX_FOOD - 32) / 3) {
    max_attempts =
        MAX_FOOD;
  } else {
    max_attempts =
        spawn_limit * 3 + 32;
  }

  while (srv->food_count <
             srv->food_target &&
         spawned < spawn_limit &&
         attempts < max_attempts) {
    attempts++;

    Cell *cell =
        server_alloc_cell(srv);

    if (!cell)
      break;

    double size = srv->config.food_min_size;

    cell_init(
        cell,
        cell->id,
        CELL_FOOD,
        vec2(0, 0),
        size);

    cell->color =
        server_random_color();

    cell->created_tick =
        srv->ticks;

    Vec2 position = {0, 0};
    bool added = false;
    bool in_ring = false;

    for (int retry = 0;
         retry < 3 && !added;
         retry++) {
      in_ring =
          server_should_spawn_food_in_ring(
              srv);

      position = in_ring
          ? server_random_pos_in_expand_ring_padded(
                srv,
                size * 0.5)
          : server_random_pos_padded(
                srv,
                size * 0.5);

      if (fg_bucket_count_at_pos(
              &srv->food_grid,
              position.x,
              position.y) >=
          FOOD_BUCKET_SOFT_CAP) {
        continue;
      }

      /* Reject positions that overlap an existing player cell */
      {
        static Cell *fp_nearby[64];
        double check_r = size + 150.0;
        Rect fp_area = {
            position.x - check_r, position.y - check_r,
            position.x + check_r, position.y + check_r};
        int fp_n = bot_grid_query(
            &srv->bot_grid, fp_area, fp_nearby, 64);
        bool fp_collides = false;
        for (int fi = 0; fi < fp_n && !fp_collides; fi++) {
          Cell *other = fp_nearby[fi];
          if (other->is_removed ||
              other->type != CELL_PLAYER)
            continue;
          double dx = other->position.x - position.x;
          double dy = other->position.y - position.y;
          double thr = other->radius + size;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < thr * thr)
            fp_collides = true;
        }
        if (fp_collides)
          continue;
      }

      cell->position =
          position;

      added =
          server_add_cell(
              srv,
              cell);
    }

    for (int retry = 0;
         retry < 2 && !added;
         retry++) {
      in_ring =
          server_should_spawn_food_in_ring(
              srv);

      position = in_ring
          ? server_random_pos_in_expand_ring_padded(
                srv,
                size * 0.5)
          : server_random_pos_padded(
                srv,
                size * 0.5);

      /* Reject positions that overlap an existing player cell */
      {
        static Cell *fp_nearby2[64];
        double check_r2 = size + 150.0;
        Rect fp_area2 = {
            position.x - check_r2, position.y - check_r2,
            position.x + check_r2, position.y + check_r2};
        int fp_n2 = bot_grid_query(
            &srv->bot_grid, fp_area2, fp_nearby2, 64);
        bool fp_collides2 = false;
        for (int fi2 = 0;
             fi2 < fp_n2 && !fp_collides2;
             fi2++) {
          Cell *other = fp_nearby2[fi2];
          if (other->is_removed ||
              other->type != CELL_PLAYER)
            continue;
          double dx = other->position.x - position.x;
          double dy = other->position.y - position.y;
          double thr = other->radius + size;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy < thr * thr)
            fp_collides2 = true;
        }
        if (fp_collides2)
          continue;
      }

      cell->position =
          position;

      added =
          server_add_cell(
              srv,
              cell);
    }

    if (added) {
      spawned++;

      if (in_ring) {
        srv->map_scaler
            .ring_food_spawned++;
      }
    } else {
      server_release_untracked_cell(
          srv,
          cell);
    }
  }
}


void server_spawn_viruses(GameServer *srv) {
  static Cell *nearby[256];
  int spawned_this_tick = 0;

  while (srv->virus_count < srv->config.virus_amount && spawned_this_tick < 50) {
    spawned_this_tick++;
    Cell *cell = server_alloc_cell(srv);
    if (!cell) break;

    Vec2 position = {0, 0};
    double radius =
        srv->config.virus_min_size;

    bool in_ring = false;
    bool collides = true;

    for (int attempt = 0;
         attempt < 20;
         attempt++) {
      in_ring =
          server_should_spawn_virus_in_ring(
              srv);

      position = in_ring
          ? server_random_pos_in_expand_ring_padded(
                srv,
                radius)
          : server_random_pos_padded(
                srv,
                radius);

      double check_radius =
          800.0 + radius;

      Rect area = {
          position.x - check_radius,
          position.y - check_radius,
          position.x + check_radius,
          position.y + check_radius,
      };

      int count = bot_grid_query(
          &srv->bot_grid,
          area,
          nearby,
          256);

      count = fg_query_from(
          &srv->food_grid,
          area,
          nearby,
          count,
          256);

      collides = false;

      for (int i = 0;
           i < count;
           i++) {
        Cell *other = nearby[i];

        if (other->is_removed)
          continue;

        double dx =
            other->position.x -
            position.x;

        double dy =
            other->position.y -
            position.y;

        double distance_squared =
            dx * dx + dy * dy;

        if (other->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
          double threshold =
              radius + other->radius;

          if (distance_squared <
              threshold * threshold) {
            collides = true;
            break;
          }
        }

        if (other->type == CELL_VIRUS &&
            distance_squared <
                800.0 * 800.0) {
          collides = true;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!collides)
        break;
    }

    if (collides) {
      server_release_untracked_cell(srv, cell);
      break;
    }

    cell_init(
        cell,
        cell->id,
        CELL_VIRUS,
        position,
        srv->config.virus_min_size);

    cell->color =
        (Color){0x33, 0xFF, 0x33};

    cell->is_virus = true;
    cell->created_tick = srv->ticks;

    if (!server_add_cell(
            srv,
            cell)) {
      server_release_untracked_cell(
          srv,
          cell);

      /*
       * Capacity exhaustion cannot be improved by trying another position.
       */
      break;
    }

    if (in_ring)
      srv->map_scaler.ring_virus_spawned++;
  }
}


void server_spawn_player(
    GameServer *srv,
    Player *player,
    Vec2 position) {
  int maximum =
      srv->config.player_max_cells;

  if (maximum > MAX_OWN_CELLS)
    maximum = MAX_OWN_CELLS;

  if (maximum < 1)
    maximum = 1;

  if (player->cell_count >= maximum)
    return;

  player->compacted_drop_count = 0;

  Cell *cell =
      server_alloc_cell(srv);

  if (!cell)
    return;

  double starting_mass = 10.0;

  player->login_bonus_applied = false;

  if (player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
    PlayerRecord *record =
        player->cached_rec;

    if (!record) {
      record = playerdb_lookup(
          &srv->player_db,
          player->uid);

      player->cached_rec = record;
    }

    /* Apply equipped_skin from database if the join message had no skin.
     * player_set_identity() was called BEFORE this lookup, so its
     * cached_rec fallback path couldn't fire. Re-apply now. */
    if (player->skin[0] == '\0' && record && record->equipped_skin[0]) {
      const char *sk = record->equipped_skin;
      if (strncmp(sk, "skin_", 5) == 0) sk += 5;
      if (sk[0] && sk[0] != 'e' && strcmp(sk, "empty") != 0) {
        if (sk[0] == '%' || strncmp(sk, "http", 4) == 0) {
          strncpy(player->skin, sk, MAX_PLAYER_SKIN);
        } else {
          snprintf(player->skin, MAX_PLAYER_SKIN, "%%%s", sk);
        }
        player->skin[MAX_PLAYER_SKIN] = '\0';
      }
    }

    if (record &&
        record->starting_mass_bonus > 0) {
      starting_mass +=
          (double)record->starting_mass_bonus;
    }

    starting_mass += 5.0;

    if (starting_mass > 43.0)
      starting_mass = 43.0;

    player->login_bonus_applied = true;
  }

  double starting_size =
      sqrt(starting_mass * 100.0);

  cell_init(
      cell,
      cell->id,
      CELL_PLAYER,
      position,
      player->is_bot ? starting_size : 1.0);

  /* Spawn grow-in animation: 1.0 second = 25 ticks at 25Hz (humans only) */
  if (!player->is_bot) {
    cell->spawn_target_radius = starting_size;
    cell->spawn_grow_end_tick = srv->ticks + 25;
  }

  cell->color = player->color;
  cell->owner_id = player->id;
  cell->created_tick = srv->ticks;

  player->cells[
      player->cell_count++] =
          cell;

  if (!server_add_cell(
          srv,
          cell)) {
    player->cells[
        --player->cell_count] = NULL;

    server_release_untracked_cell(
        srv,
        cell);

    return;
  }

  player->spawn_tick = srv->ticks;
  player->center = position;
  player->mouse_target = position;
  player->mouse = position;
  player->highest_mass = 0;
  player->session_xp = 0;
  player->food_eaten = 0;
  player->players_eaten = 0;
  player->viruses_eaten = 0;
  player->mass_consumed = 0;
  player->quest_session_start_mass = 0;
  player->cells_eaten = 0;
  player->top_position = 0;
  player->time_on_lb = 0;
  player->extra_decay_multiplier = 0;
  player->anti_danger_accum = 0;

  BinaryWriter writer;
  bw_init(&writer);

  pkt_add_node(
      &writer,
      player,
      cell->id);

  net_queue_to_player(
      player->conn_id,
      bw_data(&writer),
      bw_length(&writer));

  bw_free(&writer);
}


/* ── Player actions ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

bool server_split_cell(
    GameServer *srv,
    Player *player,
    Cell *parent,
    double angle,
    double split_mass) {
  if (!srv ||
      !player ||
      !parent ||
      parent->is_removed) {
    return false;
  }

  if (player->cell_count >= MAX_OWN_CELLS ||
      player->cell_count >=
          srv->config.player_max_cells) {
    return false;
  }

  double new_size =
      split_mass > 0
          ? sqrt(split_mass * 100.0)
          : parent->radius /
                1.4142135623730951;

  Cell *child =
      server_alloc_cell(srv);

  if (!child)
    return false;

  double original_parent_size =
      parent->radius;

  Vec2 spawn_position = vec2_add(
      parent->position,
      vec2_scale(
          vec2_from_angle(angle),
          parent->radius));

  cell_init(
      child,
      child->id,
      CELL_PLAYER,
      spawn_position,
      new_size);

  child->color = parent->color;
  child->owner_id = player->id;
  child->created_tick = srv->ticks;

  if (!server_start_cell_boost(
          srv,
          child,
          srv->config.split_velocity *
              pow(new_size, 0.0122),
          angle)) {
    child->is_moving = false;
    child->boost_dist = 0.0;
    server_release_untracked_cell(
        srv,
        child);

    return false;
  }

  child->boost_friction =
      srv->config.split_boost_friction;

  cell_set_size(
      parent,
      new_size);

  player->cells[
      player->cell_count++] =
          child;

  if (!server_add_cell(
          srv,
          child)) {
    player->cells[
        --player->cell_count] = NULL;

    cell_set_size(
        parent,
        original_parent_size);

    server_release_untracked_cell(
        srv,
        child);

    return false;
  }

  mark_cell_dirty(
      parent,
      srv->ticks);

  /* Mark ALL existing cells of this player for name refresh */
  for (int ci = 0; ci < player->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (player->cells[ci] && !player->cells[ci]->is_removed) {
      player->cells[ci]->needs_name_refresh = true;
      mark_cell_dirty(player->cells[ci], srv->ticks);
    }
  }

  mark_cell_dirty(
      child,
      srv->ticks);

  player->force_full_diff_next_tick =
      true;

  if (player->conn_id >= 0) {
    BinaryWriter writer;
    bw_init(&writer);

    pkt_add_node(
        &writer,
        player,
        child->id);

    net_queue_to_player(
        player->conn_id,
        bw_data(&writer),
        bw_length(&writer));

    bw_free(&writer);
  }

  return true;
}


void server_split_player_cells(GameServer *srv, Player *player) {
  if (player->cell_count <= 0)
    return;
  if (player->merge_override || player->frozen)
    return;

  /* Sort cells by size descending so the LARGEST cell splits first.
   * Critical for double-splits: when the 2nd split opcode arrives one tick
   * later, child1 (from split #1) is now the largest piece and is already
   * boosting outward. Splitting IT (not the shrunken parent) makes child2
   * cascade from child1's position — matching real Agar.io behavior.
   * Insertion sort: cell_count <= 16 and usually nearly sorted. */
  for (int i = 1; i < player->cell_count; i++) {
    Cell *key = player->cells[i];
    double key_r = key->radius;
    int j = i - 1;
    while (j >= 0 && player->cells[j]->radius < key_r) {
      player->cells[j + 1] = player->cells[j];
      j--;
    }
    player->cells[j + 1] = key;
  }

  int count = player->cell_count; /* snapshot, don't iterate new cells */
  bool has_split = false;
  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    if (player->cell_count >= srv->config.player_max_cells)
      break;
    Cell *cell = player->cells[i];
    if (cell->radius < srv->config.player_min_split_size)
      continue;

    double dx = player->mouse_target.x - cell->position.x;
    double dy = player->mouse_target.y - cell->position.y;
    double angle = atan2(dy, dx);

    if (server_split_cell(
            srv,
            player,
            cell,
            angle,
            0)) {
      has_split = true;
    }
  }

  if (has_split) {
    player->extra_decay_multiplier += srv->config.at_split_loss;
  }
}

void server_eject_mass(
    GameServer *srv,
    Player *player) {
  int ejected_count = 0;

  for (int index = 0;
       index < player->cell_count;
       index++) {
    Cell *parent =
        player->cells[index];

    if (parent->radius <
        srv->config.player_min_eject_size) {
      continue;
    }

    double dx =
        player->mouse_target.x -
        parent->position.x;

    double dy =
        player->mouse_target.y -
        parent->position.y;

    double angle =
        atan2(dy, dx);

    Cell *ejected =
        server_alloc_cell(srv);

    if (!ejected)
      break;

    double original_radius =
        parent->radius;

    Vec2 eject_position =
        vec2_add(
            parent->position,
            vec2_scale(
                vec2_from_angle(angle),
                parent->radius));

    cell_init(
        ejected,
        ejected->id,
        CELL_EJECTED,
        eject_position,
        srv->config.eject_size);

    ejected->color =
        parent->color;

    ejected->owner_id =
        player->id;

    ejected->created_tick =
        srv->ticks;

    if (!server_start_cell_boost(
            srv,
            ejected,
            srv->config.eject_velocity,
            angle)) {
      server_release_untracked_cell(
          srv,
          ejected);

      continue;
    }

    double radicand =
        parent->radius2 -
        srv->config.eject_size_loss *
            srv->config.eject_size_loss;

    if (radicand < 1.0)
      radicand = 1.0;

    cell_set_size(
        parent,
        sqrt(radicand));

    if (!server_add_cell(
            srv,
            ejected)) {
      /*
       * Transactional rollback: a failed ejected-cell insertion must not
       * consume player mass.
       */
      cell_set_size(
          parent,
          original_radius);

      server_release_untracked_cell(
          srv,
          ejected);

      continue;
    }

    mark_cell_dirty(
        parent,
        srv->ticks);

    mark_cell_dirty(
        ejected,
        srv->ticks);

    ejected_count++;
  }

  if (ejected_count > 0) {
    player->extra_decay_multiplier +=
        srv->config.at_eject_loss;
  }
}


void server_shoot_virus(GameServer *srv, Cell *virus, double angle) {
  Cell *new_virus = server_alloc_cell(srv);
  if (!new_virus)
    return;

  Vec2 pos = vec2_add(virus->position,
                      vec2_scale(vec2_from_angle(angle), virus->radius));
  cell_init(new_virus, new_virus->id, CELL_VIRUS, pos,
            srv->config.virus_min_size);
  new_virus->color = (Color){0x33, 0xFF, 0x33}; // Standard Agar.io Virus Green
  new_virus->is_virus = true;
  new_virus->created_tick = srv->ticks;
  if (!server_start_cell_boost(
          srv,
          new_virus,
          srv->config.virus_velocity,
          angle)) {
    server_release_untracked_cell(
        srv,
        new_virus);

    return;
  }

  if (!server_add_cell(
          srv,
          new_virus)) {
    server_release_untracked_cell(
        srv,
        new_virus);
  }
}

/* ── Cell movement ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

#ifdef __GNUC__
__attribute__((hot))
#endif
static void server_move_player_cells(GameServer *srv) {
#if defined(_OPENMP)
  #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)
#endif
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
    Player *player = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
    if (player->cell_count == 0)
      continue;

    /* Disconnected cells keep normal mechanics but stop following the
     * final mouse coordinate. Existing boosts continue normally. */
    if (player->frozen)
      continue;

    /* FAST PATH: skip movement for disconnected inactive slots (bots move via is_bot or is_lm_client) */
    if (player->conn_id < 0 && !player->is_lm_client && !player->is_bot)
      continue;

    /* No smoothing: cells react instantly to mouse_target (like real agar.io).
     * Previously 0.7 factor added ~96ms latency on direction changes. */
    player->mouse.x = player->mouse_target.x;
    player->mouse.y = player->mouse_target.y;

    double p_speed_mult = srv->config.player_speed;
    for (int i = 0; i < player->cell_count; i++) {
      Cell *cell = player->cells[i];
      if (UNLIKELY(cell->is_removed))
        continue;

      /* Move toward mouse */
      double dx = player->mouse.x - cell->position.x;
      double dy = player->mouse.y - cell->position.y;
      double dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      if (dist2 > 0.0001) {
        double speed = cell->cached_speed * p_speed_mult;
        double dist = sqrt(dist2);
        if (dist < speed) speed = dist;
        double inv_dist = 1.0 / dist;
        cell->position.x += dx * inv_dist * speed;
        cell->position.y += dy * inv_dist * speed;
      }

      /* Clamp to border */
      double r = cell->radius / 2.0;
      if (cell->position.x < srv->border.minx + r)
        cell->position.x = srv->border.minx + r;
      if (cell->position.x > srv->border.maxx - r)
        cell->position.x = srv->border.maxx - r;
      if (cell->position.y < srv->border.miny + r)
        cell->position.y = srv->border.miny + r;
      if (cell->position.y > srv->border.maxy - r)
        cell->position.y = srv->border.maxy - r;

      /* Mark dirty for pull model */
      mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks);
    }
  }
}

#ifdef __GNUC__
__attribute__((hot))
#endif
static void server_move_boosted_cells(
    GameServer *srv) {
  int index = 0;

  while (index <
         srv->moving_count) {
    Cell *cell =
        srv->moving_nodes[index];

    if (UNLIKELY(!cell)) {
      async_log(
          "[FATAL] NULL moving cell at index %d/%d\n",
          index,
          srv->moving_count);

      abort();
    }

    if (UNLIKELY(cell->moving_index != index)) {
      async_log(
          "[FATAL] Moving index mismatch: cell=%u stored=%d actual=%d\n",
          cell->id,
          cell->moving_index,
          index);

      abort();
    }

    if (UNLIKELY(cell->is_removed ||
        !cell->is_moving)) {
      server_untrack_moving_cell(
          srv,
          cell);

      continue;
    }

    /* Save pre-move position for food grid relocation */
    double old_x = cell->position.x;
    double old_y = cell->position.y;

    bool still_moving =
        cell_move_boost(
            cell,
            srv->border.minx,
            srv->border.miny,
            srv->border.maxx,
            srv->border.maxy);

    /* Relocate food cells in FoodGrid after position change */
    if (cell->food_index >= 0) {
      if (!fg_relocate(&srv->food_grid, cell, old_x, old_y)) {
        /* New bucket full: fg_relocate restored old position. Fully stop the cell. */
        cell->is_moving = false;
        cell->boost_dist = 0.0;
        server_untrack_moving_cell(srv, cell);
        continue;
      }
    }

    mark_cell_dirty(
        cell,
        srv->ticks);

    if (!still_moving) {
      server_untrack_moving_cell(
          srv,
          cell);

      continue;
    }

    index++;
  }
}


/* ── Free-roam spectator camera movement ─────────────────────── */

static void server_move_free_roam_spectators(GameServer *srv) {
  /* Dead spectators are in connected_ids, not active_player_ids. */
  for (int ci = 0;
       ci < srv->connected_count;
       ci++) {
    Player *player =
        &srv->players[
            srv->connected_ids[ci]];

    if (!player->active ||
        player->is_removed ||
        player->conn_id < 0) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!player->spectate ||
        !player->free_roam ||
        player->cell_count > 0) {
      continue;
    }

    /*
     * A whole-map scale already fits the authoritative border on screen.
     * Moving that camera shifts part of the map outside the viewport and makes
     * World Spectate look incorrect. Lock every full-map variant to the actual
     * current border centre.
     *
     * Keep the legacy non-world centred spectator locked as well.
     */
    if (player->full_map_spectate) {
      Vec2 map_center = {
          (srv->border.minx +
           srv->border.maxx) * 0.5,

          (srv->border.miny +
           srv->border.maxy) * 0.5,
      };

      player->center = map_center;
      player->mouse = map_center;
      player->mouse_target = map_center;

      continue;
    }

    /* Ordinary free-roam spectator camera. */
    player->mouse.x =
        player->mouse_target.x;

    player->mouse.y =
        player->mouse_target.y;

    Vec2 diff =
        vec2_sub(
            player->mouse,
            player->center);

    double dist =
        vec2_length(
            diff);

    if (dist > 1.0) {
      double speed =
          fmin(
              dist,
              srv->config.spectator_camera_speed);

      player->center.x +=
          diff.x / dist * speed;

      player->center.y +=
          diff.y / dist * speed;
    }

    if (player->center.x < srv->border.minx)
      player->center.x = srv->border.minx;

    if (player->center.x > srv->border.maxx)
      player->center.x = srv->border.maxx;

    if (player->center.y < srv->border.miny)
      player->center.y = srv->border.miny;

    if (player->center.y > srv->border.maxy)
      player->center.y = srv->border.maxy;
  }
}

/* ── Collision detection ─────────────────────────────────────── */

static bool can_eat(const GameServer *srv, const Cell *hunter,
                    const Cell *prey) {
  (void)srv; /* reserved for future config-dependent eat rules */
  if (hunter->is_removed || prey->is_removed || hunter == prey)
    return false;

  /* Early out for same-owner split cells (handled separately by merge logic) */
  if (hunter->type == CELL_PLAYER && prey->type == CELL_PLAYER &&
      hunter->owner_id == prey->owner_id && hunter->owner_id >= 0) {
    return false;
  }

  /* Potion cells: any player cell can eat them regardless of size */
  if (prey->type == CELL_POTION && hunter->type == CELL_PLAYER)
    goto distance_check;

  /* Type constraints */
  if (hunter->type == CELL_VIRUS && prey->type != CELL_EJECTED)
    return false;

  /* Size check: hunter must be >= 1.25x bigger in mass (1.118x radius) */
  if (hunter->radius <= prey->radius * 1.118)
    return false;

distance_check:;
  /* Squared-distance check — avoids sqrt() entirely */
  double dx = hunter->position.x - prey->position.x;
  double dy = hunter->position.y - prey->position.y;
  double dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;

  /* Potion cells: overlap check so player cells of any size can eat them */
  if (prey->type == CELL_POTION && hunter->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
    double p_thresh = hunter->radius + prey->radius * 0.5;
    return (dist2 <= p_thresh * p_thresh);
  }

  /* Coarse early-out (avoids threshold calculation below for far cells) */
  if (dist2 > hunter->radius2)
    return false;

  /* Precise squared check: dist < threshold  ⟺  dist² < threshold² */
  double threshold = hunter->radius - prey->radius / 4.0;
  if (threshold <= 0 || dist2 > threshold * threshold)
    return false;

  if (hunter->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
    if (prey->type == CELL_MOTHER && hunter->radius < prey->radius)
      return false;
    return true;
  }

  if (hunter->type == CELL_MOTHER) {
    if (prey->type == CELL_PLAYER && prey->radius < hunter->radius)
      return true;
    return (prey->type == CELL_FOOD || prey->type == CELL_EJECTED);
  }

  return false;
}

#if defined(_MSC_VER)
#define THREAD_LOCAL __declspec(thread)
#else
#define THREAD_LOCAL __thread
#endif

static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *tl_query_result[QT_QUERY_MAX];

#define SAFE_SERVER_REMOVE_CELL(srv_ptr, cell_ptr) server_remove_cell((srv_ptr), (cell_ptr))

#ifdef __GNUC__
__attribute__((hot))
#endif
static void server_check_collisions(GameServer *srv) {
  /* Collision resolution is SERIAL: it mutates global world state
   * (cell allocator, world arrays, player cell arrays, removal tracking).
   * Parallelizing this caused race conditions where two threads could
   * pop the same virus, corrupt the free list, or lose DELETE records,
   * producing ghost cells visible to clients. */
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
    Cell **query_result = tl_query_result; /* pre-allocated, no 512KB stack alloc */
    Player *player = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
    if (player->cell_count == 0)
      continue;

    /* FAST PATH: skip collision checks for disconnected inactive slots. */
    if (!player->frozen && player->conn_id < 0 && !player->is_lm_client && !player->is_bot)
      continue;

    for (int i = 0; i < player->cell_count; i++) {
      Cell *cell = player->cells[i];
      if (cell->is_removed)
        continue;

      bool popped = false;

      int count = 0;
      bool need_qt = (player->cell_count > 1) || (cell->radius >= 35.35) || (srv->mother_count > 0);

      if (need_qt) {
        double r_qt = (srv->mother_count > 0)
            ? (cell->radius + MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS)
            : ((player->cell_count > 1) ? (cell->radius * 1.5 + 35.0) : (cell->radius + 35.0));
        Rect area_qt = {cell->position.x - r_qt, cell->position.y - r_qt,
                        cell->position.x + r_qt, cell->position.y + r_qt};
        PROF_START_NS(collisions_qt_query_ns);
        count = bot_grid_query(&srv->bot_grid, area_qt, query_result, QT_QUERY_MAX);
        PROF_ADD_NS(collisions_qt_query_ns);
      }

      /* Query food grid for nearby food pellets.
       * All cells can eat food regardless of size — food is a core mechanic. */
      {
        double r_food = cell->radius + 12.0;
        PROF_START_NS(collisions_food_query_ns);
        count = fg_query_circle(&srv->food_grid, cell->position.x, cell->position.y,
                                r_food, query_result, count, QT_QUERY_MAX);
        PROF_ADD_NS(collisions_food_query_ns);
      }

      for (int j = 0; j < count; j++) {
        PREFETCH_CELL(query_result, j, count);
        if (UNLIKELY(cell->is_removed))
          break;
        Cell *other = query_result[j];

        if (UNLIKELY(other == cell || other->is_removed))
          continue;

        /* Fast-path food pellet eating (95% of collision query candidates)
         * Uses float math — 2x faster than double for distance checks,
         * more than sufficient precision for overlap detection. */
        if (LIKELY(other->type == CELL_FOOD)) {
          float fdx = (float)(other->position.x - cell->position.x);
          float fdy = (float)(other->position.y - cell->position.y);
          float fr_eat = (float)cell->radius - 3.333333f;
          if (fdx * fdx + fdy * fdy <= fr_eat * fr_eat) {
            player->mass_consumed++;
            player->food_eaten++;
            player->cells_eaten++;
            if (UNLIKELY(player->mass_boost > 1.0)) {
              double boosted_r2 = cell->radius2 + 100.0 * player->mass_boost;
              cell_set_size(cell, sqrt(boosted_r2));
            } else {
              cell_eat(cell, other);
            }
            mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks);
            SAFE_SERVER_REMOVE_CELL(srv, other);
          }
          continue;
        }

        /* Rigid body collision & merge (same player) — process each pair ONCE */
        if (cell->type == CELL_PLAYER && other->type == CELL_PLAYER &&
            cell->owner_id == other->owner_id && cell->owner_id >= 0) {
          if (cell->id >= other->id)
            continue;

          uint32_t hunter_age = srv->ticks - cell->created_tick;
          uint32_t prey_age = srv->ticks - other->created_tick;

          /* Age < 13 ticks: allow cells to pass through each other during
           * initial split boost */
          if (hunter_age >= 13 && prey_age >= 13) {
            double dx = other->position.x - cell->position.x;
            double dy = other->position.y - cell->position.y;
            double dSqrt = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            double rSum = cell->radius + other->radius;

            if (dSqrt >= rSum * rSum || dSqrt <= 0.0)
              continue;

            double mass = (cell->mass > other->mass) ? cell->mass : other->mass;
            double merge_seconds = 29.0 + (8.0 / 300.0) * mass;
            uint32_t merge_ticks = (uint32_t)(merge_seconds * 25.0);

            if (hunter_age >= merge_ticks && prey_age >= merge_ticks) {
              /* Can merge */
              double r_max =
                  (cell->radius > other->radius) ? cell->radius : other->radius;
              double r_min =
                  (cell->radius < other->radius) ? cell->radius : other->radius;
              double merge_threshold = r_max + r_min * 0.2;

              if (dSqrt < merge_threshold * merge_threshold) {
                Cell *eater = cell;
                Cell *eaten = other;

                if (other->radius > cell->radius) {
                  eater = other;
                  eaten = cell;
                } else if (other->radius == cell->radius &&
                           other->id < cell->id) {
                  eater = other;
                  eaten = cell;
                }

                eaten->killer_id = eater->id;
                cell_eat(eater, eaten);
                SAFE_SERVER_REMOVE_CELL(srv, eaten);
              }

              continue;
            }

            /* Cannot merge: apply rigid body extrusion */
            double inv_d = 1.0 / sqrt(dSqrt);
            double push = rSum * inv_d - 1.0;
            double inv_mass = push / (cell->radius2 + other->radius2);
            double r1 = cell->radius2 * inv_mass;
            double r2 = other->radius2 * inv_mass;

            cell->position.x -= dx * r2;
            cell->position.y -= dy * r2;
            other->position.x += dx * r1;
            other->position.y += dy * r1;
            continue;
          }
        }

        if (other->type == CELL_MOTHER && cell->type == CELL_PLAYER && cell->radius < other->radius) {
          double mdx = cell->position.x - other->position.x;
          double mdy = cell->position.y - other->position.y;
          double mdist2 = mdx * mdx + mdy * mdy;
          double mthr = other->radius - cell->radius / 4.0;
          if (mthr > 0 && mdist2 <= mthr * mthr) {
            double max_r2 = MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS * MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS;
            double available_r2 = max_r2 - other->radius2;
            if (available_r2 <= 0.0) {
              /* Mother is full — extrude instead of eating */
              double edist = sqrt(mdist2);
              if (edist > 0.001) {
                double overlap = other->radius + cell->radius - edist;
                if (overlap > 0) {
                  cell->position.x += (mdx / edist) * overlap;
                  cell->position.y += (mdy / edist) * overlap;
                }
              }
              continue;
            }
            /* Only eat player if Mother has room for the entire cell.
             * Partial consumption would destroy the unabsorbed mass. */
            if (cell->radius2 > available_r2) {
              /* Not enough room — extrude like a full Mother */
              double edist = sqrt(mdist2);
              if (edist > 0.001) {
                double overlap = other->radius + cell->radius - edist;
                if (overlap > 0) {
                  cell->position.x += (mdx / edist) * overlap;
                  cell->position.y += (mdy / edist) * overlap;
                }
              }
              continue;
            }
            cell->killer_id = other->id;
            double new_r2 = other->radius2 + cell->radius2;
            cell_set_size(other, sqrt(new_r2));
            SAFE_SERVER_REMOVE_CELL(srv, cell);
            mark_cell_dirty(other, srv->ticks);
            player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
            popped = true;
            break;
          }
        }

        /* Rigid body extrusion for player vs non-eatable mother cell */
        if (other->type == CELL_MOTHER && cell->type == CELL_PLAYER &&
            cell->radius >= other->radius && cell->radius < other->radius * 1.118) {
          double dx = cell->position.x - other->position.x;
          double dy = cell->position.y - other->position.y;
          double dSqrt = dx * dx + dy * dy;
          double rSum = cell->radius + other->radius;
          if (dSqrt < rSum * rSum && dSqrt > 0.0) {
            double inv_d = 1.0 / sqrt(dSqrt);
            double push = rSum - sqrt(dSqrt);
            cell->position.x += dx * inv_d * push;
            cell->position.y += dy * inv_d * push;
            cell->is_moving = true;
            mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks);
          }
          continue;
        }

        if (!can_eat(srv, cell, other))
          continue;

        /* Virus/Mother Cell pop: handle it fully if player is larger than virus/mother cell */
        if ((other->type == CELL_VIRUS || (other->type == CELL_MOTHER && cell->radius >= other->radius)) && cell->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
          int cells_left = srv->config.player_max_cells - player->cell_count;
          if (cells_left > 0) {
            player->extra_decay_multiplier += srv->config.at_virus_pop_loss;
            player->viruses_eaten++;

            /* Delta order: absorb virus mass FIRST, then pop.
             * This ensures the pop distributes the combined mass. */
            other->killer_id = cell->id;
            player->mass_consumed += (uint32_t)other->mass;
            if (player->mass_boost > 1.0) {
              double boosted_r2 =
                  cell->radius2 + other->radius2 * player->mass_boost;
              cell_set_size(cell, sqrt(boosted_r2));
            } else {
              cell_eat(cell, other);
            }

            /* ── Delta-style distributeCellMass (virusMonotonePops=false) ──
             * Multi-stage piece distribution matching original Agar.io:
             *   Stage 1: small cells  → equal pieces (mass / (splitMinMass/2))
             *   Stage 2: medium cells → power-of-2 doubling for piece count
             *   Stage 3: large cells  → halving loop + equal tail pieces
             *
             * splitMinMass = playerMinSplitSize^2 / 100
             */
            double split_min_mass =
                (srv->config.player_min_split_size *
                 srv->config.player_min_split_size) / 100.0;
            double cell_mass = cell->mass;
            double fl_cells_left = (double)cells_left;
            int pieces_spawned = 0;

            /* ── Stage 1: equal-size pieces for smaller cells ── */
            double virus_full_pop_max =
                split_min_mass * srv->config.player_max_cells;

            if (cell_mass <= virus_full_pop_max) {
              int amount = (int)floor(cell_mass / (split_min_mass / 2.0));
              if (amount > cells_left) amount = cells_left;
              double per_piece = cell_mass / (amount + 1);

              if (per_piece >= split_min_mass / 2.0) {
                for (int k = 0; k < amount; k++) {
                  double remaining = cell->mass - per_piece;
                  if (remaining <= 0) break;
                  double angle = 2.0 * M_PI * ((double)rand() / RAND_MAX);
                  if (!server_split_cell(srv, player, cell, angle, per_piece)) {
                    break;
                  }
                  player->cells[player->cell_count - 1]->boost_friction = srv->config.split_boost_friction;
                  cell_set_size(cell, sqrt(remaining * 100.0));
                  pieces_spawned++;
                }
                goto pop_done;
              }
            }

            /* ── Stage 2: power-of-2 doubling (medium cells) ── */
            if (cell_mass / fl_cells_left < split_min_mass) {
              double amount = 2;
              double per_piece = 0;
              while ((per_piece = cell_mass / (amount + 1)) >= split_min_mass
                     && amount * 2 <= fl_cells_left)
                amount *= 2;
              per_piece = cell_mass / amount;
              int n = (int)(amount - 1);
              for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                double remaining = cell->mass - per_piece;
                if (remaining <= 0) break;
                double angle = 2.0 * M_PI * ((double)rand() / RAND_MAX);
                if (!server_split_cell(srv, player, cell, angle, per_piece)) {
                  break;
                }
                player->cells[player->cell_count - 1]->boost_friction = srv->config.split_boost_friction;
                cell_set_size(cell, sqrt(remaining * 100.0));
                pieces_spawned++;
              }
              goto pop_done;
            }

            /* ── Stage 3: halving loop for large cells ── */
            {
              double next_mass = cell_mass / 2.0;
              double mass_left = next_mass;
              double cl = fl_cells_left;

              while (cl > 0) {
                if (next_mass / cl < split_min_mass) break;
                while (next_mass >= mass_left && cl > 1)
                  next_mass /= 2.0;

                double remaining = cell->mass - next_mass;
                if (remaining <= 0) break;
                double angle = 2.0 * M_PI * ((double)rand() / RAND_MAX);
                if (!server_split_cell(srv, player, cell, angle, next_mass)) {
                  break;
                }
                player->cells[player->cell_count - 1]->boost_friction = srv->config.split_boost_friction;
                cell_set_size(cell, sqrt(remaining * 100.0));
                mass_left -= next_mass;
                cl--;
                pieces_spawned++;
              }

              /* Tail: distribute remaining mass equally */
              if (cl > 0 && mass_left > 0) {
                next_mass = mass_left / cl;
                if (next_mass > 0) {
                  int tail = (int)cl;
                  for (int k = 0; k < tail; k++) {
                    double remaining = cell->mass - next_mass;
                    if (remaining <= 0) break;
                    double angle = 2.0 * M_PI * ((double)rand() / RAND_MAX);
                    if (!server_split_cell(srv, player, cell, angle, next_mass)) {
                      break;
                    }
                    player->cells[player->cell_count - 1]->boost_friction = srv->config.split_boost_friction;
                    cell_set_size(cell, sqrt(remaining * 100.0));
                    pieces_spawned++;
                  }
                }
              }
            }
            pop_done:;
          } else {
            /* At max cells (16/16): no room to pop — just absorb virus mass.
             * In original Agar.io, eating a virus at max pieces simply adds
             * the virus mass to the eating cell with no split. */
            other->killer_id = cell->id;
            player->mass_consumed += (uint32_t)other->mass;
            player->viruses_eaten++;
            if (player->mass_boost > 1.0) {
              double boosted_r2 =
                  cell->radius2 + other->radius2 * player->mass_boost;
              cell_set_size(cell, sqrt(boosted_r2));
            } else {
              cell_eat(cell, other);
            }
            mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks);
          }

          DBGLOG("[VIRUS-POP] id=%u killer=%u is_removed=%d\n", other->id,
                 other->killer_id, other->is_removed);

          /* Virus pop is a major combat transition: do not rely on the cheap
           * dirty path for the owner on the next frame. */
          mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks);
          player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;

          /* REAL removal: delete the virus immediately */
          SAFE_SERVER_REMOVE_CELL(srv, other);

          /* IMPORTANT: stop using this old query_result[] for this cell */
          popped = true;
          break;
        }

        /* Normal eat path */
        bool combat_eat = (other->type == CELL_PLAYER || other->type == CELL_VIRUS ||
                           other->type == CELL_POTION);
        int prey_owner_id = other->owner_id;
        other->killer_id = cell->id;

        /* Session stat tracking */
        player->mass_consumed += (uint32_t)other->mass;
        if (other->type == CELL_FOOD) {
          player->food_eaten++;
          player->cells_eaten++;
        } else if (other->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
          player->players_eaten++;
        } else if (other->type == CELL_EJECTED) {
          player->cells_eaten++;
        } else if (other->type == CELL_POTION) {
          player->cells_eaten++;

          /* Award 3 random potions to the eating player */
          for (int p = 0; p < 3; p++)
            potion_award_random_to(player, srv);
        }

        if (player->mass_boost > 1.0) {
          double boosted_r2 =
              cell->radius2 + other->radius2 * player->mass_boost;
          cell_set_size(cell, sqrt(boosted_r2));
        } else {
          cell_eat(cell, other);
        }

        /* The eater's mass/size changed. Coalesced dirty marking makes this
         * cheap even if the cell eats many objects in the same tick. */
        mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks);

        SAFE_SERVER_REMOVE_CELL(srv, other);

        if (combat_eat) {
          player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
          if (prey_owner_id >= 0 && prey_owner_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
            srv->players[prey_owner_id].force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
          }
        }
      }

      if (popped)
        continue;
    }
  }

  /* Check all viruses against ejected mass (PERF: skip entirely when no cells are moving/ejecting) */
  if (srv->moving_count > 0) {
    Cell *eject_query_res[64];
    for (int vi = 0; vi < srv->virus_count; vi++) {
      PREFETCH_CELL(srv->virus_nodes, vi, srv->virus_count);
      Cell *virus = srv->virus_nodes[vi];
      if (UNLIKELY(!virus || virus->is_removed))
        continue;

      /* Safety: clamp any virus below min size back to min size.
       * This should never happen — investigate root cause if logged. */
      if (virus->radius < srv->config.virus_min_size) {
        INFO_LOG("[VIRUS_BUG] virus id=%u has radius=%.1f mass=%.1f (min=%.1f), "
                 "clamping to min_size\n",
                 virus->id, virus->radius, virus->mass,
                 srv->config.virus_min_size);
        cell_set_size(virus, srv->config.virus_min_size);
      }

      double r = virus->radius * 2.0;
      Rect area = {virus->position.x - r, virus->position.y - r,
                   virus->position.x + r, virus->position.y + r};
      int count = bot_grid_query(&srv->bot_grid, area, eject_query_res, 64);

      for (int j = 0; j < count; j++) {
        Cell *other = eject_query_res[j];

        if (!other || other->is_removed)
          continue;

        if (other->type == CELL_EJECTED) {
          if (can_eat(srv, virus, other)) {
            /* Virus eats expelled mass */
            other->killer_id = virus->id;
            cell_eat(virus, other);
            SAFE_SERVER_REMOVE_CELL(srv, other);
            mark_cell_dirty(virus, srv->ticks); /* send updated size to clients */

            /* Check if virus reached maximum size to split */
            if (virus->radius >= srv->config.virus_max_size) {
              /* Reset original virus size */
              cell_set_size(virus, srv->config.virus_min_size);

              /* Calculate angle based on the consumed W-cell's trajectory */
              double angle = atan2(other->boost_dir.y, other->boost_dir.x);

              server_shoot_virus(srv, virus, angle);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── Orphan cells: disconnected player cells as hunters ──
   * When a player disconnects, their cells get owner_id = -1 and are removed
   * from active_player_ids. Without this pass, orphan cells never eat anything
   * even though they're big enough. They should behave identically to alive
   * player cells for eating purposes. */
  for (int di = 0; di < srv->dynamic_count; di++) {
    PREFETCH_CELL(srv->dynamic_nodes, di, srv->dynamic_count);
    Cell *cell = srv->dynamic_nodes[di];
    if (cell->is_removed || cell->type != CELL_PLAYER || cell->owner_id >= 0)
      continue; /* skip non-orphans */

    Cell **query_result = tl_query_result;
    double r = cell->radius * 2;
    Rect area = {cell->position.x - r, cell->position.y - r,
                 cell->position.x + r, cell->position.y + r};
    int count = bot_grid_query(&srv->bot_grid, area, query_result, QT_QUERY_MAX);
    count =
        fg_query_from(&srv->food_grid, area, query_result, count, QT_QUERY_MAX);

    for (int j = 0; j < count; j++) {
      PREFETCH_CELL(query_result, j, count);
      Cell *other = query_result[j];
      if (UNLIKELY(other == cell || other->is_removed))
        continue;

      /* Orphan cells cannot merge with each other — skip same-orphan rigid body
       */
      if (other->type == CELL_PLAYER && other->owner_id < 0)
        continue;

      if (!can_eat(srv, cell, other))
        continue;

      /* Virus pop: orphan cells don't have a player to split — just eat the
       * virus */
      if (other->type == CELL_VIRUS)
        continue; /* orphans can't pop viruses (no player slot for new cells) */

      /* Normal eat: orphan absorbs prey */
      other->killer_id = cell->id;
      cell_eat(cell, other);
      SAFE_SERVER_REMOVE_CELL(srv, other);
    }
  }
}

/* ── Mass decay (Delta extra decay multiplier) ───────────────── */

static void server_decay_cells(GameServer *srv) {
  double base_decay = srv->config.player_decay_rate; /* 0.002 */
  double min_size = srv->config.player_min_size;
  double interval_scale = srv->config.decay_interval / 25.0;

#if defined(_OPENMP)
  #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 32)
#endif
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
    Player *player = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
    if (player->cell_count == 0)
      continue;

    /* FAST PATH: skip decay for disconnected inactive slots */
    if (!player->frozen && player->conn_id < 0 && !player->is_lm_client && !player->is_bot)
      continue;

    /* 1. Danger zone: bump multiplier directly */
    if (player->anti_danger_accum > 0) {
      player->extra_decay_multiplier += player->anti_danger_accum * srv->config.at_danger_loss;
      player->anti_danger_accum = 0;
    }

    /* 2. Compensation: multiplier naturally recovers each decay cycle */
    if (player->extra_decay_multiplier > 0) {
      player->extra_decay_multiplier -= srv->config.at_compensation;
      if (player->extra_decay_multiplier < 0)
        player->extra_decay_multiplier = 0;
    }

    /* 3. Compute effective decay: base × pow(AT_BASE, multiplier)
     * multiplier=0 → 1× (normal), multiplier=5 → 1.51×, multiplier=10 → 2.28× */
    double at_mult = pow(srv->config.at_extra_decay_base, player->extra_decay_multiplier);
    double current_decay = base_decay * interval_scale * at_mult;
    /* PERF: pre-compute radius factor once per player instead of sqrt() per cell.
     * Math: sqrt(mass*(1-d)*100) = sqrt(mass*100) * sqrt(1-d) = radius * factor.
     * Saves one sqrt() (~15-20 cycles) per cell. */
    double decay_factor = sqrt(1.0 - current_decay);

    for (int i = 0; i < player->cell_count; i++) {
      Cell *cell = player->cells[i];
      if (cell->is_removed || cell->radius <= min_size)
        continue;

      double new_size = cell->radius * decay_factor;
      if (new_size < min_size)
        new_size = min_size;
      cell_set_size(cell, new_size);
      mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks);
    }
  }

  /* Also decay orphaned (disconnected) players' cells.
   * These cells lack an owner_id (-1) but remain on the map as CELL_PLAYER.
   * Without this, disconnected cells are immortal blobs that never shrink.
   * Same dynamic decay rate (no anti-team — they can't be teaming). */
  double frozen_decay = base_decay * (srv->config.decay_interval / 25.0);
  double frozen_factor = sqrt(1.0 - frozen_decay);
  for (int i = 0; i < srv->dynamic_count; i++) {
    PREFETCH_CELL(srv->dynamic_nodes, i, srv->dynamic_count);
    Cell *cell = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
    if (cell->type == CELL_PLAYER && cell->owner_id == -1 &&
        !cell->is_removed && cell->radius > min_size) {
      double new_size = cell->radius * frozen_factor;
      if (new_size < min_size)
        new_size = min_size;
      cell_set_size(cell, new_size);
      mark_cell_dirty(cell, srv->ticks); /* size change = dirty */
    }
  }
}

/* ── Leaderboard ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void server_update_leaderboard(GameServer *srv) {
  srv->leaderboard_count = 0;
  srv->largest_player = NULL;
  double max_score = 0;

  int max_lb = srv->config.server_max_lb;
  if (max_lb > 20) max_lb = 20; /* clamp to leaderboard array size */
  int lb_count = 0; /* current leaderboard fill */

  /* PERF: partial selection O(n*k) instead of full sort O(n²).
   * Build sorted top-N directly during the collection pass.
   * For 200 candidates and k=20, this is ~10x fewer comparisons. */
  /* Phase 1: Parallel score calculation & cell compaction across 3 cores */
#if defined(_OPENMP)
  #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)
#endif
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
    if (p->is_removed || p->cell_count == 0 || (p->conn_id < 0 && !p->is_bot) || p->frozen)
      continue;

    p->score = 0;
    int alive_cells = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < p->cell_count; j++) {
      if (!p->cells[j]->is_removed) {
        p->score += p->cells[j]->mass;
        if (alive_cells != j)
          p->cells[alive_cells] = p->cells[j];
        alive_cells++;
      }
    }
    p->cell_count = alive_cells;

    if (alive_cells > 0 && !p->is_local) {
      uint32_t mass_u = (uint32_t)p->score;
      if (mass_u > p->highest_mass)
        p->highest_mass = mass_u;

      if ((srv->ticks % 25) == 0 && mass_u > 0 && p->session_xp < 25000) {
        uint32_t xp_gain = mass_u;
        if (p->session_xp + xp_gain > 25000)
          xp_gain = 25000 - p->session_xp;
        p->session_xp += xp_gain;
      }
    }
  }

  /* Phase 2: Sequential top-20 insertion */
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
    if (p->is_removed || p->cell_count == 0 || (p->conn_id < 0 && !p->is_bot) || p->frozen)
      continue;

    if (p->score > max_score) {
      max_score = p->score;
      srv->largest_player = p;
    }

    if (lb_count < max_lb || p->score > srv->leaderboard[lb_count - 1]->score) {
      int pos = lb_count < max_lb ? lb_count : lb_count - 1;
      for (int i = 0; i < lb_count && i < max_lb; i++) {
        if (p->score > srv->leaderboard[i]->score) {
          pos = i;
          break;
        }
      }
      int end = lb_count < max_lb ? lb_count : max_lb - 1;
      for (int i = end; i > pos; i--) {
        srv->leaderboard[i] = srv->leaderboard[i - 1];
      }
      srv->leaderboard[pos] = p;
      if (lb_count < max_lb)
        lb_count++;
    }
  }

  /* Update leaderboard positions */
  for (int i = 0; i < lb_count; i++) {
    srv->leaderboard[i]->place = i + 1;
    /* Session stat: track best position and time on leaderboard */
    if (srv->leaderboard[i]->top_position == 0 ||
        (i + 1) < srv->leaderboard[i]->top_position)
      srv->leaderboard[i]->top_position = i + 1;
    srv->leaderboard[i]->time_on_lb++;
  }
  srv->leaderboard_count = lb_count;

  /* PERF: dirty-flag — skip re-serialization if top-N didn't change */
  bool changed = (lb_count != srv->prev_lb_count);
  if (!changed) {
    for (int i = 0; i < lb_count; i++) {
      if (srv->leaderboard[i]->id != srv->prev_lb_ids[i] ||
          srv->leaderboard[i]->score != srv->prev_lb_scores[i]) {
        changed = true;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  srv->lb_dirty = changed;
  if (changed) {
    for (int i = 0; i < lb_count && i < 20; i++) {
      srv->prev_lb_ids[i] = srv->leaderboard[i]->id;
      srv->prev_lb_scores[i] = srv->leaderboard[i]->score;
    }
    srv->prev_lb_count = lb_count;
  }

  /* Update status for /status HTTP endpoint every 1 second (25 ticks) */
  if ((srv->ticks % 25) == 0) {
    int alive = server_alive_count(srv);
    int total_connected = srv->connected_count;
    int playing_humans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < srv->connected_count; i++) {
      Player *cp = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[i]];
      if (cp->cell_count > 0 && !cp->spectate && !cp->is_removed) {
        playing_humans++;
      }
    }
    int human_spectators = total_connected - playing_humans;
    if (human_spectators < 0) human_spectators = 0;

    double sz = srv->map_scaler.current_size;
    int map_scale_x100 = (int)(sz * sz / (14142.0 * 14142.0) * 100.0 + 0.5);
    net_update_status(alive, total_connected,
                      human_spectators,
                      srv->food_count, srv->virus_count,
                      srv->ticks / 25, map_scale_x100);
  }
}

/* ── Invalidate player cells in viewers' caches ──────────────── */

void server_invalidate_player_cells(
    GameServer *server,
    int player_id) {
  if (!server ||
      player_id < 0 ||
      player_id >= MAX_PLAYERS) {
    return;
  }

  Player *target =
      &server->players[player_id];

  /*
   * NON-DESTRUCTIVE REFRESH (v1.2.46 — ghost cell fix).
   *
   * Never remove a live cell from client_nodes/view_state merely to resend
   * name or skin.  The old destructive approach created a race condition:
   *
   *   1. view_state[idx] cleared to 0 for all viewers
   *   2. Cell dies later in the SAME tick → added to removed_this_tick
   *   3. Dirty path checks vs_get(view_state, idx) == 0 → SKIP
   *   4. DELETE never sent → permanent ghost cell on every client
   *
   * With 700+ bots disconnecting, this was the primary ghost cell source.
   *
   * The fix: only set needs_name_refresh on the cell, which causes the
   * UPDATE packet to include name/skin.  Tracking state is never touched,
   * so the normal removal path works correctly if the cell dies.
   */
  for (int index = 0;
       index < target->cell_count;
       index++) {
    Cell *cell =
        target->cells[index];

    if (!cell ||
        cell->is_removed ||
        cell->type != CELL_PLAYER) {
      continue;
    }

    cell->needs_name_refresh =
        true;

    mark_cell_dirty(
        cell,
        server->ticks);
  }
}


/* ── Potion drop cells ───────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Award a single random potion to the player (rolls rarity, checks slots) */
static void potion_award_random_to(Player *player, GameServer *srv) {
  /* Find a free potion slot */
  int slot = -1;
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POTIONS; i++) {
    if (player->potions[i].rarity == POTION_NONE) {
      slot = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (slot < 0)
    return; /* no free slot */

  /* Roll random rarity: 60% common, 30% uncommon, 10% exotic */
  int roll = rand() % 100;
  PotionRarity rarity;
  if (roll < 60)
    rarity = POTION_COMMON;
  else if (roll < 90)
    rarity = POTION_UNCOMMON;
  else
    rarity = POTION_EXOTIC;

  player->potions[slot].rarity = rarity;
  player->potions[slot].brew_start_tick = 0;
  player->potions[slot].brew_duration = potion_brew_duration(rarity);
  player->potions[slot].ready = false;
  if (player->potion_count < MAX_POTIONS)
    player->potion_count++;

  PlayerRecord *rec = NULL;
  if (player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
    rec = player->cached_rec ? player->cached_rec
                             : playerdb_lookup(&srv->player_db, player->uid);
    player->cached_rec = rec;
  }
  if (rec) {
    economy_store_potion_slots(player, rec, srv->ticks, (uint64_t)time(NULL));
    playerdb_mark_dirty(&srv->player_db, rec);
  }

  if (player->conn_id >= 0) {
    BinaryWriter w;
    bw_init(&w);
    pkt_102_brew_potion_response(&w, player, srv->ticks, 1);
    net_send_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
    bw_free(&w);
  }

  INFO_LOG("[POTION_CELL] Awarded %s potion to player %d (slot %d)\n",
           potion_rarity_name(rarity), player->id, slot);
}

/* Spawn a wave of potion drop cells at random positions */
static void server_spawn_potion_cells(GameServer *srv) {
  int count = srv->config.potion_cell_count;
  int spawned = 0;

  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    Cell *c = server_alloc_cell(srv);
    if (!c)
      break;

    double size = sqrt(100.0 * 100.0); /* mass 100, size = 100 */

    Vec2 pos = {0, 0};
    bool inside_player = true;
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 15; attempt++) {
      Vec2 candidate = server_random_pos_padded(srv, 100.0);
      double check_r = size + 150.0;
      Rect area = {candidate.x - check_r, candidate.y - check_r,
                   candidate.x + check_r, candidate.y + check_r};
      static Cell *pot_nearby[64];
      int pot_n = bot_grid_query(&srv->bot_grid, area, pot_nearby, 64);
      inside_player = false;
      for (int pi = 0; pi < pot_n && !inside_player; pi++) {
        Cell *other = pot_nearby[pi];
        if (other->is_removed || other->type != CELL_PLAYER) continue;
        double dx = other->position.x - candidate.x;
        double dy = other->position.y - candidate.y;
        double thr = other->radius + size;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy < thr * thr)
          inside_player = true;
      }
      if (!inside_player) {
        pos = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (inside_player) {
      server_release_untracked_cell(srv, c);
      continue;
    }

    cell_init(c, c->id, CELL_POTION, pos, size);

    /* Golden/purple potion color */
    c->color.r = 255;
    c->color.g = 215;
    c->color.b = 0;
    c->owner_id = -1;
    c->created_tick = srv->ticks;

    if (!server_add_cell(
            srv,
            c)) {
      server_release_untracked_cell(
          srv,
          c);
    }
    spawned++;
  }

  if (spawned > 0) {
    /* Announce via opcode 99 chat to all players */
