    char msg[128];
    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg),
             "\xe2\x9a\x97\xef\xb8\x8f %d Potion Cell%s appeared on the map!",
             spawned, spawned > 1 ? "s" : "");
    server_send_chat(srv, NULL, NULL, msg);
    INFO_LOG("[POTION_CELL] Spawned %d potion cells at tick %u\n", spawned,
             srv->ticks);
  }

  /* Schedule next wave */
  srv->potion_cell_next_tick =
      srv->ticks + (uint32_t)srv->config.potion_cell_spawn_interval;
}

/* Despawn expired potion cells (older than lifetime).
 * Iterate BACKWARDS because server_remove_cell does swap-remove from
 * dynamic_nodes — forward iteration would skip the swapped-in element. */
static void server_despawn_potion_cells(GameServer *srv) {
  uint32_t max_age = (uint32_t)srv->config.potion_cell_lifetime;

  for (int i = srv->dynamic_count - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    Cell *c = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
    if (c->type == CELL_POTION && !c->is_removed) {
      uint32_t age = srv->ticks - c->created_tick;
      if (age >= max_age) {
        server_remove_cell(srv, c);
        INFO_LOG("[POTION_CELL] Despawned potion cell %u (expired)\n", c->id);
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ── Chat ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void server_send_chat(GameServer *srv, Player *sender, Player *target,
                      const char *message) {
  (void)srv;
  BinaryWriter w;
  bw_init(&w);

  const char *name = "SERVER";
  Color color = {0x9B, 0x9B, 0x9B};
  uint8_t flags = 0x80; /* server message */

  if (sender) {
    if (sender->name[0]) {
      name = sender->name;
    } else if (sender->display_name[0]) {
      name = sender->display_name;
    } else if (sender->cached_rec && sender->cached_rec->display_name[0]) {
      name = sender->cached_rec->display_name;
    } else {
      name = "An unnamed cell";
    }
    if (sender->cell_count > 0) {
      color = sender->cells[0]->color;
    }
    flags = 0;
  }

  pkt_chat_message(&w, name, color, flags, message);

  if (target) {
    /* Send to specific player */
    if (target->conn_id >= 0) {
      net_send_to_player(target->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
    }
  } else {
    /* Fast pre-framed broadcast to all connected players */
    net_broadcast_to_all(bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
  }

  bw_free(&w);
}

/* ── Team Chat (broadcast to same clan_tag only) ─────────────── */

void server_send_team_chat(GameServer *srv, Player *sender,
                           const char *message) {
  if (!sender || !sender->clan_tag[0] || !message || !message[0])
    return;

  BinaryWriter w;
  bw_init(&w);

  const char *name = sender->name[0] ? sender->name : "An unnamed cell";
  Color color = {0x9B, 0x9B, 0x9B};
  if (sender->cell_count > 0)
    color = sender->cells[0]->color;

  pkt_chat_message(&w, name, color, 0, message);

  /* Broadcast to all connected players with matching clan_tag (except sender)
   */
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->connected_count; ap++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[ap]];
    if (p->conn_id < 0 || p->id == sender->id)
      continue;
    if (p->clan_tag[0] && strcmp(p->clan_tag, sender->clan_tag) == 0) {
      net_send_to_player(p->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
    }
  }

  bw_free(&w);
}

void server_broadcast_admin_notice(GameServer *srv, uint8_t toast_type,
                                   const char *message) {
  if (!srv || !message || !message[0])
    return;

  BinaryWriter w;
  bw_init(&w);
  pkt_admin_notice(&w, toast_type, message);
  net_broadcast_to_all(bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
  bw_free(&w);
}

/* ── QuadTree rebuild ────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void server_rebuild_quadtree(
    GameServer *server) {
  /* ── QuadTree rebuild SKIPPED ──
   * All qt_query() calls have been replaced with bot_grid_query().
   * The bot_grid is rebuilt separately in the tick pipeline.
   * Skipping qt_clear+qt_insert saves ~1.7ms/tick (4.9% of collision).
   *
   * The incremental qt_insert in server_add_cell_to_index() is also
   * guarded by quad_tree_build_tick, which we no longer update,
   * so it becomes a no-op too.
   *
   * To re-enable: uncomment the block below and set build_tick. */
#if 0
  if (!qt_clear(
          &server->quad_tree)) {
    async_log(
        "[FATAL] Quadtree clear failed\n");

    abort();
  }

  for (int index = 0;
       index < server->dynamic_count;
       index++) {
    PREFETCH_CELL(server->dynamic_nodes, index, server->dynamic_count);
    Cell *cell =
        server->dynamic_nodes[index];

    if (UNLIKELY(!cell ||
        cell->is_removed)) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!qt_insert(
            &server->quad_tree,
            cell)) {
      async_log(
          "[FATAL] Quadtree rejected cell %u "
          "(dynamic=%d pool=%d/%d overflow=%d/%d)\n",
          cell->id,
          server->dynamic_count,
          server->quad_tree.pool_used,
          server->quad_tree.pool_size,
          server->quad_tree.overflow_count,
          server->quad_tree.overflow_capacity);

      abort();
    }
  }
  server->quad_tree_build_tick =
      server->ticks;
#endif

  if (server->food_tree_dirty) {
    /*
     * Preserve the permanent maximum-tier coordinate mapping.
     * Only bucket contents are rebuilt.
     */
    fg_clear(
        &server->food_grid);

    for (int index = 0;
         index < server->food_count;
         index++) {
      Cell *food =
          server->food_nodes[index];

      if (!food ||
          food->is_removed) {
        continue;
      }

      if (!fg_insert(
              &server->food_grid,
              food)) {
        async_log(
            "[FATAL] FoodGrid rebuild rejected food %u\n",
            food->id);

        abort();
      }
    }

    server->food_tree_dirty =
        false;
  }
}


/* ── Player view diff & update sending ───────────────────────── */

/* Auxiliary packet throttle thresholds */
/* AUX_LOAD_*, DIRTY_*, FULL_MAP_* all defined in config.h */

static inline int server_aux_lb_interval(const GameServer *srv,
                                         const Player *p) {
  int alive = srv->active_player_count;
  bool is_spectator = (p->cell_count == 0);
  if (alive >= AUX_LOAD_EXTREME) {
    return is_spectator ? 100 : 75;
  }
  if (alive >= AUX_LOAD_HIGH) {
    return is_spectator ? 75 : 50;
  }
  if (alive >= AUX_LOAD_MEDIUM) {
    return is_spectator ? 50 : 40;
  }
  return 25;
}

static inline int server_aux_ghost_interval(const GameServer *srv) {
  int alive = srv->active_player_count;
  if (alive >= AUX_LOAD_EXTREME)
    return 100;
  if (alive >= AUX_LOAD_HIGH)
    return 75;
  if (alive >= AUX_LOAD_MEDIUM)
    return 50;
  return 25;
}

static inline int server_aux_ping_interval(const GameServer *srv) {
  int alive = srv->active_player_count;
  if (alive >= AUX_LOAD_EXTREME)
    return 150;
  if (alive >= AUX_LOAD_HIGH)
    return 100;
  return 50;
}

static inline int server_dirty_packet_budget(const GameServer *srv) {
  int alive = srv->active_player_count;
  if (alive >= 600)
    return DIRTY_PACKET_BUDGET_LOW;
  if (alive >= 300)
    return DIRTY_PACKET_BUDGET_MED;
  return DIRTY_PACKET_BUDGET_HIGH;
}

static inline int server_estimate_update_cost(const Cell *c) {
  switch (c->type) {
  case CELL_PLAYER:
    return 48;
  case CELL_VIRUS:
    return 24;
  case CELL_EJECTED:
    return 24;
  case CELL_POTION:
    return 24;
  case CELL_FOOD:
    return 0; /* food should not be in update-only path */
  default:
    return 24;
  }
}

/* Fast in-place linear-time partial selection for truncated viewport queries.
 * Selects the top-priority k elements into arr[0...k-1] in O(N) expected time
 * without function-pointer callback overhead. */
#define SPEC_QUERY_CAP SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES
static inline void quickselect_cells_by_dist(Cell **arr, int n, int k, int owner_id, Vec2 center) {
  if (!arr || n <= k || k <= 0)
    return;

  static THREAD_LOCAL double scores[SPEC_QUERY_CAP];
  int count = (n < SPEC_QUERY_CAP) ? n : SPEC_QUERY_CAP;

  /* Step 1: Pre-compute single SIMD-friendly scalar score per cell in O(N) linear pass.
   * Eliminates all pointer dereferences, type comparisons, and math inside partition loops. */
  for (int idx = 0; idx < count; idx++) {
    Cell *c = arr[idx];
    if (!c) {
      scores[idx] = -1.0e30;
      continue;
    }
    double dx = c->position.x - center.x;
    double dy = c->position.y - center.y;
    double dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;

    if (owner_id > 0 && c->owner_id == owner_id) {
      scores[idx] = 2.0e18 - dist2;
    } else if (c->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
      scores[idx] = 1.0e18 - dist2;
    } else {
      scores[idx] = 0.0 - dist2;
    }
  }

  /* Step 2: Ultra-fast QuickSelect partitioning operating on contiguous scores array.
   * Compiles down to single vcomisd SIMD assembly instructions with 100% L1 cache hits. */
  int left = 0, right = count - 1;
  int target_idx = k - 1;
  int max_iters = count * 2; /* P2-1: prevent infinite loop on equal scores */

  while (left < right && max_iters-- > 0) {
    int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
    double pivot_score = scores[mid];

    int i = left, j = right;
    while (i <= j) {
      while (i <= right && scores[i] > pivot_score) i++;
      while (j >= left && scores[j] < pivot_score) j--;

      if (i <= j) {
        double tmp_s = scores[i]; scores[i] = scores[j]; scores[j] = tmp_s;
        Cell *tmp_c = arr[i]; arr[i] = arr[j]; arr[j] = tmp_c;
        i++; j--;
      }
    }

    if (target_idx <= j) right = j;
    else if (target_idx >= i) left = i;
    else break;
  }
}

static void server_fill_add_node_info(
    GameServer *server,
    Cell *cell,
    AddNodeInfo *info) {
  if (!server ||
      !cell ||
      !info) {
    return;
  }

  info->cell =
      cell;

  info->name = NULL;
  info->skin = NULL;

  if (cell->type == CELL_PLAYER &&
      cell->owner_id >= 0 &&
      cell->owner_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
    Player *owner =
        &server->players[
            cell->owner_id];

    info->name =
        owner->name;

    info->skin =
        owner->skin;
  } else if (cell->type == CELL_POTION) {
    info->name =
        POTION_CELL_NAME;
  }
}


static bool server_queue_spectator_update(
    GameServer *server,
    Player *viewer,
    BinaryWriter *writer,
    uint8_t *compressed_buffer,
    size_t compressed_capacity) {
  if (!server ||
      !viewer ||
      !writer ||
      !compressed_buffer ||
      compressed_capacity == 0) {
    return false;
  }

  size_t raw_length =
      bw_length(writer);

  if (raw_length >
      (size_t)server->config.lz4_min_size) {
    size_t compressed_length =
        pkt_lz4_compress(
            compressed_buffer,
            compressed_capacity,
            bw_data(writer),
            raw_length);

    if (compressed_length > 0) {
      return net_try_queue_to_player(
          viewer->conn_id,
          compressed_buffer,
          compressed_length);
    }
  }

  return net_try_queue_to_player(
      viewer->conn_id,
      bw_data(writer),
      raw_length);
}


/*
 * Checked queue helper for active-player UpdateNodes frames.
 *
 * Mirrors server_queue_spectator_update() but preserves the active
 * path's existing performance policies:
 *   - localhost bots always send raw (no LZ4 overhead)
 *   - dynamic compression threshold under load
 *   - LZ4 failure falls back to raw
 *   - every final queue attempt returns bool
 *
 * Only a true result permits a tracking commit.
 */
static bool server_queue_active_update(
    GameServer *server,
    Player *player,
    BinaryWriter *writer,
    uint8_t *compressed_buffer,
    size_t compressed_capacity) {
  if (!server ||
      !player ||
      !writer ||
      !compressed_buffer ||
      compressed_capacity == 0) {
    return false;
  }

  size_t raw_len = bw_length(writer);
  if (raw_len == 0) {
    return false;
  }

  /* Localhost bots: no network bandwidth to save, skip LZ4 */
  if (player->is_local) {
    return net_try_queue_to_player(
        player->conn_id,
        bw_data(writer),
        raw_len);
  }

  /* Dynamic compression threshold under load */
  size_t threshold =
      (size_t)server->config.lz4_min_size;

  if (server->active_player_count > 250)
    threshold = 4096;
  else if (server->active_player_count > 100)
    threshold = 1024;

  if (raw_len > threshold) {
    size_t clen = pkt_lz4_compress(
        compressed_buffer,
        compressed_capacity,
        bw_data(writer),
        raw_len);

    if (clen > 0) {
      return net_try_queue_to_player(
          player->conn_id,
          compressed_buffer,
          clen);
    }
  }

  /* Raw fallback */
  return net_try_queue_to_player(
      player->conn_id,
      bw_data(writer),
      raw_len);
}

/*
 * Build the shared World Spectate interest set once per server tick.
 *
 * Rendering the entire food population is the principal source of browser
 * frame-time spikes and network backlog. World view prioritizes player cells
 * and keeps only a bounded amount of environmental context.
 *
 * Ordering is stable and meaningful:
 *   1. player cells, up to the hard world-view ceiling;
 *   2. viruses, mother cells and potions;
 *   3. moving ejected mass;
 *   4. remaining dynamic context;
 *   5. bounded food context.
 */
static int server_build_world_interest_set(
    GameServer *server,
    Cell **output,
    int output_capacity) {
  if (!server ||
      !output ||
      output_capacity <= 0) {
    return 0;
  }

  if (output_capacity >
      WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES) {
    output_capacity =
        WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES;
  }

  /*
   * One authoritative dynamic-node scan. The previous implementation scanned
   * dynamic_nodes[] four times for every world viewer. These small category
   * buffers preserve priority without repeating the map-wide scan.
   */
  static Cell
      *hazard_context[WORLD_SPECTATE_CONTEXT_BUDGET];
  static Cell
      *moving_ejected_context[WORLD_SPECTATE_CONTEXT_BUDGET];
  static Cell
      *other_context[WORLD_SPECTATE_CONTEXT_BUDGET];

  int hazard_count = 0;
  int moving_ejected_count = 0;
  int other_count = 0;
  int count = 0;

  for (int index = 0;
       index < server->dynamic_count;
       index++) {
    Cell *cell =
        server->dynamic_nodes[index];

    if (!cell ||
        cell->is_removed) {
      continue;
    }

    if (cell->type == CELL_PLAYER) {
      if (count >= output_capacity)
        break;

      output[count++] =
          cell;

      continue;
    }

    if (cell->type == CELL_VIRUS ||
        cell->type == CELL_MOTHER ||
        cell->type == CELL_POTION) {
      if (hazard_count <
          WORLD_SPECTATE_CONTEXT_BUDGET) {
        hazard_context[hazard_count++] =
            cell;
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (cell->type == CELL_EJECTED &&
        cell->is_moving) {
      if (moving_ejected_count <
          WORLD_SPECTATE_CONTEXT_BUDGET) {
        moving_ejected_context[
            moving_ejected_count++] =
                cell;
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (other_count <
        WORLD_SPECTATE_CONTEXT_BUDGET) {
      other_context[other_count++] =
          cell;
    }
  }

  int context_limit =
      count +
      WORLD_SPECTATE_CONTEXT_BUDGET;

  if (context_limit >
      output_capacity) {
    context_limit =
        output_capacity;
  }

  int food_reserve =
      WORLD_SPECTATE_FOOD_BUDGET;

  int context_capacity =
      context_limit - count;

  if (food_reserve >
      context_capacity) {
    food_reserve =
        context_capacity;
  }

  int non_food_limit =
      context_limit -
      food_reserve;

  for (int index = 0;
       index < hazard_count &&
       count < non_food_limit;
       index++) {
    output[count++] =
        hazard_context[index];
  }

  for (int index = 0;
       index < moving_ejected_count &&
       count < non_food_limit;
       index++) {
    output[count++] =
        moving_ejected_context[index];
  }

  for (int index = 0;
       index < other_count &&
       count < non_food_limit;
       index++) {
    output[count++] =
        other_context[index];
  }

  /* Food is context, not the world-view payload. */
  if (count < context_limit) {
    Rect world_box = {
        server->border.minx,
        server->border.miny,
        server->border.maxx,
        server->border.maxy,
    };

    count =
        fg_query_from(
            &server->food_grid,
            world_box,
            output,
            count,
            context_limit);
  }

  /* Contraction can temporarily leave cells outside the authoritative border. */
  int write = 0;

  for (int index = 0;
       index < count;
       index++) {
    Cell *cell =
        output[index];

    if (!cell ||
        cell->is_removed) {
      continue;
    }

    Vec2 position =
        cell->position;

    if (position.x < server->border.minx ||
        position.x > server->border.maxx ||
        position.y < server->border.miny ||
        position.y > server->border.maxy) {
      continue;
    }

    output[write++] =
        cell;
  }

  return write;
}

/*
 * Queue one transactional World Spectate UpdateNodes packet.
 *
 * Wire compatibility:
 *   raw packet:
 *     0x10 + ordinary UpdateNodes body
 *
 *   compressed packet:
 *     0xFF
 *     uint32 little-endian uncompressed length
 *     one independent LZ4 block
 *
 * This function does NOT use an LZ4 stream or dictionary. The current client
 * decodes each 0xFF packet independently.
 */
static bool server_queue_world_update(
    GameServer *server,
    Player *viewer,
    BinaryWriter *writer) {
  if (!server ||
      !viewer ||
      !writer ||
      viewer->conn_id < 0) {
    return false;
  }

  size_t raw_length =
      bw_length(writer);

  if (raw_length == 0)
    return false;

  size_t threshold =
      (size_t)server->config.lz4_min_size;

  /*
   * World Spectate benefits strongly from compression because UpdateNodes
   * contains many structurally similar records.
   */
  if (raw_length > threshold) {
    size_t required_capacity =
        pkt_lz4_bound(raw_length);

    if (required_capacity >
        server->world_lz4_capacity) {
      uint8_t *grown_buffer =
          (uint8_t *)realloc(
              server->world_lz4_buffer,
              required_capacity);

      if (grown_buffer) {
        server->world_lz4_buffer =
            grown_buffer;

        server->world_lz4_capacity =
            required_capacity;
      }
    }

    if (server->world_lz4_buffer &&
        server->world_lz4_capacity >=
            required_capacity) {
      size_t compressed_length =
          pkt_lz4_compress(
              server->world_lz4_buffer,
              server->world_lz4_capacity,
              bw_data(writer),
              raw_length);

      /*
       * Compression is optional. Queue the compressed packet only when it is
       * valid and actually smaller than the raw packet.
       */
      if (compressed_length > 5 &&
          compressed_length < raw_length) {
        return net_try_queue_to_player(
            viewer->conn_id,
            server->world_lz4_buffer,
            compressed_length);
      }
    }
  }

  /*
   * Allocation failure, compression failure, or an incompressible packet must
   * fall back to the ordinary raw UpdateNodes packet.
   */
  return net_try_queue_to_player(
      viewer->conn_id,
      bw_data(writer),
      raw_length);
}


#ifdef __GNUC__
__attribute__((hot))
#endif
static void server_send_player_updates(GameServer *srv) {
  if (srv->connected_count == 0) {
    /* No clients — reset the dirty list so the counter doesn't grow
     * indefinitely.  Without this, g_dirty_count accumulates every tick
     * from 10K+ bot movements and eventually causes OOB reads when the
     * first viewer connects. */
    uint32_t count = g_dirty_count;
    if (count > MAX_DIRTY_CELLS) count = MAX_DIRTY_CELLS;
    for (uint32_t d = 0; d < count; d++) {
      if (g_dirty_cells[d])
        g_dirty_cells[d]->needs_name_refresh = false;
    }
    g_dirty_count = 0;
    return;
  }

  BinaryWriter w;
  bw_init(&w);

  if (server_prune_shared_tracking(srv) < 0) {
    async_log(
        "[FATAL] Shared spectator generation tracking overflow\n");

    abort();
  }

  /* Sub-phase profiling accumulators (accumulated across all players) */
#ifdef _WIN32
  LARGE_INTEGER sp_t0, sp_t1;
  LARGE_INTEGER sp_outer_t0, sp_outer_t1;
  double sp_dirty_us = 0, sp_diff_us = 0;
  double sp_build_full_us = 0;
  double sp_build_updates_only_us = 0;
  double sp_lz4_us = 0;
  double sp_queue_us = 0;

  uint64_t sp_raw_bytes = 0;
  uint64_t sp_comp_bytes = 0;

  uint64_t sp_full_packets = 0;
  uint64_t sp_updates_only_packets = 0;
  uint64_t sp_lz4_packets = 0;
  uint64_t sp_raw_packets = 0;

  int sp_skip = 0, sp_dirty = 0, sp_diff = 0;

  /* Removed unused profiling vars: sp_spec_us, sp_dead_us, sp_alive_us */
  LARGE_INTEGER loop_t0;
#endif

  /* Reusable scratch arrays — THREAD_LOCAL for lock-free parallel execution across all CPU cores */
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *visible[FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES];

  static Cell
      *world_visible[WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES];

  /*
   * Shared current-world membership map. It is rebuilt only once when the
   * first World Spectator is processed during this server update pass.
   */
  static uint8_t
      world_view_state[VIEW_STATE_BYTES];

  /*
   * Per-connection transactional replacement snapshot. It contains all
   * previously known cells that still belong to the current world snapshot,
   * plus the bounded batch of newly accepted ADD cells.
   */
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell
      *world_commit_nodes[WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES];

  int world_visible_count = 0;
  bool world_visible_computed = false;
  static THREAD_LOCAL AddNodeInfo add_list[FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES];
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *upd_list[FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES];
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *eat_list[FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES];
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *del_list[FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES];

  /*
   * Packet-independent ADD scratch for exact grouped/centered spectator diffs.
   * Sized per-thread for safe concurrent execution.
   */
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *exact_add_cells[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];

  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *prio_hi[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *prio_lo[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];

  /* Cached diff results for grouped spectators (intra-tick only) */
  static THREAD_LOCAL AddNodeInfo spec_add[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *spec_upd[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *spec_eat[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *spec_del[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];
  int spec_add_count = 0, spec_upd_count = 0;
  int spec_eat_count = 0, spec_del_count = 0;

  /*
   * These shared diff arrays still maintain the global query snapshot. Client
   * packets below use exact per-connection diffs instead.
   */
  (void)spec_upd;
  (void)spec_eat;
  (void)spec_del;
  (void)spec_upd_count;
  (void)spec_eat_count;
  (void)spec_del_count;

  bool spec_computed = false;
  bool spec_target_changed = false;
  Vec2 spec_center = {0, 0};
  double spec_scale = srv->config.server_spectator_scale;

  /* ── Pre-computed shared data (built once, reused for all players) ── */

  /* Ghost cells from leaderboard: absolute coords, no scramble.
   * Identical for all players with the same mass filter.
   * Spectators (mass=0) all get the full unfiltered set. */
  static GhostCell lb_all_ghosts[20];
  int lb_all_count = 0;
  if (srv->leaderboard_count > 0) {
    for (int li = 0; li < srv->leaderboard_count && lb_all_count < 20; li++) {
      Player *lp = srv->leaderboard[li];
      if (lp->cell_count > 0) {
        player_update_view_center(lp, srv->ticks);
        lb_all_ghosts[lb_all_count].x = (int32_t)lp->center.x;
        lb_all_ghosts[lb_all_count].y = (int32_t)lp->center.y;
        lb_all_ghosts[lb_all_count].mass = (uint32_t)lp->score;
      } else {
        lb_all_ghosts[lb_all_count].x = (int32_t)lp->mouse_target.x;
        lb_all_ghosts[lb_all_count].y = (int32_t)lp->mouse_target.y;
        lb_all_ghosts[lb_all_count].mass = 0;
      }
      lb_all_count++;
    }
  }

  /* Pre-serialized spectator ghost cells packet (all entries, no filter).
   * Built once, sent to all 200+ spectators without re-serializing. */
  static uint8_t spec_ghost_pkt[20 * 13 + 3]; /* max: 3 header + 20*13 body */
  size_t spec_ghost_len = 0;
  if (lb_all_count > 0) {
    pkt_ghost_cells(&w, lb_all_ghosts, lb_all_count);
    spec_ghost_len = bw_length(&w);
    memcpy(spec_ghost_pkt, bw_data(&w), spec_ghost_len);
  }

  /* Pre-serialized ping packet (identical for all connections). */
  static uint8_t ping_pkt[4];
  size_t ping_len = 0;
  int ping_interval = server_aux_ping_interval(srv);
  bool send_ping = (srv->ticks % ping_interval) == 0;
  if (send_ping) {
    pkt_ping(&w);
    ping_len = bw_length(&w);
    memcpy(ping_pkt, bw_data(&w), ping_len);
  }

  /* Pre-serialized leaderboard packet (all isMe=0).
   * PERF: only re-serialize when lb_dirty is true (top-N membership changed).
   * Max size: 1(op) + 4(count) + 10*(4(isMe) + 65(name) + 1(null)) = ~705 */
  static uint8_t lb_pkt[LB_PKT_MAX];
  static size_t
      lb_isMe_offsets[MAX_PLAYERS];      /* byte offset of each isMe field */
  static int lb_player_ids[MAX_PLAYERS]; /* player id for each lb entry */
  static size_t lb_pkt_len = 0;
  static int lb_cached_count = 0;

  if (srv->lb_dirty || lb_pkt_len == 0) {
    lb_pkt_len = 0;
    lb_cached_count = 0;
    size_t off = 0;
    lb_pkt[off++] = 0x31;
    uint32_t cnt = (uint32_t)srv->leaderboard_count;
    memcpy(lb_pkt + off, &cnt, 4);
    off += 4;
    for (int i = 0; i < srv->leaderboard_count && off < LB_PKT_MAX - 70;
         i++) {
      Player *item = srv->leaderboard[i];
      lb_isMe_offsets[i] = off;
      lb_player_ids[i] = item->id;
      uint32_t zero = 0;
      memcpy(lb_pkt + off, &zero, 4);
      off += 4; /* isMe = 0 */
      size_t nlen = strlen(item->name);
      memcpy(lb_pkt + off, item->name, nlen);
      off += nlen;
      lb_pkt[off++] = 0; /* null terminator */
      lb_cached_count++;
    }
    lb_pkt_len = off;
  }

  /* Serial player update packet generation (prevents shared writer & buffer data races) */
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->connected_count; ap++) {
    Player *player = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[ap]];
    if (player->conn_id < 0)
      continue;

    /*
     * World Spectators are intercepted by the dedicated fast path below.
     * They must never reach the active-player individual full-diff pipeline.
     */

    /* PERF: Earliest possible exit for cadence-skipped local bots.
     * On 24 of every 25 ticks, alive local bots have NO data to send.
     * Skip everything: cork syscall, spectator checks, backpressure,
     * prune tracking, camera, viewbox. ~618 bots × 1 setsockopt + branches
     * = ~1ms saved per tick. Combined with the later camera skip, this
     * means cadence-skipped bots touch only 2 cache lines (player + conn_id). */
    if (player->is_local && player->cell_count > 0 &&
        !player->force_full_diff_next_tick) {
      bool any_alive = false;
      for (int c = 0; c < player->cell_count; c++) {
        if (!player->cells[c]->is_removed) { any_alive = true; break; }
      }
      if (any_alive && ((srv->ticks + ap) % 25) != 0) {
        continue; /* no cork, no uncork, no data, no syscalls */
      }
    }

    /* Cork the socket: all queued packets for this player will be batched
     * into a single TCP segment. Uncork happens inside net_flush_player(). */
    net_cork_player(player->conn_id);

#ifdef _WIN32
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&loop_t0);
#endif

    /* ═══ WORLD SPECTATOR fast path ═══════════════════════════════
     *
     * This is deliberately based on the working grouped-spectator design:
     *
     *   - build one shared current snapshot;
     *   - compare it with this connection's exact known snapshot;
     *   - queue one complete packet;
     *   - commit tracking only after queue success.
     *
     * World Spectate never falls through to the active-player full-diff path.
     */
    if (player->cell_count == 0 &&
        player->spectate &&
        player->full_map_spectate) {

      /*
       * A fixed whole-map camera does not need a packet at 25 Hz.
       * Twelve-and-a-half updates per second are sufficient because movement
       * is interpolated client-side and this halves full-world processing.
       *
       * force_full_diff_next_tick bypasses cadence during initial baseline
       * construction or recovery.
       */
      if (!player->force_full_diff_next_tick &&
          ((srv->ticks + player->id) %
               WORLD_SPECTATE_UPDATE_CADENCE) != 0) {
        net_flush_player(
            player->conn_id);

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * Keep at most one World Spectate frame in flight.
       *
       * net_is_backpressured() alone permits up to SEND_BUF_HIGH_WATER bytes,
       * which is enough to accumulate stale map frames. Requiring zero pending
       * bytes coalesces intermediate states instead of queuing obsolete frames.
       */
      if (net_pending_bytes(
              player->conn_id) > 0 ||
          net_is_backpressured(
              player->conn_id)) {
        if (player->bp_stall_ticks <
            1000000) {
          player->bp_stall_ticks++;
        }

        net_flush_player(
            player->conn_id);

        continue;
      }

      player->bp_stall_ticks = 0;

      if (server_prune_player_tracking(
              srv,
              player) < 0) {
        net_kick_connection(
            player->conn_id,
            "world spectator tracking allocation failure");

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * A resync request means recompute the exact old -> current transition.
       * Do not ClearAll and do not destroy the retained known-cell snapshot.
       */
      if (player->full_map_resync_pending) {
        player->full_map_resync_pending = false;
        player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
      }

      /*
       * Build the expensive map-wide interest set once, regardless of how many
       * World Spectators are connected.
       */
      if (!world_visible_computed) {
        world_visible_count =
            server_build_world_interest_set(
                srv,
                world_visible,
                WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES);

        memset(
            world_view_state,
            0,
            sizeof(world_view_state));

        for (int world_index = 0;
             world_index < world_visible_count;
             world_index++) {
          Cell *world_cell =
              world_visible[world_index];

          if (!world_cell)
            continue;

          ptrdiff_t world_slot =
              world_cell - srv->cells;

          if (world_slot < 0 ||
              world_slot >= MAX_CELLS) {
            continue;
          }

          vs_set(
              world_view_state,
              (int)world_slot,
              1);
        }

        world_visible_computed = true;
      }

      Vec2 world_center = {
          (srv->border.minx +
           srv->border.maxx) * 0.5,

          (srv->border.miny +
           srv->border.maxy) * 0.5,
      };

      player->center = world_center;
      player->mouse = world_center;
      player->mouse_target = world_center;

      double world_width =
          srv->border.maxx -
          srv->border.minx;

      double world_height =
          srv->border.maxy -
          srv->border.miny;

      if (world_width < 1.0)
        world_width = 1.0;

      if (world_height < 1.0)
        world_height = 1.0;

      double world_scale_x =
          (srv->config.server_view_base_x + 100.0) /
          world_width;

      double world_scale_y =
          (srv->config.server_view_base_y + 100.0) /
          world_height;

      player->scale =
          fmin(
              world_scale_x,
              world_scale_y);

      if (!isfinite(player->scale) ||
          player->scale <= 0.0) {
        player->scale =
            FULL_MAP_SCALE_FLOOR;
      } else if (player->scale <
                 FULL_MAP_SCALE_FLOOR) {
        player->scale =
            FULL_MAP_SCALE_FLOOR;
      }

      player->viewbox =
          (Rect){
              srv->border.minx,
              srv->border.miny,
              srv->border.maxx,
              srv->border.maxy,
          };

      SpectatorExactDiff world_exact_diff = {
          .add_cells =
              exact_add_cells,

          .add_capacity =
              WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES,

          .update_cells =
              upd_list,

          .update_capacity =
              WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES,

          .eat_cells =
              eat_list,

          .eat_capacity =
              WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES,

          .delete_cells =
              del_list,

          .delete_capacity =
              WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES,
      };

      if (spectator_build_exact_diff(
              player,
              srv->cells,
              MAX_CELLS,
              world_visible,
              world_visible_count,
              world_view_state,
              srv->ticks,
              &world_exact_diff) < 0) {
        net_kick_connection(
            player->conn_id,
            "world spectator exact-diff failure");

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * Progressive ADD baseline:
       *
       * Keep every already-known current cell in the transactional replacement
       * snapshot. Append only the accepted ADD batch. Unknown cells beyond the
       * current batch remain unknown and are selected during the next update.
       */
      int total_world_adds =
          world_exact_diff.add_count;

      int accepted_world_adds =
          total_world_adds;

      if (accepted_world_adds >
          WORLD_SPECTATE_ADD_BUDGET) {
        accepted_world_adds =
            WORLD_SPECTATE_ADD_BUDGET;
      }

      int world_commit_count = 0;

      for (int world_index = 0;
           world_index < world_visible_count;
           world_index++) {
        Cell *world_cell =
            world_visible[world_index];

        if (!world_cell)
          continue;

        ptrdiff_t world_slot =
            world_cell - srv->cells;

        if (world_slot < 0 ||
            world_slot >= MAX_CELLS) {
          continue;
        }

        if (player->view_state &&
            vs_get(
                player->view_state,
                (int)world_slot) == 1) {
          if (world_commit_count >=
              WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES) {
            break;
          }

          world_commit_nodes[
              world_commit_count++] =
                  world_cell;
        }
      }

      /*
       * Track the number appended explicitly instead of deriving it from the
       * final commit count.
       */
      int appended_world_adds = 0;

      for (int add_index = 0;
           add_index < accepted_world_adds;
           add_index++) {
        Cell *add_cell =
            world_exact_diff.add_cells[
                add_index];

        if (!add_cell)
          continue;

        if (world_commit_count >=
            WORLD_SPECTATE_MAX_NODES) {
          break;
        }

        world_commit_nodes[
            world_commit_count++] =
                add_cell;

        server_fill_add_node_info(
            srv,
            add_cell,
            &add_list[appended_world_adds]);

        appended_world_adds++;
      }

      accepted_world_adds =
          appended_world_adds;

      world_exact_diff.add_count =
          accepted_world_adds;

      pkt_update_position(
          &w,
          player,
          world_center.x,
          world_center.y,
          player->scale,
          srv->ticks);

      if (!net_try_queue_to_player(
              player->conn_id,
              bw_data(&w),
              bw_length(&w))) {
        player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;

        net_flush_player(
            player->conn_id);

        continue;
      }

      pkt_update_nodes_full(
          &w,
          player,
          add_list,
          world_exact_diff.add_count,
          world_exact_diff.update_cells,
          world_exact_diff.update_count,
          world_exact_diff.eat_cells,
          world_exact_diff.eat_count,
          world_exact_diff.delete_cells,
          world_exact_diff.delete_count,
          player->compacted_drop_ids,
          player->compacted_drop_count,
          srv);

      if (!server_queue_world_update(
              srv,
              player,
              &w)) {
        /*
         * Preserve the old exact tracking. The next readable update rebuilds
         * the complete transition from the last successfully delivered state.
         */
        player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;

        net_flush_player(
            player->conn_id);

        continue;
      }

      if (player_replace_view_tracking(
              player,
              world_commit_nodes,
              world_commit_count,
              srv->cells,
              MAX_CELLS) < 0) {
        net_kick_connection(
            player->conn_id,
            "world spectator tracking commit failure");

        continue;
      }

      /*
       * Continue bypassing normal cadence until all baseline ADDs have been
       * accepted. Afterward World Spectate follows the configured cadence.
       */
      player->force_full_diff_next_tick =
          total_world_adds >
          accepted_world_adds;

      player->full_map_resync_pending = false;

      player->prev_center =
          player->center;

      player->prev_scale =
          player->scale;

      /*
       * Preserve ordinary spectator auxiliary packets.
       */
      player->tick_leaderboard++;

      int world_lb_interval =
          server_aux_lb_interval(
              srv,
              player);

      if (player->tick_leaderboard >=
          world_lb_interval) {
        player->tick_leaderboard = 0;

        if (lb_pkt_len > 0) {
          /*
           * A World Spectator is not an active leaderboard participant, so the
           * shared spectator packet keeps every isMe field equal to zero.
           */
          net_queue_to_player(
              player->conn_id,
              lb_pkt,
              lb_pkt_len);
        }
      }

      bool send_world_ghost =
          srv->lb_dirty ||
          (srv->ticks -
               player->last_ghost_send_tick) >=
              (uint32_t)server_aux_ghost_interval(
                  srv);

      if (send_world_ghost &&
          spec_ghost_len > 0) {
        net_queue_to_player(
            player->conn_id,
            spec_ghost_pkt,
            spec_ghost_len);

        player->last_ghost_send_tick =
            srv->ticks;
      }

      if (send_ping) {
        net_queue_to_player(
            player->conn_id,
            ping_pkt,
            ping_len);
      }

      net_flush_player(
          player->conn_id);

      continue;
    }

    /* ═══ GROUPED SPECTATOR fast path (spectate=true, free_roam=false) ═══ */
    if (player->cell_count == 0 && player->spectate && !player->free_roam) {

      /* Compute shared group state once per tick */
      #pragma omp critical(spec_compute)
      if (!spec_computed) {
        /*
         * Find target: #1 on the leaderboard.
         *
         * Player.id is a reusable slot and therefore is not a complete target
         * identity. lifecycle_generation distinguishes different connections
         * using the same slot; spawn_tick distinguishes a new life of the same
         * connection.
         */
        Player *target = NULL;

        if (srv->leaderboard_count > 0)
          target = srv->leaderboard[0];

        static double smoothed_spec_scale = 0.0;
        static int last_spec_target_id = -1;
        static uint64_t last_spec_target_generation = 0;
        static uint32_t last_spec_target_spawn_tick = 0;
        static int prev_spec_client_count = 0;

        if (target &&
            target->active &&
            target->cell_count > 0) {
          player_update_view_center(
              target,
              srv->ticks);

          spec_center =
              target->center;

          double raw_scale =
              player_get_living_scale(
                  target,
                  srv->config.server_min_scale,
                  srv->config.server_view_base_x,
                  srv->config.server_view_base_y);

          bool target_identity_changed =
              target->id !=
                  last_spec_target_id ||
              target->lifecycle_generation !=
                  last_spec_target_generation ||
              target->spawn_tick !=
                  last_spec_target_spawn_tick;

          bool snap_ema =
              smoothed_spec_scale <= 0.0;

          if (target_identity_changed) {
            snap_ema = true;
            spec_target_changed = true;
          }

          if (prev_spec_client_count == 0 &&
              srv->spec_client_count > 0) {
            snap_ema = true;
          }

          if (!snap_ema &&
              smoothed_spec_scale > 0.0) {
            double ratio =
                raw_scale /
                smoothed_spec_scale;

            if (ratio > 1.25 ||
                ratio < 0.75) {
              snap_ema = true;
            }
          }

          last_spec_target_id =
              target->id;

          last_spec_target_generation =
              target->lifecycle_generation;

          last_spec_target_spawn_tick =
              target->spawn_tick;

          prev_spec_client_count =
              srv->spec_client_count;

          if (snap_ema) {
            smoothed_spec_scale =
                raw_scale;
          } else {
            smoothed_spec_scale =
                smoothed_spec_scale * 0.85 +
                raw_scale * 0.15;
          }

          spec_scale =
              smoothed_spec_scale;
        } else {
          /*
           * Losing the target is also a target transition. Disable hysteresis
           * for this diff so cells from the former target cannot remain around
           * the fallback center.
           */
          if (last_spec_target_id != -1)
            spec_target_changed = true;

          last_spec_target_id = -1;
          last_spec_target_generation = 0;
          last_spec_target_spawn_tick = 0;
          prev_spec_client_count = 0;
          smoothed_spec_scale = 0.0;

          spec_center =
              (Vec2){0, 0};

          spec_scale =
              srv->config.server_spectator_scale;
        }

        /* Build viewbox */
        double half_w =
            (srv->config.server_view_base_x + 100.0) / spec_scale / 2.0;
        double half_h =
            (srv->config.server_view_base_y + 100.0) / spec_scale / 2.0;
        if (half_w > 9000.0) half_w = 9000.0;
        if (half_h > 9000.0) half_h = 9000.0;
        Rect box = {spec_center.x - half_w, spec_center.y - half_h,
                    spec_center.x + half_w, spec_center.y + half_h};

        /* ── TRUE HYSTERESIS for grouped spectator visibility ──
         * The spectator camera follows #1's center + scale, both of
         * which oscillate every tick during normal gameplay (eating,
         * decaying, splitting, merging). Without hysteresis, cells near
         * the viewport edge alternate between visible/invisible on
         * consecutive ticks → add/delete thrash → flickering icons.
         *
         * Fix: use ASYMMETRIC boundaries:
         *   padded_box  (600px)  — used for ADD queries (what to include)
         *   hysteresis_box (1200px) — used for REMOVE checks (what to keep)
         *
         * A cell enters visibility when it crosses the 600px boundary.
         * It only leaves when it crosses the 1200px boundary.
         * The 600px dead zone between them absorbs the jitter. */
        Rect padded_box = box;
        padded_box.minx -= srv->config.viewport_query_padding;
        padded_box.miny -= srv->config.viewport_query_padding;
        padded_box.maxx += srv->config.viewport_query_padding;
        padded_box.maxy += srv->config.viewport_query_padding;

        /* Larger box for removal hysteresis — cells must leave THIS box
         * before being deleted. Prevents edge oscillation. */
        Rect hysteresis_box = box;
        hysteresis_box.minx -= srv->config.group_hysteresis_padding;
        hysteresis_box.miny -= srv->config.group_hysteresis_padding;
        hysteresis_box.maxx += srv->config.group_hysteresis_padding;
        hysteresis_box.maxy += srv->config.group_hysteresis_padding;

        /* Query up to (MAX_VIEW_NODES + 4096) cells, quickselect if over MAX_VIEW_NODES */
        #define SPEC_QUERY_CAP SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES
        static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *query_visible[SPEC_QUERY_CAP];

        int vis_count = 0;
        if (UNLIKELY(player->full_map_spectate)) {
          for (int d = 0; d < srv->dynamic_count && vis_count < SPEC_QUERY_CAP; d++) {
            Cell *dc = srv->dynamic_nodes[d];
            if (dc && !dc->is_removed)
              query_visible[vis_count++] = dc;
          }
          vis_count = fg_query_from(&srv->food_grid, padded_box, query_visible, vis_count, SPEC_QUERY_CAP);
        } else {
          vis_count = bot_grid_query(&srv->bot_grid, padded_box, query_visible, SPEC_QUERY_CAP);
          vis_count = fg_query_from(&srv->food_grid, padded_box, query_visible, vis_count, SPEC_QUERY_CAP);
        }

        /* Filter removed cells and anything outside the real map border.
         * Matches the alive-player path and avoids border-transition junk
         * surviving in the padded query result. */
        int write = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < vis_count; r++) {
          Cell *vc = query_visible[r];
          if (vc->is_removed)
            continue;

          Vec2 p = vc->position;
          if (p.x >= srv->border.minx && p.x <= srv->border.maxx &&
              p.y >= srv->border.miny && p.y <= srv->border.maxy) {
            query_visible[write++] = vc;
          }
        }
        vis_count = write;

        if (vis_count > SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
          quickselect_cells_by_dist(query_visible, vis_count, SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES, (target) ? target->id : 0, spec_center);
          vis_count = SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES;
        }
        memcpy(visible, query_visible, vis_count * sizeof(Cell *));

        /* Force target's cells to be visible even if outside viewbox */
        if (target) {
          /* PERF: generation counter instead of 128KB memset per call. */
          static uint32_t vm_spec_gen[MAX_CELLS];
          static uint32_t vm_spec_counter = 0;
          vm_spec_counter++;
          if (vm_spec_counter == 0) {
            memset(vm_spec_gen, 0, sizeof(vm_spec_gen));
            vm_spec_counter = 1;
          }

          /* Mark all qt_query results for O(1) dedup */
          for (int v = 0; v < vis_count; v++) {
            int idx = (int)(visible[v] - srv->cells);
            if (idx >= 0 && idx < MAX_CELLS) {
              vm_spec_gen[idx] = vm_spec_counter;
            }
          }

          for (int c = 0; c < target->cell_count; c++) {
            if (vis_count >= SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES)
              break;
            Cell *tcell = target->cells[c];
            if (tcell->is_removed)
              continue;

            int idx = (int)(tcell - srv->cells);
            if (idx >= 0 && idx < MAX_CELLS && vm_spec_gen[idx] != vm_spec_counter) {
              vm_spec_gen[idx] = vm_spec_counter;
              visible[vis_count++] = tcell;
            }
          }
        }

        /* O(V) Diff against shared spec_client_nodes using spec_view_state */
        spec_add_count = spec_upd_count = 0;
        spec_eat_count = spec_del_count = 0;

        for (int vi = 0; vi < vis_count; vi++) {
          Cell *vc = visible[vi];
          if (vc->is_removed)
            continue;

          int cell_idx = (int)(vc - srv->cells);
          if (vs_get(srv->spec_view_state, cell_idx) == 1) {
            if (vc->is_moving || vc->type == CELL_PLAYER ||
                vc->last_evt_tick == srv->ticks) {
              if (spec_upd_count < SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES)
                spec_upd[spec_upd_count++] = vc;
            }
          } else {
            if (spec_add_count < SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              spec_add[spec_add_count].cell = vc;
              spec_add[spec_add_count].name =
                  (vc->type == CELL_PLAYER && vc->owner_id >= 0)
                      ? srv->players[vc->owner_id].name
                      : NULL;
              if (vc->type == CELL_POTION)
                spec_add[spec_add_count].name = POTION_CELL_NAME;
              spec_add[spec_add_count].skin =
                  (vc->type == CELL_PLAYER && vc->owner_id >= 0)
                      ? srv->players[vc->owner_id].skin
                      : NULL;
              spec_add_count++;
            }
          }
          vs_set(srv->spec_view_state, cell_idx, 2); /* seen this tick */
        }

        /* Phase 2: process previously-tracked cells.
         * TRUE HYSTERESIS: cells not in this tick's query are NOT immediately
         * deleted. Instead, check if they're still within the larger
         * hysteresis_box AND inside the map border AND alive. Only delete
         * cells that have truly left the extended viewport. */
        int keep_count = 0;
        for (int ci = 0; ci < srv->spec_client_count; ci++) {
          Cell *cc = srv->spec_client_nodes[ci];
          int cell_idx = (int)(cc - srv->cells);
          if (vs_get(srv->spec_view_state, cell_idx) == 2) {
            /* Still in this tick's query → keep */
            srv->spec_client_nodes[keep_count++] = cc;
            vs_set(srv->spec_view_state, cell_idx, 1);
          } else if (!spec_target_changed && !cc->is_removed &&
                     cc->position.x >= hysteresis_box.minx &&
                     cc->position.x <= hysteresis_box.maxx &&
                     cc->position.y >= hysteresis_box.miny &&
                     cc->position.y <= hysteresis_box.maxy &&
                     cc->position.x >= srv->border.minx &&
                     cc->position.x <= srv->border.maxx &&
                     cc->position.y >= srv->border.miny &&
                     cc->position.y <= srv->border.maxy) {
            /* Not in query but still within hysteresis zone + map border.
             * KEEP it visible to prevent edge oscillation thrash.
             * The client already has this cell — no need to re-add it.
             * It will naturally be picked up by the query again when the
             * viewport stabilizes, or deleted when it truly leaves. */
            srv->spec_client_nodes[keep_count++] = cc;
            vs_set(srv->spec_view_state, cell_idx, 1);
          } else {
            /* Truly gone: removed, or outside hysteresis zone, or
             * outside map border → send delete/eat */
            if (cc->is_removed && cc->killer_id != 0) {
              if (spec_eat_count < SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES)
                spec_eat[spec_eat_count++] = cc;
            } else {
              if (spec_del_count < SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES)
                spec_del[spec_del_count++] = cc;
            }
            vs_set(srv->spec_view_state, cell_idx, 0);
          }
        }

        int accepted_spec_adds = 0;

        for (int ai = 0;
             ai < spec_add_count;
             ai++) {
          AddNodeInfo candidate =
              spec_add[ai];

          if (view_track_append(
                  srv->spec_client_nodes,
                  srv->spec_client_handles,
                  &keep_count,
                  SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES,
                  srv->spec_view_state,
                  srv->cells,
                  MAX_CELLS,
                  candidate.cell)) {
            spec_add[
                accepted_spec_adds++] =
                    candidate;
          }
        }

        spec_add_count =
            accepted_spec_adds;

        srv->spec_client_count =
            keep_count;

        server_refresh_tracking_group(
            srv->spec_client_nodes,
            srv->spec_client_handles,
            srv->spec_client_count);

        spec_computed = true;
      }

      /*
       * Exact per-connection grouped-spectator diff.
       *
       * The query and current snapshot above are shared once per tick, but this
       * connection's previous known set is never inferred from another viewer.
       */
      if (net_is_backpressured(
              player->conn_id)) {
        if (player->bp_stall_ticks <
            1000000) {
          player->bp_stall_ticks++;
        }

        /* Do NOT set full_map_resync_pending here — that triggers ClearAll
         * which wipes all cells and rebuilds from scratch, creating more
         * traffic and potentially causing another backpressure cycle.
         * Only opcode 206 (tab-return) should trigger ClearAll.
         * On recovery, force_full_diff will reconcile with full ADDs. */

        net_flush_player(
            player->conn_id);

        continue;
      }

      player->bp_stall_ticks = 0;

      /*
       * After backpressure, the server may have committed view_state entries
       * for packets the client never received.  Force a full diff so that
       * spectator_build_exact_diff classifies every cell as ADD (with
       * name/skin) instead of UPDATE (position only).
       * This is gentler than ClearAll — the client keeps existing cells.
       */
      player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
      if (player->full_map_resync_pending) {
        /* Send explicit DELETEs (NOT opcode 0x12 ClearAll — that triggers
         * LM/OGARio reconnect). On success, tracking is cleared. */
        if (!server_send_explicit_deletes(player)) {
          net_flush_player(player->conn_id);
          continue;
        }
        player->full_map_resync_pending = false;
      }

      /*
       * Target changed: send explicit DELETEs for all tracked cells from
       * the old target. Then tracking is already cleared by the helper.
       */
      if (spec_target_changed &&
          player->client_count > 0) {
        if (!server_send_explicit_deletes(player)) {
          /* DELETEs couldn't be queued — force full diff next tick instead
           * of setting full_map_resync_pending (which triggers ClearAll). */
          player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
          net_flush_player(player->conn_id);
          continue;
        }
      }

      SpectatorExactDiff exact_diff = {
          .add_cells =
              exact_add_cells,
          .add_capacity =
              SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES,
          .update_cells =
              upd_list,
          .update_capacity =
              SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES,
          .eat_cells =
              eat_list,
          .eat_capacity =
              SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES,
          .delete_cells =
              del_list,
          .delete_capacity =
              SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES,
      };

      if (spectator_build_exact_diff(
              player,
              srv->cells,
              MAX_CELLS,
              srv->spec_client_nodes,
              srv->spec_client_count,
              srv->spec_view_state,
              srv->ticks,
              &exact_diff) < 0) {
        net_kick_connection(
            player->conn_id,
            "grouped spectator tracking failure");

        continue;
      }

      for (int index = 0;
           index < exact_diff.add_count;
           index++) {
        server_fill_add_node_info(
            srv,
            exact_diff.add_cells[index],
            &add_list[index]);
      }

      pkt_update_position(
          &w,
          player,
          spec_center.x,
          spec_center.y,
          spec_scale,
          srv->ticks);

      if (!net_try_queue_to_player(
              player->conn_id,
              bw_data(&w),
              bw_length(&w))) {
        player->full_map_resync_pending =
            true;

        net_flush_player(
            player->conn_id);

        continue;
      }

      pkt_update_nodes_full(
          &w,
          player,
          add_list,
          exact_diff.add_count,
          exact_diff.update_cells,
          exact_diff.update_count,
          exact_diff.eat_cells,
          exact_diff.eat_count,
          exact_diff.delete_cells,
          exact_diff.delete_count,
          player->compacted_drop_ids,
          player->compacted_drop_count,
          srv);

      {
        static uint8_t
            lz4buf_spec[131072];

        if (!server_queue_spectator_update(
                srv,
                player,
                &w,
                lz4buf_spec,
                sizeof(lz4buf_spec))) {
          /*
           * Preserve the old exact snapshot and compacted DELETE IDs. The next
           * readable tick recomputes the complete old->current transition.
           */
          player->full_map_resync_pending =
              true;

          net_flush_player(
              player->conn_id);

          continue;
        }
      }

      /*
       * Commit only after the complete update frame entered the queue.
       * Capacity was reserved by spectator_build_exact_diff(), so failure here
       * indicates an invariant violation rather than ordinary memory pressure.
       */
      if (player_replace_view_tracking(
              player,
              srv->spec_client_nodes,
              srv->spec_client_count,
              srv->cells,
              MAX_CELLS) < 0) {
        net_kick_connection(
            player->conn_id,
            "grouped spectator tracking commit failure");

        continue;
      }

      player->full_map_resync_pending =
          false;

      player->force_full_diff_next_tick =
          false;

      /* Leaderboard on this spectator's own timer */
      player->tick_leaderboard++;
      int lb_interval = server_aux_lb_interval(srv, player);
      if (player->tick_leaderboard >= lb_interval) {
        player->tick_leaderboard = 0;
        if (lb_pkt_len > 0) {
          /* Spectators are never on the leaderboard, so isMe stays 0 */
          net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, lb_pkt, lb_pkt_len);
        }
      }

      bool send_spec_ghost =
          srv->lb_dirty || (srv->ticks - player->last_ghost_send_tick) >=
                               (uint32_t)server_aux_ghost_interval(srv);

      if (send_spec_ghost && spec_ghost_len > 0) {
        net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, spec_ghost_pkt, spec_ghost_len);
        player->last_ghost_send_tick = srv->ticks;
      }

      /* Ping: send pre-built packet */
      if (send_ping) {
        net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, ping_pkt, ping_len);
      }

      net_flush_player(player->conn_id);
      continue; /* skip individual path */
    }

    /* ═══ INDIVIDUAL path (active players, free-roam, pre-spawn) ═══ */

    /* Progressive backpressure degradation:
     * Level 0 (0-24 ticks):    skip update, force full snapshot later
     * Level 1 (25-74 ticks):   reduce to every 3rd tick cadence
     * Level 2 (75-249 ticks):  reduce to every 5th tick cadence
     * Level 3 (250-749 ticks): switch to spectator-rate updates only
     * Level 4 (750+ ticks):    kick — client is dead (30 seconds at 25Hz)
     */
    if (net_is_backpressured(player->conn_id)) {
      player->bp_stall_ticks++;

      /*
       * TCP/WebSocket backpressure may cause a previously built full-map
       * packet to be delayed or discarded by the bounded network queue.
       * Remember that the client's known-cell state can no longer be trusted.
       */
      /* Don't set force_full_diff_next_tick on backpressure — same reasoning
       * as the DEATH SPIRAL FIX below. Let the transactional diff naturally
       * reconcile when backpressure clears. */

      if (player->is_lm_bot && player->bp_stall_ticks >= 125) {
        /* 5 seconds: bot is dead, disconnect */
        INFO_LOG("[Bot %d] Backpressure kick after %d ticks\n", player->id,
                 player->bp_stall_ticks);
        net_kick_connection(player->conn_id, "bot backpressure timeout");
        continue;
      } else if (player->bp_stall_ticks >= 750 &&
                 !player->spectate && !player->free_roam &&
                 !player->full_map_spectate) {
        /* 30 seconds: active player is dead (not a spectator), disconnect.
         * Spectators are never kicked for backpressure — they are passive
         * viewers and their slow reads are expected, not a sign of dead conn. */
        INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Backpressure kick after %d ticks\n", player->id,
                 player->bp_stall_ticks);
        net_kick_connection(player->conn_id, "backpressure timeout");
        continue;
      }

      /* DEATH SPIRAL FIX (v1.2.51): Do NOT set force_full_diff_next_tick here.
       * When many players get backpressured simultaneously (slow tick), setting
       * force_full_diff on ALL of them causes a burst of expensive full_diffs
       * on the recovery tick → even slower → more backpressure → cascade freeze.
       * Instead, let them resume on the cheap dirty path. The periodic full_diff
       * at (ticks + id) % 50 resyncs their view within 2 seconds — safe tradeoff
       * compared to a total server freeze. */
      net_flush_player(player->conn_id);
      continue; /* skip this player's update entirely */
    }
    /* Client is reading — reset stall counter */
    player->bp_stall_ticks = 0;

    if (server_prune_player_tracking(
            srv,
            player) < 0) {
      net_kick_connection(
          player->conn_id,
          "view tracking allocation failure");

      continue;
    }

    /*
     * World spectate resync (tab-return / sustained backpressure).
     *
     * Previously this sent explicit DELETEs for ALL tracked cells then
     * rebuilt from scratch — causing visible "cut scenes" as thousands
     * of cells vanished and slowly re-appeared via ADD batches.
     *
     * Now: just force a full diff next tick. The transactional diff
     * naturally handles any divergence (ADD new cells, DELETE stale ones)
     * without the destructive wipe. Same approach as grouped spectate.
     */
    if (player->full_map_spectate &&
        player->full_map_resync_pending) {
      player->full_map_resync_pending = false;
      player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
      /* Local bots: also clear tracking since they don't receive packets */
      if (player->is_local)
        player_clear_view_tracking(player);
    }

    /* NOTE: bots (no uid, no is_lm_client) go through the SAME full_diff
     * update pipeline as real players. No stagger, no skip. Bots represent
     * real player load — any optimization here would hide real scalability
     * limits. If the server can't handle N bots, it can't handle N players. */

    /* Update center and scale FIRST, then finalize spectate overrides,
     * then send position, then build viewbox from that same final state. */
    if (player->cell_count > 0) {
      player_update_view_center(player, srv->ticks);
      player->scale = player_get_living_scale(
          player, srv->config.server_min_scale, srv->config.server_view_base_x,
          srv->config.server_view_base_y);
      player->last_alive_scale = player->scale; /* save for death viewport */
    } else if (player->spectate) {
      if (!player->free_roam) {
        /* Grouped spectate: match #1's scale (computed once in spec_computed) */
        player->scale = spec_scale;
      } else {
        /* Free-roam spectate: fixed scale */
        player->scale = srv->config.server_spectator_scale;
      }
    } else {
      /* Dead, not spectating — keep last alive viewport (like original agar.io)
       */
      player->scale = player->last_alive_scale > 0
                          ? player->last_alive_scale
                          : srv->config.server_spectator_scale;
    }

    /* Finalize special spectate camera state BEFORE sending camera packet */
    if (player->full_map_spectate) {
      player->center = (Vec2){
          (srv->border.minx + srv->border.maxx) * 0.5,
          (srv->border.miny + srv->border.maxy) * 0.5,
      };

      double world_w = srv->border.maxx - srv->border.minx;
      double world_h = srv->border.maxy - srv->border.miny;

      if (world_w < 1.0)
        world_w = 1.0;
      if (world_h < 1.0)
        world_h = 1.0;

      double scale_x =
          (srv->config.server_view_base_x + 100.0) / world_w;
      double scale_y =
          (srv->config.server_view_base_y + 100.0) / world_h;

      /*
       * Full-map scale is intentionally allowed below server_min_scale.
       * server_min_scale protects ordinary gameplay view queries, whereas
       * full-map mode uses an explicitly bounded map-wide cell selection.
       */
      player->scale = fmin(scale_x, scale_y);

      if (!isfinite(player->scale) || player->scale <= 0.0)
        player->scale = FULL_MAP_SCALE_FLOOR;
      else if (player->scale < FULL_MAP_SCALE_FLOOR)
        player->scale = FULL_MAP_SCALE_FLOOR;
    }

    /* Send position update using the FINAL camera state */
    /* PERF: Local bots don't need camera/viewport position packets */
    if (!player->is_local) {
      pkt_update_position(&w, player, player->center.x, player->center.y,
                          player->scale, srv->ticks);
      net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
    }

    /* Build viewbox from the SAME final camera state */
    if (player->full_map_spectate) {
      /* Full map: use a very generous viewbox to catch EVERYTHING */
      double pad = 2000.0;
      player->viewbox = (Rect){srv->border.minx - pad, srv->border.miny - pad,
                               srv->border.maxx + pad, srv->border.maxy + pad};
    } else {
      double half_w =
          (srv->config.server_view_base_x + 100.0) / player->scale / 2.0;
      double half_h =
          (srv->config.server_view_base_y + 100.0) / player->scale / 2.0;

      /* Visibility Pruning: Hard cap maximum viewbox dimensions preventing
       * malicious tiny-scale clients from querying the entire QuadTree map
       * synchronously. 9000.0 prevents legitimate players at large scales from
       * seeing borders. */
      if (half_w > 9000.0)
        half_w = 9000.0;
      if (half_h > 9000.0)
        half_h = 9000.0;

      /* BANDWIDTH: Local bots (same machine) use a much smaller viewport.
       * They only need to see nearby cells for basic AI decisions.
       * This reduces the quadtree query size and packet payload by ~80%. */
      if (player->is_local) {
        if (half_w > 2000.0) half_w = 2000.0;
        if (half_h > 2000.0) half_h = 2000.0;
      }
      player->viewbox =
          (Rect){player->center.x - half_w, player->center.y - half_h,
                 player->center.x + half_w, player->center.y + half_h};
    }

    /* PERF: Tiered update cadence for non-alive clients.
     * Full-map spectators: expensive (entire map query/sort/diff) → every tick
     * (cadence 1) Free-roam/pre-spawn: moderate cost → every tick (cadence 1)
     * Menu screen (dead, not spectating): extremely low cost → every 25th tick
     * (1/sec) Alive players: always full updates for smooth gameplay */
    if (player->is_bot && player->conn_id < 0) {
      continue;
    }

    /* NOTE: The local bot alive-cadence check (is_local && cell_count > 0 && tick%25)
     * is handled at the TOP of the loop (before cork) for maximum skip efficiency. */

    if (player->cell_count == 0 && !player->full_map_spectate) {
      /* Non-world spectators: no cadence skip needed (cadence=1) */
      if (!player->force_full_diff_next_tick &&
          ((srv->ticks + ap) % 1) != 0) {
        net_flush_player(player->conn_id);
        continue;
      }
    }

    /* PERF: Skip full view diff for alive players whose camera barely
     * moved. Saves qt_query + sort + full diff overhead.
     * Two tiers:
     *   TOTAL SKIP — nothing changed at all: skip even mini-update
     *   MINI UPDATE — camera static but owned cells moving: send dynamic
     * updates only
     */
    if (player->cell_count > 0 && player->client_count > 0 &&
        player->prev_scale == player->scale &&
        player->cell_count == player->prev_cell_count) {
      double dx = player->center.x - player->prev_center.x;
      double dy = player->center.y - player->prev_center.y;
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 25.0) { /* 5 units squared */

        /* Check if ANY owned cell is moving (split/eject/boost in flight) */
        bool has_moving_own = false;
        if (player->split_requested || player->eject_requested) {
          has_moving_own = true;
        } else {
          for (int c = 0; c < player->cell_count; c++) {
            if (player->cells[c]->is_moving) {
              has_moving_own = true;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        int lb_interval = server_aux_lb_interval(srv, player);
        int ghost_interval = server_aux_ghost_interval(srv);

        bool skip_lb = player->tick_leaderboard < lb_interval;
        bool skip_ghost = (srv->ticks - player->last_ghost_send_tick) <
                          (uint32_t)ghost_interval;

        const TotalSkipInputs total_skip_inputs = {
            .has_moving_own =
                has_moving_own,
            .send_ping =
                send_ping,
            .skip_leaderboard =
                skip_lb,
            .skip_ghost =
                skip_ghost,
            .dirty_count =
                g_dirty_count,
            .removed_count =
                srv->removed_this_tick_count,
            .spawned_count =
                srv->spawned_this_tick_count,
            .moving_dynamic_count =
                srv->moving_dynamic_count,
            .compacted_drop_count =
                player->compacted_drop_count,
            .force_full_diff =
                player->force_full_diff_next_tick,
        };

        if (total_skip_is_safe(
                &total_skip_inputs)) {
          /*
           * TOTAL SKIP is valid only when the world had no visibility-relevant
           * mutation and no auxiliary packet is due.
           *
           * Position was already queued above; arm output and avoid query/diff.
           */

#ifdef _WIN32
          sp_skip++;
#endif
          net_flush_player(player->conn_id);
          continue;
        }

        /* ── DIRTY PATH (re-enabled v1.2.45) ──
         * Fixed to handle ADD (new cells) and EAT (removed cells)
         * directly instead of bailing to full_diff. Periodic full_diff
         * every 50 ticks cleans up any stale view state.
         * Also honor force_full_diff_next_tick (set by backpressure
         * recovery) to resynchronize the player's view.
         * OVERFLOW GUARD (real players only): when dirty cells exceed
         * the scan cap, real players fall back to full_diff for visual
         * accuracy. Bots are headless and don't need accurate visuals,
         * so they always use the cheap dirty path regardless of count.
         * PERF: Local bots use a wider periodic interval (150 vs 50 ticks)
         * since they don't need frequent reconciliation. */
        {
          int full_diff_interval = player->is_local ? 250 : 50;
          /* Camera drift since last full_diff. When the camera has moved
           * substantially, static cells near the new viewport edges won't
           * appear in the dirty list — they didn't move/change, they just
           * became visible. Force full_diff to discover them immediately,
           * eliminating the blinking at viewport corners. */
          double drift2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
          bool camera_drifted = drift2 > 50.0 * 50.0; /* ~50 world units — triggers on any real movement */
          if (((srv->ticks + player->id) % full_diff_interval) == 0 ||
              player->force_full_diff_next_tick ||
              player->full_map_spectate ||  /* always full_diff — dirty path misses removals between cadence ticks */
              camera_drifted ||  /* viewport moved enough to reveal new static cells */
              (g_dirty_count > DIRTY_MAX_SCAN_CELLS &&
               (player->conn_id >= 0 || player->is_lm_client))) {
            player->force_full_diff_next_tick = false;
            goto full_diff; /* periodic, overflow, or post-backpressure */
          }
        }

#ifdef _WIN32
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&sp_outer_t0);
#endif

        /* PERF: When dirty count is moderate or high, skip the entire
         * dirty scan for local bots. They just get a slightly delayed
         * world state and catch up on the next cadence tick. Threshold
         * lowered to 200 since bots are headless — no visual impact. */
        if (player->is_local && g_dirty_count > 200) {
          continue;
        }

        int dirty_upd_count = 0;
        int dirty_add_count = 0;
        int dirty_eat_count = 0;
        int dirty_del_count = 0;
        int hi_count = 0;
        int lo_count = 0;
        int scanned_dirty = 0;
        int budget =
            server_dirty_packet_budget(
                srv);
        int used_budget = 0;

        /*
         * prev_center/prev_scale remain anchored to the last complete diff.
         * A sequence of tiny movements therefore accumulates and eventually
         * enters full_diff instead of avoiding reconciliation forever.
         */
        bool camera_shifted =
            dx != 0.0 ||
            dy != 0.0;

        Rect retain_box =
            player->viewbox;

        retain_box.minx -= 2500.0;
        retain_box.miny -= 2500.0;
        retain_box.maxx += 2500.0;
        retain_box.maxy += 2500.0;

        /*
         * When the camera has shifted, remove any tracked cell that has left
         * the larger hysteresis box. Static cells need not be dirty to leave
         * the viewport.
         */
        /*
         * TRANSACTIONAL CAMERA-SHIFT SWEEP (v1.2.47 — ghost cell fix)
         *
         * The old code called view_track_remove_at() here, immediately
         * modifying client_nodes/view_state.  If a later inconsistency
         * triggered goto full_diff, the dirty DELETE lists were abandoned
         * and the full_diff couldn't reconstruct them (cells already
         * erased from tracking).  Result: permanent ghost cells.
         *
         * New approach: mark departures with view_state = 3 (pending
         * removal).  Tracking state is committed only after the packet
         * is successfully queued.  On failure, marks are rolled back.
         */
        /*
         * TRANSACTIONAL TRACKED-CELLS DEPARTURE & REMOVAL SWEEP
         *
         * Check all tracked cells for:
         * 1) Cell removal (tracked->is_removed == true) — ALWAYS checked even when camera is stationary.
         * 2) Viewport departure — checked when camera shifted.
         */
        int deferred_remove_count = 0;

        for (int tracked_index = 0;
             tracked_index < player->client_count;
             tracked_index++) {
          Cell *tracked = player->client_nodes[tracked_index];

          if (!tracked) {
            /* NULL entries compacted during commit */
            deferred_remove_count++;
            continue;
          }

          ptrdiff_t slot = tracked - srv->cells;

          if (slot < 0 || slot >= MAX_CELLS) {
            deferred_remove_count++;
            continue;
          }

          /* vs==3: already marked for deferred removal */
          if (vs_get(player->view_state, (int)slot) == 3) {
            continue;
          }

          ViewDeparture departure = VIEW_DEPARTURE_KEEP;
          if (tracked->is_removed) {
            departure = (tracked->killer_id != 0)
                ? VIEW_DEPARTURE_EAT
                : VIEW_DEPARTURE_DELETE;
          } else if (camera_shifted) {
            departure = view_classify_departure(tracked, retain_box, true);
          }

          if (departure == VIEW_DEPARTURE_KEEP) {
            continue;
          }

          if (departure == VIEW_DEPARTURE_EAT) {
            if (dirty_eat_count < MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              eat_list[dirty_eat_count++] = tracked;
            }
          } else {
            if (dirty_del_count < MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              del_list[dirty_del_count++] = tracked;
            }
          }

          /* Mark for deferred removal */
          vs_set(player->view_state, (int)slot, 3);
          deferred_remove_count++;
        }

        /*
         * Own player cells are always updated first. Their state controls local
         * gameplay and must not be displaced by lower-priority entities.
         */
        for (int c = 0;
             c < player->cell_count &&
             dirty_upd_count <
                 DIRTY_MAX_OWN_CELLS;
             c++) {
          Cell *own =
              player->cells[c];

          if (own &&
              !own->is_removed) {
            upd_list[
                dirty_upd_count++] =
                    own;

            used_budget +=
                server_estimate_update_cost(
                    own);
          }
        }

        for (uint32_t d = 0;
             d < g_dirty_count &&
             scanned_dirty <
                 DIRTY_MAX_SCAN_CELLS;
             d++) {
          PREFETCH_CELL(g_dirty_cells, d, g_dirty_count);
          Cell *dirty =
              g_dirty_cells[d];

          if (UNLIKELY(!dirty ||
              dirty->is_removed)) {
            continue;
          }

          scanned_dirty++;

          if (dirty->owner_id ==
                  player->id &&
              dirty->type ==
                  CELL_PLAYER) {
            continue;
          }

          ptrdiff_t cell_index =
              dirty - srv->cells;

          if (cell_index < 0 ||
              cell_index >= MAX_CELLS) {
            continue;
          }

          uint8_t vs_val =
              vs_get(
                  player->view_state,
                  (int)cell_index);

          /* vs==3: already marked for deferred removal (camera-shift
           * or earlier dirty cell).  Skip entirely to avoid duplicate
           * departure entries. */
          if (vs_val == 3)
            continue;

          bool known = (vs_val == 1);

          if (!known) {
            bool inside_entry = view_rect_contains_cell(player->viewbox, dirty);
            if (!inside_entry)
              continue;

            if (dirty_add_count < MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              add_list[
                  dirty_add_count].cell =
                      dirty;

              add_list[
                  dirty_add_count].name =
                      (
                          dirty->type ==
                              CELL_PLAYER &&
                          dirty->owner_id >= 0
                      )
                          ? srv->players[
                                dirty->owner_id].name
                          : NULL;

              add_list[
                  dirty_add_count].skin =
                      (
                          dirty->type ==
                              CELL_PLAYER &&
                          dirty->owner_id >= 0
                      )
                          ? srv->players[
                                dirty->owner_id].skin
                          : NULL;

              if (dirty->type ==
                  CELL_POTION) {
                add_list[
                    dirty_add_count].name =
                        POTION_CELL_NAME;
              }

              dirty_add_count++;
            }

            continue;
          }

          /*
           * A moving known cell can leave the retained viewport while the
           * camera itself remains stationary.
           */
          bool inside_retain = view_rect_contains_cell(retain_box, dirty);
          if (!inside_retain) {
            if (dirty_del_count <
                MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              del_list[
                  dirty_del_count++] =
                      dirty;
            }

            /* Deferred removal: mark vs=3, commit later */
            vs_set(
                player->view_state,
                (int)cell_index,
