                3);

            deferred_remove_count++;
            continue;
          }

          if (dirty->type == CELL_PLAYER ||
              dirty->is_moving ||
              dirty->type == CELL_VIRUS ||
              dirty->type == CELL_EJECTED ||
              dirty->type == CELL_POTION) {
            if (hi_count < MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              prio_hi[hi_count++] = dirty;
            }
          } else {
            if (lo_count < MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              prio_lo[lo_count++] = dirty;
            }
          }
        }

        for (int index = 0;
             index < hi_count &&
             dirty_upd_count <
                 MAX_VIEW_NODES;
             index++) {
          Cell *dirty =
              prio_hi[index];

          int cost =
              server_estimate_update_cost(
                  dirty);

          if (used_budget + cost >
              budget) {
#ifdef _WIN32
            prof_dirty_budget_clamped++;
#endif
            break;
          }

          upd_list[
              dirty_upd_count++] =
                  dirty;

          used_budget += cost;
        }

        for (int index = 0;
             index < lo_count &&
             dirty_upd_count <
                 MAX_VIEW_NODES;
             index++) {
          Cell *dirty =
              prio_lo[index];

          int cost =
              server_estimate_update_cost(
                  dirty);

          if (used_budget + cost >
              budget) {
#ifdef _WIN32
            prof_dirty_budget_clamped++;
#endif
            break;
          }

          upd_list[
              dirty_upd_count++] =
                  dirty;

          used_budget += cost;
        }

        /*
         * Removed cells are processed independently of camera movement.
         */
        for (int removed_index = 0;
             removed_index <
                 srv->removed_this_tick_count;
             removed_index++) {
          Cell *removed =
              srv->removed_this_tick[
                  removed_index];

          if (!removed)
            continue;

          ptrdiff_t cell_index =
              removed - srv->cells;

          if (cell_index < 0 ||
              cell_index >= MAX_CELLS) {
            continue;
          }

          {
            uint8_t vs_rm =
                vs_get(
                    player->view_state,
                    (int)cell_index);

            /* Not tracked or already marked for removal */
            if (vs_rm == 0 ||
                vs_rm == 3) {
              continue;
            }
          }

          if (removed->killer_id != 0) {
            if (dirty_eat_count <
                MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              eat_list[
                  dirty_eat_count++] =
                      removed;
            }
          } else {
            if (dirty_del_count <
                MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
              del_list[
                  dirty_del_count++] =
                      removed;
            }
          }

          /* Deferred removal: mark vs=3, commit later */
          vs_set(
              player->view_state,
              (int)cell_index,
              3);

          deferred_remove_count++;
        }

        /*
         * ── TRANSACTIONAL DIRTY COMMIT ──
         *
         * Plan capacity, build packet, queue (checked), then commit.
         * On queue failure: rollback vs=3 marks, preserve all anchors.
         */

        /* Project post-commit count to verify ADD capacity.
         * deferred_remove_count includes camera-shift + dirty-scan +
         * removed_this_tick departures. */
        int projected_count =
            player->client_count -
            deferred_remove_count;

        if (projected_count < 0)
          projected_count = 0;

        /* Reserve capacity for projected post-commit count.
         * Try to grow first, then truncate ADDs to what fits. */
        int desired_count =
            projected_count + dirty_add_count;

        if (desired_count >
                player->client_capacity) {
          if (player_ensure_client_capacity(
                  player,
                  desired_count) < 0) {
            /* Grow failed — truncate ADDs to
             * what current capacity allows. */
          }
        }

        int available_add_slots =
            player->client_capacity -
            projected_count;

        if (available_add_slots < 0)
          available_add_slots = 0;

        if (dirty_add_count > available_add_slots)
          dirty_add_count = available_add_slots;

        /* ── Build and queue dirty packet ── */
        bool dirty_queued = false;

        if (dirty_upd_count > 0 ||
            dirty_add_count > 0 ||
            dirty_eat_count > 0 ||
            dirty_del_count > 0 ||
            player->compacted_drop_count > 0) {
#ifdef _WIN32
          QueryPerformanceCounter(&sp_t0);
#endif

          if (dirty_add_count > 0 ||
              dirty_eat_count > 0 ||
              dirty_del_count > 0 ||
              player->compacted_drop_count > 0) {
            /* Full packet format */
            pkt_update_nodes_full(
                &w,
                player,
                add_list,
                dirty_add_count,
                upd_list,
                dirty_upd_count,
                eat_list,
                dirty_eat_count,
                del_list,
                dirty_del_count,
                player->compacted_drop_ids,
                player->compacted_drop_count,
                srv);
#ifdef _WIN32
            sp_full_packets++;
#endif
          } else {
            /* Updates only — lightweight format */
            pkt_update_nodes_updates_only(&w, player, upd_list,
                                          dirty_upd_count, srv);
#ifdef _WIN32
            sp_updates_only_packets++;
#endif
          }

#ifdef _WIN32
          QueryPerformanceCounter(&sp_t1);
          sp_build_updates_only_us +=
              (double)(sp_t1.QuadPart - sp_t0.QuadPart) / prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
#endif

          static uint8_t lz4buf_dirty[131072];
          dirty_queued = server_queue_active_update(
              srv, player, &w,
              lz4buf_dirty, sizeof(lz4buf_dirty));

#ifdef _WIN32
          if (dirty_queued) {
            size_t raw_len = bw_length(&w);
            sp_raw_bytes += raw_len;
            sp_raw_packets++;
          }
#endif
        }

        /*
         * ── COMMIT or ROLLBACK ──
         */
        if (dirty_queued) {
          /* SUCCESS: compact client_nodes (remove vs==3 entries) */
          int write_idx = 0;
          for (int ri = 0;
               ri < player->client_count;
               ri++) {
            Cell *rc =
                player->client_nodes[ri];

            if (!rc) {
              /* NULL entries already handled by prune —
               * old protocol ID was queued pre-transaction. */
              continue;
            }

            ptrdiff_t rslot =
                rc - srv->cells;

            if (rslot < 0 ||
                rslot >= MAX_CELLS) {
              continue;
            }

            if (vs_get(player->view_state,
                       (int)rslot) == 3) {
              /* Finalize removal */
              vs_set(player->view_state,
                     (int)rslot, 0);
              continue;
            }

            player->client_nodes[write_idx] =
                rc;
            player->client_handles[write_idx] =
                player->client_handles[ri];
            write_idx++;
          }

          player->client_count = write_idx;

          /* Append accepted ADDs — MUST succeed since
           * capacity was reserved pre-queue. */
          for (int ai = 0;
               ai < dirty_add_count;
               ai++) {
            if (!view_track_append(
                    player->client_nodes,
                    player->client_handles,
                    &player->client_count,
                    player->client_capacity,
                    player->view_state,
                    srv->cells,
                    MAX_CELLS,
                    add_list[ai].cell)) {
              /* Client received ADD but server lost
               * tracking — kick to prevent ghost. */
              net_kick_connection(
                  player->conn_id,
                  "active view tracking commit "
                  "invariant failure");
              goto player_post_diff;
            }
          }

          /* Clear compacted drops only after success */
          player->compacted_drop_count = 0;

          player_refresh_tracking_metadata(
              player);

        } else {
          /* FAILURE: any queue failure requests reconciliation. */

          /* Rollback vs=3 marks to vs=1 if any departures
           * were planned. */
          if (deferred_remove_count > 0) {
            for (int ri = 0;
                 ri < player->client_count;
                 ri++) {
              Cell *rc =
                  player->client_nodes[ri];

              if (!rc) continue;

              ptrdiff_t rslot =
                  rc - srv->cells;

              if (rslot < 0 ||
                  rslot >= MAX_CELLS) {
                continue;
              }

              if (vs_get(player->view_state,
                         (int)rslot) == 3) {
                vs_set(player->view_state,
                       (int)rslot, 1);
              }
            }
          }

          player->force_full_diff_next_tick =
              true;
        }

#ifdef _WIN32
        QueryPerformanceCounter(&sp_outer_t1);
        sp_dirty_us += (double)(sp_outer_t1.QuadPart - sp_outer_t0.QuadPart) /
                       prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
        sp_dirty++;
#endif
        /* Leaderboard + ghost + flush still needed */
        goto player_post_diff;
      }
    }

  full_diff:
    /* NOTE: force_full_diff_next_tick is cleared only after a
     * successful queue + tracking commit (amendment #7). */
#ifdef _WIN32
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&sp_outer_t0);
#endif
    /* Phase 2: Macro-Architecture Grid Visibility Cache (O(1) Bucket Map) */
    int vis_count = 0;

    /*
     * FULL-MAP SPECTATE SELECTION
     *
     * Priority:
     *   1. Every available player cell.
     *   2. Viruses and potion cells.
     *   3. Other dynamic objects, while reserving food context.
     *   4. A stable subset of food cells.
     *
     * The complete map can contain more food than MAX_VIEW_NODES. Sending
     * every food cell would enlarge buffers for every connection and create
     * enormous initial packets. Full-map spectate is intended primarily for
     * observing players and combat; the food subset provides spatial context.
     */


    /* ── DIRECT QUERY PATH (v1.2.18) ──
     * No legacy visibility-bucket cache — query quadtree and food grid directly every tick.
     * The previous visibility-bucket cache had a 4096-cell cap per grid tile. Under 700+ bots,
     * tiles overflowed and the fallback produced non-deterministic subsets,
     * causing cells to flicker (deleted one tick, re-added the next).
     * Direct queries are O(log N) per cell and fully deterministic. */
    {
      /* Add padding (1600.0 units) so fast splits (780 u/tick) and pop explosions
       * never cross outside the viewbox threshold, eliminating 1-tick view drops. */
      Rect padded_vb = player->viewbox;
      padded_vb.minx -= srv->config.viewport_hysteresis_padding;
      padded_vb.miny -= srv->config.viewport_hysteresis_padding;
      padded_vb.maxx += srv->config.viewport_hysteresis_padding;
      padded_vb.maxy += srv->config.viewport_hysteresis_padding;

      /* Query up to SPEC_QUERY_CAP cells (MAX_VIEW_NODES + 4096), quickselect if over MAX_VIEW_NODES.
       * Eliminates memory cache thrashing from 65K arrays and avoids sorting. */
      static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *query_visible[FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES];

      vis_count =
          bot_grid_query(
              &srv->bot_grid,
              padded_vb,
              query_visible,
              FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES);

      vis_count =
          fg_query_from(
              &srv->food_grid,
              padded_vb,
              query_visible,
              vis_count,
              FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES);

      /* Filter out removed cells and cells outside the map border */
      int write = 0;
      for (int r = 0; r < vis_count; r++) {
        if (query_visible[r]->is_removed)
          continue;
        Vec2 p = query_visible[r]->position;
        if (p.x >= srv->border.minx && p.x <= srv->border.maxx &&
            p.y >= srv->border.miny && p.y <= srv->border.maxy) {
          query_visible[write++] = query_visible[r];
        }
      }
      vis_count = write;

      /* If the query exceeded capacity, use fast O(N) linear-time quickselect
       * to keep the highest priority cells (owner cells > player cells > center distance)
       * without the massive overhead of a full qsort. */
      if (vis_count > FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES) {
        quickselect_cells_by_dist(
            query_visible,
            vis_count,
            FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES,
            player->id,
            player->center);

        vis_count =
            FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES;
      }
      memcpy(visible, query_visible, vis_count * sizeof(Cell *));
    }
    /* Force all player's own cells to be visible even if outside viewbox.
     * Use a local bitset marker for O(1) dedup to absolutely prevent
     * cross-thread/tick contamination from other players writing to the global
     * 'visible_tick' struct. */

    /* PERF: generation counter instead of 128KB memset per player per tick.
     * At 700 bots doing full_diff: eliminates 700 × 128KB = 89.6MB/tick
     * of pure memory zeroing that was trashing L1/L2 caches.
     *
     * NOTE: vm_gen/vm_counter are reused by the transactional diff below
     * to identify visible cells without mutating view_state. */
    ;  /* empty statement after label (C requirement) */
    static uint32_t vm_gen[MAX_CELLS];
    static uint32_t vm_counter = 0;
    vm_counter++;
    if (vm_counter == 0) {
      memset(vm_gen, 0, sizeof(vm_gen));
      vm_counter = 1;
    }

    for (int v = 0; v < vis_count; v++) {
      int idx = (int)(visible[v] - srv->cells);
      if (idx >= 0 && idx < MAX_CELLS) {
        vm_gen[idx] = vm_counter;
      }
    }

    for (int c = 0; c < player->cell_count; c++) {
      if (vis_count >= MAX_VIEW_NODES)
        break;
      Cell *pcell = player->cells[c];
      if (pcell->is_removed)
        continue;

      int idx = (int)(pcell - srv->cells);
      if (idx >= 0 && idx < MAX_CELLS && vm_gen[idx] != vm_counter) {
        vm_gen[idx] = vm_counter;
        visible[vis_count++] = pcell;
      }
    }

    /*
     * TRANSACTIONAL FULL DIFF (v1.2.47 — ghost cell fix)
     *
     * Use vm_gen[] (already populated above) as the "visible this tick"
     * marker instead of mutating view_state to 2.  Build the complete
     * ADD/UPDATE/EAT/DELETE diff, construct a local new_tracking[]
     * snapshot, queue the packet (checked), then atomically commit.
     */
    int add_count = 0;
    int upd_count = 0;
    int eat_count = 0;
    int del_count = 0;

    /* Build exact old-tracking generation marker from client_nodes.
     * This ensures the "known" classification matches the exact
     * tracking set, not view_state which may have orphan bits.
     * Also store cell IDs to detect recycled slots — a freed cell
     * reused at the same array index must be treated as ADD (with
     * color), not UPDATE (without color). */
    static uint32_t old_gen[MAX_CELLS];
    static uint32_t old_gen_id[MAX_CELLS];  /* cell ID at time of tracking */
    static uint32_t old_gen_counter = 0;
    old_gen_counter++;
    if (old_gen_counter == 0) {
      memset(old_gen, 0, sizeof(old_gen));
      old_gen_counter = 1;
    }

    for (int ci = 0; ci < player->client_count; ci++) {
      Cell *cc = player->client_nodes[ci];
      if (!cc) continue;
      int cidx = (int)(cc - srv->cells);
      if (cidx >= 0 && cidx < MAX_CELLS) {
        old_gen[cidx] = old_gen_counter;
        old_gen_id[cidx] = cc->id;
      }
    }

    /* Step 1: Classify visible cells using exact old tracking */
    for (int vi = 0; vi < vis_count; vi++) {
      Cell *vc = visible[vi];
      if (vc->is_removed)
        continue;

      int cell_idx = (int)(vc - srv->cells);
      if (cell_idx < 0 || cell_idx >= MAX_CELLS)
        continue;

      if (old_gen[cell_idx] == old_gen_counter &&
          old_gen_id[cell_idx] == vc->id) {
        /* Same cell still tracked → Update (no color needed, client has it) */
        if ((vc->type != CELL_FOOD && (vc->is_moving || vc->type == CELL_PLAYER)) ||
            (vc->last_evt_tick == srv->ticks)) {
          if (upd_count < MAX_VIEW_NODES) {
            upd_list[upd_count++] = vc;
          }
        }
      } else {
        /* Not in client_nodes -> Add */
        add_list[add_count].cell = vc;
        add_list[add_count].name =
            (vc->type == CELL_PLAYER && vc->owner_id >= 0)
                ? srv->players[vc->owner_id].name
                : NULL;
        add_list[add_count].skin =
            (vc->type == CELL_PLAYER && vc->owner_id >= 0)
                ? srv->players[vc->owner_id].skin
                : NULL;
        if (vc->type == CELL_POTION)
          add_list[add_count].name = POTION_CELL_NAME;
        add_count++;
      }
      /* NOTE: DO NOT set view_state here — read-only phase */
    }

    /* Step 2: Find DELETEs by sweeping client_nodes (READ-ONLY).
     * Build new_tracking[] from kept cells. */
    static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *new_tracking[MAX_VIEW_NODES];
    int new_count = 0;

    for (int ci = 0; ci < player->client_count; ci++) {
      Cell *cc = player->client_nodes[ci];
      if (!cc) continue;

      int cell_idx = (int)(cc - srv->cells);
      if (cell_idx < 0 || cell_idx >= MAX_CELLS) continue;

      if (vm_gen[cell_idx] == vm_counter) {
        /* Still visible → keep */
        if (new_count < MAX_VIEW_NODES)
          new_tracking[new_count++] = cc;
      } else {
        /* No longer in view → Removed */
        if (cc->is_removed &&
            cc->killer_id != 0) {
          eat_list[eat_count++] = cc;
        } else {
          del_list[del_count++] = cc;
        }
      }
    }

    /* Step 3: Filter ADDs by budget and capacity, append to new_tracking */
    int original_add_count = add_count;
    add_count = 0;

    /*
     * Existing tracked cells continue receiving immediate UPDATE/EAT/DELETE
     * records. Only previously unknown ADD records are progressively bounded.
     *
     * Camera packets are still sent every tick, so this does not recreate the
     * old frozen baseline/cut-scene state machine.
     */
    int add_budget =
        MAX_VIEW_NODES;

    /* Reserve capacity for kept + adds */
    int projected = new_count + original_add_count;
    if (projected > MAX_VIEW_NODES)
      projected = MAX_VIEW_NODES;

    if (player_ensure_client_capacity(
            player, projected > 0 ? projected : 1) < 0) {
      /* Capacity failure — drop all ADDs */
      original_add_count = 0;
    }

    for (int ai = 0;
         ai < original_add_count;
         ai++) {
      if (add_count >= add_budget ||
          new_count >= MAX_VIEW_NODES ||
          new_count >= player->client_capacity) {
        break;
      }

      AddNodeInfo candidate =
          add_list[ai];

      if (!candidate.cell)
        continue;

      new_tracking[new_count++] =
          candidate.cell;

      add_list[add_count++] =
          candidate;
    }


    /* Step 4: Build packet */
#ifdef _WIN32
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&sp_t0);
#endif

    pkt_update_nodes_full(&w, player, add_list, add_count, upd_list, upd_count,
                          eat_list, eat_count, del_list, del_count,
                          player->compacted_drop_ids,
                          player->compacted_drop_count,
                          srv);

#ifdef _WIN32
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&sp_t1);
    sp_build_full_us +=
        (double)(sp_t1.QuadPart - sp_t0.QuadPart) / prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
    sp_full_packets++;
#endif

    /* DIAGNOSTIC: Log per-tick summary with scrambled IDs */
#if NET_DEBUG_LOGS
    if (eat_count > 0 || del_count > 0) {
      DBGLOG("[SRV-PKT] P%d tick=%u add=%d upd=%d eat=%d del=%d scr=%u\n",
             player->id, srv->ticks, add_count, upd_count, eat_count, del_count,
             player->scramble_id);
      for (int i = 0; i < eat_count; i++) {
        DBGLOG("[SRV-EAT] rawID=%u scrID=%u type=%d killer=%u\n",
               eat_list[i]->id, eat_list[i]->id ^ player->scramble_id,
               eat_list[i]->type, eat_list[i]->killer_id);
      }
      for (int i = 0; i < del_count; i++) {
        DBGLOG("[SRV-DEL] rawID=%u scrID=%u type=%d\n", del_list[i]->id,
               del_list[i]->id ^ player->scramble_id, del_list[i]->type);
      }
    }
#endif

    /* Step 5: Queue with checked helper */
    static uint8_t
        lz4buf_full[131072];

    bool full_queued =
        server_queue_active_update(
            srv,
            player,
            &w,
            lz4buf_full,
            sizeof(lz4buf_full));

#ifdef _WIN32
    {
      size_t raw_len = bw_length(&w);
      sp_raw_bytes += raw_len;
      sp_raw_packets++;
    }
#endif

    /* Step 6: COMMIT or preserve old state */
    if (!full_queued) {
      /* Queue failure: preserve all state, retry next tick */
      player->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
    } else if (player_replace_view_tracking(
                   player,
                   new_tracking,
                   new_count,
                   srv->cells,
                   MAX_CELLS) < 0) {
      /* Post-queue commit failure: client received the
       * packet but server cannot record what it sent.
       * Kick to prevent client/server state divergence. */
      net_kick_connection(
          player->conn_id,
          "active full-diff tracking commit failure");

      goto player_post_diff;
    } else {
      player->force_full_diff_next_tick = false;

      /* Clear compacted drops only after success */
      player->compacted_drop_count = 0;

      /* Update camera anchors only after success */
      player->prev_center = player->center;
      player->prev_scale = player->scale;
    }

#ifdef _WIN32
    QueryPerformanceCounter(&sp_outer_t1);
    sp_diff_us += (double)(sp_outer_t1.QuadPart - sp_outer_t0.QuadPart) /
                  prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
    sp_diff++;
#endif

  player_post_diff:
    /* === Below here runs for BOTH full diff and camera-skip paths === */
    player->tick_leaderboard++;
    int lb_interval = server_aux_lb_interval(srv, player);
    /* PERF: Local bots skip leaderboard + ghost cells entirely */
    if (!player->is_local && player->tick_leaderboard >= lb_interval) {
      player->tick_leaderboard = 0;

      bool must_send_lb =
          srv->lb_dirty || player->place != player->last_lb_place_sent ||
          (srv->ticks - player->last_lb_send_tick) >= (uint32_t)lb_interval;

      if (must_send_lb && lb_pkt_len > 0) {
        /* Patch isMe for this player, send, unpatch */
        int my_lb_idx = -1;
        for (int li = 0; li < lb_cached_count; li++) {
          if (lb_player_ids[li] == player->id) {
            my_lb_idx = li;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (my_lb_idx >= 0) {
          uint32_t one = 1;
          memcpy(lb_pkt + lb_isMe_offsets[my_lb_idx], &one, 4);
        }
        net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, lb_pkt, lb_pkt_len);
        if (my_lb_idx >= 0) {
          uint32_t zero = 0;
          memcpy(lb_pkt + lb_isMe_offsets[my_lb_idx], &zero, 4);
        }
        player->last_lb_place_sent = player->place;
        player->last_lb_send_tick = srv->ticks;
      }

      uint32_t ghost_interval = (uint32_t)server_aux_ghost_interval(srv);
      uint32_t mass_bucket =
          (uint32_t)(player->score / 250.0); /* coarse bucket */

      bool send_ghost =
          srv->lb_dirty || mass_bucket != player->last_ghost_mass_bucket ||
          (srv->ticks - player->last_ghost_send_tick) >= ghost_interval;

      if (send_ghost) {
        GhostCell filtered[20];
        int filt_count = 0;
        double my_mass = player->score;

        for (int li = 0; li < lb_all_count && filt_count < 20; li++) {
          if (lb_all_ghosts[li].mass <= (uint32_t)my_mass && my_mass > 0)
            continue;
          filtered[filt_count++] = lb_all_ghosts[li];
        }

        pkt_ghost_cells(&w, filtered, filt_count);
        net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));

        player->last_ghost_send_tick = srv->ticks;
        player->last_ghost_mass_bucket = mass_bucket;
      }
    }

    /* Player just died this tick */
    if (player->prev_cell_count > 0 && player->cell_count == 0) {
      /* ── Flush stale play-session viewport ──
       * Send delete packets for ALL cells the client was tracking during
       * gameplay. Without this, the client retains ghost entities (food,
       * viruses, player cells) from the old viewport location. */
      if (player->client_count > 0 ||
          player->compacted_drop_count > 0) {
        int flush_count =
            player->client_count;

        if (flush_count >
            player->client_capacity) {
          flush_count =
              player->client_capacity;
        }

        pkt_update_nodes_full(
            &w,
            player,
            NULL,
            0,
            NULL,
            0,
            NULL,
            0,
            player->client_nodes,
            flush_count,
            player->compacted_drop_ids,
            player->compacted_drop_count,
            srv);

        net_queue_to_player(
            player->conn_id,
            bw_data(&w),
            bw_length(&w));
      }

      player_clear_view_tracking(
          player);

      /* Remove from active/simulation list */
      server_remove_active_player(srv, player->id);

      /* PERF: Local bots skip all death ceremony (ghost cells, PlayerDB,
       * potions, protobuf game over, stats chat). They only need the
       * cell deletion above to detect death and respawn. */
      if (player->is_local) {
        player->prev_cell_count = 0;
        player->ghost_cell_count = 0;
        goto player_death_done;
      }

      /* Ghost cells: send death visual (opcode 0x45) */
      if (player->ghost_cell_count > 0) {
        INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Sent %d ghost cells\n", player->id,
                 player->ghost_cell_count);
        pkt_ghost_cells(&w, player->ghost_cells, player->ghost_cell_count);
        net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));

        /* Send opcode 102 Game Over with full protobuf data */
        uint32_t alive_secs =
            (srv->ticks - player->spawn_tick) / 25; /* 25 ticks/sec */
        uint32_t lb_secs = player->time_on_lb / 25;

        /* Update persistent player database FIRST (so rec has latest stats) */
        if (player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
          playerdb_update(&srv->player_db, player->uid, player->session_xp,
                          player->highest_mass, player->food_eaten,
                          player->players_eaten, alive_secs,
                          player->mass_consumed, player->name);
        }

        /* Award a potion based on performance. A non-negative return value
         * is the exact newly occupied slot; -2 means the player qualified but
         * all official potion slots were already occupied. */
        int potion_award_result = potion_award(player, srv);

        /* Build session stats for protobuf */
        GameSessionStats102 session_stats = {
            .mass_consumed = player->mass_consumed,
            .time_total = alive_secs,
            .time_in_leaderboard = lb_secs,
            .top_position =
                (uint32_t)(player->top_position > 0 ? player->top_position
                                                    : 999),
            .final_position = (uint32_t)player->place,
            .longest_time_alive = alive_secs,
            .final_mass = 0,
            .highest_mass = player->highest_mass,
            .normal_cells_eaten = player->cells_eaten,
            .food_eaten = player->food_eaten,
            .viruses_eaten = player->viruses_eaten,
            .players_eaten = player->players_eaten,
        };

        /* Build the exact newly awarded potion info. Earned potions enter
         * status 1 (obtained/unbrewed); brewing starts only after type 122. */
        const char *new_potion_id = NULL;
        int new_potion_slot = 0;
        uint32_t new_potion_secs = 0;
        bool would_have_won_potion = potion_award_result == -2;
        if (potion_award_result >= 0 && potion_award_result < MAX_POTIONS) {
          int pi = potion_award_result;
          new_potion_slot = pi + 1;
          switch (player->potions[pi].rarity) {
          case POTION_COMMON:
            new_potion_id = "mystery_potion_common";
            break;
          case POTION_UNCOMMON:
            new_potion_id = "mystery_potion_uncommon";
            break;
          case POTION_EXOTIC:
            new_potion_id = "mystery_potion_exotic";
            break;
          case POTION_LEGENDARY:
            new_potion_id = "mystery_potion_legendary";
            break;
          default:
            new_potion_id = NULL;
            break;
          }
        }

        /* Send full protobuf Game Over */
        PlayerRecord *rec = NULL;
        if (player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
          rec = player->cached_rec;
          if (!rec) {
            rec = playerdb_lookup(&srv->player_db, player->uid);
            player->cached_rec = rec;
          }
        }
        if (rec) {
          EconomyTransaction quest_rewards;
          economy_transaction_init(&quest_rewards);

          /* Advance the authoritative mass-consumed quest using only mass
           * earned after this session's activation/login checkpoint. */
          uint64_t quest_now = (uint64_t)time(NULL);
          bool quest_changed = false;
          if (rec->active_quest[0]) {
            if (rec->active_quest_until <= quest_now) {
              rec->active_quest[0] = '\0';
              rec->active_quest_until = 0;
              rec->quest_goal = 0;
              rec->quest_progress = 0;
              quest_changed = true;
            } else if (strcmp(rec->active_quest,
                              "quest_activation_24h") == 0 &&
                       rec->quest_goal > 0) {
              uint32_t session_mass =
                  player->mass_consumed >= player->quest_session_start_mass
                      ? player->mass_consumed -
                            player->quest_session_start_mass
                      : player->mass_consumed;
              uint32_t remaining = rec->quest_progress >= rec->quest_goal
                                       ? 0
                                       : rec->quest_goal - rec->quest_progress;
              uint32_t applied = session_mass > remaining ? remaining
                                                           : session_mass;
              rec->quest_progress += applied;
              quest_changed = applied > 0;
              if (rec->quest_progress >= rec->quest_goal) {
                rec->coins = UINT32_MAX - rec->coins <
                                     ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_COINS
                                 ? UINT32_MAX
                                 : rec->coins + ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_COINS;
                rec->dna = UINT32_MAX - rec->dna < ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_DNA
                               ? UINT32_MAX
                               : rec->dna + ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_DNA;
                economy_transaction_add(
                    &quest_rewards, 1, "coin", rec->coins,
                    (int32_t)ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_COINS);
                economy_transaction_add(
                    &quest_rewards, 1, "dna", rec->dna,
                    (int32_t)ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_DNA);
                if (rec->quests_completed < UINT32_MAX)
                  rec->quests_completed++;
                rec->active_quest[0] = '\0';
                rec->active_quest_until = 0;
                rec->quest_goal = 0;
                rec->quest_progress = 0;
                quest_changed = true;
                INFO_LOG(
                    "[Quest] Player %d completed mass quest: +%u coins, "
                    "+%u DNA\n",
                    player->id, ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_COINS,
                    ECONOMY_QUEST_REWARD_DNA);
              }
            }
          }
          if (quest_changed)
            playerdb_mark_dirty(&srv->player_db, rec);

          bw_reset(&w);
          pkt_102_game_over_full(&w, player, rec, &session_stats,
                                 new_potion_slot, 1, /* status=obtained */
                                 new_potion_secs, new_potion_id,
                                 would_have_won_potion, &quest_rewards);
          net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));

          /* Send wallet update (sub-op 75) */
          bw_reset(&w);
          pkt_102_wallet_update(&w, rec->coins, rec->dna);
          net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
        } else {
          /* Fallback: simple game over for non-authenticated players */
          bw_reset(&w);
          pkt_102_game_over(&w);
          net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
        }

        /* Send session stats as chat message (fallback for non-native UI) */
        char stats_msg[256];
        snprintf(stats_msg, sizeof(stats_msg),
                 "Time: %us | Mass: %u | Food: %u | Players: %u | "
                 "Viruses: %u | Top #%d | LB: %us",
                 alive_secs, player->highest_mass, player->food_eaten,
                 player->players_eaten, player->viruses_eaten,
                 player->top_position > 0 ? player->top_position : 999,
                 lb_secs);
        Color stat_color = {0xFF, 0xD7, 0x00}; /* Gold */
        pkt_chat_message(&w, "STATS", stat_color, 0x80, stats_msg);
        net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));

      } /* end ghost_cell_count > 0 */

      player->prev_cell_count = 0;
      player->ghost_cell_count = 0;
    } /* end player just died */

  player_death_done:
    /* Ping: send pre-built packet (skip for local bots) */
    if (send_ping && !player->is_local) {
      net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, ping_pkt, ping_len);
    }

    /* (dirty list is cleared once after all players are processed) */

    /*
     * Arm this connection for EPOLLOUT. No socket write and no wait occurs in
     * the simulation phase.
     */
    net_flush_player(player->conn_id);
  }
  /* Clear one-shot name refresh flags */
  { /* Clamp to array bounds in case counter somehow exceeded capacity */
    uint32_t dc = g_dirty_count;
    if (dc > MAX_DIRTY_CELLS) dc = MAX_DIRTY_CELLS;
    for (uint32_t d = 0; d < dc; d++) {
      if (g_dirty_cells[d])
        g_dirty_cells[d]->needs_name_refresh = false;
    }
  }
  /* Reset dirty list — all players have been processed */
  g_dirty_count = 0;

  /* Flush sub-phase profiling to globals */
#ifdef _WIN32
  prof_send_dirty += sp_dirty_us;
  prof_send_diff += sp_diff_us;

  prof_send_build_full += sp_build_full_us;
  prof_send_build_updates_only += sp_build_updates_only_us;
  prof_send_lz4 += sp_lz4_us;
  prof_send_queue += sp_queue_us;

  prof_send_raw_bytes += sp_raw_bytes;
  prof_send_comp_bytes += sp_comp_bytes;

  prof_send_full_packets += sp_full_packets;
  prof_send_updates_only_packets += sp_updates_only_packets;
  prof_send_lz4_packets += sp_lz4_packets;
  prof_send_raw_packets += sp_raw_packets;

  prof_skip_count += sp_skip;
  prof_dirty_count += sp_dirty;
  prof_diff_count += sp_diff;
#endif

  /*
   * World Spectators were processed in the ordinary connected-player loop.
   *
   * They already received:
   * - camera packets;
   * - transactional UpdateNodes packets;
   * - LZ4 when beneficial;
   * - leaderboard/ghost/ping packets;
   * - one final net_flush_player().
   *
   * Do not invoke the legacy shared World Stream or send duplicate auxiliary
   * packets here.
   */

  bw_free(&w);
}

/* ── Potion system helpers ──────────────────────────────────── */

/* potion_rarity_name and potion_brew_duration are now inline in player.h */

static Color potion_rarity_color(PotionRarity r) {
  switch (r) {
  case POTION_COMMON:
    return (Color){0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA}; /* gray */
  case POTION_UNCOMMON:
    return (Color){0x00, 0xCC, 0x44}; /* green */
  case POTION_EXOTIC:
    return (Color){0xAA, 0x44, 0xFF}; /* purple */
  case POTION_LEGENDARY:
    return (Color){0xFF, 0xD7, 0x00}; /* gold */
  default:
    return (Color){0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF};
  }
}

/* Award a potion to a player based on performance at death.
 * Returns slot index on success, -1 when no potion was earned, and -2 when
 * the player earned one but all official potion slots were occupied. */
static int potion_award(Player *player, GameServer *srv) {
  if (player->conn_id < 0)
    return -1;

  uint32_t alive_secs = (srv->ticks - player->spawn_tick) / 25;
  uint32_t mass = player->highest_mass;

  /* Must survive at least 30 seconds for a potion. */
  if (alive_secs < 30)
    return -1;

  PotionRarity rarity;
  int roll = rand() % 100;
  if (player->top_position > 0 && player->top_position <= 10 &&
      player->players_eaten > 0) {
    rarity = POTION_LEGENDARY;
  } else if (alive_secs >= 600 || mass >= 5000) {
    if (roll < 40)
      rarity = POTION_EXOTIC;
    else if (roll < 80)
      rarity = POTION_LEGENDARY;
    else
      rarity = POTION_UNCOMMON;
  } else if (alive_secs >= 120 || mass >= 500) {
    if (roll < 50)
      rarity = POTION_UNCOMMON;
    else if (roll < 90)
      rarity = POTION_EXOTIC;
    else
      rarity = POTION_LEGENDARY;
  } else {
    rarity = roll < 70 ? POTION_COMMON : POTION_UNCOMMON;
  }

  int slot = -1;
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_POTIONS; i++) {
    if (player->potions[i].rarity == POTION_NONE) {
      slot = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (slot < 0) {
    INFO_LOG("[Potion] Player %d qualified for %s but all slots are full\n",
             player->id, potion_rarity_name(rarity));
    return -2;
  }

  Potion *p = &player->potions[slot];
  p->rarity = rarity;
  p->brew_start_tick = 0; /* official status 1: obtained, not brewing */
  p->brew_duration = potion_brew_duration(rarity);
  p->ready = false;
  if (player->potion_count < MAX_POTIONS)
    player->potion_count++;

  if (player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
    PlayerRecord *rec = player->cached_rec;
    if (!rec) {
      rec = playerdb_lookup(&srv->player_db, player->uid);
      player->cached_rec = rec;
    }
    if (rec) {
      economy_store_potion_slots(player, rec, srv->ticks,
                                 (uint64_t)time(NULL));
      playerdb_mark_dirty(&srv->player_db, rec);
    }
  }

  BinaryWriter w;
  bw_init(&w);
  char msg[128];
  snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "Earned a %s Potion! Ready to brew.",
           potion_rarity_name(rarity));
  pkt_chat_message(&w, "POTION", potion_rarity_color(rarity), 0x80, msg);
  net_send_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
  bw_free(&w);

  INFO_LOG("[Potion] Player %d earned %s potion (slot %d, obtained)\n",
           player->id, potion_rarity_name(rarity), slot);
  return slot;
}

/* Open a brewed potion and award rewards */
void potion_open(Player *player, Potion *potion, GameServer *srv) {
  if (!player || !potion || !srv || potion->rarity == POTION_NONE ||
      !potion->ready)
    return;

  PotionRarity opened_rarity = potion->rarity;
  uint32_t coins = 0, dna = 0;
  double xp_bonus = 0.0;

  switch (opened_rarity) {
  case POTION_COMMON:
    coins = 10 + (uint32_t)(rand() % 21);
    xp_bonus = 0.05;
    break;
  case POTION_UNCOMMON:
    coins = 30 + (uint32_t)(rand() % 51);
    dna = 1;
    xp_bonus = 0.10;
    break;
  case POTION_EXOTIC:
    coins = 80 + (uint32_t)(rand() % 121);
    dna = 2 + (uint32_t)(rand() % 2);
    xp_bonus = 0.15;
    break;
  case POTION_LEGENDARY:
    coins = 200 + (uint32_t)(rand() % 701);
    dna = 5 + (uint32_t)(rand() % 6);
    xp_bonus = 0.25;
    break;
  default:
    return;
  }

  PlayerRecord *rec = player->cached_rec;
  if (!rec && player_profile_is_persistent(player)) {
    rec = playerdb_lookup(&srv->player_db, player->uid);
    player->cached_rec = rec;
  }
  if (!rec)
    return;

  /* Legendary potion grants one 1-hour boost before the response is built. */
  if (opened_rarity == POTION_LEGENDARY) {
    int boost_is_xp = rand() % 2;
    int boost_idx = (rand() % 2) ? 2 : 0;
    prec_boost_add(rec, boost_is_xp, boost_idx, 1);
  }

  player->coins_session += coins;
  player->xp_boost += xp_bonus;
  rec->coins = UINT32_MAX - rec->coins < coins
                   ? UINT32_MAX
                   : rec->coins + coins;
  rec->dna = UINT32_MAX - rec->dna < dna ? UINT32_MAX : rec->dna + dna;
  rec->potions_opened++;

  /* Clear first so the type-125 response contains the authoritative post-open
   * slot state, not the potion that has already been consumed. */
  potion->rarity = POTION_NONE;
  potion->brew_start_tick = 0;
  potion->brew_duration = 0;
  potion->ready = false;
  if (player->potion_count > 0)
    player->potion_count--;
  economy_store_potion_slots(player, rec, srv->ticks, (uint64_t)time(NULL));
  playerdb_mark_dirty(&srv->player_db, rec);

  BinaryWriter w;
  bw_init(&w);
  char msg[128];
  if (dna > 0) {
    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%s Potion! +%u coins, +%u DNA, +%.0f%% XP",
             potion_rarity_name(opened_rarity), coins, dna, xp_bonus * 100);
  } else {
    snprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), "%s Potion! +%u coins, +%.0f%% XP",
             potion_rarity_name(opened_rarity), coins, xp_bonus * 100);
  }
  pkt_chat_message(&w, "POTION", potion_rarity_color(opened_rarity), 0x80,
                   msg);
  net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));

  bw_reset(&w);
  pkt_102_open_potion_response(&w, player, srv->ticks, 1,
                               rec->coins, rec->dna, coins, dna);
  net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));

  bw_reset(&w);
  pkt_102_wallet_update(&w, rec->coins, rec->dna);
  net_queue_to_player(player->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
  net_flush_player(player->conn_id);
  bw_free(&w);

  INFO_LOG("[Potion] Player %d opened %s: +%u coins, +%u DNA\n",
           player->id, potion_rarity_name(opened_rarity), coins, dna);
}

/* Per-tick: check all connected players' potions for brew completion */
static void potion_tick(GameServer *srv) {
  uint64_t now_unix = (uint64_t)time(NULL);
  for (int ci = 0; ci < srv->connected_count; ci++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[ci]];
    if (!p->active || p->is_removed || p->conn_id < 0)
      continue;

    PlayerRecord *rec = p->cached_rec;
    if (!rec && player_profile_is_persistent(p)) {
      rec = playerdb_lookup(&srv->player_db, p->uid);
      p->cached_rec = rec;
    }
    if (rec) {
      double old_mass = p->mass_boost;
      double old_xp = p->xp_boost;
      economy_refresh_expirations(p, rec, now_unix);
      if (old_mass != p->mass_boost || old_xp != p->xp_boost)
        playerdb_mark_dirty(&srv->player_db, rec);
    }

    bool potion_state_changed = false;
    for (int slot = 0; slot < MAX_POTIONS; slot++) {
      Potion *pot = &p->potions[slot];
      if (pot->rarity == POTION_NONE || pot->ready ||
          pot->brew_start_tick == 0)
        continue;
      if (srv->ticks - pot->brew_start_tick >= pot->brew_duration) {
        pot->ready = true;
        potion_state_changed = true;
      }
    }

    if (potion_state_changed && rec) {
      economy_store_potion_slots(p, rec, srv->ticks, now_unix);
      playerdb_mark_dirty(&srv->player_db, rec);

      /* Brewing completion only changes status to READY. Opening remains an
       * explicit type-124 action, matching the real client flow. */
      BinaryWriter w;
      bw_init(&w);
      pkt_102_brew_potion_response(&w, p, srv->ticks, 1);
      net_send_to_player(p->conn_id, bw_data(&w), bw_length(&w));
      bw_free(&w);
    }
  }
}

/* ── Per-phase tick profiling ──────────────────────────────────── */

#ifdef __linux__
static inline double ts_diff_us(struct timespec *a, struct timespec *b) {
  return (double)(b->tv_sec - a->tv_sec) * 1e6 +
         (double)(b->tv_nsec - a->tv_nsec) / 1e3;
}
#endif
GameServerProfileStats g_prof_stats;
static double prof_bot_ai, prof_move, prof_coll, prof_send, prof_flush;
/* prof_send_dirty and prof_send_diff already declared at line ~2231.
 * prof_send_pkt was unused, removed. */
static int prof_n;
static uint64_t prof_human_players_sum, prof_bots_sum, prof_bots_alive_sum, prof_cells_sum, prof_live_cells_sum;
static int prof_skip_count, prof_dirty_count, prof_diff_count;
#ifdef _WIN32
static double prof_qpc_freq = 0;
#endif

/* ── Main tick ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void server_tick(GameServer *srv) {
  s_prof_srv = srv;  /* for server_print_profile() */
  srv->ticks++;
  srv->step_datetime = server_time_ms();
  srv->removed_this_tick_count = 0;
  srv->spawned_this_tick_count = 0;
  srv->spec_compacted_drop_count = 0;

  /* LW border enforcement: if the border drifts from mapscaler's current_size
   * (stale build, memory corruption, etc.), force it back every tick.
   * Only enforce during PHASE_NORMAL (not during active transitions). */
  if (srv->map_scaler.enabled && srv->map_scaler.phase == PHASE_NORMAL) {
    double expected = srv->map_scaler.current_size;
    double actual = srv->border.width;
    if (fabs(actual - expected) > 1.0) {
      async_log(
          "[MapScaler] BORDER MISMATCH: actual=%.0f expected=%.0f, forcing\n",
          actual, expected);
      set_border_from_size(srv, expected);
    }
  }

#ifdef __linux__
  struct timespec t0, t1, t2, t3, t4, t5;
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t0);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  LARGE_INTEGER t0, t1, t2, t3, t4, t5;
  if (prof_qpc_freq == 0) {
    LARGE_INTEGER f;
    QueryPerformanceFrequency(&f);
    prof_qpc_freq = (double)f.QuadPart;
  }
  QueryPerformanceCounter(&t0);
#endif

  /* Measure profiler clock overhead per frame */
  uint64_t _p_oh_start = prof_now_ns();
  (void)prof_now_ns();
  g_prof_stats.profiler_overhead_ns += (prof_now_ns() - _p_oh_start);

  /* 0. Tick embedded C bots (perceive, decide, set mouse_target) */
  bots_tick(&srv->bot_mgr, srv);

#ifdef __linux__
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t1);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  QueryPerformanceCounter(&t1);
#endif

  /* 1. Move player cells toward mouse */
  {
    PROF_START_NS(move_players_ns);
    server_move_player_cells(srv);
    PROF_ADD_NS(move_players_ns);
  }
  /* 1.5 Move free-roam spectator cameras toward mouse */
  server_move_free_roam_spectators(srv);
  /* 2. Move boosted cells */
  {
    PROF_START_NS(move_boosted_ns);
    server_move_boosted_cells(srv);
    PROF_ADD_NS(move_boosted_ns);
  }
  /* 3. Quadtree rebuild DEFERRED to step 6.5 (single rebuild per tick).
   * The ejected rigid body (step 4.1) uses the previous tick's tree — the
   * sub-pixel error from one tick of stale data (~2 units) is cosmetically
   * imperceptible. Collisions and send_updates use the freshly rebuilt tree. */

#ifdef __linux__
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t2);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  QueryPerformanceCounter(&t2);
#endif

  /* 3.5 Snapshot player cells for ghost cells.
   * PERF: only update every 5 ticks, or immediately when cell count changed.
   * Ghost cells are cosmetic (death screen), not per-tick critical. */
#if defined(_OPENMP)
  #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 32)
#endif
  for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
    if (p->cell_count > 0 && p->conn_id >= 0) {
      bool needs_update =
          (p->cell_count != p->prev_cell_count) || ((srv->ticks % 5) == 0);
      if (!needs_update || p->is_local) /* PERF: local bots skip ghost cells */
        continue;
      p->ghost_cell_count = 0;
      for (int c = 0; c < p->cell_count && c < MAX_OWN_CELLS; c++) {
        Cell *cell = p->cells[c];
        if (cell->is_removed)
          continue;
        p->ghost_cells[p->ghost_cell_count].x = (int32_t)cell->position.x;
        p->ghost_cells[p->ghost_cell_count].y = (int32_t)cell->position.y;
        p->ghost_cells[p->ghost_cell_count].mass = (uint32_t)cell->mass;
        p->ghost_cell_count++;
      }
      p->prev_cell_count = p->cell_count;
    }
  }

  /* 4.1 Ejected-vs-ejected rigid body collision.
  /* Real Agar.io pushes ejected mass apart so they never overlap mid-flight.
   * Direct O(M^2) pairwise distance check across active moving_nodes.
   * Completely eliminates stale pre-movement spatial queries and candidate truncation. */
  if (srv->moving_count > 0) {
    /* Each pair updates both cells. A parallel outer loop would race when
     * different iterations touch the same secondary cell. */
    int collision_pairs = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < srv->moving_count; i++) {
      PREFETCH_CELL(srv->moving_nodes, i, srv->moving_count);
      Cell *cell = srv->moving_nodes[i];
      if (UNLIKELY(!cell || cell->is_removed || cell->type != CELL_EJECTED || !cell->is_moving))
        continue;

      for (int j = i + 1; j < srv->moving_count; j++) {
        PREFETCH_CELL(srv->moving_nodes, j, srv->moving_count);
        Cell *other = srv->moving_nodes[j];
        if (UNLIKELY(!other || other->is_removed || other->type != CELL_EJECTED))
          continue;

        double dx = other->position.x - cell->position.x;
        double dy = other->position.y - cell->position.y;
        double rSum = cell->radius + other->radius;
        double dSqrt = dx * dx + dy * dy;

        if (dSqrt > 0.0 && dSqrt < rSum * rSum) {
          double d = sqrt(dSqrt);
          double push = (rSum - d) / d;
          double half = push * 0.5;
          cell->position.x -= dx * half;
          cell->position.y -= dy * half;
          other->position.x += dx * half;
          other->position.y += dy * half;
          if (++collision_pairs > 20000) goto ejected_collision_done; /* P1-7: cap O(N^2) */
        }
      }
    }
    ejected_collision_done:;
  }

#ifdef __linux__
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t2);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  QueryPerformanceCounter(&t2);
#endif

  /* 5. Expanding Land: dynamic map scaling (before food/virus spawns) */
  if (srv->map_scaler.enabled) {
    bool border_changed = mapscaler_tick(&srv->map_scaler, srv);
    if (border_changed) {
      /* LEGENDWORLD FIX:
       * Broadcast the new physical border (opcode 64) to all clients.
       * The `ogario.v4.js` client must receive this so its internal physics
       * engine scales down alongside the server. Without it, clients see food
       * artificially clumped on an invisible wall! (We fixed the client-side
       * shivering bug).
       */
      BinaryWriter bw;
      bw_init(&bw);
      for (int i = 0; i < srv->connected_count; i++) {
        Player *p = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[i]];
        if (p->conn_id < 0)
          continue;
        bw_reset(&bw);
        pkt_set_border_simple(&bw, p, srv->border.minx, srv->border.miny,
                              srv->border.maxx, srv->border.maxy);
        net_queue_to_player(p->conn_id, bw_data(&bw), bw_length(&bw));
      }
      bw_free(&bw);
    }
    /* Update spawn border */
    mapscaler_get_spawn_border(&srv->map_scaler, &srv->spawn_border.minx,
                               &srv->spawn_border.miny, &srv->spawn_border.maxx,
                               &srv->spawn_border.maxy);
  }

  /* 6. Spawn food/viruses */
  /* Set food target directly to full config food_amount so food is instantly replenished */
  srv->food_target = srv->config.food_amount;
  server_spawn_food(srv);
  server_grow_food(srv); /* internally staggers 1/25th of food per tick */
  server_spawn_viruses(srv);

  /* 6.25 Process queued splits BEFORE the final quadtree rebuild and collisions.
   * Players queue splits via opcode 17 (pending_splits counter).
   *
   * Important:
   * - Cap the burst. 4 queued split actions is enough for 1->2->4->8->16.
   * - Process before the final quadtree rebuild so combat/collision/send logic
   *   sees a coherent spatial index for the final post-split state.
   * - Force one full diff for the splitter, because split fights are not safe
   *   to approximate with the dirty path. */
  for (int i = 0; i < srv->active_player_count; i++) {
    Player *p = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[i]];
    if (p->pending_splits > 0 && p->cell_count > 0 && !p->spectate) {
      int pending = p->pending_splits;
      if (pending > MAX_PENDING_SPLITS_PER_TICK) {
        pending = MAX_PENDING_SPLITS_PER_TICK;
        p->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
      }

      bool did_split = false;
      for (int s = 0; s < pending; s++) {
        if (p->cell_count >= srv->config.player_max_cells)
          break;
        int before = p->cell_count;
        server_split_player_cells(srv, p);
        if (p->cell_count > before)
          did_split = true;
      }

      p->pending_splits = 0;
      if (did_split)
        p->force_full_diff_next_tick = true;
    }

    if (p->eject_requested && p->cell_count > 0 && !p->spectate) {
      server_eject_mass(srv, p);
      p->eject_requested = false;
    }
  }

  /* 6.5 SINGLE quadtree rebuild for the entire tick.
   * Incorporates all movement (steps 1-2), map resize (step 5), food/virus
   * spawns (step 6), and queued split bursts (step 6.25). Previously queued
   * splits were processed after this rebuild; that made fight-state harder to
   * reason about and increased the chance of stale visibility/collision data
   * during combat spikes. */
  {
    PROF_START_NS(qt_rebuild_ns);
    server_rebuild_quadtree(srv);
    PROF_ADD_NS(qt_rebuild_ns);

    /*
     * Perform the only normal BotGrid rebuild for this simulation tick.
     *
     * The grid now contains current-tick positions after:
     * - player movement;
     * - boost movement;
     * - map resizing;
     * - food and virus spawning;
     * - queued split processing;
     * - ejection processing.
     *
     * Bot AI at the start of the next tick will read this completed snapshot.
     * Collision and visibility processing below use it immediately.
     */
    bot_grid_rebuild(&srv->bot_grid, srv);
  }

  /* 6.6 Mother Cells: Spurt food pellets and consume nearby food/ejected mass (MultiOgarII experimental physics)
   * Runs AFTER bot_grid_rebuild so spatial queries use current-tick positions. */
  if ((srv->ticks % 4) == 0 && srv->mother_count > 0) {
    /* Snapshot mother cells first to prevent dynamic_nodes[] swap-removals from skipping unprocessed mothers */
    static Cell *mothers[MOTHER_SNAPSHOT_CAP];
    int m_count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < srv->dynamic_count && m_count < MOTHER_SNAPSHOT_CAP; i++) {
      Cell *c = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
      if (c && !c->is_removed && c->type == CELL_MOTHER) {
        mothers[m_count++] = c;
      }
    }

    for (int mi = 0; mi < m_count; mi++) {
      Cell *c = mothers[mi];
      if (!c || c->is_removed) continue;

      /* Mother Hunter Pass: consume nearby food and player/bot ejected mass */
      if (c->radius < MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS) {
        Rect area = {c->position.x - c->radius, c->position.y - c->radius,
                     c->position.x + c->radius, c->position.y + c->radius};
        static Cell *dyn_nearby[MOTHER_HUNT_QUERY_CAP];
        static Cell *food_nearby[MOTHER_HUNT_QUERY_CAP];
        int d_cnt = bot_grid_query(&srv->bot_grid, area, dyn_nearby, MOTHER_HUNT_QUERY_CAP);
        int f_cnt = fg_query_circle(&srv->food_grid, c->position.x, c->position.y,
                                    c->radius, food_nearby, 0, MOTHER_HUNT_QUERY_CAP);

        bool mother_grew = false;
        /* Process dynamic cells (player W mass, ejected mass) */
        for (int ni = 0; ni < d_cnt; ni++) {
          Cell *other = dyn_nearby[ni];
          if (!other || other->is_removed || other == c) continue;
          if (other->type == CELL_EJECTED) {
            double dx = other->position.x - c->position.x;
            double dy = other->position.y - c->position.y;
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= c->radius2) {
              double max_r2 = MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS * MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS;
              double available_r2 = max_r2 - c->radius2;
              if (available_r2 <= 0.0) break; /* Mother full */
              double absorbed_r2 = other->radius2;
              if (absorbed_r2 <= available_r2) {
                /* Entire W/food fits — consume completely */
                double new_r2 = c->radius2 + absorbed_r2;
                cell_set_size(c, sqrt(new_r2));
                server_remove_cell(srv, other);
              } else {
                /* Overflow: absorb only what fits, shrink or remove the ejected mass */
                double leftover_r2 = absorbed_r2 - available_r2;
                if (leftover_r2 < 1.0) {
                  /* Remainder too small to survive (cell_set_size clamps radius<1.0 up to 1.0,
                   * which would create mass). Absorb entire prey and cap Mother. */
                  double new_r2 = c->radius2 + absorbed_r2;
                  cell_set_size(c, sqrt(new_r2 > max_r2 ? max_r2 : new_r2));
                  server_remove_cell(srv, other);
                } else {
                  cell_set_size(c, MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS);
                  cell_set_size(other, sqrt(leftover_r2));
                  mark_cell_dirty(other, srv->ticks);
                }
              }
              mother_grew = true;
              if (c->radius >= MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS) break;
            }
          }
        }
        /* Process food pellets */
        if (c->radius < MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS) {
          for (int ni = 0; ni < f_cnt; ni++) {
            Cell *other = food_nearby[ni];
            if (!other || other->is_removed || other == c) continue;
            if (other->type == CELL_FOOD) {
              double dx = other->position.x - c->position.x;
              double dy = other->position.y - c->position.y;
              if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= c->radius2) {
                double max_r2 = MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS * MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS;
                double available_r2 = max_r2 - c->radius2;
                if (available_r2 <= 0.0) break; /* Mother full */
                double absorbed_r2 = other->radius2;
                if (absorbed_r2 <= available_r2) {
                  /* Entire food fits — consume completely */
                  double new_r2 = c->radius2 + absorbed_r2;
                  cell_set_size(c, sqrt(new_r2));
                  server_remove_cell(srv, other);
                } else {
                  /* Overflow: absorb only what fits, shrink or remove the food pellet */
                  double leftover_r2 = absorbed_r2 - available_r2;
                  if (leftover_r2 < 1.0) {
                    /* Remainder too small to survive (radius<1.0 would be clamped up). */
                    double new_r2 = c->radius2 + absorbed_r2;
                    cell_set_size(c, sqrt(new_r2 > max_r2 ? max_r2 : new_r2));
                    server_remove_cell(srv, other);
                  } else {
                    cell_set_size(c, MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS);
                    cell_set_size(other, sqrt(leftover_r2));
                    mark_cell_dirty(other, srv->ticks);
                  }
                }
                mother_grew = true;
                if (c->radius >= MOTHER_MAX_RADIUS) break;
              }
            }
          }
        }
        if (mother_grew) {
          server_mark_cell_dirty(c, srv->ticks);
        }
      }

      /* Spurt food pellets if mother radius > min spurt radius with kinetic boost motion */
      if (c->radius > MOTHER_MIN_SPURT_RADIUS) {
        for (int fp = 0; fp < MOTHER_PELLETS_PER_TICK; fp++) {
          double pellet_r = MOTHER_PELLET_RADIUS;
          double new_r2 = c->radius2 - (pellet_r * pellet_r);
          double min_r2 = MOTHER_MIN_SPURT_RADIUS * MOTHER_MIN_SPURT_RADIUS;
          if (new_r2 < min_r2) break; /* stop at min radius */

          double angle = fast_random_double() * 2.0 * M_PI;
          double sin_val, cos_val;
          fast_sincos(angle, &sin_val, &cos_val);
          double dist_out = c->radius + MOTHER_PELLET_RADIUS;
          Vec2 pellet_pos = {
            c->position.x + cos_val * dist_out,
            c->position.y + sin_val * dist_out
          };
          Cell *f = server_alloc_cell(srv);
          if (f) {
            cell_init(f, f->id, CELL_FOOD, pellet_pos, pellet_r);
            f->color = (Color){(uint8_t)fast_random_int(256), (uint8_t)fast_random_int(256), (uint8_t)fast_random_int(256)};
            f->created_tick = srv->ticks;
            if (server_add_cell(srv, f)) {
              if (server_start_cell_boost(srv, f, MOTHER_SPURT_VELOCITY + fast_random_double() * MOTHER_SPURT_VEL_RANGE, angle)) {
                cell_set_size(c, sqrt(new_r2));
                server_mark_cell_dirty(c, srv->ticks);
              } else {
                /* Boost failed (e.g. MAX_MOVING capacity reached) — roll back spawned pellet */
                server_remove_cell(srv, f);
              }
            } else {
              server_release_untracked_cell(srv, f);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* 4. Check collisions (Moved here so physics catch newly spawned
   * viruses/food) */
  {
    PROF_START_NS(collisions_eat_ns);
    server_check_collisions(srv);
    PROF_ADD_NS(collisions_eat_ns);
  }

#ifdef __linux__
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t3);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  QueryPerformanceCounter(&t3);
#endif

  /* 4.5 Enforce hard player-cell limits.
   *
   * Rules:
   * - Maximum 16 owned cells.
   * - Maximum PLAYER_MAX_CELL_MASS per individual cell.
   * - Oversized cells recursively split during this same tick while ownership
   *   slots remain, so clients never receive a 30k/50k/100k intermediate cell.
   * - At 16/16 cells, remaining oversized cells are clamped to max. Excess
   *   mass must be discarded because keeping it would violate both limits.
   */
  {
    int max_cells = srv->config.player_max_cells;
    if (max_cells > MAX_OWN_CELLS)
      max_cells = MAX_OWN_CELLS;
    if (max_cells < 1)
      max_cells = 1;

    const double max_mass = PLAYER_MAX_CELL_MASS;
    const double max_radius = srv->config.player_max_size;

    for (int ap = 0; ap < srv->active_player_count; ap++) {
      Player *p = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ap]];
      if (p->is_removed || p->cell_count <= 0 || p->spectate)
        continue;

      /* Recheck each parent after splitting. A 100k cell needs several split
       * generations before every resulting piece is at or below the limit. Newly
       * appended children are reached naturally as ci advances. */
      int ci = 0;
      while (ci < p->cell_count && p->cell_count < max_cells) {
        Cell *c = p->cells[ci];

        if (!c || c->is_removed || c->mass <= max_mass) {
          ci++;
          continue;
        }

        int before = p->cell_count;
        double angle = 2.0 * M_PI * ((double)rand() / RAND_MAX);
        if (!server_split_cell(
                srv,
                p,
                c,
                angle,
                0)) {
          ci++;
          continue;
        }

        if (p->cell_count == before) {
          /* Allocation failure or another defensive guard: avoid looping. */
          ci++;
          continue;
        }

        /* Do not increment ci yet. The parent may still exceed max_mass and must
         * split again before we proceed to its children. */
      }

      /* Hard final clamp. This catches:
       * - players already at 16 cells;
       * - insufficient slots to distribute all mass;
       * - allocation failure during recursive splitting. */
      for (int i = 0; i < p->cell_count; i++) {
        Cell *c = p->cells[i];
        if (!c || c->is_removed)
          continue;

        if (c->mass > max_mass) {
          cell_set_size(c, max_radius);
          mark_cell_dirty(c, srv->ticks);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* 6b. Potion drop cells — spawn wave if timer expired, despawn expired */
  if (srv->ticks >= srv->potion_cell_next_tick)
    server_spawn_potion_cells(srv);
  server_despawn_potion_cells(srv);

  /* 6a. Spawn grow-in animation — smoothly grow newly spawned cells */
  for (int i = 0; i < srv->dynamic_count; i++) {
    PREFETCH_CELL(srv->dynamic_nodes, i, srv->dynamic_count);
    Cell *c = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
    if (c->is_removed || c->type != CELL_PLAYER) continue;
    if (c->spawn_grow_end_tick == 0) continue; /* no animation */

    if (srv->ticks >= c->spawn_grow_end_tick) {
      /* Animation complete — snap to final size */
      cell_set_size(c, c->spawn_target_radius);
      c->spawn_grow_end_tick = 0;
      server_mark_cell_dirty(c, srv->ticks);
    } else {
      /* Ease-out cubic: t = progress 0..1, f(t) = 1 - (1-t)^3 */
      uint32_t elapsed = srv->ticks - c->created_tick;
      uint32_t duration = c->spawn_grow_end_tick - c->created_tick;
      double t = (double)elapsed / (double)duration;
      if (t > 1.0) t = 1.0;
      double ease = 1.0 - (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t);
      double new_radius = 1.0 + (c->spawn_target_radius - 1.0) * ease;
      cell_set_size(c, new_radius);
      server_mark_cell_dirty(c, srv->ticks);
    }
  }

  /* 6. Decay player cells (every 100 ticks = 4 seconds) */
  if ((srv->ticks % srv->config.decay_interval) == 0)
    server_decay_cells(srv);

  /* 7. Update leaderboard (every 25 ticks) */
  if ((srv->ticks % srv->config.leaderboard_interval) == 0) {
    server_update_leaderboard(srv);

    /* 7.0.1 Broadcast LM Stats (opcode 201) alongside leaderboard.
     * Sends alive player count + bot count to update "Total" in LM UI. */
    {
      BinaryWriter sw;
      bw_init(&sw);
      /* Count only players with cells alive (not stale active_player_count) */
      uint16_t alive = 0;
      for (int ai = 0; ai < srv->active_player_count; ai++) {
        Player *ap = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ai]];
        if (!ap->is_removed && ap->cell_count > 0 && !ap->frozen &&
            (ap->conn_id >= 0 || ap->is_bot))
          alive++;
      }
      uint16_t bots = 0; /* external bots — server can't distinguish */
      pkt_lm_stats(&sw, alive, bots);
      for (int ci = 0; ci < srv->connected_count; ci++) {
        Player *p = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[ci]];
        if (p->conn_id >= 0)
          net_queue_to_player(p->conn_id, bw_data(&sw), bw_length(&sw));
      }
      bw_free(&sw);
    }

    /* 7.0a2. Opcode 0xCB: Expanding Land Player Stats — human + bot counts.
     * Separate from LM Stats (0xC9) to avoid confusing LM clients. */
    {
      BinaryWriter pw;
      bw_init(&pw);
      uint16_t humans = 0, bots = 0;
      for (int ai = 0; ai < srv->active_player_count; ai++) {
        Player *ap = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[ai]];
        if (ap->is_removed || ap->cell_count == 0 || ap->frozen || ap->spectate) continue;
        if (ap->is_bot)
          bots++;
        else if (ap->conn_id >= 0)
          humans++;
      }
      pkt_el_player_stats(&pw, humans, bots);
      for (int ci = 0; ci < srv->connected_count; ci++) {
        Player *p = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[ci]];
        if (p->conn_id >= 0)
          net_queue_to_player(p->conn_id, bw_data(&pw), bw_length(&pw));
      }
      bw_free(&pw);
    }

    /* 7.0b. Opcode 0xCA: LM Decay Info — per-player anti-team & decay status.
     * Each active player gets their own packet with their personal breakdown.
     */
    {
      BinaryWriter dw;
      bw_init(&dw);

      /* Pre-compute danger phase remaining seconds */
      bool danger_active = (srv->map_scaler.phase == PHASE_DANGER);
      uint16_t danger_secs = 0;
      if (danger_active) {
        uint32_t elapsed = srv->ticks - srv->map_scaler.phase_start_tick;
        int remaining_ticks = srv->map_scaler.danger_duration - (int)elapsed;
        if (remaining_ticks > 0)
          danger_secs = (uint16_t)(remaining_ticks / 25);
      }

      uint8_t decay_secs = (uint8_t)(srv->config.decay_interval / 25);

      for (int ci = 0; ci < srv->connected_count; ci++) {
        Player *p = &srv->players[srv->connected_ids[ci]];
        if (p->conn_id < 0 || p->cell_count == 0)
          continue; /* only send to alive players */

        /* Check if any of this player's cells are in the danger zone */
        bool player_in_danger = false;
        if (danger_active) {
          for (int c = 0; c < p->cell_count; c++) {
            if (!p->cells[c]->is_removed &&
                mapscaler_is_in_outer_zone(&srv->map_scaler,
                                           p->cells[c]->position.x,
                                           p->cells[c]->position.y)) {
              player_in_danger = true;
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        bw_reset(&dw);
        pkt_lm_decay_info(&dw, p, srv->config.at_extra_decay_base,
                          srv->config.player_decay_rate,
                          decay_secs, player_in_danger, danger_secs);
        net_queue_to_player(p->conn_id, bw_data(&dw), bw_length(&dw));
      }
      bw_free(&dw);
    }
  }

  /* 7.1 Auto-save player database (Journal every 30s, Snapshot every 5m) */
  playerdb_tick(&srv->player_db, server_data_path("players.dat"), 750, 7500);

  /* 8. Release disconnected ownership records after their final cell dies.
   * They are absent from connected_ids, so scan the fixed table once/sec. */
  if ((srv->ticks % 25) == 0) {
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_PLAYERS; i++) {
      Player *p = &srv->players[i];
      if (p->active && p->frozen && p->conn_id < 0 &&
          p->cell_count == 0) {
        int freed_id = p->id;
        server_remove_active_player(srv, freed_id);
        player_reset(p);
        /* Return slot to free stack for O(1) reallocation */
        if (srv->free_player_top < MAX_PLAYERS - 1) {
          srv->free_player_stack[++srv->free_player_top] = freed_id;
        }
        INFO_LOG("[Player %d] Disconnected ownership slot freed\n",
                 freed_id);
      }
    }
  }

  /* 8.5 Potion system — runs every 25 ticks (1 second).
   * Brewing is slow-timescale; no need to check every tick. */
  if ((srv->ticks % 25) == 0)
    potion_tick(srv);

  /* 9. Send updates to all players */
  server_send_player_updates(srv);

  /* 9.5 Flush freed cell slots to free_list after networking phase finishes */
  server_flush_pending_free(srv);

  /* 9.6 Cell pool health invariant check (every 5 seconds) */
  if ((srv->ticks % 125) == 0) {
    int live = srv->food_count + srv->dynamic_count;
    int accounted = live + srv->free_count + srv->pending_free_count;
    int unaccounted = srv->cell_count - accounted;
    async_log("[CellPool] high=%d live=%d food=%d dyn=%d free=%d pending=%d lost=%d\n",
              srv->cell_count, live, srv->food_count, srv->dynamic_count,
              srv->free_count, srv->pending_free_count, unaccounted);
  }

#ifdef __linux__
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t4);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  QueryPerformanceCounter(&t4);
#endif

  /* ── World spectate ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   * Updates every tick (25Hz). The 16K tracking cap bounds per-tick cost. */

  /*
   * Outbound queues are drained by net_run() after the simulation tick.
   * This pass only applies queue-limit and stall-timeout disconnections on the
   * single game thread.
   */
  net_process_write_failures();

#ifdef __linux__
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t5);
  prof_bot_ai += ts_diff_us(&t0, &t1);
  prof_move   += ts_diff_us(&t1, &t2);
  prof_coll   += ts_diff_us(&t2, &t3);
  prof_send   += ts_diff_us(&t3, &t4);
  prof_flush  += ts_diff_us(&t4, &t5);
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  QueryPerformanceCounter(&t5);
  prof_bot_ai += (double)(t1.QuadPart - t0.QuadPart) / prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
  prof_move   += (double)(t2.QuadPart - t1.QuadPart) / prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
  prof_coll   += (double)(t3.QuadPart - t2.QuadPart) / prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
  prof_send   += (double)(t4.QuadPart - t3.QuadPart) / prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
  prof_flush  += (double)(t5.QuadPart - t4.QuadPart) / prof_qpc_freq * 1e6;
#endif
  prof_n++;
  prof_human_players_sum += (uint64_t)srv->connected_count;
  prof_bots_sum += (uint64_t)srv->bot_mgr.count;
  prof_bots_alive_sum += (uint64_t)bots_count_alive(&srv->bot_mgr, srv);
  prof_cells_sum += (uint64_t)srv->cell_count;
  prof_live_cells_sum += (uint64_t)(srv->food_count + srv->dynamic_count);
}

/* Called every 5 seconds to print phase breakdown and % CPU utilization. */
void server_print_profile(void) {
  if (prof_n == 0)
    return;

  /* ── Atomic snapshot: exchange-and-zero every counter FIRST ───────────
   * This prevents lost increments: the returned value is the exact
   * accumulation since the last report, and workers see zero immediately. */
#ifdef _WIN32
#define PROF_SNAP(field, local) uint64_t local = (uint64_t)InterlockedExchange64((volatile LONGLONG *)&g_prof_stats.field, 0)
#elif defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
#define PROF_SNAP(field, local) uint64_t local = __atomic_exchange_n(&g_prof_stats.field, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL)
#else
#define PROF_SNAP(field, local) uint64_t local = g_prof_stats.field; g_prof_stats.field = 0
#endif

  PROF_SNAP(bot_perceive_ns,         snap_bot_perceive);
  PROF_SNAP(bot_brain_ns,            snap_bot_brain);
  PROF_SNAP(perc_qt_scan_ns,         snap_perc_qt_scan);
  PROF_SNAP(perc_food_scan_ns,       snap_perc_food_scan);
  PROF_SNAP(perc_classify_ns,        snap_perc_classify);
  PROF_SNAP(brain_perceive_ns,       snap_brain_perceive);
  PROF_SNAP(brain_updates_ns,        snap_brain_updates);
  PROF_SNAP(brain_candidates_ns,     snap_brain_candidates);
  PROF_SNAP(qt_rebuild_ns,           snap_qt_rebuild);
  PROF_SNAP(collisions_qt_query_ns,  snap_coll_qt_query);
  PROF_SNAP(collisions_food_query_ns,snap_coll_food_query);
  PROF_SNAP(net_read_ns,             snap_net_read);
  PROF_SNAP(net_write_ns,            snap_net_write);
  PROF_SNAP(profiler_overhead_ns,    snap_prof_overhead);
  PROF_SNAP(move_players_ns,         snap_move_players);
  PROF_SNAP(move_boosted_ns,         snap_move_boosted);

  /* Suppress unused-variable warnings for snapshots consumed only by the
   * extended prof.txt report (which may be compiled out in some configs). */
  (void)snap_bot_brain;
  (void)snap_brain_perceive;

  uint64_t snap_thread_total[3];
  for (int w = 0; w < 3; w++) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    snap_thread_total[w] = (uint64_t)InterlockedExchange64((volatile LONGLONG *)&g_prof_stats.thread_total_ns[w], 0);
#elif defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
    snap_thread_total[w] = __atomic_exchange_n(&g_prof_stats.thread_total_ns[w], 0, __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL);
#else
    snap_thread_total[w] = g_prof_stats.thread_total_ns[w];
    g_prof_stats.thread_total_ns[w] = 0;
#endif
  }

#undef PROF_SNAP

  /* ── Compute report from snapshot locals ────────────────────────────── */
  double bot_ai_ms = (prof_bot_ai / prof_n) / 1000.0;
  double move_ms   = (prof_move / prof_n) / 1000.0;
  double coll_ms   = (prof_coll / prof_n) / 1000.0;
  double send_ms   = (prof_send / prof_n) / 1000.0;
  double flush_ms  = (prof_flush / prof_n) / 1000.0;

  double tick_budget_ms = 40.0;
  double cpu_load_ms = bot_ai_ms + move_ms + coll_ms + send_ms + flush_ms;
  double cpu_load_pct = (cpu_load_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;

  double bot_ai_pct = (bot_ai_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;
  double move_pct   = (move_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;
  double coll_pct   = (coll_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;
  double send_pct   = (send_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;

  double avg_humans     = (double)prof_human_players_sum / (double)prof_n;
  double avg_bots       = (double)prof_bots_sum / (double)prof_n;
  double avg_bots_alive = (double)prof_bots_alive_sum / (double)prof_n;
  double avg_live_cells = (double)prof_live_cells_sum / (double)prof_n;
  double avg_alloc_high = (double)prof_cells_sum / (double)prof_n;

#ifndef BUILD_GIT_INFO
#define BUILD_GIT_INFO "v1.2.62"
#endif

  double bot_perc_ms  = (double)snap_bot_perceive / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  /* bot_think_ms removed — use brain_upd_ms + brain_cand_ms sub-breakdowns instead */

  /* Perceive sub-breakdowns */
  double perc_qt_ms    = (double)snap_perc_qt_scan / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double perc_food_ms  = (double)snap_perc_food_scan / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double perc_class_ms = (double)snap_perc_classify / (double)prof_n / 1e6;

  /* Brain sub-breakdowns */
  /* brain_perc_ms removed — overlaps with bot_perc_ms above */
  double brain_upd_ms   = (double)snap_brain_updates / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double brain_cand_ms  = (double)snap_brain_candidates / (double)prof_n / 1e6;

  /* Per-thread wall-clock */
  double cpu1_ms = (double)snap_thread_total[0] / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double cpu2_ms = (double)snap_thread_total[1] / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double cpu3_ms = (double)snap_thread_total[2] / (double)prof_n / 1e6;

  /* QT rebuild runs at step 6.5 — inside the t2→t3 (Collisions) window */
  double qt_reb_ms   = (double)snap_qt_rebuild / (double)prof_n / 1e6;

  double qt_q_ms   = (double)snap_coll_qt_query / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double fg_q_ms   = (double)snap_coll_food_query / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double eat_ms    = coll_ms - (qt_reb_ms + qt_q_ms + fg_q_ms);
  if (eat_ms < 0.0) eat_ms = 0.0;

  /* Net I/O sub-breakdowns (accumulated in net.c worker thread) */
  double net_rd_ms = (double)snap_net_read / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double net_wr_ms = (double)snap_net_write / (double)prof_n / 1e6;

  double prof_oh_ms  = (double)snap_prof_overhead / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double prof_oh_pct = (prof_oh_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;

  /* Per-thread CPU % of 40ms budget */
  double cpu1_pct = (cpu1_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;
  double cpu2_pct = (cpu2_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;
  double cpu3_pct = (cpu3_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0;

  /* Worker thread breakdown: per-thread averages (divide CPU-total by 3) */
  double avg_thr_ms = (cpu1_ms + cpu2_ms + cpu3_ms) / 3.0;
  double thr_div = avg_thr_ms > 0.001 ? avg_thr_ms : 1.0;
  double perc_of_thr = (bot_perc_ms / 3.0 / thr_div) * 100.0;  /* perceive as % of thread */
  double cand_of_thr = (brain_cand_ms / 3.0 / thr_div) * 100.0;
  double upd_of_thr  = (brain_upd_ms / 3.0 / thr_div) * 100.0;

  /* Perceive sub % (of perceive) */
  double p_total = bot_perc_ms > 0.001 ? bot_perc_ms : 1.0;
  double perc_qt_pct   = (perc_qt_ms / p_total) * 100.0;
  double perc_food_pct = (perc_food_ms / p_total) * 100.0;
  double perc_cls_pct  = (perc_class_ms / p_total) * 100.0;

  /* Collision sub % (of collisions) */
  double coll_div = coll_ms > 0.001 ? coll_ms : 1.0;
  double qt_reb_of_coll = (qt_reb_ms / coll_div) * 100.0;
  double qt_q_of_coll   = (qt_q_ms / coll_div) * 100.0;
  double fg_q_of_coll   = (fg_q_ms / coll_div) * 100.0;
  double eat_of_coll    = (eat_ms / coll_div) * 100.0;

  /* Physics sub % (of physics) */
  double move_pl_ms = (double)snap_move_players / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double move_bo_ms = (double)snap_move_boosted / (double)prof_n / 1e6;
  double mv_total = move_ms > 0.001 ? move_ms : 1.0;
  double move_pl_pct = (move_pl_ms / mv_total) * 100.0;
  double move_bo_pct = (move_bo_ms / mv_total) * 100.0;

  async_log("[Prof] [%s] %.0f live (high:%.0f) | Bots: %.0f total (%.0f alive) | Main:%.1f%% CPU1:%.1f%% CPU2:%.1f%% CPU3:%.1f%% | Coll:%.1f%% [Reb:%.1f QT:%.1f FG:%.1f Eat:%.1f] | Perc:%.1f%%thr [Food:%.1f QT:%.1f Cls:%.1f] [%d ticks]\n",
            BUILD_GIT_INFO, avg_live_cells, avg_alloc_high, avg_bots, avg_bots_alive, cpu_load_pct, cpu1_pct, cpu2_pct, cpu3_pct,
            coll_pct, qt_reb_of_coll, qt_q_of_coll, fg_q_of_coll, eat_of_coll,
