            perc_of_thr, perc_food_pct, perc_qt_pct, perc_cls_pct, prof_n);

  FILE *f = fopen(server_data_path("prof.txt"), "w");
  if (f) {
    fprintf(f,
            "\n[Prof Build] %s\n"
            "[Prof Load] Avg Humans: %.1f | Avg Bots: %.1f | Avg Live Cells: %.0f | Alloc High: %.0f\n"
            "\n"
            "  MAIN THREAD: %.1f%% of 40ms budget\n"
            "  ├─ Collisions: %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   ├─ QuadTree Queries: %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   ├─ FoodGrid Queries: %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   ├─ QT Rebuild:       %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   └─ Eat / Rigid Math: %.1f%%\n"
            "  ├─ Physics & Move: %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   ├─ Move Players: %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   └─ Move Boosted: %.1f%%\n"
            "  ├─ Send Updates: %.1f%%\n"
            "  ├─ Bot Dispatch: %.1f%%\n"
            "  ├─ Net Read:  %.1f%%\n"
            "  ├─ Net Write: %.1f%%\n"
            "  └─ Profiler:  %.4f%%\n"
            "\n"
            "  WORKER THREADS (%% of 40ms budget each):\n"
            "  ├─ CPU 1: %.1f%%\n"
            "  ├─ CPU 2: %.1f%%\n"
            "  └─ CPU 3: %.1f%%\n"
            "\n"
            "  WORKER BREAKDOWN (%% of worker time, avg across 3 CPUs):\n"
            "  ├─ Perceive: %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   ├─ Food Scan:  %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   ├─ QT Scan:    %.1f%%\n"
            "  │   └─ Classify:   %.1f%%\n"
            "  ├─ Candidates: %.1f%%\n"
            "  ├─ Updates:    %.1f%%\n"
            "  └─ Other:      %.1f%%\n",
            BUILD_GIT_INFO,
            avg_humans, avg_bots, avg_live_cells, avg_alloc_high,
            /* MAIN THREAD */
            cpu_load_pct,
            coll_pct,
            qt_q_of_coll, fg_q_of_coll, qt_reb_of_coll, eat_of_coll,
            move_pct,
            move_pl_pct, move_bo_pct,
            send_pct,
            bot_ai_pct,
            (net_rd_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0,
            (net_wr_ms / tick_budget_ms) * 100.0,
            prof_oh_pct,
            /* WORKER THREADS */
            cpu1_pct, cpu2_pct, cpu3_pct,
            /* WORKER BREAKDOWN */
            perc_of_thr,
            perc_food_pct, perc_qt_pct, perc_cls_pct,
            cand_of_thr,
            upd_of_thr,
            100.0 - perc_of_thr - cand_of_thr - upd_of_thr > 0 ? 100.0 - perc_of_thr - cand_of_thr - upd_of_thr : 0.0);

    fprintf(f,
            "  [Send Breakdown] dirty=%.2fms diff=%.2fms | skip=%d dirty=%d diff=%d (per tick avg)\n",
            (prof_send_dirty / prof_n) / 1000.0,
            (prof_send_diff / prof_n) / 1000.0, prof_skip_count / prof_n,
            prof_dirty_count / prof_n, prof_diff_count / prof_n);

    fprintf(
        f,
        "  [Send Detail] build_full=%.2fms build_upd=%.2fms lz4=%.2fms queue=%.2fms "
        "| full_pkts=%llu upd_pkts=%llu lz4_pkts=%llu raw_pkts=%llu "
        "| raw=%.2fMB comp=%.2fMB\n",
        (prof_send_build_full / prof_n) / 1000.0,
        (prof_send_build_updates_only / prof_n) / 1000.0,
        (prof_send_lz4 / prof_n) / 1000.0,
        (prof_send_queue / prof_n) / 1000.0,
        (unsigned long long)(prof_send_full_packets / (prof_n ? prof_n : 1)),
        (unsigned long long)(prof_send_updates_only_packets /
                             (prof_n ? prof_n : 1)),
        (unsigned long long)(prof_send_lz4_packets / (prof_n ? prof_n : 1)),
        (unsigned long long)(prof_send_raw_packets / (prof_n ? prof_n : 1)),
        (double)prof_send_raw_bytes /
            (1024.0 * 1024.0 * (prof_n ? prof_n : 1)),
        (double)prof_send_comp_bytes /
            (1024.0 * 1024.0 * (prof_n ? prof_n : 1)));

    fprintf(f, "  [Dirty System] fallbacks=%llu clamps=%llu soft_skips=%llu\n",
            (unsigned long long)prof_dirty_fallback_full,
            (unsigned long long)prof_dirty_budget_clamped,
            (unsigned long long)prof_dirty_new_visible_soft);
    fprintf(f, "  [WSpec] cap=%d\n", FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES);
    fclose(f);
  }
  /* g_prof_stats fields already zeroed by PROF_SNAP at function entry */
  prof_bot_ai = prof_move = prof_coll = prof_send = prof_flush = 0;
  prof_send_dirty = prof_send_diff = 0;
  prof_skip_count = prof_dirty_count = prof_diff_count = 0;
  prof_human_players_sum = prof_bots_sum = prof_bots_alive_sum = prof_cells_sum = prof_live_cells_sum = 0;
  prof_n = 0;

  prof_send_build_full = 0;
  prof_send_build_updates_only = 0;
  prof_send_lz4 = 0;
  prof_send_queue = 0;

  prof_send_raw_bytes = 0;
  prof_send_comp_bytes = 0;

  prof_send_full_packets = 0;
  prof_send_updates_only_packets = 0;
  prof_send_lz4_packets = 0;
  prof_send_raw_packets = 0;

  prof_dirty_fallback_full = 0;
  prof_dirty_budget_clamped = 0;
  prof_dirty_new_visible_soft = 0;
}

/* Forward declare */
typedef struct GameServer GameServer;

/* Border rectangle */
typedef struct {
  double minx, miny, maxx, maxy;
  double width, height;
} Border;

/*
 * Generation-checked references used by the food growth scheduler.
 *
 * Removed Cell slots may later be reused. The generation snapshot prevents a
 * stale scheduler reference from modifying a different cell occupying the
 * same pool slot.
 */
typedef struct {
  Cell *cell;
  uint32_t generation;
} FoodGrowthRef;

typedef struct {
  FoodGrowthRef *items;
  int count;
  int capacity;
} FoodGrowthBucket;

/* ── Game Server ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

struct GameServer {
  ServerConfig config;
  Border border;
  bool running;

  /* Tick state */
  uint32_t ticks;
  uint64_t step_datetime; /* ms since epoch */
  double tick_interval;   /* ms per tick (40ms = 25Hz) */

  /* Cell storage (pool) — free-list allocator (v1.2.18)
   * Cells keep their array index forever. Removed cells' indices go onto
   * the free_list stack. server_alloc_cell pops from the stack (O(1)).
   * This eliminates compaction entirely — no more index scrambling. */
  Cell cells[MAX_CELLS];
  int cell_count;          /* high-water mark in cells[] */
  int free_list[MAX_CELLS]; /* stack of freed cell indices (available for reuse) */
  int free_count;           /* number of entries in free_list */
  int pending_free[MAX_CELLS]; /* freed THIS tick — flushed to free_list after send_updates */
  int pending_free_count;
  int removed_cell_count;   /* diagnostic only (not used for compaction) */
  uint32_t last_cell_id;

  /* Players */
  Player players[MAX_PLAYERS];
  int player_count;
  int last_player_id;

  /* Free-slot stack for O(1) player allocation.
   * Pop from top on connect, push on disconnect. */
  int free_player_stack[MAX_PLAYERS];
  int free_player_top; /* index of next free slot to pop (-1 = empty) */

  /*
   * Monotonic allocation identity for reusable Player slots.
   * Zero is reserved for an unallocated/inactive slot.
   */
  uint64_t next_player_lifecycle_generation;

  /* Connected players: ALL allocated player slots (playing + spectating + idle).
   * Used for: send_updates, viewport, stats, spectator grouping. */
  int connected_ids[MAX_PLAYERS];
  int connected_count;

  /* Active/spawned players: ONLY players with cells alive (cell_count > 0).
   * Used for: simulation loops (movement, collision, decay, ghost snapshots).
   * This is the tight inner loop — must be minimal. */
  int active_player_ids[MAX_PLAYERS];
  int active_player_count;

  /* QuadTree: dynamic cells (players, ejected, viruses) — rebuilt every tick */
  QuadTree quad_tree;
  /* Spatial grid: food only — rebuilt only when food changes (food_tree_dirty) */
  FoodGrid food_grid;
  bool food_tree_dirty;

  /* Spatial grid: dynamic cells for bot perception — rebuilt every tick */
  BotGrid bot_grid;

  /*
   * Tick at which quad_tree was last rebuilt.
   * New cells are inserted incrementally only when the tree represents the
   * current tick; this prevents duplicate/stale placement in the previous
   * tick's tree before the scheduled rebuild.
   */
  uint32_t quad_tree_build_tick;

  /* Food tracking */
  Cell *food_nodes[MAX_FOOD];
  int food_count;
  int food_target;   /* deferred spawn: slowly recovers toward food_amount */

  /*
   * Only food that has not completed its grow-in period is scheduled here.
   * Each tick processes one phase instead of scanning all food_nodes[].
   */
  FoodGrowthBucket food_growth[FOOD_GROWTH_PHASES];

  /* Virus tracking */
  Cell *virus_nodes[MAX_VIRUSES];
  int virus_count;
  int mother_count;

  /*
   * Boosted cells.
   *
   * moving_count includes boosted player split cells and boosted non-player
   * entities. moving_dynamic_count includes only the latter and is maintained
   * transactionally as cells begin moving, stop moving or are removed.
   */
  Cell *moving_nodes[MAX_MOVING];
  int moving_count;
  int moving_dynamic_count;

  /* Dynamic cells: all non-food live cells (players, ejected, viruses).
   * Used for quadtree rebuild instead of scanning the full cells[] pool. */
  Cell *dynamic_nodes[MAX_DYNAMIC];
  int dynamic_count;

  /* Leaderboard */
  Player *leaderboard[MAX_PLAYERS];
  int leaderboard_count;
  int leaderboard_type;
  Player *largest_player;
  bool lb_dirty;                  /* true when top-N changed → re-serialize */
  int prev_lb_ids[20];            /* player IDs from previous leaderboard */
  double prev_lb_scores[20];      /* scores from previous leaderboard */
  int prev_lb_count;              /* count from previous leaderboard */

/* SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES, FULL_MAP_MAX_NODES defined in config.h */

  /* Spectator group: cross-tick diff history for grouped spectators (#1) */
  Cell *spec_client_nodes[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];
  uint64_t spec_client_handles[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];
  uint8_t spec_view_state[VIEW_STATE_BYTES];
  int spec_client_count;

  uint32_t spec_compacted_drop_ids[SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES];
  int spec_compacted_drop_count;

  /* World spectate updates every tick (25Hz). ADD batch (WSPEC_ADD_BATCH)
   * limits buildup rate. The 16K tracking cap inherently bounds per-tick cost. */

  /* Send buffer (per-thread, but main thread has one) */
  BinaryWriter send_buf;

  /*
   * Reusable compression buffer for transactional World Spectate packets.
   *
   * Ordinary spectator buffers are fixed at 128 KiB because normal viewports
   * are bounded. World Spectate packets can be larger, so this buffer grows
   * to pkt_lz4_bound(raw_length) and is reused across ticks.
   *
   * The packet remains an independent LZ4 block. No streaming dictionary is
   * used.
   */
  uint8_t *world_lz4_buffer;
  size_t world_lz4_capacity;

  /* Persistent player database + authoritative economy catalog */
  PlayerDB player_db;
  EconomyCatalog economy;

  /* Cells removed this tick — used by send_updates to force eat/del records
   * for clients that had these cells visible. Cleared at start of each tick. */
  Cell *removed_this_tick[MAX_REMOVED_PER_TICK];
  int removed_this_tick_count;

  /*
   * Number of cells successfully inserted during this simulation tick.
   *
   * This is reset at tick start and incremented only after server_add_cell()
   * has committed every required world structure. It allows the total-skip
   * optimization to distinguish "no dirty cells" from "new cells exist but
   * have not otherwise generated a dirty event".
   */
  int spawned_this_tick_count;

  uint32_t last_compact_tick; /* tick when last compaction ran */

  /* Expanding Land dynamic map scaling */
  MapScaler map_scaler;
  Border spawn_border; /* restricted spawn area during contraction */

  /* Potion drop cells — periodic loot */
  uint32_t potion_cell_next_tick; /* tick when next wave spawns */

  /* Embedded C Bots */
  BotManager bot_mgr;
};

typedef struct {
  uint64_t bot_workers_ai_ns;
  uint64_t bot_perceive_ns;
  uint64_t bot_brain_ns;
  /* Perceive sub-breakdowns (CPU-total across all threads) */
  uint64_t perc_qt_scan_ns;     /* qt_query inside bot_perceive */
  uint64_t perc_food_scan_ns;   /* fg_query_from inside bot_perceive */
  uint64_t perc_classify_ns;    /* cell classification loop */
  /* Brain sub-breakdowns (CPU-total across all threads) */
  uint64_t brain_perceive_ns;   /* bot_perceive call inside brain */
  uint64_t brain_updates_ns;    /* emotions, memory, spatial, social updates */
  uint64_t brain_candidates_ns; /* candidate scoring + selection */
  /* Per-thread wall-clock (worker threads 0..2) */
  uint64_t thread_total_ns[3];
  uint64_t move_players_ns;
  uint64_t move_boosted_ns;
  uint64_t qt_rebuild_ns;
  uint64_t physics_move_ns;
  uint64_t collisions_eat_ns;
  uint64_t collisions_rigid_ns;
  uint64_t collisions_qt_query_ns;
  uint64_t collisions_food_query_ns;
  uint64_t collisions_eat_rigid_ns;
  uint64_t leaderboard_ns;
  uint64_t view_updates_ns;
  uint64_t net_flush_ns;
  uint64_t net_read_ns;
  uint64_t net_write_ns;
  uint64_t net_stall_ns;
  uint64_t profiler_overhead_ns;
} GameServerProfileStats;

extern GameServerProfileStats g_prof_stats;

static inline uint64_t prof_now_ns(void) {
#ifdef __linux__
  struct timespec ts;
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW, &ts);
  return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ULL + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
#elif defined(_WIN32)
  return 0;
#else
  return 0;
#endif
}

#define PROF_START_NS(var) uint64_t _t_start_##var = prof_now_ns()

#if defined(_WIN32)
  #ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
  #define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
  #endif
  #include <winsock2.h>
  #include <windows.h>
  #define PROF_ADD_NS(var) do { \
    uint64_t _dur = (prof_now_ns() - _t_start_##var); \
    InterlockedAdd64((LONG64 volatile *)&g_prof_stats.var, (LONG64)_dur); \
  } while(0)
#elif defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
  #define PROF_ADD_NS(var) do { \
    uint64_t _dur = (prof_now_ns() - _t_start_##var); \
    __atomic_fetch_add((unsigned long long *)&g_prof_stats.var, (unsigned long long)_dur, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); \
  } while(0)
#else
  #define PROF_ADD_NS(var)   g_prof_stats.var += (prof_now_ns() - _t_start_##var)
#endif

/* Count players that are truly alive (have cells in the world).
 * This is the single source of truth for join cap, stats, map scaler.
 * Never trust a cached counter — always verify cell_count. */
static inline int server_alive_count(const GameServer *srv) {
  int count = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < srv->active_player_count; i++) {
    const Player *p = &srv->players[srv->active_player_ids[i]];
    if (p->cell_count > 0 && !p->is_removed && !p->frozen &&
        (p->conn_id >= 0 || p->is_bot))
      count++;
  }
  return count;
}
/* Remove a player from the active_player_ids simulation list.
 * Safe to call even if the player is not in the list (no-op).
 * Must be called from EVERY player teardown path:
 * death, disconnect, kick, timeout, cleanup sweep. */
static inline void server_remove_active_player(GameServer *srv, int player_id) {
  for (int i = 0; i < srv->active_player_count; i++) {
    if (srv->active_player_ids[i] == player_id) {
      srv->active_player_ids[i] =
          srv->active_player_ids[--srv->active_player_count];
      return;
    }
  }
}

/* ── Data directory path resolver ────────────────────────────── */

/* Global pointer to the active data directory string.  Set once at startup
 * from config.data_dir.  Used by async_log.c (tokens.txt) which cannot
 * access the GameServer/ServerConfig structs. */
extern const char *g_data_dir;

/* Join g_data_dir + "/" + filename into a static thread-local buffer.

#include "spectator_sync.h"
#include "server.h"

#include <stddef.h>


static int spectator_cell_slot(
    const Cell *cell,
    const Cell *cell_base,
    int cell_capacity) {
  if (!cell ||
      !cell_base ||
      cell_capacity <= 0) {
    return -1;
  }

  ptrdiff_t slot =
      cell - cell_base;

  if (slot < 0 ||
      slot >= cell_capacity) {
    return -1;
  }

  return (int)slot;
}


static int spectator_push_cell(
    Cell **array,
    int capacity,
    int *count,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!array ||
      !count ||
      !cell ||
      *count < 0 ||
      *count >= capacity) {
    return -1;
  }

  array[(*count)++] =
      cell;

  return 0;
}


int spectator_build_exact_diff(
    Player *viewer,
    Cell *cell_base,
    int cell_capacity,
    Cell *const *current_nodes,
    int current_count,
    const uint8_t *current_view_state,
    uint32_t tick,
    SpectatorExactDiff *diff) {
  if (!viewer ||
      !cell_base ||
      cell_capacity <= 0 ||
      !current_view_state ||
      !diff ||
      current_count < 0 ||
      current_count > SPEC_MAX_VIEW_NODES ||
      (current_count > 0 &&
       !current_nodes)) {
    return -1;
  }

  if (!diff->add_cells ||
      !diff->update_cells ||
      !diff->eat_cells ||
      !diff->delete_cells ||
      diff->add_capacity < current_count ||
      diff->update_capacity < current_count ||
      diff->eat_capacity < viewer->client_count ||
      diff->delete_capacity < viewer->client_count) {
    return -1;
  }

  /*
   * Reserve before building or queuing anything. A later successful enqueue
   * must always be followed by an allocation-free tracking commit.
   */
  int required_capacity =
      current_count > 0
          ? current_count
          : 1;

  if (player_ensure_client_capacity(
          viewer,
          required_capacity) < 0) {
    return -1;
  }

  /*
   * Remove reused-slot handles first. Their former protocol IDs remain in the
   * viewer's compacted-drop queue until the eventual packet succeeds.
   */
  if (player_prune_stale_tracking(
          viewer,
          cell_base,
          cell_capacity) < 0) {
    return -1;
  }

  diff->add_count = 0;
  diff->update_count = 0;
  diff->eat_count = 0;
  diff->delete_count = 0;

  /*
   * Current shared snapshot:
   *
   * - already known by this connection -> UPDATE when appropriate;
   * - absent from this connection's exact known set -> ADD.
   */
  for (int index = 0;
       index < current_count;
       index++) {
    Cell *cell =
        current_nodes[index];

    int slot =
        spectator_cell_slot(
            cell,
            cell_base,
            cell_capacity);

    if (slot < 0 ||
        cell->is_removed) {
      return -1;
    }

    bool already_known =
        viewer->view_state &&
        vs_get(
            viewer->view_state,
            slot) == 1;

    if (!already_known) {
      if (spectator_push_cell(
              diff->add_cells,
              diff->add_capacity,
              &diff->add_count,
              cell) < 0) {
        return -1;
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (cell->is_moving ||
        cell->type == CELL_PLAYER ||
        cell->last_evt_tick == tick) {
      if (spectator_push_cell(
              diff->update_cells,
              diff->update_capacity,
              &diff->update_count,
              cell) < 0) {
        return -1;
      }
    }
  }

  /*
   * Previous exact per-connection snapshot:
   *
   * Anything absent from the current shared state must be explicitly removed
   * from this specific client. This is the critical distinction from the old
   * one-bit shared-synchronization design.
   */
  for (int index = 0;
       index < viewer->client_count;
       index++) {
    Cell *cell =
        viewer->client_nodes[index];

    int slot =
        spectator_cell_slot(
            cell,
            cell_base,
            cell_capacity);

    if (slot < 0)
      return -1;

    if (vs_get(
            current_view_state,
            slot) == 1) {
      continue;
    }

    if (cell->is_removed &&
        cell->killer_id != 0) {
      if (spectator_push_cell(
              diff->eat_cells,
              diff->eat_capacity,
              &diff->eat_count,
              cell) < 0) {
        return -1;
      }
    } else {
      if (spectator_push_cell(
              diff->delete_cells,
              diff->delete_capacity,
              &diff->delete_count,
              cell) < 0) {
        return -1;
      }
    }
  }

  return 0;
}

#ifndef SPECTATOR_SYNC_H
#define SPECTATOR_SYNC_H

#include "player.h"

#include <stdint.h>


/*
 * Packet-independent exact diff for a spectator consuming a shared current
 * snapshot.
 *
 * The shared group still performs one spatial query. Each connection, however,
 * compares that shared snapshot with its own exact known-cell set.
 */
typedef struct {
  Cell **add_cells;
  int add_capacity;
  int add_count;

  Cell **update_cells;
  int update_capacity;
  int update_count;

  Cell **eat_cells;
  int eat_capacity;
  int eat_count;

  Cell **delete_cells;
  int delete_capacity;
  int delete_count;
} SpectatorExactDiff;


/*
 * Builds a diff without committing the new snapshot to the viewer.
 *
 * The viewer's exact state therefore remains unchanged if packet enqueue
 * subsequently fails. Stale reused-slot handles may be pruned and placed in
 * viewer->compacted_drop_ids; those IDs remain queued until a packet succeeds.
 */
int spectator_build_exact_diff(
    Player *viewer,
    Cell *cell_base,
    int cell_capacity,
    Cell *const *current_nodes,
    int current_count,
    const uint8_t *current_view_state,
    uint32_t tick,
    SpectatorExactDiff *diff);


#endif /* SPECTATOR_SYNC_H */

/*
 * TLS support via runtime-loaded OpenSSL.
 *
 * Loads libssl-3-x64.dll and libcrypto-3-x64.dll at runtime using
 * LoadLibrary/GetProcAddress. Zero compile-time dependency on OpenSSL
 * headers or import libraries.
 *
 * If OpenSSL DLLs are not found on the system, tls_init() fails
 * gracefully and the server can fall back to plain WS.
 */

#include "tls.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "async_log.h"


#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#include <windows.h>
typedef HMODULE lib_handle;
#define LOAD_LIB(name) LoadLibraryA(name)
#define LOAD_SYM(lib, name) (void *)GetProcAddress(lib, name)
#define FREE_LIB(lib) FreeLibrary(lib)
#else
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <unistd.h>
typedef void *lib_handle;
#define LOAD_LIB(name) dlopen(name, RTLD_NOW)
#define LOAD_SYM(lib, name) dlsym(lib, name)
#define FREE_LIB(lib) dlclose(lib)
#endif

/* ── OpenSSL constants we need ───────────────────────────────── */

#define SSL_FILETYPE_PEM 1
#define SSL_ERROR_NONE 0
#define SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ 2
#define SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE 3
#define SSL_ERROR_ZERO_RETURN 6
#define SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL 5

/* ── Function pointer types ──────────────────────────────────── */

/* SSL_METHOD* TLS_server_method(void) */
typedef void *(*fn_TLS_server_method)(void);
/* SSL_CTX* SSL_CTX_new(const SSL_METHOD*) */
typedef void *(*fn_SSL_CTX_new)(void *method);
/* void SSL_CTX_free(SSL_CTX*) */
typedef void (*fn_SSL_CTX_free)(void *ctx);
/* int SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file(SSL_CTX*, const char*, int) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file)(void *ctx, const char *file,
                                               int type);
/* int SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file(SSL_CTX*, const char*, int) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file)(void *ctx, const char *file,
                                              int type);
/* int SSL_CTX_check_private_key(const SSL_CTX*) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_CTX_check_private_key)(void *ctx);
/* SSL* SSL_new(SSL_CTX*) */
typedef void *(*fn_SSL_new)(void *ctx);
/* void SSL_free(SSL*) */
typedef void (*fn_SSL_free)(void *ssl);
/* int SSL_set_fd(SSL*, int) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_set_fd)(void *ssl, int fd);
/* int SSL_accept(SSL*) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_accept)(void *ssl);
/* int SSL_read(SSL*, void*, int) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_read)(void *ssl, void *buf, int num);
/* int SSL_write(SSL*, const void*, int) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_write)(void *ssl, const void *buf, int num);
/* int SSL_shutdown(SSL*) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_shutdown)(void *ssl);
/* int SSL_get_error(const SSL*, int) */
typedef int (*fn_SSL_get_error)(void *ssl, int ret);
/* unsigned long ERR_get_error(void) */
typedef unsigned long (*fn_ERR_get_error)(void);
/* char* ERR_error_string(unsigned long, char*) */
typedef char *(*fn_ERR_error_string)(unsigned long e, char *buf);
/* long SSL_CTX_ctrl(SSL_CTX*, int, long, void*) */
typedef long (*fn_SSL_CTX_ctrl)(void *ctx, int cmd, long larg, void *parg);
/* long SSL_ctrl(SSL*, int, long, void*) */
typedef long (*fn_SSL_ctrl)(void *ssl, int cmd, long larg, void *parg);
/* long SSL_CTX_set_mode(SSL_CTX*, long) */
typedef long (*fn_SSL_CTX_set_mode)(void *ctx, long mode);

#define SSL_CTRL_MODE 33
#define SSL_MODE_ENABLE_PARTIAL_WRITE 0x00000001L
#define SSL_MODE_ACCEPT_MOVING_WRITE_BUFFER 0x00000002L
#define SSL_MODE_AUTO_RETRY 0x00000004L

/* SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb - server-side ALPN selection callback */
typedef int (*alpn_select_cb_t)(void *ssl, const unsigned char **out,
                                unsigned char *outlen, const unsigned char *in,
                                unsigned int inlen, void *arg);
typedef void (*fn_SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb)(void *ctx, alpn_select_cb_t cb,
                                              void *arg);

/* ALPN callback: always select http/1.1 */
static int alpn_select_http11_cb(void *ssl, const unsigned char **out,
                                 unsigned char *outlen, const unsigned char *in,
                                 unsigned int inlen, void *arg) {
  (void)ssl;
  (void)arg;
  async_log("[TLS] ALPN callback invoked, client offers %u bytes of protos\n",
            inlen);
  unsigned int i = 0;
  while (i < inlen) {
    unsigned char plen = in[i];
    if (plen == 8 && i + 1 + 8 <= inlen &&
        memcmp(&in[i + 1], "http/1.1", 8) == 0) {
      *out = &in[i + 1];
      *outlen = 8;
      return 0;
    }
    i += 1 + plen;
  }
  static const unsigned char http11[] = "http/1.1";
  *out = http11;
  *outlen = 8;
  return 0;
}

/* ── Loaded function pointers ────────────────────────────────── */

static struct {
  lib_handle libssl;
  lib_handle libcrypto;
  bool loaded;

  fn_TLS_server_method TLS_server_method;
  fn_SSL_CTX_new SSL_CTX_new;
  fn_SSL_CTX_free SSL_CTX_free;
  fn_SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file;
  fn_SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file;
  fn_SSL_CTX_check_private_key SSL_CTX_check_private_key;
  fn_SSL_new SSL_new;
  fn_SSL_free SSL_free;
  fn_SSL_set_fd SSL_set_fd;
  fn_SSL_accept SSL_accept;
  fn_SSL_read SSL_read;
  fn_SSL_write SSL_write;
  fn_SSL_shutdown SSL_shutdown;
  fn_SSL_get_error SSL_get_error;
  fn_ERR_get_error ERR_get_error;
  fn_ERR_error_string ERR_error_string;
  fn_SSL_CTX_ctrl SSL_CTX_ctrl;
  fn_SSL_ctrl SSL_ctrl;
  fn_SSL_CTX_set_mode SSL_CTX_set_mode;
  fn_SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb;
} ssl_funcs = {0};

/* ── Dynamic loading ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void unload_openssl_libs(void) {
  if (ssl_funcs.libssl) {
    FREE_LIB(ssl_funcs.libssl);
    ssl_funcs.libssl = NULL;
  }
  if (ssl_funcs.libcrypto) {
    FREE_LIB(ssl_funcs.libcrypto);
    ssl_funcs.libcrypto = NULL;
  }
  memset(&ssl_funcs, 0, sizeof(ssl_funcs));
}

static bool load_openssl_libs(void) {
  if (ssl_funcs.loaded)
    return true;

#ifdef _WIN32
  /* Try OpenSSL 3.x DLL names first, then 1.1.x */
  ssl_funcs.libcrypto = LOAD_LIB("libcrypto-3-x64.dll");
  ssl_funcs.libssl = LOAD_LIB("libssl-3-x64.dll");

  if (!ssl_funcs.libssl || !ssl_funcs.libcrypto) {
    /* Try 1.1.x names */
    if (ssl_funcs.libssl)
      FREE_LIB(ssl_funcs.libssl);
    if (ssl_funcs.libcrypto)
      FREE_LIB(ssl_funcs.libcrypto);
    ssl_funcs.libcrypto = LOAD_LIB("libcrypto-1_1-x64.dll");
    ssl_funcs.libssl = LOAD_LIB("libssl-1_1-x64.dll");
  }
#else
  ssl_funcs.libcrypto = LOAD_LIB("libcrypto.so");
  ssl_funcs.libssl = LOAD_LIB("libssl.so");
#endif

  if (!ssl_funcs.libssl || !ssl_funcs.libcrypto) {
    unload_openssl_libs();
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: Could not load OpenSSL DLLs\n");
    async_log("[TLS] Make sure libssl and libcrypto DLLs are in your PATH\n");
    return false;
  }

/* Helper macro to load one function */
#define LOAD_SSL_FN(name)                                                      \
  ssl_funcs.name = (fn_##name)LOAD_SYM(ssl_funcs.libssl, #name);               \
  if (!ssl_funcs.name) {                                                       \
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: Could not find %s in libssl\n", #name);            \
    unload_openssl_libs();                                                     \
    return false;                                                              \
  }

#define LOAD_CRYPTO_FN(name)                                                   \
  ssl_funcs.name = (fn_##name)LOAD_SYM(ssl_funcs.libcrypto, #name);            \
  if (!ssl_funcs.name) {                                                       \
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: Could not find %s in libcrypto\n", #name);         \
    unload_openssl_libs();                                                     \
    return false;                                                              \
  }

  LOAD_SSL_FN(TLS_server_method);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_CTX_new);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_CTX_free);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_CTX_check_private_key);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_new);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_free);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_set_fd);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_accept);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_read);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_write);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_shutdown);
  LOAD_SSL_FN(SSL_get_error);
  LOAD_CRYPTO_FN(ERR_get_error);
  LOAD_CRYPTO_FN(ERR_error_string);

  ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_ctrl =
      (fn_SSL_CTX_ctrl)LOAD_SYM(ssl_funcs.libssl, "SSL_CTX_ctrl");
  ssl_funcs.SSL_ctrl =
      (fn_SSL_ctrl)LOAD_SYM(ssl_funcs.libssl, "SSL_ctrl");

  /* SSL_CTX_set_mode might be a macro in headers; fallback to SSL_CTX_ctrl */
  ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_set_mode =
      (fn_SSL_CTX_set_mode)LOAD_SYM(ssl_funcs.libssl, "SSL_CTX_set_mode");

  ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb =
      (fn_SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb)LOAD_SYM(ssl_funcs.libssl,
                                              "SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb");

#undef LOAD_SSL_FN
#undef LOAD_CRYPTO_FN

  ssl_funcs.loaded = true;
  async_log("[TLS] OpenSSL loaded successfully\n");
  return true;
}

static inline long ssl_ctx_set_mode(void *ctx, long mode) {
  if (ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_set_mode) {
    return ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_set_mode(ctx, mode);
  }
  if (ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_ctrl) {
    return ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_ctrl(ctx, SSL_CTRL_MODE, mode, NULL);
  }
  return 0;
}

static inline long ssl_set_mode(void *ssl, long mode) {
  if (ssl_funcs.SSL_ctrl) {
    return ssl_funcs.SSL_ctrl(ssl, SSL_CTRL_MODE, mode, NULL);
  }
  return 0;
}

/* ── TLS context ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */

struct tls_ctx {
  void *ssl_ctx; /* SSL_CTX* */
};

struct tls_conn {
  void *ssl; /* SSL* */
};

/* ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */

tls_ctx *tls_init(const char *cert_path, const char *key_path) {
  if (!load_openssl_libs())
    return NULL;

  void *method = ssl_funcs.TLS_server_method();
  if (!method) {
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: TLS_server_method() failed\n");
    unload_openssl_libs();
    return NULL;
  }

  void *ssl_ctx = ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_new(method);
  if (!ssl_ctx) {
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: SSL_CTX_new() failed\n");
    unload_openssl_libs();
    return NULL;
  }

  /* Enable SSL_MODE_ACCEPT_MOVING_WRITE_BUFFER and SSL_MODE_AUTO_RETRY
   * to allow non-blocking retry when send_buf reallocates or moves */
  ssl_ctx_set_mode(ssl_ctx,
                   SSL_MODE_ACCEPT_MOVING_WRITE_BUFFER |
                       SSL_MODE_ENABLE_PARTIAL_WRITE |
                       SSL_MODE_AUTO_RETRY);

  /* Load certificate */
  if (ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file(ssl_ctx, cert_path,
                                             SSL_FILETYPE_PEM) != 1) {
    unsigned long err = ssl_funcs.ERR_get_error();
    char errbuf[256];
    ssl_funcs.ERR_error_string(err, errbuf);
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: Failed to load certificate '%s': %s\n", cert_path,
           errbuf);
    ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_free(ssl_ctx);
    unload_openssl_libs();
    return NULL;
  }

  /* Load private key */
  if (ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file(ssl_ctx, key_path,
                                            SSL_FILETYPE_PEM) != 1) {
    unsigned long err = ssl_funcs.ERR_get_error();
    char errbuf[256];
    ssl_funcs.ERR_error_string(err, errbuf);
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: Failed to load private key '%s': %s\n", key_path,
           errbuf);
    ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_free(ssl_ctx);
    unload_openssl_libs();
    return NULL;
  }

  /* Verify key matches cert */
  if (ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_check_private_key(ssl_ctx) != 1) {
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: Certificate and private key don't match!\n");
    ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_free(ssl_ctx);
    unload_openssl_libs();
    return NULL;
  }

  tls_ctx *ctx = (tls_ctx *)malloc(sizeof(tls_ctx));
  if (!ctx) {
    ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_free(ssl_ctx);
    unload_openssl_libs();
    return NULL;
  }
  ctx->ssl_ctx = ssl_ctx;

  /* Set ALPN callback to select http/1.1 so browsers use HTTP/1.1
   * for WebSocket upgrades instead of HTTP/2. */
  if (ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb) {
    ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_set_alpn_select_cb(ctx->ssl_ctx, alpn_select_http11_cb,
                                         NULL);
    async_log("[TLS] ALPN callback set (http/1.1)\n");
  }

  async_log("[TLS] Context initialized (cert: %s, key: %s)\n", cert_path,
         key_path);
  return ctx;
}

tls_conn *tls_accept(tls_ctx *ctx, tls_socket_t sock) {
  if (!ctx || !ssl_funcs.loaded)
    return NULL;

  void *ssl = ssl_funcs.SSL_new(ctx->ssl_ctx);
  if (!ssl) {
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: SSL_new() failed\n");
    return NULL;
  }

  ssl_set_mode(ssl,
               SSL_MODE_ACCEPT_MOVING_WRITE_BUFFER |
                   SSL_MODE_ENABLE_PARTIAL_WRITE |
                   SSL_MODE_AUTO_RETRY);

  if (ssl_funcs.SSL_set_fd(ssl, (int)sock) != 1) {
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: SSL_set_fd() failed\n");
    ssl_funcs.SSL_free(ssl);
    return NULL;
  }

  int ret = ssl_funcs.SSL_accept(ssl);
  if (ret != 1) {
    int err = ssl_funcs.SSL_get_error(ssl, ret);
    async_log("[TLS] ERROR: SSL_accept failed (ssl_error=%d)\n", err);

    /* Drain the error queue */
    unsigned long ssl_err;
    while ((ssl_err = ssl_funcs.ERR_get_error()) != 0) {
      char errbuf[256];
      ssl_funcs.ERR_error_string(ssl_err, errbuf);
      async_log("[TLS]   %s\n", errbuf);
    }

    ssl_funcs.SSL_free(ssl);
    return NULL;
  }

  tls_conn *conn = (tls_conn *)malloc(sizeof(tls_conn));
  if (!conn) {
    ssl_funcs.SSL_free(ssl);
    return NULL;
  }
  conn->ssl = ssl;
  return conn;
}

int tls_read(tls_conn *conn, void *buf, int len) {
  if (!conn || !conn->ssl || !buf || len <= 0)
    return TLS_IO_FATAL;

  int n = ssl_funcs.SSL_read(
      conn->ssl,
      buf,
      len);

  if (n > 0)
    return n;

  int error =
      ssl_funcs.SSL_get_error(
          conn->ssl,
          n);

  if (error == SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ)
    return TLS_IO_WANT_READ;

  if (error == SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE)
    return TLS_IO_WANT_WRITE;

  if (error == SSL_ERROR_ZERO_RETURN)
    return 0;

  async_log(
      "[TLS] SSL_read fatal error: ssl_err=%d n=%d\n",
      error,
      n);

  unsigned long detail;

  while ((detail = ssl_funcs.ERR_get_error()) != 0) {
    char message[256];
    ssl_funcs.ERR_error_string(
        detail,
        message);

    async_log(
        "[TLS] detail: %s\n",
        message);
  }

  return TLS_IO_FATAL;
}


int tls_write(tls_conn *conn, const void *buf, int len) {
  if (!conn || !conn->ssl || !buf || len <= 0)
    return TLS_IO_FATAL;

  int n = ssl_funcs.SSL_write(
      conn->ssl,
      buf,
      len);

  if (n > 0)
    return n;

  int error =
      ssl_funcs.SSL_get_error(
          conn->ssl,
          n);

  if (error == SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ)
    return TLS_IO_WANT_READ;

  if (error == SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE)
    return TLS_IO_WANT_WRITE;

  async_log(
      "[TLS] SSL_write fatal error: ssl_err=%d n=%d\n",
      error,
      n);

  unsigned long detail;

  while ((detail = ssl_funcs.ERR_get_error()) != 0) {
    char message[256];
    ssl_funcs.ERR_error_string(
        detail,
        message);

    async_log(
        "[TLS] detail: %s\n",
        message);
  }

  return TLS_IO_FATAL;
}


void tls_close(tls_conn *conn) {
  if (!conn)
    return;
  if (conn->ssl) {
    ssl_funcs.SSL_shutdown(conn->ssl);
    ssl_funcs.SSL_free(conn->ssl);
  }
  free(conn);
}

void tls_shutdown(tls_ctx *ctx) {
  if (!ctx)
    return;
  if (ctx->ssl_ctx)
    ssl_funcs.SSL_CTX_free(ctx->ssl_ctx);
  free(ctx);
  unload_openssl_libs();
}

bool tls_is_available(void) { return ssl_funcs.loaded; }

#ifndef TOTAL_SKIP_H
#define TOTAL_SKIP_H

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>


/*
 * Complete set of conditions required before an alive player's visibility
 * processing may be skipped for the current tick.
 *
 * This helper is intentionally pure and allocation-free so the optimization
 * can be regression-tested independently of the complete GameServer.
 */
typedef struct {
  bool has_moving_own;
  bool send_ping;
  bool skip_leaderboard;
  bool skip_ghost;

  uint32_t dirty_count;

  int removed_count;
  int spawned_count;
  int moving_dynamic_count;
  int compacted_drop_count;

  bool force_full_diff;
} TotalSkipInputs;


static inline bool total_skip_is_safe(
    const TotalSkipInputs *inputs) {
  if (!inputs)
    return false;

  return
      !inputs->has_moving_own &&
      !inputs->send_ping &&
      inputs->skip_leaderboard &&
      inputs->skip_ghost &&
      inputs->dirty_count == 0 &&
      inputs->removed_count == 0 &&
      inputs->spawned_count == 0 &&
      inputs->moving_dynamic_count == 0 &&
      inputs->compacted_drop_count == 0 &&
      !inputs->force_full_diff;
}


#endif /* TOTAL_SKIP_H */

#ifndef VEC2_H
#define VEC2_H

#include <math.h>

typedef struct {
    double x;
    double y;
} Vec2;

static inline Vec2 vec2(double x, double y) {
    return (Vec2){x, y};
}

static inline Vec2 vec2_add(Vec2 a, Vec2 b) {
    return (Vec2){a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y};
}

static inline Vec2 vec2_sub(Vec2 a, Vec2 b) {
    return (Vec2){a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y};
}

static inline Vec2 vec2_scale(Vec2 v, double s) {
    return (Vec2){v.x * s, v.y * s};
}

static inline double vec2_dist2(Vec2 a, Vec2 b) {
    double dx = a.x - b.x;
    double dy = a.y - b.y;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy;
}

static inline double vec2_dist(Vec2 a, Vec2 b) {
    return sqrt(vec2_dist2(a, b));
}

static inline double vec2_length(Vec2 v) {
    return sqrt(v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y);
}

static inline Vec2 vec2_normalize(Vec2 v) {
    double len = vec2_length(v);
    if (len == 0.0) return (Vec2){0, 0};
    return (Vec2){v.x / len, v.y / len};
}

static inline double vec2_angle(Vec2 v) {
    return atan2(v.y, v.x);
}

static inline Vec2 vec2_from_angle(double angle) {
    return (Vec2){cos(angle), sin(angle)};
}

static inline Vec2 vec2_clone(Vec2 v) {
    return v;
}

#endif /* VEC2_H */

#ifndef VIEW_DIFF_H
#define VIEW_DIFF_H

#include "cell.h"
#include "config.h"
#include "quadtree.h"

#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>


typedef enum {
  VIEW_DEPARTURE_KEEP = 0,
  VIEW_DEPARTURE_EAT,
  VIEW_DEPARTURE_DELETE,
} ViewDeparture;


#if defined(__GNUC__) && defined(__SSE2__)
#include <emmintrin.h> /* SSE2 intrinsics */
#endif

static inline bool view_rect_contains_cell(
    Rect area,
    const Cell *cell) {
  if (!cell)
    return false;

#if defined(__GNUC__) && defined(__SSE2__)
  /* SSE2: compare both x,y simultaneously in packed doubles.
   * 2 SIMD comparisons instead of 4 scalar branches. */
  __m128d pos = _mm_set_pd(cell->position.y, cell->position.x);
  __m128d lo  = _mm_set_pd(area.miny, area.minx);
  __m128d hi  = _mm_set_pd(area.maxy, area.maxx);
  int mask = _mm_movemask_pd(
      _mm_and_pd(_mm_cmpge_pd(pos, lo),
                 _mm_cmple_pd(pos, hi)));
  return mask == 0x3; /* both x and y in range */
#else
  return
      cell->position.x >= area.minx &&
      cell->position.x <= area.maxx &&
      cell->position.y >= area.miny &&
      cell->position.y <= area.maxy;
#endif
}


static inline ViewDeparture view_classify_departure(
    const Cell *cell,
    Rect retain_area,
    bool enforce_retain_area) {
  if (!cell)
    return VIEW_DEPARTURE_DELETE;

  if (cell->is_removed) {
    return cell->killer_id != 0
        ? VIEW_DEPARTURE_EAT
        : VIEW_DEPARTURE_DELETE;
  }

  if (enforce_retain_area &&
      !view_rect_contains_cell(
          retain_area,
          cell)) {
    return VIEW_DEPARTURE_DELETE;
  }

  return VIEW_DEPARTURE_KEEP;
}


/*
 * Append only when the connection can retain enough metadata to delete this
 * cell later. The view_state value may be 0 for a dirty-path candidate or 2
 * for a candidate marked during a complete diff.
 */
static inline bool view_track_append(
    Cell **nodes,
    uint64_t *handles,
    int *count,
    int capacity,
    uint8_t *view_state,
    Cell *cell_base,
    int cell_capacity,
    Cell *cell) {
  if (!nodes ||
      !handles ||
      !count ||
      !view_state ||
      !cell_base ||
      !cell ||
      capacity < 0 ||
      cell_capacity <= 0) {
    return false;
  }

  ptrdiff_t cell_index =
      cell - cell_base;

  if (cell_index < 0 ||
      cell_index >= cell_capacity) {
    return false;
  }

  if (*count < 0)
    *count = 0;

  uint8_t state =
      vs_get(
          view_state,
          (int)cell_index);

  if (state == 1) {
    /*
     * Already tracked. Never append a duplicate pointer.
     */
    return false;
  }

  if (*count >= capacity) {
    /*
     * A candidate marked as "current" during a full diff must become unknown
     * again when capacity prevents tracking it.
     */
    vs_set(
        view_state,
        (int)cell_index,
        0);

    return false;
  }

  nodes[*count] =
      cell;

  handles[*count] =
      cell_handle_value(cell);

  (*count)++;

  vs_set(
      view_state,
      (int)cell_index,
      1);

  return true;
}


static inline bool view_track_remove_at(
    Cell **nodes,
    uint64_t *handles,
    int *count,
    int index,
    uint8_t *view_state,
    Cell *cell_base,
    int cell_capacity) {
  if (!nodes ||
      !handles ||
      !count ||
      !view_state ||
      !cell_base ||
      *count <= 0 ||
      index < 0 ||
      index >= *count) {
    return false;
  }

  Cell *removed =
      nodes[index];

  if (removed) {
    ptrdiff_t cell_index =
        removed - cell_base;

    if (cell_index >= 0 &&
        cell_index < cell_capacity) {
      vs_set(
          view_state,
          (int)cell_index,
          0);
    }
  }

  int last_index =
      --(*count);

  if (index != last_index) {
    nodes[index] =
        nodes[last_index];

    handles[index] =
        handles[last_index];
  }

  nodes[last_index] = NULL;
  handles[last_index] = 0;

  return true;
}


static inline bool view_track_remove_cell(
    Cell **nodes,
    uint64_t *handles,
    int *count,
    uint8_t *view_state,
    Cell *cell_base,
    int cell_capacity,
    Cell *target) {
  if (!nodes ||
      !handles ||
      !count ||
      !target) {
    return false;
  }

  for (int index = 0;
       index < *count;
       index++) {
    if (nodes[index] == target) {
      return view_track_remove_at(
          nodes,
          handles,
          count,
          index,
          view_state,
          cell_base,
          cell_capacity);
    }
  }

  return false;
}


#endif /* VIEW_DIFF_H */

#include "bot.h"
#include "bot_intelligence_engine.h"
#include "bot_social_engine.h"
#include "bot_movement_engine.h"
#include "bot_pool.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

/* Forward declaration — defined after bots_set_count */
static void bots_drain_pending(BotManager *mgr, GameServer *srv);

static bool ensure_bot_active_player(GameServer *srv, int player_id) {
  if (!srv || player_id < 0 || player_id >= MAX_PLAYERS) return false;
  Player *p = &srv->players[player_id];
  if (!p->active || p->is_removed || p->cell_count <= 0) return false;

  for (int ai = 0; ai < srv->active_player_count; ai++) {
    if (srv->active_player_ids[ai] == player_id) return true;
  }
  if (srv->active_player_count >= MAX_PLAYERS) return false;
  srv->active_player_ids[srv->active_player_count++] = player_id;
  return true;
}

#ifdef _MSC_VER
static __declspec(thread) uint32_t g_tls_bot_c_rng = 246813579U;
#else
static __thread uint32_t g_tls_bot_c_rng = 246813579U;
#endif

static inline double randf(void) {
  if (g_tls_bot_c_rng == 0) g_tls_bot_c_rng = 246813579U;
  g_tls_bot_c_rng ^= g_tls_bot_c_rng << 13;
  g_tls_bot_c_rng ^= g_tls_bot_c_rng >> 17;
  g_tls_bot_c_rng ^= g_tls_bot_c_rng << 5;
  return (double)g_tls_bot_c_rng / 4294967296.0;
}

static Vec2 get_spawn_position_for_sector(GameServer *srv, int col, int row) {
  double b_minx = srv->border.minx, b_maxx = srv->border.maxx;
  double b_miny = srv->border.miny, b_maxy = srv->border.maxy;
  double b_w = b_maxx - b_minx, b_h = b_maxy - b_miny;

  double cell_w = b_w / 5.0;
  double cell_h = b_h / 5.0;

  double sector_min_x = b_minx + col * cell_w;
  double sector_min_y = b_miny + row * cell_h;

  Vec2 pos;
  pos.x = sector_min_x + cell_w * (0.10 + randf() * 0.80);
  pos.y = sector_min_y + cell_h * (0.10 + randf() * 0.80);
  return pos;
}

void bots_init(BotManager *mgr, GameServer *srv, int count) {
  memset(mgr, 0, sizeof(*mgr));
  if (count > MAX_BOTS) count = MAX_BOTS;
  if (count > MAX_PLAYERS - 64) count = MAX_PLAYERS - 64;
  mgr->count = count;

  printf("[Bots] Initializing %d embedded C bots across 25 Grid Sectors (A1..E5)...\n", count);

  double b_minx = srv->border.minx, b_maxx = srv->border.maxx;
  double b_miny = srv->border.miny, b_maxy = srv->border.maxy;
  double b_w = b_maxx - b_minx, b_h = b_maxy - b_miny;
  double cell_w = b_w / 5.0, cell_h = b_h / 5.0;



  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
    memset(bot, 0, sizeof(*bot));

    /* Acquire player slot from the free stack (same pool as clients) */
    int pid = -1;
    if (srv->free_player_top >= 0) {
      pid = srv->free_player_stack[srv->free_player_top--];
    }
    if (pid < 0) {
      printf("[Bots] WARNING: No free player slot for bot %d\n", i);
      mgr->count = i;
      break;
    }

    bot->player_id = pid;
    bot->active = true;
    bot->chase_target_id = -1;
    bot_intel_init(bot);
    bot_social_init(bot);
    bot_movement_engine_init(bot);

    /* Roll traits */
    bot->personality = roll_personality();
    bot->iq_level    = roll_intelligence();
    bot->iq_profile  = get_iq_profile(bot->iq_level);
    emotions_init(&bot->emotions, &bot->personality);

    /* Equal Grid Sector Territory Assignment (A1..E5)
     * Distributes 960 bots uniformly (38 bots per sector) across all 25 map grid sectors */
    int sector_col = i % 5;        /* 0=A, 1=B, 2=C, 3=D, 4=E */
    int sector_row = (i / 5) % 5;  /* 0=1, 1=2, 2=3, 3=4, 4=5 */
    bot->home_sector_col = sector_col;
    bot->home_sector_row = sector_row;

    double sector_min_x = b_minx + sector_col * cell_w;
    double sector_min_y = b_miny + sector_row * cell_h;

    bot->territory_anchor_x = sector_min_x + cell_w * (0.20 + randf() * 0.60);
    bot->territory_anchor_y = sector_min_y + cell_h * (0.20 + randf() * 0.60);
    bot->roam_ticks = 0;
    bot->patrol_direction = ((pid % 2) == 0) ? 1 : -1;

    /* Roll identity */
    const char *bname = roll_bot_name(bot->personality.type, i);
    const char *bskin = roll_bot_skin(i);
    snprintf(bot->skin, sizeof(bot->skin), "%s", bskin);
    snprintf(bot->name, sizeof(bot->name), "%s", bname);

    /* Initialize player slot */
    Player *p = &srv->players[pid];
    player_init(p, pid);
    p->active = true;
    p->is_bot = true;
    p->conn_id = -1;
    p->protocol = 6;
    p->scale = 1.0;
    p->xp_boost = 1.0;
    p->mass_boost = 1.0;
    p->color = server_random_color();
    player_set_identity(p, bname, bskin);

    /* Spawn bot directly inside its assigned home sector */
    Vec2 pos = get_spawn_position_for_sector(srv, sector_col, sector_row);
    server_spawn_player(srv, p, pos);
    bot->spawn_tick = srv->ticks;

    if (p->cell_count > 0) {
      if (!ensure_bot_active_player(srv, pid)) {
        while (p->cell_count > 0)
          server_remove_cell(srv, p->cells[p->cell_count - 1]);
        bot->was_alive = false;
        bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 125;
      } else {
        bot->was_alive = true;
        bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 25;
      }
    } else {
      /* Initial cell allocation failed — retry in 5 seconds when pool recovers */
      bot->was_alive = false;
      bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 125;
    }
  }

  /* Initialize high-performance pthread worker pool for bot decisions */
  bot_pool_init(mgr, srv);
}

void bots_tick(BotManager *mgr, GameServer *srv) {
  if (!mgr) return;
  if (mgr->count == 0 && mgr->pending_target == 0) return;

  /* Drain pending batched spawn (50 bots/tick) if scale-up is queued */
  if (mgr->pending_target > mgr->count)
    bots_drain_pending(mgr, srv);

#define BOT_RESPAWN_BUDGET 128
  int respawns_this_tick = 0;

  for (int i = 0; i < mgr->count; i++) {
    BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
    if (!bot->active || bot->player_id < 0 || bot->player_id >= MAX_PLAYERS) continue;

    Player *p = &srv->players[bot->player_id];
    if (!p->active) continue;

    /* Respawn if dead */
    if (p->cell_count == 0) {
      if (bot->was_alive) {
        bot->was_alive = false;
        bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 25 + (bot_rng_u32(bot) % 25); /* 1-2s jittered death-to-respawn delay */
        server_remove_active_player(srv, bot->player_id);
        continue;
      }
      if ((int32_t)(srv->ticks - bot->next_respawn_tick) < 0) {
        continue;
      }

      if (respawns_this_tick >= BOT_RESPAWN_BUDGET) {
        /* Exceeded per-tick respawn budget — defer remaining respawns to subsequent ticks */
        continue;
      }

      respawns_this_tick++;

      bot->personality = roll_personality();
      bot->iq_level    = roll_intelligence();
      bot->iq_profile  = get_iq_profile(bot->iq_level);
      const char *bname = roll_bot_name(bot->personality.type, i + bot_rng_u32(bot));
      const char *bskin = roll_bot_skin(i + bot_rng_u32(bot));
      snprintf(bot->skin, sizeof(bot->skin), "%s", bskin);
      snprintf(bot->name, sizeof(bot->name), "%s", bname);
      player_set_identity(p, bname, bskin);

      /* Re-roll random home sector on respawn */
      int sector_col = bot_rng_u32(bot) % 5;
      int sector_row = bot_rng_u32(bot) % 5;
      bot->home_sector_col = sector_col;
      bot->home_sector_row = sector_row;

      double b_minx = srv->border.minx, b_maxx = srv->border.maxx;
      double b_miny = srv->border.miny, b_maxy = srv->border.maxy;
      double cell_w = (b_maxx - b_minx) / 5.0;
      double cell_h = (b_maxy - b_miny) / 5.0;

      bot->territory_anchor_x = (b_minx + sector_col * cell_w) + cell_w * (0.20 + randf() * 0.60);
      bot->territory_anchor_y = (b_miny + sector_row * cell_h) + cell_h * (0.20 + randf() * 0.60);

      Vec2 pos = get_spawn_position_for_sector(srv, sector_col, sector_row);
      server_spawn_player(srv, p, pos);
      if (p->cell_count == 0) {
        /* Spawn failed (cell pool exhausted) — jittered backoff 5-10 seconds */
        bot->was_alive = false;
        bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 125 + (bot_rng_u32(bot) % 125);
        continue;
      }
      if (!ensure_bot_active_player(srv, bot->player_id)) {
        while (p->cell_count > 0)
          server_remove_cell(srv, p->cells[p->cell_count - 1]);
        bot->was_alive = false;
        bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 125 + (bot_rng_u32(bot) % 125);
        continue;
      }
      bot->was_alive = true;
      bot->spawn_tick = srv->ticks;
      bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 25 + (bot_rng_u32(bot) % 25);
      bot->last_evaluated_tick = 0;
      emotions_init(&bot->emotions, &bot->personality);
      bot_social_init(bot);
      continue;
    }

    bot->was_alive = true;

    /* Update bot center position from cells before AI perceives */
    player_update_view_center(p, srv->ticks);
  }

  /* Phase 2 (Dedicated Bot AI Thread / Core 2): Evaluate all 960 bot decision trees */
  bot_pool_tick(mgr, srv);
}

int bots_count_alive(const BotManager *mgr, const GameServer *srv) {
  if (!mgr || !srv) return 0;
  int alive = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < mgr->count; i++) {
    const BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
    if (bot->active && bot->player_id >= 0 && bot->player_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
      if (srv->players[bot->player_id].active && srv->players[bot->player_id].cell_count > 0)
        alive++;
    }
  }
  return alive;
}

void bots_shutdown(BotManager *mgr, GameServer *srv) {
  if (!mgr) return;
  bot_pool_shutdown();

  for (int i = 0; i < mgr->count; i++) {
    BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
    if (bot->active && bot->player_id >= 0 && bot->player_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
      Player *p = &srv->players[bot->player_id];
      /* Reverse iteration: server_remove_cell() swap-removes from the array,
       * so forward iteration skips the element moved into the current slot. */
      while (p->cell_count > 0) {
        Cell *cell = p->cells[p->cell_count - 1];
        if (cell && !cell->is_removed)
          server_remove_cell(srv, cell);
        else
          p->cells[--p->cell_count] = NULL;
      }
      p->active = false;
      p->is_bot = false;
      bot->active = false;
      server_remove_active_player(srv, bot->player_id);
      bot->player_id = -1;
    }
  }
  mgr->count = 0;
}

void bots_set_count(BotManager *mgr, GameServer *srv, int target_count) {
  if (!mgr || !srv) return;
  if (target_count < 0) target_count = 0;
  if (target_count > MAX_BOTS) target_count = MAX_BOTS;
  if (target_count > MAX_PLAYERS - 64) target_count = MAX_PLAYERS - 64;

  int current = mgr->count;
  if (target_count == current && mgr->pending_target == 0) return;

  if (target_count > current) {
    /* Scale UP: defer to batched spawning in bots_tick (50 per tick) */
    mgr->pending_target = target_count;
    printf("[Bots] Live count update queued: %d -> %d (batched spawn)\n", current, target_count);
  } else {
    /* Scale DOWN: immediate — deactivate bots beyond target_count */
    mgr->pending_target = 0;
    for (int i = target_count; i < current; i++) {
      BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
      if (bot->active && bot->player_id >= 0 && bot->player_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
        Player *p = &srv->players[bot->player_id];
        p->active = false;  /* Deactivate immediately so worker threads skip */
        bot->active = false;
        /* Reverse iteration: server_remove_cell() swap-removes from the array,
         * so forward iteration skips the element moved into the current slot. */
        while (p->cell_count > 0) {
          Cell *cell = p->cells[p->cell_count - 1];
          if (cell && !cell->is_removed)
            server_remove_cell(srv, cell);
          else
            p->cells[--p->cell_count] = NULL;
        }
        int released_id = bot->player_id;
        p->is_bot = false;
        server_remove_active_player(srv, released_id);
        player_reset(p);
        if (srv->free_player_top < MAX_PLAYERS - 1) {
          srv->free_player_stack[++srv->free_player_top] = released_id;
        }
        bot->player_id = -1;
      }
    }

    mgr->count = target_count;
    printf("[Bots] Live count updated: %d -> %d active bots on the fly\n", current, target_count);
  }
}

/* Spawn up to BOTS_SPAWN_BATCH bots per tick when a pending scale-up is active.
 * Called from bots_tick() on the sim thread, same context as bots_init(). */
#define BOTS_SPAWN_BATCH 50

static void bots_drain_pending(BotManager *mgr, GameServer *srv) {
  if (mgr->pending_target <= mgr->count) {
    mgr->pending_target = 0;
    return;
  }

  int batch_end = mgr->count + BOTS_SPAWN_BATCH;
  if (batch_end > mgr->pending_target) batch_end = mgr->pending_target;

  for (int i = mgr->count; i < batch_end; i++) {
    BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
    memset(bot, 0, sizeof(*bot));

    /* Acquire player slot from the free stack (same pool as clients) */
    int pid = -1;
    if (srv->free_player_top >= 0) {
      pid = srv->free_player_stack[srv->free_player_top--];
    }
    if (pid < 0) {
      mgr->pending_target = 0;
      mgr->count = i;
      printf("[Bots] WARNING: No free player slots at %d bots\n", i);
      return;
    }

    bot->player_id = pid;
    bot->active = false; /* Kept inactive until fully initialized */
    bot->chase_target_id = -1;
    bot_intel_init(bot);
    bot_social_init(bot);
    bot_movement_engine_init(bot);
    bot->personality = roll_personality();
    bot->iq_level    = roll_intelligence();
    bot->iq_profile  = get_iq_profile(bot->iq_level);
    emotions_init(&bot->emotions, &bot->personality);

    const char *bname = roll_bot_name(bot->personality.type, i + bot_rng_u32(bot));
    const char *bskin = roll_bot_skin(i + bot_rng_u32(bot));
    snprintf(bot->skin, sizeof(bot->skin), "%s", bskin);
    snprintf(bot->name, sizeof(bot->name), "%s", bname);

    Player *p = &srv->players[pid];
    player_init(p, pid);
    p->active = true;
    p->is_bot = true;
    p->conn_id = -1;
    p->protocol = 6;
    p->scale = 1.0;
    p->color = server_random_color();
    bot->home_sector_col = i % 5;
    bot->home_sector_row = (i / 5) % 5;
    Vec2 pos = get_spawn_position_for_sector(srv, bot->home_sector_col, bot->home_sector_row);
    server_spawn_player(srv, p, pos);
    bot->spawn_tick = srv->ticks;

    if (p->cell_count > 0) {
      if (!ensure_bot_active_player(srv, pid)) {
        while (p->cell_count > 0)
          server_remove_cell(srv, p->cells[p->cell_count - 1]);
        bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 125;
      } else {
        bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 25;
      }
    } else {
      /* Batched cell allocation failed — retry in 5 seconds when pool recovers */
      bot->next_respawn_tick = srv->ticks + 125;
    }

    /* Lock-Free Atomic Publication: Publish bot as active ONLY when 100% ready */
    bot->active = true;
  }

  mgr->count = batch_end;

  if (mgr->count >= mgr->pending_target) {
    printf("[Bots] Batched spawn complete: %d active bots\n", mgr->count);
    mgr->pending_target = 0;
  }
}

/* Fast, thread-safe per-bot PRNG (XorShift32) */
static inline uint32_t bot_rng_u32(BotState *bot) {
  if (!bot || bot->rng_state == 0) {
    if (bot) bot->rng_state = (uint32_t)(bot->player_id + 1) * 314159265U + 123456789U;
    else return 123456789U;
  }
  uint32_t x = bot->rng_state;
  x ^= x << 13;
  x ^= x >> 17;
  x ^= x << 5;
  bot->rng_state = x;
  return x;
}

static inline double bot_rng_double(BotState *bot) {
  return (double)bot_rng_u32(bot) / 4294967296.0;
}

static inline double bot_split_boost(double radius) {
  if (radius <= 0.0) return 780.0;
  int idx = (int)(radius * 0.25);
  if (UNLIKELY(idx >= 2047)) return g_split_boost_table[2047];
  return g_split_boost_table[idx];
}

/* Social & Anti-Team API */
typedef struct {
  /* ── Cross-bot-readable fields (atomic for OpenMP safety) ──
   * Other bots' OpenMP threads read these to check alliance status.
   * Each bot only writes to its OWN social state. On x86-64 aligned
   * int loads/stores are already atomic, but _Atomic eliminates the
   * C standard UB classification. */
#ifdef _WIN32
  volatile long ally_pid;
  volatile long ally_bot_idx;
  char ally_name[32];
  volatile long trust_score_x1000;
#else
  _Atomic int ally_pid;
  _Atomic int ally_bot_idx;           /* Direct bot index in mgr->bots (or -1 if human) */
  char ally_name[32];
  _Atomic int trust_score_x1000;      /* Fixed-point ×1000 (e.g. 500 = 0.5) — avoids _Atomic double portability issues */
#endif
  uint32_t last_w_tick;
  int gratitude_w_pending;
  int pending_w_target_pid;
  uint32_t pending_w_tick;
  bool betrayed;

  /* Feed-split coordination signal — seqlock-protected.
   * All 4 fields (x, y, owner, tick) must be read as one coherent snapshot.
   * Writer: bump seq to ODD → write payload → bump seq to EVEN.
   * Reader: spin until seq_before == seq_after and both even. */
#ifdef _WIN32
  volatile long feed_split_seq;
  volatile long feed_split_signal_tick;
  volatile long feed_split_enemy_x_bits;
  volatile long feed_split_enemy_y_bits;
  volatile long feed_split_enemy_owner;
#else
  _Atomic uint32_t feed_split_seq;
  _Atomic uint32_t feed_split_signal_tick;
  _Atomic float feed_split_enemy_x;
  _Atomic float feed_split_enemy_y;
  _Atomic int feed_split_enemy_owner;
#endif
} BotSocialState;

/* Transparent accessors for trust_score (stored as _Atomic int ×1000).
 * Usage: double t = BOT_TRUST_GET(soc); BOT_TRUST_SET(soc, 0.5); */
#ifdef _WIN32
#define BOT_TRUST_GET(soc)       ((double)InterlockedCompareExchange(&(soc)->trust_score_x1000, 0, 0) / 1000.0)
#define BOT_TRUST_SET(soc, val)  InterlockedExchange(&(soc)->trust_score_x1000, (long)((val) * 1000.0))
#else
#define BOT_TRUST_GET(soc)       ((double)atomic_load_explicit(&(soc)->trust_score_x1000, memory_order_relaxed) / 1000.0)
#define BOT_TRUST_SET(soc, val)  atomic_store_explicit(&(soc)->trust_score_x1000, (int)((val) * 1000.0), memory_order_relaxed)
#endif

extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];

static inline void bot_social_send_feed_split_signal(int ally_bot_idx, uint32_t tick, float x, float y, int owner) {
  if (ally_bot_idx < 0 || ally_bot_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;
  BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[ally_bot_idx];
#ifdef _WIN32
  long bits_x, bits_y;
  memcpy(&bits_x, &x, sizeof(bits_x));
  memcpy(&bits_y, &y, sizeof(bits_y));
  InterlockedIncrement(&soc->feed_split_seq);                  /* Odd: write in progress */
  InterlockedExchange(&soc->feed_split_enemy_x_bits, bits_x);
  InterlockedExchange(&soc->feed_split_enemy_y_bits, bits_y);
  InterlockedExchange(&soc->feed_split_enemy_owner, (long)owner);
  InterlockedExchange(&soc->feed_split_signal_tick, (long)tick);
  InterlockedIncrement(&soc->feed_split_seq);                  /* Even: write complete */
#else
  atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&soc->feed_split_seq, 1, memory_order_release);  /* Odd */
  atomic_store_explicit(&soc->feed_split_enemy_x, x, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&soc->feed_split_enemy_y, y, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&soc->feed_split_enemy_owner, owner, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&soc->feed_split_signal_tick, tick, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&soc->feed_split_seq, 1, memory_order_release);  /* Even */
#endif
}

static inline uint32_t bot_social_get_feed_split_signal(int b_idx, float *out_x, float *out_y, int *out_owner) {
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return 0;
  BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[b_idx];
#ifdef _WIN32
  for (int spin = 0; spin < 8; spin++) {
    long before = InterlockedCompareExchange(&soc->feed_split_seq, 0, 0);
    if (before & 1) continue;
    uint32_t tick = (uint32_t)InterlockedCompareExchange(&soc->feed_split_signal_tick, 0, 0);
    long bits_x = InterlockedCompareExchange(&soc->feed_split_enemy_x_bits, 0, 0);
    long bits_y = InterlockedCompareExchange(&soc->feed_split_enemy_y_bits, 0, 0);
    int owner = (int)InterlockedCompareExchange(&soc->feed_split_enemy_owner, 0, 0);
    long after = InterlockedCompareExchange(&soc->feed_split_seq, 0, 0);
    if (before == after && !(after & 1)) {
      float fx = 0, fy = 0;
      memcpy(&fx, &bits_x, sizeof(fx));
      memcpy(&fy, &bits_y, sizeof(fy));
      if (out_x) *out_x = fx;
      if (out_y) *out_y = fy;
      if (out_owner) *out_owner = owner;
      return tick;
    }
  }
  return 0;
#else
  for (int spin = 0; spin < 8; spin++) {
    uint32_t before = atomic_load_explicit(&soc->feed_split_seq, memory_order_acquire);
    if (before & 1) continue;
    uint32_t tick = atomic_load_explicit(&soc->feed_split_signal_tick, memory_order_relaxed);
    float lx = atomic_load_explicit(&soc->feed_split_enemy_x, memory_order_relaxed);
    float ly = atomic_load_explicit(&soc->feed_split_enemy_y, memory_order_relaxed);
    int lowner = atomic_load_explicit(&soc->feed_split_enemy_owner, memory_order_relaxed);
    uint32_t after = atomic_load_explicit(&soc->feed_split_seq, memory_order_acquire);
    if (before == after && !(after & 1)) {
      if (out_x) *out_x = lx;
      if (out_y) *out_y = ly;
      if (out_owner) *out_owner = lowner;
      return tick;
    }
  }
  return 0;
#endif
}

static inline void bot_social_clear_feed_split_signal(int b_idx, uint32_t expected_tick) {
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS || expected_tick == 0) return;
  BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[b_idx];
#ifdef _WIN32
  InterlockedCompareExchange(&soc->feed_split_signal_tick, 0, (long)expected_tick);
#else
  uint32_t expected = expected_tick;
  atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&soc->feed_split_signal_tick, &expected, 0);
#endif
}

void bot_social_init(BotState *bot);
typedef struct {
  bool allow;
  const char *reason;
  double adjusted_score;
} BotVetoVerdict;

BotVetoVerdict bot_veto_evaluate(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, const BotIQProfile *iq, double target_x, double target_y, double action_score, double prey_mass, BotActionType action);
bool bot_can_split_safely(Player *me, uint32_t tick);
bool bot_can_eject_safely(Player *me, uint32_t tick);

/* Contraction API */
void bot_contraction_nudge(Player *me, GameServer *srv, double *out_target_x, double *out_target_y);

#endif /* BOT_H */

#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif







/* External candidates scorers from other C files */

/* score_alliance_support removed — wrapper for bot_social_eval_team_w_boost which is called directly */
BotCandidate score_juke_dodge(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq);
