/* score_friendship_w_initiation removed — wrapper for bot_social_eval_w_initiation which is called directly */
BotCandidate score_follow_big(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, double my_mass, BotState *bot);

void bot_social_update(BotState *bot, Player *me, BotPerception *perc, uint32_t tick, GameServer *srv);
bool bot_can_split_safely(Player *me, uint32_t tick);
bool bot_can_eject_safely(Player *me, uint32_t tick);

void bot_check_stale(BotState *bot, Player *me);
void bot_smooth_aim(BotState *bot, Player *me, double target_x, double target_y, double accuracy);



void bot_brain_decide(BotState *bot, GameServer *srv, Player *me) {
  /* ── TRICKSPLIT PHASE 2 HANDLER ──────────────────────────────────
   * If previous tick was a tricksplit phase 1, execute phase 2 NOW:
   * Change mouse to predicted dodge direction and split from back piece. */
  if (bot->tricksplit_phase == 1) {
    if ((srv->ticks - bot->tricksplit_tick) <= (BOT_AI_CADENCE + 2)) {
      me->mouse_target.x = bot->tricksplit_phase2_x;
      me->mouse_target.y = bot->tricksplit_phase2_y;
      bot->target_x = bot->tricksplit_phase2_x;
      bot->target_y = bot->tricksplit_phase2_y;
      me->split_requested = true;
      me->pending_splits = 1;
      bot->last_split_tick = srv->ticks;
      bot->tricksplit_phase = 0;
      return;
    }
    bot->tricksplit_phase = 0; /* Timeout — abort phase 2 */
  }

  /*
   * bot_pool.c now selects the complete decision cadence.
   *
   * Every scheduled decision receives a fresh perception snapshot:
   * urgent = 25 Hz, active = 12.5 Hz, calm = 6.25 Hz.
   */
  PROF_START_NS(brain_perceive_ns);
  bot_perceive(
      bot,
      srv,
      me,
      &bot->perception
  );
  PROF_ADD_NS(brain_perceive_ns);

  /* Step 2: Update emotional state, memory, spatial, social */
  PROF_START_NS(brain_updates_ns);
  emotions_update(&bot->emotions, me, bot->perception.urgency, bot->current_action, srv->ticks);
  bot_memory_update(bot, me, &bot->perception, srv->ticks, srv);
  /* bot_spatial_update removed — heatmap output was never read */
  bot_social_update(bot, me, &bot->perception, srv->ticks, srv);
  bot_intel_update(bot, me, srv);
  bot_movement_engine_update(bot, me, srv);
  PROF_ADD_NS(brain_updates_ns);

  /* Discrete Plan Override Check ("Unless They Have a Plan")
   * If the bot has an active strategic plan, execute the plan and bypass ordinary farming/roaming! */
  BotCandidate active_plan_cand;
  if (bot_intel_execute_discrete_plan(bot, me, srv, &active_plan_cand)) {
    me->mouse_target.x = active_plan_cand.target_x;
    me->mouse_target.y = active_plan_cand.target_y;
    bot->target_x = active_plan_cand.target_x;
    bot->target_y = active_plan_cand.target_y;
    if (active_plan_cand.should_split) { me->split_requested = true; me->pending_splits = active_plan_cand.split_count; }
    if (active_plan_cand.should_eject) { me->eject_requested = true; }
    return;
  }

  /*
   * Reuse metadata already calculated by player_update_view_center().
   *
   * Only the virus-specific poppable-cell bounds still require a conditional
   * cell scan, and that scan is skipped completely when proactive virus
   * steering cannot run.
   */
  BotSelfSnapshot self_snap = {0};

  self_snap.total_mass =
      me->total_mass;

  self_snap.cell_count =
      me->active_cell_count;

  self_snap.largest_cell =
      me->largest_cell;

  self_snap.smallest_cell =
      me->smallest_cell;

  if (me->largest_cell) {
    self_snap.largest_radius =
        me->largest_cell->radius;

    self_snap.largest_mass =
        me->largest_cell->mass;
  }

  if (me->smallest_cell) {
    self_snap.smallest_radius =
        me->smallest_cell->radius;

    self_snap.smallest_mass =
        me->smallest_cell->mass;
  } else {
    self_snap.smallest_radius =
        self_snap.largest_radius;

    self_snap.smallest_mass =
        self_snap.largest_mass;
  }

  if (me->cell_count < 16 &&
      srv->virus_count > 0 &&
      self_snap.largest_radius >
          100.0 * 1.118) {
    self_snap.pop_bbox_minx = 1e9;
    self_snap.pop_bbox_miny = 1e9;
    self_snap.pop_bbox_maxx = -1e9;
    self_snap.pop_bbox_maxy = -1e9;

    for (int i = 0;
         i < me->cell_count;
         i++) {
      Cell *cell = me->cells[i];

      if (!cell ||
          cell->is_removed ||
          cell->radius <=
              100.0 * 1.118) {
        continue;
      }

      self_snap.has_poppable_cell =
          true;

      if (cell->position.x <
          self_snap.pop_bbox_minx) {
        self_snap.pop_bbox_minx =
            cell->position.x;
      }

      if (cell->position.x >
          self_snap.pop_bbox_maxx) {
        self_snap.pop_bbox_maxx =
            cell->position.x;
      }

      if (cell->position.y <
          self_snap.pop_bbox_miny) {
        self_snap.pop_bbox_miny =
            cell->position.y;
      }

      if (cell->position.y >
          self_snap.pop_bbox_maxy) {
        self_snap.pop_bbox_maxy =
            cell->position.y;
      }
    }

    if (self_snap.has_poppable_cell) {
      self_snap.pop_bbox_minx -= 1200.0;
      self_snap.pop_bbox_miny -= 1200.0;
      self_snap.pop_bbox_maxx += 1200.0;
      self_snap.pop_bbox_maxy += 1200.0;
    }
  }

  double my_mass =
      self_snap.total_mass;

  double my_size =
      self_snap.largest_radius > 0.0
          ? self_snap.largest_radius
          : 31.6;

  bool friendship_w_pending = false;
  double friendship_w_x = 0.0, friendship_w_y = 0.0;

  /* Step 3: Compute effective tier weights */
  BotTierWeights tw = get_effective_weights(
    &bot->personality,
    bot->emotions.mass_tier,
    bot->personality.death_shift_survival,
    bot->personality.death_shift_farming,
    bot->personality.death_shift_hunting
  );

    /* ── DIRECT FRIENDSHIP W ──────────────────────────────────
     * Detect friendship W target BEFORE candidates. The actual mouse_target
     * override happens AFTER smooth_aim so it doesn't get overwritten. */
    {
      extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
      int b_idx = bot->player_id;
      if (b_idx >= 0 && b_idx < MAX_BOTS) {
        BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[b_idx];
        if (bot->personality.friendly_approach && soc->ally_pid < 0 &&
            my_mass > 80.0 && me->extra_decay_multiplier <= 2.0 &&
            !me->eject_requested && (srv->ticks % 30) == (unsigned)(b_idx % 30)) {

          /* Find a nearby similar-sized player to W toward */
          for (int i = 0; i < bot->perception.prey_count; i++) {
            BotEntity *other = &bot->perception.prey[i];
            if (other->dist > 800.0 || other->dist < 100.0) continue;
            if (other->can_split_eat) continue;
            if (!other->cell || other->cell->is_removed) continue;
            int opid = other->cell->owner_id;
            if (opid < 0 || opid >= MAX_PLAYERS || opid == me->id) continue;
            if (other->total_mass < my_mass * 0.20) continue;
            if (other->total_mass < 30.0) continue;

            friendship_w_x = other->cell->position.x;
            friendship_w_y = other->cell->position.y;
            friendship_w_pending = true;

            soc->ally_pid = opid;
            BOT_TRUST_SET(soc, 0.5);
            soc->last_w_tick = srv->ticks;
            break;
          }

          /* Also try equal-sized cells from threat list (not actually dangerous) */
          if (!friendship_w_pending) {
            for (int i = 0; i < bot->perception.threat_count; i++) {
              BotEntity *other = &bot->perception.threats[i];
              if (other->dist > 600.0 || other->dist < 100.0) continue;
              if (other->can_eat_me || other->can_split_eat) continue;
              if (other->danger > 0.3) continue;
              if (!other->cell || other->cell->is_removed) continue;
              int opid = other->cell->owner_id;
              if (opid < 0 || opid >= MAX_PLAYERS || opid == me->id) continue;
              if (other->cell->mass < 30.0) continue;

              friendship_w_x = other->cell->position.x;
              friendship_w_y = other->cell->position.y;
              friendship_w_pending = true;

              soc->ally_pid = opid;
              BOT_TRUST_SET(soc, 0.5);
              soc->last_w_tick = srv->ticks;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    /* Step 4: Context-Gated Candidate Collection — Streaming Selection.
     * Track the best and committed candidates inline instead of storing
     * all candidates in an array and scanning twice. */
    PROF_START_NS(brain_candidates_ns);

    /* Streaming selection state — no array allocation needed */
    typedef struct {
      BotCandidate best;
      BotCandidate committed;
      bool have_best;
      bool have_committed;
    } BotSelection;

    BotSelection sel = {0};
    BotActionType cmt_act = bot->committed_action;

    /* consider(): O(1) per candidate — tracks best score and committed action */
    #define CONSIDER(cand_expr) do { \
      BotCandidate _c = (cand_expr); \
      if (!sel.have_best || _c.score > sel.best.score) { \
        sel.best = _c; sel.have_best = true; \
      } \
      if (_c.action == cmt_act) { \
        sel.committed = _c; sel.have_committed = true; \
      } \
    } while(0)

    /* Also support the conditional pattern used by engine/social candidates */
    #define CONSIDER_IF(cand_expr) do { \
      BotCandidate _c = (cand_expr); \
      if (_c.action != BOT_ACT_NONE && _c.score > 0.0) { \
        if (!sel.have_best || _c.score > sel.best.score) { \
          sel.best = _c; sel.have_best = true; \
        } \
        if (_c.action == cmt_act) { \
          sel.committed = _c; sel.have_committed = true; \
        } \
      } \
    } while(0)

    /* Threat & Survival Candidates */
    if (bot->perception.threat_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER(score_flee(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, srv, bot));
      CONSIDER(score_anti_trap(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile));
      CONSIDER(score_virus_dodge(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw));
    }

    if (bot->perception.border_dist < 300.0 || bot->perception.corner_pressure > 0.05) {
      CONSIDER(score_center_reposition(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, srv));
      CONSIDER(score_border_pressure(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, srv));
    }

    /* Economy & Farming Candidates */
    CONSIDER(score_farm_route(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw));

    /* Hunting & Trapping Candidates */
    if (bot->perception.prey_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER(score_prey_chase(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, my_mass, bot));
      CONSIDER(score_corner_pin(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, srv));
      CONSIDER(score_pop_eat_followup(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw));
      CONSIDER(score_wall_pinch(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, srv, &bot->iq_profile));
      CONSIDER(score_ejection_bait(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile));
      CONSIDER(score_mass_sweep(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile, srv));
      if (my_mass >= 70.0) {
        CONSIDER(score_split_kill(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, my_mass, my_size, &bot->iq_profile));
      }
    }

    /* Small Bot Follow — trail bigger non-friend players */
    if (my_mass < 200.0 && bot->perception.threat_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER(score_follow_big(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, my_mass, bot));
    }

    /* Bait, Trap & Alliance Candidates (Requires mass >= 80) */
    if (my_mass >= 80.0) {
      CONSIDER(score_bait_trap(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile));
      /* Alliance support and friendship W are evaluated via bot_social_eval_* below */
      CONSIDER(score_feed_split_feeder(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile, bot, srv));
      CONSIDER(score_feed_split_splitter(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile, bot, srv));
    }

    /* Pro Human Survival Tactics */
    if (bot->perception.threat_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER(
          score_juke_dodge(
              me,
              &bot->perception,
              &bot->personality,
              tw,
              &bot->iq_profile
          )
      );

      if (bot->perception.virus_count > 0) {
        CONSIDER(
            score_virus_hide(
                me,
                &bot->perception,
                &bot->personality,
                tw
            )
        );
      }
    }

    if (me->cell_count > 1) {
      if (bot->perception.threat_count > 0) {
        CONSIDER(
            score_merge_bait(
                me,
                &bot->perception,
                &bot->personality,
                tw,
                &bot->iq_profile
            )
        );
      }

      CONSIDER(
          score_merge_regroup(
              me,
              &bot->perception,
              &bot->personality,
              tw
          )
      );

      CONSIDER(
          score_split_eat_pieces(
              me,
              &bot->perception,
              &bot->personality,
              tw,
              &bot->iq_profile
          )
      );

      CONSIDER(
          score_self_feed(
              me,
              &bot->perception,
              &bot->personality,
              tw
          )
      );
    }

    /* Virus Tactics Candidates */
    if (bot->perception.virus_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER(score_virus_shield(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw));
      if (my_mass >= 130.0) {
        CONSIDER(score_virus_fire(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile, bot, srv));
      }
      if (me->cell_count >= 16) {
        CONSIDER(score_virus_eat(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile));
      }
    }

    /* Advanced Combo Split Candidates */
    if (my_mass >= 120.0) {
      if (bot->iq_profile.can_popsplit) {
        CONSIDER(score_popsplit(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile));
      }
      CONSIDER(score_chain_eat_combo(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile));
      if (my_mass >= 250.0 && bot->iq_profile.can_tricksplit) {
        CONSIDER(score_tricksplit(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile, bot));
      }
      CONSIDER(score_team_feed_split(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile, bot));
      if (me->cell_count == 16) {
        CONSIDER(score_shift_16_split(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile, bot));
      }
      if (bot->perception.prey_count > 0) {
        CONSIDER(score_multi_split_aggression(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile));
      }
    }

    /* Next-Gen Bot Intelligence Engine Subsystems */
    CONSIDER_IF(bot_intel_eval_plan_chain(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));

    extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
    int b_idx = bot->player_id;
    bool has_ally = (b_idx >= 0 && b_idx < MAX_BOTS && g_bot_socials[b_idx].ally_pid >= 0);

    if (has_ally) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_intel_eval_team_synergy(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, bot, srv));
    }

    if (bot->perception.threat_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_intel_eval_escape_ray(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, tw, &bot->iq_profile, srv));
    }

    /* Master Social & Friendship Engine Subsystem Candidates */
    CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_w_initiation(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_w_response(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));

    if (has_ally) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_team_w_boost(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_team_split_shield(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_team_refeed(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    }

    CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_betrayal_revenge(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));

    if (bot->perception.virus_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_virus_sweeper(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    }

    if (has_ally) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_duo_formation_follow(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_cooperative_pincer(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_escort_bodyguard(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    }

    CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_nemesis_retaliation(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    CONSIDER_IF(bot_social_eval_intent_signaling(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));

    /* High-Intelligence Movement Engine Subsystem Candidates */
    if (has_ally) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_move_eval_duo_escort(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    }

    if (bot->perception.virus_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_move_eval_bezier_virus_detour(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    }

    CONSIDER_IF(bot_move_eval_organic_sector_patrol(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    if (bot->perception.threat_count > 0) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_move_eval_threat_repulsion_vector(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    }

    if (me->cell_count > 1) {
      CONSIDER_IF(bot_move_eval_remerge_flank_steering(bot, me, srv, &bot->perception));
    }

    /* Fallback Exploration / Roam */
    #undef CONSIDER
    #undef CONSIDER_IF

    /* Step 5: Pick winner with Commitment Window Persistence */
    /* Strategic Plan Persistence: if committed and not fleeing, maintain commitment */
    BotCandidate chosen_val = sel.best;
    if (srv->ticks < bot->commit_until_tick &&
        sel.best.action != BOT_ACT_FLEE && sel.best.action != BOT_ACT_ANTI_TRAP &&
        sel.have_committed) {
      chosen_val = sel.committed;
    }
    BotCandidate *chosen = &chosen_val;
    PROF_ADD_NS(brain_candidates_ns);

    /* Update commitment window for high-IQ combat/social plans */
    if (chosen->action == BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT || chosen->action == BOT_ACT_TRICKSPLIT ||
        chosen->action == BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED || chosen->action == BOT_ACT_CORNER_PIN ||
        chosen->action == BOT_ACT_BAIT_TRAP) {
      bot->committed_action = chosen->action;
      bot->commit_until_tick = srv->ticks + 18 + (bot_rng_u32(bot) % 15); /* 0.7-1.3 sec commitment */
    }

    /* ── HARD SAFETY OVERRIDE ──────────────────────────────────
     * If the chosen target would bring us CLOSER to a threat that can eat/split us,
     * and we'd enter their danger zone, override the target to flee away.
     * This prevents small bots from walking into bigger enemies. */
    if (chosen->action != BOT_ACT_FLEE && chosen->action != BOT_ACT_ANTI_TRAP &&
        chosen->action != BOT_ACT_EDGE_FLEE && chosen->action != BOT_ACT_VIRUS_SHIELD && bot->perception.threat_count > 0) {
      for (int ti = 0; ti < bot->perception.threat_count; ti++) {
        BotEntity *threat = &bot->perception.threats[ti];
        if (!threat->cell || threat->cell->is_removed) continue;
        if (!threat->can_eat_me && !threat->can_split_eat) continue;

        double tx = threat->cell->position.x;
        double ty = threat->cell->position.y;

        /* How far is our chosen target from this threat? */
        double tgt_dx = chosen->target_x - tx;
        double tgt_dy = chosen->target_y - ty;
        double tgt_dist_to_threat = sqrt(tgt_dx * tgt_dx + tgt_dy * tgt_dy);

        /* Danger zone using real server split physics:
         * Split range = threat_radius + 780 * pow(split_half, 0.0122) + safety buffer */
        double danger_zone;
        if (threat->can_split_eat) {
          double split_half = threat->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
          double boost = bot_split_boost(split_half);
          danger_zone = threat->cell->radius + boost + 80.0; /* 80u safety buffer */
        } else {
          danger_zone = threat->cell->radius + my_size + 50.0;
        }

        double our_dist_to_threat = threat->dist;

        /* Case 1: We're ALREADY inside the danger zone — flee immediately!
         * Don't care what the target is, get out NOW. */
        if (our_dist_to_threat < danger_zone) {
          double flee_dx = me->center.x - tx;
          double flee_dy = me->center.y - ty;
          double flee_dist = sqrt(flee_dx * flee_dx + flee_dy * flee_dy);
          if (flee_dist > 1.0) {
            chosen->target_x = me->center.x + (flee_dx / flee_dist) * 1200.0;
            chosen->target_y = me->center.y + (flee_dy / flee_dist) * 1200.0;
            chosen->should_split = false;
            chosen->should_eject = false;
            chosen->action = BOT_ACT_FLEE;
          }
          break;
        }

        /* Case 2: Smart preemptive flee — only for passive actions.
         * If the bot is actively hunting/chasing, let it proceed (veto handles safety).
         * But if roaming/farming, avoid walking into a split-eat threat's kill zone. */
        if (threat->can_split_eat &&
            chosen->action != BOT_ACT_CHASE &&
            chosen->action != BOT_ACT_SPLIT_KILL &&
            chosen->action != BOT_ACT_SPLIT_EAT &&
            chosen->action != BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT &&
            chosen->action != BOT_ACT_TRICKSPLIT &&
            chosen->action != BOT_ACT_MASS_SWEEP &&
            chosen->action != BOT_ACT_CORNER_PIN) {
          /* Only flee if target brings us DEEP inside the zone (80% penetration) */
          if (tgt_dist_to_threat < danger_zone * 0.80) {
            double flee_dx = me->center.x - tx;
            double flee_dy = me->center.y - ty;
            double flee_dist = sqrt(flee_dx * flee_dx + flee_dy * flee_dy);
            if (flee_dist > 1.0) {
              chosen->target_x = me->center.x + (flee_dx / flee_dist) * 1200.0;
              chosen->target_y = me->center.y + (flee_dy / flee_dist) * 1200.0;
              chosen->should_split = false;
              chosen->should_eject = false;
              chosen->action = BOT_ACT_FLEE;
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    /* Contraction nudge if applicable */
    bot_contraction_nudge(me, srv, &chosen->target_x, &chosen->target_y);

    bot->target_x = chosen->target_x;
    bot->target_y = chosen->target_y;
    bot->current_action = (int)chosen->action;

    if (chosen->should_split && !me->split_requested && bot_can_split_safely(me, srv->ticks)) {
      /* Estimate total prey mass near the split target for veto assessment.
       * The split-half will eat multiple cells in its path (snowball effect). */
      double prey_mass = 0.0;
      double split_r = my_size / 1.41421356;
      for (int pi = 0; pi < bot->perception.prey_count; pi++) {
        BotEntity *pr = &bot->perception.prey[pi];
        /* Only count prey we can eat (initially or after some growth) */
        if (pr->dist > my_size + 900.0) continue;
        if (pr->cell->radius > split_r * 1.5) continue; /* too big even after growth */
        /* Check if prey is roughly in the split direction */
        double pdx = pr->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
        double pdy = pr->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
        double tdx = chosen->target_x - me->center.x;
        double tdy = chosen->target_y - me->center.y;
        double tdist = sqrt(tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy);
        if (tdist > 1.0) {
          double dot = (pdx * tdx + pdy * tdy) / (tdist * sqrt(pdx * pdx + pdy * pdy) + 1.0);
          if (dot < 0.3) continue; /* Not in the split direction */
        }
        prey_mass += pr->cell->mass;
      }
      if (prey_mass < 30.0) prey_mass = 30.0;
      BotVetoVerdict v = bot_veto_evaluate(me, &bot->perception, &bot->personality, &bot->iq_profile, chosen->target_x, chosen->target_y, chosen->score, prey_mass, chosen->action);
      if (v.allow) {
        me->split_requested = true;
        int splits = (chosen->split_count > 1) ? chosen->split_count : 1;
        me->pending_splits = splits;
        bot->last_split_tick = srv->ticks;
        /* Track tricksplit phase transition */
        if (chosen->action == BOT_ACT_TRICKSPLIT) {
          bot->tricksplit_phase = 1;
          bot->tricksplit_tick = srv->ticks;
        }
      }
    }

    if (chosen->should_eject && bot_can_eject_safely(me, srv->ticks)) {
      me->eject_requested = true;

      /* Track W-count for VIRUS_FIRE to prevent over-feeding.
       * After 3 W's the virus fires and resets. Mark this position as
       * "done" so the bot won't re-feed the same virus. */
      if (chosen->action == BOT_ACT_VIRUS_FIRE) {
        bot->virus_fire_target_x = chosen->target_x;
        bot->virus_fire_target_y = chosen->target_y;
        bot->virus_fire_w_sent++;
        if (bot->virus_fire_w_sent >= 3) {
          bot->virus_fire_done_x = chosen->target_x;
          bot->virus_fire_done_y = chosen->target_y;
          bot->virus_fire_w_sent = 0;
        }
      }
    }


  /* Anti-Freeze Hard Guarantee: Never let mouse target sit at center or stay stale */
  double tdx = bot->target_x - me->center.x;
  double tdy = bot->target_y - me->center.y;
  double tdist = sqrt(tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy);
  if (tdist < 100.0 || bot->stale_ticks > 10) {
    double angle = bot_rng_double(bot) * 2.0 * M_PI;
    bot->target_x = me->center.x + cos(angle) * 1200.0;
    bot->target_y = me->center.y + sin(angle) * 1200.0;
    if (bot->stale_ticks > 10) bot->stale_ticks = 0;
  }

  /* Step 6: Motion smoothing & execution */
  bot_smooth_aim(bot, me, bot->target_x, bot->target_y, bot->iq_profile.aim_accuracy);

  /* ── PROACTIVE VIRUS STEERING (Multi-Cell Aware, Post-Smoothing) ────────
   * Applied AFTER smooth_aim so the deflection isn't diluted by the
   * smoothing alpha. Operates directly on the final me->mouse_target.
   *
   * Fixes for multi-cell scenarios:
   * 1. Scans srv->virus_nodes[] directly (not perception) so far-flung
   *    cells after multi-split can detect viruses outside BOT_SCAN_RADIUS.
   * 2. Per-virus deduplication: each virus contributes ONE deflection from
   *    the cell with the closest approach, preventing double-force.
   * 3. Conflicting deflection fallback: if opposing forces cancel out,
   *    dodge only the single most dangerous cell-virus pair. */
  if (me->cell_count < 16 && srv->virus_count > 0 &&
      bot->current_action != BOT_ACT_VIRUS_SHIELD &&
      bot->current_action != BOT_ACT_VIRUS_FIRE &&
      bot->current_action != BOT_ACT_VIRUS_EAT &&
      bot->current_action != BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT) {

    /* Per-virus best deflection: store the deflection from the worst cell.
     * Cap at 32 active — only nearby viruses matter, can't have 4096 on stack. */
    enum { VIRUS_STEER_CAP = 32 };
    double vir_steer_x[VIRUS_STEER_CAP];
    double vir_steer_y[VIRUS_STEER_CAP];
    double vir_force[VIRUS_STEER_CAP];
    int vir_active_count = 0;

    /* Track strongest single deflection for conflict fallback */
    double fallback_sx = 0.0, fallback_sy = 0.0;
    double fallback_force = 0.0;

    /* Use pre-computed poppable cell bounding box from BotSelfSnapshot.
     * This replaces a redundant cell-array scan — values computed at decision start. */
    double bbox_minx = self_snap.pop_bbox_minx;
    double bbox_miny = self_snap.pop_bbox_miny;
    double bbox_maxx = self_snap.pop_bbox_maxx;
    double bbox_maxy = self_snap.pop_bbox_maxy;
    bool has_poppable = self_snap.has_poppable_cell;

    if (has_poppable) {
      /* Margin already applied in self_snap */

      for (int vi = 0; vi < srv->virus_count; vi++) {
        Cell *v = srv->virus_nodes[vi];
        if (!v || v->is_removed) continue;

        /* Fast bbox reject — skip viruses nowhere near any poppable cell */
        if (v->position.x < bbox_minx || v->position.x > bbox_maxx ||
            v->position.y < bbox_miny || v->position.y > bbox_maxy) continue;

        /* For this virus, find which poppable cell has the closest approach */
        double best_perp_x = 0.0, best_perp_y = 0.0;
        double best_perp_dist = 1e9;
        double best_danger_r = 0.0;
        double best_path_ny = 0.0, best_path_nx = 0.0;
        double best_proj = 50.0, best_path_len = 2000.0;
        bool any_danger = false;

        for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
          Cell *my_cell = me->cells[ci];
          if (!my_cell || my_cell->is_removed) continue;
          /* Poppability: cell radius must exceed virus_radius * 1.118 */
          if (my_cell->radius <= v->radius * 1.118) continue;

          double vx = v->position.x - my_cell->position.x;
          double vy = v->position.y - my_cell->position.y;
          double vdist = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
          if (vdist > 1200.0) continue;

          /* This cell's trajectory to the smoothed mouse */
          double path_dx = me->mouse_target.x - my_cell->position.x;
          double path_dy = me->mouse_target.y - my_cell->position.y;
          double path_len = sqrt(path_dx * path_dx + path_dy * path_dy);
          if (path_len < 10.0) continue;

          double path_nx = path_dx / path_len;
          double path_ny = path_dy / path_len;

          double danger_r = v->radius + my_cell->radius + 80.0;
          double proj = vx * path_nx + vy * path_ny;
          if (proj < 0.0 || proj > path_len + danger_r) continue;

          double perp_x = vx - proj * path_nx;
          double perp_y = vy - proj * path_ny;
          double perp_dist = sqrt(perp_x * perp_x + perp_y * perp_y);

          if (perp_dist < danger_r && perp_dist < best_perp_dist) {
            best_perp_dist = perp_dist;
            best_perp_x = perp_x;
            best_perp_y = perp_y;
            best_danger_r = danger_r;
            best_path_nx = path_nx;
            best_path_ny = path_ny;
            best_proj = fmax(proj, 50.0);
            best_path_len = path_len;
            any_danger = true;
          }
        }

        if (any_danger && vir_active_count < VIRUS_STEER_CAP) {
          /* Geometrically exact mouse deflection to clear the virus.
           * The path goes from cell to mouse_target (path_len away).
           * The virus is at projection 'proj' along this path with
           * perpendicular distance 'perp_dist'. To make the deflected
           * path miss by danger_r, the mouse must shift perpendicular by:
           *   Δ = (danger_r - perp_dist + margin) * path_len / proj
           * A virus close to the cell (small proj) needs a larger mouse
           * shift; one far away needs less. */
          double clearance = best_danger_r - best_perp_dist + 20.0;
          double force = clearance * best_path_len / best_proj;
          if (force > 2000.0) force = 2000.0;
          if (force < 50.0) force = 50.0;

          double sx, sy;
          if (best_perp_dist > 1.0) {
            sx = -(best_perp_x / best_perp_dist) * force;
            sy = -(best_perp_y / best_perp_dist) * force;
          } else {
            sx = best_path_ny * force;
            sy = -best_path_nx * force;
          }

          vir_steer_x[vir_active_count] = sx;
          vir_steer_y[vir_active_count] = sy;
          vir_force[vir_active_count] = force;
          vir_active_count++;

          /* Track the strongest single deflection as fallback */
          if (force > fallback_force) {
            fallback_force = force;
            fallback_sx = sx;
            fallback_sy = sy;
          }
        }
      }

      if (vir_active_count > 0) {
        /* Sum all per-virus deflections */
        double total_sx = 0.0, total_sy = 0.0;
        double total_force = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < vir_active_count; i++) {
          total_sx += vir_steer_x[i];
          total_sy += vir_steer_y[i];
          total_force += vir_force[i];
        }

        double result_mag = sqrt(total_sx * total_sx + total_sy * total_sy);

        /* Conflict detection: if accumulated result is < 30% of total force,
         * opposing deflections are canceling each other out.
         * Fall back to dodging only the strongest single virus. */
        if (vir_active_count > 1 && result_mag < total_force * 0.30) {
          total_sx = fallback_sx;
          total_sy = fallback_sy;
        }

        me->mouse_target.x += total_sx;
        me->mouse_target.y += total_sy;
      }
    } /* has_poppable */
  }

  /* Apply friendship W AFTER smooth_aim so mouse_target isn't overwritten.
   * BUT: if feed-split feeder already set an eject this tick, don't override. */
  if (friendship_w_pending && !me->eject_requested) {
    me->mouse_target.x = friendship_w_x;
    me->mouse_target.y = friendship_w_y;
    me->eject_requested = true;
  }

  bot_check_stale(bot, me);
}

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include "mapscaler.h"
#include <math.h>

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

void bot_contraction_nudge(Player *me, GameServer *srv, double *out_target_x, double *out_target_y) {
  if (!srv->map_scaler.enabled) return;

  MapScaler *ms = &srv->map_scaler;
  if (ms->phase == PHASE_DANGER || ms->phase == PHASE_SHRINKING) {
    double minx, miny, maxx, maxy;
    mapscaler_get_spawn_border(ms, &minx, &miny, &maxx, &maxy);
    *out_target_x = clampd(*out_target_x, minx + 200.0, maxx - 200.0);
    *out_target_y = clampd(*out_target_y, miny + 200.0, maxy - 200.0);
  }
}

#include "bot.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "../../src/fast_math.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

static inline double randf(void) { return fast_random_double(); }

void emotions_init(BotEmotionalState *emo, const BotPersonality *p) {
  memset(emo, 0, sizeof(*emo));
  emo->confidence  = p->base_confidence;
  emo->anxiety     = p->base_anxiety;
  emo->curiosity   = p->base_curiosity;
  emo->aggression  = 0.3;
  emo->focus       = 0.5;
  emo->frustration = 0.0;
  emo->boredom     = 0.0;
  emo->last_mass   = 10.0;
}

void emotions_update(BotEmotionalState *emo, Player *me, double urgency, int last_action, uint32_t tick) {
  (void)last_action; (void)tick;
  /* Compute total mass */
  double total_mass = 0.0;
  if (me->active && me->cell_count > 0) {
    for (int i = 0; i < me->cell_count; i++) {
      if (me->cells[i] && !me->cells[i]->is_removed) {
        total_mass += me->cells[i]->mass;
      }
    }
  }

  /* Mass growth & peak */
  double mass_change = total_mass - emo->last_mass;
  emo->mass_growth_rate = emo->mass_growth_rate * 0.9 + mass_change * 0.1;
  emo->last_mass = total_mass;
  if (total_mass > emo->peak_mass) emo->peak_mass = total_mass;

  /* Classify Mass Tier: 0:small (<100), 1:medium (100-500), 2:large (500-2k), 3:dominant (>2k) */
  if (total_mass < 100.0) emo->mass_tier = 0;
  else if (total_mass < 500.0) emo->mass_tier = 1;
  else if (total_mass < 2000.0) emo->mass_tier = 2;
  else emo->mass_tier = 3;

  if (emo->mass_tier == 3) {
    emo->ticks_dominant++;
    /* Boredom builds during long dominance */
    if (emo->ticks_dominant > 500) {
      emo->boredom = clampd(emo->boredom + 0.0005, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
  } else {
    emo->boredom = clampd(emo->boredom - 0.002, 0.0, 1.0);
  }

  /* Emotional dynamics */
  /* Anxiety rises with urgency */
  emo->anxiety = clampd(emo->anxiety * 0.95 + urgency * 0.4 * 0.05, 0.0, 1.0);

  /* Confidence rises with mass tier and positive growth */
  double tier_conf_baseline = 0.3 + emo->mass_tier * 0.2;
  emo->confidence = clampd(emo->confidence * 0.98 + tier_conf_baseline * 0.02 + (emo->mass_growth_rate > 0 ? 0.01 : -0.005), 0.0, 1.0);

  /* Frustration decays slowly over time */
  emo->frustration = clampd(emo->frustration - 0.001, 0.0, 1.0);

  /* Momentum */
  if (emo->mass_growth_rate > 2.0) {
    emo->momentum = clampd(emo->momentum + 0.02, -1.0, 1.0);
  } else if (emo->mass_growth_rate < -2.0) {
    emo->momentum = clampd(emo->momentum - 0.02, -1.0, 1.0);
  } else {
    emo->momentum *= 0.99;
  }

  /* Attention drift simulation */
  if (randf() < 0.05) {
    emo->attention_drift = clampd(emo->attention_drift + (randf() - 0.5) * 0.1, 0.0, 0.5);
  }
}

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>



BotCandidate score_farm_route(Player *me,
                              BotPerception *perc,
                              const BotPersonality *p,
                              BotTierWeights tw) {
  BotCandidate c = {
      BOT_ACT_FARM,
      0.0,
      me->center.x,
      me->center.y,
      false,
      false,
      0
  };

  /*
   * Preserve the existing no-food movement floor.
   */
  if (perc->food_count == 0) {
    c.score = 0.05 * tw.farming;

    c.target_x =
        me->center.x +
        (me->mouse_target.x -
         me->center.x) *
            0.9;

    c.target_y =
        me->center.y +
        (me->mouse_target.y -
         me->center.y) *
            0.9;

    return c;
  }

  Cell *best_food =
      perc->nearest_safe_food;

  /*
   * Preserve the previous behavior when food exists but every candidate is
   * unsafe: return a zero-score farming candidate.
   */
  if (!best_food ||
      best_food->is_removed) {
    return c;
  }

  c.target_x =
      best_food->position.x;

  c.target_y =
      best_food->position.y;

  c.score =
      0.35 * tw.farming;

  (void)p;
  return c;
}

/*
 * bot_grid.c — Prefix-sum flat spatial grid for bot/collision queries
 *
 * Two-pass rebuild (O(N)):
 *   Pass 1: count cells per tile
 *   Pass 2: prefix-sum tile offsets, then scatter cells into flat array
 *
 * Query (O(K)):
 *   Iterate contiguous flat[start..start+count] spans of overlapping tiles.
 *   No overflow scan — all cells are always reachable.
 */

#include "bot_grid.h"
#include "server.h"

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#ifdef _OPENMP
#include <omp.h>
#endif

/* Compile-time safety: Cell::grid_qid[] must have at least MAX_OMP_THREADS slots */
_Static_assert(sizeof(((Cell *)0)->grid_qid) / sizeof(uint32_t) >= MAX_OMP_THREADS,
               "Cell::grid_qid[] is too small for MAX_OMP_THREADS");

void bot_grid_rebuild(BotGrid *g, GameServer *srv) {
  if (g->build_tick == srv->ticks)
    return;  /* already rebuilt this tick */

  /* Grid covers the full map border with 500-unit padding on each side
   * so cells slightly outside the border still get indexed. */
  double pad = 500.0;
  double gminx = srv->border.minx - pad;
  double gminy = srv->border.miny - pad;
  double gmaxx = srv->border.maxx + pad;
  double gmaxy = srv->border.maxy + pad;

  double width  = gmaxx - gminx;
  double height = gmaxy - gminy;

  if (width < 1.0) width = 1.0;
  if (height < 1.0) height = 1.0;

  double inv_cell_w = (double)BOT_GRID_DIM / width;
  double inv_cell_h = (double)BOT_GRID_DIM / height;

  /* ── Pre-pass: calculate total entries required across all tiles ─────
   * Large cells (e.g. Mother Cells radius 160-210, large players) span multiple tiles.
   * To guarantee multi-tile coverage, count entries for every tile each cell touches. */
  int total = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < srv->dynamic_count; i++) {
    Cell *c = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
    if (UNLIKELY(!c || c->is_removed))
      continue;

    double r = c->radius;
    int gx0 = (int)((c->position.x - r - gminx) * inv_cell_w);
    int gy0 = (int)((c->position.y - r - gminy) * inv_cell_h);
    int gx1 = (int)((c->position.x + r - gminx) * inv_cell_w);
    int gy1 = (int)((c->position.y + r - gminy) * inv_cell_h);
    /* Skip cells entirely outside the grid */
    if (gx1 < 0 || gy1 < 0 || gx0 >= BOT_GRID_DIM || gy0 >= BOT_GRID_DIM)
      continue;
    if (gx0 < 0) gx0 = 0;
    if (gy0 < 0) gy0 = 0;
    if (gx1 >= BOT_GRID_DIM) gx1 = BOT_GRID_DIM - 1;
    if (gy1 >= BOT_GRID_DIM) gy1 = BOT_GRID_DIM - 1;

    total += (gx1 - gx0 + 1) * (gy1 - gy0 + 1);
  }

  /* ── Ensure flat array is large enough BEFORE modifying grid state ─
   * 100% Transactional: if realloc fails, return before modifying g->tiles or g->minx
   * so the existing valid spatial grid remains intact. */
  if (total > g->flat_capacity) {
    int new_cap = total + (total >> 2); /* 1.25x headroom */
    if (new_cap < BOT_GRID_FLAT_CAP) new_cap = BOT_GRID_FLAT_CAP;
    Cell **new_flat = (Cell **)realloc(g->flat, (size_t)new_cap * sizeof(Cell *));
    if (new_flat) {
      g->flat = new_flat;
      g->flat_capacity = new_cap;
    } else {
      return;
    }
  }

  /* ── Publish updated grid dimensions ─────────────────────── */
  g->minx = gminx;
  g->miny = gminy;
  g->inv_cell_w = inv_cell_w;
  g->inv_cell_h = inv_cell_h;

  /* ── Pass 1: count cells per tile ─────────────────────────── */
  for (int y = 0; y < BOT_GRID_DIM; y++) {
    for (int x = 0; x < BOT_GRID_DIM; x++) {
      g->tiles[y][x].count = 0;
    }
  }

  for (int i = 0; i < srv->dynamic_count; i++) {
    Cell *c = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
    if (UNLIKELY(!c || c->is_removed))
      continue;

    double r = c->radius;
    int gx0 = (int)((c->position.x - r - gminx) * inv_cell_w);
    int gy0 = (int)((c->position.y - r - gminy) * inv_cell_h);
    int gx1 = (int)((c->position.x + r - gminx) * inv_cell_w);
    int gy1 = (int)((c->position.y + r - gminy) * inv_cell_h);
    if (gx1 < 0 || gy1 < 0 || gx0 >= BOT_GRID_DIM || gy0 >= BOT_GRID_DIM)
      continue;
    if (gx0 < 0) gx0 = 0;
    if (gy0 < 0) gy0 = 0;
    if (gx1 >= BOT_GRID_DIM) gx1 = BOT_GRID_DIM - 1;
    if (gy1 >= BOT_GRID_DIM) gy1 = BOT_GRID_DIM - 1;

    for (int gy = gy0; gy <= gy1; gy++) {
      for (int gx = gx0; gx <= gx1; gx++) {
        g->tiles[gy][gx].count++;
      }
    }
  }

  /* ── Prefix-sum: compute start offset for each tile ───────── */
  uint32_t offset = 0;
  for (int y = 0; y < BOT_GRID_DIM; y++) {
    for (int x = 0; x < BOT_GRID_DIM; x++) {
      g->tiles[y][x].start = offset;
      offset += g->tiles[y][x].count;
      g->tiles[y][x].count = 0; /* reset for pass 2 scatter */
    }
  }

  /* ── Pass 2: scatter cells into flat array ────────────────── */
  for (int i = 0; i < srv->dynamic_count; i++) {
    Cell *c = srv->dynamic_nodes[i];
    if (UNLIKELY(!c || c->is_removed))
      continue;

    double r = c->radius;
    int gx0 = (int)((c->position.x - r - gminx) * inv_cell_w);
    int gy0 = (int)((c->position.y - r - gminy) * inv_cell_h);
    int gx1 = (int)((c->position.x + r - gminx) * inv_cell_w);
    int gy1 = (int)((c->position.y + r - gminy) * inv_cell_h);
    if (gx1 < 0 || gy1 < 0 || gx0 >= BOT_GRID_DIM || gy0 >= BOT_GRID_DIM)
      continue;
    if (gx0 < 0) gx0 = 0;
    if (gy0 < 0) gy0 = 0;
    if (gx1 >= BOT_GRID_DIM) gx1 = BOT_GRID_DIM - 1;
    if (gy1 >= BOT_GRID_DIM) gy1 = BOT_GRID_DIM - 1;

    for (int gy = gy0; gy <= gy1; gy++) {
      for (int gx = gx0; gx <= gx1; gx++) {
        BotGridSpan *tile = &g->tiles[gy][gx];
        uint32_t idx = tile->start + tile->count;
        g->flat[idx] = c;
        tile->count++;
      }
    }
  }

  g->flat_count = total;
  g->build_tick = srv->ticks;
}


int bot_grid_query(const BotGrid *g, Rect area, Cell **out, int max_results) {
  int count = 0;

  /* Convert query rect to grid tile range */
  int x0 = (int)((area.minx - g->minx) * g->inv_cell_w);
  int y0 = (int)((area.miny - g->miny) * g->inv_cell_h);
  int x1 = (int)((area.maxx - g->minx) * g->inv_cell_w);
  int y1 = (int)((area.maxy - g->miny) * g->inv_cell_h);

  /* Guard: query rect entirely outside grid → no results */
  if (x1 < 0 || y1 < 0 || x0 >= BOT_GRID_DIM || y0 >= BOT_GRID_DIM)
    return 0;

  /* Clamp to grid bounds (after the guard, all ranges are valid) */
  if (x0 < 0) x0 = 0;
  if (y0 < 0) y0 = 0;
  if (x1 >= BOT_GRID_DIM) x1 = BOT_GRID_DIM - 1;
  if (y1 >= BOT_GRID_DIM) y1 = BOT_GRID_DIM - 1;

  /* Precompute query bounds for fast overlap test */
  double qminx = area.minx, qminy = area.miny;
  double qmaxx = area.maxx, qmaxy = area.maxy;

  Cell **flat = g->flat;
  int flat_count = g->flat_count;

  /* Thread-safe query deduplication:
   * Each OpenMP thread has its own sequence counter (thread-local) and
   * writes to its own slot in Cell::grid_qid[tid].  No cross-thread writes. */
#ifdef _OPENMP
  int tid = omp_get_thread_num();
#else
  int tid = 0;
#endif
  if (tid >= MAX_OMP_THREADS) tid = 0; /* safety clamp */

  static _Thread_local uint32_t tl_query_seq = 0;
  uint32_t q_id = ++tl_query_seq;
  if (UNLIKELY(q_id == 0)) q_id = ++tl_query_seq;

  /* Iterate tiles in the query range — each tile is a contiguous span */
  for (int gy = y0; gy <= y1 && count < max_results; gy++) {
    for (int gx = x0; gx <= x1 && count < max_results; gx++) {
      const BotGridSpan *tile = &g->tiles[gy][gx];
      uint32_t end = tile->start + tile->count;
      if ((int)end > flat_count) end = (uint32_t)flat_count;

      for (uint32_t i = tile->start; i < end && count < max_results; i++) {
        Cell *c = flat[i];

        if (UNLIKELY(c->is_removed || c->grid_qid[tid] == q_id))
          continue;

        c->grid_qid[tid] = q_id;

        /* Point-in-rect test using cell center + radius (AABB overlap) */
        double r = c->radius;
        double px = c->position.x;
        double py = c->position.y;

        if ((px + r >= qminx) & (px - r <= qmaxx) &
            (py + r >= qminy) & (py - r <= qmaxy)) {
          out[count++] = c;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return count;
}


void bot_grid_free(BotGrid *g) {
  if (g->flat) {
    free(g->flat);
    g->flat = NULL;
  }
  g->flat_count = 0;
  g->flat_capacity = 0;
}

/*
 * bot_grid.h — Prefix-sum flat spatial grid for bot perception queries
 *
 * Replaces fixed-bucket grid with a contiguous flat array.
 * No per-tile capacity limit, no global overflow, no dropped cells.
 *
 * Rebuild: O(N) two-pass — count per tile, prefix-sum, scatter.
 * Query:   O(K) — iterate contiguous spans of overlapping tiles.
 *
 * Memory layout: one flat Cell*[] array indexed by tile spans.
 * Each tile is a {start, count} pair into the flat array.
 */

#ifndef BOT_GRID_H
#define BOT_GRID_H

#include "config.h"    /* MAX_DYNAMIC for BOT_GRID_FLAT_CAP */
#include "cell.h"
#include "quadtree.h"  /* for Rect */

/* BOT_GRID_DIM, BOT_GRID_FLAT_CAP defined in config.h */

typedef struct {
  uint32_t start;  /* index into flat[] where this tile's cells begin */
  uint32_t count;  /* number of cells in this tile */
} BotGridSpan;

typedef struct {
  BotGridSpan tiles[BOT_GRID_DIM][BOT_GRID_DIM];

  /* Flat contiguous array of cell pointers — all tiles' cells packed together */
  Cell  **flat;
  int     flat_count;    /* total cells inserted */
  int     flat_capacity; /* allocated size of flat[] */

  /* Grid coordinate mapping (set once at rebuild) */
  double minx, miny;     /* grid origin (map min corner with padding) */
  double inv_cell_w;     /* 1.0 / tile_width — precomputed for fast indexing */
  double inv_cell_h;     /* 1.0 / tile_height */

  uint32_t build_tick;   /* tick when last rebuilt — init to UINT32_MAX to force first build */
} BotGrid;

/* Forward decl */
struct GameServer;

/*
 * Rebuild the grid from srv->dynamic_nodes[].
 * O(N) where N = srv->dynamic_count. Two-pass: count + scatter.
 *
 * Normal lifecycle:
 * - one initial build after startup spawning;
 * - one rebuild near the middle/end of each server_tick(), after movement,
 *   spawning, queued splits and ejection;
 * - bot AI reads the completed previous-tick snapshot.
 *
 * Thread-safe: rebuild is called only from the main simulation thread.
 */
void bot_grid_rebuild(BotGrid *g, struct GameServer *srv);

/*
 * Query cells overlapping the given rectangle.
 * Returns the number of cells written to out[].
 * O(K) where K = cells in the overlapping tiles.
 * No overflow — all cells in all tiles are always reachable.
 */
int bot_grid_query(const BotGrid *g, Rect area, Cell **out, int max_results);

/*
 * Free the dynamically allocated flat array.
 * Call during server shutdown.
 */
void bot_grid_free(BotGrid *g);

#endif /* BOT_GRID_H */

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include "../../src/fast_math.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

BotCandidate score_prey_chase(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, double my_mass, BotState *bot) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CHASE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->prey_count == 0) {
    bot->chase_active = false;
    bot->chase_ticks = 0;
    bot->chase_target_id = -1;
    return c;
  }

  /* ── CHASE WILLINGNESS GATE ──
   * In real play, only ~10% of players actively chase at any moment.
   * The rest farm/roam even when prey is visible.
   * Exceptions:
   *   - Already mid-chase (committed) → continue
   *   - Prey is very close (<300u, practically touching) → always eat
   *   - Split-kill opportunity (handled by score_split_kill separately)
   * Aggressive personalities get higher chase probability. */
  if (!bot->chase_active) {
    /* Check if any prey is close enough to eat on contact */
    bool prey_touching = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
      if (perc->prey[i].dist < 300.0) { prey_touching = true; break; }
    }
    if (!prey_touching) {
      /* Rotating chase slot: use bot ID + tick to create time-varying willingness.
       * Each bot gets a ~50-tick "chase window" every ~500 ticks.
       * split_aggression (0.2-1.3) scales the window size. */
      unsigned int slot = ((unsigned int)me->id * 7 + (unsigned int)(bot->chase_ticks / 50)) % 100;
      unsigned int threshold = (unsigned int)(10.0 + p->split_aggression * 12.0); /* 10-25% */
      if (slot >= threshold) {
        return c; /* Not our turn to chase — farm/roam instead */
      }
    }
  }

  /* Find my largest cell for speed/size calculations */
  double my_largest_r = 0.0;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed && me->cells[ci]->radius > my_largest_r)
      my_largest_r = me->cells[ci]->radius;
  }

  BotEntity *best = NULL;
  double best_val = -1.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[i];
    /* Exclude our ally friend from being targeted as prey! */
    extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
    int ally_pid = (me->id >= 0 && me->id < MAX_BOTS) ? g_bot_socials[me->id].ally_pid : -1;
    if (ally_pid >= 0 && prey->cell->owner_id == ally_pid) continue;
    bool unsafe_prey = false;
    for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
      BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[ti];
      if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
      double tdx = prey->cell->position.x - t->cell->position.x;
      double tdy = prey->cell->position.y - t->cell->position.y;
      double threat_split_half = t->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
      double threat_boost = bot_split_boost(threat_split_half);
      double safe_r = t->cell->radius + threat_boost + 700.0;
      if (tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy < safe_r * safe_r) {
        unsafe_prey = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (unsafe_prey) continue;

    /* Local Sector Distance Gate: Non-giant bots only chase prey in local sector (< 1500u) */
    if (my_mass < 2500.0 && prey->dist > 1500.0) continue;

    /* Skip smaller cells of the same owner — only chase the biggest one.
     * This prevents the bot from chasing a tiny split piece when the
     * player's main cell is the real prize. */
    if (prey->cell->owner_id >= 0) {
      bool bigger_exists = false;
      for (int j = 0; j < perc->prey_count; j++) {
        if (j == i) continue;
        BotEntity *other = &perc->prey[j];
        if (other->cell && !other->cell->is_removed &&
            other->cell->owner_id == prey->cell->owner_id &&
            other->cell->mass > prey->cell->mass) {
          bigger_exists = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (bigger_exists) continue;
    }

    /* ── HUMAN-LIKE: Minimum size advantage check ──
     * Real players don't chase something they can barely eat.
     * Require at least 2x mass advantage for active chasing.
     * Exception: prey literally touching us (< 200u) — eat what's in your mouth. */
    double mass_ratio = my_mass / (prey->cell->mass + 1.0);
    if (mass_ratio < 2.0 && prey->dist > 200.0) continue;

    /* ── HUMAN-LIKE: Speed futility check ──
     * Smaller cells move faster. If prey is faster than us and far away,
     * we'll never catch them. Don't even try.
     * Speed ∝ 1/radius, so compare radii. */
    double my_speed = bot_cell_speed(my_largest_r);
    double prey_speed = bot_cell_speed(prey->cell->radius);
    if (prey_speed > my_speed * 1.05 && prey->dist > 400.0) continue;

    double reward = prey->cell->mass;
    double cost = prey->dist / 500.0;
    double s = reward / (cost + 1.0);
    if (s > best_val) {
      best_val = s;
      best = prey;
    }
  }

  if (best) {
    double tx = best->cell->position.x;
    double ty = best->cell->position.y;

    /* ── Chase target tracking for timeout logic ── */
    int target_owner = best->cell->owner_id;
    if (target_owner != bot->chase_target_id) {
      /* New target — reset chase timer */
      bot->chase_target_id = target_owner;
      bot->chase_ticks = 0;
    }
    bot->chase_ticks++;

    /* ── HUMAN-LIKE: Chase timeout / give-up ──
     * Real players give up on unproductive chases.
     * chase_patience is personality-dependent (15-120 ticks). */
    uint32_t patience = (uint32_t)(p->chase_patience > 0 ? p->chase_patience : 30);
    if (bot->chase_ticks > patience) {
      /* Diminishing returns — score drops the longer we chase */
      double fatigue = 1.0 - clampd((double)(bot->chase_ticks - patience) / (double)patience, 0.0, 0.85);
      /* After 2x patience, essentially give up */
      if (fatigue < 0.15) {
        bot->chase_active = false;
        bot->chase_ticks = 0;
        bot->chase_target_id = -1;
        return c;
      }
      /* Gradually reduce commitment */
      best_val *= fatigue;
    }

    /* ── HUMAN-LIKE: Dynamic Hunting Styles & Interception Steering ──
     * Real players don't magnetic-track. They cut off escape vectors ahead of the prey (flanking),
     * angle toward map borders (wall pinning), or feign interest in food before a surprise turn. */
    double prey_vx = 0.0, prey_vy = 0.0;
    if (best->cell && best->cell->radius > 0.0) {
      double prey_speed = bot_cell_speed(best->cell->radius);
      double pdx = best->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
      double pdy = best->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
      double plen = sqrt(pdx * pdx + pdy * pdy);
      if (plen > 1.0) {
        prey_vx = (pdx / plen) * prey_speed;
        prey_vy = (pdy / plen) * prey_speed;
      }
    }

    /* Interception Prediction: aim 0.4s to 1.2s ahead of prey's velocity */
    double lead_time = 0.4 + (double)(bot->player_id % 5) * 0.15;
    double lead_x = tx + prey_vx * lead_time * 25.0;
    double lead_y = ty + prey_vy * lead_time * 25.0;

    int hunt_style = (bot->player_id + (bot->chase_ticks / 40)) % 3;

    if (hunt_style == 0) { /* HUNT_STYLE_FLANK: Cut off velocity vector ahead */
      tx = lead_x;
      ty = lead_y;
    } else if (hunt_style == 1) { /* HUNT_STYLE_PIN_WALL: Angle target toward nearest map border to block escape */
      double b_minx = 0.0, b_maxx = 14142.0, b_miny = 0.0, b_maxy = 14142.0;
      double dist_left = tx - b_minx, dist_right = b_maxx - tx;
      double dist_top = ty - b_miny, dist_bottom = b_maxy - ty;
      double min_bdist = fmin(fmin(dist_left, dist_right), fmin(dist_top, dist_bottom));

      if (min_bdist < 2000.0) {
        /* Angle mouse 25 deg between prey and nearest wall to cut off open-space escape */
        double wall_pull_x = (dist_left < dist_right) ? b_minx : b_maxx;
        double wall_pull_y = (dist_top < dist_bottom) ? b_miny : b_maxy;
        tx = tx * 0.75 + wall_pull_x * 0.25;
        ty = ty * 0.75 + wall_pull_y * 0.25;
      } else {
        tx = lead_x; ty = lead_y;
      }
    } else { /* HUNT_STYLE_FEIGN_FEEDS: Periodic human micro-distraction */
      bool feigning = ((bot->chase_ticks / 15) % 4 == 1);
      if (feigning && best->dist > 450.0) {
        /* Briefly look 35 degrees away to trick victim before surprise turn */
        double pdx = tx - me->center.x;
        double pdy = ty - me->center.y;
        tx = me->center.x + pdx * 0.85 - pdy * 0.35;
        ty = me->center.y + pdy * 0.85 + pdx * 0.35;
      } else {
        tx = lead_x; ty = lead_y;
      }
    }

    if (my_mass > 500.0 && me->cell_count <= 4) {
      double split_half_r = my_largest_r / 1.41421356;
      double boost = bot_split_boost(split_half_r);
      double split_range = my_largest_r + boost;

      if (best->dist > split_range * 0.80 && best->dist < split_range * 2.5) {
        /* ORBIT MODE: Position at split_range distance, offset toward prey's escape direction */
        double orbit_dist = split_range * 0.85;
        double dx = tx - me->center.x;
        double dy = ty - me->center.y;
        double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        if (d > 1.0) {
          double nx = dx / d;
          double ny = dy / d;
          tx = best->cell->position.x - nx * orbit_dist;
          ty = best->cell->position.y - ny * orbit_dist;

          double tangent_offset = 150.0;
          /* Alternate orbit direction based on bot ID for variety */
          if (me->id % 2 == 0) {
            tx += -ny * tangent_offset;
            ty +=  nx * tangent_offset;
          } else {
            tx +=  ny * tangent_offset;
            ty += -nx * tangent_offset;
          }
        }
      }
      /* else: prey is close enough for direct chase — fall through to normal targeting */
    }

    /* Lead Interception: project target coordinates if smart/genius IQ */
    if (bot->iq_profile.prey_prediction && (best->dx != 0 || best->dy != 0)) {
      double lead_time = clampd(best->dist / 400.0, 0.5, 3.0);
      /* Bigger bots use more aggressive lead — they need to cut off, not follow */
      if (my_mass > 500.0) lead_time *= 1.5;
      tx += (best->dx / (best->dist + 1.0)) * 120.0 * lead_time;
      ty += (best->dy / (best->dist + 1.0)) * 120.0 * lead_time;
    }

    c.target_x = tx;
    c.target_y = ty;

    double mem_chase_mod = (best->cell && best->cell->owner_id >= 0) ? bot_memory_get_chase_modifier(bot, best->cell->owner_id) : 1.0;
    c.score = clampd((0.8 + p->split_aggression * 0.8) * mem_chase_mod, 0.0, 3.2) * tw.hunting;

    /* ── Size-aware score scaling (reworked) ──
     * Small bots: almost never chase — farming is more productive.
     * Medium bots: moderate chase drive.
     * Big bots: strong chase but tempered by orbit patience. */
    if (my_mass < 80.0) {
      c.score *= 0.05; /* Tiny bots: farm, don't chase */
    } else if (my_mass < 200.0) {
      c.score *= 0.4;  /* Small-medium: opportunistic only */
    } else if (my_mass > 500.0) {
      c.score *= 1.5;  /* Big: confident hunter */
    }

    if (best->dist < 600.0) c.score += 0.35;

    bot->chase_active = true;
  } else {
    bot->chase_active = false;
    bot->chase_ticks = 0;
    bot->chase_target_id = -1;
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_corner_pin(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CORNER_PIN, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  double my_total = 0.0;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed) my_total += me->cells[ci]->mass;
  }

  /* Find the prey closest to a border (best pin target) */
  BotEntity *best_pin = NULL;
  double best_border_dist = 1e9;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!prey->cell || prey->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (prey->dist > 1500.0) continue;

    /* Skip prey whose owner has dangerous total_mass with multiple cells —
     * chasing toward a wall leaves us vulnerable to the owner's other cells. */
    if (prey->owner_cell_count > 1 && prey->total_mass >= my_total * 0.8) continue;
    double px = prey->cell->position.x;
    double py = prey->cell->position.y;
    double dL = px - srv->border.minx;
    double dR = srv->border.maxx - px;
    double dT = py - srv->border.miny;
    double dB = srv->border.maxy - py;
    double bd = fmin(fmin(dL, dR), fmin(dT, dB));
    if (bd < 1200.0 && bd < best_border_dist) {
      best_border_dist = bd;
      best_pin = prey;
    }
  }

  if (best_pin) {
    double px = best_pin->cell->position.x;
    double py = best_pin->cell->position.y;
    /* Angle chase vector 25 degrees toward open space side of prey to block escape */
    double map_cx = (srv->border.minx + srv->border.maxx) / 2.0;
    double map_cy = (srv->border.miny + srv->border.maxy) / 2.0;

    double open_angle = atan2(map_cy - py, map_cx - px);
    c.target_x = px + cos(open_angle) * 300.0;
    c.target_y = py + sin(open_angle) * 300.0;
    c.score = 3.82;
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_pop_eat_followup(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SPLIT_EAT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  double my_mass = 10.0, my_size = 10.0;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed && me->cells[ci]->mass > my_mass) {
      my_mass = me->cells[ci]->mass;
      my_size = me->cells[ci]->radius;
    }
  }
  if (my_mass < 70.0) return c;

  double split_half_r = my_size / 1.41421356;
  double boost = bot_split_boost(split_half_r);
  double split_range = my_size + boost;

  /* Detect small popped pieces (< 60 mass) from an enemy cell that recently popped */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[i];
    if (prey->cell->mass > 60.0 || prey->cell->mass < 10.0) continue;
    if (prey->dist > split_range) continue;

    /* Mass check: our split half must eat prey */
    if (split_half_r <= prey->cell->radius * 1.18) continue;

    /* Multi-cell owner check: a popped player has 16 cells. If their
     * total_mass is still large, their surviving pieces can eat us. */
    double split_half_mass = (split_half_r * split_half_r) / 100.0;
    if (prey->owner_cell_count > 2 && prey->total_mass > split_half_mass * 1.3) continue;

    c.target_x = prey->cell->position.x;
    c.target_y = prey->cell->position.y;
    c.score = 3.94;
    c.should_split = true;
    return c;
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_split_kill(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, double my_mass, double my_size, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SPLIT_KILL, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_split_kill || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;
  if (me->cell_count >= 16) return c; /* Hard limit: can't split at max cells */
  if (my_mass < 70.0) return c;

  /* Find largest cell to calculate true split-half radius when multi-celled */
  Cell *largest_cell = NULL;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed) {
      if (!largest_cell || me->cells[ci]->radius > largest_cell->radius)
        largest_cell = me->cells[ci];
    }
  }
  double split_half_r = (largest_cell ? largest_cell->radius : my_size) / 1.41421356;
  double split_half_mass = (split_half_r * split_half_r) / 100.0;

  /* Calculate vulnerable mass loss across all pieces if threats attack */
  double vulnerable_mass_loss = 0.0;
  bool pieces_safe = true;
  for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
    BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[ti];
    if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (!t->can_eat_me && !t->can_split_eat) continue;

    double t_split_half = t->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
    double t_boost = bot_split_boost(t_split_half);
    double t_range = t->cell->radius + t_boost + 100.0;
    if (t->dist < t_range) {
      pieces_safe = false;
      /* Sum mass of any cell piece that this threat can consume */
      for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
        if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed) {
          if (t->cell->radius > me->cells[ci]->radius * 1.118) {
            vulnerable_mass_loss += me->cells[ci]->mass;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  double comfort_penalty = pieces_safe ? 1.0 : 0.85;

  /* Check if we have a nearby ally (makes splitting safer) */
  extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
  int b_idx = me->id;
  bool has_ally = false;
  if (b_idx >= 0 && b_idx < MAX_BOTS) {
    BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[b_idx];
    if (soc->ally_pid >= 0 && BOT_TRUST_GET(soc) >= 0.4) {
      has_ally = true;
      comfort_penalty = 1.0;
    }
  }
  (void)has_ally;

  /* ── SPLIT PHYSICS (matching server exactly) ──
   * Server eat condition: hunter->radius > prey->radius * 1.118
   * We use 1.18 for safety margin (~2.8x mass ratio required) */
  double boost_dist = bot_split_boost(split_half_r);
  double total_reach = my_size + boost_dist;
  double effective_range = total_reach * iq->split_range;

  double best_score = 0.0;
  double best_tx = me->center.x, best_ty = me->center.y;

  /* Try each prey as a potential aim target direction */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *aim_prey = &perc->prey[i];
    if (aim_prey->cell->mass < 10.0) continue;
    if (aim_prey->dist > effective_range) continue;

    /* Compute aim direction toward this prey */
    double aim_dx = aim_prey->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
    double aim_dy = aim_prey->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
    double aim_dist = sqrt(aim_dx * aim_dx + aim_dy * aim_dy);
    if (aim_dist < 1.0) continue;
    double aim_nx = aim_dx / aim_dist;
    double aim_ny = aim_dy / aim_dist;

    /* ── AGGREGATE PATH EATING SIMULATION ──
     * Scan all prey along this trajectory. Sort by distance (closest first).
     * Simulate the split-half growing as it eats each cell (snowball effect). */

    /* Collect all prey in the path cone */
    typedef struct { int idx; double proj; } PathPrey;
    PathPrey in_path[32];
    int path_count = 0;

    for (int j = 0; j < perc->prey_count && path_count < 32; j++) {
      BotEntity *p2 = &perc->prey[j];
      double dx = p2->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
      double dy = p2->cell->position.y - me->center.y;

      /* Project onto aim direction */
      double proj = dx * aim_nx + dy * aim_ny;
      if (proj < my_size * 0.3 || proj > total_reach) continue;

      /* Perpendicular distance from trajectory line */
      double perp = fabs(dx * aim_ny - dy * aim_nx);

      /* Must be close enough to the path to be eaten (use generous threshold) */
      if (perp > split_half_r * 1.5) continue;

      in_path[path_count].idx = j;
      in_path[path_count].proj = proj;
      path_count++;
    }

    if (path_count == 0) continue;

    /* Sort by projection distance (closest first = eaten first) */
    for (int a = 0; a < path_count - 1; a++) {
      for (int b = a + 1; b < path_count; b++) {
        if (in_path[b].proj < in_path[a].proj) {
          PathPrey tmp = in_path[a];
          in_path[a] = in_path[b];
          in_path[b] = tmp;
        }
      }
    }

    /* Simulate eating: split half grows as it eats each cell */
    double sim_mass = split_half_mass;
    double sim_r = split_half_r;
    double total_harvest = 0.0;
    int cells_eaten = 0;

    for (int k = 0; k < path_count; k++) {
      BotEntity *target = &perc->prey[in_path[k].idx];
      double dx = target->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
      double dy = target->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
      double perp = fabs(dx * aim_ny - dy * aim_nx);

      /* Can our current (growing) split-half eat this cell? */
      double eat_threshold = sim_r - target->cell->radius / 3.0;
      if (sim_r <= target->cell->radius * 1.118 || eat_threshold < 1.0 || perp > eat_threshold)
        continue;

      /* EAT IT — grow the split half */
      sim_mass += target->cell->mass;
      sim_r = sqrt(sim_mass * 100.0);
      total_harvest += target->cell->mass;
      cells_eaten++;
    }

    if (total_harvest < 30.0) continue; /* Not worth splitting for crumbs */

    /* Calculated Net Profit Trade Rule:
     * If a smaller piece might be eaten, ONLY execute if total_harvest >= vulnerable_mass_loss * 1.30! */
    if (vulnerable_mass_loss > 0.0 && total_harvest < (vulnerable_mass_loss * 1.30)) {
      continue; /* Net gain is below 1.3x loss — skip uncalculated trade */
    }

    /* Score based on harvest ratio and cell count */
    double harvest_ratio = total_harvest / split_half_mass;
    double score = (2.20 + harvest_ratio * 0.8 + cells_eaten * 0.35) * (tw.hunting + 0.3);
    score *= (0.85 + p->split_aggression * 0.45);
    if (score > 3.85) score = 3.85;
    score *= comfort_penalty; /* Reduced if over split_comfort, boosted by ally */

    /* Threat proximity check: penalize ONLY if threats can still eat us AFTER harvest.
     * If our grown split-half is too big for threats to eat, the split is SAFE. */
    if (perc->threat_count > 0 && perc->nearest_threat_dist < 1200.0) {
      bool still_vulnerable = false;
      for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
        BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[ti];
        if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
        if (!t->can_eat_me && !t->can_split_eat) continue;
        /* Can threat's split-half eat our GROWN cell? */
        double t_split_half_r = t->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
        if (t_split_half_r > sim_r * 1.118) {
          still_vulnerable = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (still_vulnerable) {
        score *= 0.4; /* Genuine danger — reduce score */
      }
      /* If NOT vulnerable after harvest, NO penalty — this split is worth it! */
    }

    /* Multi-cell owner check: if the prey we're splitting on has OTHER cells
     * (same owner) that are bigger than our split-half, they can eat us.
     * Use total_mass from perception to detect this. */
    if (aim_prey->total_mass > sim_mass * 1.5 && aim_prey->owner_cell_count > 1) {
      score *= 0.3; /* Prey's other cells are dangerous post-split */
    }

    if (score > best_score) {
      best_score = score;
      best_tx = aim_prey->cell->position.x;
      best_ty = aim_prey->cell->position.y;

      /* Determine multi-split count when harvesting multiple prey cells in cluster */
      int splits = 1;
      if (my_mass >= 350.0 && cells_eaten >= 2 && me->cell_count <= 4) {
        if (cells_eaten >= 5 && me->cell_count == 1) splits = 4;
        else if (cells_eaten >= 3 && me->cell_count <= 2) splits = 3;
        else splits = 2;
      }
      c.split_count = splits;
    }
  }

  if (best_score > 0.0) {
    c.target_x = best_tx;
    c.target_y = best_ty;
    /* Scale harvest score so big cluster splits win decision loop */
    c.score = clampd(best_score, 1.20, 3.80);
    c.should_split = true;
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── FOLLOW BIG PLAYER ──────────────────────────────────────────
 * Small bots trail behind larger non-friend players at a safe distance.
 * This mimics the common agar.io behavior of small cells following big
 * ones, hoping to grab scraps from their kills or just tagging along.
 * Only activates for small bots (< 200 mass), keeps outside split range,
 * and never follows friends/allies. */
BotCandidate score_follow_big(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, double my_mass, BotState *bot) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_FOLLOW, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};

  /* Only small bots follow — bigger bots have their own agenda */
  if (my_mass > 200.0) return c;
  if (perc->threat_count == 0) return c;

  /* Get ally pid to exclude friends */
  extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
  int b_idx = me->id;
  int ally_pid = (b_idx >= 0 && b_idx < MAX_BOTS) ? g_bot_socials[b_idx].ally_pid : -1;

  /* Find the best non-friend threat to follow:
   * - Must be significantly bigger (at least 3x our mass)
   * - Must not be our ally
   * - Prefer closer targets
   * - Prefer bigger targets (more scraps potential) */
  BotEntity *follow_target = NULL;
  double best_follow_score = -1.0;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;

    /* Skip friends/allies */
    if (ally_pid >= 0 && t->cell->owner_id == ally_pid) continue;

    /* Must be much bigger — we're following, not challenging */
    double their_mass = t->total_mass > 0.0 ? t->total_mass : (t->cell->radius * t->cell->radius / 100.0);
    if (their_mass < my_mass * 3.0) continue;

    /* Don't follow if too far away (>900u) — stay in local sector */
    if (t->dist > 900.0) continue;

    /* Don't follow if too close (<400u) — we'll get eaten */
    if (t->dist < 400.0) continue;

    /* Score: prefer closer + bigger targets */
    double dist_score = 1.0 - (t->dist / 2000.0);
    double mass_score = clampd(their_mass / 1000.0, 0.1, 1.0);
    double score = dist_score * 0.6 + mass_score * 0.4;

    if (score > best_follow_score) {
      best_follow_score = score;
      follow_target = t;
    }
  }

  if (!follow_target) return c;

  /* Calculate safe following position:
   * Stay at 120% of their split range, trailing slightly behind.
   * If they're moving, position behind their movement direction. */
  double tx = follow_target->cell->position.x;
  double ty = follow_target->cell->position.y;
  double fdx = me->center.x - tx;
  double fdy = me->center.y - ty;
  double fdist = sqrt(fdx * fdx + fdy * fdy);

  /* Safe distance: just outside their split+boost range */
  double their_r = follow_target->cell->radius;
  double split_half = their_r / 1.41421356;
  double split_boost = bot_split_boost(split_half);
  double safe_dist = their_r + split_boost + 250.0; /* pad 250u beyond split range */

  if (fdist < 1.0) {
    /* Directly on top — move to a random offset */
    double angle = fast_random_double() * 2.0 * M_PI;
    c.target_x = tx + cos(angle) * safe_dist;
    c.target_y = ty + sin(angle) * safe_dist;
  } else {
    /* Trail at safe distance, on our side of the target */
    c.target_x = tx + (fdx / fdist) * safe_dist;
    c.target_y = ty + (fdy / fdist) * safe_dist;
  }

  /* Score: moderate — beats basic roaming (0.08) but loses to farming,
   * fleeing, or actual hunting. Curiosity personality boosts it. */
  c.score = 0.15 + p->base_curiosity * 0.08 + best_follow_score * 0.05;
  c.score *= tw.hunting; /* Use hunting tier weight */

  return c;
}

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

#ifdef _MSC_VER
static __declspec(thread) uint32_t g_tls_bot_intel_rng = 543216789U;
#else
static __thread uint32_t g_tls_bot_intel_rng = 543216789U;
#endif

static inline double randf(void) {
  if (g_tls_bot_intel_rng == 0) g_tls_bot_intel_rng = 543216789U;
  g_tls_bot_intel_rng ^= g_tls_bot_intel_rng << 13;
  g_tls_bot_intel_rng ^= g_tls_bot_intel_rng >> 17;
  g_tls_bot_intel_rng ^= g_tls_bot_intel_rng << 5;
  return (double)g_tls_bot_intel_rng / 4294967296.0;
}
