BotIQLevel roll_intelligence(void) {
  double r = fast_random_double();
  if (r < 0.10) return BOT_IQ_AVERAGE;     /* 10% average */
  if (r < 0.50) return BOT_IQ_SMART;       /* 40% smart */
  return BOT_IQ_GENIUS;                    /* 50% genius pro masters! */
}

BotIQProfile get_iq_profile(BotIQLevel iq) {
  int idx = (int)iq - 1;
  if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
  if (idx > 3) idx = 3;
  return IQ_PROFILES[idx];
}

/* Global trust matrix for inter-bot alliances */
static double g_intel_trust_matrix[MAX_BOTS];

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 1: MULTI-STEP TACTICAL PLAN EVALUATOR ─────────────── */

static BotIntelPlanChain g_bot_plan_chains[MAX_BOTS];
static BotDiscretePlan g_bot_discrete_plans[MAX_BOTS];

void bot_intel_init(BotState *bot) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;
  memset(&g_bot_plan_chains[b_idx], 0, sizeof(BotIntelPlanChain));
  memset(&g_bot_discrete_plans[b_idx], 0, sizeof(BotDiscretePlan));
  g_intel_trust_matrix[b_idx] = 0.5;
}

void bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(BotState *bot, BotDiscretePlanType type, double target_x, double target_y, int target_pid, uint32_t duration_ticks) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;

  BotDiscretePlan *plan = &g_bot_discrete_plans[b_idx];
  plan->type = type;
  plan->start_tick = 0;
  plan->expiry_tick = duration_ticks;
  plan->target_x = target_x;
  plan->target_y = target_y;
  plan->target_player_id = target_pid;
  plan->step = 0;
  plan->active = true;
  plan->overrides_farming = true;
  plan->overrides_roaming = true;
}

bool bot_intel_has_active_plan(BotState *bot, uint32_t current_tick) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return false;

  BotDiscretePlan *plan = &g_bot_discrete_plans[b_idx];
  if (!plan->active || plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_NONE) return false;
  if (plan->start_tick > 0 && current_tick >= plan->expiry_tick) {
    plan->active = false;
    plan->type = DISCRETE_PLAN_NONE;
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

bool bot_intel_execute_discrete_plan(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotCandidate *out_candidate) {
  if (!out_candidate) return false;
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return false;

  BotDiscretePlan *plan = &g_bot_discrete_plans[b_idx];
  if (!plan->active || plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_NONE) return false;

  if (plan->start_tick == 0) {
    plan->start_tick = srv->ticks;
    plan->expiry_tick = srv->ticks + plan->expiry_tick;
  }

  if (srv->ticks >= plan->expiry_tick) {
    plan->active = false;
    plan->type = DISCRETE_PLAN_NONE;
    return false;
  }

  /* Threat Safety Override: if a threat is close enough to consume us, abort discrete plan */
  if (bot->perception.threat_count > 0 && bot->perception.nearest_threat_dist < 380.0) {
    plan->active = false;
    plan->type = DISCRETE_PLAN_NONE;
    return false;
  }

  /* DISCRETE PLAN EXECUTING: Bypasses ordinary farming and roaming parameters! */
  out_candidate->action = BOT_ACT_CHASE;
  out_candidate->score = 4.0;
  out_candidate->target_x = plan->target_x;
  out_candidate->target_y = plan->target_y;
  out_candidate->should_split = (plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_SPLIT_KILL ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_MULTI_SPLIT_AGGRESSION ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_CHAIN_EAT_COMBO ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_POPSPLIT ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_TRICKSPLIT ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_SHIFT_16_SPLIT ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_TEAM_FEED_SPLIT ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_SPLIT_EAT_PIECES);

  out_candidate->should_eject = (plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_FRIENDSHIP_W_INITIATION ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_ALLIANCE_FEED ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_VIRUS_FIRE ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_FEED_SPLIT_FEEDER ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_SELF_FEED ||
                                 plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_BAIT_TRAP);

  out_candidate->split_count = (plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_TRICKSPLIT || plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_SHIFT_16_SPLIT) ? 4 :
                               (plan->type == DISCRETE_PLAN_MULTI_SPLIT_AGGRESSION) ? 2 : 1;

  (void)me;
  return true;
}

void bot_intel_update(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv) {
  (void)me;
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;

  BotIntelPlanChain *chain = &g_bot_plan_chains[b_idx];
  if (chain->phase != PLAN_STEP_IDLE) {
    uint32_t elapsed = srv->ticks - chain->start_tick;
    if (elapsed > chain->duration_ticks) {
      chain->phase = PLAN_STEP_IDLE;
    }
  }
}

BotCandidate bot_intel_eval_plan_chain(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_NONE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotIntelPlanChain *chain = &g_bot_plan_chains[b_idx];
  if (chain->phase == PLAN_STEP_IDLE) return c;

  /* Evaluate active step progression */
  c.action = chain->action;
  c.target_x = chain->target_x;
  c.target_y = chain->target_y;
  c.score = 3.90; /* High priority committed tactical chain execution */

  if (chain->phase == PLAN_STEP_SETUP) {
    /* Setup phase: positioning and trajectory alignment */
    double dx = chain->target_x - me->center.x;
    double dy = chain->target_y - me->center.y;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 150.0 * 150.0) {
      chain->phase = PLAN_STEP_EXECUTE;
      chain->start_tick = srv->ticks;
      c.should_split = true;
    }
  } else if (chain->phase == PLAN_STEP_EXECUTE) {
    c.should_split = false;
    if ((srv->ticks - chain->start_tick) > 8) {
      chain->phase = PLAN_STEP_CLEANUP;
    }
  } else if (chain->phase == PLAN_STEP_CLEANUP) {
    if ((srv->ticks - chain->start_tick) > 15) {
      chain->phase = PLAN_STEP_IDLE;
    }
  }

  (void)perc;
  return c;
}

bool bot_intel_update_commitment(BotState *bot, uint32_t current_tick, BotCandidate *chosen) {
  if (!chosen) return false;

  /* Assign commitment window if high-IQ tactical plan is selected */
  if (chosen->action == BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT || chosen->action == BOT_ACT_TRICKSPLIT ||
      chosen->action == BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED || chosen->action == BOT_ACT_CORNER_PIN ||
      chosen->action == BOT_ACT_BAIT_TRAP) {
    bot->committed_action = chosen->action;
    bot->commit_until_tick = current_tick + 20 + (bot_rng_u32(bot) % 15);
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 2: HIGH-PRECISION TRAJECTORY & BEZIER SMOOTHING ──── */

Vec2 bot_intel_compute_bezier_target(Vec2 start, Vec2 control, Vec2 end, double t) {
  t = clampd(t, 0.0, 1.0);
  double u = 1.0 - t;
  double tt = t * t;
  double uu = u * u;

  Vec2 p;
  p.x = uu * start.x + 2.0 * u * t * control.x + tt * end.x;
  p.y = uu * start.y + 2.0 * u * t * control.y + tt * end.y;
  return p;
}

void bot_intel_apply_human_jitter(BotState *bot, Player *me, Vec2 *target, uint32_t tick) {
  if (!target || !me) return;

  /* Jitter frequency derived from emotional anxiety and IQ level */
  double anxiety_factor = bot->emotions.anxiety;
  double jitter_scale = (1.0 - bot->iq_profile.aim_accuracy) * 35.0 + anxiety_factor * 15.0;

  if (jitter_scale > 1.0) {
    double phase = (double)(tick % 60) / 60.0 * 2.0 * M_PI;
    double noise_x = sin(phase * 3.7 + bot->player_id) * jitter_scale;
    double noise_y = cos(phase * 2.9 + bot->player_id) * jitter_scale;

    target->x += noise_x;
    target->y += noise_y;
  }
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 3: MULTI-CELL RE-MERGE BAITING & TRAP SIMULATOR ─── */

BotCandidate bot_intel_eval_remerge_bait(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, BotState *bot, uint32_t tick) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_BAIT_TRAP, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_split_kill || me->cell_count < 2 || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  /* Find largest and smallest cells */
  Cell *largest = NULL, *smallest = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < me->cell_count; i++) {
    if (me->cells[i] && !me->cells[i]->is_removed) {
      if (!largest || me->cells[i]->mass > largest->mass) largest = me->cells[i];
      if (!smallest || me->cells[i]->mass < smallest->mass) smallest = me->cells[i];
    }
  }
  if (!largest || !smallest || largest == smallest) return c;

  /* Re-merge cooldown estimation: remerge_ticks = 30s + (mass * 0.02) */
  double largest_remerge = 30.0 + (largest->mass * 0.02);
  double remerge_tick_threshold = largest_remerge * 25.0;
  uint32_t time_since_split = tick - bot->last_split_tick;

  /* Check if re-merge window is opening within 4 seconds (~100 ticks) */
  if (time_since_split < (remerge_tick_threshold - 100)) return c;

  /* Find prey near the smaller cell acting as bait */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!prey->cell || prey->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (prey->cell->mass * 1.15 > largest->mass) continue;

    double bdx = prey->cell->position.x - smallest->position.x;
    double bdy = prey->cell->position.y - smallest->position.y;
    double bdist2 = bdx * bdx + bdy * bdy;

    if (bdist2 < (600.0 * 600.0)) {
      /* Position bait cell forward, pulling prey into re-merge range */
      c.target_x = prey->cell->position.x;
      c.target_y = prey->cell->position.y;
      c.score = 3.75 * tw.hunting;
      return c;
    }
  }

  (void)p;
  return c;
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 4: DUO-TEAMPLAY & TRUST COORDINATOR ───────────────── */

BotCandidate bot_intel_eval_team_synergy(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, BotState *bot, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
  BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || BOT_TRUST_GET(soc) < 0.3) return c;

  Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
  if (!ally->active) return c;

  if (ally->active_cell_count <= 0) {
    return c;
  }

  double ally_x =
      ally->cell_centroid.x;

  double ally_y =
      ally->cell_centroid.y;

  double adx = ally_x - me->center.x;
  double ady = ally_y - me->center.y;
  double adist2 = adx * adx + ady * ady;

  /* If ally is close (< 800u) and fighting an enemy threat, provide W-mass support */
  if (adist2 < (800.0 * 800.0) && me->total_mass > 120.0) {
    for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
      BotEntity *enemy = &perc->threats[ti];
      if (!enemy->cell || enemy->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (enemy->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid || enemy->cell->owner_id == me->id) continue;

      double edx = enemy->cell->position.x - ally_x;
      double edy = enemy->cell->position.y - ally_y;
      if (edx * edx + edy * edy < (900.0 * 900.0)) {
        /* Support ally with W mass feed */
        c.target_x = ally_x;
        c.target_y = ally_y;
        c.score = 3.70 * tw.diplomacy;
        c.should_eject = true;
        return c;
      }
    }
  }

  (void)p;
  return c;
}

void bot_intel_update_trust_matrix(int bot_id, int partner_id, double delta_trust) {
  (void)partner_id;
  if (bot_id < 0 || bot_id >= MAX_BOTS) return;
  g_intel_trust_matrix[bot_id] = clampd(g_intel_trust_matrix[bot_id] + delta_trust, 0.0, 1.0);
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 5: SPATIAL HEATMAP & ORGANIC ROAMING GENERATOR ────── */

BotCandidate bot_intel_generate_organic_roam(
    BotState *bot,
    Player *me,
    GameServer *srv,
    BotPerception *perc) {
  /*
   * Compatibility wrapper.
   *
   * Canonical map-sector routing is owned by the movement engine.
   * Preserve this public function and its historical score levels.
   */
  BotCandidate c =
      bot_move_eval_organic_sector_patrol(
          bot,
          me,
          srv,
          perc
      );

  Cell *safe_food =
      perc->nearest_safe_food;

  if (safe_food &&
      !safe_food->is_removed) {
    c.action = BOT_ACT_ROAM;
    c.target_x =
        safe_food->position.x;
    c.target_y =
        safe_food->position.y;
    c.score = 0.25;
    return c;
  }

  c.score = 0.18;
  return c;
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 6: THREAT RAYCASTING & ANTI-CORNER TRAP ESCAPER ───── */

BotCandidate bot_intel_eval_escape_ray(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ANTI_TRAP, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->threat_count == 0) return c;

  double b_minx = srv->border.minx, b_maxx = srv->border.maxx;
  double b_miny = srv->border.miny, b_maxy = srv->border.maxy;

  /* Check border proximity for corner pressure */
  double dist_left = me->center.x - b_minx;
  double dist_right = b_maxx - me->center.x;
  double dist_top = me->center.y - b_miny;
  double dist_bottom = b_maxy - me->center.y;

  bool near_corner = ((dist_left < 500.0 || dist_right < 500.0) && (dist_top < 500.0 || dist_bottom < 500.0));
  if (!near_corner && perc->threat_count < 2) return c;

  /* Raycast vector pointing $90^\circ$ perpendicular away from threat approach angle */
  BotEntity *primary_threat = &perc->threats[0];
  if (!primary_threat->cell || primary_threat->cell->is_removed) return c;

  double tdx = me->center.x - primary_threat->cell->position.x;
  double tdy = me->center.y - primary_threat->cell->position.y;
  double tlen = sqrt(tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy);
  if (tlen < 1.0) tlen = 1.0;

  /* Perpendicular escape vectors (+90 deg & -90 deg) */
  double perp1_x = -tdy / tlen;
  double perp1_y = tdx / tlen;

  /* Steer target 1200u away in perpendicular direction */
  c.target_x = me->center.x + perp1_x * 1200.0;
  c.target_y = me->center.y + perp1_y * 1200.0;
  c.score = 3.85 * tw.survival;

  (void)p; (void)iq;
  return c;
}

typedef enum {
  PLAN_STEP_IDLE = 0,
  PLAN_STEP_SETUP,
  PLAN_STEP_EXECUTE,
  PLAN_STEP_CLEANUP
} PlanStepPhase;

  PlanStepPhase phase;
  uint32_t start_tick;
  uint32_t duration_ticks;
  double target_x;
  double target_y;
  int target_entity_id;
  double expected_mass_gain;
} BotIntelPlanChain;

typedef enum {
  DISCRETE_PLAN_NONE = 0,

  /* Combat & Split Tactics */
  DISCRETE_PLAN_SPLIT_KILL,
  DISCRETE_PLAN_MULTI_SPLIT_AGGRESSION,
  DISCRETE_PLAN_CHAIN_EAT_COMBO,

  DISCRETE_PLAN_TEAM_FEED_SPLIT,
  DISCRETE_PLAN_SPLIT_EAT_PIECES,

  /* Traps & Positioning */

  DISCRETE_PLAN_REMERGE_BAIT,
  DISCRETE_PLAN_BAIT_TRAP,

  DISCRETE_PLAN_FEED_SPLIT_FEEDER,

  DISCRETE_PLAN_MASS_SWEEP,

  bool overrides_farming;
  bool overrides_roaming;

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <string.h>

#define MAX_MEMORY_PROFILES 32

typedef struct {
  int player_id;
  char name[32];
  int sightings;
  int aggression_events;
  int deaths_caused;   /* Times we killed them */
  int kills_suffered;  /* Times they killed us */
  bool is_friend;
  bool is_betrayer;
  uint32_t last_seen_tick;
  double trust_score;
  double aggression_score;
} BotPlayerProfile;

typedef struct {
  BotPlayerProfile profiles[MAX_MEMORY_PROFILES];
  int count;
} BotMemoryState;

static BotMemoryState g_bot_memories[MAX_BOTS];

void bot_memory_update(BotState *bot, Player *me, BotPerception *perc, uint32_t tick, GameServer *srv) {
  if (bot->iq_profile.memory_depth == 0) return;

  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;
  BotMemoryState *mem = &g_bot_memories[b_idx];

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!t->cell) continue;
    int pid = t->cell->owner_id;
    if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_PLAYERS || pid == me->id) continue;

    const char *pname = srv->players[pid].name[0] ? srv->players[pid].name : "Player";

    BotPlayerProfile *p = NULL;
    for (int k = 0; k < mem->count; k++) {
      if (mem->profiles[k].player_id == pid) {
        p = &mem->profiles[k];
        if (UNLIKELY(p->name[0] == '\0' && pname[0])) {
          strncpy(p->name, pname, 31);
          p->name[31] = '\0';
        }
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!p && mem->count < MAX_MEMORY_PROFILES) {
      p = &mem->profiles[mem->count++];
      memset(p, 0, sizeof(*p));
      p->player_id = pid;
      strncpy(p->name, pname, 31);
    }

    if (p) {
      p->sightings++;
      p->last_seen_tick = tick;
      if (t->danger > 0.5) p->aggression_events++;
      p->aggression_score = (double)p->aggression_events / (double)(p->sightings > 0 ? p->sightings : 1);
    }
  }
}

void bot_memory_record_kill(int b_idx, int killed_pid, const char *killed_name) {
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;
  BotMemoryState *mem = &g_bot_memories[b_idx];
  for (int k = 0; k < mem->count; k++) {
    if ((killed_pid >= 0 && mem->profiles[k].player_id == killed_pid) ||
        (killed_name && killed_name[0] && strcmp(mem->profiles[k].name, killed_name) == 0)) {
      mem->profiles[k].deaths_caused++;
      break;
    }
  }
}

void bot_memory_record_death(int b_idx, int killer_pid, const char *killer_name) {
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;
  BotMemoryState *mem = &g_bot_memories[b_idx];
  for (int k = 0; k < mem->count; k++) {
    if ((killer_pid >= 0 && mem->profiles[k].player_id == killer_pid) ||
        (killer_name && killer_name[0] && strcmp(mem->profiles[k].name, killer_name) == 0)) {
      mem->profiles[k].kills_suffered++;
      mem->profiles[k].aggression_score = 1.0;
      break;
    }
  }
}

void bot_memory_set_friend(int b_idx, int friend_pid, const char *friend_name, bool is_friend) {
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;
  BotMemoryState *mem = &g_bot_memories[b_idx];
  for (int k = 0; k < mem->count; k++) {
    if ((friend_pid >= 0 && mem->profiles[k].player_id == friend_pid) ||
        (friend_name && friend_name[0] && strcmp(mem->profiles[k].name, friend_name) == 0)) {
      mem->profiles[k].is_friend = is_friend;
      if (is_friend) mem->profiles[k].trust_score = 0.95;
      break;
    }
  }
}

bool bot_memory_is_known_friend(int b_idx, int pid, const char *name) {
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return false;
  BotMemoryState *mem = &g_bot_memories[b_idx];
  for (int k = 0; k < mem->count; k++) {
    if ((pid >= 0 && mem->profiles[k].player_id == pid) ||
        (name && name[0] && strcmp(mem->profiles[k].name, name) == 0)) {
      return mem->profiles[k].is_friend;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

double bot_memory_get_flee_modifier(BotState *bot, int target_pid) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return 1.0;
  BotMemoryState *mem = &g_bot_memories[b_idx];

  for (int k = 0; k < mem->count; k++) {
    if (mem->profiles[k].player_id == target_pid) {
      if (mem->profiles[k].kills_suffered > 0) return 1.60; /* Fear enemy who killed us before! */
      if (mem->profiles[k].is_betrayer) return 1.50;
      if (mem->profiles[k].aggression_score > 0.6) return 1.40;
      if (mem->profiles[k].is_friend) return 0.20; /* Do not flee from friends! */
    }
  }
  return 1.0;
}

double bot_memory_get_chase_modifier(BotState *bot, int target_pid) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return 1.0;
  BotMemoryState *mem = &g_bot_memories[b_idx];

  for (int k = 0; k < mem->count; k++) {
    if (mem->profiles[k].player_id == target_pid) {
      if (mem->profiles[k].is_friend) return 0.0; /* NEVER hunt a friend! */
      if (mem->profiles[k].kills_suffered > 0) return 1.65; /* REVENGE HUNTING! */
      if (mem->profiles[k].is_betrayer) return 1.75; /* REVENGE HUNT BETRAYER! */
      if (mem->profiles[k].aggression_score > 0.7) return 1.35;
    }
  }
  return 1.0;
}

#include "bot.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "../../src/fast_math.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

void bot_check_stale(BotState *bot, Player *me) {
  double dx = me->center.x - bot->prev_x;
  double dy = me->center.y - bot->prev_y;
  if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 25.0) {
    bot->stale_ticks++;
  } else {
    bot->stale_ticks = 0;
  }

  bot->prev_x = me->center.x;
  bot->prev_y = me->center.y;
}

void bot_smooth_aim(BotState *bot, Player *me, double target_x, double target_y, double accuracy) {
  double dx = target_x - me->center.x;
  double dy = target_y - me->center.y;
  double dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

  /* Continuous Motion Guarantee: Never let mouse target drop below 1000 units ahead of center */
  if (dist < 800.0) {
    if (dist < 1.0) {
      double angle = fast_random_double() * 2.0 * M_PI;
      target_x = me->center.x + cos(angle) * 1200.0;
      target_y = me->center.y + sin(angle) * 1200.0;
    } else {
      target_x = me->center.x + (dx / dist) * 1200.0;
      target_y = me->center.y + (dy / dist) * 1200.0;
    }
  }

  /* Apply aim accuracy jitter if accuracy < 1.0 */
  if (accuracy < 1.0) {
    double jitter = (1.0 - accuracy) * 60.0;
    target_x += (fast_random_double() - 0.5) * jitter;
    target_y += (fast_random_double() - 0.5) * jitter;
  }

  /* ACTION-AWARE SMOOTHING:
   * Urgent actions (flee, split, anti-trap, juke, edge-flee) need near-instant response.
   * Non-urgent actions (roam, farm, chase) get human-like smooth trajectory.
   * alpha = 1.0 means instant snap, alpha = 0.18 means very smooth. */
  double alpha;
  int action = bot->current_action;
  if (action == BOT_ACT_FLEE || action == BOT_ACT_ANTI_TRAP ||
      action == BOT_ACT_EDGE_FLEE || action == BOT_ACT_VIRUS_DODGE) {
    alpha = 0.85; /* Near-instant — survival critical */
  } else if (action == BOT_ACT_SPLIT_EAT || action == BOT_ACT_SPLIT_KILL ||
             action == BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT || action == BOT_ACT_TRICKSPLIT ||
             action == BOT_ACT_MASS_SWEEP || action == BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED) {
    alpha = 0.75; /* Fast — split/eject aim accuracy matters */
  } else if (action == BOT_ACT_CHASE) {
    /* ── HUMAN-LIKE CHASE SMOOTHING ──
     * Approach caution: closing in at medium range uses slower alpha,
     * creating a deliberate "stalking" feel instead of a beeline.
     * At close range, snap to full speed for the kill. */
    double chase_alpha = 0.22 * clampd(accuracy, 0.5, 1.0);
    if (dist < 600.0) {
      chase_alpha = 0.35; /* Close range — commit to the chase */
    } else if (dist < 1200.0) {
      chase_alpha = 0.14; /* Medium range — cautious approach */
    }

    /* Micro-hesitation: every ~40-80 ticks, briefly drop alpha for 3-5 ticks.
     * This simulates a human pausing to reconsider before continuing the chase. */
    if (bot->chase_ticks > 0 && (bot->chase_ticks % 50) < 4) {
      chase_alpha *= 0.3; /* Brief hesitation — "should I keep chasing?" */
    }

    alpha = chase_alpha;
  } else {
    alpha = 0.18 * clampd(accuracy, 0.5, 1.0); /* Smooth — human-like for roam/farm */
  }

  double current_mx = (me->mouse_target.x != 0.0) ? me->mouse_target.x : target_x;
  double current_my = (me->mouse_target.y != 0.0) ? me->mouse_target.y : target_y;

  double smoothed_x = current_mx * (1.0 - alpha) + target_x * alpha;
  double smoothed_y = current_my * (1.0 - alpha) + target_y * alpha;

  /* ALWAYS PROJECT MOUSE TARGET 2000 UNITS AHEAD OF CENTER VECTOR!
   * In Agar.io physics, mouse distance must be > speed so cell moves at 100% full speed.
   * This guarantees bots NEVER decelerate, stall, or freeze in place. */
  double final_dx = smoothed_x - me->center.x;
  double final_dy = smoothed_y - me->center.y;
  double final_dist = sqrt(final_dx * final_dx + final_dy * final_dy);
  if (final_dist < 10.0) {
    double angle = bot_rng_double(bot) * 2.0 * M_PI;
    smoothed_x = me->center.x + cos(angle) * 2000.0;
    smoothed_y = me->center.y + sin(angle) * 2000.0;
  } else {
    smoothed_x = me->center.x + (final_dx / final_dist) * 2000.0;
    smoothed_y = me->center.y + (final_dy / final_dist) * 2000.0;
  }

  bot->target_x = smoothed_x;
  bot->target_y = smoothed_y;
  me->mouse_target.x = smoothed_x;
  me->mouse_target.y = smoothed_y;
  me->mouse = me->mouse_target;
}

#include "bot_movement_engine.h"
#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include "../../src/fast_math.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

#ifdef _MSC_VER
static __declspec(thread) uint32_t g_tls_bot_rng = 987654321U;
#else
static __thread uint32_t g_tls_bot_rng = 987654321U;
#endif

static inline double randf(void) {
  if (g_tls_bot_rng == 0) g_tls_bot_rng = 987654321U;
  g_tls_bot_rng ^= g_tls_bot_rng << 13;
  g_tls_bot_rng ^= g_tls_bot_rng >> 17;
  g_tls_bot_rng ^= g_tls_bot_rng << 5;
  return (double)g_tls_bot_rng / 4294967296.0;
}

/* Global Movement States across all bots */
BotMovementState g_bot_movement_states[MAX_BOTS];


/* ── MOVEMENT ENGINE INITIALIZATION & TICK UPDATE ─────────────────── */

void bot_movement_engine_init(BotState *bot) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;

  BotMovementState *ms = &g_bot_movement_states[b_idx];
  memset(ms, 0, sizeof(BotMovementState));
  ms->formation_angle = ((b_idx % 4) * 0.25) * M_PI;
  ms->formation_distance = 320.0 + (b_idx % 5) * 35.0;
}

void bot_movement_engine_update(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;

  BotMovementState *ms = &g_bot_movement_states[b_idx];

  /* Smooth formation angle oscillation for dynamic human-like movement */
  double osc = sin((double)srv->ticks * 0.03 + (double)b_idx);
  ms->formation_angle += osc * 0.01;

  if (ms->is_detouring && srv->ticks > ms->detour_until_tick) {
    ms->is_detouring = false;
  }

  (void)me;
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 1: DUO ESCORT & DYNAMIC FORMATION STEERING (~220 lines) */

BotCandidate bot_move_eval_duo_escort(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CHASE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
  if (!ally->active || ally->cell_count == 0) return c;

  BotMovementState *ms = &g_bot_movement_states[b_idx];

  /* Calculate ally mass vs my mass to assign Vanguard / Wingman roles */
  double ally_mass =
      ally->total_mass;

  bool is_wingman = (me->total_mass < ally_mass);

  /* Calculate dynamic formation target */
  double adx = soc->ally_last_x - me->center.x;
  double ady = soc->ally_last_y - me->center.y;
  double adist = sqrt(adx * adx + ady * ady);

  if (adist < 180.0) return c; /* Already close in formation */

  double offset_dist = is_wingman ? ms->formation_distance : 240.0;
  double offset_angle = ms->formation_angle;

  /* Rotate offset vector relative to ally heading */
  double rot_x = cos(offset_angle) * offset_dist;
  double rot_y = sin(offset_angle) * offset_dist;

  double target_x = soc->ally_last_x + rot_x;
  double target_y = soc->ally_last_y + rot_y;

  /* Ensure formation waypoint stays within map borders */
  double margin = 200.0;
  target_x = clampd(target_x, srv->border.minx + margin, srv->border.maxx - margin);
  target_y = clampd(target_y, srv->border.miny + margin, srv->border.maxy - margin);

  /* Assign Discrete Plan for Teammate Escort */
  bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_PERIMETER_SWEEP, target_x, target_y, soc->ally_pid, 35);

  c.target_x = target_x;
  c.target_y = target_y;
  c.score = 3.78;

  (void)perc;
  return c;
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 2: BEZIER PATHFINDING & VIRUS DETOURS (~200 lines) ──── */

BotCandidate bot_move_eval_bezier_virus_detour(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_VIRUS_DODGE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  /* Find the closest virus/mother that poses a real collision threat
   * to any of our cells. Use per-cell radius comparison, NOT a fixed mass. */
  BotMovementState *ms = &g_bot_movement_states[b_idx];

  Cell *closest_hazard = NULL;
  double min_gap2 = 1e9;
  Cell *threatened_cell = NULL;

  for (int vi = 0; vi < perc->virus_count; vi++) {
    Cell *v = perc->viruses[vi];
    if (!v || v->is_removed) continue;

    /* Check each bot cell against this hazard */
    for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
      Cell *mc = me->cells[ci];
      if (!mc || mc->is_removed) continue;

      /* Virus poppability: cell must be > virus * 1.118 to pop.
       * Mother Cells eat ANY smaller cell — always dangerous. */
      bool is_dangerous;
      if (v->type == CELL_MOTHER) {
        is_dangerous = (mc->radius <= v->radius * 1.118); /* can't eat Mother at or below 1.118x */
      } else {
        is_dangerous = (mc->radius > v->radius * 1.118); /* Can pop on virus */
      }
      if (!is_dangerous) continue;

      /* Distance from THIS cell (not aggregate center) to the hazard */
      double dx = v->position.x - mc->position.x;
      double dy = v->position.y - mc->position.y;
      double dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;

      double safe_dist = mc->radius + v->radius + 30.0;
      if (dist2 < (safe_dist * safe_dist) && dist2 < min_gap2) {
        min_gap2 = dist2;
        closest_hazard = v;
        threatened_cell = mc;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!closest_hazard || !threatened_cell) return c;

  /* Repulsion vector: move threatened cell away from hazard */
  double vdx = closest_hazard->position.x - threatened_cell->position.x;
  double vdy = closest_hazard->position.y - threatened_cell->position.y;
  double vdist = sqrt(vdx * vdx + vdy * vdy);
  if (vdist < 1.0) vdist = 1.0;

  /* Tangential nudge to steer past the hazard without orbiting */
  double perp_x = -vdy / vdist;
  double perp_y = vdx / vdist;
  if (b_idx % 2 == 0) { perp_x = -perp_x; perp_y = -perp_y; }

  double push_dist = threatened_cell->radius + 60.0;
  double detour_x = threatened_cell->position.x - (vdx / vdist) * push_dist + perp_x * 40.0;
  double detour_y = threatened_cell->position.y - (vdy / vdist) * push_dist + perp_y * 40.0;

  /* Ensure detour target stays within map borders */
  double margin = 100.0;
  detour_x = clampd(detour_x, srv->border.minx + margin, srv->border.maxx - margin);
  detour_y = clampd(detour_y, srv->border.miny + margin, srv->border.maxy - margin);

  ms->is_detouring = true;
  ms->detour_control_point.x = detour_x;
  ms->detour_control_point.y = detour_y;
  ms->detour_until_tick = srv->ticks + 10;

  c.target_x = detour_x;
  c.target_y = detour_y;
  c.score = 2.45; /* Balanced score: dodges hazards without overriding farming/fleeing/hunting */

  return c;
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 3: ORGANIC PERIMETER PATROL & SECTOR NAVIGATION (~180 lines) */

BotCandidate bot_move_eval_organic_sector_patrol(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ROAM, 0.15, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};

  double map_cx = (srv->border.minx + srv->border.maxx) / 2.0;
  double map_cy = (srv->border.miny + srv->border.maxy) / 2.0;
  double b_w = srv->border.maxx - srv->border.minx;
  double b_h = srv->border.maxy - srv->border.miny;

  /* Sector Waypoint Generator (Grid A1..E5)
   * Converts random grid sector coordinates (e.g., A3 -> C1, A5 -> A1) into world targets */
  uint32_t sector_duration = 180 + (bot_rng_u32(bot) % 320);

  double r_dx = bot->territory_anchor_x - me->center.x;
  double r_dy = bot->territory_anchor_y - me->center.y;
  double dist_to_waypoint2 = r_dx * r_dx + r_dy * r_dy;

  /* Pick random sector target when reached waypoint or duration expired */
  if (bot->roam_ticks == 0 || (srv->ticks - bot->roam_ticks) > sector_duration || dist_to_waypoint2 < (300.0 * 300.0)) {
    /* Select waypoint inside home sector or adjacent neighbor sector (±1 offset) */
    int col_offset = (int)(bot_rng_u32(bot) % 3) - 1; /* -1, 0, +1 */
    int row_offset = (int)(bot_rng_u32(bot) % 3) - 1; /* -1, 0, +1 */
    int target_col = (int)clampd(bot->home_sector_col + col_offset, 0, 4);
    int target_row = (int)clampd(bot->home_sector_row + row_offset, 0, 4);

    /* 15% chance to wander to a completely new sector across map */
    if ((bot_rng_u32(bot) % 100) < 15) {
      target_col = bot_rng_u32(bot) % 5;
      target_row = bot_rng_u32(bot) % 5;
      bot->home_sector_col = target_col;
      bot->home_sector_row = target_row;
    }

    double cell_w = b_w / 5.0;
    double cell_h = b_h / 5.0;

    double margin_x = cell_w * (0.15 + randf() * 0.70);
    double margin_y = cell_h * (0.15 + randf() * 0.70);

    bot->territory_anchor_x = srv->border.minx + target_col * cell_w + margin_x;
    bot->territory_anchor_y = srv->border.miny + target_row * cell_h + margin_y;
    bot->roam_ticks = srv->ticks;
  }
  /* Mid-route Wayward Direction Shift (Human-like course adjustment) */
  else if ((bot_rng_u32(bot) % 100) < 5) { /* ~5% chance per tick to alter course angle by ±25° */
    double shift_angle = (randf() - 0.5) * (M_PI / 3.6);
    double current_dx = bot->territory_anchor_x - me->center.x;
    double current_dy = bot->territory_anchor_y - me->center.y;
    double c_len = sqrt(current_dx * current_dx + current_dy * current_dy);
    if (c_len > 100.0) {
      double base_angle = atan2(current_dy, current_dx);
      double new_angle = base_angle + shift_angle;
      bot->territory_anchor_x = clampd(me->center.x + cos(new_angle) * c_len, srv->border.minx + 200.0, srv->border.maxx - 200.0);
      bot->territory_anchor_y = clampd(me->center.y + sin(new_angle) * c_len, srv->border.miny + 200.0, srv->border.maxy - 200.0);
    }
  }

  double nav_tx = bot->territory_anchor_x;
  double nav_ty = bot->territory_anchor_y;

  /* Peripheral Corner Detour around Center C3 */
  double lx = nav_tx - me->center.x;
  double ly = nav_ty - me->center.y;
  double len2 = lx * lx + ly * ly;
  if (len2 > 100.0) {
    double t_proj = ((map_cx - me->center.x) * lx + (map_cy - me->center.y) * ly) / len2;
    if (t_proj > 0.15 && t_proj < 0.85) {
      double proj_x = me->center.x + t_proj * lx;
      double proj_y = me->center.y + t_proj * ly;
      double c_dx = map_cx - proj_x;
      double c_dy = map_cy - proj_y;

      if ((c_dx * c_dx + c_dy * c_dy) < (b_w * 0.22) * (b_w * 0.22)) {
        /* Route perimeter detour around center */
        if (lx * ly > 0.0) {
          nav_tx = srv->border.maxx - 400.0; nav_ty = srv->border.maxy - 400.0;
        } else {
          nav_tx = srv->border.minx + 400.0; nav_ty = srv->border.maxy - 400.0;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  c.target_x = nav_tx;
  c.target_y = nav_ty;
  c.score = 0.45; /* High roaming score to maintain active sector patrol */

  (void)perc;
  return c;
}

/* ── SUBSYSTEM 4: MULTI-THREAT REPULSION & ANTI-CORNER TRAP (~160 lines) */

BotCandidate bot_move_eval_threat_repulsion_vector(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ANTI_TRAP, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->threat_count == 0) return c;

  double net_rx = 0.0, net_ry = 0.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;

    double tdx = me->center.x - t->cell->position.x;
    double tdy = me->center.y - t->cell->position.y;
    double tdist2 = tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy;
    if (tdist2 < 1.0) tdist2 = 1.0;

    double tdist = sqrt(tdist2);
    /* Inverse-square repulsion vector */
    double weight = 1e6 / (tdist2 * tdist);
    net_rx += (tdx / tdist) * weight;
    net_ry += (tdy / tdist) * weight;
  }

  double net_len = sqrt(net_rx * net_rx + net_ry * net_ry);
  if (net_len < 0.001) return c;

  double escape_x = me->center.x + (net_rx / net_len) * 1200.0;
  double escape_y = me->center.y + (net_ry / net_len) * 1200.0;

  /* Check border proximity for corner pressure */
  double b_minx = srv->border.minx, b_maxx = srv->border.maxx;
  double b_miny = srv->border.miny, b_maxy = srv->border.maxy;

  bool near_corner = ((me->center.x - b_minx < 500.0 || b_maxx - me->center.x < 500.0) &&
                      (me->center.y - b_miny < 500.0 || b_maxy - me->center.y < 500.0));

  if (near_corner) {
    /* 90-degree perpendicular escape vector away from wall */
    escape_x = clampd(escape_x, b_minx + 600.0, b_maxx - 600.0);
    escape_y = clampd(escape_y, b_miny + 600.0, b_maxy - 600.0);
  }

  c.target_x = escape_x;
  c.target_y = escape_y;
  c.score = 3.92;

  (void)bot;
  return c;
}


/* ── SUBSYSTEM 6: BAITING FLANK & RE-MERGE POSITIONING (~120 lines) ─ */

BotCandidate bot_move_eval_remerge_flank_steering(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_BAIT_TRAP, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (me->cell_count < 2 || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  /* Find largest and smallest cells */
  Cell *largest = NULL, *smallest = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < me->cell_count; i++) {
    if (me->cells[i] && !me->cells[i]->is_removed) {
      if (!largest || me->cells[i]->mass > largest->mass) largest = me->cells[i];
      if (!smallest || me->cells[i]->mass < smallest->mass) smallest = me->cells[i];
    }
  }

  if (!largest || !smallest || largest == smallest) return c;

  /* Find prey near smaller bait cell */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!prey->cell || prey->cell->is_removed) continue;

    double bdx = prey->cell->position.x - smallest->position.x;
    double bdy = prey->cell->position.y - smallest->position.y;
    if (bdx * bdx + bdy * bdy < (550.0 * 550.0)) {
      /* Flank target: angle mouse to pull prey between split cells */
      c.target_x = (largest->position.x + prey->cell->position.x) / 2.0;
      c.target_y = (largest->position.y + prey->cell->position.y) / 2.0;
      c.score = 3.76;

      bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_REMERGE_BAIT, c.target_x, c.target_y, prey->cell->owner_id, 45);
      return c;
    }
  }

  (void)srv;
  return c;
}

  double formation_distance;

/* ── Movement Engine API ────────────────────────────────────── */

#include "bot.h"
#include "bot_grid.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "quadtree.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

double get_corner_pressure(double x, double y, GameServer *srv) {
  double dL = x - srv->border.minx;
  double dR = srv->border.maxx - x;
  double dT = y - srv->border.miny;
  double dB = srv->border.maxy - y;

  double min1 = dL < dR ? dL : dR;
  double min1_other = dL < dR ? dR : dL;
  double min2 = dT < dB ? dT : dB;
  double min2_other = dT < dB ? dB : dT;

  double closest = min1 < min2 ? min1 : min2;
  double second = (min1 < min2) ? (min1_other < min2 ? min1_other : min2) : (min2_other < min1 ? min2_other : min1);

  if (closest > 600.0 || second > 600.0) return 0.0;

  double p1 = 1.0 - closest * (1.0 / 600.0);
  double p2 = 1.0 - second * (1.0 / 600.0);
  if (p1 < 0.0) p1 = 0.0;
  if (p2 < 0.0) p2 = 0.0;
  return p1 * p2;
}

void bot_perceive(BotState *bot, GameServer *srv, Player *me, BotPerception *perc) {
  PROF_START_NS(bot_perceive_ns);
  memset(perc, 0, sizeof(*perc));
  perc->nearest_threat_dist = 1e9;
  perc->nearest_food_dist = 1e9;

  double cx = me->center.x;
  double cy = me->center.y;

  Cell *largest_cell = me->largest_cell;
  Cell *smallest_cell = me->smallest_cell;

  double my_size =
      largest_cell
          ? largest_cell->radius
          : 31.6;

  double smallest_size =
      smallest_cell
          ? smallest_cell->radius
          : my_size;

  double my_total_mass = me->total_mass;

  double min_x =
      me->active_cell_count > 0
          ? me->cell_bounds.minx
          : cx;

  double max_x =
      me->active_cell_count > 0
          ? me->cell_bounds.maxx
          : cx;

  double min_y =
      me->active_cell_count > 0
          ? me->cell_bounds.miny
          : cy;

  double max_y =
      me->active_cell_count > 0
          ? me->cell_bounds.maxy
          : cy;

  perc->corner_pressure = get_corner_pressure(cx, cy, srv);

  /* Distance to border */
  double dL = cx - srv->border.minx;
  double dR = srv->border.maxx - cx;
  double dT = cy - srv->border.miny;
  double dB = srv->border.maxy - cy;
  perc->border_dist = fmin(fmin(dL, dR), fmin(dT, dB));

#ifdef _MSC_VER
#define THREAD_LOCAL __declspec(thread)
#else
#define THREAD_LOCAL __thread
#endif

  /* Mass-adaptive scan radius & query limits: small farming bots query compact area, large bots query wide area */
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *results[BOT_SCAN_MAX];
  double r = BOT_SCAN_RADIUS;
  int scan_cap = BOT_SCAN_MAX;
  int food_cap = 128;

  if (my_size < 50.0) {
    r = 850.0;
    scan_cap = 64;
    food_cap = 32;
  } else if (my_size < 150.0) {
    r = 1600.0;
    scan_cap = 128;
    food_cap = 64;
  }
  Rect area = {min_x - r, min_y - r, max_x + r, max_y + r};
  PROF_START_NS(perc_qt_scan_ns);
  int count = bot_grid_query(&srv->bot_grid, area, results, scan_cap);
  PROF_ADD_NS(perc_qt_scan_ns);

  double scan_radius2 = r * r;

  double max_detect =
      BOT_SCAN_RADIUS *
      bot->iq_profile.threat_detect_range;

  double max_detect2 =
      max_detect * max_detect;

  /* Separate query for food pellets */
  double nearest_food_dist2 = perc->nearest_food_dist * perc->nearest_food_dist;
  static THREAD_LOCAL Cell *food_results[128];
  PROF_START_NS(perc_food_scan_ns);
  int food_found = fg_query_circle(&srv->food_grid, cx, cy, r, food_results, 0, food_cap);
  PROF_ADD_NS(perc_food_scan_ns);
  for (int i = 0; i < food_found && perc->food_count < 64; i++) {
    Cell *f = food_results[i];
    if (f && !f->is_removed) {
      perc->food[perc->food_count++] = f;
      double fdx = f->position.x - cx;
      double fdy = f->position.y - cy;
      double fdist2 = fdx * fdx + fdy * fdy;
      if (fdist2 < nearest_food_dist2) nearest_food_dist2 = fdist2;
    }
  }
  if (nearest_food_dist2 < 1e17) {
    perc->nearest_food_dist = sqrt(nearest_food_dist2);
  }

  double inv_my_size = 1.0 / my_size;

  PROF_START_NS(perc_classify_ns);
  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    Cell *cell = results[i];
    if (UNLIKELY(!cell || cell->is_removed)) continue;
    if (cell->owner_id == me->id) continue;

    double dx = cell->position.x - cx;
    double dy = cell->position.y - cy;
    double dist2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if (dist2 > scan_radius2) continue;

    switch (cell->type) {
    case CELL_VIRUS:
    case CELL_MOTHER:
      /* Both viruses and Mother Cells are hazards for bots.
       * Mother Cells eat any player cell smaller than themselves.
       * Keep the 16 nearest hazards — evict farthest when full. */
      if (perc->virus_count < 16) {
        perc->virus_dist2[perc->virus_count] = dist2;
        perc->viruses[perc->virus_count++] = cell;
      } else {
        /* Find the farthest currently stored hazard */
        int farthest_idx = 0;
        double farthest_d2 = perc->virus_dist2[0];
        for (int vi = 1; vi < 16; vi++) {
          if (perc->virus_dist2[vi] > farthest_d2) {
            farthest_d2 = perc->virus_dist2[vi];
            farthest_idx = vi;
          }
        }
        /* Replace if this hazard is closer */
        if (dist2 < farthest_d2) {
          perc->viruses[farthest_idx] = cell;
          perc->virus_dist2[farthest_idx] = dist2;
        }
      }
      break;

    case CELL_PLAYER: {
      double size_ratio = cell->radius * inv_my_size;
      bool enemy_can_eat_me = (cell->radius >= smallest_size * 1.118);
      bool i_can_eat_enemy = (size_ratio <= 0.89445) && !enemy_can_eat_me;

      /* Early out if far beyond detection range and cannot be eaten */
      if (dist2 > max_detect2 && !i_can_eat_enemy)
        continue;

      double dist = 0.0;
      double split_half = 0;
      bool enemy_can_split_eat = false;
      if (cell->radius >= smallest_size * 1.579 && dist2 <= 6250000.0) {
        dist = sqrt(dist2);
        enemy_can_split_eat = physics_can_split_catch(cell->radius, smallest_size, dist, &split_half);
      }

      double owner_total_mass = cell->mass;
      int owner_cell_count = 1;

      if (cell->owner_id >= 0 &&
          cell->owner_id < MAX_PLAYERS) {
        Player *owner =
            &srv->players[cell->owner_id];

        owner_total_mass =
            owner->total_mass;

        owner_cell_count =
            owner->active_cell_count;
      }

      /* Threat: enemy can eat me or can split eat me */
      if ((enemy_can_eat_me || enemy_can_split_eat) && dist2 <= max_detect2) {
        if (perc->threat_count < 32) {
          if (dist == 0.0) dist = sqrt(dist2);
          BotEntity *e = &perc->threats[perc->threat_count++];
          e->cell = cell;
          e->dist = dist;
          e->size_ratio = size_ratio;
          e->dx = dx;
          e->dy = dy;
          e->can_eat_me = enemy_can_eat_me;
          e->can_split_eat = enemy_can_split_eat;
          e->total_mass = owner_total_mass;
          e->owner_cell_count = owner_cell_count;

          /* Compute closing speed: how fast is this threat moving toward us?
           * Positive = closing in, Negative = moving away.
           * Use enemy's mouse_target to estimate their movement direction. */
          e->closing_speed = 0.0;
          if (cell->owner_id >= 0 && cell->owner_id < MAX_PLAYERS && dist > 1.0) {
            Player *enemy_player = &srv->players[cell->owner_id];
            if (enemy_player->active) {
              double emx = enemy_player->mouse_target.x - cell->position.x;
              double emy = enemy_player->mouse_target.y - cell->position.y;
              double em_dist2 = emx * emx + emy * emy;
              if (em_dist2 > 1.0) {
                double inv_em_dist = 1.0 / sqrt(em_dist2);
                double enx = emx * inv_em_dist;
                double eny = emy * inv_em_dist;
                double inv_dist = 1.0 / dist;
                double to_us_x = -dx * inv_dist;
                double to_us_y = -dy * inv_dist;
                double enemy_speed = cell->cached_speed > 0 ? cell->cached_speed : bot_cell_speed(cell->radius);
                e->closing_speed = (enx * to_us_x + eny * to_us_y) * enemy_speed;
              }
            }
          }

          /* Danger rating: scale aggressively with size ratio and proximity */
          e->danger = clampd((1.0 - dist / 2500.0) * size_ratio * 1.5, 0.4, 2.5);
          if (enemy_can_split_eat) e->danger = fmax(e->danger, 1.2); /* Floor: split-eat is always scary */
          if (enemy_can_eat_me && dist < 1200.0) e->danger = fmax(e->danger, 1.6); /* Close direct-eat */

          if (dist < perc->nearest_threat_dist)
            perc->nearest_threat_dist = dist;
        }
      } else if (i_can_eat_enemy) {
        if (perc->prey_count < 32) {
          if (dist == 0.0) dist = sqrt(dist2);
          BotEntity *e = &perc->prey[perc->prey_count++];
          e->cell = cell;
          e->dist = dist;
          e->size_ratio = size_ratio;
          e->dx = dx;
          e->dy = dy;
          e->can_eat_me = false;
          e->can_split_eat = false;
          e->total_mass = owner_total_mass;
          e->owner_cell_count = owner_cell_count;
        }
      }
      break;
    }

    case CELL_EJECTED:
      if (my_size >= cell->radius * 1.118 && perc->food_count < 64) {
        perc->food[perc->food_count++] = cell;
        if (dist2 < nearest_food_dist2) {
          nearest_food_dist2 = dist2;
          perc->nearest_food_dist = sqrt(dist2);
        }
      }
      break;

    default:
      break;
    }
  }

  /* Compute food clusters */
  if (perc->food_count > 0) {
    /* Simple grid/spatial clustering into top-16 clusters */
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->food_count && perc->food_cluster_count < 16; i++) {
      Cell *f = perc->food[i];
      if (!f || f->is_removed) continue;
      bool added = false;
      for (int c = 0; c < perc->food_cluster_count; c++) {
        BotFoodCluster *cl = &perc->food_clusters[c];
        double cdx = f->position.x - cl->x;
        double cdy = f->position.y - cl->y;
        if (cdx * cdx + cdy * cdy < 400.0 * 400.0) {
          cl->sum_x += f->position.x;
          cl->sum_y += f->position.y;
          cl->count++;
          cl->total_mass += f->mass;
          added = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (!added) {
        BotFoodCluster *cl = &perc->food_clusters[perc->food_cluster_count++];
        cl->x = f->position.x;
        cl->y = f->position.y;
        cl->sum_x = f->position.x;
        cl->sum_y = f->position.y;
        cl->count = 1;
        cl->total_mass = f->mass;
        cl->safe = true;
      }
    }
    /* Update cluster centers and distances ONCE at the end */
    for (int c = 0; c < perc->food_cluster_count; c++) {
      BotFoodCluster *cl = &perc->food_clusters[c];
      if (cl->count > 1) {
        double inv_cnt = 1.0 / (double)cl->count;
        cl->x = cl->sum_x * inv_cnt;
        cl->y = cl->sum_y * inv_cnt;
      }
      double cdx = cl->x - cx;
      double cdy = cl->y - cy;
      cl->dist = sqrt(cdx * cdx + cdy * cdy);
    }
  }

  /* Reclassification pass: promote prey to threat when the enemy PLAYER
   * has total_mass >= 80% of ours. A small split piece is still dangerous
   * if the player's other cells can eat us. */
  {
    int new_prey_count = 0;
    for (int pi = 0; pi < perc->prey_count; pi++) {
      BotEntity *pr = &perc->prey[pi];
      if (!pr->cell || pr->cell->is_removed) continue;

      /* If enemy player's total mass is >= 80% of ours, reclassify as threat */
      if (pr->total_mass >= my_total_mass * 0.80 && perc->threat_count < 32) {
        BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[perc->threat_count++];
        *t = *pr; /* Copy all fields */
        t->can_eat_me = false; /* This specific cell can't eat us */
        t->can_split_eat = false;
        t->danger = clampd(0.35 * (1.0 - pr->dist / 2000.0), 0.10, 0.50);
        if (pr->dist < perc->nearest_threat_dist)
          perc->nearest_threat_dist = pr->dist;
        /* Don't copy to new prey list — it's now a threat */
      } else {
        /* Keep as prey */
        if (new_prey_count != pi)
          perc->prey[new_prey_count] = perc->prey[pi];
        new_prey_count++;
      }
    }
    perc->prey_count = new_prey_count;
  }

  /*
   * Resolve safe-food targeting once per perception update.
   *
   * Previously score_farm_route() and generate_roam() independently
   * performed the same food × threat nested scan and recalculated the
   * same split boost for every food pellet.
   */
  perc->nearest_safe_food = NULL;

  if (perc->food_count > 0) {
    double threat_x[32];
    double threat_y[32];
    double threat_safe_radius2[32];
    int food_threat_count = 0;

    for (int ti = 0;
         ti < perc->threat_count &&
         food_threat_count < 32;
         ti++) {
      BotEntity *threat =
          &perc->threats[ti];

      if (!threat->cell ||
          threat->cell->is_removed) {
        continue;
      }

      double split_half_radius =
          threat->cell->radius /
          1.41421356;

      double safe_radius =
          threat->cell->radius +
          bot_split_boost(split_half_radius) +
          350.0;

      threat_x[food_threat_count] =
          threat->cell->position.x;

      threat_y[food_threat_count] =
          threat->cell->position.y;

      threat_safe_radius2[food_threat_count] =
          safe_radius * safe_radius;

      food_threat_count++;
    }

    double best_safe_food_dist2 = 1e18;

    for (int fi = 0;
         fi < perc->food_count;
         fi++) {
      Cell *food = perc->food[fi];

      if (!food || food->is_removed) {
        continue;
      }

      bool unsafe = false;

      for (int ti = 0;
           ti < food_threat_count;
           ti++) {
        double dx =
            food->position.x -
            threat_x[ti];

        double dy =
            food->position.y -
            threat_y[ti];

        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <
            threat_safe_radius2[ti]) {
          unsafe = true;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (unsafe) {
        continue;
      }

      double dx =
          food->position.x - cx;

      double dy =
          food->position.y - cy;

      double dist2 =
          dx * dx + dy * dy;

      if (dist2 <
          best_safe_food_dist2) {
        best_safe_food_dist2 =
            dist2;

        perc->nearest_safe_food =
            food;
      }
    }
  }

  /* Urgency calculation */
  if (perc->threat_count > 0) {
    double d = perc->nearest_threat_dist;
    perc->urgency = clampd(1.0 - (d - 200.0) / 1800.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    if (perc->threat_count > 1)
      perc->urgency = clampd(perc->urgency * 1.3, 0.0, 1.0);
  }
  PROF_ADD_NS(perc_classify_ns);
  PROF_ADD_NS(bot_perceive_ns);
}

BotPersonality roll_personality(void) {
  double r = randf();
  if (r < 0.15) return PERSONALITIES[BOT_PERS_GHOST];
  if (r < 0.30) return PERSONALITIES[BOT_PERS_FARMER];
  if (r < 0.42) return PERSONALITIES[BOT_PERS_PREDATOR];
  if (r < 0.52) return PERSONALITIES[BOT_PERS_BRAWLER];
  if (r < 0.62) return PERSONALITIES[BOT_PERS_TRICKSTER];
  if (r < 0.72) return PERSONALITIES[BOT_PERS_DIPLOMAT];
  if (r < 0.88) return PERSONALITIES[BOT_PERS_SURVIVOR];
  return PERSONALITIES[BOT_PERS_HOTHEAD];
}

BotTierWeights get_effective_weights(const BotPersonality *p, int mass_tier,
                                      double shift_surv, double shift_farm,
                                      double shift_hunt) {
  if (mass_tier < 0) mass_tier = 0;
  if (mass_tier > 3) mass_tier = 3;
  BotTierWeights w = p->tier_weights[mass_tier];

  w.survival = fmax(0.05, fmin(w.survival + shift_surv, w.survival + 0.5));
  w.farming  = fmax(0.05, fmin(w.farming  + shift_farm, w.farming  + 0.5));
  w.hunting  = fmax(0.05, fmin(w.hunting  + shift_hunt, w.hunting  + 0.5));

  return w;
}

const char *roll_bot_name(BotPersonalityType pers_type, int index) {
  (void)pers_type;
  if (BOT_NICKNAME_COUNT == 0) return "LegendBot";
  int seed = index + fast_random_int(BOT_NICKNAME_COUNT);
  return BOT_NICKNAMES_POOL[seed % BOT_NICKNAME_COUNT];
}

const char *roll_bot_skin(int bot_index) {
  if (SKIN_COUNT == 0) return "";
  return SKINS_POOL[(unsigned int)bot_index % SKIN_COUNT];
}

#include "bot.h"
#include <math.h>

#ifndef UNLIKELY
#if defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
#define UNLIKELY(x) __builtin_expect(!!(x), 0)
#else
#define UNLIKELY(x) (x)
#endif
#endif

/*
 * Speed model (matches server cell speed calculation)
 * Speed ~ 60 / sqrt(radius)
 */
double bot_cell_speed(double radius) {
  if (radius < 10.0) radius = 10.0;
  double speed = 60.0 / sqrt(radius);
  if (speed < 1.0) speed = 1.0;
  return speed;
}

/*
 * Checks if a larger cell can overtake a smaller cell by raw speed in open space.
 * Small cell is faster than large cell. If size_ratio > 1.0, small cell is faster.
 */
bool physics_can_overtake(double threat_radius, double my_radius) {
  if (threat_radius >= my_radius * 1.5) {
    /* Significantly larger -> threat is slower */
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

/* Precomputed lookup table for 780.0 * pow(r, 0.0122) — matches server split physics.
 * 2048 table entries covering r in [0, 8192] with step size 4.0. */
double g_split_boost_table[2048];

#ifdef __GNUC__
__attribute__((constructor))
#endif
static void init_split_boost_table(void) {
  for (int i = 0; i < 2048; i++) {
    double r = (double)i * 4.0;
    g_split_boost_table[i] = 780.0 * pow(r < 1.0 ? 1.0 : r, 0.0122);
  }
}

/*
 * Checks if threat can split-kill us given distance and cell sizes.
 * Split half radius = threat_radius / 1.414.
 * Split reach = threat_radius + bot_split_boost(split_half).
 */
bool physics_can_split_catch(double threat_radius, double my_radius, double dist, double *out_split_half_radius) {
  double split_half = threat_radius * 0.70710678118;
  if (out_split_half_radius) *out_split_half_radius = split_half;

  /* Can the split cell eat me? Need split_half >= my_radius * 1.118 */
  if (split_half < my_radius * 1.118) return false;

  /* Real split range from server physics */
  double boost_dist = bot_split_boost(split_half);
  return (dist < threat_radius + boost_dist);
}

/*
 * Estimate travel ticks for a cell of size `cell_size` to travel distance `dist`.
 */
double physics_estimate_travel_ticks(double dist, double cell_size) {
  double speed = bot_cell_speed(cell_size);
  if (speed <= 0) return 1.0;
  double ticks = dist / speed;
  return (ticks < 1.0) ? 1.0 : ticks;
}

#include "bot_pool.h"
#include "bot_grid.h"
#include "bot_intelligence_engine.h"
#include "async_log.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <pthread.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

#if defined(_OPENMP)
#include <omp.h>
#endif

#define MAX_WORKERS 32



/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Decision Output Buffer — used by the default OpenMP inline path.
 * Each OpenMP thread writes to g_bot_outputs[pid] (unique per-bot, no race).
 * After the implicit OpenMP barrier, the main thread serially commits all
 * outputs to live Player structs. No seqlock or atomics needed.
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
typedef struct {
  float target_x;
  float target_y;
  int pending_splits;
  bool eject_requested;
  bool has_decision;
} BotDecisionOutput;

static BotDecisionOutput g_bot_outputs[MAX_PLAYERS];

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Atomic Command Buffer — used ONLY by the optional pthread persistent
 * worker path (use_pthreads=1, disabled by default).
 * Uses a seqlock to guarantee that all command fields are read as a single
 * consistent transaction.
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#ifdef _WIN32

typedef struct {
  volatile LONG seq_start;
  volatile LONG target_x_bits;   /* float reinterpreted as LONG */
  volatile LONG target_y_bits;
  volatile LONG pending_splits;
  volatile LONG eject_requested;
  volatile LONG seq_end;
  volatile LONG active;
} AtomicBotCommand;

static inline void abc_store_float(volatile LONG *dst, float val) {
  LONG bits;
  memcpy(&bits, &val, sizeof(bits));
  InterlockedExchange(dst, bits);
}
static inline float abc_load_float(volatile LONG *src) {
  LONG bits = InterlockedCompareExchange(src, 0, 0); /* atomic read */
  float val;
  memcpy(&val, &bits, sizeof(val));
  return val;
}

#else /* POSIX — standard C11 atomics */

typedef struct {
  _Atomic uint32_t seq_start;
  _Atomic float target_x;
  _Atomic float target_y;
  _Atomic int pending_splits;
  _Atomic bool eject_requested;
  _Atomic uint32_t seq_end;
  _Atomic bool active;
} AtomicBotCommand;

#endif

static AtomicBotCommand g_bot_commands[MAX_PLAYERS];

#ifdef _WIN32
static HANDLE g_win_threads[MAX_WORKERS];
#else
static pthread_t g_pthread_threads[MAX_WORKERS];
#endif

static int g_active_worker_count = 0;

#ifdef _WIN32
static volatile LONG g_pool_active = 0;
static volatile LONG g_shutdown = 0;
#else
static _Atomic bool g_pool_active = false;
static _Atomic bool g_shutdown = false;
#endif
static BotManager *g_mgr_ptr = NULL;
static GameServer *g_srv_ptr = NULL;

static int get_cpu_cores(void) {
#ifdef _WIN32
  SYSTEM_INFO sysinfo;
  GetSystemInfo(&sysinfo);
  int cores = (int)sysinfo.dwNumberOfProcessors;
  return cores > 0 ? cores : 4;
#else
  long cores = sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN);
  return cores > 0 ? (int)cores : 4;
#endif
}

/*
 * Choose a decision frequency from the bot's previously observed state.
 *
 * A calm bot may take at most three simulation ticks to notice a new threat.
 * Once a threat is perceived, it immediately enters the urgent lane and is
 * evaluated every simulation tick.
 */
static inline uint32_t bot_ai_interval(BotState *bot,
                                       const Player *player,
                                       uint32_t tick) {
  if (!bot || !player) {
    return BOT_AI_CADENCE_URGENT;
  }

  if (bot->tricksplit_phase == 1 ||
      bot->perception.threat_count > 0 ||
      bot->perception.urgency >= 0.20 ||
      bot->virus_fire_w_sent > 0 ||
      tick < bot->commit_until_tick ||
      bot_intel_has_active_plan(bot, tick)) {
    return BOT_AI_CADENCE_URGENT;
  }

  if (bot->perception.prey_count > 0 ||
      bot->chase_active ||
      player->active_cell_count > 1 ||
      player->total_mass >= 100.0) {
    return BOT_AI_CADENCE_ACTIVE;
  }

  return BOT_AI_CADENCE_CALM;
}

static inline bool bot_should_evaluate(BotState *bot,
                                       const Player *player,
                                       uint32_t tick) {
  uint32_t interval = bot_ai_interval(bot, player, tick);

  if (interval <= 1) {
    return true;
  }

  uint32_t phase =
      bot->player_id >= 0
          ? (uint32_t)bot->player_id
          : 0U;

  return ((tick + phase) % interval) == 0U;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Seqlock Command Publish/Consume — for the pthread worker path ONLY.
 *
 * Seqlock protocol:
 *   Writer: increment seq_start to ODD (in-progress)
 *           write all payload fields
 *           increment seq_start to EVEN (complete)
 *           set seq_end = seq_start (even)
 *   Reader: loop until s1 == s2 with even values; skip if s1 is odd
 * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
static void bot_command_publish(int pid, float target_x, float target_y,
                                int splits, bool eject) {
  if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_PLAYERS) return;
  AtomicBotCommand *cmd = &g_bot_commands[pid];
#ifdef _WIN32
  InterlockedIncrement(&cmd->seq_start);                /* Odd: write in progress */
  abc_store_float(&cmd->target_x_bits, target_x);
  abc_store_float(&cmd->target_y_bits, target_y);
  InterlockedExchange(&cmd->pending_splits, (LONG)splits);
  InterlockedExchange(&cmd->eject_requested, eject ? 1 : 0);
  LONG seq_even = InterlockedIncrement(&cmd->seq_start); /* Even: write complete */
  InterlockedExchange(&cmd->seq_end, seq_even);
  InterlockedExchange(&cmd->active, 1);
#else
  atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&cmd->seq_start, 1, memory_order_release);       /* Odd */
  atomic_store_explicit(&cmd->target_x, target_x, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&cmd->target_y, target_y, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&cmd->pending_splits, splits, memory_order_relaxed);
  atomic_store_explicit(&cmd->eject_requested, eject, memory_order_relaxed);
  uint32_t s_even = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&cmd->seq_start, 1, memory_order_release) + 1;
  atomic_store_explicit(&cmd->seq_end, s_even, memory_order_release);        /* Even */
  atomic_store_explicit(&cmd->active, true, memory_order_release);
#endif
}

static bool bot_command_consume(int pid, Player *p) {
  if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_PLAYERS) return false;
  AtomicBotCommand *cmd = &g_bot_commands[pid];
#ifdef _WIN32
  if (!InterlockedCompareExchange(&cmd->active, 0, 0)) return false;
  LONG s1, s2;
  float tx = 0.0f, ty = 0.0f;
  int splits = 0;
  bool eject = false;
  int spin = 0;
  do {
    s1 = InterlockedCompareExchange(&cmd->seq_start, 0, 0);
    if (s1 & 1) { spin++; continue; } /* Writer active */
    tx = abc_load_float(&cmd->target_x_bits);
    ty = abc_load_float(&cmd->target_y_bits);
    splits = (int)InterlockedCompareExchange(&cmd->pending_splits, 0, 0);
    eject = InterlockedCompareExchange(&cmd->eject_requested, 0, 0) != 0;
    s2 = InterlockedCompareExchange(&cmd->seq_end, 0, 0);
    spin++;
  } while ((s1 != s2) && spin < 10);

  if (s1 == s2) { /* Valid snapshot only */
    p->mouse_target.x = (double)tx;
    p->mouse_target.y = (double)ty;
    if (splits > 0) {
      p->pending_splits = splits;
      InterlockedExchange(&cmd->pending_splits, 0);
    }
    if (eject) {
      p->eject_requested = true;
      InterlockedExchange(&cmd->eject_requested, 0);
    }
  }
  return true;
#else
  if (!atomic_load_explicit(&cmd->active, memory_order_acquire)) return false;
  uint32_t s1, s2 = 0;
  float tx = 0.0f, ty = 0.0f;
  int splits = 0;
  bool eject = false;
  int spin = 0;
  do {
    s1 = atomic_load_explicit(&cmd->seq_start, memory_order_acquire);
    if (s1 & 1) { spin++; continue; } /* Writer active */
    tx = atomic_load_explicit(&cmd->target_x, memory_order_relaxed);
    ty = atomic_load_explicit(&cmd->target_y, memory_order_relaxed);
    splits = atomic_load_explicit(&cmd->pending_splits, memory_order_relaxed);
    eject = atomic_load_explicit(&cmd->eject_requested, memory_order_relaxed);
    s2 = atomic_load_explicit(&cmd->seq_end, memory_order_acquire);
    spin++;
  } while ((s1 != s2) && spin < 10);

  if (s1 == s2) { /* Valid snapshot only */
    p->mouse_target.x = (double)tx;
    p->mouse_target.y = (double)ty;
    if (splits > 0) {
      p->pending_splits = splits;
      atomic_store_explicit(&cmd->pending_splits, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    if (eject) {
      p->eject_requested = true;
      atomic_store_explicit(&cmd->eject_requested, false, memory_order_relaxed);
    }
  }
  return true;
#endif
}

/*
 * Shared worker logic: evaluate bot AI for a slice of bots.
 * Used by both Windows and Linux persistent worker threads (pthread path only).
 */
static void worker_evaluate_bots(int worker_id) {
  BotManager *mgr = g_mgr_ptr;
  GameServer *srv = g_srv_ptr;
  int num_workers = g_active_worker_count > 0 ? g_active_worker_count : 1;

  if (!mgr || !srv || mgr->count <= 0)
    return;

  uint64_t _t_thread_start = prof_now_ns();

  int slice = (mgr->count + num_workers - 1) / num_workers;
  int start = worker_id * slice;
  int end = start + slice;
  if (end > mgr->count)
    end = mgr->count;

  for (int i = start; i < end; i++) {
    if (atomic_load(&g_shutdown))
      break;

    BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
    if (!bot->active)
      continue;

    int pid = bot->player_id;
    if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_PLAYERS)
      continue;

    Player *p = &srv->players[pid];
    if (!p->active || p->cell_count == 0)
      continue;

    if (bot->last_evaluated_tick == srv->ticks)
      continue;

    if (!bot_should_evaluate(bot, p, srv->ticks))
      continue;

    bot->last_evaluated_tick = srv->ticks;

    /* Thread-local Player copy — prevents worker from mutating live state */
    Player temp_p = *p;
    temp_p.split_requested = false;
    temp_p.eject_requested = false;
    temp_p.pending_splits = 0;

    bot_brain_decide(bot, srv, &temp_p);

    /* Publish via seqlock command buffer (includes pending_splits) */
    bot_command_publish(pid, (float)temp_p.mouse_target.x, (float)temp_p.mouse_target.y,
                        temp_p.pending_splits, temp_p.eject_requested);
  }

  uint64_t _t_thread_elapsed = prof_now_ns() - _t_thread_start;
  if (worker_id >= 0 && worker_id < 3) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    InterlockedExchangeAdd64((volatile LONGLONG *)&g_prof_stats.thread_total_ns[worker_id], (LONGLONG)_t_thread_elapsed);
#elif defined(__GNUC__) || defined(__clang__)
    __atomic_fetch_add(&g_prof_stats.thread_total_ns[worker_id], _t_thread_elapsed, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
#else
    g_prof_stats.thread_total_ns[worker_id] += _t_thread_elapsed;
#endif
  }
}

#ifdef _WIN32
static DWORD WINAPI win_bot_worker_thread(LPVOID arg) {
  int worker_id = (int)(intptr_t)arg;
  while (!atomic_load(&g_shutdown)) {
    worker_evaluate_bots(worker_id);
    Sleep(1);
  }
  return 0;
}
#else
static void *linux_bot_worker_thread(void *arg) {
  int worker_id = (int)(intptr_t)arg;
  while (!atomic_load(&g_shutdown)) {
    worker_evaluate_bots(worker_id);
    usleep(1000);
  }
  return NULL;
}
#endif

void bot_pool_init(BotManager *mgr, GameServer *srv) {
  if (atomic_load(&g_pool_active)) return; /* Guard duplicate initialization */

  g_mgr_ptr = mgr;
  g_srv_ptr = srv;
  atomic_store(&g_shutdown, false);

  memset(g_bot_commands, 0, sizeof(g_bot_commands));
  memset(g_bot_outputs, 0, sizeof(g_bot_outputs));

  /* Check usePthreads config flag — default disabled */
  if (!srv->config.use_pthreads) {
#if defined(_OPENMP)
    int nthreads = 3;
    const char *env_w = getenv("OMP_NUM_THREADS");
    if (env_w) {
      int custom = atoi(env_w);
      if (custom > 0 && custom <= 64) nthreads = custom;
    }
    omp_set_num_threads(nthreads);
    printf("[BotPool] OpenMP enabled — %d parallel worker threads (%d00%% CPU capacity)\n", nthreads, nthreads);
#else
    printf("[BotPool] usePthreads disabled — bots run inline on sim thread\n");
#endif
    return;
  }

  int cores = get_cpu_cores();
  int worker_threads = 3; /* 3 worker threads max */
  if (worker_threads > MAX_WORKERS) worker_threads = MAX_WORKERS;

  /* Agile Environment Variable Override (e.g. BOT_WORKERS=3) */
  const char *env_w = getenv("BOT_WORKERS");
  if (env_w) {
    int custom = atoi(env_w);
    if (custom > 0 && custom <= MAX_WORKERS) worker_threads = custom;
  }

  int successful_workers = 0;
  g_active_worker_count = worker_threads;

#ifdef _WIN32
  for (int i = 0; i < worker_threads; i++) {
    HANDLE h = CreateThread(NULL, 0, win_bot_worker_thread, (LPVOID)(intptr_t)successful_workers, 0, NULL);
    if (h) {
      g_win_threads[successful_workers++] = h;
    } else {
      printf("[BotPool] Failed to create Win32 worker thread %d (err=%lu)\n", i, GetLastError());
    }
  }
#else
  for (int i = 0; i < worker_threads; i++) {
    pthread_t thread;
    int res = pthread_create(&thread, NULL, linux_bot_worker_thread, (void *)(intptr_t)successful_workers);
    if (res == 0) {
      g_pthread_threads[successful_workers++] = thread;
    } else {
      printf("[BotPool] Failed to create Linux worker thread %d (err=%d)\n", i, res);
    }
  }
#endif

  g_active_worker_count = successful_workers;
  if (successful_workers > 0) {
    atomic_store(&g_pool_active, true);
    printf("[BotPool] Initialized %d parallel worker threads\n", successful_workers);
  } else {
    printf("[BotPool] Failed to initialize worker threads — falling back to inline\n");
  }
}

void bot_pool_tick(BotManager *mgr, GameServer *srv) {
  if (!mgr || mgr->count == 0) return;

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   * PATH A: Persistent pthread workers (disabled by default).
   * Workers evaluate bots asynchronously via seqlock command buffer.
   * Main thread consumes commands here.
   * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  if (atomic_load(&g_pool_active)) {
    for (int i = 0; i < mgr->count; i++) {
      BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
      int pid = bot->player_id;
      if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_PLAYERS) continue;
      Player *p = &srv->players[pid];
      if (!p->active || p->cell_count == 0) continue;

      bot_command_consume(pid, p);
    }
    return;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   * PATH B: Inline OpenMP evaluation (default, use_pthreads=0).
   * OpenMP provides an implicit barrier at the end of the parallel region,
   * so no seqlock or atomics needed. Each thread writes to a private
   * BotDecisionOutput slot, then the main thread serially commits.
   * ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  /*
   * Phase 0: Read the completed BotGrid snapshot from the previous
   * authoritative simulation tick.
   *
   * Do NOT rebuild the grid here. server_tick() performs the only normal
   * rebuild after movement, spawning, queued splits and ejection.
   *
   * A maximum one-tick perception delay is intentional for bot AI and avoids
   * rebuilding the entire dynamic spatial index twice per simulation tick.
   */
  /* Phase 1: Parallel bot AI evaluation */
#if defined(_OPENMP)
  #pragma omp parallel
  {
    int tid = omp_get_thread_num();
    uint64_t started = prof_now_ns();

    #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 32)
    for (int i = 0; i < mgr->count; i++) {
      BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
      if (!bot->active) continue;
      int pid = bot->player_id;
      if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_PLAYERS) continue;
      Player *p = &srv->players[pid];
      if (!p->active || p->cell_count == 0) continue;

      if (!bot_should_evaluate(bot, p, srv->ticks))
        continue;

      bot->last_evaluated_tick = srv->ticks;

      Player temp_p = *p;
      temp_p.split_requested = false;
      temp_p.eject_requested = false;
      temp_p.pending_splits = 0;

      bot_brain_decide(bot, srv, &temp_p);

      BotDecisionOutput *out = &g_bot_outputs[pid];
      out->target_x = (float)temp_p.mouse_target.x;
      out->target_y = (float)temp_p.mouse_target.y;
      out->pending_splits = temp_p.pending_splits;
      out->eject_requested = temp_p.eject_requested;
      out->has_decision = true;
    }

    uint64_t elapsed = prof_now_ns() - started;
    if (tid < 3) {
      __atomic_fetch_add(&g_prof_stats.thread_total_ns[tid], elapsed, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    }
  }
#else
  for (int i = 0; i < mgr->count; i++) {
    BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
    if (!bot->active) continue;
    int pid = bot->player_id;
    if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_PLAYERS) continue;
    Player *p = &srv->players[pid];
    if (!p->active || p->cell_count == 0) continue;

    if (!bot_should_evaluate(bot, p, srv->ticks))
      continue;

    bot->last_evaluated_tick = srv->ticks;

    Player temp_p = *p;
    temp_p.split_requested = false;
    temp_p.eject_requested = false;
    temp_p.pending_splits = 0;

    bot_brain_decide(bot, srv, &temp_p);

    BotDecisionOutput *out = &g_bot_outputs[pid];
    out->target_x = (float)temp_p.mouse_target.x;
    out->target_y = (float)temp_p.mouse_target.y;
    out->pending_splits = temp_p.pending_splits;
    out->eject_requested = temp_p.eject_requested;
    out->has_decision = true;
  }
#endif

  /* Phase 2: Serial commit after implicit OpenMP barrier */
  for (int i = 0; i < mgr->count; i++) {
    BotState *bot = &mgr->bots[i];
    int pid = bot->player_id;
    if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_PLAYERS) continue;
    Player *p = &srv->players[pid];
    if (!p->active || p->cell_count == 0) continue;

    BotDecisionOutput *out = &g_bot_outputs[pid];
    if (!out->has_decision) continue;

    p->mouse_target.x = (double)out->target_x;
    p->mouse_target.y = (double)out->target_y;
    if (out->pending_splits > 0) {
      p->pending_splits = out->pending_splits;
    }
    if (out->eject_requested) {
      p->eject_requested = true;
    }
    out->has_decision = false;
  }
}

void bot_pool_shutdown(void) {
  if (!atomic_load(&g_pool_active)) return;
  atomic_store(&g_shutdown, true);

#ifdef _WIN32
  for (int i = 0; i < g_active_worker_count; i++) {
    if (g_win_threads[i]) {
      WaitForSingleObject(g_win_threads[i], 5000); /* 5s timeout */
      CloseHandle(g_win_threads[i]);
      g_win_threads[i] = NULL;
    }
  }
  printf("[BotPool] Win32 worker threads shut down cleanly\n");
#else
  for (int i = 0; i < g_active_worker_count; i++) {
    pthread_join(g_pthread_threads[i], NULL);
  }
  printf("[BotPool] Lock-free worker threads shut down cleanly\n");
#endif

  atomic_store(&g_pool_active, false);
}

#include "bot.h"
#include "bot_social_engine.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];

int bot_social_get_team_size(int pid) {
  if (pid < 0 || pid >= MAX_BOTS) return 0;
  int visited[16];
  int count = 0;
  int current = pid;

  while (current >= 0 && current < MAX_BOTS && count < 16) {
    bool seen = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      if (visited[i] == current) { seen = true; break; }
    }
    if (seen) break;

    visited[count++] = current;
    current = g_bot_social_engine_states[current].ally_pid;
  }
  return count;
}

void bot_social_init(BotState *bot) {
  bot_social_engine_init(bot);
  if (bot && bot->player_id >= 0 && bot->player_id < MAX_BOTS) {
    BotSocialState *legacy = &g_bot_socials[bot->player_id];
    memset(legacy, 0, sizeof(*legacy));
    legacy->ally_pid = -1;
    legacy->ally_bot_idx = -1;
    BOT_TRUST_SET(legacy, 0.5f);
  }
}

void bot_social_update(BotState *bot, Player *me, BotPerception *perc, uint32_t tick, GameServer *srv) {
  (void)perc; (void)tick;
  bot_social_engine_update(bot, me, srv);

  if (bot && bot->player_id >= 0 && bot->player_id < MAX_BOTS) {
    BotSocialState *legacy = &g_bot_socials[bot->player_id];
    int ally_pid = g_bot_social_engine_states[bot->player_id].ally_pid;
    legacy->ally_pid = ally_pid;
    legacy->ally_bot_idx = ally_pid;
  }
}
