#include "bot_social_engine.h"
#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include "../../src/fast_math.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

#ifdef _MSC_VER
static __declspec(thread) uint32_t g_tls_bot_soc_rng = 135792468U;
#else
static __thread uint32_t g_tls_bot_soc_rng = 135792468U;
#endif

static inline uint32_t bot_soc_rng_u32(void) {
  if (g_tls_bot_soc_rng == 0) g_tls_bot_soc_rng = 135792468U;
  g_tls_bot_soc_rng ^= g_tls_bot_soc_rng << 13;
  g_tls_bot_soc_rng ^= g_tls_bot_soc_rng >> 17;
  g_tls_bot_soc_rng ^= g_tls_bot_soc_rng << 5;
  return g_tls_bot_soc_rng;
}

/* Global Social Engine States for all bots */
BotSocialStateEngine g_bot_social_engine_states[MAX_BOTS];

/* ── MASTER SOCIAL ENGINE INITIALIZATION & TICK UPDATES ──────────── */

void bot_social_engine_init(BotState *bot) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  memset(soc, 0, sizeof(BotSocialStateEngine));
  soc->handshake = HANDSHAKE_IDLE;
  soc->stage = TEAM_STAGE_IDLE;
  soc->ally_pid = -1;
  soc->trust_score = 0.50; /* Neutral initial trust */
}

void bot_social_engine_update(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];

  /* 1. Handshake Timeout Logic:
   * If W invitation was sent over 180 ticks (~7s) ago without response, abort handshake */
  if (soc->handshake == HANDSHAKE_W_SENT) {
    if (srv->ticks - soc->last_w_sent_tick > 180) {
      soc->handshake = HANDSHAKE_REJECTED;
      soc->ally_pid = -1;
    }
  }

  /* 2. Ally Active & Distance Check:
   * If ally disconnected or killed, reset team state */
  if (soc->ally_pid >= 0) {
    Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
    if (!ally->active || ally->cell_count == 0) {
      soc->ally_pid = -1;
      soc->handshake = HANDSHAKE_IDLE;
      soc->stage = TEAM_STAGE_IDLE;
      soc->trust_score = 0.50;
    } else {
      /*
       * Preserve the old arithmetic-center behavior using the cached
       * Player.cell_centroid value.
       */
      soc->ally_last_x =
          ally->cell_centroid.x;

      soc->ally_last_y =
          ally->cell_centroid.y;
    }
  }

  (void)me;
}

/* ── MODULE 1: FRIENDSHIP W HANDSHAKE STATE MACHINE (~200 lines) ─── */

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_w_initiation(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid >= 0 || soc->handshake == HANDSHAKE_W_SENT) return c;

  /* Check personality willingness for friendship */
  if (bot->personality.type == BOT_PERS_PREDATOR || bot->personality.type == BOT_PERS_HOTHEAD) return c;
  if (me->total_mass < 90.0) return c;

  /* Search nearby neutral players (not threats) to initiate W handshake */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *candidate = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!candidate->cell || candidate->cell->is_removed) continue;
    int target_pid = candidate->cell->owner_id;
    if (target_pid < 0 || target_pid == me->id) continue;

    if (bot_social_is_traitor(b_idx, target_pid)) continue;

    double dx = candidate->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
    double dy = candidate->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
    double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;

    if (d2 > (300.0 * 300.0) && d2 < (900.0 * 900.0)) {
      /* Initiate W handshake! */
      soc->handshake = HANDSHAKE_W_SENT;
      soc->ally_pid = target_pid;
      soc->last_w_sent_tick = srv->ticks;

      /* Set Discrete Plan Override */
      bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_FRIENDSHIP_W_INITIATION, candidate->cell->position.x, candidate->cell->position.y, target_pid, 40);

      c.target_x = candidate->cell->position.x;
      c.target_y = candidate->cell->position.y;
      c.score = 3.65;
      c.should_eject = true;
      return c;
    }
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_w_response(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];

  /* Detect nearby neutral players offering partnership */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *candidate = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!candidate->cell || candidate->cell->is_removed) continue;

    double dx = candidate->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
    double dy = candidate->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (500.0 * 500.0)) {
      int feeder_pid = candidate->cell->owner_id;
      if (feeder_pid >= 0 && feeder_pid != me->id) {
        soc->handshake = HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED;
        soc->ally_pid = feeder_pid;
        soc->last_w_received_tick = srv->ticks;
        bot_social_record_event(b_idx, feeder_pid, +0.35);

        bot_social_trigger_chat(bot, srv, "handshake_accept");

        bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_ALLIANCE_FEED, candidate->cell->position.x, candidate->cell->position.y, feeder_pid, 30);

        c.target_x = candidate->cell->position.x;
        c.target_y = candidate->cell->position.y;
        c.score = 3.80;
        c.should_eject = true;
        return c;
      }
    }
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── MODULE 2: 3-STAGE DUO-TEAMPLAY STATE MACHINE (~250 lines) ───── */

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_team_w_boost(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
  if (!ally->active || ally->cell_count == 0) return c;

  /* Calculate ally mass and center */
  double ally_mass =
      ally->total_mass;

  /* Stage 1: W-Boost — Feed ally W mass so ally can split-kill a mutual enemy */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *enemy = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!enemy->cell || enemy->cell->is_removed || enemy->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid) continue;

    double edx = enemy->cell->position.x - soc->ally_last_x;
    double edy = enemy->cell->position.y - soc->ally_last_y;
    double edist2 = edx * edx + edy * edy;

    if (edist2 < (1000.0 * 1000.0)) {
      /* If ally mass is close to split-kill threshold (enemy_mass * 1.15), pump W mass! */
      if (ally_mass * 1.35 > enemy->cell->mass && me->total_mass > 120.0) {
        soc->stage = TEAM_STAGE_W_BOOST;

        bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_ALLIANCE_FEED, soc->ally_last_x, soc->ally_last_y, soc->ally_pid, 50);

        c.target_x = soc->ally_last_x;
        c.target_y = soc->ally_last_y;
        c.score = 3.90;
        c.should_eject = true;
        return c;
      }
    }
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_team_split_shield(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CHASE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  /* Stage 2: Split-Shield — Position cell directly between ally and giant enemy threat */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *threat = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!threat->cell || threat->cell->is_removed || threat->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid) continue;

    double tdx = threat->cell->position.x - soc->ally_last_x;
    double tdy = threat->cell->position.y - soc->ally_last_y;
    double tdist2 = tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy;

    if (tdist2 < (1200.0 * 1200.0)) {
      /* Intercept angle between threat and ally */
      double shield_x = (soc->ally_last_x + threat->cell->position.x) / 2.0;
      double shield_y = (soc->ally_last_y + threat->cell->position.y) / 2.0;

      soc->stage = TEAM_STAGE_SPLIT_SHIELD;
      bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_PROTECT_SMALL_ALLY, shield_x, shield_y, soc->ally_pid, 60);

      c.target_x = shield_x;
      c.target_y = shield_y;
      c.score = 3.85;
      return c;
    }
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_team_refeed(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  /* Stage 3: Refeed — When ally split-kills an enemy, feed W mass to help ally re-merge */
  Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
  if (ally->active && ally->cell_count >= 2) {
    soc->stage = TEAM_STAGE_REFEED;

    bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_ALLIANCE_FEED, soc->ally_last_x, soc->ally_last_y, soc->ally_pid, 40);

    c.target_x = soc->ally_last_x;
    c.target_y = soc->ally_last_y;
    c.score = 3.75;
    c.should_eject = true;
    return c;
  }

  (void)perc; (void)me;
  return c;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_duo_formation_follow(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CHASE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
  if (!ally->active || ally->cell_count == 0) return c;

  double adx = soc->ally_last_x - me->center.x;
  double ady = soc->ally_last_y - me->center.y;
  double adist = sqrt(adx * adx + ady * ady);

  /* Formation Follow triggers when teammates are separated (> 350u) or roaming together */
  if (adist < 220.0) return c;

  /* Calculate formation target position: offset 320u from ally at 45 degree angle */
  double form_offset_x = (b_idx % 2 == 0) ? 280.0 : -280.0;
  double form_offset_y = (b_idx % 3 == 0) ? 220.0 : -220.0;

  double target_fx = soc->ally_last_x + form_offset_x;
  double target_fy = soc->ally_last_y + form_offset_y;

  /* HAZARD SAFETY CHECK 1: Virus Detour Routing */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->virus_count; i++) {
    Cell *v = perc->viruses[i];
    if (!v || v->is_removed) continue;

    double vdx = v->position.x - me->center.x;
    double vdy = v->position.y - me->center.y;
    double vdist2 = vdx * vdx + vdy * vdy;

    /* If virus is directly between bot and target formation waypoint (< 320u), steer detour */
    if (vdist2 < (320.0 * 320.0)) {
      double perp_x = -vdy;
      double perp_y = vdx;
      double plen = sqrt(perp_x * perp_x + perp_y * perp_y);
      if (plen > 1.0) {
        target_fx = v->position.x + (perp_x / plen) * 380.0;
        target_fy = v->position.y + (perp_y / plen) * 380.0;
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  /* HAZARD SAFETY CHECK 2: Enemy Threat Avoidance */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *threat = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!threat->cell || threat->cell->is_removed || threat->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid) continue;

    double tdx = target_fx - threat->cell->position.x;
    double tdy = target_fy - threat->cell->position.y;
    if (tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy < (600.0 * 600.0)) {
      /* Position formation waypoint behind ally relative to threat */
      double push_x = soc->ally_last_x - threat->cell->position.x;
      double push_y = soc->ally_last_y - threat->cell->position.y;
      double plen = sqrt(push_x * push_x + push_y * push_y);
      if (plen > 1.0) {
        target_fx = soc->ally_last_x + (push_x / plen) * 350.0;
        target_fy = soc->ally_last_y + (push_y / plen) * 350.0;
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  /* Set Discrete Plan for Duo Formation Following */
  bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_PERIMETER_SWEEP, target_fx, target_fy, soc->ally_pid, 40);

  c.target_x = target_fx;
  c.target_y = target_fy;
  c.score = 3.70;
  (void)srv;
  return c;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_cooperative_pincer(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CHASE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
  if (!ally->active || ally->cell_count == 0 || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  /* Search for prey visible to both teammates */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *target = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!target->cell || target->cell->is_removed || target->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid) continue;

    double tdx = target->cell->position.x - soc->ally_last_x;
    double tdy = target->cell->position.y - soc->ally_last_y;
    double adist2 = tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy;

    /* If target is near both teammates (< 1000u), initiate Cooperative Pincer! */
    if (adist2 < (1000.0 * 1000.0)) {
      soc->active_pincer = true;

      /* Flank offset: bot ID determines left (+45 deg) or right (-45 deg) pincer arm */
      double angle_offset = (b_idx % 2 == 0) ? (M_PI / 4.0) : (-M_PI / 4.0);
      double pdx = target->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
      double pdy = target->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
      double plen = sqrt(pdx * pdx + pdy * pdy);
      if (plen < 1.0) plen = 1.0;

      double base_angle = atan2(pdy, pdx);
      double pincer_angle = base_angle + angle_offset;

      double pincer_x = me->center.x + cos(pincer_angle) * (plen + 250.0);
      double pincer_y = me->center.y + sin(pincer_angle) * (plen + 250.0);

      bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_TEAM_FEED_SPLIT, pincer_x, pincer_y, target->cell->owner_id, 45);

      c.target_x = pincer_x;
      c.target_y = pincer_y;
      c.score = 3.95;
      c.should_split = (me->total_mass > target->cell->mass * 1.35);
      return c;
    }
  }

  (void)srv;
  return c;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_escort_bodyguard(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_HOLD, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
  if (!ally->active || ally->cell_count == 0) return c;

  /* Calculate ally mass */
  double ally_mass = 0.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < ally->cell_count; i++) {
    if (ally->cells[i] && !ally->cells[i]->is_removed) ally_mass += ally->cells[i]->mass;
  }

  /* Only larger bot acts as Vanguard Bodyguard */
  if (me->total_mass <= ally_mass * 1.20) return c;

  /* Position Vanguard Bodyguard cell directly between small ally and nearest threat */
  if (perc->threat_count > 0) {
    BotEntity *threat = &perc->threats[0];
    if (threat->cell && !threat->cell->is_removed && threat->cell->owner_id != soc->ally_pid) {
      double bg_x = (soc->ally_last_x + threat->cell->position.x * 2.0) / 3.0;
      double bg_y = (soc->ally_last_y + threat->cell->position.y * 2.0) / 3.0;

      bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_PROTECT_SMALL_ALLY, bg_x, bg_y, soc->ally_pid, 50);

      c.target_x = bg_x;
      c.target_y = bg_y;
      c.score = 3.88;
      return c;
    }
  }

  (void)srv;
  return c;
}

bool bot_social_check_misunderstanding(BotState *bot, uint32_t current_tick) {
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return false;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->misunderstanding_active) {
    if (current_tick < soc->misunderstanding_until_tick) {
      return true;
    } else {
      soc->misunderstanding_active = false;
    }
  }

  /* ~18% chance to trigger an intent misunderstanding / hesitation window when an ally signals */
  if (soc->ally_pid >= 0 && soc->active_intent != INTENT_NONE && !soc->misunderstanding_active) {
    if ((bot_soc_rng_u32() % 100) < 18) {
      soc->misunderstanding_active = true;
      soc->misunderstanding_until_tick = current_tick + 12 + (bot_soc_rng_u32() % 18);
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_intent_signaling(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_HOLD, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  /* Check if currently in an Intent Misunderstanding / Hesitation window */
  if (bot_social_check_misunderstanding(bot, srv->ticks)) {
    /* MISUNDERSTANDING ACTIVE: Bot hesitates, looking slightly off-target (30 deg offset) for 0.5s! */
    double pdx = soc->ally_last_x - me->center.x;
    double pdy = soc->ally_last_y - me->center.y;

    c.target_x = me->center.x + pdx * 0.70 - pdy * 0.40;
    c.target_y = me->center.y + pdy * 0.70 + pdx * 0.40;
    c.score = 3.90;
    return c;
  }

  /* Non-Verbal Intent Signal Movement Generation */
  if (soc->active_intent == INTENT_FEED_ME) {
    bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_ALLIANCE_FEED, soc->ally_last_x, soc->ally_last_y, soc->ally_pid, 30);
    c.target_x = soc->ally_last_x;
    c.target_y = soc->ally_last_y;
    c.score = 3.82;
    c.should_eject = true;
    return c;
  } else if (soc->active_intent == INTENT_VIRUS_POP) {
    if (perc->virus_count > 0 && perc->viruses[0]) {
      Cell *v = perc->viruses[0];
      bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_VIRUS_FIRE, v->position.x, v->position.y, soc->ally_pid, 35);
      c.target_x = v->position.x;
      c.target_y = v->position.y;
      c.score = 3.85;
      c.should_eject = true;
      return c;
    }
  }

  (void)srv;
  return c;
}

/* ── MODULE 3: DYNAMIC TRUST MATRIX & ANTI-BETRAYAL TRACKER (~200 lines) */

void bot_social_record_event(int bot_id, int partner_id, double trust_delta) {
  if (bot_id < 0 || bot_id >= MAX_BOTS) return;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[bot_id];
  soc->trust_score = clampd(soc->trust_score + trust_delta, 0.0, 1.0);

  if (trust_delta < -0.40) {
    soc->betrayal_counter++;
    soc->handshake = HANDSHAKE_REJECTED;
    soc->anti_pid = partner_id; /* Set explicit Nemesis / Anti ID */
    soc->ally_pid = -1;
  }
}

bool bot_social_is_traitor(int bot_id, int player_id) {
  if (bot_id < 0 || bot_id >= MAX_BOTS) return false;
  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[bot_id];
  if (soc->anti_pid == player_id) return true;
  if (soc->ally_pid == player_id && soc->trust_score < 0.20) return true;
  return (soc->betrayal_counter > 0 && soc->anti_pid == player_id);
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_nemesis_retaliation(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SPLIT_KILL, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->anti_pid < 0) return c;

  /* Search for explicit Nemesis / Anti player in perception */
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *nemesis = &perc->prey[i];
    if (nemesis->cell && nemesis->cell->owner_id == soc->anti_pid) {
      soc->anti_last_x = nemesis->cell->position.x;
      soc->anti_last_y = nemesis->cell->position.y;

      bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_SPLIT_KILL, soc->anti_last_x, soc->anti_last_y, soc->anti_pid, 50);

      c.target_x = soc->anti_last_x;
      c.target_y = soc->anti_last_y;
      c.score = 4.15; /* Maximum Nemesis Retaliation Priority! */
      c.should_split = (me->total_mass > nemesis->cell->mass * 1.30);
      c.split_count = 1;
      return c;
    }
  }

  (void)srv;
  return c;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_betrayal_revenge(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SPLIT_KILL, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];

  /* If a former ally betrayed us (ate our cell), initiate high-priority revenge split-kill! */
  if (soc->betrayal_counter > 0 && soc->ally_pid >= 0) {
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
      BotEntity *target = &perc->prey[i];
      if (target->cell && target->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid) {
        bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_SPLIT_KILL, target->cell->position.x, target->cell->position.y, soc->ally_pid, 50);

        c.target_x = target->cell->position.x;
        c.target_y = target->cell->position.y;
        c.score = 4.10; /* Max revenge priority! */
        c.should_split = true;
        c.split_count = 1;
        return c;
      }
    }
  }

  (void)me; (void)srv;
  return c;
}

/* ── MODULE 4: VIRUS-SWEEPER & ALLY SUPPORT PROTOCOLS (~180 lines) ── */

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_virus_sweeper(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_VIRUS_EAT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialStateEngine *soc = &g_bot_social_engine_states[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || soc->handshake != HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED) return c;

  Player *ally = &srv->players[soc->ally_pid];
  if (!ally->active) return c;

  /* If bot is small (100-300 mass) and ally is giant (1500+ mass), sweep viruses ahead of ally! */
  if (me->total_mass > 80.0 && me->total_mass < 400.0 && me->cell_count == 16) {
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->virus_count; i++) {
      Cell *v = perc->viruses[i];
      if (!v || v->is_removed) continue;

      double vdx = v->position.x - soc->ally_last_x;
      double vdy = v->position.y - soc->ally_last_y;
      if (vdx * vdx + vdy * vdy < (800.0 * 800.0)) {
        /* Clear virus obstacle for giant ally! */
        soc->stage = TEAM_STAGE_VIRUS_SWEEP;
        bot_intel_set_discrete_plan(bot, DISCRETE_PLAN_VIRUS_EAT, v->position.x, v->position.y, soc->ally_pid, 40);

        c.target_x = v->position.x;
        c.target_y = v->position.y;
        c.score = 3.80;
        return c;
      }
    }
  }

  (void)srv;
  return c;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_protect_ally(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv, BotPerception *perc) {
  /* Delegate to split shield implementation */
  return bot_social_eval_team_split_shield(bot, me, srv, perc);
}

/* ── MODULE 5: PERSONALITY-DRIVEN CHAT & SOCIAL EMOTES (~170 lines) ─ */

void bot_social_trigger_chat(BotState *bot, GameServer *srv, const char *trigger_type) {
  if (!bot || !trigger_type) return;

  /* Dynamic chat lines based on personality type */
  const char *msg = "gg";
  if (strcmp(trigger_type, "handshake_accept") == 0) {
    if (bot->personality.type == BOT_PERS_DIPLOMAT) msg = "team?";
    else if (bot->personality.type == BOT_PERS_TRICKSTER) msg = "lets team W";
    else msg = "W";
  } else if (strcmp(trigger_type, "team_save") == 0) {
    msg = "thanks!";
  } else if (strcmp(trigger_type, "popsplit_kill") == 0) {
    msg = "nice try!";
  }

  (void)srv; (void)msg;
}

BotCandidate bot_social_eval_emote(BotState *bot, Player *me, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_NONE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  (void)bot; (void)srv;
  return c;
}

#ifndef BOT_SOCIAL_ENGINE_H

/* ── Friendship Handshake & Duo-Teamplay States ─────────────── */

typedef enum {
  HANDSHAKE_IDLE = 0,
  HANDSHAKE_W_SENT,
  HANDSHAKE_W_RECEIVED,
  HANDSHAKE_CONFIRMED,
  HANDSHAKE_REJECTED
} HandshakeState;

typedef enum {
  TEAM_STAGE_IDLE = 0,
  TEAM_STAGE_W_BOOST,
  TEAM_STAGE_SPLIT_SHIELD,
  TEAM_STAGE_REFEED,
  TEAM_STAGE_VIRUS_SWEEP
} TeamplayStage;

typedef enum {
  INTENT_NONE = 0,
  INTENT_FOLLOW_ME,
  INTENT_FEED_ME,
  INTENT_VIRUS_POP,
  INTENT_RETREAT
} TeammateIntentSignal;

typedef struct {
  HandshakeState handshake;
  TeamplayStage stage;
  TeammateIntentSignal active_intent;
  uint32_t intent_tick;
  int ally_pid;
  int anti_pid;                  /* Nemesis / Traitor Player ID */
  double trust_score;            /* 0.0 (traitor) to 1.0 (sworn brother) */
  uint32_t handshake_tick;
  uint32_t stage_start_tick;
  uint32_t last_w_received_tick;
  uint32_t last_w_sent_tick;
  double ally_last_x;
  double ally_last_y;
  double anti_last_x;            /* Cached nemesis position */
  double anti_last_y;
  int betrayal_counter;
  bool active_pincer;            /* Active cooperative pincer attack */
  bool misunderstanding_active; /* 15-25% chance bot hesitates/misunderstands intent */
  uint32_t misunderstanding_until_tick;
} BotSocialStateEngine;

/* Global trust matrix across all bots */
extern BotSocialStateEngine g_bot_social_engine_states[MAX_BOTS];

void bot_social_engine_init(BotState *bot);

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static Cell *find_largest_cell_s(Player *me) {
  Cell *best = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < me->cell_count; i++) {
    if (me->cells[i] && !me->cells[i]->is_removed) {
      if (!best || me->cells[i]->mass > best->mass) best = me->cells[i];
    }
  }
  return best;
}

BotCandidate score_popsplit(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_popsplit || perc->virus_count == 0 || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  Cell *lg = find_largest_cell_s(me);
  double my_mass = lg ? lg->mass : 10.0;
  if (my_mass < 180.0) return c; /* Lower mass threshold so bots actually execute popsplits */

  for (int vi = 0; vi < perc->virus_count; vi++) {
    Cell *v = perc->viruses[vi];
    if (!v || v->is_removed) continue;
    double bv_x = v->position.x - me->center.x;
    double bv_y = v->position.y - me->center.y;
    double bv_dist2 = bv_x * bv_x + bv_y * bv_y;
    if (bv_dist2 < (100.0 * 100.0) || bv_dist2 > (650.0 * 650.0)) continue;

    double bv_angle = atan2(bv_y, bv_x);

    extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
    int ally_pid = (me->id >= 0 && me->id < MAX_BOTS) ? g_bot_socials[me->id].ally_pid : -1;

    for (int pi = 0; pi < perc->prey_count; pi++) {
      BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[pi];
      if (!prey->cell || prey->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (ally_pid >= 0 && prey->cell->owner_id == ally_pid) continue; /* Never popsplit ally */
      double prey_mass = prey->cell->mass;
      if (prey_mass < 80.0) continue;

      /* Vector from virus to prey */
      double ve_x = prey->cell->position.x - v->position.x;
      double ve_y = prey->cell->position.y - v->position.y;
      double ve_dist2 = ve_x * ve_x + ve_y * ve_y;
      if (ve_dist2 < (40.0 * 40.0) || ve_dist2 > (480.0 * 480.0)) continue;

      /* Trajectory Ray Alignment: Angle(Bot -> Virus) vs Angle(Virus -> Prey) */
      double ve_angle = atan2(ve_y, ve_x);
      double align_diff = fabs(bv_angle - ve_angle);
      if (align_diff > M_PI) align_diff = 2.0 * M_PI - align_diff;

      /* Line of sight alignment check: < 25° */
      if (align_diff > (25.0 * M_PI / 180.0)) continue;

      /* Real Pop-Split Mass Math:
       * 1st split piece hits virus and pops into 16 pieces.
       * 2nd split piece has mass = my_mass / 4.
       * Radius of 2nd split piece must be > prey_radius * 1.118 to consume prey! */
      double post_pop_split_mass = my_mass / 4.0;
      double post_pop_split_r = sqrt(post_pop_split_mass * 100.0);
      if (post_pop_split_r <= prey->cell->radius * 1.118) continue;

      /* Multi-cell owner check: if prey's owner has large total_mass
       * with multiple cells, their other cells can eat our pop pieces. */
      if (prey->owner_cell_count > 1 && prey->total_mass > post_pop_split_mass * 1.5) continue;

      /* REAL POPSPLIT CONFIRMED:
       * Aim target directly at enemy position through the virus!
       * Trigger a double split (split_count = 2) for the pop-split combo! */
      c.target_x = prey->cell->position.x;
      c.target_y = prey->cell->position.y;
      c.score = 3.60; /* TOP PRIORITY PRO POPSPLIT ACTION */
      c.should_split = true;
      c.split_count = 2; /* Double split = 1st split pops virus, 2nd split eats prey! */
      return c;
    }
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_chain_eat_combo(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SPLIT_KILL, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_split_kill || perc->prey_count == 0 || perc->threat_count == 0) return c;

  Cell *lg = find_largest_cell_s(me);
  double my_mass = lg ? lg->mass : 10.0;
  if (my_mass < 120.0) return c;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *small_prey = &perc->prey[i];
    if (small_prey->dist < 100.0 || small_prey->dist > 650.0) continue;

    if (!small_prey->cell || small_prey->cell->is_removed) continue;
    int enemy_owner = small_prey->cell->owner_id;
    if (enemy_owner < 0) continue;

    for (int j = 0; j < perc->threat_count; j++) {
      BotEntity *big_enemy = &perc->threats[j];
      if (!big_enemy->cell || big_enemy->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (big_enemy->cell->owner_id != enemy_owner) continue;

      double boosted_half_mass = (my_mass * 0.5) + small_prey->cell->mass;
      double boosted_half_r_check = sqrt(boosted_half_mass * 100.0);
      if (boosted_half_r_check <= big_enemy->cell->radius * 1.18) continue;

      double s_dx = small_prey->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
      double s_dy = small_prey->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
      double s_angle = atan2(s_dy, s_dx);

      double b_dx = big_enemy->cell->position.x - small_prey->cell->position.x;
      double b_dy = big_enemy->cell->position.y - small_prey->cell->position.y;
      double b_angle = atan2(b_dy, b_dx);

      double align_diff = fabs(s_angle - b_angle);
      if (align_diff > M_PI) align_diff = 2.0 * M_PI - align_diff;

      double parent_r = lg ? lg->radius : 31.6;
      double split_half_r_at_split = parent_r / 1.41421356;
      double boost = bot_split_boost(split_half_r_at_split);
      double split_reach = parent_r + boost;
      double total_dist = sqrt((big_enemy->cell->position.x - me->center.x) * (big_enemy->cell->position.x - me->center.x) +
                               (big_enemy->cell->position.y - me->center.y) * (big_enemy->cell->position.y - me->center.y));
      if (total_dist > split_reach) continue;

      c.target_x = big_enemy->cell->position.x;
      c.target_y = big_enemy->cell->position.y;
      c.score = 3.88;
      c.should_split = true;
      return c;
    }
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_tricksplit(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, BotState *bot) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_TRICKSPLIT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_tricksplit || !bot) return c;

  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || BOT_TRUST_GET(soc) < 0.25) return c;

  /* Total player mass check: must be sufficiently big (mass >= 350) */
  double my_total_mass = 0.0;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed)
      my_total_mass += me->cells[ci]->mass;
  }
  if (my_total_mass < 350.0) return c;

  /* FRIEND PROXIMITY REQUIREMENT:
   * Allied friend MUST be VERY CLOSE (dist < 450.0) so mass burst lands directly on friend! */
  BotEntity *ally = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    if (!perc->prey[i].cell || perc->prey[i].cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (perc->prey[i].cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid && perc->prey[i].dist < 450.0) {
      ally = &perc->prey[i];
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!ally) {
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
      if (!perc->threats[i].cell || perc->threats[i].cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (perc->threats[i].cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid && perc->threats[i].dist < 450.0) {
        ally = &perc->threats[i];
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (!ally) return c;

  /* TARGET ENEMY EATING CAPABILITY:
   * Search for enemy cell near friend. Verify friend's post-feed mass will allow friend
   * to eat (or split-kill) the enemy! */
  BotEntity *target_enemy = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *e = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!e->cell || e->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (e->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid || e->cell->owner_id == me->id) continue;
    double edx = e->cell->position.x - ally->cell->position.x;
    double edy = e->cell->position.y - ally->cell->position.y;
    double edist = sqrt(edx * edx + edy * edy);
    if (edist < 1400.0) {
      target_enemy = e;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!target_enemy) {
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
      BotEntity *e = &perc->prey[i];
      if (!e->cell || e->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (e->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid || e->cell->owner_id == me->id) continue;
      double edx = e->cell->position.x - ally->cell->position.x;
      double edy = e->cell->position.y - ally->cell->position.y;
      double edist = sqrt(edx * edx + edy * edy);
      if (edist < 1400.0) {
        target_enemy = e;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  /* Must have a target enemy OR viruses nearby */
  bool virus_near = false;
  if (perc->virus_count > 0 && perc->viruses[0]) {
    double vdx = perc->viruses[0]->position.x - me->center.x;
    double vdy = perc->viruses[0]->position.y - me->center.y;
    if (sqrt(vdx * vdx + vdy * vdy) < 800.0) virus_near = true;
  }
  if (!target_enemy && !virus_near) return c;

  if (target_enemy) {
    double combined_friend_mass = ally->cell->mass + my_total_mass * 0.90;
    double friend_split_half_r = sqrt((combined_friend_mass * 0.5) * 100.0);
    double friend_total_r = sqrt(combined_friend_mass * 100.0);

    /* Verify friend can eat enemy (either by split-kill or overlap if on 16) */
    if (friend_total_r <= target_enemy->cell->radius * 1.15) return c;

    /* If friend is not on 16, friend's split-half must eat enemy */
    if (ally->cell->owner_id >= 0 && friend_split_half_r <= target_enemy->cell->radius * 1.118 && !virus_near) {
      return c;
    }
  }

  /* Safety Verification: Ensure no enemy threat can split-kill small 16-pieces */
  double piece_mass = my_total_mass / 16.0;
  double piece_r = sqrt(piece_mass * 100.0);
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (t->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid || t->cell->owner_id == me->id) continue;
    double t_split_half = t->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
    double t_boost = bot_split_boost(t_split_half);
    double split_reach = t->cell->radius + t_boost;
    if (t->cell->radius > piece_r * 1.118 && t->dist < (split_reach + 300.0)) {
      return c;
    }
  }

  /* SHIFT 16-SPLIT CONFIRMED:
   * Friend is very close (< 450u) and ready to eat enemy / vacuum viruses! */
  c.target_x = ally->cell->position.x;
  c.target_y = ally->cell->position.y;
  c.score = 3.65; /* TOP PRIORITY 16-SHIFT ALLY FEED */
  c.should_split = true;
  c.split_count = 4; /* 4 splits = 16 pieces */

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_shift_16_split(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, BotState *bot) {

}

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}

BotCandidate score_flee(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, GameServer *srv, BotState *bot) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_FLEE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->threat_count == 0) return c;

  extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
  int ally_pid = (me->id >= 0 && me->id < MAX_BOTS) ? g_bot_socials[me->id].ally_pid : -1;

  BotEntity *worst = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    if (!perc->threats[i].cell || perc->threats[i].cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (perc->threats[i].cell->owner_id == ally_pid) continue; /* Do not flee from active ally! */
    if (!worst || perc->threats[i].danger > worst->danger) {
      worst = &perc->threats[i];
    }
  }
  if (!worst) return c;

  double split_half_r = worst->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
  double boost_range = bot_split_boost(split_half_r);
  double safe_split_dist = worst->cell->radius + boost_range;

  double score = worst->danger * tw.survival * 4.0;
  if ((worst->can_split_eat || worst->can_eat_me) && worst->dist < safe_split_dist + 500.0) {
    score = fmax(score, 3.85);
  }

  /* Apply long-term player memory flee modifier (fear enemies who killed us before) */
  if (worst->cell && worst->cell->owner_id >= 0 && bot) {
    double mem_flee_mod = bot_memory_get_flee_modifier(bot, worst->cell->owner_id);
    score *= mem_flee_mod;
  }

  c.score = clampd(score, 0.0, 4.0);

  /* Compute dynamic map center from srv->border */
  double map_cx = (srv->border.minx + srv->border.maxx) / 2.0;
  double map_cy = (srv->border.miny + srv->border.maxy) / 2.0;
  double center_angle = atan2(map_cy - me->center.y, map_cx - me->center.x);

  /* Compute flee direction considering ALL cells of the worst threat's owner.
   * This prevents fleeing from one cell into another cell of the same player. */
  double flee_wx = 0.0, flee_wy = 0.0;
  int worst_owner = worst->cell->owner_id;
  if (worst_owner >= 0) {
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
      BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[i];
      if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (t->cell->owner_id != worst_owner) continue;
      /* Weight by danger and inverse distance — closer cells matter more */
      double w = t->danger / (t->dist + 100.0);
      flee_wx += t->dx * w;
      flee_wy += t->dy * w;
    }
  } else {
    flee_wx = worst->dx;
    flee_wy = worst->dy;
  }
  double threat_angle = atan2(flee_wy, flee_wx);
  double flee_angle = atan2(-flee_wy, -flee_wx);

  /* Tactical Perimeter Orbiting:
   * If threat is beyond immediate split-kill range, orbit tangentially (±75° - 90°)
   * around enemy split range rather than running straight away, preventing corner traps! */
  if (worst->dist > safe_split_dist && worst->dist < safe_split_dist + 800.0) {
    double orbit_offset = 1.30; /* ~75 degrees */
    double orbit1 = threat_angle + orbit_offset;
    double orbit2 = threat_angle - orbit_offset;

    double diff1 = fabs(orbit1 - center_angle);
    if (diff1 > M_PI) diff1 = 2.0 * M_PI - diff1;
    double diff2 = fabs(orbit2 - center_angle);
    if (diff2 > M_PI) diff2 = 2.0 * M_PI - diff2;

    flee_angle = (diff1 < diff2) ? orbit1 : orbit2;
  }
  else if (perc->border_dist < 1200.0 || perc->corner_pressure > 0.05) {
    flee_angle = flee_angle * 0.50 + center_angle * 0.50;
  }

  c.target_x = me->center.x + cos(flee_angle) * 1200.0;
  c.target_y = me->center.y + sin(flee_angle) * 1200.0;

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_anti_trap(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ANTI_TRAP, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->trap_detection || perc->threat_count < 2) return c;

  extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
  int ally_pid = (me->id >= 0 && me->id < MAX_BOTS) ? g_bot_socials[me->id].ally_pid : -1;

  /* Find the two most dangerous NON-ALLY threats */
  BotEntity *t1 = NULL, *t2 = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (t->cell->owner_id == ally_pid) continue; /* Skip ally */
    if (!t1) { t1 = t; continue; }
    if (!t2) { t2 = t; continue; }
    if (t->danger > t2->danger) t2 = t;
  }
  if (!t1 || !t2) return c;

  c.score = 0.65 * tw.survival;

  double cx = (t1->cell->position.x + t2->cell->position.x) / 2.0;
  double cy = (t1->cell->position.y + t2->cell->position.y) / 2.0;

  double dx = me->center.x - cx;
  double dy = me->center.y - cy;
  double dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

  if (dist > 0) {
    c.target_x = me->center.x + (dx / dist) * 1200.0;
    c.target_y = me->center.y + (dy / dist) * 1200.0;
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_virus_dodge(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_VIRUS_DODGE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->virus_count == 0 || me->cell_count == 16) return c;

  /* Find the most dangerous cell-virus pair across ALL poppable cells.
   * A bot with 4 cells at 300 mass each has 4 cells that can pop. The one
   * closest to a virus is the most urgent to dodge. */
  Cell *worst_cell = NULL;
  Cell *worst_virus = NULL;
  double worst_gap = 1e9;  /* distance minus pop_zone: smaller = more dangerous */

  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    Cell *my_cell = me->cells[ci];
    if (!my_cell || my_cell->is_removed) continue;

    for (int vi = 0; vi < perc->virus_count; vi++) {
      Cell *v = perc->viruses[vi];
      if (!v || v->is_removed) continue;

      /* Per-cell danger check: Mother eats smaller, virus pops bigger */
      bool dangerous;
      if (v->type == CELL_MOTHER) {
        dangerous = (my_cell->radius <= v->radius * 1.118); /* can't eat Mother at or below 1.118x */
      } else {
        dangerous = (my_cell->radius > v->radius * 1.118);
      }
      if (!dangerous) continue;

      double dx = my_cell->position.x - v->position.x;
      double dy = my_cell->position.y - v->position.y;
      double dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      double pop_zone = v->radius + my_cell->radius;
      double gap = dist - pop_zone; /* negative = overlapping! */

      if (gap < worst_gap) {
        worst_gap = gap;
        worst_cell = my_cell;
        worst_virus = v;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!worst_cell || !worst_virus) return c;

  /* Only dodge if within danger zone (pop_zone + 200 units) */
  if (worst_gap > 200.0) return c;

  double dx = worst_cell->position.x - worst_virus->position.x;
  double dy = worst_cell->position.y - worst_virus->position.y;
  double dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
  if (dist < 0.1) dist = 0.1;

  /* Graduated scoring: higher priority closer to pop zone */
  if (worst_gap < 50.0) {
    c.score = 3.50; /* EMERGENCY: about to pop or overlapping */
  } else {
    /* Smooth ramp: 1.5 at outer edge -> 3.0 near pop zone */
    double t = 1.0 - (worst_gap / 200.0);
    c.score = 1.5 + t * 1.5;
  }

  /* Dodge direction: push the endangered cell AWAY from the virus.
   * Target from me->center so the mouse pulls all cells including this one. */
  c.target_x = me->center.x + (dx / dist) * 800.0;
  c.target_y = me->center.y + (dy / dist) * 800.0;

  return c;
}

static void get_wall_avoidance_target(Player *me, GameServer *srv, double *tx, double *ty) {
  /* Soft wall reflection ONLY within 150u of actual boundary wall */
  double minx = srv->border.minx + 150.0;
  double maxx = srv->border.maxx - 150.0;
  double miny = srv->border.miny + 150.0;
  double maxy = srv->border.maxy - 150.0;

  double push_x = *tx;
  double push_y = *ty;

  if (me->center.x < minx) push_x = minx + 300.0;
  if (me->center.x > maxx) push_x = maxx - 300.0;
  if (me->center.y < miny) push_y = miny + 300.0;
  if (me->center.y > maxy) push_y = maxy - 300.0;

  *tx = push_x;
  *ty = push_y;
}

BotCandidate score_center_reposition(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CENTER_REPOS, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->border_dist > 150.0) return c;

  c.score = 0.10 * tw.survival;
  get_wall_avoidance_target(me, srv, &c.target_x, &c.target_y);
  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_border_pressure(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_BORDER_PRESSURE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->border_dist > 150.0) return c;

  c.score = 0.15 * tw.survival;
  get_wall_avoidance_target(me, srv, &c.target_x, &c.target_y);
  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_edge_flee(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_EDGE_FLEE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->border_dist > 150.0) return c;

  c.score = 0.15 * tw.survival;
  get_wall_avoidance_target(me, srv, &c.target_x, &c.target_y);
  return c;
}

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

BotCandidate score_merge_regroup(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_MERGE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (me->cell_count <= 1) return c;

  c.target_x = me->center.x + (me->mouse_target.x - me->center.x) * 0.8;
  c.target_y = me->center.y + (me->mouse_target.y - me->center.y) * 0.8;

  double urgency = (double)(me->cell_count - 1) / 15.0;
  c.score = urgency * (0.3 + (1.0 - p->split_aggression) * 0.2);

  if (me->cell_count > p->split_comfort) c.score += 0.35;
  if (me->cell_count > 8) c.score += 0.3;

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_split_eat_pieces(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SPLIT_EAT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_split_kill || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;
  if (me->cell_count >= 16) return c; /* Can't split at max cells */

  /* Find our largest cell */
  Cell *largest = NULL;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed) {
      if (!largest || me->cells[ci]->mass > largest->mass)
        largest = me->cells[ci];
    }
  }
  if (!largest || largest->mass < 70.0) return c;

  double split_half_r = largest->radius / 1.41421356;
  double boost = bot_split_boost(split_half_r);
  double split_range = largest->radius + boost;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!prey->cell || prey->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (prey->dist > split_range) continue;

    /* Mass check: our split half must eat prey */
    if (split_half_r <= prey->cell->radius * 1.18) continue;
    if (prey->cell->mass < 20.0) continue;

    /* Safety check: can any nearby threat eat our split-half? */
    bool safe = true;
    for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
      BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[ti];
      if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (!t->can_eat_me && !t->can_split_eat) continue;
      if (t->cell->radius > split_half_r * 1.118) {
        double t_half = t->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
        double t_boost = bot_split_boost(t_half);
        if (t->dist < t->cell->radius + t_boost + 300.0) {
          safe = false;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!safe) continue;

    /* Multi-cell owner check: prey's owner may have other cells that can
     * eat our split-half. Check owner's total_mass vs our split-half mass. */
    double split_half_mass = (split_half_r * split_half_r) / 100.0;
    if (prey->owner_cell_count > 1 && prey->total_mass > split_half_mass * 1.5) continue;

    c.target_x = prey->cell->position.x;
    c.target_y = prey->cell->position.y;
    double gain_score = prey->cell->mass / 200.0;
    c.score = (1.80 + gain_score) * tw.hunting;
    if (c.score > 3.20) c.score = 3.20;
    c.should_split = true;
    return c;
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_self_feed(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SELF_FEED, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (me->cell_count <= 1) return c;

  bool threat_near = (perc->threat_count > 0 && perc->nearest_threat_dist < 400.0);
  bool chasing = (perc->prey_count > 0 && perc->prey[0].dist < 800.0);

  if (!threat_near && !chasing) return c;

  Cell *largest = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < me->cell_count; i++) {
    if (me->cells[i] && !me->cells[i]->is_removed) {
      if (!largest || me->cells[i]->mass > largest->mass) largest = me->cells[i];
    }
  }
  if (!largest) return c;

  c.target_x = largest->position.x;
  c.target_y = largest->position.y;
  c.score = threat_near ? 3.75 : 3.60;
  c.should_eject = true;

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_bait_trap(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_BAIT_TRAP, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_detect_bait || perc->virus_count == 0 || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  Cell *v = perc->viruses[0];
  if (!v || v->is_removed) return c;
  BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[0];
  if (!prey->cell || prey->cell->is_removed) return c;

  double dx = v->position.x - me->center.x;
  double dy = v->position.y - me->center.y;
  double vdist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

  if (vdist < 300.0 && prey->dist < 800.0 && prey->dist > 400.0) {
    c.target_x = me->center.x + (v->position.x - me->center.x) * 0.2;
    c.target_y = me->center.y + (v->position.y - me->center.y) * 0.2;
    c.score = 0.50 * tw.hunting;
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── TEAM FEED SPLIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Coordinated team tactic: Bot A positions behind Ally B along the line to
 * Enemy, then splits all mass into Ally so Ally can eat the enemy. */
BotCandidate score_team_feed_split(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, BotState *bot) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};

  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || BOT_TRUST_GET(soc) < 0.30) return c;

  /* Find ally's LARGEST cell (not just first one found).
   * Feeding mass to the biggest cell maximizes team effectiveness. */
  BotEntity *ally = NULL;
  double ally_best_mass = 0.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    if (!perc->prey[i].cell || perc->prey[i].cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (perc->prey[i].cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid && perc->prey[i].dist < 1400.0) {
      if (perc->prey[i].cell->mass > ally_best_mass) {
        ally_best_mass = perc->prey[i].cell->mass;
        ally = &perc->prey[i];
      }
    }
  }
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    if (!perc->threats[i].cell || perc->threats[i].cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (perc->threats[i].cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid && perc->threats[i].dist < 1400.0) {
      if (perc->threats[i].cell->mass > ally_best_mass) {
        ally_best_mass = perc->threats[i].cell->mass;
        ally = &perc->threats[i];
      }
    }
  }
  if (!ally) return c;

  BotEntity *target_enemy = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *e = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!e->cell || e->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (e->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid || e->cell->owner_id == me->id) continue;
    double edx = e->cell->position.x - ally->cell->position.x;
    double edy = e->cell->position.y - ally->cell->position.y;
    double edist = sqrt(edx * edx + edy * edy);
    if (edist < 1400.0 && e->cell->radius >= 70.0) {
      target_enemy = e;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!target_enemy) {
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
      BotEntity *e = &perc->prey[i];
      if (!e->cell || e->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (e->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid || e->cell->owner_id == me->id) continue;
      double edx = e->cell->position.x - ally->cell->position.x;
      double edy = e->cell->position.y - ally->cell->position.y;
      double edist = sqrt(edx * edx + edy * edy);
      if (edist < 1400.0 && e->cell->radius >= 70.0) {
        target_enemy = e;
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (!target_enemy) return c;

  double a_to_b_dx = ally->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
  double a_to_b_dy = ally->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
  double a_to_b_dist = sqrt(a_to_b_dx * a_to_b_dx + a_to_b_dy * a_to_b_dy);
  if (a_to_b_dist < 1.0) return c;

  double a_to_b_angle = atan2(a_to_b_dy, a_to_b_dx);

  double b_to_e_dx = target_enemy->cell->position.x - ally->cell->position.x;
  double b_to_e_dy = target_enemy->cell->position.y - ally->cell->position.y;
  double b_to_e_dist = sqrt(b_to_e_dx * b_to_e_dx + b_to_e_dy * b_to_e_dy);
  if (b_to_e_dist < 1.0) return c;

  double b_to_e_angle = atan2(b_to_e_dy, b_to_e_dx);

  double align_diff = fabs(a_to_b_angle - b_to_e_angle);
  if (align_diff > M_PI) align_diff = 2.0 * M_PI - align_diff;

  double my_mass = 10.0;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed && me->cells[ci]->mass > my_mass)
      my_mass = me->cells[ci]->mass;
  }
  double combined_fed_mass = ally->cell->mass + my_mass * 0.85;

  double combined_r = sqrt(combined_fed_mass * 100.0);
  if (combined_r <= target_enemy->cell->radius * 1.18) return c;

  double new_ally_radius = sqrt(combined_fed_mass * 100.0);
  double new_ally_half = new_ally_radius / 1.41421356;
  double ally_boost = bot_split_boost(new_ally_half);
  double ally_split_reach = new_ally_radius + ally_boost;

  if (new_ally_half <= target_enemy->cell->radius * 1.18) return c;
  if (b_to_e_dist > ally_split_reach + 200.0) return c;

  double my_radius = sqrt(my_mass * 100.0);
  bool is_inside_ally = (a_to_b_dist < (my_radius + ally->cell->radius + 50.0));

  if (is_inside_ally) {
    if (new_ally_half > target_enemy->cell->radius * 1.118 && b_to_e_dist < (ally_split_reach + 250.0)) {
      c.target_x = ally->cell->position.x;
      c.target_y = ally->cell->position.y;
      c.score = 3.85;
      c.should_split = true;
      c.split_count = 2;
      return c;
    }
  }

  double dir_x = b_to_e_dx / b_to_e_dist;
  double dir_y = b_to_e_dy / b_to_e_dist;
  double ideal_align_x = ally->cell->position.x - dir_x * (ally->cell->radius + 150.0);
  double ideal_align_y = ally->cell->position.y - dir_y * (ally->cell->radius + 150.0);

  if (align_diff > (18.0 * M_PI / 180.0)) {
    c.target_x = ideal_align_x;
    c.target_y = ideal_align_y;
    c.score = 3.10;
    c.should_split = false;
    return c;
  }

  c.target_x = ally->cell->position.x;
  c.target_y = ally->cell->position.y;
  c.score = 3.65;
  c.should_split = true;
  c.split_count = 4;

  return c;
}


/* ── REAL TRICKSPLIT (Solo 2-phase directional split) ─────────────────────
 * Phase 1: Split directly at prey — front piece flies toward them.
 *          Forces the prey to react and dodge sideways.
 * Phase 2: (Executed next tick by bot_brain_decide)
 *          Split from the BACK piece toward the PREDICTED DODGE direction.
 *          The prey can't dodge two directions — one split catches them.
 *
 * Dodge prediction: prey dodges perpendicular to the attack vector,
 * toward the side farther from map center (more open space). */
BotCandidate score_solo_tricksplit(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, BotState *bot) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_TRICKSPLIT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};

  if (!iq->can_tricksplit) return c;
  if (me->cell_count > 4) return c;
  if (perc->prey_count == 0) return c;
  if (bot->tricksplit_phase != 0) return c;

  /* Find largest cell */
  Cell *largest = NULL;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed) {
      if (!largest || me->cells[ci]->radius > largest->radius)
        largest = me->cells[ci];
    }
  }
  if (!largest || largest->mass < 140.0) return c;

  double my_r = largest->radius;
  double split_half_r = my_r / 1.41421356;
  double quarter_r = split_half_r / 1.41421356;

  double boost_val = bot_split_boost(split_half_r);
  double split_range = my_r + boost_val;

  double best_score = 0.0;
  double best_tx = 0, best_ty = 0;
  double best_p2x = 0, best_p2y = 0;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *pr = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!pr->cell || pr->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (pr->dist > split_range * 1.05) continue;
    if (pr->dist < my_r * 0.6) continue;

    if (split_half_r <= pr->cell->radius * 1.118) continue;
    if (quarter_r <= pr->cell->radius * 1.118) continue;

    /* Multi-cell owner check: after tricksplit, our quarter-cell is vulnerable.
     * If prey's owner has large total_mass with multiple cells, abort. */
    double quarter_mass = (quarter_r * quarter_r) / 100.0;
    if (pr->owner_cell_count > 1 && pr->total_mass > quarter_mass * 1.3) continue;

    /* Attack vector */
    double dx = pr->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
    double dy = pr->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
    double adist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (adist < 1.0) continue;
    double nx = dx / adist;
    double ny = dy / adist;

    /* Perpendicular dodge vectors */
    double perp_lx = -ny, perp_ly = nx;
    double perp_rx = ny,  perp_ry = -nx;

    /* Predict dodge side: prey flees toward whichever side is farther from map center */
    double prey_x = pr->cell->position.x;
    double prey_y = pr->cell->position.y;
    double dodge_amt = pr->cell->radius * 4.0 + 200.0;

    double left_x = prey_x + perp_lx * dodge_amt;
    double left_y = prey_y + perp_ly * dodge_amt;
    double right_x = prey_x + perp_rx * dodge_amt;
    double right_y = prey_y + perp_ry * dodge_amt;

    double left_from_center  = left_x * left_x + left_y * left_y;
    double right_from_center = right_x * right_x + right_y * right_y;

    double dodge_x, dodge_y;
    if (left_from_center > right_from_center) {
      dodge_x = left_x;
      dodge_y = left_y;
    } else {
      dodge_x = right_x;
      dodge_y = right_y;
    }

    /* Score: prefer larger prey near the edge of split range */
    double range_factor = pr->dist / split_range;
    double mass_factor = pr->cell->mass / 100.0;
    double score = (1.80 + range_factor * 0.6 + mass_factor * 0.4) * (tw.hunting + 0.3);
    score *= (0.80 + p->split_aggression * 0.5);
    if (score > 3.50) score = 3.50;

    if (score > best_score) {
      best_score = score;
      best_tx = pr->cell->position.x;
      best_ty = pr->cell->position.y;
      best_p2x = dodge_x;
      best_p2y = dodge_y;
    }
  }

  if (best_score <= 0.0) return c;

  /* Phase 1: split directly at prey */
  c.target_x = best_tx;
  c.target_y = best_ty;
  c.score = best_score;
  c.should_split = true;
  c.split_count = 1;

  /* Store phase 2 target for bot_brain_decide */
  bot->tricksplit_phase2_x = best_p2x;
  bot->tricksplit_phase2_y = best_p2y;

  return c;
}

/* ── FEED-SPLIT: FEEDER ROLE ─────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Sustained W-feeding toward ally to enable a split-kill on an enemy.
 *
 * Physics: each W ejects a ~12 mass pellet. Feeder loses ~16 mass per W.
 * Pellets travel at eject_velocity and take several ticks to arrive.
 *
 * The feeder keeps W-ing on consecutive ticks until:
 *   a) Ally has eaten enough W to split-eat the enemy (normal split_kill fires)
 *   b) Enemy moves away or dies (condition no longer met)
 *   c) Feeder runs out of mass (below 35 mass = can't W)
 *
 * This function scores high EVERY tick the opportunity exists,
 * causing the feeder to W repeatedly (sustained feeding). */
BotCandidate score_feed_split_feeder(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, BotState *bot, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_ALLIANCE_FEED, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};

  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  BotSocialState *soc = &g_bot_socials[b_idx];
  if (soc->ally_pid < 0 || BOT_TRUST_GET(soc) < 0.40) return c;

  /* Find ally in perception */
  BotEntity *ally = NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    if (!perc->prey[i].cell || perc->prey[i].cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (perc->prey[i].cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid && perc->prey[i].dist < 1200.0) {
      ally = &perc->prey[i];
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!ally) {
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
      if (!perc->threats[i].cell || perc->threats[i].cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (perc->threats[i].cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid && perc->threats[i].dist < 1200.0) {
        ally = &perc->threats[i];
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  if (!ally) return c;

  double ally_mass = ally->cell->mass;
  double ally_r = ally->cell->radius;
  double ally_split_half_r = ally_r / 1.41421356;

  /* Our largest cell mass — need >= 35 to eject */
  double my_mass = 10.0;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed && me->cells[ci]->mass > my_mass)
      my_mass = me->cells[ci]->mass;
  }
  if (my_mass < 35.0) return c;  /* Can't W below min_eject_size */

  BotEntity *target = NULL;
  double best_priority = 0;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *e = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!e->cell || e->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (e->cell->owner_id == soc->ally_pid || e->cell->owner_id == me->id) continue;

    /* Enemy must be near ally */
    double edx = e->cell->position.x - ally->cell->position.x;
    double edy = e->cell->position.y - ally->cell->position.y;
    double edist = sqrt(edx * edx + edy * edy);
    if (edist > 1400.0 || edist < 50.0) continue;

    /* Condition 1: Ally can't eat enemy alone */
    if (ally_split_half_r > e->cell->radius * 1.118) continue;

    /* Condition 2: With ALL our feedable mass, ally COULD eat enemy.
     * Each W gives ~12 mass. We can W about (my_mass - 35) / 16 times.
     * Total transfer ≈ num_w * 12 mass. */
    int max_w_presses = (int)((my_mass - 35.0) / 16.0);
    if (max_w_presses < 1) continue;
    double max_transfer = max_w_presses * 12.0;
    double fed_ally_mass = ally_mass + max_transfer;
    double fed_ally_r = sqrt(fed_ally_mass * 100.0);
    double fed_split_half_r = fed_ally_r / 1.41421356;

    if (fed_split_half_r <= e->cell->radius * 1.118) continue;

    /* Condition 3: Feeder → Ally → Enemy alignment (within 40°) */
    double me_to_ally_dx = ally->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
    double me_to_ally_dy = ally->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
    double me_to_ally_dist = sqrt(me_to_ally_dx * me_to_ally_dx + me_to_ally_dy * me_to_ally_dy);
    if (me_to_ally_dist < 1.0) continue;

    double me_to_ally_angle = atan2(me_to_ally_dy, me_to_ally_dx);
    double ally_to_e_angle = atan2(edy, edx);

    double angle_diff = fabs(me_to_ally_angle - ally_to_e_angle);
    if (angle_diff > M_PI) angle_diff = 2.0 * M_PI - angle_diff;
    if (angle_diff > (40.0 * M_PI / 180.0)) continue;

    /* Feeder must be BEHIND ally (farther from enemy) */
    double me_to_e_dx = e->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
    double me_to_e_dy = e->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
    double me_to_e_dist = sqrt(me_to_e_dx * me_to_e_dx + me_to_e_dy * me_to_e_dy);
    if (me_to_e_dist < edist) continue;

    double priority = e->cell->mass;
    if (priority > best_priority) {
      best_priority = priority;
      target = e;
    }
  }

  if (!target) return c;

  /* Signal ally with enemy position (refreshed every tick while feeding) */
  int ally_bot_idx = soc->ally_bot_idx;
  if (ally_bot_idx >= 0 && ally_bot_idx < MAX_BOTS) {
    if (g_bot_socials[ally_bot_idx].ally_pid == me->id) {
      bot_social_send_feed_split_signal(
          ally_bot_idx, srv->ticks, (float)target->cell->position.x,
          (float)target->cell->position.y, target->cell->owner_id);
    }
  }

  /* Eject toward ally — this fires EVERY tick the opportunity exists */
  c.target_x = ally->cell->position.x;
  c.target_y = ally->cell->position.y;
  c.score = 3.70;
  c.should_eject = true;
  c.should_split = false;

  return c;
}


/* ── FEED-SPLIT: SPLITTER ROLE ───────────────────────────────────────────
 * The splitter knows its ally is feeding it (via signal). It checks:
 *   1. Is the signaled enemy still alive and nearby?
 *   2. Can MY CURRENT split-half ACTUALLY eat the enemy RIGHT NOW?
 *      (Not a prediction — check real mass after absorbing W pellets)
 *   3. If yes → 16-split toward enemy.
 *   4. If no → DON'T split. Keep waiting. Move toward enemy to close distance.
 *      The feeder keeps W-ing, ally keeps absorbing, and this function
 *      re-evaluates every tick until the mass threshold is crossed. */
BotCandidate score_feed_split_splitter(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, BotState *bot, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SPLIT_EAT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};

  int b_idx = bot->player_id;
  if (b_idx < 0 || b_idx >= MAX_BOTS) return c;

  float sig_x_f = 0.0f, sig_y_f = 0.0f;
  int sig_owner = 0;
  uint32_t signal_tick = bot_social_get_feed_split_signal(b_idx, &sig_x_f, &sig_y_f, &sig_owner);

  /* Check: was I signaled recently? (feeder refreshes every tick) */
  if (signal_tick == 0) return c;
  if ((srv->ticks - signal_tick) > 8) {
    bot_social_clear_feed_split_signal(b_idx, signal_tick);  /* Feeder stopped feeding — abort */
    return c;
  }

  /* Find enemy matching the signal */
  BotEntity *target = NULL;
  double sig_x = (double)sig_x_f;
  double sig_y = (double)sig_y_f;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *e = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!e->cell || e->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (e->cell->owner_id != sig_owner) continue;
    double ddx = e->cell->position.x - sig_x;
    double ddy = e->cell->position.y - sig_y;
    if (sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy) < 500.0) {
      target = e;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!target) {
    for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
      BotEntity *e = &perc->prey[i];
      if (!e->cell || e->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (e->cell->owner_id != sig_owner) continue;
      double ddx = e->cell->position.x - sig_x;
      double ddy = e->cell->position.y - sig_y;
      if (sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy) < 500.0) {
        target = e;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!target) {
    bot_social_clear_feed_split_signal(b_idx, signal_tick);
    return c;
  }

  /* Find MY largest cell and check REAL current mass */
  Cell *largest = NULL;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed) {
      if (!largest || me->cells[ci]->radius > largest->radius)
        largest = me->cells[ci];
    }
  }
  if (!largest) return c;

  double my_split_half_r = largest->radius / 1.41421356;

  /* CAN I eat the enemy with my current split-half? */
  if (my_split_half_r <= target->cell->radius * 1.118) {
    /* NOT YET — mass hasn't arrived or isn't enough yet.
     * Move toward enemy to close distance while waiting for more W. */
    c.target_x = target->cell->position.x;
    c.target_y = target->cell->position.y;
    c.score = 1.50;  /* Medium priority — approach but don't split */
    c.should_split = false;
    return c;
  }

  /* Check split range */
  double boost_val = bot_split_boost(my_split_half_r);
  double split_range = largest->radius + boost_val;
  if (target->dist > split_range * 1.1) {
    /* In range soon — approach */
    c.target_x = target->cell->position.x;
    c.target_y = target->cell->position.y;
    c.score = 1.80;
    c.should_split = false;
    return c;
  }

  /* YES — we're big enough AND in range. 16-SPLIT NOW! */
  bot_social_clear_feed_split_signal(b_idx, signal_tick);  /* Consume signal */

  c.target_x = target->cell->position.x;
  c.target_y = target->cell->position.y;
  c.score = 3.80;
  c.should_split = true;
  c.split_count = 4;  /* 1→2→4→8→16 cells */

  return c;
}
