#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static double clampd(double v, double lo, double hi) {
  if (v < lo) return lo;
  if (v > hi) return hi;
  return v;
}



/* ── 1. JUKE DODGE ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 * When an enemy is about to split-kill us (within split range + 200u buffer),
 * perform a sharp 90° angle change perpendicular to the threat vector.
 * This causes the enemy's split to miss — the #1 survival move pros use. */
BotCandidate score_juke_dodge(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_FLEE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->trap_detection || perc->threat_count == 0) return c;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (!t->can_split_eat) continue;

    double split_half = t->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
    double boost = bot_split_boost(split_half);
    double split_reach = t->cell->radius + boost;
    double danger_zone = split_reach + 200.0;

    /* Only juke when enemy is just entering split range (closing in) */
    if (t->dist > danger_zone || t->dist < 100.0) continue;

    /* Sharp 90° perpendicular dodge */
    double threat_angle = atan2(t->dy, t->dx);
    double juke_angle = threat_angle + (M_PI / 2.0); /* perpendicular */

    /* Pick the juke direction that moves us toward map center */
    double juke1_x = me->center.x + cos(juke_angle) * 800.0;
    double juke1_y = me->center.y + sin(juke_angle) * 800.0;
    double juke2_x = me->center.x + cos(juke_angle + M_PI) * 800.0;
    double juke2_y = me->center.y + sin(juke_angle + M_PI) * 800.0;

    /* Pick whichever juke direction is further from this specific threat */
    double d1 = (juke1_x - t->cell->position.x) * (juke1_x - t->cell->position.x) +
                (juke1_y - t->cell->position.y) * (juke1_y - t->cell->position.y);
    double d2 = (juke2_x - t->cell->position.x) * (juke2_x - t->cell->position.x) +
                (juke2_y - t->cell->position.y) * (juke2_y - t->cell->position.y);

    if (d1 > d2) {
      c.target_x = juke1_x;
      c.target_y = juke1_y;
    } else {
      c.target_x = juke2_x;
      c.target_y = juke2_y;
    }

    c.score = 3.96; /* Very high priority — life-saving maneuver */
    return c;
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── 2. MERGE BAIT ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 * When split into 2+ cells, appear vulnerable to lure enemy close.
 * As enemy approaches to eat a "free" small piece, time the merge
 * so we recombine into one large cell that swallows the attacker. */
BotCandidate score_merge_bait(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CHASE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (me->cell_count < 2 || !iq->can_split_kill) return c;

  /* Calculate total mass if merged */
  double total_mass =
      me->total_mass;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *enemy = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!enemy->cell || enemy->cell->is_removed) continue;
    /* Enemy is approaching to eat one of our pieces */
    if (enemy->dist > 600.0) continue;

    /* If we merged, would we be big enough to eat them? (radius-based check) */
    double merged_radius = sqrt(total_mass * 100.0);
    if (merged_radius <= enemy->cell->radius * 1.18) continue;

    /* Enemy must be smaller than our merged mass but bigger than our individual pieces */
    Cell *smallest_cell =
        me->smallest_cell;

    if (!smallest_cell) {
      continue;
    }

    double smallest_piece =
        smallest_cell->mass;
    if (enemy->cell->radius < sqrt(smallest_piece * 100.0) * 1.118) continue; /* enemy can't eat our pieces, no bait */

    /* MERGE BAIT: Move cells toward center to trigger merge, aim at enemy */
    c.target_x = me->center.x; /* Pull toward own center to force merge */
    c.target_y = me->center.y;
    c.score = 3.78;
    return c;
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── 3. VIRUS HIDING ────────────────────────────────────────────
 * When small (< virus eat threshold) and being chased by a large enemy,
 * hide behind or inside a nearby virus. The enemy won't chase through
 * the virus because they'd pop. */
BotCandidate score_virus_hide(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_FLEE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->threat_count == 0 || perc->virus_count == 0) return c;

  /* Compute maximum piece radius for poppability check */
  double max_piece_radius =
      me->largest_cell
          ? me->largest_cell->radius
          : 0.0;

  /* VIRUS FORTRESS ELIGIBILITY:
   * Must be smaller than smallest virus (radius 100 * 1.118) or at 16 pieces. */
  if (max_piece_radius > 100.0 * 1.118 && me->cell_count < 16) return c;

  BotEntity *threat = &perc->threats[0];
  if (!threat->cell || threat->cell->is_removed) return c;

  /* STRESS / SURROUNDED REQUIREMENT:
   * Trigger when under chase (threat dist < 800u), high urgency (>= 0.30),
   * or when surrounded by multiple threats / corner pressure. */
  bool surrounded = (perc->threat_count >= 2 || perc->corner_pressure > 0.20);
  if (threat->dist > 800.0 && perc->urgency < 0.30 && !surrounded) return c;

  /* Find nearest virus sanctuary */
  Cell *best_virus = NULL;
  double min_vdist = 1e9;
  for (int vi = 0; vi < perc->virus_count; vi++) {
    Cell *v = perc->viruses[vi];
    if (!v || v->is_removed) continue;
    double vx = v->position.x - me->center.x;
    double vy = v->position.y - me->center.y;
    double vdist = sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
    if (vdist < min_vdist && vdist < 1000.0) {
      min_vdist = vdist;
      best_virus = v;
    }
  }

  if (best_virus) {
    /* Drive straight into the INSIDE / CENTER of the virus as fortress sanctuary */
    c.target_x = best_virus->position.x;
    c.target_y = best_virus->position.y;

    /* FORTRESS HOLD: If already inside virus (dist < 50u) and surrounded by threats,
     * HOLD position inside the virus until danger clears! */
    if (min_vdist < 50.0 && (surrounded || threat->dist < 700.0)) {
      c.score = 3.95; /* TOP PRIORITY FORTRESS HOLD */
    } else {
      c.score = fmax(3.60, perc->urgency * 3.85);
    }
    return c;
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── 4. EJECTION BAIT ──────────────────────────────────────────
 * Eject 1-2 W pellets in front of us to lure a greedy prey cell
 * closer into our split-kill range. */
BotCandidate score_ejection_bait(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_BAIT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!p->bait_feeding || !iq->can_split_kill || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  Cell *lg = me->largest_cell;
  double my_mass = lg ? lg->mass : 10.0;
  if (my_mass < 150.0) return c; /* Need enough mass to split-kill after baiting */

  double my_radius = lg ? lg->radius : sqrt(my_mass * 100.0);
  double split_half_r = my_radius / 1.41421356;
  double split_boost = bot_split_boost(split_half_r);
  double split_range = my_radius + split_boost;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[i];
    /* Prey is just outside split range but approaching */
    if (prey->dist < split_range || prey->dist > split_range + 500.0) continue;
    if (prey->cell->mass < 40.0) continue; /* Not worth baiting tiny cells */

    /* Eject W toward the prey to lure them in */
    c.target_x = prey->cell->position.x;
    c.target_y = prey->cell->position.y;
    c.score = 3.65;
    c.should_eject = true;
    return c;
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── 5. WALL PINCH / CORNER DRIVE ──────────────────────────────
 * When chasing prey, steer them toward the nearest wall or corner
 * by positioning between the prey and the map center. */
BotCandidate score_wall_pinch(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, GameServer *srv, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_CHASE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->trap_detection || perc->prey_count == 0) return c;

  double map_cx = (srv->border.minx + srv->border.maxx) / 2.0;
  double map_cy = (srv->border.miny + srv->border.maxy) / 2.0;

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->prey_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[i];
    if (!prey->cell || prey->cell->is_removed) continue;
    if (prey->dist > 1200.0) continue;

    double px = prey->cell->position.x;
    double py = prey->cell->position.y;

    /* How close is prey to any border? */
    double dL = px - srv->border.minx;
    double dR = srv->border.maxx - px;
    double dT = py - srv->border.miny;
    double dB = srv->border.maxy - py;
    double prey_border_dist = fmin(fmin(dL, dR), fmin(dT, dB));

    if (prey_border_dist > 2000.0) continue; /* Prey isn't near a wall */

    /* Position between prey and map center to cut off their escape */
    double to_center_x = map_cx - px;
    double to_center_y = map_cy - py;
    double to_center_dist = sqrt(to_center_x * to_center_x + to_center_y * to_center_y);
    if (to_center_dist < 1.0) continue;

    /* Intercept point: 200u toward center from prey position */
    c.target_x = px + (to_center_x / to_center_dist) * 200.0;
    c.target_y = py + (to_center_y / to_center_dist) * 200.0;
    c.score = 3.70;
    return c;
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── 6. MASS SWEEP ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Evaluate splitting into a cluster of small enemy cells along a trajectory.
 * Count how many small pieces can be eaten in a sweep path, calculate total
 * harvestable mass, and only commit if:
 *   - Total harvest mass is significant (> 30% of our mass or > 200)
 *   - No big enemy within counter-split range that could eat us after
 *   - The trajectory is clear (we can reach the cells)
 * This mimics the pro "plowing through scattered pieces" move. */
BotCandidate score_mass_sweep(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_MASS_SWEEP, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_split_kill || perc->prey_count < 2) return c;

  Cell *lg = me->largest_cell;
  double my_mass = lg ? lg->mass : 10.0;
  double my_radius = lg ? lg->radius : 10.0;
  if (my_mass < 80.0) return c;

  /* Post-split initial cell mass & radius */
  double split_mass = my_mass / 2.0;

  double best_sweep_score = 0.0;
  double best_tx = me->center.x;
  double best_ty = me->center.y;
  bool best_should_split = false;

  /* Helper structure for sorting prey by distance in sweep cone */
  typedef struct {
    BotEntity *prey;
    double dist;
  } SweepCandidate;

  SweepCandidate cand_list[32];

  for (int anchor = 0; anchor < perc->prey_count && anchor < 12; anchor++) {
    BotEntity *a = &perc->prey[anchor];
    if (!a->cell || a->cell->is_removed || a->dist > 1100.0) continue;

    /* Direction vector from us toward this anchor */
    double dx = a->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
    double dy = a->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
    double dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (dist < 1.0) continue;
    double dir_x = dx / dist;
    double dir_y = dy / dist;

    /* Collect all prey within 120° sweep cone (angle <= 60°, dot >= 0.5) */
    int cand_count = 0;
    for (int pi = 0; pi < perc->prey_count; pi++) {
      BotEntity *pr = &perc->prey[pi];
      if (!pr->cell || pr->cell->is_removed || pr->dist > 1100.0) continue;

      double pdx = pr->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
      double pdy = pr->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
      double pdist = sqrt(pdx * pdx + pdy * pdy);
      if (pdist < 1.0) continue;

      double dot = (pdx * dir_x + pdy * dir_y) / pdist;
      if (dot < 0.5) continue; /* Outside 120° cone */

      cand_list[cand_count].prey = pr;
      cand_list[cand_count].dist = pdist;
      cand_count++;
      if (cand_count >= 32) break;
    }

    if (cand_count < 2) continue;

    /* Sort candidate prey cells by distance (closest first) */
    for (int i = 0; i < cand_count - 1; i++) {
      for (int j = i + 1; j < cand_count; j++) {
        if (cand_list[i].dist > cand_list[j].dist) {
          SweepCandidate tmp = cand_list[i];
          cand_list[i] = cand_list[j];
          cand_list[j] = tmp;
        }
      }
    }

    /* SNOWBALL CUMULATIVE MASS SIMULATION:
     * Simulate our split cell sweeping through the cluster in distance order.
     * As it eats each small piece, its mass & radius grow, allowing it to eat
     * larger pieces further along the path into a HUGE cell! */
    double accumulated_mass = split_mass;
    double sweep_harvest_mass = 0.0;
    int sweep_count = 0;
    double furthest_dist = 0.0;
    double centroid_x = 0.0;
    double centroid_y = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < cand_count; i++) {
      BotEntity *pr = cand_list[i].prey;
      double current_r = sqrt(accumulated_mass * 100.0);

      /* Can our growing split piece eat this prey cell? */
      if (current_r >= pr->cell->radius * 1.118) {
        accumulated_mass += pr->cell->mass * 0.95; /* Snowball growth! */
        sweep_harvest_mass += pr->cell->mass;
        sweep_count++;
        centroid_x += pr->cell->position.x;
        centroid_y += pr->cell->position.y;
        if (cand_list[i].dist > furthest_dist) furthest_dist = cand_list[i].dist;
      }
    }

    if (sweep_count < 2 || sweep_harvest_mass < 40.0) continue;

    centroid_x /= sweep_count;
    centroid_y /= sweep_count;

    /* SAFETY CHECK: Is there a big enemy threat near the landing centroid? */
    bool safe = true;
    double final_split_r = sqrt(accumulated_mass * 100.0);
    for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
      BotEntity *threat = &perc->threats[ti];
      if (!threat->cell || threat->cell->is_removed) continue;
      /* If threat is bigger than our grown snowball piece */
      if (threat->cell->radius > final_split_r * 1.118) {
        double t_half = threat->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
        double t_boost = bot_split_boost(t_half);
        double enemy_split_range = threat->cell->radius + t_boost;
        double ex = threat->cell->position.x - centroid_x;
        double ey = threat->cell->position.y - centroid_y;
        if (sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey) < enemy_split_range + 250.0) {
          safe = false;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!safe) continue;

    /* Score: High priority for snowballing multifood clusters */
    double harvest_ratio = sweep_harvest_mass / my_mass;
    double score = clampd(fmax(3.70, 3.50 + harvest_ratio * 0.5 + sweep_count * 0.10), 3.70, 3.92);

    if (score > best_sweep_score) {
      best_sweep_score = score;
      best_tx = centroid_x;
      best_ty = centroid_y;
      double my_split_half = my_radius / 1.41421356;
      double my_split_boost = bot_split_boost(my_split_half);
      best_should_split = (furthest_dist < my_radius + my_split_boost + 300.0);
    }
  }

  if (best_sweep_score > 0.0) {
    c.target_x = best_tx;
    c.target_y = best_ty;
    c.score = best_sweep_score;
    c.should_split = best_should_split;
  }

  return c;
}

/* ── 7. MULTI-SPLIT AGGRESSION ──────────────────────────────────
 * When the bot is big and safe, evaluate whether splitting 2-4 times
 * (into 4/8/16 pieces) can eat multiple large prey cells in a direction.
 *
 * Requirements for multi-split:
 *   1. No threat can eat our smallest piece after N splits
 *   2. At least 2 prey cells are eatable by our split pieces
 *   3. Total harvested mass justifies the risk
 *   4. All eatable prey are roughly in the same direction (45° cone)
 *
 * Split math:
 *   1 split → 2 cells, each = mass/2
 *   2 splits → 4 cells, each = mass/4
 *   3 splits → 8 cells, each = mass/8
 *   4 splits → 16 cells, each = mass/16
 */
BotCandidate score_multi_split_aggression(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_SPLIT_KILL, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_split_kill || me->cell_count > 4) return c;

  Cell *lg = me->largest_cell;
  double my_mass = lg ? lg->mass : 10.0;
  double my_size = lg ? lg->radius : 10.0;
  if (my_mass < 200.0) return c;

  /* Try split counts from 4 down to 1 (single split into cluster) */
  for (int num_splits = 4; num_splits >= 1; num_splits--) {
    int pieces = 1 << num_splits; /* 2, 4, 8, or 16 */
    double piece_mass = my_mass / (double)pieces;
    double piece_radius = sqrt(piece_mass * 100.0);

    /* Too many pieces when already split? */
    if (me->cell_count * pieces > 16) continue;

    /* ANTI-TEAMING MASS BLEED EVALUATION:
     * Only restrict multi-splits if under HEAVY Anti-Teaming penalty (> 1.8). */
    if (me->extra_decay_multiplier > 1.8 && num_splits > 1) {
      continue;
    }

    /* Check: can any nearby threat eat our smallest piece? */
    bool safe = true;
    for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
      BotEntity *threat = &perc->threats[ti];
      if (!threat->cell || threat->cell->is_removed) continue;

      /* Correct server split range for threat */
      double t_split_half = threat->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
      double t_boost = bot_split_boost(t_split_half);
      double threat_split_range = threat->cell->radius + t_boost;

      /* Threat can eat our piece if threat_radius > piece_radius * 1.118 */
      if (threat->cell->radius > piece_radius * 1.118) {
        if (threat->dist < threat_split_range + 400.0) {
          safe = false;
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    if (!safe) continue;

    /* Count how many prey cells our split pieces can eat in the best direction */
    /* Try 12 radial directions (every 30°) for finer coverage */
    double best_dir_score = 0.0;
    double best_dir_x = 0.0;
    double best_dir_y = 0.0;
    int best_eat_count = 0;
    double best_harvest = 0.0;

    /* Split range for our piece */
    double piece_half_r = piece_radius / 1.41421356;
    double piece_boost = bot_split_boost(piece_half_r);
    double piece_reach = my_size + piece_boost; /* for single split, reach from parent center */
    if (num_splits > 1) piece_reach = my_size + piece_boost + 200.0; /* extra for chain splits */

    for (int dir = 0; dir < 12; dir++) {
      double angle = dir * (M_PI / 6.0);
      double dir_x = cos(angle);
      double dir_y = sin(angle);

      double harvest = 0.0;
      int eat_count = 0;
      double centroid_x = 0.0;
      double centroid_y = 0.0;

      for (int pi = 0; pi < perc->prey_count; pi++) {
        BotEntity *prey = &perc->prey[pi];
        if (!prey->cell || prey->cell->is_removed) continue;
        if (prey->dist > piece_reach * 1.2) continue;

        /* Can our split piece eat this prey? Use radius ratio with safety margin */
        if (piece_radius <= prey->cell->radius * 1.18) continue;

        /* Is prey roughly in this direction? (within generous 60° cone) */
        double pdx = prey->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
        double pdy = prey->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
        double pdist = sqrt(pdx * pdx + pdy * pdy);
        if (pdist < 1.0) continue;

        double dot = (pdx * dir_x + pdy * dir_y) / pdist;
        if (dot < 0.50) continue; /* cos(60°) = 0.50 */

        /* Count ALL edible prey (even small ones — they add up) */
        if (prey->cell->mass > 10.0) {
          harvest += prey->cell->mass;
          eat_count++;
          centroid_x += prey->cell->position.x;
          centroid_y += prey->cell->position.y;
        }
      }

      /* For single split: even 1 big cell (>= 150 mass) is worth it */
      int min_eat = (num_splits == 1) ? 1 : 2;
      double min_harvest = fmin(my_mass * 0.03, 150.0);

      if (eat_count >= min_eat && harvest >= min_harvest) {
        double dir_score = harvest + eat_count * 50.0;
        if (dir_score > best_dir_score) {
          best_dir_score = dir_score;
          best_dir_x = centroid_x / eat_count;
          best_dir_y = centroid_y / eat_count;
          best_eat_count = eat_count;
          best_harvest = harvest;
        }
      }
    }

    if (best_eat_count >= 1 && best_harvest >= fmin(my_mass * 0.03, 150.0)) {
      double relative_ratio = best_harvest / my_mass;
      double absolute_gain_score = best_harvest / 350.0;
      double base_score = 1.90 + relative_ratio * 1.5 + absolute_gain_score + best_eat_count * 0.35;

      c.score = clampd(base_score * tw.hunting, 0.0, 3.90);
      c.target_x = best_dir_x;
      c.target_y = best_dir_y;
      c.should_split = true;
      c.split_count = num_splits;

      /* Only penalize score if a dangerous threat is in the SAME DIRECTION as the split!
       * If splitting away from threat (e.g. splitting left while threat is above), do NOT penalize! */
      double sdx = best_dir_x - me->center.x;
      double sdy = best_dir_y - me->center.y;
      double sdist = sqrt(sdx * sdx + sdy * sdy);
      if (sdist > 1.0) {
        for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
          BotEntity *threat = &perc->threats[ti];
          if (!threat->cell || threat->cell->is_removed) continue;
          if (threat->cell->radius <= piece_radius * 1.118) continue;
          double tdx = threat->cell->position.x - me->center.x;
          double tdy = threat->cell->position.y - me->center.y;
          double tdist = sqrt(tdx * tdx + tdy * tdy);
          if (tdist > 1.0) {
            double dot = (sdx * tdx + sdy * tdy) / (sdist * tdist);
            /* If threat is in the same direction cone (> 45° = dot > 0.707) and within range */
            if (dot > 0.707 && tdist < 1400.0) {
              c.score *= 0.6;
              break;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return c;
    }
  }

  return c;
}

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>

BotVetoVerdict bot_veto_evaluate(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, const BotIQProfile *iq, double target_x, double target_y, double action_score, double prey_mass, BotActionType action) {
  BotVetoVerdict v = {true, NULL, action_score};

  double largest_r = 31.6;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed && me->cells[ci]->radius > largest_r)
      largest_r = me->cells[ci]->radius;
  }
  double split_half_r = largest_r / 1.41421356;
  double split_half_mass = (split_half_r * split_half_r) / 100.0;

  /* Rule 1: Split-Half Vulnerability Check to Enemy Threats
   * Account for expected prey mass gain — after eating prey, we're bigger and may be safe. */
  double post_eat_mass = split_half_mass + prey_mass;
  double post_eat_r = sqrt(post_eat_mass * 100.0);

  for (int i = 0; i < perc->threat_count; i++) {
    BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[i];
    if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;

    double threat_r = t->cell->radius;
    /* If threat can eat our front split piece EVEN AFTER it eats prey */
    if (threat_r >= post_eat_r * 1.118) {
      double dx = t->cell->position.x - target_x;
      double dy = t->cell->position.y - target_y;
      double dist_to_landing = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

      /* If threat is within threat's actual split range of where front piece lands */
      /* If threat is within threat's actual split range of where front piece lands */
      double threat_split_half = threat_r / 1.41421356;
      double threat_boost = bot_split_boost(threat_split_half);
      if (dist_to_landing < (threat_r + threat_boost)) {
        v.allow = false;
        v.reason = "front_piece_vulnerable_to_threat";
        v.adjusted_score = 0.0;
        return v;
      }
    }
  }

  /* Rule 2: Trailing Piece Exposure & Net-Loss Check */
  if (me->cell_count > 1) {
    for (int ci = 1; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
      Cell *trailing = me->cells[ci];
      if (!trailing || trailing->is_removed) continue;

      for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
        BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[ti];
        if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;

        double t_split_half = t->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
        double t_boost = bot_split_boost(t_split_half);
        if (t->cell->radius >= trailing->radius * 1.118 && t->dist < (t->cell->radius + t_boost)) {
          /* If potential mass lost to threat > mass gained from prey, VETO */
          if (trailing->mass >= prey_mass) {
            v.allow = false;
            v.reason = "net_loss_trailing_piece_exposed";
            v.adjusted_score = 0.0;
            return v;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* Rule 3: Unintended Virus Collision Check (Trajectory-Based)
   * A split piece gets boosted ~780 units from the splitting cell in the
   * mouse direction. Check if ANY virus is along this trajectory, not just
   * at the mouse target (which is ~2000 units away and far past the landing).
   * For BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT, popping on the virus is INTENDED, so bypass. */
  if (action != BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT && me->cell_count < 16 && perc->virus_count > 0 && split_half_mass >= 130.0) {
    /* Find the splitting cell (largest) to compute boost trajectory */
    Cell *split_cell = NULL;
    for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
      if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed) {
        if (!split_cell || me->cells[ci]->radius > split_cell->radius)
          split_cell = me->cells[ci];
      }
    }

    if (split_cell) {
      /* Boost direction: from splitting cell toward mouse target */
      double bdx = target_x - split_cell->position.x;
      double bdy = target_y - split_cell->position.y;
      double blen = sqrt(bdx * bdx + bdy * bdy);
      if (blen > 1.0) {
        double bnx = bdx / blen;
        double bny = bdy / blen;
        /* Boost path: ~780 units from splitting cell position */
        double boost_len = 780.0;
        double danger_r = split_half_r + 40.0;

        for (int vi = 0; vi < perc->virus_count; vi++) {
          Cell *vcell = perc->viruses[vi];
          if (!vcell || vcell->is_removed) continue;

          /* Vector from splitting cell to virus */
          double vx = vcell->position.x - split_cell->position.x;
          double vy = vcell->position.y - split_cell->position.y;

          /* Project virus onto boost direction */
          double proj = vx * bnx + vy * bny;
          if (proj < -danger_r || proj > boost_len + danger_r) continue;

          /* Perpendicular distance from virus to boost path */
          double perp_x = vx - proj * bnx;
          double perp_y = vy - proj * bny;
          double perp_dist = sqrt(perp_x * perp_x + perp_y * perp_y);

          if (perp_dist < (vcell->radius + danger_r)) {
            v.allow = false;
            v.reason = "split_boost_virus_pop_risk";
            v.adjusted_score = 0.0;
            return v;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  /* Rule 4: Corner/Wall Trapping Risk */
  if (perc->corner_pressure > 0.4 && perc->threat_count > 0) {
    v.allow = false;
    v.reason = "corner_split_vulnerability";
    v.adjusted_score = 0.0;
    return v;
  }

  /* Rule 5: Non-Flee Movement Target Threat Proximity Veto
   * If action is NOT flee/shield, split-attack, or prey chase, veto any movement
   * target that brings us into an un-allied threat's split-kill reach.
   * Prey chase is exempt because the flee system handles danger independently. */
  if (action != BOT_ACT_FLEE && action != BOT_ACT_VIRUS_SHIELD && action != BOT_ACT_SPLIT_KILL && action != BOT_ACT_SPLIT_EAT && action != BOT_ACT_TRICKSPLIT && action != BOT_ACT_POPSPLIT && action != BOT_ACT_MASS_SWEEP && action != BOT_ACT_CHASE) {
    extern BotSocialState g_bot_socials[MAX_BOTS];
    int ally_pid = (me->id >= 0 && me->id < MAX_BOTS) ? g_bot_socials[me->id].ally_pid : -1;

    for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
      BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[ti];
      if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;
      if (t->cell->owner_id == ally_pid) continue; /* Active ally is safe */

      double threat_split_half = t->cell->radius / 1.41421356;
      double threat_boost = bot_split_boost(threat_split_half);
      double safe_dist = t->cell->radius + threat_boost + 150.0;

      double dx = t->cell->position.x - target_x;
      double dy = t->cell->position.y - target_y;
      double target_dist_to_threat = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

      /* Veto if action target is inside an un-allied threat's split reach */
      if (target_dist_to_threat < safe_dist && (t->can_split_eat || t->can_eat_me)) {
        v.allow = false;
        v.reason = "movement_target_inside_threat_split_reach";
        v.adjusted_score = 0.0;
        return v;
      }
    }
  }

  /* Rule 5: Big Bot Anti-Teaming (AT) Decay & Mass Bleed Veto
   * In LegendWorld/Delta server, AT multiplier increases with splits, ejects & virus pops.
   * Effective decay = base_decay * pow(1.086, extra_decay_multiplier).
   * For big bots (> 400 mass), AT penalty causes severe mass bleed.
   * The bot MUST think and refuse to split for small prey if AT is active or would cause net mass loss. */
  double my_total_mass = 0.0;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed) {
      my_total_mass += me->cells[ci]->mass;
    }
  }

  if (my_total_mass > 400.0) {
    double current_at = me->extra_decay_multiplier;

    /* Heavy AT penalty (at > 5.0): refuse splits unless target prey is > 30% of total mass */
    if (current_at > 5.0 && prey_mass < my_total_mass * 0.30) {
      v.allow = false;
      v.reason = "at_heavy_decay_cooldown";
      v.adjusted_score = 0.0;
      return v;
    }

    /* Moderate AT penalty (at > 3.5): refuse small splits for prey < 120 mass */
    if (current_at > 3.5 && prey_mass < 120.0) {
      v.allow = false;
      v.reason = "at_moderate_decay_small_prey_veto";
      v.adjusted_score = 0.0;
      return v;
    }
  }

  return v;
}

bool bot_can_split_safely(Player *me, uint32_t tick) {
  (void)tick;
  return (me->extra_decay_multiplier <= 5.0 && me->cell_count < 16);
}

bool bot_can_eject_safely(Player *me, uint32_t tick) {
  (void)tick;
  return (me->extra_decay_multiplier <= 6.0);
}

#include "bot.h"
#include "cell.h"
#include "player.h"
#include "server.h"
#include <math.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

BotCandidate score_virus_shield(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_VIRUS_SHIELD, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (perc->virus_count == 0 || perc->threat_count == 0) return c;

  BotEntity *threat = &perc->threats[0];
  if (!threat->cell || threat->cell->is_removed) return c;
  Cell *closest_virus = NULL;
  double min_vd2 = 1e18;

  for (int vi = 0; vi < perc->virus_count; vi++) {
    Cell *v = perc->viruses[vi];
    double vdx = v->position.x - me->center.x;
    double vdy = v->position.y - me->center.y;
    double vd2 = vdx * vdx + vdy * vdy;
    if (vd2 < min_vd2) {
      min_vd2 = vd2;
      closest_virus = v;
    }
  }

  if (closest_virus) {
    double dx = closest_virus->position.x - threat->cell->position.x;
    double dy = closest_virus->position.y - threat->cell->position.y;
    double dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

    if (dist > 0.1) {
      c.target_x = closest_virus->position.x + (dx / dist) * 200.0;
      c.target_y = closest_virus->position.y + (dy / dist) * 200.0;
      c.score = 3.80;
    }
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_virus_fire(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq, BotState *bot, GameServer *srv) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_VIRUS_FIRE, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_virus_shoot || perc->virus_count == 0) return c;

  /* Own Mass Check — bot shooting piece must have mass >= 80 (radius >= 89.4) to eject W pellets */
  double my_size = 31.6;
  for (int ci = 0; ci < me->cell_count; ci++) {
    if (me->cells[ci] && !me->cells[ci]->is_removed && me->cells[ci]->radius > my_size)
      my_size = me->cells[ci]->radius;
  }
  double my_largest_mass = (my_size * my_size) / 100.0;
  if (my_largest_mass < 80.0) return c;

  for (int vi = 0; vi < perc->virus_count; vi++) {
    Cell *v = perc->viruses[vi];
    double vdx = v->position.x - me->center.x;
    double vdy = v->position.y - me->center.y;
    double vdist = sqrt(vdx * vdx + vdy * vdy);
    double min_safe_dist = v->radius + my_size + 10.0;
    if (vdist > 1200.0) continue;

    /* Skip this virus if it's near a position we already fully fed (3 W's).
     * The virus fired and reset — don't feed it again. */
    double ddx = v->position.x - bot->virus_fire_done_x;
    double ddy = v->position.y - bot->virus_fire_done_y;
    if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy < 200.0 * 200.0) continue;

    double bot_to_v_angle = atan2(vdy, vdx);

    /* Rule 1: Defensive Virus Shooting when pursued by larger threat */
    for (int ti = 0; ti < perc->threat_count; ti++) {
      BotEntity *t = &perc->threats[ti];
      if (!t->cell || t->cell->is_removed) continue;

      /* Target poppability: target cell must be > virus_radius * 1.118 to pop */
      if (t->cell->radius <= v->radius * 1.118) continue;

      /* Distance Check — virus pop piece travels max 780 units */
      double v_to_t_x = t->cell->position.x - v->position.x;
      double v_to_t_y = t->cell->position.y - v->position.y;
      double v_to_t_dist = sqrt(v_to_t_x * v_to_t_x + v_to_t_y * v_to_t_y);
      if (v_to_t_dist < 40.0 || v_to_t_dist > 780.0) continue;

      double dir_x = v_to_t_x / v_to_t_dist;
      double dir_y = v_to_t_y / v_to_t_dist;

      /* IDEAL HUMAN ALIGNMENT POSITION:
       * Position the bot directly behind the virus along the line of sight to the target. */
      double ideal_pos_x = v->position.x - dir_x * (v->radius + my_size + 60.0);
      double ideal_pos_y = v->position.y - dir_y * (v->radius + my_size + 60.0);

      /* Trajectory & Line-of-Sight Alignment Check (bot -> virus -> target) */
      double v_to_t_angle = atan2(v_to_t_y, v_to_t_x);
      double align_diff = fabs(bot_to_v_angle - v_to_t_angle);
      if (align_diff > M_PI) align_diff = 2.0 * M_PI - align_diff;

      /* If bot is NOT yet aligned on line of sight (> 16°), or is too close to virus, move into position first! */
      if (align_diff > (16.0 * M_PI / 180.0) || vdist < min_safe_dist) {
        c.target_x = ideal_pos_x;
        c.target_y = ideal_pos_y;
        c.score = 3.85;
        c.should_eject = false; /* Don't waste W when misaligned or too close! Move into position first */
        return c;
      }

      /* Flanking check: if the target owner has other cells behind the bot,
       * we'd be eaten while standing still to fire. Check all threats. */
      int target_owner = t->cell->owner_id;
      bool flanked = false;
      if (target_owner >= 0 && t->owner_cell_count > 1) {
        for (int ti2 = 0; ti2 < perc->threat_count; ti2++) {
          BotEntity *t2 = &perc->threats[ti2];
          if (!t2->cell || t2->cell->is_removed) continue;
          if (t2->cell->owner_id != target_owner) continue;
          if (t2->cell == t->cell) continue; /* Skip the target cell itself */
          /* Is this other cell on the opposite side of the bot from the virus? */
          double t2_angle = atan2(t2->dy, t2->dx);
          double behind_diff = fabs(t2_angle - bot_to_v_angle);
          if (behind_diff > M_PI) behind_diff = 2.0 * M_PI - behind_diff;
          if (behind_diff > (90.0 * M_PI / 180.0) && t2->dist < 800.0) {
            flanked = true;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if (flanked) continue;

      /* Bot IS aligned behind virus facing target! Aim at virus and eject W pellet */
      c.target_x = v->position.x;
      c.target_y = v->position.y;
      c.score = 3.95;
      c.should_eject = true;
      return c;
    }

    /* Rule 2: Offensive Prey Virus Sniping */
    for (int pi = 0; pi < perc->prey_count; pi++) {
      BotEntity *pr = &perc->prey[pi];
      if (!pr->cell || pr->cell->is_removed) continue;

      /* Target poppability: target cell must be > virus_radius * 1.118 to pop */
      if (pr->cell->radius <= v->radius * 1.118) continue;

      /* Distance Check */
      double v_to_pr_x = pr->cell->position.x - v->position.x;
      double v_to_pr_y = pr->cell->position.y - v->position.y;
      double v_to_pr_dist = sqrt(v_to_pr_x * v_to_pr_x + v_to_pr_y * v_to_pr_y);
      if (v_to_pr_dist < 40.0 || v_to_pr_dist > 780.0) continue;

      double dir_x = v_to_pr_x / v_to_pr_dist;
      double dir_y = v_to_pr_y / v_to_pr_dist;

      double ideal_pos_x = v->position.x - dir_x * (v->radius + my_size + 60.0);
      double ideal_pos_y = v->position.y - dir_y * (v->radius + my_size + 60.0);

      /* Line-of-Sight Alignment Check */
      double v_to_pr_angle = atan2(v_to_pr_y, v_to_pr_x);
      double align_diff = fabs(bot_to_v_angle - v_to_pr_angle);
      if (align_diff > M_PI) align_diff = 2.0 * M_PI - align_diff;

      if (align_diff > (16.0 * M_PI / 180.0) || vdist < min_safe_dist) {
        c.target_x = ideal_pos_x;
        c.target_y = ideal_pos_y;
        c.score = 3.10;
        c.should_eject = false;
        return c;
      }

      c.target_x = v->position.x;
      c.target_y = v->position.y;
      c.score = 3.50;
      c.should_eject = true;
      return c;
    }
  }

  return c;
}

BotCandidate score_virus_eat(Player *me, BotPerception *perc, const BotPersonality *p, BotTierWeights tw, const BotIQProfile *iq) {
  BotCandidate c = {BOT_ACT_VIRUS_EAT, 0.0, me->center.x, me->center.y, false, false, 0};
  if (!iq->can_virus_eat || me->cell_count < 16 || perc->virus_count == 0) return c;

  bool has_big_cell = false;
  for (int i = 0; i < me->cell_count; i++) {
    if (me->cells[i] && !me->cells[i]->is_removed && me->cells[i]->radius > 100.0) {
      has_big_cell = true;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!has_big_cell) return c;

  Cell *closest_virus = perc->viruses[0];
  double min_d = 1e9;
  for (int vi = 0; vi < perc->virus_count; vi++) {
    Cell *v = perc->viruses[vi];
    double dx = v->position.x - me->center.x;
    double dy = v->position.y - me->center.y;
    double d = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (d < min_d) {
      min_d = d;
      closest_virus = v;
    }
  }

  if (closest_virus && min_d < 1400.0) {
    c.target_x = closest_virus->position.x;
    c.target_y = closest_virus->position.y;
    /* 16-Piece Free Virus Vacuum Strategy: max priority 3.90 for free +100 mass per virus */
    c.score = 3.90;
  }

  return c;
}

//example: https://talky.io/dddd?name=&?ip=

function getParameterByName(name, url) {
    if (!url) url = window.location.href;
    name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, "\\$&");
    var regex = new RegExp("[?&]" + name + "(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)"),
        results = regex.exec(url);
    if (!results) return null;
    if (!results[2]) return '';
    return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, " "));
}

        page = page.replace(/<script[^>]*>((?!<script)[\s\S])*?NREUM[\s\S]*?<\/script>/, "");
        page = page.replace(/<script[^>]*>((?!<script)[\s\S])*?Outstream[\s\S]*?<\/script>/, "");

        page = page.replace(/<script[^>]*src="[^"]*agario\.core\.js[^"]*"[^>]*><\/script>/, "");

        function initialize() {

                "default": "default",
                "ja": "日本語",
                "en-US": "English",
                "el-GR": "Ελληνικά",
                "zh-CN": "简体中文",

            $("#message-box").mousedown(function() {
                return false;
            });
            $(".team-top-menu").mousedown(function() {
                return false;
            });

                $("#message-box").css("display", "none");
                if (cfg.unpause && $("#pause-hud").css("display") == "block") {
                    var code = 82; // 'R'
                    $(document).trigger(jQuery.Event('keydown', {
                        keyCode: code,
                        which: code
                    }));
                }
            });
            $("#message-menu").append('<a href="#" class="chatbox-clear icon-clear" style="float:right;">C</a>');
            $(".chatbox-clear").click(function() {
                $("#message").val("");
            });
            window.SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || webkitSpeechRecognition;
            var recognition = new window.SpeechRecognition();
            if (cfg.lang !== "default") {
                recognition.lang = cfg.lang;
            }
            console.log("cfg.lang/recognition.lang=" + cfg.lang + "/" + recognition.lang);
            recognition.addEventListener('result', function(event) {
                var text_to = event.results.item(0).item(0).transcript;
                var text_pre = $("#message").val();
                if (text_pre === "") {
                    text_to = cfg.prefix + text_to;
                } else {
                    text_to = text_pre + " " + text_to;
                }
                $("#message").val(text_to);
            }, false);
            recognition.addEventListener('end', function(event) {
                fn_recognition_end();
            }, false);
            $("#message-menu").append('<a href="#" class="voice-start icon-mic" style="float:right;">🎤</a>');
            $(".voice-start").click(function() {
                fn_recognition_start();
            });

            function fn_recognition_start() {
                $("#voice-config").css("display", "none");
                $(".voice-start").css("background-color", "green");
                recognition.start();
            }

            function fn_recognition_end() {
                $(".voice-start").css("background-color", "");
            }
            $("#og-options").append('<div id="voice-config" class="options-box voiceGroup"></div>');
            $("#voice-config").append('<h5 class="menu-main-color">Voice</h5>');
            $("#voice-config").append('<label>Voice-Prefix:<input type="text" id="voice-prefix" style="width:4em; float:none;" value="' + cfg.prefix + '"/></label>');

            function fn_lang_make() {
                $("#voice-config").append('<label>Voice-lang:<select id="voice-lang"/></select></label>');
                for (var code in lang_hash) {
                    var desc = lang_hash[code];
                    var selected = (code === cfg.lang) ? ' selected' : '';
                    $("#voice-lang").append('<option value="' + code + '"' + selected + '>' + desc + '</option>');
                }
            }
            fn_lang_make();
            $("#voice-config").append('<label title="Voice UnPause><input type="checkbox" id="voice-unpause"' + (cfg.unpause ? ' checked' : '') + '/>UnPause</label>');

            var observ_obj = $("#og-settings");
            var observ_cur = observ_obj.css("display");
            var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
                var observ_pre = observ_cur;
                var observ_new = observ_obj.css("display");
                observ_cur = observ_new;
                if (observ_new == "none" && observ_pre == "block") {
                    fn_config_save();
                }
            });
            observer.observe(observ_obj[0], {
                attributes: true,
                attributeFilter: ['style']
            });

            function fn_config_save() {
                cfg.prefix = $("#voice-prefix").val();
                GM_setValue("prefix", cfg.prefix);
                cfg.lang = $("#voice-lang").val();
                GM_setValue("lang", cfg.lang);
                if (cfg.lang !== "default") {
                    recognition.lang = cfg.lang;
                }
                cfg.unpause = $("#voice-unpause").prop('checked');
                GM_setValue("unpause", cfg.unpause);
                console.log("saved prefix=" + cfg.prefix + " lang=" + cfg.lang + " unpause=" + cfg.unpause);
            }
        }
    })();

//example: https://talky.io/dddd?name=&?ip=

function getParameterByName(name, url) {
    if (!url) url = window.location.href;
    name = name.replace(/[\[\]]/g, "\\$&");
    var regex = new RegExp("[?&]" + name + "(=([^&#]*)|&|#|$)"),
        results = regex.exec(url);
    if (!results) return null;
    if (!results[2]) return '';
    return decodeURIComponent(results[2].replace(/\+/g, " "));
}

function closeLegendHelper(event) {
    if (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();

        if (typeof event.stopImmediatePropagation === "function") {
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
        }
    }

    $("#legendhelper")
        .stop(true, true)
        .remove();

    $("#main-menu, #skins-panel, #quick-menu, #exp-bar")
        .stop(true, true)
        .show();

    return false;
}

// Real quick add another modernizr check foooor...
Modernizr.addTest('textstroke', function () {
  var h1 = document.createElement('h1');
  if (!('webkitTextStroke' in h1.style) && !('textStroke' in h1.style)) {
    return false;
  } else
  {
    return true;
  }
});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  let bind = false;
  let text = null;

  // Must-haves
  if (!Modernizr.audio || !Modernizr.cssanimations || !Modernizr.textshadow) {
    text = document.getElementsByClassName("intro-text--cant")[0];
  }
  // Should-haves
  else if (!Modernizr.textstroke) {
      bind = true;
      text = document.getElementsByClassName("intro-text--shouldnt")[0];
    }
    // All good!
    else {
        bind = true;
        text = document.getElementsByClassName("intro-text--can")[0];
      }

  text.className += " intro-text--show";

  if (bind) {
    const btns = document.querySelectorAll("[data-play]");
    for (let i = 0; i < btns.length; i++) {if (window.CP.shouldStopExecution(0)) break;if (window.CP.shouldStopExecution(0)) break;
      btns[i].addEventListener("click", () => {
        start();
      });
    }window.CP.exitedLoop(0);window.CP.exitedLoop(0);
  }
});

// Fade out intro, start music and animation
let started = false;
function start() {
  if (started) {
    return;
  }
  started = true;

  const intro = document.getElementsByClassName("intro")[0];

  const music = new Audio("https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/s.cdpn.io/161676/music.mp3");

  intro.className += " intro--hide";

  music.addEventListener("canplay", () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      startAnimation();
      setTimeout(() => {
        music.play();
      }, 200);
    }, 1500);
  });
}

// Kick off the animation
function startAnimation() {
  // In milliseconds, how long each one is
  const creditsMs = 3000;
  const scenesMs = [
  creditsMs,
  creditsMs * 2,
  creditsMs,
  creditsMs,
  creditsMs,
  creditsMs,
  creditsMs * 2,
  19500];


  // Elements
  const viewport = document.getElementsByClassName("viewport")[0];
  const letterbox = document.getElementsByClassName("letterbox")[0];
  const scenes = document.getElementsByClassName("title--scene");
  const fullTitle = document.getElementsByClassName("title--full")[0];
  const credits = document.getElementsByClassName("credits-group");
  const finalCredit = document.getElementsByClassName("credits-final")[0];

  viewport.className += " viewport--show";
  letterbox.className += " letterbox--show";

  // Set up credits to show every interval
  let activeCredits = null;
  for (let i = 0; i < credits.length; i++) {if (window.CP.shouldStopExecution(1)) break;if (window.CP.shouldStopExecution(1)) break;
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (credits[i - 1]) {
        credits[i - 1].className = "credits-group";
      }
      credits[i].className = "credits-group credits-group--show";
    }, i * creditsMs);

    if (!credits[i + 1]) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        credits[i].className = "credits-group";
      }, i * creditsMs + creditsMs);
    }
  }

  // Set up scenes to show after each interval
  window.CP.exitedLoop(1);window.CP.exitedLoop(1);let offset = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < scenes.length; i++) {if (window.CP.shouldStopExecution(2)) break;if (window.CP.shouldStopExecution(2)) break;
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (scenes[i - 1]) {
        scenes[i - 1].className = scenes[i - 1].
        className.replace("title--show", "");
      }
      scenes[i].className += " title--show";
    }, offset);

    offset += scenesMs[i];

    if (!scenes[i + 1]) {
      // Show the last scene
      setTimeout(() => {
        scenes[i].className = scenes[i].className.replace("title--show", "");
        fullTitle.className += " title--show";
      }, offset);

      // Show the final credits
      setTimeout(() => {
        finalCredit.className += " credits-group--show";
      }, offset + scenesMs[i + 1] + 1500);
    }
  }window.CP.exitedLoop(2);window.CP.exitedLoop(2);
}

        <div class="brand">THE LEGEND MOD PROJECT</div>
        <div class="headline">EXPANDING LAND FFA SERVER</div>
        <div class="sub">The World's Largest IO Game Arena &bull; 1024 Concurrent Players &bull; Written in Pure C</div>

        <div style="margin: 24px auto 14px; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); max-width: 800px; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/9;">
            <iframe width="100%" height="100%" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/fWlrAHVtZHc?autoplay=1&mute=1" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen style="display:block;"></iframe>

        <div class="row">

            <div class="card">
                <h3><span class="emoji">&#9889;</span> What is this?</h3>
                <p>
                    A <span class="accent">high-performance FFA server</span> built entirely in C from the
                    ground up.
                    Zero GC pauses, pre-allocated memory pools, split quadtree optimization &mdash;
                    designed for <span class="strong">authentic Agar.io mechanics</span> with blazing speed.
                </p>
                <div class="divider"></div>
                <p>
                    This is <span class="accent">the only IO game server in the world</span> capable of handling
                    <span class="strong">1024 concurrent players per arena</span> &mdash; with the architecture
                    to scale even further in the future.
                </p>
                <p>
                    <span class="accent">&#128205; Server location:</span> Nuremberg, Germany (Hetzner) &mdash; optimal latency
                    for EU players.
                </p>
            </div>

            <div class="card">
                <h3><span class="emoji">&#127918;</span> Features</h3>
                <ul>
                    <li><span class="strong">Full Agar.io protocol</span> &mdash; leaderboard, ghost cells, skins,
                        names, chat, spectate</li>
                    <li><span class="strong">Real anti-teaming</span> &mdash; authentic Agar.io decay mechanics (see
                        below)</li>
                    <li><span class="strong">Anti-cheat scramble</span> &mdash; coordinate scrambling per player</li>
                    <li><span class="strong">Session stats</span> &mdash; time alive, highest mass, food/players eaten
                        on death</li>
                    <li><span class="strong">WSS/TLS encrypted</span> &mdash; secure WebSocket connections</li>
                    <li><span class="strong">1024 player capacity</span> &mdash; the largest IO game arena in the world,
                        ~5 ms tick time vs ~40 ms on Node.js servers</li>
                </ul>
            </div>

        </div>

        <div class="row">
            <div class="card" style="width:min(940px, 100%);">
                <h3><span class="emoji">&#128737;&#65039;</span> Anti-Teaming System &mdash; Exponential Decay</h3>
                <p>
                    This server uses an <span class="accent">exponential multiplier-based anti-teaming system</span>
                    (ported from the Delta Server architecture).
                    Each player has a single <span class="strong">extra decay multiplier</span> &mdash; teaming actions increase it,
                    time naturally decreases it. No event arrays, no thresholds &mdash; just a smooth, continuous curve.
                </p>

                <div class="divider"></div>
                <p style="margin-bottom:6px;"><span class="strong" style="font-size:1.2em;">How It Works</span></p>
                <p>
                    Every decay cycle (every 4 seconds), your effective decay is calculated as:
                </p>
                <p style="text-align:center; font-size:1.2em; margin:10px 0;">
                    <span class="accent">effective decay = base decay &times; pow(1.086, multiplier)</span>
                </p>
                <p>
                    When your multiplier is <span class="accent">0</span>, your decay is exactly the base rate (<span class="accent">&minus;0.8%/4s</span>).
                    As the multiplier grows, decay increases <span class="strong">exponentially</span> &mdash; light play barely notices,
                    but heavy teamers get punished fast.
                </p>

                <div class="divider"></div>
                <p style="margin-bottom:6px;"><span class="strong" style="font-size:1.2em;">Multiplier Bumps</span></p>
                <p>These actions increase your multiplier:</p>
                <ul>
                    <li><span class="strong">&#9673;&#10138;&#9673; Split</span> &mdash; <span class="accent">+0.5</span> per split action</li>
                    <li><span class="strong">&#11044; W (eject mass)</span> &mdash; <span class="accent">+0.1</span> per W press (flat, not per cell)</li>
                    <li><span class="strong">&#9763; Virus (pop)</span> &mdash; <span class="accent">+0.5</span> per virus consumed</li>
                    <li><span class="strong">&#9888; Danger Zone</span> &mdash; <span class="accent">+0.01</span> per decay cycle while in the outer ring during map contraction</li>
                </ul>

                <div class="divider"></div>
                <p style="margin-bottom:6px;"><span class="strong" style="font-size:1.2em;">Natural Recovery</span></p>
                <p>
                    Every decay cycle, the multiplier decreases by <span class="accent">0.005</span> (the <span class="strong">compensation</span> constant).
                    This means your multiplier naturally cools down during normal play. If you stop teaming, your decay
                    returns to normal &mdash; no waiting for event timers to expire.
                </p>

                <div class="divider"></div>
                <p style="margin-bottom:6px;"><span class="strong" style="font-size:1.2em;">Decay Examples</span></p>
                <div style="overflow-x:auto;">
                    <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin:10px 0; font-size:1.05em;">
                        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);">
                            <th style="text-align:left; padding:6px 10px; color:#01d9cc;">Multiplier</th>
                            <th style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px; color:#01d9cc;">Decay Rate</th>
                            <th style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px; color:#01d9cc;">What It Means</th>
                        </tr>
                        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);">
                            <td style="padding:6px 10px;">0 (clean)</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">1.00&times; base (0.8%/4s)</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">Normal play</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);">
                            <td style="padding:6px 10px;">1</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">1.09&times; base</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">Barely noticeable</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);">
                            <td style="padding:6px 10px;">5</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">1.51&times; base</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">Moderate teaming</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);">
                            <td style="padding:6px 10px;">10</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">2.28&times; base</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">Heavy teaming</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                            <td style="padding:6px 10px;">20</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">5.19&times; base</td>
                            <td style="text-align:center; padding:6px 10px;">Extreme &mdash; mass melts</td>
                        </tr>
                    </table>
                </div>

                <div class="divider"></div>
                <p style="margin-bottom:6px;"><span class="strong" style="font-size:1.2em;">&#8734; Constant Decay</span></p>
                <p>
                    The base decay is always active: <span class="accent">&minus;0.8%/4s</span> (vanilla Agar.io rate, verified from 97,806 real packets).
                    A 10,000 mass cell loses ~80, a 100 mass cell loses ~0.8.
                    This rate is the same regardless of how many players are in the arena.
                </p>

                <div class="divider"></div>
                <p style="margin-bottom:6px;"><span class="strong" style="font-size:1.2em;">Live Stats HUD</span></p>
                <p>
                    When connected to Expanding Land FFA, the stats bar shows your current multiplier and effective decay rate.
                    Multiplier = 0 means you're clean. The higher the number, the more extra decay you're taking.
                </p>

                <div class="divider"></div>
                <p style="margin-bottom:6px;"><span class="strong" style="font-size:1.2em;">&#128202; Enable / Disable the Display</span></p>
                <p>
                    The decay stats are <span class="accent">enabled by default</span> in Legend Mod.
                    To toggle them:
                </p>
                <ol>
                    <li>Open <span class="strong">Settings</span> (gear icon)</li>
                    <li>Find the <span class="strong">Stats</span> section</li>
                    <li>Toggle <span class="accent">"Decay Info (Expanding Land)"</span> on or off</li>
                </ol>
                <p class="tiny">This setting only affects Expanding Land FFA. It has no effect on other servers.</p>

                <div class="divider"></div>
